verses.english_text: And spend in the way of Allah, and do not cause your death, and do good deeds, and verily Allah likes the person doing good work.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَنفِقُوا فِى سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ وَ لَا تُلْقُوا بِاَيْدِيكُمْ اِلَى التَّهْلُكَةِ ۛ وَ اَحْسِنُوْا  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Complete Hajj or Umrah only for Allah, if you are helpless, you may sacrifice as per your capacity and do not shave your head until sacrifice reaches its destination, and if someone is sick or have some disease of head, than fasting or giving charity or sacrifice are the replacement of the same, and if somebody is performing Umrah instead of Hajj than he should offer sacrifice as per his capacity and if one cannot offer sacrifice than fasting of 3 days should be observed during the Hajj period and 7 days of fasting should be observed, after returning home, command of these ten days are for those whose sons are not residing in the vicinity of Sacred Mosque, and keep fearing Allah and know that He gives grievous punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَتِمُّوا الْحَجَّ وَ الْعُمْرَةَ لِلّٰهِ  فَاِنْ اُحْصِرْتُمْ فَمَا اسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ الْهَدْىِ  وَ لَا تَحْلِقُوا رُءُوْسَكُمْ حَتّٰى يَبْلُغَ الْهَدْىُ مَحِلَّهُ  فَمَن كَانَ مِنكُم مَّرِيضًا اَوْ بِهِٓ اَذًى مِّنْ رَّاْسِهِ فَفِدْيَةٌ مِّنْ صِيَامٍ اَوْ صَدَقَةٍ اَوْ نُسُكٍ  فَاِذَآ اَمِنتُمْ    فَمَن تَمَتَّعَ بِالْعُمْرَةِ اِلَى الْحَجِّ فَمَا اسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ الْهَدْىِ  فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ ثَلٰثَةِ اَيَّامٍ فِى الْحَجِّ وَ سَبْعَةٍ اِذَا رَجَعْتُمْ   تِلْكَ عَشَرَةٌ كَامِلَةٌ   ذٰلِكَ لِمَن لَّمْ يَكُنْ اَهْلُهُ حَاضِرِى الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ   وَ اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اعْلَمُوٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ

verses.english_text: Months of performing of Hajj is known, whosoever decide to perform Hajj then it is imperative on him from wearing of Ahram till the end of Hajj should not do intercourse, fight or commit any sin, Allah knows the good work very well and make provision and the best provision is piety, and O wise one keep fearing Me.
verses.arabic_text: الْحَجُّ اَشْهُرٌ مَّعْلُوماتٌ  فَمَنْ فَرَضَ فِيهِنَّ الْحَجَّ فَلَا رَفَثَ وَ لَا فُسُوْقَ وَ لَا جِدَ الَ فِى الْحَجِّ   وَ مَا تَفْعَلُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ يَّعْلَمْهُ اللّٰهُ   وَ تَزَوَّدُوا فَاِنَّ خَيْرَ الزَّادِ التَّقْوٰى  وَ اتَّقُونِ يٰٓاُولِى الْاَلْبابِ

verses.english_text: There is no harm if you seek the benefit of His Blessings during the Hajj period, when you leave Arafat then remember Allah near Mashar al-Haram as has been told to you, however earlier you were among strayed ones.
verses.arabic_text: لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ اَن تَبْتَغُوا فَضْلًا مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ  فَاِذَآ اَفَضْتُم مِّنْ عَرَفاتٍ فَاذْكُرُوا اللّٰهَ عِنْدَ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ  وَ اذْكُرُوْهُ كَمَا هَدٰكُمْ  وَ اِن كُنتُم مِّن قَبْلِهِ لَمِنَ الضَّآلِّينَ

verses.english_text: Then you also leave with others asking forgiveness from Allah, verily Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَفِيضُوا مِنْ حَيْثُ اَفَاضَ النَّاسُ وَ اسْتَغْفِرُوا اللّٰهَ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

verses.english_text: When you complete the Hajj rites then remember Allah as you remember your forefathers, and even more, and there are some people who ask for benefits in this world only, then they would not have any share on the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا قَضَيْتُمْ مَّنَاسِكَكُمْ فَاذْكُرُوا اللّٰهَ كَذِكْرِكُمْ اٰبَآءَكُمْ اَوْ اَشَدَّ ذِكْرًا   فَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ اٰتِنَا فِى الدُّنْيَا وَ مَا لَهُ فِى الْاٰخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَاقٍ

verses.english_text: And there are some people who say O Lord give us the benefits of this world and also reward on the Day of Judgement and save us from Hell-Fire.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِنْهُم مَّن يَّقُولُ رَبَّنَآ اٰتِنَا فِى الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّ فِى الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَّ قِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

verses.english_text: These are people who will have their portion of what they have earned and Allah is quick in taking account.
verses.arabic_text: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ نَصِيبٌ مِّمَّا كَسَبُوا  وَاللّٰهُ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ

verses.english_text: And remember Allah for a few appointed days, then if someone hastens and leaves Mina after two days, there is no harm, and if he stays for three days there is no harm also, but this concession is for the pious people, and fear Allah and be sure you will all be called from your graves towards Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اذْكُرُوا اللّٰهَ فِٓى اَيَّامٍ مَّعْدُودٰتٍ  فَمَنْ تَعَجَّلَ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ فَلَآ اِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ  وَ مَنْ تَاَخَّرَ فَلَآ اِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ لِمَنِ اتَّقٰى   وَ اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اعْلَمُٓوْا اَنَّكُمْ اِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! There are certain people who talk sweetly, which looks nice in this world and they swear on Allah for your love, but they are quarrelsome and your enemies.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِنَ النَّاسِ مَنّ يُّعْجِبُكَ قَوْلُهُ فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَ يُشْهِدُ اللّٰهَ عَلَٰى مَا فِى قَلْبِهِ وَ هُوَ اَلَدُّ الْخِصَامِ

verses.english_text: And when he became ruler, he started running here and there to spread disquiet and destroy agriculture and animal life, and Allah does not like perversity.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا تَوَلّٰى سَعٰى فِى الْاَرْضِ لِيُفْسِدَ فِيهَا وَ يُهْلِكَ الْحَرْثَ وَ النَّسْلَ   وَ اللّٰهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْفَسَادَ

verses.english_text: When it is said to fear Allah, the pride incites them to commit sin, so Hell is enough for them and it is very bad place.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا قِيلَ لَهُ اتَّقِ اللّٰهَ اَخَذَتْهُ الْعِزَّةُ بِالْاِثْمِ  فَحَسْبُهُ جَهَنَّمُ  وَ لَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ

verses.english_text: And among them there are people who even sell themselves to please Allah, Allah is very Compassionate for such people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَّشْرِى نَفْسَهُ ابْتِغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِ اللّٰهِ   وَ اللّٰهُ رَءُوفٌ بِالْعِبَادِ

verses.english_text: O Believers! All of you together enter Islam completely and do not follow the footsteps of the Devil because he is your open enemy.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا ادْخُلُوا فِى السِّلْمِ كَآفَّةً وَ لَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوٰتِ الشَّيْطٰنِ  اِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ

verses.english_text: When clear proofs come to you, then why waver, understand clearly that Allah is predominant and a great planner.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنْ زَلَلْتُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْكُمُ الْبَيِّنٰتُ فَاعْلَمُوٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Are they waiting for this only that Allah should come in the shadow of white clouds with angels of punishment and do settle all the things, however all matters return to Allah.
verses.arabic_text: هَلْ يَنظُرُوْنَ اِلَّآ اَنْ يَّاْتِيَهُمُ اللّٰهُ فِى ظُلَلٍ مِّنَ الْغَمَامِ وَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ وَ قُضِىَ الْاَمْرُ  وَ اِلَى اللّٰهِ تُرْجَعُ الْاُمُورُ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Ask Bani Israel how unambiguous signs were given to them, when somebody has received the blessings of Allah and distort it, so undoubtedly Allah gives the severest punishment.
verses.arabic_text: سَلْ بَنِٓى اِسْرآءِيلَ كَمْ اٰتَيْنٰهُم مِّنْ اٰيَةٍ بَيِّنَةٍ   وَ مَن يُّبَدِّلْ نِعْمَةَ اللّٰهِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ

verses.english_text: Who has chosen the infidelity world looks beautiful to them, and they make fun of believers whereas on the Day of Judgement the status of pious ones will be much higher, and Allah gives abundant sustenance to whoever He pleases.
verses.arabic_text: زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا الْحَيٰوةُ الدُّنْيَا وَ يَسْخَرُوْنَ مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا  وَ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ   وَاللّٰهُ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَّشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

verses.english_text: Earlier they were one community, then Allah sent messengers who gave glad tidings and warn them, revealed scriptures with truth, to arbitrate between people who differed, and alas, differing people were only those to whom scriptures were given, then they played mischief, so Allah with His Compassion showed the righteous path to the faithful in which they have disputed, and Allah guide to the right path whomsoever He pleases.
verses.arabic_text: كَانَ النَّاسُ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً فَبَعَثَ اللّٰهُ النَّبِيِّنَ مُبَشِّرِينَ وَ مُنذِرِينَ وَ اَنزَلَ مَعَهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ بِالْحَقِّ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ فِيمَا اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ   وَ مَا اخْتَلَفَ فِيهِ اِلَّا الَّذِينَ اُوتُوهُ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنٰتُ بَغْيًاۢ بَيْنَهُمْ  فَهَدَى اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا لِمَا اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِاِذْنِهِ  وَ اللّٰهُ يَهْدِىْ مَن يَّشَآءُ اِلَٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

verses.english_text: Do you think you will enter Paradise easily, whereas you have not faced the situation which people earlier time has faced, they were encircled with many difficulties like illness, hunger and poverty and they were jolted by earthquake in such a way that messengers and their followers said let us see when the help of Allah will arrive, look do not be disappointed, help of Allah is near.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ اَنْ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ وَ لَمَّا يَاْتِكُمْ مَّثَلُ الَّذِيْنَ خَلَوْا مِن قَبْلِكُم  مَسَّتْهُمُ البَاْسَآءُ وَ الضَّرَّآءُ وَ زُلْزِلُوْا حَتّٰى يَقُولَ الرَّسُولُ وَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا مَعَهُ مَتٰى نَصْرُ اللّٰهِ   اَلَآ اِنَّ نَصْرَ اللّٰهِ قَرِيبٌ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! They ask you what they should spend in the way of Allah, tell them whatever they spend from their rightful earnings is for their parents, relatives and orphans and wayfarer, whatever good work you do Allah knows it.
verses.arabic_text: يَسْئَلُونَكَ مَاذَا يُنْفِقُونَ  قُلْ مَآ اَنْفَقْتُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ فَلِلْوالِدَيْنِ وَ الاَقْرَبِينَ وَ اليَتٰمٰى وَالمَسٰكِينِ وَ ابْنِ السَّبِيلِ   وَ مَا تَفْعَلُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِهِ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Warfare is made imperative on you, however you will dislike it, something you may like but it may not be good for you, and something you may not like but it may be good for you, and Allah knows all but you do not know.
verses.arabic_text: كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِتَالُ وَ هُوَ كُرْهٌ لَّكُمْ  وَ عَسٰٓى اَنْ تَكْرَهُوْا شَيْئًا وَّهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ  وَ عَسٰٓى اَن تُحِبُّوا شَيْئًا وَّ هُوَ شَرٌّ لَّكُمْ   وَ اللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ وَ اَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! They question you whether warfare during the sacred months are allowed, so tell them warfare is great sin in these months, creating hindrance in the way of Allah and denying Allah, and denying entry into Sacred Mosque, is greater sin near Allah, and persecution is much grievous sin than bloodshed, these unbelievers will keep fighting you till they can made you renegades from your religion, and if somebody renegades and dies as unbeliever, such people will not get any reward of their deeds and these are people destined for Hell-Fire and they will remain there forever.
verses.arabic_text: يَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ الشَّهْرِ الحَرَامِ قِتَالٍ فِيهِ  قُلْ قِتَالٌ فِيهِ كَبِيرٌ  وَ صَدٌّ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ وَ كُفْرٌ بِهِ وَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَ اِخْرَاجُ اَهْلِهِ مِنْهُ اَكْبَرُ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ  وَ الْفِتْنَةُ اَكْبَرُ مِنَ الْقَتْلِ   وَ لَا يَزَالُونَ يُقَاتِلُونَكُمْ حَتّٰى يَرُدُّوكُمْ عَنْ دِينِكُمْ اِنِ اسْتَطَاعُوا  وَ مَن يَّرْتَدِدْ مِنكُمْ عَنْ دِينِهِ فَيَمُتْ وَ هُوَ كٰفِرٌ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ حَبِطَتْ اَعْمَالُهُمْ فِى الدُّنْيَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ  وَ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِ  هُمْ فِيهَا خٰلِدُونَ

verses.english_text: Undoubtedly, people who believed and emigrated and fought in the way of Allah, these are people who are hopeful of the Blessings of Allah, and Allah is all Forgiving and Compassionate.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا وَ الَّذِيْنَ هَاجَرُوا وَ جاهَدُوا فِى سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ يَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَ اللّٰهِ  وَ اللّٰهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! These people ask you about liquor and gambling, tell them there is great sin in both these acts, there may be some benefits but sins are greater in them, they ask you what they should spend in the way of Allah tell them, whatever remain with you after spending on your needs, like this Allah describes His commands clearly so you may ponder.
verses.arabic_text: يَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْخَمْرِ وَ الْمَيْسِرِ  قُلْ فِيهِمَآ اِثْمٌ كَبِيرٌ وَّ مَنافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَ اِثْمُهُمَآ اَكْبَرُ مِن نَّفْعِهِمَا   وَ يَسْئَلُونَكَ مَاذَا يُنْفِقُونَ  قُلِ الْعَفْوَ   كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمُ الْاٰيٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَفَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: And in this world and the Hereafter they ask you about orphans, tell them setting their affairs right is better and is better if you mix their affairs with yours, eventually they are your brothers, Allah differentiate between perverts and well-wishers very well, and if He wanted, he could have put you in adversity, and verily Allah has great Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: فِى الدُّنْيَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ  وَ يَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ اليَتٰمٰى  قُلْ اِصْلَاحٌ لَّهُمْ خَيْرٌ  وَ اِن تُخَالِطُوهُمْ فَاِخْوانُكُمْ  وَ اللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ الْمُفْسِدَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِ  وَ لَوْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَاَعْنَتَكُمْ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَزِيْزٌ حَكِيمٌ

verses.english_text: And O believers! Do not marry unbelieving women unless they turn believers, unbelieving women may appear pleasant but faithful women are even better, and do not marry your women to unbelievers until they turn believers, however good unbelieving men may appear but believing men are Verily better, these unbelievers call you towards Hell by offering to marry, but Allah invites you towards Paradise and Forgiveness with His Benignity, and describes His Commands explicitly so the people get guided.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَنْكِحُوا الْمُشْرِكٰتِ حَتّٰى يُؤْمِنَّ  وَ لَاَمَةٌ مُّؤْمِنَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ مُّشْرِكَةٍ وَ لَوْ اَعْجَبَتْكُمْ   وَ لَا تُنكِحُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ حَتّٰى يُؤْمِنُوا  وَ لَعَبْدٌ مُّؤْمِنٌ خَيْرٌ مِّن مُّشْرِكٍ وَّ لَوْ اَعْجَبَكُمْ   اُو۟لٰٓئِكَ يَدْعُونَ اِلَى النَّارِ  وَ اللّٰهُ يَدْعُوٓا اِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ بِاِذْنِهِ  وَ يُبَيِّنُ اٰيٰتِهِ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! They ask you about menstruation, tell them it is discomfort therefore keep away from them during menstruation and do not go near them until they are purified, and when they become pure you can enter from where Allah has allowed you, verify Allah likes pure people and who ask for forgiveness.
verses.arabic_text: وَ يَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ  قُلْ هُوَ اَذًى فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَآءَ فِى الْمَحِيضِ وَ لَا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتّٰى يَطْهُرْنَ  فَاِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ فَاْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ اَمَرَكُمُ اللّٰهُ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ وَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ

verses.english_text: Your wives are tilth for you, you can go there as you like, send good deeds ahead of you and keep fearing Allah and remember that one day you have to be present in front of Him and give them glad tidings for deliverance.
verses.arabic_text: نِسَآؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَّكُمْ فَاْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ اَنّٰى شِئْتُمْ  وَ قَدِّمُوا لِاَنفُسِكُمْ  وَ اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اعْلَمُوٓا اَنَّكُم مُّلٰقُوهُ   وَ بَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And do not make Allah an excuse for doing good work and fearing Allah and arbitrating between people and Allah knows all and hear all.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَجْعَلُوا اللّٰهَ عُرْضَةً لِّاَيْمَانِكُمْ اَن تَبَرُّوْا وَ تَتَّقُوا وَ تُصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ النَّاسِ   وَ اللّٰهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Swearing which unintentionally are uttered Allah will not hold you responsible, but Allah will Verily hold you responsible if you swear intentionally, and He is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ اللّٰهُ بِاللَّغْوِ فِٓى اَيْمَانِكُمْ وَ لٰكِنْ يُّؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا كَسَبَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ   وَ اللّٰهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: People who swear not to go near their wives, they have got intervening time of 4 months to desist from their swearing and return to them, verily Allah is all Forgiving and Compassionate.
verses.arabic_text: لِلَّذِينَ يُؤْلُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ تَرَبُّصُ اَرْبَعَةِ اَشْهُرٍ  فَاِنْ فَآءُوْ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

verses.english_text: And if they have decided to give divorce so verily Allah listens and knows all.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنْ عَزَمُوا الطَّلَاقَ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: The women who have been divorced should wait for three menstrual cycles before marrying again, and if they believe in Allah and the Day of Judgement then it is not permitted for them to hide whatever Allah has created in their wombs, and if their husbands wish for reconciliation, during this period then they are more entitled for it, rights of women and men are same on each other, although men are a degree above women, and Allah has the Great Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الْمُطَلَّقَٰتُ يَتَرَبَّصْنَ بِاَنْفُسِهِنَّ ثَلٰثَةَ قُرُوْٓءٍ  وَ لَا يَحِلُّ لَهُنَّ اَنْ يَكْتُمْنَ مَا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ فِٓى اَرْحَامِهِنَّ اِنْ كُنَّ يُؤْمِنَّ بِاللّٰهِ وَ الْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ  وَ بُعُوْلَتُهُنَّ اَحَقُّ بِرَدِّهِنَّ فِى ذٰلِكَ اِنْ اَرَادُوٓا اِصْلَاحًا  وَ لَهُنَّ مِثْلُ الَّذِى عَلَيْهِنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ  وَ لِلرِّجَالِ عَلَيْهِنَّ دَرَجَةٌ   وَ اللّٰهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Divorce can be give only twice, and third time either they can be stopped or will be finally sent with kindness, and it is not permitted for you to take from them whatever you have already given, unless both fear that they cannot keep within limits of Allah and then if you fear they will not be able to abide by the limits of Allah, in that case if a women give some gift to set herself free, then there is no sin on both, and do not exceed the boundaries set by Allah and whoever cross that boundaries of Allah are among the oppressors.
verses.arabic_text: الطَّلَاقُ مَرَّتٰنِ  فَاِمْسَاكٌۭ بِمَعْرُوفٍ اَوْ تَسْرِيحٌۢ بِاِحْسانٍ  وَ لَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ اَنْ تَاْخُذُوا مِمَّآ اٰتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ شَيْئًا اِلَّاٰ اَن يَّخَافَآ اَلَّا يُقِيْمَا حُدُودَ اللّٰهِ  فَاِنْ خِفْتُمْ اَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ اللّٰهِ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا فِيمَا افْتَدَتْ بِهِ   تِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللّٰهِ فَلَا تَعْتَدُوهَا  وَ مَنْ يَّتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ اللّٰهِ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الظّٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: If a woman is given divorce third time then reconciliation is not possible without her getting married to another man, and if that man divorces her, then there is no sin in reconciliation, if they think they can keep the limits of Allah, and these are limits of Allah, which He explains for sensible persons very clearly.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِن طَلَّقَهَا فَلَا تَحِلُّ لَهُ مِنۢ بَعْدُ حَتّٰى تَنكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ   فَاِن طَلَّقَهَا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَآ اَنْ يَّتَرَاجَعَآ اِنْ ظَنَّآ اَنْ يُقِيْمَا حُدُودَ اللّٰهِ   وَ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللّٰهِ يُبَيِّنُهَا لِقَوْمٍ يَّعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: When you divorce your wives and they reach their prescribed time, either hold them with your good behavior or bid them goodbye with liberality, and do not hold them back to torment or to do excesses, and if you do this you will be doing unjust to yourselves, and do not make mockery of commands of Allah, and remember the Blessings of Allah, He guides you through His Books and words of wisdom, keep fearing Allah and know very well that Allah necessarily know all.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَآءَ فَبَلَغْنَ اَجَلَهُنَّ فَاَمْسِكُوْهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ اَوْ سَرِّحُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ  وَ لَا تُمْسِكُوهُنَّ ضِرَارًا لِّتَعْتَدُوا  وَ مَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُ  وَ لَا تَتَّخِذُوْٓا اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ هُزُوًا  وَ اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ مَآ اَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ الْكِتٰبِ وَ الْحِكْمَةِ يَعِظُكُم بِهِ  وَ اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: And when you give divorce to your women and they complete their prescribed time, do not stop them from marrying again, and when they start living lawfully, Allah advises with His commands, and following this is refining and purification, and you do not know what Allah knows.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَآءَ فَبَلَغْنَ اَجَلَهُنَّ فَلَا تَعْضُلُوهُنَّ اَن يَّنْكِحْنَ اَزْوَاجَهُنَّ اِذَا تَرَاضَوْا بَيْنَهُم بِالْمَعْرُوفِ   ذٰلِكَ يُوعَظُ بِهِ مَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللّٰهِ وَ الْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ   ذٰلِكُمْ اَزْكٰى لَكُمْ وَ اَطْهَرُ   وَ اللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ وَ اَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Women can breastfeed their child for two years and its imperative on the father to arrange the maintenance, food and clothing for her. Nobody is given hardship more than what they can tolerate, so neither mother nor the father of the child should suffer. (if father has died) likewise it is also required by from heirs of father of the child, then if with mutual understanding they wish to end the breastfeeding, then there is no sin on both, and if you want to breastfeed your child by someone else, which is also allowed provided you give whatever has been agreed, and keep fearing Allah and know that whatever you do Allah Verily sees it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الْوَالِدَاتُ يُرْضِعْنَ اَوْلَادَهُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ لِمَنْ اَرَادَ اَنْ يُّتِمَّ الرَّضَاعَةَ  وَ عَلَى الْمَوْلُودِ لَهُ رِزْقُهُنَّ وَ كِسْوَتُهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ  لَا تُكَلَّفُ نَفْسٌ اِلَّا وُسْعَهَا  لَا تُضَآرَّ وَالِدَةٌ بِوَلَدِهَا وَ لَا مَوْلُودٌ لَّهُ بِوَلَدِهِ  وَ عَلَى الْوَارِثِ مِثْلُ ذٰلِكَ  فَاِنْ اَرَادَا فِصَالًا عَنْ تَرَاضٍ مِّنْهُمَا وَ تَشَاوُرٍ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا   وَ اِنْ اَرَدْتُّمْ اَنْ تَسْتَرْضِعُوْٓا اَوْلَادَكُمْ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ اِذَا سَلَّمْتُم مَّآ اٰتَيْتُم بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ   وَ اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

verses.english_text: And whoever dies leaving behind wives, they should keep themselves waiting for four months and ten days, and after they attain that period, they can do whatever they want and there will be no blame on you, and Allah is aware of whatever you do.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنكُمْ وَ يَذَرُوْنَ اَزْوٰاجًا يَّتَرَبَّصْنَ بِاَنفُسِهِنَّ اَرْبَعَةَ اَشْهُرٍ وَّ عَشْرًا  فَاِذَا بَلَغْنَ اَجَلَهُنَّ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيْمَا فَعَلْنَ فِٓىْ اَنْفُسِهِنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ   وَ اللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

verses.english_text: And if you fear that somebody else might propose her, you can symbolically indicate to her or keep to your hearts, there is no harm in it, Allah knows that you will think of marrying her but do not marry secretly, there is no harm in speaking pleasantly and do not even think of marrying them before they complete the term, Allah Verily knows what is in your hearts, so keep fearing Allah and know that Allah is all Forgiving and Forbearing.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيْمَا عَرَّضْتُم بِهِ مِنْ خِطْبَةِ النِّسَآءِ اَوْ اَكْنَنْتُمْ فِٓىْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ  عَلِمَ اللّٰهُ اَنَّكُمْ سَتَذْكُرُونَهُنَّ وَ لٰكِنْ لَّا تُوَاعِدُوهُنَّ سِرًّا اِلَّآ اَنْ تَقُوْلُوْا قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوفًا  وَ لَا تَعْزِمُوْا عُقْدَةَ النِّكَاحِ حَتّٰى يَبْلُغَ الْكِتٰبُ اَجَلَهُ  وَ اعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِْٓى اَنْفُسِكُمْ فَاحْذَرُوهُ  وَ اعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ حَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: And if you give divorce before you have touched your wives and before dower is fixed, then there is no blame on you, however wealthy and poor people should do them favors according to their capacity, and it is a duty upon people who do good work.
verses.arabic_text: لَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ اِنْ طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَآءَ مَا لَمْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ اَوْ تَفْرِضُوا لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً  وَّ مَتِّعُوهُنَّ عَلَى الْمُوْسِعِ قَدَرُهُ وَ عَلَى الْمُقْتِرِ قَدَرُهُ  مَتَاعًۭا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ  حَقًّا عَلَى الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And if you have fixed the dower of woman and divorce them before touching them in private then pay half of the dower, but if woman relinquish it, or their guardian who are empowered relinquish it, then ho harm, but if you give full dower which is very near to piousness and do not forget mutual liberality, and Allah is Verily watching your actions.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِن طَلَّقْتُمُوْهُنَّ مِن قَبْلِ اَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ وَ قَدْ فَرَضْتُمْ لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً فَنِصْفُ مَا فَرَضْتُمْ اِلَّآ اَنْ يَّعْفُوْنَ اَوْ يَعْفُوَ الَّذِى بِيَدِهِ عُقْدَةُ النِّكَاحِ  وَ اَن تَعْفُوْٓا اَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوٰى  وَ لَا تَنسَوُا الْفَضْلَ بَيْنَكُمْ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

verses.english_text: O Muslims! Guard your prayers regularly especially the middle prayer, and stand devoutly only for Allah.
verses.arabic_text: حافِظُوا عَلَى الصَّلٰوتِ وَ الصَّلٰوةِ الْوُسْطٰى وَ قُومُوا لِلّٰهِ قٰنِتِينَ

verses.english_text: Pray even if you are in a fearful situation or walking or riding, then when you become secure remember Allah as has been taught to you which you did not know.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنْ خِفْتُمْ فَرِجَالًا اَوْ رُكْبَانًا  فَاِذَآ اَمِنْتُمْ فَاذْكُرُوا اللّٰهَ كَمَا عَلَّمَكُم مَّا لَمْ تَكُونُوا تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Remember Allah, and who are dying and leaving behind their wives then they should make provision in their will for their maintenance and home stay for one year, thereafter if women leave on their own, you are not to be blamed, Allah is Predominant and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنكُمْ وَ يَذَرُوْنَ اَزْوَاجًا وَّ صِيَّةً لِّاَزْوَاجِهِم مَّتَاعًا اِلَى الْحَوْلِ غَيْرَ اِخْرَاجٍ  فَاِنْ خَرَجْنَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِىْ مَا فَعَلْنَ فِٓىْ اَنْفُسِهِنَّ مِنْ مَّعْرُوفٍ   وَ اللّٰهُ عَزِيْزٌ حَكِيمٌ

verses.english_text: And women whose dower is fixed but are divorced without touching, provision should also be made for them, this is duty of the pious people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لِلْمُطَلَّقٰتِ مَتٰاعٌ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ  حَقًّا عَلَى الْمُتَّقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Allah sent His communications like this so you may understand.
verses.arabic_text: كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمْ اٰيٰتِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Did not you notice them when thousands escaped their homes fearing death, but, Allah commanded them to die and they died, then Allah brought them to life, He is very Compassionate to people but majority do not thank Him.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِيْنَ خَرَجُوا مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَ هُمْ اُلُوْفٌ حَذَرَ الْمَوْتِ فَقَالَ لَهُمُ اللّٰهُ مُوْتُوْا  ثُمَّ اَحْيَاهُمْ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَذُوْ فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: O Muslims, fight in the way of Allah and know that Allah hears and knows everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَاتِلُوا فِى سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ وَ اعْلَمُوٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Is there anyone who can give loan to Allah so He multiplies your wealth, and Allah lessens straitness or amplifies your wealth, and unto Him everyone will return.
verses.arabic_text: مَّن ذَا الَّذِىْ يُقْرِضُ اللّٰهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضٰعِفَهُ لَهُٓ اَضْعَافًا كَثِيْرَةً   وَ اللّٰهُ يَقْبِضُ وَ يَبْصُۜطُ وَ اِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Have not you considered the heads of Bani-Israel tribe when they said to their messenger to appoint a king for them so they can fight in the way of Allah, he said you may not flee when you are asked to fight, they said we have left our abodes and children and have no excuse that we would not fight in the way of Allah, and when fighting was made compulsory all of them fled except a few, and Allah knows the oppressors very well.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الْمَلَاِ مِنْۢ بَنِىْٓ اِسْرآءِيْلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مُوسٰى اِذْ قَالُوا لِنَبِىٍّ لَّهُمُ ابْعَثْ لَنَا مَلِكًا نُّقاتِلْ فِى سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ  قَالَ هَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ اِن كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِتَالُ اَلَّا تُقَاتِلُوا  قَالُوا وَ مَا لَنَآ اَلَّا نُقَاتِلَ فِىْ سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ وَ قَدْ اُخْرِجْنَا مِنْ دِيَارِنَا وَ اَبْنَآئِنَا  فَلَمَّا كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقِتَالُ تَوَلَّوْا اِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّنْهُمْ   وَ اللّٰهُ عَلِيمٌ بِالظّٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And their messenger said to them: Allah has appointed Taloot as king over you, they said we have greater right to the kingship because he is not capable even monetarily Messenger said Allah has given him preference over you and he may not have wealth but Allah has given him knowledge and good physique and Allah may give His kingdom to whoever He pleases and Allah is all capable and knows all.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ قَدْ بَعَثَ لَكُمْ طَالُوتَ مَلِكًا  قَالُوٓا اَنّٰى يَكُوْنُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ عَلَيْنَا وَ نَحْنُ اَحَقُّ بِالْمُلْكِ مِنْهُ وَ لَمْ يُؤْتَ سَعَةً مِّنَ الْمَالِ  قَالَ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ اصْطَفٰهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ زَادَهُ  بَسْطَةً فِى الْعِلْمِ وَ الْجِسْمِ  وَ اللّٰهُ يُؤْتِى مُلْكَهُ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ  وَ اللّٰهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: And their messenger told them as a sign that this kingdom is from Allah that a chest will come to you in which there is tranquility and relics which the children of Moosa and Haroon have left behind, and this chest will be carried by angels. And if you believe, verily there is a sign for you.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ اِنَّ اٰيَةَ مُلْكِهِٓ اَنْ يَّاْتِيَكُمُ التَّابُوتُ فِيْهِ سَكِيْنَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ وَ بَقِيَّةٌ مِّمَّا تَرَكَ اٰلُ مُوسٰى وَ اٰلُ هٰرُونَ تَحْمِلُهُ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ  اِنَّ فِى ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لَّكُمْ اِن كُنْتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: When Taloot left the city with his army he said to his companions you will find a river through which you will be tested, whoever will drink its water will not be on my side and whoever will not drink its water will be definitely on my side, however if you will drink a handful of water there is no harm, when they reached the river, everyone except a few drank its water, when Taloot with the believers crossed the river they said today we do not find strength to confront Jaloot and his army, but who were real believers instantly said that it is seen quite a few times when a small group has vanquished the large group with the help of Allah, and Allah is with those who have patience.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوْتُ بِالْجُنُودِ قَالَ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ مُبْتَلِيْكُم بِنَهَرٍ  فَمَنْ شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَ مَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَاِنَّهُ مِنِّىْٓ اِلَّا مَنِ اغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۭ بِيَدِهِ  فَشَرِبُوا مِنْهُ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا مِّنْهُمْ  فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُ هُوَ وَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا مَعَهُ قَالُوا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا الْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَ جُنُودِهِ  قَالَ الَّذِيْنَ يَظُنُّونَ اَنَّهُم مُّلٰقُوا اللّٰهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍ قَلِيْلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةً كَثِيرَةً بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ   وَاللّٰهُ مَعَ الصّٰبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: At last, when they went to confront the army of Jaloot they prayed, O Lord! Give us patience and make us steadfast in fighting and grant us the victory over the unbelievers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَمَّا بَرَزُواْ لِجَالُوتَ وَ جُنُودِهِ قَالُوا رَبَّنَآ اَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَّثَبِّتْ اَقْدَامَنَا وَ انْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Then they defeated the enemy with the command of Allah and Dawood killed Jaloot, and Allah granted him kingdom and wisdom and knowledge and taught him what He pleased, and if Allah would not have repelled a group through another group, there would have been disorder on the earth, but Allah is Gracious for all the people of the world.
verses.arabic_text: فَهَزَمُوْهُم بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ وَ قَتَلَ دَاوُدُ جَالُوتَ وَ اٰتٰهُ اللّٰهُ الْمُلْكَ وَ الْحِكْمَةَ وَ عَلَّمَهُ مِمَّا يَشَآءُ   وَ لَوْلَا دَفْعُ اللّٰهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لَّفَسَدَتِ الْاَرْضُ وَ لٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى الْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! These are the true verses of Allah which He revealed on you very clearly and Verily you are among the Prophets.
verses.arabic_text: تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ اللّٰهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ  وَاِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: I have given eminence, to some over some messengers whom I have sent, with some of them Allah spoke, and some of them were exalted, and He gave Isa son of Maryam clear miracles and helped him through Sacred Spirit and if Allah pleased, those after them would not have fought among themselves after receiving the distinct miracles, but they were divided among them and some of them accepted the faith but some become infidels and if Allah pleased they would not have fought, but Allah does whatever He pleases.
verses.arabic_text: تِلْكَ الرُّسُلُ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَٰى بَعْضٍۢ  مِّنْهُم مَّنْ كَلَّمَ اللّٰهُ وَ رَفَعَ بَعْضَهُمْ دَرَجٰتٍ  وَ اٰتَيْنَا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ الْبَيِّنٰتِ وَ اَيَّدْنٰهُ بِرُوحِ الْقُدُسِ   وَ لَوْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ مَا اقْتَتَلَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنٰتُ وَ لٰكِنِ اخْتَلَفُوا فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ اٰمَنَ وَ مِنْهُمْ مَّنْ كَفَرَ  وَ لَوْ شَآءُ اللّٰهُ مَا اقْتَتَلُوا  وَ لٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ

verses.english_text: O believers, whatever has been given to you spend in the way of Allah before the day come when here won’t be any trade and no one will help, nor any intercession will be accepted and only infidels are the oppressors.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوٓا اَنْفِقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنٰكُمْ مِّنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يَّاْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا بَيْعٌ فِيْهِ وَ لَا خُلَّةٌ وَّ لَا شَفَاعَةٌ   وَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ هُمُ الظّٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Allah is the Lord, no one else is worthy of worship, he is Everliving, and the world exists because of Him, He does not doze off nor He sleeps, everything in the skies and on the earth belong to Him, and who is there who can intercede with Him without His permission, He know everything; whatever is in present and whatever has happened earlier, and nobody can comprehend anything from His knowledge except whatsoever He pleases, His Throne encompasses all the skies and all the earths, and the preservation of both the sky and the earth is on Him and He never feel fatigued, and He is Most Great and Most High.
verses.arabic_text: اللّٰهُ لَاٰ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَىُّ الْقَيُّومُ  لَا تَاْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَ لَا نَوْمٌ  لَّهُ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ   مَن ذَا الَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُٓ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهِ  يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيهِمْ وَ مَا خَلْفَهُمْ  وَ لَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِٓ اِلَّا بِمَا شَآءُ  وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ  وَ لَا يَئُوْدُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا  وَ هُوَ الْعَلِىُّ الْعَظِيمُ

verses.english_text: There is no compulsion in the religion, Allah has distinguished guidance from straying, whoever has denied the false gods and believes in Allah only, they are holding the string tightly which will never break, and Allah hears and knows all.
verses.arabic_text: لَآ اِكْرَاهَ فِى الدِّينِ  قَد تَّبَيَّنَ الرُّشْدُ مِنَ الْغَىِّ  فَمَنْ يَّكْفُرْ بِالطَّاغُوتِ وَ يُؤْمِنۢ بِاللّٰهِ فَقَدِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقٰى لَا انْفِصَامَ لَهَا   وَ اللّٰهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: And Allah is the Patron of those who have become believers, He bring them from darkness to the light of guidance, whoever is unbeliever, Devil is their patron, and He has pushed from light of guidance to the darkness, and these are dwellers of Hell and shall remain there forever.
verses.arabic_text: اللّٰهُ وَلِىُّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا  يُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمٰتِ اِلَى النُّورِ  وَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوٓا اَوْلِيٰٓئُهُمُ الطَّاغُوتُ يُخْرِجُونَهُم مِّنَ النُّورِ اِلَى الظُّلُمٰتِ   اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِ  هُمْ فِيهَا خٰلِدُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Did you not considered him that he disputed about his Lord because I have given him kingdom, Ibrahim said my Allah is that who gives life and death, and while boasting he said that I also give life and death, Ibrahim said my Allah causes sun to rise from East, you bring the sun from West, on this he was astonished but did not become a believer, and Allah never guides the oppressors.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِى حَآجَّ اِبْرٰهِمَ فِى رَبِّهِٓ اَنْ اٰتٰهُ اللّٰهُ الْمُلْكَ  اِذْ قَالَ اِبْرٰهِمُ رَبِّىَ الَّذِى يُحْىِ وَ يُمِيْتُ  قَالَ اَنَا اُحْىِ وَ اُمِيْتُ  قَالَ اِبْرٰهِمُ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَاْتِى بِالشَّمْسِ مِنَ الْمَشْرِقِ فَاْتِ بِهَا مِنَ الْمَغْرِبِ  فَبُهِتَ الَّذِى كَفَرَ   وَ اللّٰهُ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الظّٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Did you considered the condition of a man who was crossing a village which was devastated and roofs have fallen down, he said how Allah will settle the village after such devastation, on this Allah make him dead for 100 years, then He brought him to life again and asked him how long you were lying down, he said one day or even less, He said no you were lying down here for 100 years, now look at your food which has not spoilt and your donkey whose bones are scattered, all this was done to show the example of My Power and look at the bones, I set them together and make skeleton and cover with flesh, when he it became clear to him, he said now I have complete believe that Allah has power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ كَالَّذِى مَرَّ عَلَٰى قَرْيَةٍ وَ هِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَٰى عُرُوشِهَا  قَالَ اَنّٰى يُحْىِ هٰذِهِ اللّٰهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا  فَاَمَاتَهُ اللّٰهُ مِائَةَ عَامٍ ثُمَّ بَعَثَهُ  قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتَ  قَالَ لَبِثْتُ يَوْمًا اَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ  قَالَ بَل لَّبِثْتَ مِائَةَ عَامٍ فَانْظُرْ اِلَٰى طَعَامِكَ وَ شَرَابِكَ لَمْ يَتَسَنَّهْ  وَ انظُرْ اِلَٰى حِمَارِكَ  وَ لِنَجْعَلَكَ اٰيَةً لِلّنَّاسِ  وَ انظُرْ اِلَى الْعِظَامِ كَيْفَ نُنشِزُهَا ثُمَّ نَكْسُوهَا لَحْمًا  فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ قَالَ اَعْلَمُ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet! Remember that time also when Ibrahim requested Me to show him how I bring alive from the dead, Allah said don’t you believe this, he said yes I do believe but I want to see it myself so that I am satisfied at heart, Allah said if it is so then bring 4 birds, slaughter them and keep pieces of their flesh on the hills and then call them and you will see them coming running towards you, and do understand that Allah is Predominant and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ قَالَ اِبْرٰهِمُ رَبِّ اَرِنِى كَيْفَ تُحْىِ الْمَوْتٰى  قَالَ اَوَلَمْ تُؤْمِن  قَالَ بَلَٰى وَ لٰكِن لِّيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِىْ  قَالَ فَخُذْ اَرْبَعَةً مِّنَ الطَّيْرِ فَصُرْهُنَّ اِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ اجْعَلْ عَلَٰى كُلِّ جَبَلٍ مِّنْهُنَّ جُزْءً ثُمَّ ادْعُهُنَّ يَاْتِيْنَكَ سَعْيًا  وَاعْلَمْ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Parable of spending in the name of Allah is like the parable of a seed which has seven ears and every ear has 100 seeds and Allah doubles it for some, Allah is of vast capacity and knows all.
verses.arabic_text: مَّثَلُ الَّذِيْنَ يُنفِقُونَ اَمْوَالَهُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ اَنْبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِى كُلِّ سُنْبُلَةٍ مِّائَةُ حَبَّةٍ   وَ اللّٰهُ يُضٰعِفُ لِمَنْ يَّشَآءُ   وَ اللّٰهُ و اسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: People who spend in the way of Allah and do not showcase it or trouble them, their reward is with their Lord, they will have no fear on the Day of Judgement, nor will they be depressed.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَّذِيْنَ يُنْفِقُوْنَ اَمْوَالَهُمْ فِى سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ لَا يُتْبِعُونَ مَآ اَنْفَقُوْا مَنًّا وَّلَآ اَذًى لَّهُمْ اَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ  وَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ لَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

verses.english_text: Reply softly, leniency is much better than such charity, which hurts, Allah is Self-Sufficient and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: قَوْلٌ مَّعْرُوفٌ وَّمَغْفِرَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ صَدَقَةٍ يَّتْبَعُهَآ اَذًى   وَ اللّٰهُ غَنِىٌّ حَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: O believers, do not make your charity worthless by showing it off and hurting the supplicant, do not be like the person who do the charity just for show off, and does not believe in Allah and the Day of Judgement, his parable is like a shining stone on which dust falls but when heavy rainfalls it get clears it, hypocrites will not get benefit of their charities, Allah never guide the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا لَا تُبْطِلُوا صَدَقٰتِكُم بِالْمَنِّ وَ الْاَذٰى كَالَّذِىْ يُنْفِقُ مَالَهُ رِئَآءَ النَّاسِ وَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللّٰهِ وَ الْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ  فَمَثَلُهُ كَمَثَلِ صَفْوَانٍ عَلَيْهِ تُرَابٌ فَاَصَابَهُ وَ ابِلٌ فَتَرَكَهُ صَلْدًا  لَا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَٰى شَىْءٍ مِّمَّا كَسَبُوا   وَ اللّٰهُ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And those who spend with their hearts in the name of Allah, their parable is like a garden on the hillock, when heavy rain falls their yield becomes double, even if heavy rain does not fall only a drizzle will suffice, Allah is always aware about your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَثَلُ الَّذِيْنَ يُنفِقُونَ اَمْوَالَهُمُ ابْتِغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِ اللّٰهِ وَ تَثْبِيْتًا مِّنْ اَنْفُسِهِمْ كَمَثَلِ جَنَّةٍ بِرَبْوَةٍ اَصَابَهَا وَابِلٌ فَاٰتَتْ اُكُلَهَا ضِعْفَيْنِ  فَاِن لَّمْ يُصِبْهَا وَابِلٌ فَطَلٌّ   وَ اللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

verses.english_text: Does any of you would like that you have a garden of dates and grapes and there are rivers beneath it and also there are different types of fruits, and old age catches him and his children are small and weak, suddenly hot air blows which is full of fire and devastate the garden, Allah describes his commands clearly like this so you ponder over it.
verses.arabic_text: اَيَوَدُّ اَحَدُكُمْ اَنْ تَكُونَ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ مِّنْ نَّخِيلٍ وَّاَعْنَابٍ تَجْرِىْ مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ لَهُ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ وَ اَصَابَهُ الِْكِبَرُ وَ لَهُ ذُرِّيَّةٌ ضُعَفَآءُ فَاَصَابَهَآ اِعْصَارٌ فِيهِ نَارٌ فَاحْتَرَقَتْ   كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمُ الْاٰيٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَفَكَّرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O believers, spend in the way of Allah from your pure earning and whatever I have grown on earth for you, and do not even think of giving your bad earnings in the way of Allah, and if someone give, you will not take it except that your eyes are closed, and be aware that Allah is self-sufficient and Praiseworthy.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوٓا اَنفِقُوا مِن طَيِّبٰتِ مَا كَسَبْتُمْ وَ مِمَّاٰ اَخْرَجْنَا لَكُم مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ  وَ لَا تَيَمَّمُوا الْخَبِيثَ مِنْهُ تُنفِقُونَ وَ لَسْتُم بِاٰخِذِيهِ اِلَّاٰ اَن تُغْمِضُوا فِيهِ  وَ اعْلَمُوٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ

verses.english_text: Satan makes you fear poverty and encourage you for niggardly whereas Allah gives you assurance of His Forgiveness and Abundance, Allah has vastness and knows all.
verses.arabic_text: الشَّيْطٰنُ يَعِدُكُمُ الْفَقْرَ وَ يَاْمُرُكُمْ بِالْفَحْشَآءِ  وَ اللّٰهُ يَعِدُكُم مَّغْفِرَةً مِّنْهُ وَ فَضْلًا   وَ اللّٰهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: He grants wisdom to whom He pleases, and if someone gets wisdom from Him, as if he has received wealth of goodness, and nobody recognizes importance except those who know.
verses.arabic_text: يُؤْتِى الْحِكْمَةَ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ  وَ مَن يُّؤْتَ الْحِكْمَةَ فَقَدْ اُوْتِىَ خَيْرًا كَثِيْرًا   وَ مَا يَذَّكَّرُ اِلَّآ اُولُوا الْاَلْبَابِ

verses.english_text: If you spend anything or make vow Allah Verily know, and no one will help the oppressors on the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَنْفَقْتُم مِّن نَّفَقَةٍ اَوْ نَذَرْتُم مِّن نَّذْرٍ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعْلَمُهُ   وَ مَا لِلظّٰلِمِينَ مِنْ اَنْصَارٍ

verses.english_text: You can give charity openly, but if you hide it is better for you, Allah will forgive your sins if you give charity this way, and whatever you do Allah knows it.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ تُبْدُوا الصَّدَقٰتِ فَنِعِمَّا هِىَ  وَ اِن تُخْفُوْهَا وَ تُؤْتُوهَا الْفُقَرَآءَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ  وَ يُكَفِّرُ عَنْكُمْ مِّنْ سَيِّاٰتِكُمْ   وَ اللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! It is not incumbent on you to reach them to their destination, you have to just show the way, but Allah guide whoever He pleases, O people, whatever you will spend in good work is for your own benefit, and you do not do anything but to please Allah, whatever you will spend in good work, you will get back manifold in return, and your right will not be marginalized.
verses.arabic_text: لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ هُدٰهُمْ وَ لٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَهْدِىْ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ   وَ مَا تُنفِقُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ فَلِاَنفُسِكُمْ  وَ مَا تُنفِقُونَ اِلَّا ابْتِغَاٰءَ وَجْهِ اللّٰهِ  وَ مَا تُنفِقُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ يُوَفَّ اِلَيْكُمْ وَ اَنتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Charity is for those who need, and are confined in the way of Allah and cannot move, they do not ask for alms and people think they are rich, but if you see closely their face you will know, they do not cling on you for help and whatever you spend in good activity, Allah Verily know it.
verses.arabic_text: لِلْفُقَرَآءِ الَّذِيْنَ اُحْصِرُوا فِى سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ ضَرْبًا فِى الْاَرْضِ  يَحْسَبُهُمُ الْجَاهِلُ اَغْنِيَآءَ مِنَ التَّعَفُّفِ  تَعْرِفُهُمْ بِسِيْمٰهُمْ  لَا يَسْئَلُونَ النَّاسَ اِلْحَافًا   وَ مَا تُنْفِقُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِهِ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: People who spend during the day or night secretly or openly in the way of Allah, their reward is with their Allah, on the Day of Judgement they will not have any fear or grief.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ يُنْفِقُوْنَ اَمْوالَهُم بِالَّيْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ سِرًّا وَّ عَلَانِيَةً فَلَهُمْ اَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ  وَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ لَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

verses.english_text: People who survive on usury, they will stand dazed on the Day of Judgement, these are people whom Satan has cling on, this is because they think that matter of trading and usury is alike, whereas Allah has allowed trading and forbidden usury, then whoever received this Command and refrained, can retain whatever taken earlier, their matter is with Allah, and whoever continue usury even after receiving Command, those are dwellers of Hell and shall remain there forever.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ يَاْكُلُوْنَ الرِّبٰوا لَا يَقُومُونَ اِلَّا كَمَا يَقُومُ الَّذِى يَتَخَبَّطُهُ الشَّيْطٰنُ مِنَ الْمَسِّ  ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ قَالُوٓا اِنَّمَا البَيْعُ مِثْلُ الرِّبٰوا وَ اَحَلَّ اللّٰهُ الْبَيْعَ وَ حَرَّمَ الرِّبٰوا فَمَن جَآءَهُ مَوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ فَانتَهٰى فَلَهُ مَا سَلَفَ وَ اَمْرُهُٓ اِلَى اللّٰهِ  وَ مَنْ عَادَ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِ  هُمْ فِيهَا خٰلِدُونَ

verses.english_text: Allah eradicates usury and promote charity and He does not like thankless and sinners.
verses.arabic_text: يَمْحَقُ اللّٰهُ الرِّبٰوا وَ يُرْبِى الصَّدَقٰتِ   وَ اللّٰهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ اَثِيمٍ

verses.english_text: People who believe and do good work and pray regularly and give charity, their reward is with their Lord, on the Day of Judgement they will neither fear nor grieve.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَ اَقَامُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَ اٰتَوُا الزَّكٰوةَ لَهُمْ اَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ  وَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ لَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

verses.english_text: O you believers, fear your Lord, and if any interest remains, forgo it, if you are true believers.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ ذَرُوا مَا بَقِىَ مِنَ الرِّبٰٓوا اِنْ كُنْتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And if you don’t do it then be ready to fight your Lord and His Prophet, if you have repented then that is your real wealth, do not cause unnecessary loss to anyone and nor any loss will be caused to you.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوا فَاْذَنُوا بِحَرْبٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَ رَسُولِهِ  وَ اِنْ تُبْتُمْ فَلَكُمْ رُءُوسُ اَمْوالِكُمْ  لَا تَظْلِمُونَ وَ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And if the debtor is in difficulty, give him time till his difficulty eases, and if you forgo the amount fully it is better for you.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِن كَانَ ذُو عُسْرَةٍ فَنَظِرَةٌ اِلَٰى مَيْسَرَةٍ  وَ اَنْ تَصَدَّقُوا خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ  اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And fear the day when you will be returned to the Lord, then whatever you have done will be rewarded in full and no one’s right will be trampled.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اتَّقُوا يَوْمًا تُرْجَعُونَ فِيهِ اِلَى اللّٰهِ  ثُمَّ تُوَفّٰى كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَ هُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: O believers, when you deal with each other in contracting debt, make a note of the same, and whoever write should write with fairness and should not refuse to write as Allah has made them literate, let him write who is taking loan should dictate clearly and continue to fear Allah and should not undermine the right of the loaner, and if the person taking loan is incapable or obtuse and illiterate, let the guardian should supervise with fairness, call for two witness, take two men as witness, but if there are no two men then one man and two women as witness, if out of two one woman forget second would remind her, witness should not refuse when they are called, do not be averse to writing whether amount is small or large with time frame, for Allah the contract is justifiable and strong for proof, and is very necessary that you may not have any doubt in future, but when you deal in cash there is no blame on you for not writing, and have witness for sale or purchase, and do not harm the writer or witness, and if you do this it is considered transgression, and fear your Lord, He teaches you and know everything.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوٓا اِذَا تَدَايَنْتُم بِدَيْنٍ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَاكْتُبُوهُ  وَ لْيَكْتُب بَّيْنَكُمْ كَاتِبٌۭ بِالْعَدْلِ  وَ لَا يَاْبَ كَاتِبٌ اَنْ يَّكْتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ اللّٰهُ  فَلْيَكْتُبْ  وَ لْيُمْلِلِ الَّذِى عَلَيْهِ الْحَقُّ وَ لْيَتَّقِ اللّٰهَ رَبَّهُ وَ لَا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا  فَاِنْ كَانَ الَّذِىْ عَلَيْهِ الْحَقُّ سَفِيْهًا اَوْ ضَعِيْفًا اَوْ لَا يَسْتَطِيْعُ اَنْ يُّمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَ لِيُّهُ بِالْعَدْلِ  وَ اسْتَشْهِدُوا شَهِيْدَيْنِ مِنْ رِّجَالِكُمْ  فَاِنْ لَّمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌ وَ امْرَاَتٰنِ مِمَّن تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ الشُّهَدَآءِ اَن تَضِلَّ اِحْدٰهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ اِحْدٰهُمَا الْاُخْرٰى  وَ لَا يَاْبَ الشُّهَدَآءُ اِذَا مَا دُعُوا  وَ لَا تَسْئَمُوٓا اَن تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا اَوْ كَبِيرًا اِلٰٓى اَجَلِهِ  ذٰلِكُمْ اَقْسَطُ عِندَ اللّٰهِ وَ اَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَادَةِ وَ اَدْنَٰى اَلَّا تَرْتَابُوْٓا  اِلَّآ اَنْ تَكُونَ تِجَارَةً حَاضِرَةً تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ اَلَّا تَكْتُبُوهَا   وَ اَشْهِدُوْٓا اِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ  وَ لَا يُضَآرَّ كَاتِبٌ وَّ لَا شَهِيدٌ  وَ اِن تَفْعَلُوا فَاِنَّهُ فُسُوقٌۭ بِكُمْ   وَ اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ  وَ يُعَلِّمُكُمُ اللّٰهُ   وَ اللّٰهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: If you have to give loan while travelling and could not find any writer then take something as deposit, if you know each other you can give loan without writing but person who has been trusted should return the debt to the loaner and fear your Lord, and do not hide testimony and whoever will hide testimony his heart will be sinner, Allah is fully aware of all your actions.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنْ كُنتُمْ عَلَٰى سَفَرٍ وَ لَمْ تَجِدُوْا كَاتِبًا فَرِهٰنٌ مَّقْبُوضَةٌ  فَاِنْ اَمِنَ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًا فَلْيُؤَدِّ الَّذِى اؤْتُمِنَ اَمَانَتَهُ وَلْيَتَّقِ اللّٰهَ رَبَّهُ   وَ لَا تَكْتُمُوا الشَّهَادَةَ  وَ مَن يَكْتُمْهَا فَاِنَّهُٓ اٰثِمٌ قَلْبُهُ   وَ اللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Whatever is in the skies and whatever is in the earth belongs to Allah, and whatever is in your hearts whether you declare or not, Allah will hold you accountable for it, then Allah will forgive whom he pleases, and will punish whom he pleases, and Allah has power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: لِّلَّهِ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ   وَ اِن تُبْدُوا مَا فِىٓ اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَوْ تُخْفُوهُ يُحَاسِبْكُم بِهِ اللّٰهُ  فَيَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَ يُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ   وَ اللّٰهُ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

verses.english_text: Prophet (Mohammad) believes, on whatever have been revealed on him, and all believers who have faith in Allah, His angels, His Books, and His Prophets, and they say they do not differentiate between the Prophets, and also say, O Lord, we heard and believed, and O Lord, we only need your Forgiveness and we have to return unto You.
verses.arabic_text: اٰمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَآ  اُنزِلَ اِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَّبِّهِ وَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ  كُلٌّ اٰمَنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَ مَلٰٓئِكَتِهِ وَ كُتُبِهِ وَ رُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ اَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ  وَ قَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَاَطَعْنَا  غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَ اِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: Allah do not impose on anyone more than their ability, your good deeds are beneficial for you, and you will see the consequences for bad deeds, O Lord, do not punish us if we forget or commit mistake, O Lord do not burden us like you have burdened the earlier people, O Lord do not burden us more than what we cannot tolerate, and forgive our mistakes and sins, and have Mercy on us, You are our Lord, now help us against the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللّٰهُ نَفْسًا اِلَّا وُسْعَهَا  لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَ عَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ   رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ اِن نَّسِينَآ اَوْ اَخْطَاْنَا  رَبَّنَا وَ لَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَاٰ اِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ مِن قَبْلِنَا  رَبَّنَا وَ لَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ  وَ اعْفُ عَنَّا وَ اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَ ارْحَمْنَا  اَنتَ مَوْلٰنَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Alif Laam Meem
verses.arabic_text: الم

verses.english_text: Allah is the Lord, no one else is worthy of worship, he is Ever-living, and the world exists because of Him.
verses.arabic_text: اللّٰهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! He has revealed the truthful Book on you which confirms the existing books, and He has sent Taurait and Injeel for the guidance of the people.
verses.arabic_text: نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ بِالْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَ اَنْزَلَ التَّوْرٰةَ وَ الْاِنجِيلَ

verses.english_text: And we sent the book to differentiate truth from falsehood, and verily there is serious punishment for those who do not believe the verses, Allah overpowers all and He is a revenger.
verses.arabic_text: مِن قَبْلُ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَ اَنزَلَ الْفُرْقَانَ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَ اللّٰهُ عَزِيزٌ ذُو انْتِقَامٍ

verses.english_text: Verily, nothing is hidden from Allah neither on earth nor on sky.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَخْفٰى عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ فِىْ الْاَرْضِ وَ لَا فِىْ السَّمَآءِ

verses.english_text: It is He who carve your faces in the womb of your mother as He pleases, there is no god but Allah, He is Predominant and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِىْ الْاَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: It is He Who have revealed the Book and some of the verses are very decisive which are base of the Book, and some verses are metaphoric, and whose hearts are not straight, follow only these verses which are metaphoric to create mischief and interpret their own meaning, whereas except Allah and those who are firmly entrenched in knowledge ; nobody knows their meaning, they say we believe in all whatever has been revealed from the Lord, and only knowledgeable understand.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِي اَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ مِنْهُ اٰيٰتٌ مُّحْكَمٰتٌ هُنَّ اُمُّ الْكِتٰبِ وَ اُخَرُ مُتَشٰبِهٰتٌ   فَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ فِىْ قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَابَهَ مِنْهُ ابْتِغَآءَ الْفِتْنَةِ وَ ابْتِغَآءَ تَاْوِيْلِهِ  وَ مَا يَعْلَمُ تَاْوِيْلَهُٓ  اِلَّا اللّٰهُ   وَ الرَاسِخُونَ فِىْ الْعِلْمِ يَقُوْلُوْنَ اٰمَنَّا بِهِ   كُلٌّ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا  وَ مَا يَذَّكَّرُ اِلَّآ اُو۟لُوا الْاَلْبَابِ

verses.english_text: And they pray: O my Lord, do not deviate our hearts after You have guided us, and bestow upon us Mercy from your Court, there is no doubt that you are the Giver.
verses.arabic_text: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوْبَنَا بَعْدَ اِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَ هَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً  ۚ  اِنَّكَ اَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ

verses.english_text: O my Lord, verily one day You will collect all the people, undoubtedly Allah does not renege on His promise.
verses.arabic_text: رَبَّنَآ اِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيْهِ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ  ۚ

verses.english_text: Verily, people who turned unbelievers, nothing will save them, neither their wealth nor their children, they are the fuel of Hell-Fire.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوا لَن تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ اَمْوَالُهُمْ وَ لَآ اَوْلَادُهُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ شَيْئًا   وَ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمْ وَ قُودُ النَّارِ

verses.english_text: They are like tribes of Firaun and people earlier than them, who denied Our verses, so Allah punished them because of their sins, Allah is strict in punishment.
verses.arabic_text: كَدَاْبِ اٰلِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ  ۚ  كَذَّبُوا بِاٰيَاتِنَا  فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ   وَ اللّٰهُ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Tell those who turn unbelievers, that very soon they will be defeated against the believers and will be assembled in Hell, what a bad place it is.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لِّلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوا سَتُغْلَبُونَ وَ تُحْشَرُونَ اِلَٰى جَهَنَّمَ   وَ بِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ

verses.english_text: Verily, there is a big sign for you in two group which confronted each other, one group was fighting holy war, and another of the unbelievers, whom believers saw double in quantity, but Allah gave victory to the small group, and Allah strengthens with His help whom He pleases verily it is a lesson in this incident for those who can see.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ اٰيَةٌ فِىْ فِئَتَيْنِ الْتَقَتَا   فِئَةٌ تُقَاتِلُ فِىْ سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ وَ اُخْرٰى كٰفِرَةٌ يَّرَوْنَهُم مِّثْلَيْهِمْ رَاْيَ الْعَيْنِ ۚ  وَ اللّٰهُ يُؤَيِّدُ بِنَصْرِهِ مَن يَّشَآءُ  اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّاُولِي الْاَبْصَارِ

verses.english_text: In this world, love of beautiful things such as, wives and sons, large piles of gold and silver, superior breeds of horse and livestock and agricultural fields are made to seem good; these are few benefits of this world, but an everlasting living place is with Allah.
verses.arabic_text: زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ الشَّهَوٰتِ مِنَ النِّسَآءِ وَ الْبَنِينَ وَ الْقَنَاطِيرِ الْمُقَنْطَرَةِ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَ الْفِضَّةِ وَ الْخَيْلِ الْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَ الْاَنْعَامِ وَالْحَرْثِ   ذٰلِكَ مَتَاعُ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا   وَ اللّٰهُ عِنْدَهُ حُسْنُ الْمَآبِ

verses.english_text: Tell them shall I tell you something better than these things, whoever followed piety, there are gardens of Paradise for them with the rivers flowing beneath, and they will remain forever there, and apart from this there are pure and clean spouses for them, and above all there is happiness of Allah, and Allah is watching these believers.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَؤُنَبِّئُكُم بِخَيْرٍ مِّن ذٰلِكُمْ   لِلَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنّٰتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِينَ فِيْهَا وَ اَزْوَاجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ وَّ رِضْوَانٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ   وَ اللّٰهُ بَصِيرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ

verses.english_text: These people say, O my Lord we have accepted faith, forgive our sins, save us from the torment of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَآ اِنَّنَآ اٰمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا وَ قِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

verses.english_text: These are the people who are patient and speak truth, obey Allah, and spend in the way of Allah and seek repentance in early hours of morning.
verses.arabic_text: اَلصّٰبِرِينَ وَ الصّٰدِقِينَ وَ الْقٰنِتِينَ وَ الْمُنْفِقِيْنَ وَ الْمُسْتَغْفِرِيْنَ بِالْاَسْحَارِ

verses.english_text: Allah, has Himself bore witness that there is no god but Allah, and all angels and people with knowledge who are steadfast on justice bear the same witness, that He has Great Wisdom and there is no god but Him and He is Predominant and Knowing.
verses.arabic_text: شَهِدَ اللّٰهُ اَنَّهُ لََاٰ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ وَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ وَ اُولُو الْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًا بِالْقِسْطِ  لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: Religion near Allah is only Islam, and people of the book disputed it among them out of envy after knowing it, and whosoever deny the signs of Allah, should know that Allah is quick in reckoning.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الدِّيْنَ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ الْاِسْلَامُ   وَ مَا اخْتَلَفَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوتُوا الْكِتٰبَ اِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَ هُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ   وَ مَن يَّكْفُرْ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! If these people unnecessary argue with you, tell them you have submitted totally to Allah, and my followers have also done so, and ask the people of book and ignorant whether they have accepted the faith, if they have become believers they are on the right path, and if they turn away, then you were just to reach the message to them, and Allah know His servants.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنْ حَاجُّوكَ فَقُلْ اَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلّٰهِ وَ مَنِ اتَّبَعَنِ   وَ قُلْ لِلَّذِيْنَ اُوتُوا الْكِتٰبَ وَ الْاُمِّيِّينَ ءَاَسْلَمْتُمْ  فَاِنْ اَسْلَمُوا فَقَدِ اهْتَدَوْا   وَ اِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلٰغُ   وَ اللّٰهُ بَصِيرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ

verses.english_text: Verily, who deny verses of Allah and unjustly slay messengers, and slay those who do justice, then give them good news of painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ النَّبِيِّينَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَيَقْتُلُونَ الَّذِيْنَ يَاْمُرُونَ بِالْقِسْطِ مِنَ النَّاسِ فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيمٍ

verses.english_text: These are the unlucky people whose all acts are futile in this world and the world hereafter, and no one will help them.
verses.arabic_text: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيْنَ حَبِطَتْ اَعْمَالُهُمْ فِىْ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ   وَ مَا لَهُمْ مِّن نّٰصِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Did you not notice the condition of the people who are given part of the book; now they are being called towards the Book of Allah, so the justice is done among them through these books and some of them turned their face.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِيْنَ اُوتُوا نَصِيبًۭا مِّنَ الْكِتٰبِ يُدْعَوْنَ اِلَٰى كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ وَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ

verses.english_text: These are the people who turn back, because they say they have to stay only for a few days in Hell, and more than that the fire cannot touch them, with these forgeries they are defeated in their own religion.
verses.arabic_text: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا لَن تَمَسَّنَا النَّارُ اِلَّاٰ اَيَّامًۭا مَّعْدُودَٰتٍۢ   وَغَرَّهُمْ فِىْ دِينِهِم مَّا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ

verses.english_text: In what condition will they be, when on the Day of Judgement, which is certain, they will be collected and everyone will be rewarded according to their deeds and no injustice will be done to them.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ اِذَا جَمَعْنٰهُمْ لِيَوْمٍۢ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيْهِ   وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Pray: O Allah, You, are the Owner of all the worlds, You give kingdom to whoever You please and take away kingdom from whoever you please, and it is only You who give honour to whoever You please and disgrace to whoever You please, and all the goodness are in Your Hands, Verily, you have power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: قُلِ اللّٰهُمَّ مٰلِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى الْمُلْكَ مَنْ تَشَاٰءُ وَ تَنْزِعُ الْمُلْكَ مِمَّنْ تَشَاٰءُ   وَ تُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشَاٰءُ وَ تُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشَاٰءُ   بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ   اِنَّكَ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

verses.english_text: It is You who stretch the night into the day, and stretch the day into night, You bring life out of death, and, You bring death out of life, and it is You Who gives uncountable sustenance to whoever you please.
verses.arabic_text: تُوْلِجُ الَّيْلَ فِىْ النَّهَارِ وَ تُوْلِجُ النَّهَارَ فِىْ الَّيْلِ   وَ تُخْرِجُ الْحَىَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَ تُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَىِّ   وَ تَرْزُقُ مَن تَشَاٰءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

verses.english_text: Believers should make believers only their patrons and not the unbelievers, and if someone will do this then he will not have anything to do with Allah, but if you want to guard yourself against them (then there is no issue), Allah makes you fearful from Himself only, you shall return to Allah.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يَتَّخِذِ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ اَوْلِيَآءَ مِنْ دُوْنِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ   وَ مَن يَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَ اللّٰهِ فِىْ شَىْءٍ اِلَّآ اَنْ تَتَّقُوْا مِنْهُمْ تُقٰةً   وَ يُحَذِّرُكُمُ اللّٰهُ نَفْسَهُ   وَ اِلَى اللّٰهِ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Tell them whatever is in your hearts whether you conceal or reveal it, Allah knows all, and whatever is in skies and whatever is on the earth, Allah knows all, and Allah is extremely capable.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنْ تُخْفُوْا مَا فِىْ صُدُوْرِكُمْ اَوْ تُبْدُوْهُ يَعْلَمْهُ اللّٰهُ   وَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِىْ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِىْ الْاَرْضِ   وَ اللّٰهُ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

verses.english_text: And remember that day, when, whoever has done any good or bad deeds will see it present there, and will say, I wish, there could have been long duration between me and my bad deeds, and Allah makes you fearful from Himself only, and Allah is very Generous on His servants.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ مُّحْضَرًا وَّ مَا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ سُوْٓءٍ تَوَدُّ لَوْ اَنَّ بَيْنَهَا وَ بَيْنَهُٓ اَمَدًا بَعِيْدًا   وَ يُحَذِّرُكُمُ اللّٰهُ نَفْسَهُ   وَ اللّٰهُ رَءُوفٌۢ بِالْعِبَادِ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Tell them if you love Allah then follow me, so Allah may also love you, and will forgive your sins, Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِن كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللّٰهَ فَاتَّبِعُونِىْ يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللّٰهُ وَ يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ   وَ اللّٰهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Tell them to obey Allah and His messenger and if they rebel then they should know that Allah does not like infidels.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَطِيعُوا اللّٰهَ وَ الرَّسُولَ   فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Verily, Allah has chosen Adam, Nooh, and descendants of Ibrahim, and descendants of Imran over the whole world.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ اصْطَفٰٓى اٰدَمَ وَ نُوحًا وَ اٰلَ اِبْرٰهِيمَ وَ اٰلَ عِمْرٰنَ عَلَى الْعٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Descendants of some from some, Allah know Allah hear everybody all and know everything.
verses.arabic_text: ذُرِّيَّةًۭ بَعْضُهَا مِنْۢ بَعْضٍ   وَ اللّٰهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Remember the time when the wife of Imran said, O my Lord, I want to free my child who is in my womb from worldly affairs, and want to devote him for your service, please accept my offering, Verily, You are hearing and knowing.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَتِ امْرَاَتُ عِمْرٰنَ رَبِّ اِنِّىْ نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِىْ بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىْ   اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيْمُ

verses.english_text: When the baby girl was born, she was amazed and said, O my Lord, I bore a girl, but girl is not like a boy, whereas Allah knew of the importance what she bore, I have named her Maryam and give my daughter and her offspring in your refuge against accursed Satan.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا وَ ضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ اِنِّى وَ ضَعْتُهَاٰ اُنْثٰى   وَ اللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَ ضَعَتْ   وَ لَيْسَ الذَّكَرُ كَالْاُنْثٰى   وَ اِنِّى سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَ اِنِّىْٓ اُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَ ذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ الشَّيْطٰنِ الرَّجِيْمِ

verses.english_text: Her offering was Graciously accepted by her Lord, He made her grow in purity and beauty, and made Zakaria her guardian, whenever Zakaria visited her chamber of prayer he found some eatables kept beside her, and asks her, O Maryam, from where this came, Maryam replies that it is from Allah, indeed to whosoever Allah pleases gives uncountable sustenance.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ وَّ اَنْبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا   وَّ كَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا   كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا الْمِحْرَابَ  وَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا رِزْقًا   قَالَ يٰمَرْيَمُ اَنّٰى لَكِ هٰذَا   قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ   اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَّشَاٰءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

verses.english_text: Observing all this, Zakaria prayed that time to Allah and requested that O my Lord grant me from Yourself a pure offspring, Verily only you listen to the supplication.
verses.arabic_text: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُ  قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً   اِنَّكَ سَمِيْعُ الدُّعَاٰءِ

verses.english_text: Then angels called to him while Zakaria was praying in the room and told him that Allah is giving glad tiding to you of Yahya who will witness the Words of Allah, will be chief, pious and a messenger among the righteous ones.
verses.arabic_text: فَنَادَتْهُ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ وَ هُوَ قَاٰئِمٌ يُصَلِّىْ فِىْ الْمِحْرَابِ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيٰى مُصَدِّقًا بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَ سَيِّدًا وَّ حَصُورًا وَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ الصّٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: He said how I can have the son when I have become old and my wife is barren, he said, Allah does what he pleases.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ اَنّٰى يَكُونُ لِى غُلٰمٌ وَّ قَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ الْكِبَرُ وَ امْرَاَتِى عَاقِرٌ   قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ اللّٰهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاٰءُ

verses.english_text: Zakaria said, O my Lord, give some sign for my satisfaction, He said, the sign is that you will be able to speak only in sign language for three days, and remember your Lord much, and glorify Him in the morning and the evening.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَل لِّٓيْ اٰيَةً قَالَ ءَاٰيَتُكَ اَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلٰثَةَ اَيَّامٍ اِلَّا رَمْزًا وَ اذْكُر رَّبَّكَ كَثِيرًا وَّ سَبِّحْ بِالْعَشِىِّ وَ الْاِبْكَارِ

verses.english_text: And remember the incident that the angel told Maryam, Allah has chosen you and has purified you and selected you from the females of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ يٰمَرْيَمُ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ اصْطَفٰكِ وَ طَهَّرَكِ وَ اصْطَفٰكِ عَلَٰى نِسَاٰءِ الْعٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: O Maryam! obey your Lord and be among the people who bow down and prostrate.
verses.arabic_text: يٰمَرْيَمُ اقْنُتِىْ لِرَبِّكِ وَ اسْجُدِى وَ ارْكَعِى مَعَ الرَّاكِعِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! This announcement is from the unseen news, which We sent you through revelation, you were not with them when they were dipping their pens in water to decide who will be guardian of Maryam, and you were not present with them.
verses.arabic_text: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ اَنبَاٰءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيْهِ اِلَيْكَ  وَ مَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ اِذْ يُلْقُونَ اَقْلامَهُمْ اَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ  وَ مَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ اِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

verses.english_text: When people were quarrelling among them, remember when angels told Maryam that Allah is giving glad tidings to you for a son, whose name will be Isa ibn Maryam, and he will be among the honourable in this world and The Hereafter and will be among the near ones.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ يٰمَرْيَمُ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنْهُ اسْمُهُ الْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَ جِيهًا فِى الدُّنْيَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ وَ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ

verses.english_text: And he shall speak to the people in the same tone, from the cradle as well as in old age, and will be among the pious ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَ يُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ فِىْ الْمَهْدِ وَ كَهْلًا وَّ مِنَ الصّٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: On hearing this, Maryam said with astonishment, O my Lord! how can I bear the son when no man has even touched me, it was said, Allah does what He pleases, when He decides to do something, He just says Be it, and it becomes.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَتْ رَبِّ اَنّٰى يَكُونُ لِىْ وَلَدٌ وَّلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ   قَالَ كَذٰلِكِ اللّٰهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاٰءُ  اِذَا قَضٰٓى اَمْرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُوْلُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ

verses.english_text: O Maryam, Allah will make him learn Heavenly books and wisdom, especially Taurait and Injeel.
verses.arabic_text: وَ يُعَلِّمُهُ الْكِتٰبَ وَ الْحِكْمَةَ وَ التَّوْرٰةَ وَ الْاِنجِيلَ

verses.english_text: And will make him a messenger for Bani Israel and he will tell them: I have come to you from your Lord and brought these signs for my prophethood, I will make a bird from clay and blow something on it and with the command of Allah it will fly, and with command of Allah will give sight to the blinds, and will cure people afflicted with leprosy, and will bring alive the dead, and will inform you, whatever you eat and hoard in your homes, if you are honest, these are signs for you.
verses.arabic_text: وَ رَسُولًا اِلَٰى بَنِٓي اِسْرَآئِيْلَ اَنِّي قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِاٰيَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ اَنِّىْٓ اَخْلُقُ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الطِّيْنِ كَهَيْئَةِ الطَّيْرِ فَاَنْفُخُ فِيْهِ فَيَكُوْنُ طَيْرًا بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ   وَ اُبْرِئُ الْاَكْمَهَ وَ الْاَبْرَصَ وَ اُحِْى الْمَوْتٰى بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ   وَ اُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا تَاْكُلُوْنَ وَ مَا تَدَّخِرُوْنَ فِىْ بُيُوتِكُمْ  اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لَّكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And I verify Taurait which is already here; one of the reasons for my coming is that I will allow many things for you which are forbidden now, I have come from your Lord with signs, so you fear Allah and obey me.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوْرٰةِ وَ لِاُحِلَّ لَكُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِىْ حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ  وَ جِئْتُكُمْ بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اَطِيْعُونِ

verses.english_text: Verily, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him because this is the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ رَبِّي وَ رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوْهُ  هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: When Isa saw unbelieve in them, he asked who is with Allah, and will be my helper, his disciples said we are the adherents of Allah and have believe in you, O Isa be witness that we are the obedient.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ اَحَسَّ عِيسٰى مِنْهُمُ الْكُفْرَ قَالَ مَنْ اَنْصَارِىْٓ اِلَى اللّٰهِ   قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّوْنَ نَحْنُ اَنْصَارُ اللّٰهِ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَ اشْهَدْ بِاَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Our Lord, we believe, in whatever you revealed and follow the messenger, then mention us as the witness of Your messengers.
verses.arabic_text: رَبَّنَآ اٰمَنَّا بِمَآ اَنْزَلْتَ وَ اتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُوْلَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشّٰهِدِينَ

verses.english_text: And they planned against Isa and We dispelled their planning; Allah is the best planner.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَكَرُوْا وَ مَكَرَ اللّٰهُ   وَ اللّٰهُ خَيْرُ الْمٰكِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And remember the time when Allah said O Isa, I will complete your period of stay on earth, and will cause you to ascend towards Me, and will keep you pure from these infidels, and I will empower your followers over the infidels until the Day of Judgement, then you all have to return to Me, and on that Day I will decide among you who were quarrelling.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ اللّٰهُ يٰعِيْسٰٓى اِنِّىْ مُتَوَفِّيْكَ وَ رَافِعُكَ اِلَىَّ وَ مُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوا وَ جَاعِلُ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّبَعُوكَ فَوْقَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اِلَٰى يَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِ   ثُمَّ اِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَاَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ فِيْمَا كُنْتُمْ فِيْهِ تَخْتَلِفُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Whoever turned unbeliever (Allah) will punish them severely in this world and The Hereafter and nobody will be their helper.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فَاُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيْدًا فِىْ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ   وَ مَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And Allah will reward you fully if you did good deeds, and Allah does not like the oppressors.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا وَ عَمِلُوْا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيْهِمْ اُجُوْرَهُمْ   وَ اللّٰهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! This We are describing to you are My signs and incidents full of wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: ذٰلِكَ نَتْلُوْهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ الْاٰيٰتِ وَ الذِّكْرِ الْحَكِيْمِ

verses.english_text: Resemblance of Isa and Adam are the same to Allah, We created a body of clay and said Be, and it became.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيْسٰى عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ كَمَثَلِ اٰدَمَ   خَلَقَهُ مِن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ

verses.english_text: Rightful things are from Allah, and don't be among the people who doubt.
verses.arabic_text: الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُنْ مِّنَ الْمُمْتَرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Then after you have received the knowledge of Quran, if someone dispute with you, tell them we bring our sons and you bring your sons, we bring our women and you bring your women, we bring our souls and you bring your souls, then we together will earnestly invoke curse of Allah on the liars.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَنْ حَآجَّكَ فِيْهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا نَدْعُ اَبْنَآءَنَا وَ اَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَ نِسَآءَنَا وَ نِسَآءَكُمْ وَ اَنْفُسَنَا وَ اَنْفُسَكُمْ ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَل لَّعْنَتَ اللّٰهِ عَلَى الْكٰذِبِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! These are all truthful incidents, and except Allah there is no god, Allah is Predominant and having Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هٰذَا لَهُوَ الْقَصَصُ الْحَقُّ ۚ  وَ مَا مِنْ اِلٰهٍ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ  وَ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ

verses.english_text: And still if they turned their faces, then Allah does not like oppressors.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيْمٌ بِالْمُفْسِدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Tell these people of the book, come at an equitable position between us that do not worship anyone except Allah, and should not make anyone His partner and should not accept anybody as your Lord, but still if they turn away, say, be witness we are obedient to Allah.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ تَعَالَوْا اِلَٰى كَلِمَةٍ سَوَآءٍۢ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَكُمْ اَلَّا نَعْبُدَ اِلَّا اللّٰهَ وَ لَا نُشْرِكَ بِهِ شَيْئًا وَ لَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا اَرْبَابًا مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ  فَاِن تَوَلَّوْا فَقُوْلُواْ اشْهَدُوْا بِاَنَّا مُسْلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O People of Book! Why do you dispute unnecessary and fight about Ibrahim, some call him Jew and some call him Christian, whereas Taurait and Injeel, which are their origin, these books were revealed after him, don't you understand this?
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لِمَ تُحَآجُّوْنَ فِىْٓ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَ مَآ اُنْزِلَتِ التَّوْرٰةُ وَ الْاِنجِيلُ اِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِ  اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Ah! You are the same fools who disputed about some knowledge you received, now you are quarreling about the things which you do not know at all, and reality is known to Allah and you do not know.
verses.arabic_text: هٰٓاَنتُمْ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ حَاجَجْتُمْ فِيْمَا لَكُم بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِيْمَا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِ عِلْمٌ   وَ اللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ وَ اَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Ibrahim was neither Jew or Christian, but he was purely on truth and obedience nor he was from the polytheists.
verses.arabic_text: مَا كَانَ اِبْرٰهِيْمُ يَهُوْدِيًّا وّٓ لَآ نَصْرَانِيًّا وَّ لٰكِن كَانَ حَنِيْفًا مُّسْلِمًا  وَ مَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ

verses.english_text: More important to Ibrahim is those who follow him, and this messenger and faithful, and Allah is the Guardian of faithful.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِاِبْرٰهِيْمَ لَلَّذِيْنَ اتَّبَعُوْهُ وَ هٰذَا النَّبِىُّ وَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا   وَ اللّٰهُ وَلِىُّ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: A group of the people of the book tried to distract you from the right path, however with their planning they do not distract you but themselves, also they do not understand.
verses.arabic_text: وَ دَّت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ لَوْ يُضِلُّونَكُمْ  وَ مَا يُضِلُّونَ اِلَّآ اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَ مَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O people of the book! Why do you deny verses of Allah whereas you can be the witness.
