verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَ اَنتُمْ تَشْهَدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O people of the book! Why do you dispute the verses of Allah and conceal them whereas you know.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُونَ الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَ تَكْتُمُوْنَ الْحَقَّ وَ اَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: A group of people of book said, in the morning accept the Book which has been revealed on Muslims, and deny it in the evening, may be this way Muslims also renounce.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ اٰمِنُوْا بِالَّذِىْٓ اُنْزِلَ عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَجْهَ النَّهَارِ وَ اكْفُرُوٓا اٰخِرَهُ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: Do not believe anybody except those who follow your religion, O Prophet! Tell them guidance is only, Guidance of Allah, and never believe that Allah will give to anyone else the importance given to you, and can anyone argue about you before Allah, O Prophet, tell them, giving importance is in the Hands of Allah, and He gives to whoever He pleases, and He is Generous and Knowing.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تُؤْمِنُوْٓا اِلَّا لِمَنْ تَبِعَ دِيْنَكُمْ   قُلْ اِنَّ الْهُدٰى هُدَى اللّٰهِ   اَنْ يُّؤْتٰٓى اَحَدٌ مِّثْلَ مَآ اُوتِيتُمْ اَوْ يُحَآجُّوكُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ   قُلْ اِنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللّٰهِ يُؤْتِيْهِ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ   وَ اللّٰهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: He chooses with Mercy, anyone He pleases, and Allah is Mighty Graceful.
verses.arabic_text: يَّخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِ   مَنْ يَّشَآءُ ۚ  وَ اللّٰهُ ذُوْ الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيْمِ

verses.english_text: Among the people of book are some such that if you entrust heap of wealth they will return, and there are some with whom if you entrust even one coin they will not return until you strongly demand, and they think, they do not have any obligation towards Arabs, they tell lie about Allah and know they are lying.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ مَنْ اِنْ تَاْمَنْهُ بِقِنْطٓارٍ يُّؤَدِّهِٓ اِلَيْكَ   وَ مِنْهُمْ مَّنْ اِنْ تَاْمَنْهُ بِدِيْنَارٍ لَّا يُؤَدِّهِٓ اِلَيْكَ اِلَّا مَا دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَآئِمًا   ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا لَيْسَ عَلَيْنَا فِىْ الْاُمِّيِّنَ سَبِيْلٌ وَ يَقُولُوْنَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ الْكَذِبَ وَ هُمْ يَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And whoever oblige their covenant and practices piety, Verily Allah loves the pious people.
verses.arabic_text: بَلَٰى مَنْ اَوْفٰى بِعَهْدِهِ وَ اتَّقٰى فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: People who sell their promise made to Allah for small sum, these people do not have any share in The Hereafter, and Allah shall neither speak to them on the Day of Judgement nor will look them with Mercy, nor He will purify them of their sins, there is severest chastisement for them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَشْتَرُوْنَ بِعَهْدِ اللّٰهِ وَ اَيْمَانِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا  اُو۟لٰٓئِكَ لَا خَلَاقَ لَهُمْ فِىْ الْاٰخِرَةِ وَ لَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَ لَا يَنْظُرُ اِلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ وَ لَا يُزَكِّيْهِمْ  وَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Most Verily, there are some, among people of the book, who read their own meaning from Taurait to show that it is part of the book but it is not part of the book, and they say whatever we are reading have been revealed from Allah, but it is not revealed by Allah, and knowingly falsely speaking against Allah and they know.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنَّ مِنْهُمْ لَفَرِيْقًا يَّلْوُنَ اَلْسِنَتَهُمْ بِالْكِتٰبِ لِتَحْسَبُوْهُ مِنَ الْكِتٰبِ وَ مَا هُوَ مِنَ الْكِتٰبِ وَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ وَ مَا هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ   وَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ الْكَذِبَ وَ هُمْ يَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: It is not appropriate for any mortal that he is given the book, wisdom and prophethood, and he say to people: be my followers instead of Allah, but his word would be that you follow Allah, you teach the book of Allah and also read.
verses.arabic_text: مَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ اَنْ يُّؤْتِيَهُ اللّٰهُ الْكِتٰبَ وَ الْحُكْمَ وَ النُّبُوَّةَ ثُمَّ يَقُوْلَ لِلنَّاسِ كُوْنُوْا عِبَادًا لِّىْ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ وَ لٰكِنْ كُوْنُوْا رَبَّانِيِّنَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تُعَلِّمُوْنَ الْكِتٰبَ وَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَدْرُسُوْنَ

verses.english_text: He will never enjoin you to consider angels and prophets as Lord, how can he enjoin you towards infidelity after you became Muslims.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا يَاْمُرَكُمْ اَنْ تَتَّخِذُوا الْمَلٰٓئِكَةَ وَ النَّبِيِّنَ اَرْبَابًا   اَيَاْمُرُكُمْ بِالْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ اِذْ اَنْتُمْ مُّسْلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Remember the time when the covenant was taken from the messengers that whatever book and wisdom We gave you, then a messenger will come and he will confirm your books, you also believe in him and help him; and Allah asked: do you agree? Apart from all other things, you also carried my covenant; all said: yes, we agree, He said then be a witness of one another and I am also a witness with you.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ اَخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِيْثَاقَ النَّبِيِّنَ لَمَآ اٰتَيْتُكُمْ مِّنْ كِتٰبٍ وَ حِكْمَةٍ ثُمَّ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهِ وَ لَتَنصُرُنَّهُ  قَالَ ءَاَقْرَرْتُمْ وَ اَخَذْتُمْ عَلَٰى ذٰلِكُمْ اِصْرِىْ   قَالُوْٓا اَقْرَرْنَا  قَالَ فَاشْهَدُوْا وَ اَنَا مَعَكُمْ مِّنَ الشّٰهِدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And after this whoever turn back on his covenant then he will be among the transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَنْ تَوَلّٰى بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ فَاُو۟لٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْفٰسِقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Are they seeking anything other than religion of Allah, when all the dwellers of earth and the sky, willingly or unwillingly, are bowing down before Him, and everyone have to return unto Him.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَغَيْرَ دِيْنِ اللّٰهِ يَبْغُوْنَ وَ لَهُٓ اَسْلَمَ مَنْ فِىْ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ طَوْعًا وَّكَرْهًا وَّ اِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Tell them we believe in Allah and on whatever has been revealed on us and on Ibrahim, Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqoob and children of Yaqoob and on Moosa, Isa and other messengers from their Lord, and we do not differentiate among them and we are His obedient.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَ مَآ اُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا وَ مَآ اُنْزِلَ عَلَىٰٓ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَ اِسْمٰعِيْلَ وَ اِسْحٰقَ وَ يَعْقُوْبَ وَ الْاَسْبَاطِ وَ مَآ اُوتِىَ مُوْسٰى وَ عِيسٰى وَ النَّبِيُّونَ مِنْ رَّبِّهِمْ  لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ اَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ وَ نَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And anyone who desire anything other than the religion of Allah shall not be accepted and he shall be in great loss in the Hereafter.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَنْ يَّبْتَغِ غَيْرَ الْاِسْلَامِ دِيْنًا فَلَنْ يُّقْبَلَ مِنْهُ   وَ هُوَ فِىْ الْاٰخِرَةِ مِنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: How will Allah guide such people who turned unbeliever after accepting faith, whereas they had accepted that he is truthful Prophet and they have also received clear miracles, Allah do not guide unjust.
verses.arabic_text: كَيْفَ يَهْدِ اللّٰهُ قَوْمًا كَفَرُوْا بَعْدَ اِيْمَانِهِمْ وَ شَهِدُوْٓا اَنَّ الرَّسُولَ حَقٌّ وَّ جَآءَهُمُ الْبَيِّنٰتُ  وَ اللّٰهُ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Curses of Allah and His angels and all people are on such people.
verses.arabic_text: اُولٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ اَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةَ اللّٰهِ وَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ وَ النَّاسِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ

verses.english_text: They will always be in the curse, there won't be any remission in their punishment, nor they will be given any respite.
verses.arabic_text: خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا   لَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَ لَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: But except those people who repented and have corrected themselves because Allah is all Forgiving and very Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ تَابُوا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ وَاَصْلَحُوا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Those who turned unbeliever after accepting faith, and increased their infidelity, their repentance will never be accepted, and these are the worst strayed.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوا بَعْدَ اِيْمَانِهِمْ ثُمَّ ازْدَادُوا كُفْرًا لَّنْ تُقْبَلَ تَوْبَتُهُمْ ۚ  وَ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الضَّآلُّونَ

verses.english_text: Who turned unbeliever and died in this condition only, so if somebody give gold in ransom which will fill the earth, it will not be accepted, these are the people who will get painful punishment, and nobody will be their helper.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوا وَ مَاتُوْا وَ هُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَنْ يُّقْبَلَ مِنْ اَحَدِهِمْ مِّلْءُ الْاَرْضِ ذَهَبًا وَّ لَوِ افْتَدٰى بِهِٓ   اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌ وَّ مَا لَهُم مِّن نّٰصِرِينَ

verses.english_text: O People! Unless you don’t give your favourite thing in charity, your status will not be elevated, and whatever you spend, Allah Verily knows it.
verses.arabic_text: لَنْ تَنَالُوُا الْبِرَّ حَتّٰى تُنْفِقُوْا مِمَّا تُحِبُّوْنَ  وَ مَا تُنْفِقُوْا مِنْ شَىْءٍ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِهِ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Before the revelation of Taurait and Injeel, Bani Israel was allowed to consume everything except those which Israel had forbidden on himself, O Prophet! Tell them if there is any truth in whatever they are saying, then bring Taurait and read in front of us.
verses.arabic_text: كُلُّ الطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلًّا لِّبَنِىْٓ اِسْرَآءِيْلَ اِلَّا مَا حَرَّمَ اِسْرَآءِيلُ عَلَٰى نَفْسِهِ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَن تُنَزَّلَ التَّوْرٰةُ   قُلْ فَاْتُوْا بِالتَّوْرٰةِ فَاتْلُوْهَآ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Even after this if anybody fabricates a lie against Allah, these are people who are oppressors.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَنِ افْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ الْكَذِبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ فَاُو۟لٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Tell them Allah has spoken Truth, now you follow the religion of Ibrahim, who was not among the pagans.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ صَدَقَ اللّٰهُ ۙ فَاتَّبِعُوْا مِلَّةَ اِبْرٰهِيمَ حَنِيْفًا   وَ مَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ

verses.english_text: House which was first made for the prayers is this only which is in Bakkah, it is blessed and is a guide for the world.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اَوَّلَ بَيْتٍ وُّضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِى بِبَكَّةَ مُبٰرَكًا وَّ هُدًى لِّلْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: There is clear sign in it such as the standing Place of Ibrahim, whoever enters in it shall be secure, if they have sufficient financial eligibility they should perform Hajj, and if anybody turns unbeliever, Allah is self-sufficient from the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: فِيْهِ اٰيٰتٌ بَيِّنٰتٌ مَّقَامُ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ   وَ مَنْ دَخَلَهُ  كَانَ اٰمِنًا   وَ لِلّٰهِ عَلَى النَّاسِ حِجُّ الْبَيْتِ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ اِلَيْهِ سَبِيْلًا  وَ مَنْ كَفَرَ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنِ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O People of book why do you deny the verses, when Allah is the Witness of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَ اللّٰهُ شَهِيْدٌ عَلَٰى مَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Tell to the people of book, why do they deter the people from the way of Allah, and try to find crookedness in it, when you are witness of its reality, and whatever you do Allah is not unaware of it.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لِمَ تَصُدُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ مَنْ اٰمَنَ تَبْغُوْنَهَا عِوَجًا وَّ اَنْتُمْ شُهَدَآءُ  وَ مَا اللّٰهُ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers, if you follow any group of the people of book, they will make you infidel again after your accepting Islam.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓا اِنْ تُطِيْعُوْا فَرِيْقًا مِّنَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوتُوا الْكِتٰبَ يَرُدُّوْكُمْ بَعْدَ اِيْمَانِكُمْ كٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: However, the verses of Allah are being read before you and His Prophet is also from among you, and whoever gets attached with Allah, so definitely He will guide you to the right path.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَيْفَ تَكْفُرُوْنَ وَ اَنْتُمْ تُتْلَٰى عَلَيْكُمْ اٰيٰتُ اللّٰهِ وَ فِيْكُمْ رَسُولُهُ  وَ مَنْ يَّعْتَصِمْ بِاللّٰهِ فَقَدْ هُدِىَ اِلَٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ

verses.english_text: O Believers, fear Allah, the way He should be feared, and do not die in any other religion except Islam.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ تُقٰتِهِ وَ لَا تَمُوْتُنَّ اِلَّا وَ اَنتُم مُّسْلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: You all together keep holding rope of Allah tightly, and do not dispute among you, and remember the favour of Allah on your condition when you were enemies of one another, Allah put love in your hearts and with this blessing you become brothers, and you were standing on the brink of burning fire and were about to fall in it but Allah saved you, and Allah describe His commands like this so you come on the right path.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اعْتَصِمُوْا بِحَبْلِ اللّٰهِ جَمِيْعًا وَ لَا تَفَرَّقُوْا  وَ اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ اِذْ كُنْتُمْ اَعْدَآءً فَاَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوْبِكُمْ فَاَصْبَحْتُم بِنِعْمَتِهِٓ اِخْوَانًا   وَ كُنْتُمْ عَلَٰى شَفَا حُفْرَةٍ مِّنَ النَّارِ فَاَنْقَذَكُمْ مِّنْهَا   كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمْ اٰيٰتِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: There should be a group among you, who should invite people towards good deeds and bar them from the bad deeds, and these are the people who will get their desires fulfilled in The Hereafter.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لْتَكُنْ مِّنْكُمْ اُمَّةٌ يَّدْعُوْنَ اِلَى الْخَيْرِ وَ يَاْمُرُوْنَ بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ وَ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ  وَ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And do not be among the those who cause division among the people, and even after receiving clear signs their words and action are not the same, and strictest punishment is for these kinds of people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَكُوْنُوْا كَالَّذِيْنَ تَفَرَّقُوْا وَ اخْتَلَفُوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ الْبَيِّنٰتُ  وَ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Fear the day when some faces will be white and some faces will be black, people will ask the black faced people, Oh, you, you turned unbeliever, after believing, now you taste the punishment.
verses.arabic_text: يَّوْمَ تَبْيَضُّ وُجُوهٌ وَّتَسْوَدُّ وُجُوهٌ   فَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ اسْوَدَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ اَكَفَرْتُمْ بَعْدَ اِيمانِكُمْ فَذُوْقُوا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Whose faces will be white will be in Paradise due to the Mercy of Allah, and they will remain there forever.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ ابْيَضَّتْ وُجُوْهُهُمْ فَفِىْ رَحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ   هُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! These are verses which We recite for you clearly, and Allah does not desire to punish anybody of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ اللّٰهِ نَتْلُوْهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ  وَ مَا اللّٰهُ يُرِيْدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Whatever is in the skies and on the earth belongs to Allah, turn to Allah for all the Affairs.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لِلّٰهِ مَا فِىْ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِىْ الْاَرْضِ  وَ اِلَى اللّٰهِ تُرْجَعُ الْاُمُوْرُ

verses.english_text: How good a group you are, you have been created for the guidance of the people, you enjoin the people for good work and stops them from bad deeds, and believe in Allah, it would have been better for the people of book, if they also would have accepted the faith like this, there are only few faithful among them and most of them are transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: كُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ اُمَّةٍ اُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ تَاْمُرُوْنَ بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ وَ تَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَ تُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ   وَ لَوْ اٰمَنَ اَهْلُ الْكِتٰبِ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ  مِّنْهُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ وَ اَكْثَرُهُمُ الْفٰسِقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Muslims! They shall by no means can harm you but a little, and if they fight you, they will have to turn their backs on you and they will not get help from anywhere.
verses.arabic_text: لَن يَّضُرُّوْكُمْ اِلَّآ اَذًى   وَ اِن يُقَاتِلُوْكُمْ يُوَلُّوْكُمُ الْاَدْبَارَ ثُمَّ لَا يُنصَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: They have been identified with humiliation wherever they stay, only if they get refuge with the covenant of Allah or covenant of people, they will be under the wrath of Allah and will suffer with destitution, because they deny the verses of Allah and unjustly slay messengers, this because they were disobedient and committed excesses.
verses.arabic_text: ضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الذِّلَّةُ اَيْنَ مَا ثُقِفُوْٓا اِلَّا بِحَبْلٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَ حَبْلٍ مِّنَ النَّاسِ وَ بَآءُو بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَ ضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَسْكَنَةُ  ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يَكْفُرُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَ يَقْتُلُونَ الْاَنبِيَآءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ   ذٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوْا وَّ كَانُوا يَعْتَدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: They are not all alike, but some people of the book are such that they are steadfast and recite verses of Allah during the night and they prostrate regularly.
verses.arabic_text: لَيْسُوا سَوَآءً   مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ اُمَّةٌ قَآئِمَةٌ يَّتْلُوْنَ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ اٰنَآءَ الَّيْلِ وَ هُمْ يَسْجُدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: They believe in Allah and on the Day of the Judgement, invite people for good deeds and bar them from bad deeds, and run towards the good deeds, these are the righteous people.
verses.arabic_text: يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَ الْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَ يَاْمُرُوْنَ بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ وَ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَ يُسَارِعُوْنَ فِىْ الْخَيْرٰتِ   وَ اُولٰٓئِكَ مِنَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ

verses.english_text: They won't be denied of their good deeds, and Allah is well aware of righteous people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يَفْعَلُوْا مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلَن يُّكْفَرُوْهُ   وَ اللّٰهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِالْمُتَّقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Verily, who opted for infidelity, they cannot be saved with their wealth or children, these people are dwellers of Hell and shall remain there forever.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَنْ تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ اَمْوالُهُمْ وَ لَآ اَوْلادُهُم مِّنَ اللّٰهِ شَيئًا   وَ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِ   هُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: In the few days of this world whatever they spend is like a breeze full of frost, which fell on their fields, and whoever has done injustice on themselves and destroyed it and then fell the frost, Allah has not oppressed them, but they have done injustice to themselves.
verses.arabic_text: مَّثَلُ مَا يُنْفِقُونَ فِىْ هٰذِهِ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا كَمَثَلِ رِيْحٍ فِيْهَا صِرٌّ اَصَابَتْ حَرْثَ قَوْمٍۢ ظَلَمُوٓا اَنفُسَهُمْ فَاَهْلَكَتْهُ   وَ مَا ظَلَمَهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَ لٰكِنْ اَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Do not make anyone your confident other than believers, because these people will not fell short in inflicting more loss on you, they wish more strife and affliction for you, their enmity is obvious from their words, and they have more in their hearts, and if you are prudent, We have described our signs clearly for you.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا بِطَانَةً مِّنْ دُوْنِكُمْ لَا يَاْلُوْنَكُمْ خَبَالًا  وَّ دُّوا مَا عَنِتُّمْ  قَدْ بَدَتِ الْبَغْضَآءُ مِنْ اَفْوَاهِهِمْ  ۚ  وَ مَا تُخْفِىْ صُدُوْرُهُمْ اَكْبَرُ  قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ الْاٰيٰتِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: O People! You befriend them but they do not befriend you, you believe on the whole book, when they meet you, they say they believe in the Book and when they are alone, they bite their fingers in rage, O Prophet, tell them to die in their rage, whatever is in your hearts, Allah knows it.
verses.arabic_text: هٰٓاَنتُمْ اُولَاٰءِ تُحِبُّونَهُمْ وَ لَا يُحِبُّوْنَكُمْ وَ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْكِتٰبِ كُلِّهِ  ۚ  وَ اِذَا لَقُوْكُمْ قَالُوْٓا اٰمَنَّا  ۚ  وَ اِذَا خَلَوْا عَضُّوا عَلَيْكُمُ الْاَنَامِلَ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ   قُلْ مُوْتُوْا بِغَيْظِكُمْ   اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ

verses.english_text: O Believers, they do not like even if you are benefited a little, but feel happy when any trouble befalls you, and if you show patience and safeguard yourself then they cannot deceive you, and Allah has power over their activities.
verses.arabic_text: اِن تَمْسَسْكُمْ حَسَنَةٌ تَسُؤْهُمْ   وَ اِنْ تُصِبْكُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَّفْرَحُوْا بِهَا   وَ اِنْ تَصْبِرُوْا وَ تَتَّقُوْا لَا يَضُرُّكُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْئًا   اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُوْنَ مُحِيْطٌ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Recall the time when you left early in the morning, and when you were identifying the position of war for believers, and Allah is all-knowing and all-hearing.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ غَدَوْتَ مِنْ اَهْلِكَ تُبَوِّئُ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ مَقَاعِدَ لِلْقِتَالِ   وَ اللّٰهُ سَمِيْعٌ عَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: At the time when two groups wanted to show laziness but were safe because Allah was their Guardian, and believers should depend on Him only.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ هَمَّت طَّآئِفَتَانِ مِنكُمْ اَن تَفْشَلَا وَ اللّٰهُ وَ لِيُّهُمَا   وَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Verily, Allah did help you in the Battle of Badr, in spite of you being weak, still Allah granted you the victory, so fear Allah, so you may become thankful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللّٰهُ بِبَدْرٍ وَّ اَنْتُمْ اَذِلَّةٌ  ۚ  فَاتَّقُوْا اللّٰهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! You were telling the believers is it not enough for you that Allah has sent 3000 angels from sky to assist you.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ تَقُولُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ اَلَنْ يَّكْفِيَكُمْ اَنْ يُمِدَّكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ بِثَلٰثَةِ اٰلَافٍ مِّنَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ مُنْزَلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Verily, if you remain patient and practice piety, and suddenly enemy confronts you, then Allah will send 5000 angels to help you who will be carrying the signs of bravery.
verses.arabic_text: بَلٰٓى  اِنْ تَصْبِرُوْا وَ تَتَّقُوا وَ يَاْتُوْكُمْ مِّنْ فَوْرِهِمْ هٰذَا يُمْدِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِخَمْسَةِ اٰلَافٍ مِّنَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ مُسَوِّمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Allah did this help to please you, and for assurance of your hearts, help is always from Allah, Allah is Predominant and have Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا جَعَلَهُ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بُشْرٰى لَكُمْ وَ لِتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوْبُكُم بِهِ   وَ مَا النَّصْرُ اِلَّا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ الْعَزِيْزِ الْحَكِيْمِ

verses.english_text: This help was to cut a group of infidels or denigrate them, so that they should return to their homes in disgrace.
verses.arabic_text: لِيَقْطَعَ طَرَفًا مِّنَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اَوْ يَكْبِتَهُمْ فَيَنْقَلِبُوْا خَآئِبِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! You do not have any role whether I accept their repentance or punish them, because verily, they are oppressors.
verses.arabic_text: لَّيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الْاَمْرِ شَىْءٌ اَوْ يَتُوْبَ عَلَيْهِمْ اَوْ يُعَذِّبَهُمْ فَاِنَّهُمْ ظٰلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Allah is the owner of everything whether in skies or on earth, He may forgive anybody or punish anybody, and Allah is most Gracious and Forgiving.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لِلّٰهِ مَا فِىْ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِىْ الْاَرْضِ  يَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَّشَآءُ وَ يُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ  وَ اللّٰهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Do not use usury to increase your wealth, and fear Allah so you are delivered.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَاْكُلُوْا الرِّبٰٓوا اَضْعافًا مُّضٰعَفَةً   وَ اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Fear the fire of Hell which has been prepared for the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اتَّقُوْا النَّارَ الَّتِىٓ اُعِدَّتْ لِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And obey Allah and His Prophet so that you may be shown Mercy.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَطِيعُوا اللّٰهَ وَ الرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And hasten towards Forgiveness of your Lord and Paradise which is as extensive as skies and the earth, and which has been made available for the pious people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ سَارِعُوْٓا اِلَٰى مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ وَ جَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا السَّمٰوٰتُ وَ الْاَرْضُ اُعِدَّتْ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Whoever spend generously, whether in ease or in strait and control anger and forgive men, and Allah loves those who do favours.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ يُنْفِقُوْنَ فِىْ السَّرَّآءِ وَ الضَّرَّآءِ وَ الْكاظِمِيْنَ الْغَيْظَ وَ الْعَافِيْنَ عَنِ النَّاسِ   وَ اللّٰهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Those are the people, if they commit any sin or cause damage to their souls, they remember Allah and seek forgiveness, and who else can give forgiveness except Allah, and they do not insist on their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ اِذَا فَعَلُوا فاحِشَةً اَوْ ظَلَمُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوْا اللّٰهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوْا لِذُنُوْبِهِمْ   وَ مَنْ يَّغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَ لَمْ يُصِرُّوْا عَلَٰى مَا فَعَلُوْا وَ هُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: These are the people whose reward is forgiveness and Paradise, beneath which there are flowing rivers in which they will dwell forever, and this is the best reward for good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّهِمْ وَ جَنّٰتٌ تَجْرِىْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِينَ فِيْهَا  وَ نِعْمَ اَجْرُ الْعٰمِلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: There are examples in the past before you, now go and travel on the earth and see consequences of those who have denied.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ سُنَنٌ فَسِيْرُوا فِىْ الْاَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ

verses.english_text: This is a statement of truth for general people and admonition and guidance for the righteous people.
verses.arabic_text: هٰذَا بَيَانٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَ هُدًى وَّ مَوْعِظَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Beware! Do not be lazy, don’t feel dejected in distress, if you are the believer then your head will be held high.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَهِنُوْا وَ لَا تَحْزَنُوْا وَ اَنْتُمُ الْاَعْلَوْنَ اِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: (In Battle of Ohad) If a wound was inflicted on you, such wounds were also afflicted on your opponents (in Battle of Badr) also, and We alternate time among the people so Allah observe the believers separately, and some of you may get the rank of martyrs, and Allah does not befriend the oppressors.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ يَمْسَسْكُمْ قَرْحٌ فَقَدْ مَسَّ الْقَوْمَ قَرْحٌ مِّثْلُهُ  وَ تِلْكَ الْاَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيْنَ النَّاسِ وَ لِيَعْلَمَ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ يَتَّخِذَ مِنْكُمْ شُهَدَآءَ   وَ اللّٰهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And Allah wanted to segregate the believers and destroy the unbelievers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لِيُمَحِّصَ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ يَمْحَقَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Do you think you will all go to the Paradise? And Allah does not know who has fought in His way and who has remained steadfast.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ اَنْ تَدْخُلُوْا الْجَنَّةَ وَ لَمَّا يَعْلَمِ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ جَاهَدُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَ يَعْلَمَ الصّٰبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: You were desirous of death before going into battle, and now you have seen it and are seeing it yourselves also. (then why not are you going to the battlefield now).
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ تَمَنَّوْنَ الْمَوْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَن تَلْقَوْهُ فَقَدْ رَاَيْتُمُوْهُ وَ اَنتُمْ تَنْظُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And Mohammad [SAW] is only a Prophet, and there were many prophets before him, then if he dies or is killed, will you turn back (to infidelity)? No one can harm Allah if you turn back, and in near future Allah will reward you for your thankfulness.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا مُحَمَّدٌ اِلَّا رَسُولٌ  ۚ  قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ  اَفَاْئِنْ مَّاتَ اَوْ قُتِلَ انقَلَبْتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ اَعْقَابِكُمْ  وَ مَنْ يَّنْقَلِبْ عَلَٰى عَقِبَيْهِ فَلَنْ يَّضُرَّ اللّٰهَ شَيْئًا   وَ سَيَجْزِى اللّٰهُ الشّٰكِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And no one can die without command of Allah, and the time is fixed for every one’s death, and whoever desires for reward in this world, I will give here, and whoever desire for the reward in the Hereafter, I will give them there, and shortly We will reward the thankful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ اَنْ تَمُوْتَ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ كِتٰبًا مُّؤَجَّلًا   وَ مَنْ يُرِدْ ثَوَابَ الدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِ مِنْهَا   وَ مَنْ يُّرِدْ ثَوَابَ الْاٰخِرَةِ نُؤْتِهِ مِنْهَا  وَ سَنَجْزِى الشّٰكِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And many messengers have passed with whom faithful have fought the enemies in such a way that they were not weakened by distress, neither they show cowardice, nor they disgraced before enemies, and Allah befriends who exercise restraint.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَاَيِّنْ مِّنْ نَّبِىٍّ قٰتَلَ مَعَهُ رِبِّيُّوْنَ كَثِيْرٌ فَمَا وَ هَنُوْا لِمَآ اَصَابَهُمْ فِىْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ وَ مَا ضَعُفُوْا وَ مَا اسْتَكَانُوْا   وَ اللّٰهُ يُحِبُّ الصَّابِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Their saying was only, O Lord, forgive our sins and increase our deeds in Your way, and keep us steadfast and give us the victory over infidels.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كَانَ قَوْلَهُمْ اِلَّآ اَنْ قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَ اِسْرَافَنَا فِىْٓ اَمْرِنَا وَ ثَبِّتْ اَقْدَامَنَا وَ انْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: So, Allah rewarded them in this world and good reward for the Hereafter, and Allah loves the people of good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: فَاٰتٰهُمُ اللّٰهُ ثَوَابَ الدُّنْيَا وَ حُسْنَ ثَوَابِ الْاٰخِرَةِ   وَ اللّٰهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Faithful, if you follow unbelievers, then you will be returned on your heels (to the infidelity) and only you will be in loss.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓا اِنْ تُطِيْعُوا الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا يَرُدُّوْكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ اَعْقابِكُمْ فَتَنْقَلِبُوْا خٰسِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Allah is your Guardian and is better than all the helpers.
verses.arabic_text: بَلِ اللّٰهُ مَوْلٰكُمْ  ۚ  وَ هُوَ خَيْرُ النّٰصِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Soon, We will instill your fear in the hearts of the infidels because they made partner to Allah for whom Allah has not sent any sign, and they are destined for Hell which is very bad place for oppressors.
verses.arabic_text: سَنُلْقِىْ فِىْ قُلُوْبِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوا الرُّعْبَ بِمَآ اَشْرَكُوْا بِاللّٰهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ سُلْطٰنًا  ۚ  وَ مَاْوٰهُمُ النَّارُ  وَ بِئْسَ مَثْوَى الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Certainly, Allah fulfilled his promise when you were slaying the infidels with His command in the Battle of Ohad until you reached your desire, later you showed your cowardice for war booty and disputed the instructions of the Prophet and disobeyed him, some of you are desirous of this world, and some desire the Hereafter (and sacrificed themselves over the Prophet), then He turned you from them, and Allah wanted to test you, then Allah forgave you, Allah is very Considerate and Gracious for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ صَدَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُ وَعْدَهُٓ اِذْ تَحُسُّوْنَهُم بِاِذْنِهِ   حَتّٰٓى اِذَا فَشِلْتُمْ وَ تَنَازَعْتُمْ فِىْ الْاَمْرِ وَ عَصَيْتُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَآ اَرٰكُمْ مَّا تُحِبُّوْنَ  مِنْكُمْ مَّنْ يُّرِيْدُ الدُّنْيَا وَ مِنْكُمْ مَّنْ يُّرِيْدُ الْاٰخِرَةَ  ۚ  ثُمَّ صَرَفَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ لِيَبْتَلِيَكُمْ  ۚ  وَ لَقَدْ عَفَا عَنْكُمْ   وَ اللّٰهُ ذُوْ فَضْلٍ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And remember the time when you were running up the hill and not looking back and Prophet was calling you from rear, due to this Allah gave you sorrow in exchange of sorrow, so you don't get depressed for whatever you have lost, and neither on affliction which befell on you, Allah is well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ تُصْعِدُونَ وَ لَا تَلْوُنَ عَلَىٰٓ اَحَدٍ وَّ الرَّسُوْلُ يَدْعُوْكُمْ فِىْٓ اُخْرٰكُمْ فَاَثَابَكُمْ غَمًّۭا بِغَمٍّ لِّكَيْلَا تَحْزَنُوْا عَلَٰى مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَ لَا مَآ اَصَابَكُمْ   وَ اللّٰهُ خَبِيْرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Later, Allah made to sleep peacefully a group and another one was deprived of sleep because they were worried about their lives only and have untruthful and ignorant thoughts, and they were saying, what control do we have over affairs of war, O Prophet, tell them that Control is only that of Allah, they concealed in their hearts which they do not tell you and they say, if it was in our hands we would not have been killed here, tell them, even if you stayed back in homes and if martyrdom was your fate you would have come to battlefield, Allah wishes to test thoughts of your hearts and wishes to clarify the truth of your conscience, and He know the thoughts of the hearts.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ الْغَمِّ اَمَنَةً نُّعَاسًا يَّغْشٰى طَآئِفَةً مِّنْكُمْ   وَ طَآئِفَةٌ قَدْ اَهَمَّتْهُمْ اَنْفُسُهُمْ يَظُنُّوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ غَيْرَ الْحَقِّ ظَنَّ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ   يَقُوْلُوْنَ هَل لَّنَا مِنَ الْاَمْرِ مِنْ شَىْءٍ   قُلْ اِنَّ الْاَمْرَ كُلَّهُ لِلّٰهِ   يُخْفُوْنَ فِىْٓ اَنْفُسِهِم مَّا لَا يُبْدُوْنَ لَكَ   يَقُوْلُوْنَ لَوْ كَانَ لَنَا مِنَ الْاَمْرِ شَىْءٌ مَّا قُتِلْنَا هٰهُنَا   قُل لَّوْ كُنْتُمْ فِىْ بُيُوتِكُمْ لَبَرَزَ الَّذِيْنَ كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَتْلُ اِلَٰى مَضَاجِعِهِمْ  ۚ  وَ لِيَبْتَلِىَ اللّٰهُ مَا فِىْ صُدُورِكُمْ وَ لِيُمَحِّصَ مَا فِىْ قُلُوْبِكُمْ   وَ اللّٰهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ

verses.english_text: Verily, the day when two groups were fighting and some of them fled the scene because of their sins Satan strayed them, but Allah forgave them, and Allah is Forbearing and all Forgiving.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ تَوَلَّوْا مِنْكُمْ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعٰنِ اِنَّمَا اسْتَزَلَّهُمُ الشَّيْطٰنُ بِبَعْضِ مَا كَسَبُوْا   وَ لَقَدْ عَفَا اللّٰهُ عَنْهُمْ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ حَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: O believers, do not be like those who turned infidel, whose brethren died abroad, or were killed in war, they said, if they were with us, they would not have died or killed, Allah makes this cause of intense regret their hearts, Allah gives life and death, and He is well aware from your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَكُوْنُوْا كَالَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ قَالُوْا لِاِخْوَانِهِمْ اِذَا ضَرَبُوْا فِىْ الْاَرْضِ اَوْ كَانُوا غُزًّى  لَّوْ كَانُوا عِنْدَنَا مَا مَاتُوْا وَ مَا قُتِلُوْا  ۚ  لِيَجْعَلَ اللّٰهُ ذٰلِكَ حَسْرَةً فِىْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ   وَ اللّٰهُ يُحْىِ وَ يُمِيْتُ   وَ اللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِيْرٌ

verses.english_text: If you are killed or died in the way of Allah, then Blessings and Forgiveness of Allah is better than the wealth which you collect.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَئِن قُتِلْتُمْ فِىْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ اَوْ مُتُّمْ لَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَ رَحْمَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُوْنَ

verses.english_text: If you die or get killed you will be raised to Allah only (from your graves).
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَئِنْ مُّتُّمْ اَوْ قُتِلْتُمْ لَاِ الَى اللّٰهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: It is a Blessing of Allah that they got a soft-hearted person like you, if you would have been rude and hard-hearted, they would have scattered long ago, now pardon them, and seek forgiveness for them, take their advice in your affairs, but if you decide on something, trust upon Allah only, Verily, Allah befriends those who trust on Him.
verses.arabic_text: فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ لِنْتَ لَهُمْ   وَ لَوْ كُنْتَ فَظًّا غَلِيْظَ الْقَلْبِ لَانْفَضُّوْا مِنْ حَوْلِكَ   فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَ اسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَ شَاوِرْهُمْ فِىْ الْاَمْرِ  ۚ  فَاِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللّٰهِ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَوَكِّلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: If Allah helps you then nobody can overpower you, and if Allah forsakes you then who is there who can stand for your help, and believers should have trust in Allah only.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ يَّنْصُرْكُمُ اللّٰهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ   وَ اِنْ يَخْذُلْكُمْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِى يَنْصُرُكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِ   وَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Status of a messenger is not that he betrays, whoever betray, will have to present that thing on the Day of Judgement, they will get full reward for their deeds, and nobody's rights will be trampled.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كَانَ لِنَبِىٍّ اَن يَّغُلَّ  وَ مَنْ يَّغْلُلْ يَاْتِ بِمَا غَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ  ۚ  ثُمَّ تُوَفّٰى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَ هُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Whoever is regular in adherence to please Allah, can he be compared with who is caught in the wrath of Allah, and whose place is hell, and that is the worst destination.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ رِضْوانَ اللّٰهِ كَمَنْۢ بَآءَ بِسَخَطٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَ مَاْوٰهُ جَهَنَّمُ   وَ بِئْسَ الْمَصِيْرُ

verses.english_text: They are in varying grades in the sight of Allah, and Allah is seeing whatever they do.
verses.arabic_text: هُمْ دَرَجٰتٌ عِندَ اللّٰهِ   وَ اللّٰهُ بَصِيْرٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Allah has favoured believers that he sent a Prophet from among them who recite the verses and purify them, and teaches him the Book and words of wisdom, whereas these people (before declaration of prophethood) were in total misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ مَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ اِذْ بَعَثَ فِيْهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْ اَنْفُسِهِمْ يَتْلُوْا عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتِهِ وَ يُزَكِّيْهِمْ وَ يُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ وَ الْحِكْمَةَ  ۚ  وَ اِنْ كَانُوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ لَفِىْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ

verses.english_text: When affliction befallen you whereas you had befallen double the affliction on them, they said from where this affliction has come, O Prophet, tell them this is from you only (because you have disobeyed Prophet), Verily, Allah has power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمَّآ اَصَابَتْكُم مُّصِيْبَةٌ قَدْ اَصَبْتُم مِّثْلَيْهَا قُلْتُمْ اَنّٰى هٰذَا   قُلْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اَنفُسِكُمْ   اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ

verses.english_text: And the day when two parties confronted each other, and that day the affliction befallen on you was from Allah (because of your mischief) so that he tests you.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَصَابَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعٰنِ فَبِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ وَ لِيَعْلَمَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And notice the hypocrites, hypocrites were told to fight in the way of Allah, or at least drive your enemy away, they said had we know how to fight then we would have accompanied you, that day they were nearer to infidelity rather than with faith, they were saying what was not in their hearts, and what they conceal, Allah knows all.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِيْنَ نَافَقُوا  ۚ  وَ قِيْلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا قاتِلُوْا فِىْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ اَوِ ادْفَعُوْا قَالُوْا لَوْ نَعْلَمُ قِتَالًا لَّااتَّبَعْنٰكُمْ   هُمْ لِلْكُفْرِ يَوْمَئِذٍ اَقْرَبُ مِنْهُمْ لِلْاِيْمانِ  ۚ  يَقُوْلُوْنَ بِاَفْوَاهِهِمْ مَّا لَيْسَ فِىْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ   وَ اللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَكْتُمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And these are the people who stayed in their homes and said about their brothers if they would have followed us, they would not have been killed, O Prophet, tell them if you are truthful then avert your death.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ قَالُوْا لِاِخْوَانِهِمْ وَ قَعَدُوْا لَوْ اَطَاعُونَا مَا قُتِلُوْا   قُلْ فَادْرَءُوْا عَنْ اَنْفُسِكُمُ الْمَوْتَ اِنْ كُنتُمْ صٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Those who were martyred in the way of Allah, don't consider them dead, but they are alive and get sustenance from their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ قُتِلُوْا فِىْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ اَمْوَاتًا  ۚ  بَلْ اَحْيَآءٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ يُرْزَقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: They were overjoyed for the bounties they received from Allah and have good news for those who could not join them that they shall have no fear or grief.
verses.arabic_text: فَرِحِيْنَ بِمَآ اٰتٰهُمُ اللّٰهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَ يَسْتَبْشِرُوْنَ بِالَّذِيْنَ لَمْ يَلْحَقُوْا بِهِم مِّنْ خَلْفِهِمْ اَلَّا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ لَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: They are rejoicing with promise of Grace and Blessings of their Lord, and He does not overlook the reward for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: يَسْتَبْشِرُوْنَ بِنِعْمَةٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَ فَضْلٍ وَّ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُضِيْعُ اَجْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Who were wounded (in the Battle of Ohad) and were steadfast in obeying Allah and His Prophet and among them who were pious and did good work, there is great reward for them.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ اسْتَجَابُوْا لِلّٰهِ وَ الرَّسُولِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَآ اَصَابَهُمُ الْقَرْحُ  ۚ  لِلَّذِيْنَ اَحْسَنُوْا مِنْهُمْ وَ اتَّقَوْا اَجْرٌ عَظِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Those are people, when they were told that people have compiled large battalion for you so be afraid of them, upon hearing this, their faith increased and they said: Allah is sufficient for us, and Responsible.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ قَالَ لَهُمُ النَّاسُ اِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوْا لَكُمْ فَاخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ اِيْمَانًا وَّ قَالُوْا حَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ وَ نِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ

verses.english_text: These fighters came back with the blessings of Allah, and they did not face any trouble, they obeyed the order of Allah, Allah is very Gracious.
verses.arabic_text: فَانْقَلَبُوْا بِنِعْمَةٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَ فَضْلٍ لَّمْ يَمْسَسْهُمْ سُوْٓءٌ  وَ اتَّبَعُوْا رِضْوَانَ اللّٰهِ   وَ اللّٰهُ ذُوْ فَضْلٍ عَظِيْمٍ

verses.english_text: This Satan instill fear among his friends, so do not be afraid of him; if you are believer then fear Me (Only).
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا ذٰلِكُمُ الشَّيْطٰنُ يُخَوِّفُ اَوْلِيَآءَهُ فَلَا تَخَافُوْهُمْ وَ خَافُوْنِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And do not grieve for those who hastens towards infidelity, because they cannot harm Allah at all, however Allah wants them to have no share in the Hereafter, and there is grievous punishment for them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا يَحْزُنْكَ الَّذِيْنَ يُسَارِعُوْنَ فِىْ الْكُفْرِ  ۚ  اِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يَّضُرُّوْا اللّٰهَ شَيْئاً   يُرِيْدُ اللّٰهُ اَلَّا يَجْعَلَ لَهُمْ حَظًّا فِىْ الْاٰخِرَةِ   وَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Those who have adopted infidelity instead of believing they cannot harm Allah, there is grievous punishment for them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اشْتَرَوُا الْكُفْرَ بِالْاِيْمَانِ لَنْ يَّضُرُّوْا اللّٰهَ شَيْئاً   وَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: And those who disbelieve should never think that respite given is of any good to them, but time is given to them to add to their sins, in the end there is humiliating punishment for them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوٓا اَنَّمَا نُمْلِىْ لَهُمْ خَيْرٌ لِّاَنْفُسِهِمْ  اِنَّمَا نُمْلِىْ لَهُمْ لِيَزْدَادُوْٓا اِثْمًا  ۚ  وَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِيْنٌ

verses.english_text: Allah cannot leave you in this condition unless evil ones are separated with the pure ones and also do not wish to inform you about the unseen, but He chooses some from His messengers for this, hence, believe in Allah and Prophet, and if you will practice faith and piety there is grand reward for you.
verses.arabic_text: مَّا كَانَ اللّٰهُ لِيَذَرَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ عَلَٰى مَآ اَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ حَتّٰى يَمِيْزَ الْخَبِيْثَ مِنَ الطَّيِّبِ   وَ مَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ لِيُطْلِعَكُمْ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ وَ لٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَجْتَبِىْ مِنْ رُّسُلِهِ مَن يَّشَآءُ   فَاٰمِنُوْا بِاللّٰهِ وَ رُسُلِهِ  ۚ  وَ اِنْ تُؤْمِنُوا وَ تَتَّقُوْا فَلَكُمْ اَجْرٌ عَظِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Beware! People who show stinginess in whatever Allah has given them, should think that there is no benefit in stinginess, this is bad, very soon, on the Day of Judgement, in the wealth they practice stinginess will be put around their necks as shackles, and all the heritage of earth and skies belong to Allah and He is well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَبْخَلُوْنَ بِمَآ اٰتٰهُمُ اللّٰهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ   بَلْ هُوَ شَرٌّ لَّهُمْ   سَيُطَوَّقُوْنَ مَا بَخِلُوْا بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ   وَ لِلّٰهِ مِيْرَاثُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ   وَ اللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ خَبِيْرٌ

verses.english_text: Allah heard them say that Allah is a pauper and we are very rich, We are writing their nonsense, and their act of slaying of messengers also, but on the Day of Judgement I will say: now as punishment, taste fire of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: لَّقَدْ سَمِعَ اللّٰهُ قَوْلَ الَّذِيْنَ قَالُوْٓا اِنَّ اللّٰهَ فَقِيْرٌ وَّ نَحْنُ اَغْنِيَآءُ  ۘ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَالُوْا وَ قَتْلَهُمُ الْاَنْبِيَآءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَّ نَقُوْلُ ذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيْقِ

verses.english_text: This is the reward for your deed which you have sent ahead, otherwise Allah never oppresses His servants.
verses.arabic_text: ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ اَيْدِيْكُمْ وَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِيْدِ

verses.english_text: And these people say: Allah has made covenant with us unless some messenger show us this miracle that his sacrifice is accepted by way of lightning from the sky, we will not believe him, O Prophet, tell them that many messengers brought clear signs and showed the miracles as demanded by you, if you are truthful then why did you slay them?
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ قَالُوْٓا اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَهِدَ اِلَيْنَآ اَلَّا نُؤْمِنَ لِرَسُوْلٍ حَتّٰى يَاْتِيَنَا بِقُرْبَانٍ تَاْكُلُهُ النَّارُ   قُلْ قَدْ جَآءَكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنْ قَبْلِى بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ وَ بِالَّذِى قُلْتُمْ فَلِمَ قَتَلْتُمُوْهُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Still if they deny, do not get worried, before you many messengers have come with clear signs, scriptures and illuminated books, but still they rejected them.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِن كَذَّبُوْكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَ رُسُلٌ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ جَآءُوْ بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ وَالزُّبُرِ وَالْكِتٰبِ الْمُنِيْرِ

verses.english_text: Every soul shall taste the death, and you will get full reward for your deeds on the Day of Judgement, and successful will be the person who will be saved from Hell and will enter Paradise, and a few days' life in the world is only delusion.
verses.arabic_text: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ   وَ اِنَّمَا تُوَفَّوْنَ اُجُوْرَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ   فَمَنْ زُحْزِحَ عَنِ النَّارِ وَ اُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ فَقَدْ فَازَ   وَ مَا الْحَيٰوةُ الدُّنْيَآ اِلَّا مَتَاعُ الْغُرُوْرِ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Verily, you will be tested with your lives and wealth, and you will have to hear the annoying talk from the people who were given the Book of Allah before you and also from infidels, and if you tolerate it will be an act of determination.
verses.arabic_text: لَتُبْلَوُنَّ فِىْٓ اَمْوَالِكُمْ وَ اَنفُسِكُمْ   وَ لَتَسْمَعُنَّ مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوْا الْكِتٰبَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَ مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ اَشْرَكُوْٓا اَذًى كَثِيْرًا  وَ اِنْ تَصْبِرُوْا وَ تَتَّقُوْا فَاِنَّ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ الْاُمُوْرِ

verses.english_text: Remind the time when Allah had taken a covenant that you will explain the book of Allah properly and do not conceal anything of it, but they did not honour it and they cast it behind them, and got a small price in lieu of it, what a bad transaction it is.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ اَخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِيْثَاقَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوْا الْكِتٰبَ لَتُبَيِّنُنَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ وَ لَا تَكْتُمُوْنَهُ فَنَبَذُوْهُ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ وَ اشْتَرَوْا بِهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيْلًا   فَبِئْسَ مَا يَشْتَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Beware! The people who rejoice on what they have done and wish that they should be praised for whatever good work they have not done, don't think they are saved from punishment, there is painful punishment for them.
verses.arabic_text: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَفْرَحُوْنَ بِمَآ اَتَوْا وَّيُحِبُّونَ اَنْ يُحْمَدُوْا بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوْا فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّهُم بِمَفَازَةٍ مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ   وَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: And the sky and the earth belong to Allah, and He has control over everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لِلّٰهِ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ   وَ اللّٰهُ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ

verses.english_text: Undoubtedly, in the creation of earth and the skies, and in alternation of day and night are many signs for those who understand.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِىْ خَلْقِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ اخْتِلَافِ الَّيْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّاُولِى الْاَلْبَابِ

verses.english_text: Those who remember Allah standing and sitting and lying on their sides and ponder over the creation of skies and the earth and spontaneously say: O Allah, You have not created anything which is useless, You are Pure, save us from the punishment of fire.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ يَذْكُرُوْنَ اللّٰهَ قِيَامًا وَّ قُعُوْدًا وَ عَلَٰى جُنُوبِهِمْ وَ يَتَفَكَّرُوْنَ فِىْ خَلْقِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هٰذَا بَاطِلًا ۚ   سُبْحٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

verses.english_text: O my Lord, to whoever you make to enter the fire You have Verily disgraced, and no one helps the oppressors.
verses.arabic_text: رَبَّنَآ اِنَّكَ مَنْ تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ اَخْزَيْتَهُ  وَ مَا لِلظّٰلِمِيْنَ مِنْ اَنصَارٍ

verses.english_text: O our Lord! we heard a caller who was calling towards faith, saying: believe in your Lord, so we believed; O our Lord forgive our sins and ward off our faults, and may we die with the righteous ones.
verses.arabic_text: رَبَّنَآ اِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِى لِلْاِيْمَانِ اَنْ اٰمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَامَنَّا   رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا وَ كَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّاٰتِنَا وَ تَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْاَبْرَارِ

verses.english_text: O our Lord! Grant us what You have promised to your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Judgement and You never break Your promise.
verses.arabic_text: رَبَّنَا وَ اٰتِنَا مَا وَ عَدْتَّنَا عَلَٰى رُسُلِكَ وَ لَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ   اِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيْعَادَ

verses.english_text: So their Lord accepted their prayer, I do not waste anyone's work whether man or woman, you are from one another, who were deported from homeland and persecuted in My way, and were martyred in the battle against infidels, I will Verily cover their evil deeds, and will make them enter Gardens of Paradise, beneath them rivers are flowing, this is their reward with Allah, and there is always good reward with Allah.
verses.arabic_text: فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ اَنِّى لَآ اُضِيْعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنْكُم مِّنْ ذَكَرٍ اَوْ اُنْثٰى   بَعْضُكُمْ مِّنۢ بَعْضٍ   ۚ   فَالَّذِيْنَ هَاجَرُوْا وَ اُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ وَ اُوْذُوْا فِىْ سَبِيْلِىْ وَ قٰتَلُوْا وَ قُتِلُوْا لَاُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّاٰتِهِمْ وَ لَاُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ  ۚ  ثَوَابًا مِّنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ   وَ اللّٰهُ عِنْدَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ

verses.english_text: Beware, you should not be deceived by infidels who roam from city to city.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فِىْ الْبِلَادِ

verses.english_text: This enjoyment is brief, and their ultimate destination is Hell and what a bad place this is.
verses.arabic_text: مَتَاعٌ قَلِيْلٌ ثُمَّ مَاْوٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ  وَ بِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ

verses.english_text: But whoever practices piety of Allah, there are Gardens of Paradise beneath which are flowing rivers, and they will always remain there, this is hospitality from Allah, for pious people the Hereafter is better than this world.
verses.arabic_text: لٰكِنِ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنّٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا نُزُلًا مِّنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ   وَ مَا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلْاَبْرَارِ

verses.english_text: And Verily, there are some among the people of book who have faith in Allah, and on the Book revealed to you, and on the books revealed on them and prostrate before Allah, and they do not take small price for the verses of Allah, there is reward for them with Allah, and certainly, Allah is quick in taking account.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنَّ مِنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ لَمَنْ يُّؤْمِنُ بِاللّٰهِ وَ مَآ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكُمْ وَ مَآ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْهِمْ خٰشِعِيْنَ لِلّٰهِ   لَا يَشْتَرُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيْلًا   اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ اَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ   اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَرِيْعُ الْحِسَابِ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Be patient and teach others to be patient, and prepare (for the holy struggle), and fear Allah so that you may be successful.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا اصْبِرُوا وَ صَابِرُوْا وَ رَابِطُوْا وَ اتَّقُوْا اللّٰهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O People! Fear the Lord Who created you all from one soul and created his mate from the same soul, then from those two created numerous men and women and scattered them in the world, and fear Allah, through Whom you demand from one another (your mutual benefit), and be afraid of negligence of relatives, Allah supervises all your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَّاحِدَةٍ وَّ خَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَ بَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيْرًا وَّ نِسَآءً ۚ وَ اتَّقُوْا اللّٰهَ الَّذِىْ تَسَآءَلُوْنَ بِهِ وَ الْاَرْحَامَ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيْبًا

verses.english_text: And give orphans their property, and do not exchange good with bad, and don't mix their property with yours, this is a very grave sin.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اٰتُوْا الْيَتٰمٰى اَمْوَالَهُمْ وَ لَا تَتَبَدَّلُوْا الْخَبِيْثَ بِالطَّيِّبِ وَ لَا تَاْكُلُوْٓا اَمْوَالَهُمْ اِلٰٓى اَمْوَالِكُمْ  اِنَّهُ كَانَ حُوْبًا كَبِيْرًا

verses.english_text: If you doubt that you would not do justice to orphan, then you can marry women of your choice two, three or four times, but if you fear you cannot do justice among them then contend with one only and with captive that your right hand possess, this is more proper and that you may not deviate from the right path.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنْ خِفْتُمْ اَلَّا تُقْسِطُوْا فِىْ الْيَتٰمٰى فَانْكِحُوا مَا طَابَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ النِّسَآءِ مَثْنٰى وَ ثُلٰثَ وَ رُبٰعَ   فَاِنْ خِفْتُمْ اَلَّا تَعْدِلُوْا فَوَاحِدَةً اَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُكُمْ  ذٰلِكَ اَدْنٰٓى اَلَّا تَعُوْلُوْا

verses.english_text: Give women her dower happily, and if they themselves give up some portion out of their free will, then you can consume it.
verses.arabic_text: وَاٰتُوا النِّسَآءَ صَدُقَاتِهِنَّ نِحْلَةً  فَاِن طِبْنَ لَكُمْ عَنْ شَىْءٍ مِّنْهُ نَفْسًا فَكُلُوْهُ هَنِيٓئًا مَّرِيْٓئًا

verses.english_text: And don't give the weak-minded your wealth, which Allah has made means of sustenance for you, but provide for them clothes and food and speak to them with kindness.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تُؤْتُوْا السُّفَهَآءَ اَمْوَالَكُمُ الَّتِى جَعَلَ اللّٰهُ لَكُمْ قِيٰمًا وَ ارْزُقُوْهُمْ فِيْهَا وَ اكْسُوْهُمْ وَ قُوْلُوْا لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوْفًا

verses.english_text: And test the orphans, when they reach the age of marriage and if you find in them ability of sound judgement, return their property to them, and do not consume in excess fearing they may get adult soon, and whoever is rich among you, desist from their property, and whoever is poor should take minimum, and when you return their property to them take witnesses in their presence, and Allah is self-sufficient in reckoning.
verses.arabic_text: وَ ابْتَلُوا الْيَتٰمٰى حَتّٰٓى اِذَا بَلَغُوا النِّكَاحَ  ۚ فَاِنْ اٰنَسْتُم مِّنْهُمْ رُشْدًا فَادْفَعُوْٓا اِلَيْهِمْ اَمْوَالَهُمْ  ۚ وَ لَا تَاْكُلُوْهَآ اِسْرَافًا وَّ بِدَارًا اَنْ يَّكْبَرُوا ۚ وَ مَنْ كَانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ  ۚ وَ مَنْ كَانَ فَقِيْرًا فَلْيَاْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ   فَاِذَا دَفَعْتُمْ اِلَيْهِمْ اَمْوَالَهُمْ فَاَشْهِدُوْا عَلَيْهِمْ وَ كَفٰى بِاللّٰهِ حَسِيْبًا

verses.english_text: There is a part for men in the inheritance of property of parents and relatives, and for women also there is a part in the inheritance of property of parents and relatives, whether wealth is small or big, it is a duty.
verses.arabic_text: لِلرِّجَالِ نَصِيْبٌ مِّمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدٰنِ وَ الْاَقْرَبُوْنَ وَ لِلنِّسَآءِ نَصِيْبٌ مِّمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدٰنِ وَ الْاَقْرَبُوْنَ مِمَّا قَلَّ مِنْهُ اَوْ كَثُرَ   نَصِيْبًا مَّفْرُوْضًا

verses.english_text: And at the time of distribution if other relatives, orphans and poor come, also give them something as sustenance, and talk softly and appropriately to them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا حَضَرَ الْقِسْمَةَ اوْلُوْا الْقُرْبٰى وَ الْيَتٰمٰى وَ الْمَسٰكِيْنُ فَارْزُقُوْهُمْ مِّنْهُ وَ قُوْلُوْا لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوْفًا

verses.english_text: Those people should be afraid and think how pity they would feel, if they leave behind weak children, they should fear Allah and talk to them softly.
verses.arabic_text: وَلْيَخْشَ الَّذِيْنَ لَوْ تَرَكُوْا مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّةً ضِعٰفًا خَافُوْا عَلَيْهِمْ فَلْيَتَّقُوْا اللّٰهَ وَلْيَقُوْلُوْا قَوْلًا سَدِيْدًا

verses.english_text: People who unlawfully grab the property of orphans, they are filling their bellies with fire, and soon they will go to Hell.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَاْكُلُوْنَ اَمْوَالَ الْيَتٰمٰى ظُلْمًا اِنَّمَا يَاْكُلُوْنَ فِىْ بُطُوْنِهِمْ نَارًا  وَ سَيَصْلَوْنَ سَعِيْرًا

verses.english_text: O Believers! Allah directs you for your children that the boy shall have the equal of the portion of two girls, then if they are more than two girls then they will get two-third of the inheritance, if there is only one girl she will get half, and if children are there and parents are alive there is one-sixth share for each parent, if there are no children then mother will get one third share and if brother is there the mother will get one-sixth, after the payment of bequest he may have made and payment of debts if any, these are your parents and children but you did not know who is more beneficial for you, this is ordinance from Allah and Allah Verily have knowledge and wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: يُوصِيْكُمُ اللّٰهُ فِىْٓ اَوْلَادِكُمْ  لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ الْانْثَيَيْنِ ۚ فَاِنْ كُنَّ نِسَاءً فَوْقَ اثْنَتَيْنِ فَلَهُنَّ ثُلُثَا مَا تَرَكَ  ۚ وَ اِنْ كَانَتْ وَاحِدَةً فَلَهَا النِّصْفُ  وَ لِاَبَوَيْهِ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِّنْهُمَا السُّدُسُ مِمَّا تَرَكَ اِنْ كَانَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ ۚ فَاِنْ لَّمْ يَكُنْ لَّهُ وَلَدٌ وَّ وَرِثَهُٓ اَبَوٰهُ فَلِامِّهِ الثُّلُثُ ۚ فَاِن كَانَ لَهُٓ اِخْوَةٌ فَلِامِّهِ السُّدُسُ  مِنْ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ يُوْصِىْ بِهَآ اَوْ دَيْنٍ  اٰبَآؤُكُمْ وَ اَبْنَآؤُكُمْ لَا تَدْرُوْنَ اَيُّهُمْ اَقْرَبُ لَكُمْ نَفْعًا  فَرِيْضَةً مِّنَ اللّٰهِ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلِيْمًا حَكِيْمًا

verses.english_text: Your share is half of her property if your wife dies and does not leave a child, and if she leaves behind a child then your share is one-fourth after payment of debt and any bequest she had made; if you do not have any child then there is one-fourth share for your wives and if you have any offspring, than there is one-eighth share for them, after payment of debt and bequest if you had made, if somebody dies leaving behind brother or sister as inheritor. (if deceased's parents are not alive and he has no children), then each will have one-sixth share, but if more than two then their share is one-third, after payment of debt or bequest the he had made, as long as it is not detrimental to their rights, then this order is from Allah and He is Knowing and Forbearing.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَكُمْ نِصْفُ مَا تَرَكَ اَزْوَاجُكُمْ اِنْ لَّمْ يَكُنْ لَّهُنَّ وَلَدٌ ۚ فَاِنْ كَانَ لَهُنَّ وَلَدٌ فَلَكُمُ الرُّبُعُ مِمَّا تَرَكْنَ  مِنْۢ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ يُوْصِيْنَ بِهَآ اَوْ دَيْنٍ  وَ لَهُنَّ الرُّبُعُ مِمَّا تَرَكْتُمْ اِنْ لَّمْ يَكُنْ لَّكُمْ وَلَدٌ ۚ فَاِنْ كَانَ لَكُمْ وَلَدٌ فَلَهُنَّ الثُّمُنُ مِمَّا تَرَكْتُمْ مِّنۢ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ تُوْصُوْنَ بِهَآ اَوْ دَيْنٍ  وَ اِنْ كَانَ رَجُلٌ يُوْرَثُ كَلٰلَةً اَوِ امْرَاَةٌ وَّ لَهُٓ اَخٌ اَوْ اخْتٌ فَلِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِّنْهُمَا السُّدُسُ ۚ فَاِنْ كَانُوٓا اَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ فَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فِىْ الثُّلُثِ  مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ يُوْصٰى بِهَآ اَوْ دَيْنٍ غَيْرَ مُضَآرٍّ ۚ وَصِيَّةً مِّنَ اللّٰهِ  وَ اللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌ حَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: These limitations are set by Allah, and whoever will obey Allah and His Prophet, on the Day of Judgement Allah will send him to the Gardens beneath which the rivers will be flowing and they will remain there forever and this is the biggest success.
verses.arabic_text: تِلْكَ حُدُوْدُ اللّٰهِ  وَ مَن يُّطِعِ اللّٰهَ وَ رَسُولَهُ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا  وَ ذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيْمُ

verses.english_text: And whoever disobeys Allah and the Prophet and crosses these limits, then Allah will send him to Hell and he shall remain there forever, and this is the most disgraceful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَن يَّعْصِ اللّٰهَ وَ رَسُولَهُ وَ يَتَعَدَّ حُدُوْدَهُ يُدْخِلْهُ نَارًا خَالدًا فِيْهَا وَ لَهُ عَذَابٌ مُّهِيْنٌ

verses.english_text: And if your women commit adultery then take four witnesses among you, and if all four confirm this then as punishment confine them in the house until they die or Allah makes some way for them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الّٰتِى يَاْتِينَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مِنْ نِّسَآئِكُمْ فَاسْتَشْهِدُوْا عَلَيْهِنَّ اَرْبَعَةً مِّنْكُمْ  فَاِنْ شَهِدُوْا فَاَمْسِكُوهُنَّ فِى الْبُيُوْتِ  حَتّٰى يَتَوَفّٰهُنَّ الْمَوْتُ اَوْ يَجْعَلَ اللّٰهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيْلًا

verses.english_text: And among them who commit fornication they should be beaten up, but if they repent and reform themselves, then leave them, Verily Allah accepts repentance and is Kind.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذٰنِ يَاْتِيٰنِهَا مِنْكُمْ فَاٰذُوْهُمَا  فَاِنْ تَابَا وَ اَصْلَحَا فَاَعْرِضُوْا عَنْهُمَا   اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ تَوَّابًا رَّحِيْمًا

verses.english_text: But repentance is accepted by Allah from those who do evil unknowingly and repent as soon as they realize, and Allah accept repentance of such people, and Allah is all knowing and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا التَّوْبَةُ عَلَى اللّٰهِ لِلَّذِيْنَ يَعْمَلُوْنَ السُّوٓءَ بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ يَتُوْبُوْنَ مِنْ قَرِيْبٍ  فَاولٰٓئِكَ يَتُوبُ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِمْ   وَ كَانَ اللّٰهُ عَلِيْمًا حَكِيْمًا

verses.english_text: And repentance is not for those who did evil throughout their lives and when they reach the death bed, they say we repent, and likewise repentance is not for those also who died in infidelity and We have prepared painful punishment for them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَيْسَتِ التَّوْبَةُ لِلَّذِيْنَ يَعْمَلُوْنَ السَّيِّاٰتِ  حَتّٰٓى اِذَا حَضَرَ اَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ اِنِّى تُبْتُ الْئٰنَ وَ لَا الَّذِيْنَ يَمُوْتُوْنَ وَ هُمْ كُفَّارٌ  اولٰٓئِكَ اَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابًا اَلِيْمًا

verses.english_text: O Believers, this is not proper for you to become inheritor of a woman forcefully, just for the intention of taking some part of the dower from them do not stop them from marrying again, however if they commit indecency. (you may warn them), and continue good behavior with your wives, even if you do not like them for any reason, have patience, perhaps Allah may have kept betterment, in the things you may dislike.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَ اَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ اَنْ تَرِثُوْا النِّسَآءَ كَرْهًا   وَ لَا تَعْضُلُوْهُنَّ لِتَذْهَبُوْا بِبَعْضِ مَآ اٰتَيْتُمُوْهُنَّ اِلَّا اَنْ يَّاْتِيْنَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُّبَيِّنَةٍ ۚ وَ عَاشِرُوْهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ ۚ فَاِنْ كَرِهْتُمُوْهُنَّ فَعَسٰٓى اَنْ تَكْرَهُوْا شَيْئًا وَّ يَجْعَلَ اللّٰهُ فِىْهِ خَيْرًا كَثِيْرًا

verses.english_text: And if you wish to replace a wife with another (after divorcing her), and even if you have given her much in dower, do not take anything back, would you like to take that back in exchange of slander and clear sin.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنْ اَرَدْتُّمُ اسْتِبْدَالَ زَوْجٍ مَّكَانَ زَوْجٍ وَّ اٰتَيْتُمْ اِحْدٰهُنَّ قِنْطَارًا فَلَا تَاْخُذُوْا مِنْهُ شَيْئًا  اَتَاْخُذُوْنَهُ بُهْتَانًا وَّ اِثْمًا مُّبِيْنًا

verses.english_text: How you will take back when you have already consummated the marriage, and they have taken a firm covenant from you.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَيْفَ تَاْخُذُونَهُ وَ قَدْ اَفْضٰى بَعْضُكُمْ اِلَٰى بَعْضٍۢ وَ اَخَذْنَ مِنكُم مِّيثَاقًا غَلِيْظًا

verses.english_text: Do not marry the women whom your fathers had married (even illegally), now whatever has been done, it was shameful and a very abominable custom.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَنْكِحُوا مَا نَكَحَ آبَآؤُكُم مِّنَ النِّسَآءِ اِلَّا مَا قَدْ سَلَفَ  اِنَّهُ كَانَ فَاحِشَةً وَّ مَقْتًا وَ سَآءَ سَبِيْلًا

verses.english_text: O Believers, following women are forbidden for you: your mothers (maternal and paternal grandmothers), daughters (granddaughters), sisters and your parental and maternal, nieces (brother's and sister's daughters), and the women who have breast fed you, and your 'milk sisters', and mothers of wives, your step-daughters under your guardianship born of your wives with whom you have cohabited, but you can marry the girls whose mother you have not cohabited with, and wives of your sons (daughters-in-law) who are from your own loins, and marrying with two sisters at a time, except what has already past, Verily Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ امَّهٰتُكُمْ وَ بَنٰتُكُمْ وَ اَخَوٰتُكُمْ وَ عَمّٰتُكُمْ وَ خٰلٰتُكُمْ وَ بَنٰتُ الْاَخِ وَ بَنٰتُ الْاخْتِ وَ امَّهٰتُكُمُ الّٰتِى اَرْضَعْنَكُمْ وَ اَخَوٰتُكُم مِّنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ وَ امَّهٰتُ نِسَآئِكُمْ وَ رَبَآئِبُكُمُ الّٰتِى فِى حُجُورِكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِكُمُ الّٰتِى دَخَلْتُم بِهِنَّ فَاِن لَّمْ تَكُونُوا دَخَلْتُم بِهِنَّ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ حَلَآئِلُ اَبْنَآئِكُمُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ اَصْلَابِكُمْ وَ اَن تَجْمَعُوْا بَيْنَ الْاخْتَيْنِ اِلَّا مَا قَدْ سَلَفَ   اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيْمًا

verses.english_text: And married women are prohibited except those you get them as slaves in the battle against infidels, this is written command of Allah, other women are also allowed with purity and chastity you wish to marry them by paying dower and not with indecency and adultery, the women you have taken in temporary marriage, pay them the prescribed dower, and after completing the agreed period, if you wish to stay with them with mutual consent, there is no harm, Verily Allah is All-Knowing and All-Wise.
verses.arabic_text: وَّ الْمُحْصَنٰتُ مِنَ النِّسَآءِ اِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُكُمْ  ۚ  كِتٰبَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَ احِلَّ لَكُم مَّا وَرَآءَ ذٰلِكُمْ اَنْ تَبْتَغُوْا بِاَمْوَالِكُم مُّحْصِنِيْنَ غَيْرَ مُسَافِحِيْنَ  فَمَا اسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ بِهِ مِنْهُنَّ فَاٰتُوْهُنَّ اُجُوُرَهُنَّ فَرِيْضَةً  وَ لَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِىْمَا تَراضَيْتُم بِهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ الْفَرِيْضَةِ   اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلِيْمًا حَكِيْمًا

verses.english_text: Among you who is unable to pay dower to the free believing women, then he can marry a believing slave-girl in your possession, and Allah know your thoughts, you are from one another, and marry the slave-girls with the permission of their masters and pay them dower, but marry only those who will remain steadfast with you, they should not be indulging in fornication openly or stealthily, after becoming your wife if she commit adultery then her punishment is half of the free woman, this is for those who fear falling for evil, but if you exercise restraint it is better for you, Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَنْ لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ مِنْكُمْ طَوْلًا اَن يَّنْكِحَ الْمُحْصَنٰتِ الْمُؤْمِنٰتِ فَمِنْ مَّا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُكُم مِّنْ فَتَيٰتِكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنٰتِ ۚ وَ اللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِاِيْمَانِكُمْ  بَعْضُكُمْ مِّنْ بَعْضٍ ۚ فَانْكِحُوْهُنَّ بِاِذْنِ اَهْلِهِنَّ وَ اٰتُوْهُنَّ اُجُوْرَهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ مُحْصَنٰتٍ غَيْرَ مُسٰفِحٰتٍ وَّ لَا مُتَّخِذٰتِ اَخْدَانٍ ۚ فَاِذَآ اُحْصِنَّ فَاِنْ اَتَيْنَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ فَعَلَيْهِنَّ نِصْفُ مَا عَلَى الْمُحْصَنٰتِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ  ذٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ الْعَنَتَ مِنكُمْ  وَ اَنْ تَصْبِرُوْا خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ   وَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Allah wishes to explain His commands to you and make you tread the path of upright people and accept your repentance, and Allah is aware of everything and is Wise.
verses.arabic_text: يُرِيدُ اللّٰهُ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ وَ يَهْدِيَكُمْ سُنَنَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَ يَتُوْبَ عَلَيْكُمْ   وَ اللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌ حَكِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Allah desires to accept your repentance and people who follow lusty desires want to drive you far away from the right path.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اللّٰهُ يُرِيْدُ اَنْ يَّتُوْبَ عَلَيْكُمْ  وَ يُرِيْدُ الَّذِيْنَ يَتَّبِعُونَ الشَّهَوٰتِ اَن تَمِيْلُوا مَيْلًا عَظِيْمًا

verses.english_text: Allah desires to mitigate your burden because humans have been created weak.
verses.arabic_text: يُرِيْدُ اللّٰهُ اَن يُّخَفِّفَ عَنكُمْ ۚ وَ خُلِقَ الْاِنْسَانُ ضَعِيْفًا

verses.english_text: O Believers, do not unjustly grab the wealth of one another, but if you do trade with mutual consent where wealth of one another is involved then there is no harm, do not commit suicide by choking yourself because Allah is Merciful on your condition.
verses.arabic_text: يَآ اَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا لَا تَاْكُلُوْا اَمْوَالَكُم بَيْنَكُم بِالْبَاطِلِ اِلَّآ اَنْ تَكُوْنَ تِجَارَةً عَن تَرَاضٍ مِّنْكُمْ  وَ لَا تَقْتُلُوْٓا انْفُسَكُمْ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيْمًا

verses.english_text: And whoever will cross the limit and unjustly commit excesses, very soon We will cast them in the fire of Hell and it is very easy for Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ عُدْوَانًا وَّ ظُلْمًا فَسَوْفَ نُصْلِيْهِ نَارًا  وَ كَانَ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ يَسِيْرًا

verses.english_text: If you do not commit the major sins out of prohibited acts, then We will forgive your smaller sins and will send you to the honourable place.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ تَجْتَنِبُوا كَبٰٓئِرَ مَا تُنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ نُكَفِّرْ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّاٰتِكُمْ وَ نُدْخِلْكُم مُّدْخَلًا كَرِيْمًا

verses.english_text: And among you Allah has given preference to one over another, but don’t wish because this preference is because of their deeds, men will get their share of what they earn, and women will get their share of what they earn, ask Allah for His Mercy, Verily, Allah is aware of everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَتَمَنَّوْا مَا فَضَّلَ اللّٰهُ بِهِ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَٰى بَعْضٍ   لِلرِّجَالِ نَصِيْبٌ مِّمَّا اكْتَسَبُوا  وَ لِلنِّسَآءِ نَصِيْبٌ مِّمَّا اكْتَسَبْنَ   وَ سْئَلُوا اللّٰهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيْمًا

verses.english_text: And to every one We have appointed heirs of what parents and near relatives leave; and whoever has made covenant, give them their portion, Verily Allah is witness over all.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِكُلٍّۢ جَعَلْنَا مَوَالِىَ مِمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدٰنِ وَ الْاَقْرَبُْونَ  وَ الَّذِيْنَ عَقَدَتْ اَيْمَانُكُمْ فَاٰتُوْهُمْ نَصِيْبَهُمْ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيْدًا

verses.english_text: Men have control over women, Allah has preferred some over some others, and good women obey men since they spend their wealth over them, and like Allah has provided them safety, they also preserve everything, and if you doubt that they may go rebellious, admonish them, and then stop sleeping with them, and still if they don't reform then hit them (lightly that do not cause blood to come out and no limb should break), but if they obey, do not seek a way against them, Allah is High and Great.
verses.arabic_text: الرِّجَالُ قَوَّامُوْنَ عَلَى النِّسَآءِ بِمَا فَضَّلَ اللّٰهُ بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَٰى بَعْضٍ وَّ بِمَآ اَنْفَقُوْا مِنْ اَمْوَالِهِمْ  فَالصّٰلِحٰتُ قٰنِتٰتٌ حٰفِظٰتٌ لِّلْغَيْبِ بِمَا حَفِظَ اللّٰهُ  وَ الّٰتِى تَخَافُونَ نُشُوزَهُنَّ فَعِظُوهُنَّ وَاهْجُرُوْهُنَّ فِى الْمَضَاجِعِ وَ اضْرِبُوْهُنَّ  فَاِنْ اَطَعْنَكُمْ فَلَا تَبْغُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ سَبِيْلًا  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلِيًّا كَبِيْرًا

verses.english_text: And if you fear dispute between them, take one arbitrator from man's side and one arbitrator from woman's side so they make peace between them, and Allah will make best arrangement, and Allah is Knowing and Aware.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنْ خِفْتُمْ شِقَاقَ بَيْنِهِمَا فَابْعَثُوا حَكَمًا مِّنْ اَهْلِهِ وَ حَكَمًا مِّنْ اَهْلِهَا اِنْ يُّرِيدَٓا اِصْلَاحًا يُوَفِّقِ اللّٰهُ بَيْنَهُمَا  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلِيْمًا خَبِيْرًا

verses.english_text: Worship Allah only and make no partner for Him, and be kind to your parents, relatives, orphans, destitute, immediate neighbours, unknown neighbours, those sitting beside you, aliens, slaves and slave-girls, and Allah does not like proud and boastfulness.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَ لَا تُشْرِكُوْا بِهِ شَيْئًا ۖ وَّ بِالْوَالِدَيْنِ اِحْسَانًا وَّ بِذِى الْقُرْبٰى وَ الْيَتٰمٰى وَ الْمَسٰكِيْنِ وَ الْجَارِ ذِى الْقُرْبٰى وَ الْجَارِ الْجُنُبِ وَ الصَّاحِبِ بِالْجَنۢبِ وَ ابْنِ السَّبِيْلِ وَ مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُكُمْ ۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ مَنْ كَانَ مُخْتَالًا فَخُورًا

verses.english_text: These are the people who are stingy and advise other about it, and conceal the wealth given by the Grace of Allah, and We have prepared disgraceful punishment for unbelievers.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ يَبْخَلُوْنَ وَ يَاْمُرُوْنَ النَّاسَ بِالْبُخْلِ وَ يَكْتُمُوْنَ مَآ اٰتٰهُمُ اللّٰهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ وَ اَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ عَذَابًا مُّهِيْنًا

verses.english_text: And the people who spend their wealth just to show off and do not believe in Allah and the Day of Judgement, and whose companion is Satan how bad is he.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ يُنْفِقُوْنَ اَمْوَالَهُمْ رِئَآءَ النَّاسِ وَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَ لَا بِالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ  وَ مَنْ يَّكُنِ الشَّيْطٰنُ لَهُ قَرِيْنًا فَسَآءَ قَرِيْنًا

verses.english_text: What harm would have happened If people who believe in Allah and the Day of Judgement have spent something in the way of Allah, and Allah knows them very well.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَاذَا عَلَيْهِمْ لَوْ اٰمَنُوا بِاللّٰهِ وَ الْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَ اَنْفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَهُمُ اللّٰهُ   وَ كَانَ اللّٰهُ بِهِمْ عَلِيْمًا

verses.english_text: Allah does not cause injustice to anyone even of the size of a particle (on the contrast) He cause to doubles the good deeds of anyone and Himself reward abundantly.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ   وَ اِنْ تَكُ حَسَنَةً يُضٰعِفْهَا وَ يُؤْتِ مِنْ لَّدُنْهُ اَجْرًا عَظِيْمًا

verses.english_text: What condition would that be when We will summon the witness of every group, and (O Mohammad) you will be summoned to witness over them.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ اِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ امَّةٍ بِشَهِيْدٍ وَّ جِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَٰى هٰٓؤُلَآءِ شَهِيْدًا

verses.english_text: That day, O Prophet, unbelievers who disobeyed the Prophet will desire they were levelled with earth, and alas, they will not be able to conceal anything from Allah.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَّوَدُّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ عَصَوُا الرَّسُوْلَ لَوْ تُسَوّٰى بِهِمُ الْاَرْضُ وَ لَا يَكْتُمُوْنَ اللّٰهَ حَدِيْثًا

verses.english_text: O Believers, do not go near prayer in intoxication, so you should understand what you are saying, and not after intercourse until you perform bath, but if you are passing on the road (you can go), if you are sick or in travel and stool comes out or perform intercourse and could not find water, then get yourself clean with dust, then wipe your face and hands with dust and perform dry-ablution (taymoom), Verily Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving.
verses.arabic_text: يٰاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا لَا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَ اَنْتُمْ سُكَارٰى حَتّٰى تَعْلَمُوْا مَا تَقُوْلُوْنَ وَ لَا جُنُبًا اِلَّا عَابِرِى سَبِيْلٍ حَتّٰى تَغْتَسِلُوا  وَ اِنْ كُنتُم مَّرْضٰٓى اَوْ عَلَٰى سَفَرٍ اَوْ جَآءَ اَحَدٌ مِّنْكُم مِّنَ الْغَآئِطِ اَوْ لٰمَسْتُمُ النِّسَآءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَآءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيْدًا طَيِّبًا فَامْسَحُوا بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَ اَيْدِيْكُمْ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَفُوًّا غَفُوْرًا

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Didn’t you notice those who were given a portion of the book of Allah, but those people started purchasing ignorance instead of guidance, they really want you also to stray from the right path.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِينَ اوتُوا نَصِيْبًا مِّنَ الْكِتٰبِ يَشْتَرُوْنَ الضَّلٰلَةَ وَ يُرِيْدُوْنَ اَنْ تَضِلُّوْا السَّبِيْلَ

verses.english_text: And Verily Allah is well aware of your enemies, and Allah is enough for friendship and Allah is enough for support.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِاَعْدَائِكُمْ  وَ كَفٰى بِاللّٰهِ وَ لِيًّا وَّ كَفٰى بِاللّٰهِ نَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: There are people in Jews who alter words from their places and say: we heard and disobeyed, you also listen but you will not be heard, this is because of language distortion and taunts, it would have been better if they would have said: we heard and obeyed and you also listen and do favour, but Allah has cursed them because of their infidelity, so very few of them will turn believers.
verses.arabic_text: مِّنَ الَّذِينَ هَادُوْا يُحَرِّفُوْنَ الْكَلِمَ عَنْ مَّوَاضِعِهِ  وَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ سَمِعْنَا وَ عَصَيْنَا وَ اسْمَعْ غَيْرَ مُسْمَعٍ وَّ رَاعِنَا لَيًّۢا بِاَلْسِنَتِهِمْ وَ طَعْنًا فِى الدِّينِ  وَ لَوْ اَنَّهُمْ قَالُوْا سَمِعْنَا وَ اَطَعْنَا وَ اسْمَعْ وَ انْظُرْنَا لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ وَ اَقْوَمَ وَ لٰكِنْ لَّعَنَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِكُفْرِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا

verses.english_text: O People of Book! The Book which We have revealed (now) also confirms the book which you have, so believe in it before We distort the faces and turn them toward their backs, like We cursed the violators of Sabbath, shall do the same for them, and Allah's command shall be implemented.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اُوْتُوْا الْكِتٰبَ اٰمِنُوْا بِمَا نَزَّلْنَا مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ مِّنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ نَّطْمِسَ وُجُوْهًآ فَنَرُدَّهَا عَلَىٰٓ اَدْبَارِهَآ اَوْ نَلْعَنَهُمْ كَمَا لَعَنَّآ اَصْحٰبَ السَّبْتِ ۚ وَ كَانَ اَمْرُ اللّٰهِ مَفْعُوْلًا

verses.english_text: Allah does not forgive the sin, that someone makes someone partner with Allah, except that He can forgive any sin, and whoever makes someone associate with Allah, has committed a great sin.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَغْفِرُ اَنْ يُّشْرَكَ بِهِ وَ يَغْفِرُ مَا دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَ لِمَنْ يَّشَآءُ ۚ وَ مَنْ يُشْرِكْ بِاللّٰهِ فَقَدِ افْتَرٰٓى اِثْمًا عَظِيْمًا

verses.english_text: O Prophet, did you not notice that some people show off purity, whereas to whoever Allah gives purity whoever He pleases, and they shall not be wronged even as small as thread.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِينَ يُزَكُّوْنَ اَنفُسَهُمْ  بَلِ اللّٰهُ يُزَكِّى مَنْ يَّشَآءُ وَ لَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ فَتِيْلًا

verses.english_text: Look, how blatantly they are blaming Allah, and this is sufficient for their manifest sin.
verses.arabic_text: اُنْظُرْ كَيْفَ يَفْتَرُوْنَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ الْكَذِبَ  وَ كَفٰى بِهِٓ اِثْمًا مُّبِيْنًا

verses.english_text: Did you not notice that those who were given portions of the book have faith in Satan and idols and say infidels are better than the believers.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِينَ اوْتُوْا نَصِيْبًا مِّنَ الْكِتٰبِ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْجِبْتِ وَ الطَّاغُوتِ وَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ لِلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا هٰٓؤُلَآءِ اَهْدٰى مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا سَبِيْلًا

verses.english_text: O Prophet, these are the people who have curse of Allah, you will see that no one will help them.
verses.arabic_text: اُوْلٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيْنَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللّٰهُ   وَ مَنْ يَّلْعَنِ اللّٰهُ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهُ نَصِيْرًا

verses.english_text: Do they have any share in the kingdom? That they do not want to give even a straw to them.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ لَهُمْ نَصِيْبٌ مِّنَ الْمُلْكِ فَاِذًا لَّا يُؤْتُوْنَ النَّاسَ نَقِيْرًا

verses.english_text: Or they are jealous of those whom Allah has given abundance with His Grace, and gave book, wisdom and kingdom to the family of Ibrahim.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ يَحْسُدُوْنَ النَّاسَ عَلَٰى مَآ اٰتٰهُمُ اللّٰهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ   فَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَآ اٰلَ اِبْرٰهِيمَ الْكِتٰبَ وَ الْحِكْمَةَ وَ اٰتَيْنٰهُمْ مُّلْكًا عَظِيْمًا

verses.english_text: Then some of them believed and some of them denied, and burning Hell is sufficient for these people.
verses.arabic_text: فَمِنْهُمْ مَّنْ اٰمَنَ بِهِ وَ مِنْهُمْ مَّنْ صَدَّ عَنْهُ  وَ كَفٰى بِجَهَنَّمَ سَعِيْرًا

verses.english_text: Whoever deny Our verses, Verily, shortly We will enter them in Hell-fire, their skins will melt We will replace with new skins, so they taste the punishment, Allah is Predominant and Wise.
