verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَنزَلْنَا التَّوْرٰةَ فِيْهَا هُدًى وَّنُوْرٌ ۚ يَحْكُمُ بِهَا النَّبِيُّوْنَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْلَمُوْا لِلَّذِيْنَ هَادُوْا وَالرَّبّٰنِيُّوْنَ وَ الْاَحْبَارُ بِمَا اسْتُحْفِظُوا مِنْ كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ وَ كَانُوْا عَلَيْهِ شُهَدَآءَ ۚ فَلَا تَخْشَوُا النَّاسَ وَ اخْشَوْنِ وَ لَا تَشْتَرُوْا بِاٰيٰتِىْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيْلًا  وَ مَنْ لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ فَاُوْلٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And We have commanded in Taurait for Jews that life in lieu of life, eye in lieu of eye, ear in lieu of ear, tooth in lieu of tooth, and wound in lieu of similar wound; and if the oppressed forgoes the oppressor, it will be the expiation for his sins, and those are oppressors who do not judge in accordance with the Book of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَتَبْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِيْهَآ اَنَّ النَّفْسَ بِالنَّفْسِ وَ الْعَيْنَ بِالْعَيْنِ وَ الْاَنْفَ بِالْاَنْفِ وَ الْاُذُنَ بِالْاُذُنِ وَ السِّنَّ بِالسِّنِّ وَ الْجُرُوْحَ قِصَاصٌ  ۚ فَمَنْ تَصَدَّقَ بِهِ فَهُوَ كَفَّارَةٌ لَّهُ وَ مَنْ لَّمْ يَحْكُمْ بِمَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ فَاُوْلٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الظّٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And I made Isa, son of Maryam tread the path of earlier messengers; he verified the book Taurat, which was already existing with them, and I gave him the Injeel, which had guidance and light (faith), and verifying earlier existing book of Taurait, and in it was the guidance and counsel for the pious people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَٰىٓ اٰثَارِهِمْ بِعِيْسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ التَّوْرٰةِ   وَ اٰتَيْنٰهُ الْاِنْجِيْلَ فِيْهِ هُدًى وَّ نُوْرٌ وَ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ التَّوْرٰةِ وَ هُدًى وَّ مَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And people of Injeel should have judged by whatever Allah has revealed in it, and whoever does not follow the Book of Allah is transgressor.
verses.arabic_text: وَلْيَحْكُمْ اَهْلُ الْاِْنجِيْلِ بِمَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ فِيْهِ وَ مَنْ لَّمْ يَحْكُمْ بِمَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ فَاُوْلٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْفٰسِقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And, O Prophet, I also have given you the truthful Book that verifies the books which are already existing and it also protects them, and you also instruct accordingly what has been revealed to you; and do not shrink of whatever has come from Allah and do not follow their ill desires, and We sent different laws and methods for different people, if Allah had pleased He could have sent only one law for all of you, but with different laws He wanted to test to you in whatever has been given to you, step towards the virtuous deeds, and be sure all of you have to return to Him only, there, He will tell you in which you differed;
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَنْزَلْنَآ اِلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ بِالْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ الْكِتٰبِ وَ مُهَيْمِنًا عَلَيْهِ   فَاحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ وَ لَا تَتَّبِعْ اَهْوَآءَهُمْ عَمَّا جَآءَكَ مِنَ الْحَقِّ  لِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مِنْكُمْ شِرْعَةً وَّ مِنْهَاجًا  وَ لَوْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَلٰكِنْ لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِىْ مَآ اٰتٰكُمْ   فَاسْتَبِقُوا الْخَيْرٰتِ  اِلَى اللّٰهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيْعًا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنْتُمْ فِيْهِ تَخْتَلِفُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet, I repeat you make judgement according to what has been revealed to you, and do not follow their low-desires but save yourself from it, may it not be so that they deviate you from whatever has been revealed to you by Allah, thereafter if they turn back from your order then know it is the will of Allah that He afflict them in distress due to their sins, and certainly many are transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَنِ احْكُمْ بَيْنَهُم بِمَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ  وَ لَا تَتَّبِعْ اَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَ احْذَرْهُمْ اَن يَفْتِنُوكَ عَنْۢ بَعْضِ مَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ اِلَيْكَ  فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاعْلَمْ اَنَّمَا يُرِيْدُ اللّٰهُ اَنْ يُّصِيْبَهُم بِبَعْضِ ذُنُوْبِهِمْ وَ اِنَّ كَثِيْرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ لَفٰسِقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Do they desire that you judge them like the period of ignorance, whereas for those who believe; nobody's judgement can be better the judgement of Allah for them.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَحُكْمَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ يَبْغُوْنَ وَ مَنْ اَحْسَنُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ حُكْمًا لِّقَوْمٍ يُّوْقِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Do not befriend with Jews and Christians because they are mutual friends (and they oppose you) and remember whoever among you took them as friend then Verily, he will become one of them, and Verily Allah does not guide the oppressors.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْاْ لَا تَتَّخِذُوْاْ الْيَهُوْدَ وَ النَّصٰرٰىٓ اَوْلِيَآءَۘ بَعْضُهُمْ اَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ وَ مَنْ يَّتَوَلَّهُم مِّنْكُمْ فَاِنَّهُ مِنْهُمْۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And, O Prophet! who have illness (of hypocrisy) you will see they hasten to meet them and tell you the reason that they are scare of them lest affliction may befall because of turn of events; so, very soon, Allah will show victory of Muslims, or some other sign from Him, then they will regret, on what they hid in their hearts.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَرَى الَّذِيْنَ فِىْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّرَضٌ يُّسَارِعُوْنَ فِيْهِمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ نَخْشَىٰٓ اَن تُصِيْبَنَا دَآئِرَةٌ فَعَسَى اللّٰهُ اَنْ يَّاْتِيَ بِالْفَتْحِ اَوْ اَمْرٍ مِّنْ عِنْدِهِ  فَيُصْبِحُواْ عَلَٰى مَآ اَسَرُّوْاْ فِىْٓ اَنْفُسِهِمْ نٰدِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And the believers (when the hypocrite will be exposed), will say: are these the same people who swear hard and tell us: Verily, we were with you, all their deeds are wasted, and they are in utter loss.
verses.arabic_text: وَ يَقُوْلُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓاْ اَهٰٓؤُلَآءِ الَّذِيْنَ اَقْسَمُوْا بِاللّٰهِ جَهْدَ اَيْمَانِهِمْ اِنَّهُمْ لَمَعَكُمْ حَبِطَتْ اَعْمَالُهُمْ فَاَصْبَحُواْ خٰسِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers! (there is no worry) if any of you revert from your faith, very soon, Allah will bring a nation, He shall love them and they shall love Allah, who will be lowly with the believers and will fight with infidels in the way of Allah, and will not mind the reproaches of the reproachers, this is Grace of Allah, He gives to whom he pleases; Allah is Magnanimous and Knowing.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْاْ مَنْ يَّرْتَدَّ مِنْكُمْ عَنْ دِيْنِهِ فَسَوْفَ يَاْتِي اللّٰهُ بِقَوْمٍ يُحِبُّهُمْ وَ يُحِبُّوْنَهُٓ اَذِلَّةٍ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ اَعِزَّةٍ عَلَى الْكٰفِرِيْنَ يُجَاهِدُونَ فِىْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ وَ لَا يَخَافُوْنَ لَوْمَةَ لَآئِمٍ ذٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللّٰهِ يُؤْتِيْهِ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ وَ اللّٰهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Your master and guardian are only these: Allah, His Prophet and those believers who pray regularly and give poor-rate while they bow down.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا وَ لِيُّكُمُ اللّٰهُ وَ رَسُوْلُهُ وَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا الَّذِيْنَ يُقِيْمُوْنَ الصَّلٰوْةَ وَ يُؤْتُوْنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَ هُمْ رٰكِعُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Whoever made Allah, His Prophet and these believers their guardian then he has entered into the Party of Allah, Party of Allah is always predominant.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَنْ يَّتَوَلَّ اللّٰهَ وَ رَسُوْلَهُ وَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْاْ فَاِنَّ حِزْبَ اللّٰهِ هُمُ الْغٰلِبُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers, and to whom the books (Taurait and Injeel) have been given before you, and those who make mockery of your religion, do not make them and the infidels your guardians, and if you are believer then fear Allah only.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَتَّخِذُواْ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّخَذُواْ دِيْنَكُمْ هُزُوًا وَّ لَعِبًا مِّنَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوْاْ الْكِتٰبَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَ الْكُفَّارَ اَوْلِيَآءَ  ۚ وَ اتَّقُواْ اللّٰهَ اِنْ كُنْتُم مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And their mischief has come to the point that when you call them for prayer, they make fun of it, this is because they don't understand anything.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا نَادَيْتُمْ اِلَى الصَّلٰوةِ اتَّخَذُوهَا هُزُوًا وَّ لَعِبًا ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Ask the people of the book which fault do you find with us except that we believe in Allah, and in the Book which has been revealed upon us, and also the books which were sent earlier, and that many of you are wicked.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ هَلْ تَنقِمُونَ مِنَّآ اِلَّآ اَنْ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَ مَآ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْنَا وَ مَآ اُنْزِلَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَ اَنَّ اَكْثَرَكُمْ فٰسِقُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Tell them: shall I tell you which is worst fault is considered by Allah, who has been cursed by Allah, on whom is the wrath of Allah, and those whose entity has been distorted and made monkeys and swine, and who worshipped Satan (instead of Allah); thus, these are the more erring and have strayed from the right path and have gone far away.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ هَلْ اُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّ مِّنْ ذٰلِكَ مَثُوْبَةً عِندَ اللّٰهِ مَن لَّعَنَهُ اللّٰهُ وَ غَضِبَ عَلَيْهِ وَ جَعَلَ مِنْهُمُ الْقِرَدَةَ وَ الْخَنَازِيْرَ وَ عَبَدَ الطَّاغُوتَ اُوْلٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَ اَضَلُّ عَن سَوَآءِ السَّبِيْلِ

verses.english_text: And when they come to you, they say they believe, but they came with infidelity and they also left with it, and whatever they concealed (hypocrisy), Allah knows very well.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا جَآءُوكُمْ قَالُوا آمَنَّا وَ قَد دَّخَلُوْا بِالْكُفْرِ وَ هُمْ قَدْ خَرَجُوا بِهِ وَ اللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْتُمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! You will see many hastening towards sins and transgression, devouring the forbidden, and Verily it is very evil what they do.
verses.arabic_text: وَ تَرٰى كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ يُسَارِعُوْنَ فِىْ الْاِثْمِ وَ الْعُدْوَانِ وَ اَكْلِهِمُ السُّحْْتَ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Why don't people of Allah and religious scholars stop the people from lying and devouring forbidden which they continue, Verily it is very evil.
verses.arabic_text: لَوْلَا يَنْهٰهُمُ الرَّبَّانِيُّونَ وَ الْاَحْبَارُ عَنْ قَوْلِهِمُ الْاِثْمَ وَاَكْلِهِمُ السُّحْتَ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا يَصْنَعُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And Jews say Allah's hand is tied, their hands shall be tied and rebuke of Allah is on them (why would Allah's hand tied); whereas Allah's both hands are spread out and He spends how he pleases; the Book which has been revealed on you will increase their begrudge and jealousy, and will drag them towards disobedience and transgression, and I have put enmity and malice among them till the Day of Judgement, and when they flare up the fire of fight, Allah puts it out; and they roam the earth to spread mischief, and Allah does not like mischief makers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالَتِ الْيَهُوْدُ يَدُ اللّٰهِ مَغْلُوْلَةٌ غُلَّتْ اَيْدِيهِمْ وَ لُعِنُوْا بِمَا قَالُوا بَلْ يَدٰهُ مَبْسُوطَتٰنِ يُنْفِقُ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ وَ لَيَزِيْدَنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم مَّا اُنزِلَ اِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَانًا وَ كُفْرًا وَ اَلْقَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ الْعَدَاوَةَ وَ الْبَغْضَآءَ اِلَٰى يَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِ كُلَّمَآ اَوْقَدُوا نَارًا لِّلْحَرْبِ اَطْفَاَهَا اللّٰهُ وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِىْ الْاَرْضِ فَسَادًا وَ اللّٰهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُفْسِدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And if people of book would have obtained faith and feared me, then Verily, I would have forgone their sins, had bestowed blisses, and caused them to enter in restful Gardens.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ اَنَّ اَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ اٰمَنُوْا وَ اتَّقَوْا لَكَفَّرْنَا عَنْهُمْ سَيِّاٰتِهِمْ وَ لَاَدْخَلْنٰهُمْ جَنّٰتِ النَّعِيْمِ

verses.english_text: If they would have followed what was written in Taurait and Injeel, revealed to them by Allah; then Verily sustenance would have come from the above, and from beneath their feet, and would have consumed peacefully, among them some are reasonable, but most of them, whatever they do, do evil.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ اَنَّهُمْ اَقَامُوا التَّوْرٰةَ وَ الْاِنْجِيْلَ وَ مَا اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْهِم مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ لَاَكَلُوا مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَ مِن تَحْتِ اَرْجُلِهِم مِّنْهُمْ اُمَّةٌ مُّقْتَصِدَةٌ وَ كَثِيْرٌ مِّنْهُمْ سَآء مَا يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Deliver the order of Allah to the people which has already been revealed to you, and if you didn't do it that will mean you have not delivered any of His messages, and do not be afraid, Allah will protect you from mischief of the people, Allah will never allow to reach tribe of infidels to their destination.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَا اُنزِلَ اِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ وَ اِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلْ فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُ وَ اللّٰهُ يَعْصِمُكَ مِنَ النَّاسِ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Tell people of book that unless you will not practice the orders mentioned in Taurait and Injeel which have been sent to you from your Lord, your religion is nothing, and O Prophet, their bitterness and envy because of the Book revealed from your Lord will increase transgression and infidelity; so do not feel sorry for the group of infidels.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لَسْتُمْ عَلَٰى شَيْءٍ حَتّٰى تُقِيْمُوْا التَّوْرٰةَ وَ الْاِنْجِيْلَ وَ مَا اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكُم مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ وَ لَيَزِيْدَنَّ كَثِيْرًا مِّنْهُم مَّآ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَانًا وَكُفْرًا فَلَا تَاْسَ عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: There is no doubt, whether Muslim or Jew whoever is steadfast and wise whether Christian and whoever believe on Allah and the Day of Judgement and perform good deeds, they will not have any fear nor will these people have any grief.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ الَّذِيْنَ هَادُوا وَالصَّابِئُونَ وَالنَّصٰرٰى مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَ الْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ لَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: We have taken a covenant from Bani Israel and sent many messengers to them, in spite of this, when any messenger orders which was against their desires, they denied some and slayed some.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ اَخَذْنَا مِيْثَاقَ بَنِي اِسْرَائِيْلَ وَ اَرْسَلْنَا اِلَيْهِمْ رُسُلًا كُلَّمَا جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ بِمَا لَا تَهْوٰٓى اَنْفُسُهُمْ فَرِيْقًا كَذَّبُوْا وَ فَرِيْقًا يَقْتُلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And they thought there won't be any harm for them, as if they became blind and deaf from the truth. (but despite this, when they repented) Allah accepted their repentance, but again most of them became blind and deaf, and Allah is seeing what they are doing.
verses.arabic_text: وَ حَسِبُوْا اَلَّا تَكُوْنَ فِتْنَةٌ فَعَمُوْا وَ صَمُّوْا ثُمَّ تَابَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ عَمُوْا وَ صَمُّوْا كَثِيْرٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَ اللّٰهُ بَصِيْرٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Whoever is of the belief that Isa son of Maryam is god, they are all infidel, whereas Maseeh himself has said: O Bani Israel, worship the Allah, Who is yours and our Lord, because remember whoever makes the partner to God, Allah have forbidden Paradise on him, and his place is Hell, and none will help oppressors.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ كَفَرَ الَّذِيْنَ قَالُوا اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَ قَالَ الْمَسِيحُ يٰبَنِي اِسْرَآئِيْلَ اعْبُدُوْا اللّٰهَ رَبِّي وَ رَبَّكُمْ اِنَّهُ مَنْ يُّشْرِكْ بِاللّٰهِ فَقَدْ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ وَ مَاْوٰهُ النَّارُ وَ مَا لِلظّٰلِمِيْنَ مِنْ اَنْصَارٍ

verses.english_text: Who believe that Allah is third in Trinity, Verily, they have become infidel, remember, except one Allah, there is no god, if they don't desist from talking nonsense about Allah, and those who remained infidel they will Verily face punishment.
verses.arabic_text: لَّقَدْ كَفَرَ الَّذِيْنَ قَالُوا اِنَّ اللّٰهَ ثٰلِثُ ثَلٰثَةٍ  وَ مَا مِنْ اِلٰهٍ اِلَّا اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ وَ اِنْ لَّمْ يَنْتَهُوْا عَمَّا يَقُوْلُوْنَ لَيَمَسَّنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: So, why don't they repent in the Court of Allah, and seek forgiveness for their sins, whereas Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَلَا يَتُوبُونَ اِلَى اللّٰهِ وَ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَهُ وَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Maseeh, son of Maryam is just a messenger, and many messengers have passed before him, his mother was also a true servant of Allah, like others they were also used to consume food, O Prophet, ponder over, how I explain Our orders to them clearly, and see where they are wandering, O Prophet, tell them: instead of Allah you worship such things which neither can benefit you nor can cause harm, see how they are straying.
verses.arabic_text: مَّا الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ اِلَّا رَسُولٌ  ۚ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ وَ اُمُّهُ صِدِّيقَةٌ كَانَا يَاْكُلٰنِ الطَّعَامَ انْظُرْ كَيْفَ نُبَيِّنُ لَهُمُ الْاٰيٰتِ ثُمَّ انْظُرْ اَنّٰى يُؤْفَكُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! You tell them, instead of All Powerful Allah you are worshipping such a thing which neither can benefit you nor harm you, and Allah Hears and Knows everything.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَتَعْبُدُوْنَ مِن دُونِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَّ لَا نَفْعًا   وَ اللّٰهُ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Tell people of book do not commit unnecessary excesses in your religion, and do not follow their low-desires who had gone astray and have misguided many, and went far away from the right path.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لَا تَغْلُوا فِى دِيْنِكُمْ غَيْرَ الْحَقِّ وَ لَا تَتَّبِعُوْٓا اَهْوَآءَ قَوْمٍ قَدْ ضَلُّوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَ اَضَلُّوْا كَثِيْرًا وَ ضَلُّوْا عَنْ سَوَآءِ السَّبِيْلِ

verses.english_text: Who were infidels in Bani Israel were cursed by Dawood and Isa son of Maryam, curses befall them because they disobeyed and exceeded their limits.
verses.arabic_text: لُعِنَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنۢ بَنِىٓ اِسْرَآءِيْلَ عَلَٰى لِسَانِ دَاوُدَ وَ عِيْسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ   ذٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوْا وَّكَانُوا يَعْتَدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And they did not withhold themselves from any of their evil deeds, but in spite of advice they were stubborn, and how evil these people were doing.
verses.arabic_text: كَانُوا لَا يَتَنَاهَوْنَ عَن مُّنكَرٍ فَعَلُوْهُ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! You will notice that these Jews befriend many infidels, whatever they have accumulated for themselves how evil it is that Allah is enraged with them in this world, and in the Hereafter, they will be in everlasting punishment.
verses.arabic_text: تَرٰى كَثِيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتَوَلَّوْنَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا  ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ لَهُمْ اَنْفُسُهُمْ اَنْ سَخِطَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ فِى الْعَذَابِ هُمْ خٰلِدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: If they had faith upon Allah, His Prophet and on whatever was revealed to them, then never would they have befriended them, but most of them are immoral.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ كَانُوا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَ النَّبِىِّ وَ مَآ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْهِ مَا اتَّخَذُوْهُمْ اَوْلِيَآءَ وَلٰكِنَّ كَثِيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ فٰسِقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! You will find among these Jews and polytheists most hostile to the believers; (among non-Muslims) you will find friendliest persons who call themselves Christians, because among them there are many are abstinent and worshippers, and also that they do not boast.
verses.arabic_text: لَتَجِدَنَّ اَشَدَّ النَّاسِ عَدَاوَةً لِّلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا الْيَهُوْدَ وَ الَّذِيْنَ اَشْرَكُوْا   وَ لَتَجِدَنَّ اَقْرَبَهُمْ مَّوَدَّةً لِّلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا الَّذِيْنَ قَالُوٓا اِنَّا نَصٰرٰى  ۚ ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ مِنْهُمْ قِسِّيْسِيْنَ وَ رُهْبَانًا وَ اَنَّهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And you see suddenly tears roll out of their eyes when these people hear Quran which is revealed on Our Prophet, because they realized the truth and say: Our Lord we believed, write us among those who have supported the prophets.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا سَمِعُوا مَآ اُنزِلَ اِلَى الرَّسُولِ تَرٰٓى اَعْيُنَهُمْ تَفِيْضُ مِنَ الدَّمْعِ مِمَّا عَرَفُوا مِنَ الْحَقِّ   يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ اٰمَنَّا فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشّٰهِدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: How should we not believe on truth which came to us; when we aspire that our Lord will cause us to enter (Paradise) with the people who perform good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا لَنَا لَا نُؤْمِنُ بِاللّٰهِ وَ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ الْحَقِّ وَنَطْمَعُ اَن يُدْخِلَنَا رَبُّنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الصّٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: So Allah granted them green Gardens beneath that rivers are flowing, on the basis of their belief and they will live there forever, and this is the reward for the people who perform good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَثَابَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِمَا قَالُوا جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا  وَ ذٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: These are the Hellish people who adopted infidelity and denied our verses.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ كَذَّبُوا بِاٰيٰتِنَآ اُوْلٰٓئِكَ اَصْحٰبُ الْجَحِيْمِ

verses.english_text: O Believers! The pure things which are made lawful by Allah, do not make them unlawful for you, and do not exceed the limit, Allah does not like transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تُحَرِّمُوا طَيِّبٰتِ مَآ اَحَلَّ اللّٰهُ لَكُمْ وَ لَا تَعْتَدُوٓا  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And consume happily whatever is lawful, clean and pure things Allah has given you; and keep fearing the Lord on which you believe.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كُلُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُ حَلٰلًا طَيِّبًا ۚ وَ اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ الَّذِىٓ اَنْتُمْ بِهِ مُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Allah will not hold you responsible for your loose oaths, but will certainly hold you responsible for your serious swearing, and penalty for the same is to feed ten poor persons of the food you normally eat, or give them clothes or set a slave free; and if anybody cannot do this then he should fast for three days - this is penalty for your swearing, when you swear, fulfil it, Allah explains His orders clearly so that you become thankful.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ اللّٰهُ بِاللَّغْوِ فِىٓ اَيْمَانِكُمْ وَلٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا عَقَّدتُّمُ الْاَيْمَانَ   ۚ فَكَفَّارَتُهُٓ اِطْعَامُ عَشَرَةِ مَسٰكِيْنَ مِنْ اَوْسَطِ مَا تُطْعِمُوْنَ اَهْلِيْكُمْ اَوْ كِسْوَتُهُمْ اَوْ تَحْرِيْرُ رَقَبَةٍ   فَمَنْ لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ ثَلٰثَةِ اَيَّامٍ  ذٰلِكَ كَفَّارَةُ اَيْمَانِكُمْ اِذَا حَلَفْتُمْ ۚ وَ احْفَظُوْٓا اَيْمَانَكُمْ  كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمْ اٰيٰتِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers, Liquor, gambling, idols, dice, these are all impure and Satan works, save yourself from it so you get prosperity.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓا اِنَّمَا الْخَمْرُ وَ الْمَيْسِرُ وَ الْاَنْصَابُ وَ الْاَزْلَامُ رِجْسٌ مِّنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطٰنِ فَاجْتَنِْبُوْهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Satan wants to create enmity among you through liquor and gambling; and keep you off from prayer and remembrance of Allah, so will you then desist?
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا يُرِيْدُ الشَّيْطٰنُ اَن يُوقِعَ بَيْنَكُمُ الْعَدَاوَةَ وَ الْبَغْضَآءَ فِى الْخَمْرِ وَ الْمَيْسِرِ وَ يَصُدَّكُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللّٰهِ وَ عَنِ الصَّلٰوةِ   ۚ فَهَلْ اَنْتُم مُّنتَهُونَ

verses.english_text: Obey Allah and obey the Prophet and desist from disobeying, still if you turn-back then know that Our Prophet had come just to deliver the clear message.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَطِيْعُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اَطِيْعُوْا الرَّسُوْلَ وَ احْذَرُوْا ۚ فَاِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَاعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّمَا عَلَٰى رَسُولِنَا الْبَلٰغُ الْمُبِينُ

verses.english_text: And those who believed and did good work there is no harm what they have already consumed; and if they guard (against evil) and believed and did good work, then they guarded (against evil) and believed, again they guarded (against evil) and performed good deeds, Allah likes the people who do good work.
verses.arabic_text: لَيْسَ عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوْا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيْمَا طَعِمُوْٓا اِذَا مَا اتَّقَوْا وَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوْا الصّٰلِحٰتِ ثُمَّ اتَّقَوْا وَ اٰمَنُوْا ثُمَّ اتَّقَوْا وَ اَحْسَنُوْا  وَ اللّٰهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Allah Verily will test you through hunting to which your hands and spears can reach, because Allah wishes to observe, who fears him in secret, and if still he will transgress then there is painful punishment for him.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَيَبْلُوَنَّكُمُ اللّٰهُ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنَ الصَّيْدِ تَنَالُهُ اَيْدِيْكُمْ وَ رِمَاحُكُمْ لِيَعْلَمَ اللّٰهُ مَنْ يَّخَافُهُ  بِالْغَيْبِ  ۚ فَمَنِ اعْتَدٰى بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ فَلَهُ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Do not kill by hunting while on pilgrimage wearing Ahram, but if you did intentionally, you will have to give compensation of the same of the same kind of animal (which you have killed by hunting) as the two wise men among you will judge, compensation animal shall be brought to Kaaba for sacrifice, or in its equivalent food should be given to the poor or in its lieu fast should be kept, this is because he may taste punishment for his sins which he has committed, and Allah has forgone it, and whoever repeat the act, Allah will punish him; Allah is a Great Avenger.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَقْتُلُوْا الصَّيْدَ وَ اَنْتُمْ حُرُمٌ  ۚ وَ مَنْ قَتَلَهُ مِنْكُم مُّتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَآءٌ مِّثْلُ مَا قَتَلَ مِنَ النَّعَمِ يَحْكُمُ بِهِ ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِّنْكُمْ هَدْيًاۢ بٰلِغَ الْكَعْبَةِ اَوْ كَفَّارَةٌ طَعَامُ مَسٰكِيْنَ اَوْ عَدْلُ ذٰلِكَ صِيَامًا لِّيَذُوْقَ وَبَالَ اَمْرِهِ  عَفَا اللّٰهُ عَمَّا سَلَفَ ۚ وَ مَنْ عَادَ فَيَنْتَقِمُ اللّٰهُ مِنْهُ  وَ اللّٰهُ عَزِيْزٌ ذُو انْتِقَامٍ

verses.english_text: For you and your head of the caravan hunting in the sea and consuming it has been allowed for you, but hunting on the ground is forbidden while you are in Ahram, and keep fearing Allah to whom you have to return.
verses.arabic_text: اُحِلَّ لَكُمْ صَيْدُ الْبَحْرِ وَ طَعَامُهُ مَتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَ لِلسَّيَّارَةِ  ۚ  وَ حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ صَيْدُ الْبَرِّ مَا دُمْتُمْ حُرُمًا  وَ اتَّقُوْا اللّٰهَ الَّذِىْٓ اِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Allah has made Kaaba, His Sacred House, sacred months, sacrifice, and animals who are garlanded for sacrifice, are designated reasons to establish peace, this is because you should know that Allah is aware of everything - whether in skies or on earth; and Verily Allah knows all things.
verses.arabic_text: جَعَلَ اللّٰهُ الْكَعْبَةَ الْبَيْتَ الْحَرَامَ قِيٰمًا لِّلنَّاسِ وَ الشَّهْرَ الْحَرَامَ وَ الْهَدْىَ وَ الْقَلَآئِدَ  ذٰلِكَ لِتَعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ وَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Know that Allah gives the severest punishment and also that He is Great Forgiver and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: اعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ شَدِيْدُ الْعِقَابِ وَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Nothing is imperative on Our Prophet except to deliver the message, and Allah knows everything that you do openly and what you do secretly.
verses.arabic_text: مَّا عَلَى الرَّسُوْلِ اِلَّا الْبَلٰغُ  وَ اللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُوْنَ وَ مَا تَكْتُمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Say: Impure and pure cannot be the same; even if the quantity of impure you may like, and O men of understanding, keep fearing Allah so you become successful.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ لَّا يَسْتَوِى الْخَبِيْثُ وَ الطَّيِّبُ وَ لَوْ اَعْجَبَكَ كَثْرَةُ الْخَبِيْثِ  ۚ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ يٰٓاُوْلِى الْاَلْبَابِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Do not question Prophet for things that if you will come to know you may not like it, but if you will question at the time of revelation of Quran, you will be told about it. (and the questions you had already asked), Allah has forgone, and Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَسْئلُوْا عَنْ اَشْيَآءَ اِنْ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ تَسُؤْكُمْ   وَ اِنْ تَسْئلُوْا عَنْهَا حِيْنَ يُنَزَّلُ الْقُرْاٰنُ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ  ۚ عَفَا اللّٰهُ عَنْهَا  وَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرٌ حَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Earlier people also questioned similarly (to the messengers of their time). (when they could not endure), they became unbelievers.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ سَاَلَهَا قَوْمٌ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ثُمَّ اَصْبَحُوا بِهَا كٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Allah has not fixed any rule such as Bahirah (slit ear she-camel), nor Saibah (bull), nor wasaila (twins), nor Haam (old bull), but infidels fabricate lies against Allah, and most of them do not understand.
verses.arabic_text: مَا جَعَلَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ بَحِيْرَةٍ وَّ لَا سَآئِبَةٍ وَّ لَا وَصِيْلَةٍ وَّ لَا حَامٍ وَّ لٰكِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا يَفْتَرُوْنَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ الْكَذِبَ وَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: When they are called towards the Book revealed by Allah; and towards the Prophet, they say we have seen our forefathers like this and that is sufficient for us, whereas their forefathers neither knew anything nor they got guidance.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا قِيْلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا اِلَٰى مَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ وَ اِلَى الرَّسُوْلِ قَالُوا حَسْبُنَا مَا وَ جَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ اٰبَآءَنَا  اَوَ لَوْ كَانَ اٰبَآؤُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ شَيْئًا وَّ لَا يَهْتَدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Guard yourself when you are on the right path, their misguidance cannot harm you, you have all to return to Allah, there Allah will reveal to you their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا عَلَيْكُمْ اَنْفُسَكُمْ  ۚ لَا يَضُرُّكُمْ مَّنْ ضَلَّ اِذَا اهْتَدَيْتُمْ اِلَى اللّٰهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers! When someone is near his death then for preparing the Will two just witnesses are necessary, if you are travelling and distress of death befall you then two witness (may be non-believers also) are necessary, and if you doubt, than hold them until after prayer, and they should swear on Allah that they will not take a price in exchange of testimony (from anyone), even if one may be our relative, we will testify in the name of Allah and shall not conceal, and if we do, then Verily we are the sinners.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا شَهَادَةُ بَيْنِكُمْ اِذَا حَضَرَ اَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ حِيْنَ الْوَصِيَّةِ اثْنٰنِ ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِّنْكُمْ اَوْ اٰخَرٰنِ مِنْ غَيْرِكُمْ اِنْ اَنْتُمْ ضَرَبْتُمْ فِىْ الْاَرْضِ فَاَصَابَتْكُم مُّصِيْبَةُ الْمَوْتِ  تَحْبِسُوْنَهُمَا مِنْ بَعْدِ الصَّلٰوةِ فَيُقْسِمٰنِ بِاللّٰهِ اِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ لَا نَشْتَرِي بِهِ ثَمَنًا وَّ لَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبٰى وَ لَا نَكْتُمُ شَهَادَةَ اللّٰهِ اِنَّا اِذًا لَّمِنَ الْاٰثِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Then if it became known that they are guilty of lying then take another two witnesses from among whose right is given, and who is nearer to deceased will stand in their denial, then these new witnesses will swear on Allah that their testimony is truer than the earlier witnesses and have not lied even equal to a hair, and if we did are Verily among the oppressors.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنْ عُثِرَ عَلَىٰٓ اَنَّهُمَا اسْتَحَقَّآ اِثْمًا فَآخَرٰنِ يَقُوْمٰنِ مَقَامَهُمَا مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ اسْتَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْاَوْلَيٰنِ فَيُقْسِمٰنِ بِاللّٰهِ لَشَهَادَتُنَا اَحَقُّ مِن شَهَادَتِهِمَا وَ مَا اعْتَدَيْنَآ اِنَّآ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: It is more reasonable to testify correctly, and/or should fear that their testimony may not be rejected by other witnesses, keep fearing Allah and listen to Him, He does not guide the nation of transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: ذٰلِكَ اَدْنٰٓى اَنْ يَّاْتُوْا بِالشَّهَادَةِ عَلَٰى وَجْهِهَآ اَوْ يَخَافُوْآ اَنْ تُرَدَّ اَيْمَانٌۭ بَعْدَ اَيْمَانِهِمْ  وَ اتَّقُوْا اللّٰهَ وَ اسْمَعُوْا  وَ اللّٰهُ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الْفٰسِقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Remember the time, when Allah will gather the Messengers and ask: what answer did you get for your preaching, they will say, what can we say, You know the unseen.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُ اللّٰهُ الرُّسُلَ فَيَقُوْلُ مَاذَآ اُجِبْتُمْ   قَالُوْا لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا   اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوْبِ

verses.english_text: When Allah will say: O son of Maryam remember My favours to you and your mother, and confirmed you through Holy Spirit; you spoke to people from cradle; in the same way as you did in old age, when I taught you writing and words of wisdom, and Taurait and Injeel and when you made bird from clay then blows something on it and it became live bird with My order, and you healed the blind and lepers; and you brought to life the dead from the graves with My order, and when you went to Bani Israel, with miracles and We saved you from them, some infidel said it is manifest magic.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ اللّٰهُ يٰعِيْسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ اذْكُرْ نِعْمَتِىْ عَلَيْكَ وَ عَلَٰى وَالِدَتِكَ   اِذْ اَيَّدتُّكَ بِرُوْحِ الْقُدُسِ تُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ فِىْ الْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا  ۚ وَ اِذْ عَلَّمْتُكَ الْكِتٰبَ وَ الْحِكْمَةَ وَ التَّوْرٰةَ وَ الْاِنْجِيْلَ  ۚ وَ اِذْ تَخْلُقُ مِنَ الطِّيْنِ كَهَيْئَةِ الطَّيْرِ بِاِذْنِي فَتَنْفُخُ فِيْهَا فَتَكُوْنُ طَيْرًا بِاِذْنِي   وَ تُبْرِئُ الْاَكْمَهَ وَ الْاَبْرَصَ بِاِذْنِْي   وَ اِذْ تُخْرِجُ الْمَوْتٰى بِاِذْنِْي   وَ اِذْ كَفَفْتُ بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَآءِيْلَ عَنْكَ اِذْ جِئْتَهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ فَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْهُمْ اِنْ هٰذَآ اِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ

verses.english_text: And when I caused divine inspiration to the disciples (of Isa) to believe in Me and My Prophets, they said: we believed and be our witness that we are Your obedient.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ اَوْحَيْتُ اِلَى الْحَوَارِيِّنَ اَنْ اٰمِنُوْا بِي وَ بِرَسُولِيْ  ۚ قَالُوْا اٰمَنَّا وَ اشْهَدْ بِاَنَّنَا مُسْلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And remember the time when disciples asked Isa, O son of Maryam are you capable that a tray of food to come for us from the sky, Isa said if you are truthful than fear Allah (do not ask anything to test Him).
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ يٰعِيْسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ هَلْ يَسْتَطِيْعُ رَبُّكَ اَنْ يُّنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ   قَالَ اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ اِنْ كُنْتُم مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: They said: we just wanted to taste it as a blessing and eat something from it so our hearts are totally satisfied and we assure you whatever you told us was the truth, and we are witness upon it.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا نُرِيْدُ اَن نَّاْكُلَ مِنْهَا وَ تَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُنَا وَ نَعْلَمَ اَنْ قَدْ صَدَقْتَنَا وَ نَكُوْنَ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ الشّٰهِدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Then Isa son of Maryam requested O Allah, my Lord, send us a table-spread of food for us from sky so that this day becomes a solemn festival for the first of us and to the last of us; and may a great sign be therein for us, and give us sustenance and you are the Best Giver of sustenance.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ عِيْسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ اللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّنَا اَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ تَكُوْنُ لَنَا عِيْدًا لِّاَوَّلِنَا وَ آخِرِنَا وَ آيَةً مِّنْكَ   وَ ارْزُقْنَا وَ اَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرّٰزِقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Allah said: Verily, I will send the table-spread of food but if anybody denies it then I will give such a severe punishment which I shall not give (such severe punishment) to anyone else in My Kingdom.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اللّٰهُ اِنِّي مُنَزِّلُهَا عَلَيْكُمْ  ۚ فَمَن يَّكْفُرْ بَعْدُ مِنْكُمْ فَاِنِّي اُعَذِّبُهُ عَذَابًا لَّآ اُعَذِّبُهُٓ اَحَدًا مِّنَ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Visualize the time when Allah will say: O son of Maryam, did you said: consider me and my mother as Gods instead of Allah; Isa will say: Glory be to Allah, it was not my capacity to utter any word, which I had no right to speak, and had I said, you would be knowing, because you know what is in my heart but I do not know what is in Your Secret, without any doubt you are aware of the unseen.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ قَالَ اللّٰهُ يٰعِيْسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ ءَاَنْتَ قُلتَ لِلنَّاسِ اتَّخِذُونِي وَ اُمِّيَ اِلٰهَيْنِ مِن دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ   قَالَ سُبْحٰنَكَ مَا يَكُوْنُ لِيْٓ اَنْ اَقُوْلَ مَا لَيْسَ لِيْ بِحَقٍّ  ۘ اِنْ كُنْتُ قُلْتُهُ فَقَدْ عَلِمْتَهُ  ۚ تَعْلَمُ مَا فِىْ نَفْسِيْ وَ لَآ اَعْلَمُ مَا فِىْ نَفْسِكَ   اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوْبِ

verses.english_text: I have not said anything more than what you had ordered me, worship Allah who is our Lord and Lord of you all, and up till I was there I took care of them, and when you lifted me; then You were their guardian, and You are witness to everything, and if you punish them, you are the Owner.
verses.arabic_text: مَا قُلْتُ لَهُمْ اِلَّا مَآ اَمَرْتَنِيْ بِهِ اَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ رَبِّي وَ رَبَّكُمْ  ۚ وَ كُنْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيْدًا مَّا دُمْتُ فِيْهِمْ   فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّيْتَنِيْ كُنْتَ اَنْتَ الرَّقِيْبَ عَلَيْهِمْ  ۚ وَ اَنْتَ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيْدٌ

verses.english_text: (O Allah), whether You punish them or forgive them they are your servants; Great Wisdom you have.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَاِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ  ۚ وَ اِنْ تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَاِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ

verses.english_text: Allah said: this is the day when truth will benefit truthful, there will be green Garden beneath which rivers will be flowing, and they will live everlasting life there, Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Allah, and this is the biggest success.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اللّٰهُ هٰذَا يَوْمُ يَنفَعُ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ صِدْقُهُمْ  ۚ لَهُمْ جَنّٰتٌ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا اَبَدًا  ۚ رَّضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنْهُمْ وَ رَضُوْا عَنْهُ ۚ ذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيْمُ

verses.english_text: Whatever is in the skies and on the earth everything is Kingdom of Allah, and He is Competent of Everything.
verses.arabic_text: لِلّٰهِ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا فِيْهِنَّ  ۚ وَ هُوَ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ

verses.english_text: All praises are due to Allah, who has created many skies and earths, and made different darkness and light, and yet the infidels try to compare Allah with others.
verses.arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ وَ جَعَلَ الظُّلُمٰتِ وَ النُّوْرَ  ثُمَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: This is Allah, who created you from clay, and fixed a time for your death, and the time of Day of Judgement is fixed by Him, yet you doubt.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِّنْ طِيْنٍ ثُمَّ قَضٰٓى اَجَلًا  وَ اَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى عِنْدَهُ ثُمَّ اَنْتُمْ تَمْتَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: He is the Lord in the skies and on earth, He is aware of what is obvious, and what is concealed, and He is aware of what you do.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هُوَ اللّٰهُ فِىْ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ فِىْ الْاَرْضِ  يَعْلَمُ سِرَّكُمْ وَ جَهْرَكُمْ وَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُوْنَ

verses.english_text: What a strange condition of theirs, when any verse comes to them from the verses of Allah, they turn their face away.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا تَاتِيْهِم مِّنْ اٰيَةٍ مِّنْ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ اِلَّا كَانُوْا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Therefore, when truth came to them, they indeed rejected it, so these people who are mocking at, will soon know of its reality.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ  فَسَوْفَ يَاتِيْهِمْ اَنۢبٰٓؤُا مَا كَانُوْا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Don't you see, I have destroyed many generations who were given such a power which so far, I have not given you, and sent downpour over them from the skies, and made rivers beneath them (their abodes); but then on account of their sins I destroyed them, and after them I created another generation.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ يَرَوْا كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ مَّكَّنّٰهُمْ فِىْ الْاَرْضِ مَا لَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّكُمْ وَ اَرْسَلْنَا السَّمَآءَ عَلَيْهِم مِّدْرَارًا وَ جَعَلْنَا الْاَنْهٰرَ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهِمْ فَاَهْلَكْنٰهُم بِذُنُوْبِهِمْ وَ اَنْشَانَا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا اٰخَرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet, even if I would have sent a Book written on paper and had they touched it, yet infidels (would have not believed and) would have said it is manifest magic.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ كِتٰبًا فِىْ قِرْطَاسٍ فَلَمَسُوْهُ بِاَيْدِيْهِمْ لَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اِنْ هٰذَآ اِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ

verses.english_text: And they say why don't an angel comes to him, if I had sent an angel, matter would have been settled; and they would not have got any respite.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالُوا لَوْلَآ اُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ مَلَكٞۚ وَ لَوْ اَنزَلْنَا مَلَكًا لَّقُضِيَ الْاَمْرُ ثُمَّ لَا يُنظَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Had I sent an angel as Prophet then I would have made him male only, and would have made him wear same cloth, as male wears cloth.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ جَعَلْنٰهُ مَلَكًا لَّجَعَلْنٰهُ رَجُلًا وَ لَلَبَسْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّا يَلْبِسُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Do not be disheartened, messengers prior to you were also mocked at, the same punishment had encompassed them which they had mocking at.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِالَّذِينَ سَخِرُوْا مِنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Ask them to travel on earth, so they should see how evil was the consequence of those who denied (the messengers).
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ سِيْرُوْا فِىْ الْاَرْضِ ثُمَّ انْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Just ask them whom does it belong; all whatever is in the skies and whatever is on earth, tell them it all belongs to Allah, He has considered Mercy upon himself as imperative, you will all be made to gathered on the Day of Judgement there is no doubt about it, whoever has harmed themselves will not believe.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ لِّمَنْ مَّا فِىْ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ قُلْ لِّلّٰهِ  كَتَبَ عَلَٰى نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ اِلَٰى يَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيْهِ الَّذِيْنَ خَسِرُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: However, they do not understand, whatever lives in the night and in the day, everything belongs to Allah, and He Hears (to everybody), and Knows (everything).
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَهُ مَا سَكَنَ فِىْ الَّيْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ  وَ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيْمُ

verses.english_text: O Prophet, tell them: Shall I take anyone else as guardian leaving Allah, who is Creator of the skies and the earth, and He gives livelihood to everyone, and nobody gives livelihood to Him. (also) you tell them that Allah has ordained me, and I am the first Muslim and that you should not be of the polytheists.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَغَيْرَ اللّٰهِ اَتَّخِذُ وَلِيًّا فَاطِرِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ هُوَ يُطْعِمُ وَ لَا يُطْعَمُ  قُلْ اِنِّىْٓ اُمِرْتُ اَنْ اَكُوْنَ اَوَّلَ مَنْ اَسْلَمَ  وَ لَا تَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! You tell them if I disobey my Lord, Verily I fear the day of severe punishment.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنِّىٓ اَخَافُ اِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

verses.english_text: And that day, from whose head the punishment is averted, then Allah has been Merciful to him and this is manifest success.
verses.arabic_text: مَّن يُصْرَفْ عَنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمَهُ وَ ذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْمُبِيْنُ

verses.english_text: And if you are afflicted from Allah, then know Verily only Allah can repel it, and if any benefit reaches you then nobody can stop Him, because Allah has Power over Everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِن يَمْسَسْكَ اللّٰهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُٓ اِلَّا هُوَ  وَ اِن يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَهُوَ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ

verses.english_text: He is dominant on His servant, He is Aware and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هُوَ الْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِ وَ هُوَ الْحَكِيْمُ الْخَبِيْرُ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Ask them which is biggest testimony; say: Allah is Witness between you and me; this Quran has been revealed to me so that I may give you news and warn you; and do you bear witness that along with Allah there are other gods; O Prophet, tell them you do not testify this; and tell them there is only one Allah, and I deny the things to whom you make partner with Allah.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَيُّ شَيْءٍ اَكْبَرُ شَهَادَةً  قُلِ اللّٰهُ  شَهِيْدُۢ بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَكُمْ  وَ اُوْحِيَ اِلَيَّ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ لِاُنْذِرَكُمْ بِهِ وَ مَنْۢ بَلَغَ اَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَشْهَدُوْنَ اَنَّ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اٰلِهَةً اُخْرٰى  قُلْ لَّآ اَشْهَدُ قُلْ اِنَّمَا هُوَ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ  وَ اِنَّنِيْ بَرِىْٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُوْنَ

verses.english_text: To those whom We gave the book, they recognize the Prophet as they recognize their children, but whoever have put themselves in loss, they cannot become believers.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ اٰتَيْنٰهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ يَعْرِفُوْنَهُ كَمَا يَعْرِفُوْنَ اَبْنَآءَهُمْ  ۘ الَّذِيْنَ خَسِرُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Who will be more tyrant than who falsely slander on Allah or deny His verses, and tyrants will never be saved.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اَوْ كَذَّبَ بِاٰيٰتِهِ اِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الظَّٰلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And remember the day when I will gather all those polytheists, then I will ask them where are those; who they considered partner with Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيْعًا ثُمَّ نَقُوْلُ لِلَّذِيْنَ اَشْرَكُوْٓا اَيْنَ شُرَكَآؤُكُمُ الَّذِيْنَ كُنْتُمْ تَزْعُمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Then none of their mischief will remain; instead they will say: we swear on Allah who is our Lord, we had made none His partner.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَكُنْ فِتْنَتُهُمْ اِلَّآ اَنْ قَالُوا وَ اللّٰهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشْرِكِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Just see how they are lying with themselves, and whatever slander they did; have now vanished.
verses.arabic_text: انْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَذَبُوْا عَلَىٰٓ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ ضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَفْتَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And some of them hear you but We have cast a veil over their hearts and ears so they could not understand, even if they would have seen the divine miracles also, yet they will not believe; after disputing with you when infidels go away, they say it is nothing, but stories of earlier people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِنْهُمْ مَّنْ يَّسْتَمِعُ اِلَيْكَ  ۚ وَ جَعَلْنَا عَلَٰى قُلُوْبِهِمْ اَكِنَّةً اَنْ يَّفْقَهُوْهُ وَ فِىْٓ اٰذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا   وَ اِنْ يَّرَوْا كُلَّ اٰيَةٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوْا بِهَا  حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَآءُوْكَ يُجَادِلُوْنَكَ يَقُوْلُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اِنْ هٰذَآ اِلَّآ اَسَاطِيْرُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And they stop (others) from listening and do not listen themselves also; and they only destruct themselves while they do not understand.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هُمْ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ وَ يَنْئَوْنَ عَنْهُ  ۚ وَ اِنْ يُّهْلِكُوْنَ اِلَّآ اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَ مَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! You will see them when they will be brought on the brink of Hell, they will say: alas, we if would have been sent back and we would not deny the verses of Allah and we would be among the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ تَرٰٓى اِذْ وُقِفُوا عَلَى النَّارِ فَقَالُوْا يٰلَيْتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَ لَا نُكَذِّبَ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّنَا وَ نَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: (But their desire will not be fulfilled) But whatever they have concealed before, has become manifest to them, if they are sent back yet they will do everything which are prohibited, and Verily, they are liars.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ بَدَا لَهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يُخْفُوْنَ مِنْ قَبْلُ  وَ لَوْ رُدُّوْا لَعَادُوْا لِمَا نُهُوْا عَنْهُ وَ اِنَّهُمْ لَكٰذِبُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And infidels also say that everything is worldly life only (and Day of Judgement is a myth), and we will not be raised again (after our death).
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُوْآ اِنْ هِيَ اِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوْثِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet! you will see when Allah will question them, is it not truth? They will reply, by our Lord, it is all truth, then He will say: since in the world you denied it, now taste the punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ تَرٰٓى اِذْ وُقِفُوا عَلَٰى رَبِّهِمْ قَالَ اَلَيْسَ هٰذَا بِالْحَقِّ قَالُوْا بَلَٰى وَ رَبِّنَا قَالَ فَذُوْقُوْا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Whoever denies the presence before Allah on the Day of Judgement is in great loss, till suddenly it will come on their head, they will say, alas, we neglected it, and they will be carrying a burden of sins on their back, how bad is this burden which they will carry.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِلِقَآءِ اللّٰهِ  حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَآءَتْهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغۡتَةً قَالُوا يٰحَسْرَتَنَا عَلَٰى مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِيْهَا وَ هُمْ يَحْمِلُوْنَ اَوْزَارَهُمْ عَلَٰى ظُهُوْرِهِمْ  اَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And this world's life is nothing but play and amusement, and it is obvious that abode of the Hereafter is for the pious ones which is much better than this, don't you know that much also.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا الْحَيٰوةُ الدُّنْيَآ اِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَّ لَهْوٌ  وَلَلدَّارُ الْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَۗ  اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: We know you are grieved by their talk; they deny you not; but (in fact) these tyrants deny the verses of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ نَعْلَمُ اِنَّهُ لَيَحْزُنُكَ الَّذِي يَقُوْلُوْنَ  فَاِنَّهُمْ لَا يُكَذِّبُوْنَكَ وَ لٰكِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ يَجْحَدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And many messengers were denied before you, and they were patient on the denial and persecution till Our help reached them, and there is no one who can change the words of Allah, and incidents of messengers already have reached you.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ فَصَبَرُوْا عَلَٰى مَا كُذِّبُوْا وَ اُوْذُوْا حَتّٰٓى اَتٰهُمْ نَصْرُنَا وَ لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمٰتِ اللّٰهِ  ۚ وَ لَقَدْ جَآءَكَ مِنْ نَّبَاِى الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Their turning away is hard on you, but if you can make a tunnel in the ground or put a ladder on sky to show them some miracle; if Allah pleases, He could have gathered all on the right path (but He tests people); but don't you be among the ignorant.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنْ كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكَ اِعْرَاضُهُمْ فَاِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ اَنْ تَبْتَغِىَ نَفَقًا فِى الْاَرْضِ اَوْ سُلَّمًا فِى السَّمَآءِ فَتَاْتِيَهُمْ بِاٰيَةٍ وَ لَوْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَى الْهُدٰى فَلَا تَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْجٰهِلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Those only follow you who hear you, and the dead will be raised again (on the Day of Judgement) and will be returned unto Him.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا يَسْتَجِيْبُ الَّذِيْنَ يَسْمَعُوْنَ وَ الْمَوْتٰى يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللّٰهُ ثُمَّ اِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And they say why does no miracle come on messenger from his Lord, tell them, Allah is capable of revealing miracles, but many of them do not know the prudent measures of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُوْا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ اٰيَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّهِ قُلْ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ اَنْ يُّنَزِّلَ اٰيَةً وَّ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Four-legged animals who live on earth and two-legged animals who fly in the sky also have communities like you, nothing we have omitted from the Book, then all of them will be brought to their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا مِنْ دَآبَّةٍ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَ لَا طٰٓئِرٍ يَّطِيْرُ بِجَنَاحَيْهِ اِلَّآ اُمَمٌ اَمْثَالُكُم مَّا فَرَّطْنَا فِى الْكِتٰبِ مِنْ شَىْءٍ ثُمَّ اِلَٰى رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And whoever denied Our Verses they have gone into the darkness (of infidelity) and they have become deaf and dumb, Allah may leave in misguidance to whom He pleases and He may guide to whom He pleases.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِاٰيَاتِنَا صُمٌّ وَ بُكْمٌ فِى الظُّلُمٰتِ مَنْ يَّشَاِ اللّٰهُ يُضْلِلْهُ وَ مَنْ يَّشَاْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلَٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Ask them, do you think if the wrath of Allah and the Day of Judgement come to you and if you are truthful, will you call somebody other than Allah?
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتَكُمْ اِنْ اَتٰكُمْ عَذَابُ اللّٰهِ اَوْ اَتَتْكُمُ السَّاعَةُ اَغَيْرَ اللّٰهِ تَدْعُوْنَ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Not anybody else, but you will call Him only, and then for the purpose you have called him, if He pleases, He will repel that then you will forget the gods whom you used to partner with Allah.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ اِيَّاهُ تَدْعُوْنَ فَيَكْشِفُ مَا تَدْعُوْنَ اِلَيْهِ اِنْ شَآءَ وَ تَنْسَوْنَ مَا تُشْرِكُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! I sent many messengers to Ummah which have gone prior to you, but when they disobeyed, I encompassed them in difficulty and hardship so they may implore tearfully in Our Court.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَآ اِلٰٓى اُمَمٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ فَاَخَذْنٰهُم بِالْبَاسَآءِ وَ الضَّرَّآءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَضَرَّعُوْنَ

verses.english_text: So when Our punishment came on their head; why did they not implore us tearfully? but their hearts have hardened and Satan has decorated their acts for them.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَوْلَآ اِذْ جَآءَهُمْ بَاسُنَا تَضَرَّعُوْا وَ لٰكِنْ قَسَتْ قُلُوْبُهُمْ وَ زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطٰنُ مَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: When they forgot who admonished them, then We opened the doors of worldly things so much so when they were happily enjoying the rewards, then suddenly We seized on them, and they became hopeless.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا نَسُوْا مَا ذُكِّرُوْا بِهِ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ اَبْوَابَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَتّٰٓى اِذَا فَرِحُوْا بِمَآ اُوْتُوْا اَخَذْنٰهُمْ بَغْتَةً فَاِذَا هُمْ مُّبْلِسُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Then the roots of the unjust people were cut off, all praise to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! ask them, if Allah takes away your hearing and eyesight and seals your hearts; then except Allah, which other Lord who can give you these bounties again; O Prophet see how clearly We explain Our arguments, yet they turn away their faces.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِنْ اَخَذَ اللّٰهُ سَمْعَكُمْ وَ اَبْصَارَكُمْ وَ خَتَمَ عَلَٰى قُلُوبِكُم مَّنْ اِلٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللّٰهِ يَاتِيْكُم بِهِ اُنْظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ الْاٰيٰتِ ثُمَّ هُمْ يَصْدِفُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Ask them do you think that if punishment of Allah befalls suddenly or openly, so will others also be destroyed unjustly? (never)
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتَكُمْ اِنْ اَتٰكُمْ عَذَابُ اللّٰهِ بَغْتَةً اَوْ جَهْرَةً هَلْ يُهْلَكُ اِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And we send messengers just to give glad tidings to (the good doers) and warn (bad doers), then whoever accepted faith and did good deeds will neither have any fear on the Day of Judgement nor will they grieve.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرِيْنَ وَ مُنْذِرِيْنَ  ۚ  فَمَنْ اٰمَنَ وَ اَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ لَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And whoever denies our verses, torment will engulf them because they were wicked.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيَاتِنَا يَمَسُّهُمُ الْعَذَابُ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَفْسُقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet say: I don't say to you I have treasures of Allah, nor I do know the unseen, neither I tell you that I am an angel, I am only bound by what is revealed to me; ask them, can both blind and seeing persons be the same? Do you not reflect?
verses.arabic_text: قُل لَّآ اَقُوْلُ لَكُمْ عِنْدِىْ خَزَآئِنُ اللّٰهِ وَ لَآ اَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ وَ لَآ اَقُوْلُ لَكُمْ اِنِّى مَلَكٌ  اِنْ اَتَّبِعُ اِلَّا مَا يُوْحَىٰٓ اِلَىَّ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى الْاَعْمٰى وَ الْبَصِيْرُ اَفَلَا تَتَفَكَّرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Through this Quran warn them who fear (in their hearts) that they will be brought before Allah after their death, and (they think) none to be their guardian and intercessor, so that they become pious.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَنْذِرْ بِهِ الَّذِيْنَ يَخَافُوْنَ اَنْ يُّحْشَرُوْٓا اِلَٰى رَبِّهِمْ لَيْسَ لَهُم مِّنْ دُونِهِ وَ لِىٌّ وَ لَا شَفِيْعٌ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet, drive them not away (from your gatherings), who pray morning and evening to seek pleasure of Allah; you are not answerable for their reckoning, and they are not answerable for your reckoning, do not drive them away that you become among unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَطْرُدِ الَّذِيْنَ يَدْعُوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَدٰوةِ وَ الْعَشِىِّ يُرِيْدُونَ وَجْهَهُ  مَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ وَ لَا مِنْ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ شَىْءٍ فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ فَتَكُوْنَ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Likewise, We tested some people with some, so that they say: these are people among us who have Mercy of Allah on them, and does He not know His grateful servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَذٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لِّيَقُوْلُوْٓا اَهٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنۢ بَيْنِنَا اَلَيْسَ اللّٰهُ بِاَعْلَمَ بِالشّٰكِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And whoever believed our verses and come to you, give salutation (to them) and tell them: Allah has made Mercy imperative upon Himself, Verily, who commit a wrong in ignorance but repent and reform himself, then Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا جَآءَكَ الَّذِيْنَ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاٰيَاتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ  كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَٰى نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ  اَنَّهُ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنْكُمْ سُوْٓءًا بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِ وَ اَصْلَحَ فَاَنَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: We explain our verses clearly so that the path of sinners becomes obvious for everyone (and no one should tread on that).
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْاٰيٰتِ وَ لِتَسْتَبِيْنَ سَبِيْلُ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet say: leaving Allah, I have been forbidden from worshipping gods, whom you worship, also tell: I will not follow your low desires otherwise I will be among the misguided, and will not remain among the guided ones.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنِّي نُهِيْتُ اَنْ اَعْبُدَ الَّذِيْنَ تَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ قُلْ لَّآ اَتَّبِعُ اَهْوَآءَكُمْ قَدْ ضَلَلْتُ اِذًا وَّ مَآ اَنَاْ مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet say: I am following the clear argument of Allah and you have denied it, and (in punishment) you try to hasten; which I don't have with me, governance is that of Allah only; and He states the truth and He is Best among who give judgements.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنِّي عَلَٰى بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّي وَ كَذَّبْتُم بِهِ مَا عِنْدِي مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَ بِهِ اِنِ الْحُكْمُ اِلَّا لِلّٰهِ  يَقُصُّ الْحَقَّ  وَ هُوَ خَيْرُ الْفَاصِلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And tell them in which (in punishment) you try to hasten, if I had it with me; so that would certainly have been decided between you and me, and Allah is well aware of the tyrants.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لَّوْ اَنَّ عِنْدِي مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَ بِهِ لَقُضِيَ الْاَمْرُ بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَ اللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِالظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And none else knows the keys of unseen except Allah, only He knows whatever is on earth and in the sea, and no leaf falls but He Verily knows, and no grain in the darkness of earth, neither any moist or dry thing, but that is mentioned in the Divine Book.
verses.arabic_text: وَ عِنْدَهُ مَفَاتِحُ الْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُهَآ اِلَّا هُوَ وَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِىْ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَ مَا تَسْقُطُ مِن وَرَقَةٍ اِلَّا يَعْلَمُهَا وَ لَا حَبَّةٍ فِىْ ظُلُمٰتِ الْاَرْضِ وَ لَا رَطْبٍ وَّ لَا يَابِسٍ اِلَّا فِىْ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيْنٍ

verses.english_text: He is the Lord who take your soul at night, and know what you did during the day, when He raises you up at day, so an appointed term of life (which He knows) is completed, then at last you have to return unto Him, then He will inform you about your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هُوَ الَّذِي يَتَوَفّٰكُم بِالَّيْلِ وَ يَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُمْ بِالنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِيْهِ لِيُقْضٰٓى اَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ اِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: He is Predominant on his servants, and he sends keepers (angels) on you, so much so that if someone's death nears so My angel picks him up and they not shrink their responsibility in following My orders.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هُوَ الْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِ  وَ يُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةً حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَآءَ اَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنَا وَ هُمْ لَا يُفَرِّطُونَ

verses.english_text: Then these people were called back to their truthful Master, be aware that governance is of His only, and He is swiftest in taking account.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ رُدُّوْٓا اِلَى اللّٰهِ مَوْلٰهُمُ الْحَقِّ اَلَا لَهُ الْحُكْمُ وَ هُوَ اَسْرَعُ الْحٰسِبِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Ask them who gives you freedom from the utter darkness of the land and the sea, who you beseech and implore Him with tears and also quietly, and say that we will be thankful if He releases us from these difficulties?
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ مَنْ يُّنَجِّيْكُم مِّنْ ظُلُمٰتِ الْبَرِّ وَ الْبَحْرِ تَدْعُونَهُ تَضَرُّعًا وَ خُفْيَةً لَّئِنْ اَنْجٰنَا مِنْ هٰذِهِ لَنَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الشّٰكِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Say you: Allah gives you freedom from difficulties and distress, yet you make others partner with Allah.
verses.arabic_text: قُلِ اللّٰهُ يُنَجِّيْكُم مِّنْهَا وَ مِنْ كُلِّ كَرْبٍ ثُمَّ اَنْتُمْ تُشْرِكُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet say: It is He who is Predominant on you, if He pleases, He can send punishment from over your head and from beneath your feet; or caused one group to fight with other group, and make to you taste the fight of others, just ponder how We explain our verses in different way so that you could understand.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَٰىٓ اَنْ يَّبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًا مِّنْ فَوْقِكُمْ اَوْ مِنْ تَحْتِ اَرْجُلِكُمْ اَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعًا وَ يُذِيْقَ بَعْضَكُمْ بَاسَ بَعْضٍ انْظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ الْاٰيٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَفْقَهُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And your tribe denied this (Quran) which is a truth, O Prophet, tell them you are not any keeper on them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَذَّبَ بِهِ قَوْمُكَ وَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ قُلْ لَّسْتُ عَلَيْكُم بِوَكِيْلٍ

verses.english_text: There is a term fixed for every prophecy to complete, you will know shortly.
verses.arabic_text: لِّكُلِّ نَبَاٍ مُّسْتَقَرٌّ وَ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And when you see people are absurdly arguing about Our verses, then leave from there, lest they start some other argument, if Satan has caused you to forget this; do not sit (again) with them when you remember.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا رَاَيْتَ الَّذِيْنَ يَخُوْضُوْنَ فِىْٓ اٰيَاتِنَا فَاَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ حَتّٰى يَخُوْضُوْا فِىْ حَدِيْثٍ غَيْرِهِ وَ اِمَّا يُنْسِيَنَّكَ الشَّيْطٰنُ فَلَا تَقْعُدْ بَعْدَ الذِّكْرٰى مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Pious ones have no responsibility for accounting of these people, but they should remind them so they may become pious too.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ يَتَّقُوْنَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّنْ شَيْءٍ وَّ لٰكِنْ ذِكْرَىٰ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And whoever considers religion a play and amusement, they are deceiving themselves, leave such people, and keep advising them through Quran lest someone is afflicted with distress and then they will not find any guardian or intercessor other than Allah, and if they give ransom of the whole world in exchange of their sins, it shall not be accepted; who are afflicted with sins due to their deeds, they will be given hot and boiling water for drinking and they will face painful punishment because they practice infidelity.
verses.arabic_text: وَ ذَرِ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّخَذُوْا دِيْنَهُمْ لَعِبًا وَ لَهْوًا وَ غَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَيٰوةُ الدُّنْيَا وَذَكِّرْ بِهِٓ اَنْ تُبْسَلَ نَفْسُۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ اللّٰهِ وَ لِيٌّ وَّ لَا شَفِيْعٌ  وَ اِنْ تَعْدِلْ كُلَّ عَدْلٍ لَّا يُؤْخَذْ مِنْهَا اُوْلٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيْنَ اُبْسِلُوْا بِمَا كَسَبُوْا  لَهُمْ شَرَابٌ مِّنْ حَمِيْمٍ وَ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمُۢ بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْفُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet ask them, shall we implore the gods, leaving Allah, who can neither benefit nor harm us; and after Allah has guided us, shall we return back on our heels towards infidelity like the person who is misguided by Satan and fell down perplexed in forest; and he has friends who call him towards the right path, saying: come to us; (O Prophet) tell them: Guidance comes from Allah only; and we have been commanded that we be obedient servants of the Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَنَدْعُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُنَا وَ لَا يَضُرُّنَا وَ نُرَدُّ عَلَىٰٓ اَعْقَابِنَا بَعْدَ اِذْ هَدٰنَا اللّٰهُ كَالَّذِى اسْتَهْوَتْهُ الشَّيٰطِيْنُ فِى الْاَرْضِ حَيْرَانَ لَهُٓ اَصْحٰبٌ يَّدْعُوْنَهُٓ اِلَى الْهُدَى ائْتِنَا  قُلْ اِنَّ هُدَى اللّٰهِ هُوَ الْهُدٰى   وَ اُمِرْنَا لِنُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And we have also been ordained to keep up prayers and fears Him only; and it is He that you will all be made to gather before Him.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَنْ اَقِيْمُوْا الصَّلٰوةَ وَ اتَّقُوْهُ وَ هُوَ الَّذِىْٓ اِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: It is He, who have created skies and earth correctly; and on any day when He says: Be, it becomes; His Word is truth, when trumpet will be blown, on that day it will be exclusive Kingdom of Him, and He is the Knower of obvious and unseen, and He is Wise and Aware.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هُوَ الَّذِىْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ   وَ يَوْمَ يَقُوْلُ كُنْ فَيَكُوْنُ ۚ قَوْلُهُ الْحَقُّ  وَ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِى الصُّوْرِ ۚ عٰلِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَ الشَّهَادَةِ  وَ هُوَ الْحَكِيْمُ الْخَبِيْرُ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet, remember the time) When Ibrahim told his father Azar, you consider idols as god, I see you and your tribe in manifest misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ قَالَ اِبْرٰهِيْمُ لِاَبِيْهِ اٰزَرَ اَتَتَّخِذُ اَصْنَامًا اٰلِهَةً ۚ اِنِّى اَرٰكَ وَ قَوْمَكَ فِى ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ

verses.english_text: Likewise, I showed him My Kingdom of skies and earth; so that he be among those who are confident.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَذٰلِكَ نُرِىْٓ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ مَلَكُوْتَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ لِيَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُوْقِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: When the darkness of night fell and he saw a star and suddenly he said, is it my god? So when it set, he said, I love not those that sets.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَنَّ عَلَيْهِ الَّيْلُ رَاَ كَوْكَبًا  ۚ قَالَ هٰذَا رَبِّىْ  ۚ فَلَمَّآ اَفَلَ قَالَ لَآ اُحِبُّ الْآفِلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: When he saw the shining moon, he said, is it my god, so when it set, he said, if my Lord had not guided me, I would Verily have been among those who are astray.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَاَ الْقَمَرَ بَازِغًا قَالَ هٰذَا رَبِّىْ  ۚ فَلَمَّآ اَفَلَ قَالَ لَئِن لَّمْ يَهْدِنِى رَبِّى لَاَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الضَّآلِّيْنَ

verses.english_text: Then, when he saw the burning Sun, he said, is it my god, this is bigger, so when it also set, then he said: O my nation, I am away from the things you make partners with Allah; (they can't be god).
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَاَ الشَّمْسَ بَازِغَةً قَالَ هٰذَا رَبِّىْ هٰذَآ اَكْبَرُ  ۚ فَلَمَّآ اَفَلَتْ قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اِنِّى بَرِْٓئٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُوْنَ

verses.english_text: I have avoided falsehood and I have turned wholly towards Who have created skies and the earth and I am not among the polytheist.
verses.arabic_text: اِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ حَنِيْفًا وَّ مَآ اَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And people of his nation started arguing, then Ibrahim said: do you argue with me for Allah who Verily have guided me, and I do not fear the idols whom you make partners with Allah, however my Lord can do whatever He pleases, Predominant is my Lord because He have Knowledge; yet you don't heed to the advice.
verses.arabic_text: وَ حَآجَّهُ قَوْمُهُ  قَالَ اَتُحَآجُّوْٓنِّى فِى اللّٰهِ وَ قَدْ هَدٰنِ  وَ لَآ اَخَافُ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِٓ اِلَّآ اَنْ يَّشَآءَ رَبِّى شَيْئًا  وَ سِعَ رَبِّىْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا  اَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And why should I fear those whom you make partner with Allah; while you don't fear the matter that He has not sent any authority to you by which you set partners with Allah; then among two of us who has more right to security; say, if you know.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَيْفَ اَخَافُ مَآ اَشْرَكْتُمْ وَ لَا تَخَافُونَ اَنَّكُمْ اَشْرَكْتُمْ بِاللّٰهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطٰنًا ۚ فَاَيُّ الْفَرِيْقَيْنِ اَحَقُّ بِالْاَمْنِ  ۚ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Whosoever believed and he did not contaminate his faith with falsehood; peace is for them only, and Verily, they have been guided.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ لَمْ يَلْبِسُوْٓا اِيْمانَهُم بِظُلْمٍ اُوْلٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ الْاَمْنُ وَ هُمْ مُّهْتَدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And these were Our arguments which We gave to Ibrahim against his nation; We will raise in degree to whoever We please, Verily your Lord is Wise and Knowing.
verses.arabic_text: وَ تِلْكَ حُجَّتُنَآ اٰتَيْنٰهَآ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ عَلَٰى قَوْمِهِ ۚ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجٰتٍ مَّنْ نَّشَآءُ  اِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيْمٌ عَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: We gave to Ibrahim; Ishaq and Yaqoob and We guided them all, and before them We guided Nooh; and his descendants (of Ibrahim): Dawood and Suleiman and Ayub and Yusuf and Moosa and Haroon; and We give such reward to the do-gooders.
verses.arabic_text: وَ وَهَبْنَا لَهُٓ اِسْحٰقَ وَ يَعْقُوبَ ۚ كُلًّا هَدَيْنَا  ۚ  وَ نُوْحًا هَدَيْنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ   وَ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ دَاوُدَ وَ سُلَيْمٰنَ وَ اَيُّوبَ وَ يُوْسُفَ وَ مُوسٰى وَ هٰرُونَ ۚ وَ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And Zakariya and Yahya and Isa and Ilyas. (guided them all); these are all among good servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَ زَكَرِيَّا وَ يَحْيٰى وَ عِيسٰى وَ اِلْيَاسَ   كُلٌّ مِّنَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And Ismail and Al-Yasha and Yunus and Lut (guided them all) and exalted them over all the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِسْمٰعِيْلَ وَ الْيَسَعَ وَ يُوْنُسَ وَ لُوْطًا ۚ وَ كُلًّا فَضَّلْنَا عَلَى الْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Not only to them, but We selected many from their forefathers and their children and brothers and guided them to the right path.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِنْ اٰبَآئِهِمْ وَ ذُرِّيّٰتِهِمْ وَ اِخْوَانِهِمْ  ۚ وَ اجْتَبَيْنٰهُمْ وَ هَدَيْنٰهُمْ اِلَٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ

verses.english_text: See, this the guidance of Allah, He guides to whoever He pleases, if they were polytheist all their deeds would have gone waste.
verses.arabic_text: ذٰلِكَ هُدَى اللّٰهِ يَهْدِىْ بِهِ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ  وَ لَوْ اَشْرَكُوْا لَحَبِطَ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: These were the messengers whom We gave books, perfect intellect and prophethood, even if people do not believe it, We have appointed a nation who will never deny it.
verses.arabic_text: اُوْلٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰتَيْنٰهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ وَ الْحُكْمَ وَ النُّبُوَّةَ ۚ فَاِنْ يَكْفُرْ بِهَا هٰٓؤُلَآءِ فَقَدْ وَكَّلْنَا بِهَا قَوْمًا لَّيْسُوْا بِهَا بِكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: (Prophets of earlier time) were the people whom Allah has guided, so you also follow their guidance. (O Prophet) tell them you do not want any reward for this prophethood, this is nothing but advice for the whole world.
verses.arabic_text: اُوْلٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيْنَ هَدَى اللّٰهُ   فَبِهُدٰهُمُ اقْتَدِهْ  قُلْ لَّآ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ اَجْرًا   اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٰى لِلْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And Jews did not value Allah the way they should have done, because in their absurd talk they said that Allah has not revealed anything on a human being. (O Prophet) ask them: who had revealed the book which Moosa brought; which was a light and total guidance for them, you divided to which and converted into pieces of paper, among that which conform with you, you make it into public and, you conceal which is against you; however you were taught through this book which neither you nor your forefathers knew. (O Prophet) say: Allah had revealed it and then leave them so they play in their own loose discussion.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا قَدَرُوْا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِٓ اِذْ قَالُوْا مَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ عَلَٰى بَشَرٍ مِّن شَىْءٍ  قُلْ مَنْ اَنْزَلَ الْكِتٰبَ الَّذِىْ جَآءَ بِهِ مُوسٰى نُوْرًا وَ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ   تَجْعَلُوْنَهُ قَرَاطِيْسَ تُبْدُوْنَهَا وَ تُخْفُوْنَ كَثِيْرًا  ۚ وَ عُلِّمْتُمْ مَّا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوْٓا اَنْتُمْ وَ لَآ اٰبَآؤُكُمْ قُلِ اللّٰهُ ثُمَّ ذَرْهُمْ فِىْ خَوْضِهِمْ يَلْعَبُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Quran is the book which I revealed with Blessings, and it confirms the already existing book, and We have revealed it so that you warn the people who have faith in the Hereafter living in Mother City and its vicinity, and they believe in it and in prayers they are bound.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هٰذَا كِتٰبٌ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ مُبٰرَكٌ مُّصَدِّقُ الَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَ لِتُنْذِرَ اُمَّ الْقُرٰى وَ مَنْ حَوْلَهَا ۚ وَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهِ   وَ هُمْ عَلَٰى صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Who can be more unjust that who falsely say that he has received revelation, whereas no revelation was sent to him, or the person claim that he will also reveal a similar Quran as Allah has revealed, O Prophet have you seen, how the unjust will be in difficulties of death and angels will tell them to give up their lives and today you shall be recompenses with disgraceful punishment because you falsely blame Allah and you showed pride while listening His verses.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اَوْ قَالَ اُوحِىَ اِلَىَّ وَ لَمْ يُوْحَ اِلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ وَّ مَنْ قَالَ سَاُنْزِلُ مِثْلَ مَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ  وَ لَوْ تَرٰٓى اِذِ الظّٰلِمُونَ فِى غَمَرٰتِ الْمَوْتِ وَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ بَاسِطُوْٓا اَيْدِيْهِمْ اَخْرِجُوْٓا اَنْفُسَكُمْ   الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ الْهُوْنِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَقُوْلُوْنَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ غَيْرَ الْحَقِّ وَ كُنْتُمْ عَنْ اٰيٰتِهِ تَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And at last you have come alone to Me, as I have created you at first, and you left all behind wealth and children that I had given you, and I don't see your intercessor whom you considered My partner, now your mutual ties between you have broken and they have vanished.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ جِئْتُمُوْنَا فُرَادٰى كَمَا خَلَقْنٰكُمْ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَ تَّرَكْتُمْ مَّا خَوَّلْنٰكُمْ وَرَآءَ ظُهُوْرِكُمْ  ۚ وَ مَا نَرٰى مَعَكُمْ شُفَعَآءَكُمُ الَّذِيْنَ زَعَمْتُمْ اَنَّهُمْ فِيْكُمْ شُرَكٰٓؤا لَقَد تَّقَطَّعَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَ ضَلَّ عَنْكُم مَّا كُنْتُمْ تَزْعُمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: It is Allah who cracks kernels and seeds and makes them into trees, and He brings forth the living from the dead, and brings forth the dead from living ones, He is your Lord, then where you are going away.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ فَالِقُ الْحَبِّ وَ النَّوٰى   يُخْرِجُ الْحَىَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَ مُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتِ مِنَ الْحَىِّ  ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ فَاَنّٰى تُؤْفَكُوْنَ

verses.english_text: He causes the dawn to break and created the night for rest and Sun and the Moon for accounting, these are the established rules of Predominant and Wise Allah.
verses.arabic_text: فَالِقُ الْاِصْبَاحِ وَ جَعَلَ الَّيْلَ سَكَنًا وَّ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ حُسْبَانًۭا ۚ ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيْزِ الْعَلِيْمِ

verses.english_text: This is the Lord, Who created stars for your benefit, so that you find the ways in the darkness of forests and the seas, and We have explained our signs in detail; for those who are acquainted.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هُوَ الَّذِىْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ النُّجُومَ لِتَهْتَدُوْا بِهَا فِى ظُلُمٰتِ الْبَرِّ وَ الْبَحْرِ  قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا الْاٰيٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَّعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And it is Allah who has created you all from one person, then kept you (in father's back), and reared you (in womb of mother); and for the wise ones We have explained our signs in detail.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هُوَ الَّذِىٓ اَنْشَاَكُم مِّنْ نَّفْسٍۢ وَاحِدَةٍ فَمُسْتَقَرٌّۭ وَ مُسْتَوْدَعٌ  قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا الْاٰيٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَفْقَهُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And it is He Who is Able and Powerful, Who sent rain from skies, and We bring forth buds, and created green stems, then brought bunch of seeds from them; date-palm and its spathes (come) clusters of dates hanging low and near, and created gardens of dates and grapes and olives and pomegranates, which were similar to one another but different in taste and when they give yields and ripen, ponder over them; Verily there are many signs (of Allah) for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هُوَ الَّذِىْٓ اَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً  ۚ فَاَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ نَبَاتَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ فَاَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهُ خَضِرًا نُّخْرِجُ مِنْهُ حَبًّا مُّتَرَاكِبًا  ۚ وَ مِنَ النَّخْلِ مِنْ طَلْعِهَا قِنْوَانٌ دَانِيَةٌ وَ جَنّٰتٍ مِّنْ اَعْنابٍ وَّ الزَّيْتُوْنَ وَ الرُّمَّانَ مُشْتَبِهًا وَّ غَيْرَ مُتَشَابِهٍ ۚ اُنْظُرُوْٓا اِلَٰى ثَمَرِهِٓ اِذَآ اَثْمَرَ وَ يَنْعِهِ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذٰلِكُمْ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُّؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And they make Jins partners of Allah whereas they are also creatures of Allah, and they fabricated sons and daughters for Allah. (whereas) Allah is Exalted and Pure from all these things; which they ascribe about Him.
verses.arabic_text: وَ جَعَلُوْا لِلّٰهِ شُرَكَآءَ الْجِنَّ وَ خَلَقَهُمْ   وَ خَرَقُوْا لَهُ بَنِيْنَ وَ بَنٰتٍۢ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ ۚ سُبْحٰنَهُ وَ تَعٰلَٰى عَمَّا يَصِفُوْنَ

verses.english_text: He is the Creator of skies and earth, how can He have a son neither He does have any wife, He has created everything and knows everything.
verses.arabic_text: بَدِيعُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ   اَنّٰى يَكُونُ لَهُ وَلَدٌ وَ لَمْ تَكُنْ لَّهُ صَاحِبَةٌ   وَ خَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ  ۚ  وَ هُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: (O People!) This Allah is your Lord, and there is no lord except Him, He is the Creator of everything, so worship Him and He is Guardian of everything.
verses.arabic_text: ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمْ   لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ   خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ فَاعْبُدُوْهُ ۚ وَ هُوَ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَّكِيْلٌ

verses.english_text: Eyes cannot see Him neither in this world nor in the Hereafter (but) He sees to all eyes very well; He has grasp over all visions and Knower of all things.
verses.arabic_text: لَا تُدْرِكُهُ الْاَبْصَارُ وَ هُوَ يُدْرِكُ الْاَبْصَارَ وَ هُوَ اللَّطِيْفُ الْخَبِيْرُ

verses.english_text: Thing to advise you has come to you, now you take benefit from it or if he becomes blind then he will harm himself. (and the Prophet tells them) you are not their keeper.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ جَآءَكُمْ بَصَآئِرُ مِنْ رَّبِّكُمْ   فَمَنْ اَبْصَرَ فَلِنَفْسِهِ  ۚ وَ مَنْ عَمِىَ فَعَلَيْهَا  وَ مَآ اَنَاْ عَلَيْكُمْ بِحَفِيْظٍ

verses.english_text: And We describe our verses differently. (in order to complete the argument), so they should say you have recited the Quran, and We make clear the Quran for those who know.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَذٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ الْاٰيٰتِ وَ لِيَقُوْلُوْا دَرَسْتَ وَ لِنُبَيِّنَهُ لِقَوْمٍۢ يَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Follow that Whatever has been revealed to you from your Lord, there is no god but Allah, and renounce the polytheists.
verses.arabic_text: اتَّبِعْ مَآ اُوحِىَ اِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ   ۚ لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ  ۚ وَ اَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And if Allah pleased, they would not have practiced polytheism, and We have not made you their keeper and neither you are responsible for them.
