verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ مَآ اَشْرَكُوا  وَ مَا جَعَلْنٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيْظًا  ۚ  وَ مَآ اَنْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيْلٍ

verses.english_text: And revile not to those whom polytheists consider their god lest in the enmity they may revile unknowingly for Allah, and We have made pleasing to every community their deeds, later everyone has to return to the Lord only, and He Verily will inform them, about their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَسُبُّوا الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ فَيَسُبُّوْا اللّٰهَ عَدْوًا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ  كَذٰلِكَ زَيَّنَّا لِكُلِّ اُمَّةٍ عَمَلَهُمْ   ثُمَّ اِلَٰى رَبِّهِم مَّرْجِعُهُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And they swore strongly in the name of Allah that if they receive a miracle they will Verily believe, O Prophet, tell them that miracle is with Allah only; and what should you know that Verily, they will not believe even after receiving a miracle.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَقْسَمُوا بِاللّٰهِ جَهْدَ اَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِنْ جَآءَتْهُمْ اٰيَةٌ لَّيُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهَا ۚ قُلْ اِنَّمَا الْاٰيٰتُ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ وَ مَا يُشْعِرُكُمْ اَنَّهَآ اِذَا جَآءَتْ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And We have turned their hearts and eyes and like they have not believed at first on Quran so We have left them in rebellion that they wander.
verses.arabic_text: وَ نُقَلِّبُ اَفْئِدَتَهُمْ وَ اَبْصَارَهُمْ كَمَا لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوْا بِهِٓ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَّ نَذَرُهُمْ فِىْ طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet! Fact is that if We would have sent angels and made dead talk to them and would have brought all unseen things (Paradise, Hell, etc.) in front of them in groups, yet they would not have accepted faith unless Allah pleases, and most of them do not know.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ اَنَّنَا نَزَّلْنَآ اِلَيْهِمُ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةَ وَ كَلَّمَهُمُ الْمَوْتٰى وَ حَشَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ قُبُلًا مَّا كَانُوْا لِيُؤْمِنُوْٓا اِلَّآ اَنْ يَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ يَجْهَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet, as the infidels are your enemy), similarly, We made enemy of all prophets to Satan from among men and jinn, to test them; they deceive each other with whispering of their sweet-talk, and if your Lord pleased they could not have done all this, so leave them in their slanders.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا شَيٰطِيْنَ الْاِنْسِ وَ الْجِنِّ يُوْحِىْ بَعْضُهُمْ اِلَٰى بَعْضٍ زُخْرُفَ الْقَوْلِ غُرُوْرًا  وَ لَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ مَا فَعَلُوْهُ   فَذَرْهُمْ وَ مَا يَفْتَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (This whispering was for) Who do not believe in the Hereafter their hearts may inclined towards them and they be pleased with it, so the slander which they are doing, they also indulge in it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لِتَصْغٰٓى اِلَيْهِ اَفْئِدَةُ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ وَ لِيَرْضَوْهُ وَ لِيَقْتَرِفُوْا مَا هُمْ مُّقْتَرِفُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Do you want that shall I search an arbitrator other than Allah, whereas it is Allah who has sent the obvious book, and to whom We have sent the Book they Verily know that this (Quran) has been sent truthfully from your Lord; so you don't be among those who doubt.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَغَيْرَ اللّٰهِ اَبْتَغِىْ حَكَمًا وَّ هُوَ الَّذِىْٓ اَنْزَلَ اِلَيْكُمُ الْكِتٰبَ مُفَصَّلًا  وَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰتَيْنٰهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ يَعْلَمُوْنَ اَنَّهُ مُنَزَّلٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ بِالْحَقِّ   فَلَا تَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And the word of Allah is completed with truth and just, no one can change the word of Allah, and He listens and Knows.
verses.arabic_text: وَ تَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ صِدْقًا وَ عَدْلًا  لَّا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمٰتِهِ ۚ وَ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ

verses.english_text: O Prophet, there are many people in the world if you follow them, they will misguide you from the path of Allah, they just follow their assumptions, they just do the guesswork.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنْ تُطِعْ اَكْثَرَ مَنْ فِىْ الْاَرْضِ يُضِلُّوْكَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ  اِنْ يَّتَّبِعُوْنَ اِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَ اِنْ هُمْ اِلَّا يَخْرُصُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (What do you know) Allah knows them well who have astray from His path, and He also knows those who have been guided.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ مَنْ يَّضِلُّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ  ۚ وَ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: If you believe His verses then eat that only on which Allah's name was pronounced at the time of slaughter.
verses.arabic_text: فَكُلُوْا مِمَّا ذُكِرَ اسْمُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْهِ اِنْ كُنْتُم بِاٰيٰتِهِ مُؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And what has happened to you, you do not eat from on which Allah's name was pronounced, however, and you have been explained on what is forbidden for you, but if you are helpless (then you can eat), and many people misguide others who follow their low-desires, and your Lord know who transgress from truth.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا لَكُمْ اَلَّا تَاكُلُوْا مِمَّا ذُكِرَ اسْمُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْهِ وَ قَدْ فَصَّلَ لَكُمْ مَّا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ اِلَّا مَا اضْطُرِرْتُمْ اِلَيْهِ  وَ اِنَّ كَثِيْرًا لَّيُضِلُّوْنَ بِاَهْوَآئِهِمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ  اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِالْمُعْتَدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O People, leave obvious and secret sins both, whoever commits sin, shortly they will be recompensed for their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ ذَرُوا ظَاهِرَ الْاِثْمِ وَ بَاطِنَهُ ۚ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَكْسِبُوْنَ الْاِثْمَ سَيُجْزَوْنَ بِمَا كَانُوا يَقْتَرِفُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And on do not eat the animal slaughtered without the name of Allah, because it is Verily misconduct; and Satans create evil-suggestion in the hearts of their well-wishers, that they should contend with you unnecessarily, and if you obey them, then Verily you are also polytheist.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَاكُلُوا مِمَّا لَمْ يُذْكَرِ اسْمُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْهِ وَ اِنَّهُ لَفِسْقٌ  وَ اِنَّ الشَّيٰطِيْنَ لَيُوْحُوْنَ اِلٰٓى اَوْلِيٰٓئِهِمْ لِيُجَادِلُوْكُمْ   وَ اِنْ اَطَعْتُمُوْهُمْ اِنَّكُمْ لَمُشْرِكُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And the person who was earlier dead and We brought him to live and created a light for him through which he walks among the people, can be like the person who is struck in utter darkness and cannot come out of there. (as faith is decorated for believers) likewise the deeds of the unbelievers have been decorated for them.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَ مَنْ كَانَ مَيْتًا فَاَحْيَيْنٰهُ وَ جَعَلْنَا لَهُ نُوْرًا يَمْشِى بِهِ فِى النَّاسِ كَمَنْ مَّثَلُهُ فِى الظُّلُمٰتِ لَيْسَ بِخَارِجٍ مِّنْهَا ۚ كَذٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (And like in Makkah) In every settlement We placed wicked ones as Chief of their tribes, that they may plot therein, and these people who plot, harm themselves only but they don't understand.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ اَكٰبِرَ مُجْرِمِيْهَا لِيَمْكُرُوْا فِيْهَا وَ مَا يَمْكُرُوْنَ اِلَّا بِاَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ مَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (To verify Prophet) When any sign comes down, they say: we will not believe unless the same thing is given to us that has been given to the Prophet, and Allah knows well where to keep His prophethood, and those who are sinners will shortly get the punishment for their plotting, and with Allah there is painful and disgraceful punishment for them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ اٰيَةٌ قَالُوْا لَنْ نُّؤْمِنَ حَتّٰى نُؤْتٰى مِثْلَ مَآ اُوْتِىَ رُسُلُ اللّٰهِ ۘ اللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ حَيْثُ يَجْعَلُ رِسَالَتَهُ  سَيُصِيْبُ الَّذِيْنَ اَجْرَمُوْا صَغَارٌ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ وَ عَذَابٌ شَدِيْدٌۭ بِمَا كَانُوا يَمْكُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: To whoever Allah pleases to show the right path, Allah expands his breast and fills it with wealth of Islam, and to whoever He pleases to leave in misguidance, He causes difficulty (for him) and makes his breast strait, as if accepting faith (for him) is like climbing the sky, Allah imposes evil on those who do not believe on Him.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَنْ يُّرِدِ اللّٰهُ اَنْ يَّهْدِيَهُ يَشْرَحْ صَدْرَهُ لِلْاِسْلَامِ   وَ مَنْ يُّرِدْ اَنْ يُّضِلَّهُ يَجْعَلْ صَدْرَهُ ضَيِّقًا حَرَجًا كَاَنَّمَا يَصَّعَّدُ فِى السَّمَآءِ ۚ كَذٰلِكَ يَجْعَلُ اللّٰهُ الرِّجْسَ عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet tell them, Islam is a straight path made by your Lord, We have explained our verses in detail for those who wish to take lessons.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هٰذَا صِرَاطُ رَبِّكَ مُسْتَقِيْمًا  قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا الْاٰيٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَّذَّكَّرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: They shall have a house of peace and tranquility for them with their Lord; Allah will be their Guardian in reward of their deeds, which they have done in the world.
verses.arabic_text: لَهُمْ دَارُ السَّلٰمِ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَ هُوَ وَ لِيُّهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet remind them of the day when Allah will gather them all and will say: O Assembly of Jinn, you have misguided many people and increased your party, and among men who were their friends will say: O my Lord, we benefitted mutually and now came to those time when You had decided to punish us, Allah will say: Hell is the abode for all of you and you shall remain there forever, but to whoever Allah may please may deliver, Verily, your Lord is Wise and Knower.
verses.arabic_text: وَ يَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيْعًا ۚ يٰمَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ قَدِ اسْتَكْثَرْتُمْ مِّنَ الْاِنْسِ   وَ قَالَ اَوْلِيٰٓؤُهُمْ مِّنَ الْاِنْسِ رَبَّنَا اسْتَمْتَعَ بَعْضُنَا بِبَعْضٍ وَ بَلَغْنَآ اَجَلَنَا الَّذِىْٓ اَجَّلْتَ لَنَا  قَالَ النَّارُ مَثْوٰكُمْ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَآ اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ اللّٰهُ  اِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيْمٌ عَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Likewise, because of their deeds We shall make some unjust guardian over some other unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَذٰلِكَ نُوَلِّى بَعْضَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ بَعْضًاۢ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (Then We will ask them) O assembly of jinn and men, didn't the prophets among you came who recited Our verses and warn you about this day (Day of Judgement), they will reply: (Verily they did come), and we are testifying against our own selves, worldly life of some days kept deceiving them and they testified against themselves, they Verily were all infidels.
verses.arabic_text: يٰمَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْاِنسِ اَلَمْ يَاتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنْكُمْ يَقُصُّوْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ اٰيٰتِى وَ يُنْذِرُوْنَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هٰذَا  قَالُوْا شَهِدْنَا عَلَىٰٓ اَنْفُسِنَا   وَ غَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَيٰوةُ الدُّنْيَا وَ شَهِدُوْا عَلَىٰٓ اَنْفُسِهِمْ اَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا كٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: (And reason for sending the prophets was) Because your Lord does not destroy the people of the towns with force and coercion, while they are in negligence.
verses.arabic_text: ذٰلِكَ اَنْ لَّمْ يَكُنْ رَّبُّكَ مُهْلِكَ الْقُرٰى بِظُلْمٍ وَّ اَهْلُهَا غٰفِلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: There are ranks for everybody according to their deeds, and your Lord is not unaware of what you do.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لِكُلٍّ دَرَجٰتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوْا  وَ مَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Your Lord is selflessly Merciful, if He pleases He will destroy all of you and make your heirs to anyone He may please, like He created you from the children of others.
verses.arabic_text: وَ رَبُّكَ الْغَنِىُّ ذُو الرَّحْمَةِ  اِنْ يَّشَا يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَ يَسْتَخْلِفْ مِنۢ بَعْدِكُمْ مَّا يَشَآءُ كَمَآ اَنْشَاَكُمْ مِّنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ قَوْمٍ اٰخَرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: What promise is made to you will Verily come one day and you cannot make Allah helpless (in bringing it).
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ مَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ لَاٰتٍ وَ مَآ اَنْتُم بِمُعْجِزِيْنَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) say: O my nation, you do whatever you want, I am doing my work, then shortly you will come to know that the house of the Hereafter is for whom, and the unjust will never be successful.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يٰقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْا عَلَٰى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّى عَامِلٌ   فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ تَكُوْنُ لَهُ عَاقِبَةُ الدَّارِ اِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: In farming and four-footed animals created by Allah they set apart portions; and according to their thinking say this portion belongs to Allah and this portion for our partners, but the share of their partners reached not to Allah, but the portion of the Lord reaches their partners, and what an evil judgement they make.
verses.arabic_text: وَ جَعَلُوْا لِلّٰهِ مِمَّا ذَرَاَ مِنَ الْحَرْثِ وَ الْاَنْعَامِ نَصِيْبًا فَقَالُوْا هٰذَا لِلّٰهِ بِزَعْمِهِمْ وَ هٰذَا لِشُرَكَآئِنَا  ۚ  فَمَا كَانَ لِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ فَلَا يَصِلُ اِلَى اللّٰهِ  ۚ وَ مَا كَانَ لِلّٰهِ فَهُوَ يَصِلُ اِلَٰى شُرَكَآئِهِمْ ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And thus their partners presented to unbelievers slaying of children as good deed, to throw them in ever-destruction, and distort the religion for them, if Allah had pleased they would not have done this, O Prophet, therefore leave them and in that which they slander.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَذٰلِكَ زَيَّنَ لِكَثِيْرٍ مِّنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ قَتْلَ اَوْلَادِهِمْ شُرَكَآؤُهُمْ لِيُرْدُوْهُمْ وَ لِيَلْبِسُوْا عَلَيْهِمْ دِيْنَهُمْ   وَ لَوْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ مَا فَعَلُوْهُ   فَذَرْهُمْ وَ مَا يَفْتَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And according to their whims they say: these four-footed animals and farming are untouchable, no one can eat it without our order, and some of the animals are forbidden for riding and loading, and on some of animal they do not mention Allah's Name. (and they did attribute falsely to Allah), this is all slander and accusation on Allah, and Allah will shortly punish them for their false accusations.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُوْا هٰذِهِٓ اَنْعَامٌ وَّ حَرْثٌ حِجْرٌ لَّا يَطْعَمُهَآ اِلَّا مَنْ نَّشَآءُ بِزَعْمِهِمْ وَ اَنْعَامٌ حُرِّمَتْ ظُهُوْرُهَا وَ اَنْعَامٌ لَّا يَذْكُرُوْنَ اسْمَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْهَا افْتِرَآءً عَلَيْهِ  سَيَجْزِيْهِم بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And infidels also say: that the calf which is in the wombs of slaughtered cattle who we had set free in the name of idols, comes out alive then it is lawful for our males and unlawful for our females, and if it comes out dead, then portion is for everyone; Allah will reward them for making such description; He is Wise and Knowing.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُوْا مَا فِى بُطُوْنِ هٰذِهِ الْاَنْعَامِ خَالِصَةٌ لِّذُكُوْرِنَا وَّ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَٰىٓ اَزْوَاجِنَا  ۚ وَ اِنْ يَّكُنْ مَّيْتَةً فَهُمْ فِيْهِ شُرَكَآءُ ۚ سَيَجْزِيْهِمْ وَصْفَهُمْ  اِنَّهُ حَكِيْمٌ عَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Verily, who killed their children foolishly and unknowingly; the sustenance which was given to them by Allah; they considered forbidden for themselves by falsely blaming Allah, they are in severe loss and have gone astray from the right path; and they were not to get guidance.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِيْنَ قَتَلُوٓا اَوْلَادَهُمْ سَفَهًۭا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَّ حَرَّمُوْا مَا رَزَقَهُمُ اللّٰهُ افْتِرَآءً عَلَى اللّٰهِ ۚ قَدْ ضَلُّوْا وَ مَا كَانُوا مُهْتَدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: It is Allah who created many gardens which have different kind of trees, some are creepers (like grapes); and some are on ground and some dates trees, and farming whose fruits are of different tastes, and olive and pomegranate, some are similar and some are unique; ripen when they get, consume their yields, the day you do harvesting separate the share of Allah (give poor-rate), and do not spend wastefully, because Allah does not like those who spend wastefully.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هُوَ الَّذِىْٓ اَنْشَاَ جَنّٰتٍۢ مَّعْرُوْشٰتٍۢ وَّ غَيْرَ مَعْرُوْشٰتٍ وَّ النَّخْلَ وَ الزَّرْعَ مُخْتَلِفًا اُكُلُهُ وَ الزَّيْتُوْنَ وَ الرُّمَّانَ مُتَشَابِهًا وَ غَيْرَ مُتَشَابِهٍۢ  كُلُوْا مِنْ ثَمَرِهِٓ اِذَآ اَثْمَرَ وَ اٰتُوْا حَقَّهُ يَوْمَ حَصَادِهِ وَ لَا تُسْرِفُوْا ۚ اِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْرِفِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And among four-footed animals some are big ones to carry load and some are grounded (small ones); and do consume the sustenance given by Allah, and follow not footsteps of Satan, he is your open enemy.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِنَ الْاَنْعَامِ حَمُوْلَةً وَ فَرْشًا ۚ كُلُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُ وَ لَا تَتَّبِعُوْا خُطُوٰتِ الشَّيْطٰنِ  اِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيْنٌ

verses.english_text: Allah has created eight types of pairs, two from the sheep and two from the goat, O Prophet, ask them: 'whether Allah has forbidden two males, or two females or their young-ones which are in the wombs of two females, inform me if you are truthful'.
verses.arabic_text: ثَمٰنِيَةَ اَزْوَاجٍ  ۚ مِّنَ الضَّاْنِ اثْنَيْنِ  ۚ وَ مِنَ الْمَعْزِ اثْنَيْنِ  قُلْ ءٰٓالذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ اَمِ الْاُنْثَيَيْنِ اَمَّا اشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ اَرْحَامُ الْاُنْثَيَيْنِ  نَبِّئْوْنِى بِعِلْمٍ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And two of camels (male and female) and two of heifer (male and female), O Prophet ask them, whether Allah has forbidden their males or females or their calves which are in the wombs of two females? Were you present when Allah commanded this? Then who can be more unjust who slander on Allah, so they misguide people without understanding; and Allah never causes unjust to reach their destination.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِنَ الْاِبِلِ اثْنَيْنِ وَ مِنَ الْبَقَرِ اثْنَيْنِ  قُلْ ءٰٓالذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ اَمِ الْاُنْثَيَيْنِ اَمَّا اشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ اَرْحَامُ الْاُنْثَيَيْنِ  اَمْ كُنْتُمْ شُهَدَآءَ اِذْ وَصّٰكُمُ اللّٰهُ بِهٰذَا ۚ فَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا لِّيُضِلَّ النَّاسَ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet, say: What has been revealed to me (Quran) I do not find any eatables unlawful to consume in it, except dead (animal), blood and flesh of swine, Verily these are impure, or on slaughtered animals on which somebody else's name was taken in disobedience (of Allah), then if anybody consume this in helplessness and is not disobedient and transgressor, then your Lord is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ لَّآ اَجِدُ فِىْ مَآ اُوْحِىَ اِلَىَّ مُحَرَّمًا عَلَٰى طَاعِمٍ يَّطْعَمُهُٓ اِلَّآ اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ مَيْتَةً اَوْ دَمًا مَّسْفُوْحًا اَوْ لَحْمَ خِنْزِيْرٍ فَاِنَّهُ رِجْسٌ اَوْ فِسْقًا اُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ اللّٰهِ بِهِ  ۚ فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَّ لَا عَادٍ فَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: And We have forbidden for Jews all the animals who have claws; and fats of heifer and goats, except the fat which is on their back, or on intestine or what mixed with bones, this We had given them punishment for their transgression, and there is not any doubt that We are the truthful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ هَادُوْا حَرَّمْنَا كُلَّ ذِىْ ظُفُرٍ  ۚ وَ مِنَ الْبَقَرِ وَ الْغَنَمِ حَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ شُحُوْمَهُمَآ اِلَّا مَا حَمَلَتْ ظُهُوْرُهُمَآ اَوِ الْحَوَايَآ اَوْ مَا اخْتَلَطَ بِعَظْمٍ  ذٰلِكَ جَزَيْنٰهُمْ بِبَغْيِهِمْ  وَ اِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet, if they deny you, tell them although Your Lord is vast Merciful but punishment to the sinners cannot be warded off.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنْ كَذَّبُوْكَ فَقُلْ رَّبُّكُمْ ذُوْ رَحْمَةٍ وَّاسِعَةٍ  ۚ وَ لَا يُرَدُّ بَاْسُهُ عَنِ الْقَوْمِ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Shortly, polytheists will say, if Allah pleased, neither we nor our forefathers would have been polytheists; and neither we would have caused upon ourselves anything as unlawful, and those who have passed before them kept denying (prophets) and they tasted Our punishment, O Prophet! say: do you have any argument, if yes, take out and show me, but you only follow your whims; and your talk is only speculation.
verses.arabic_text: سَيَقُوْلُ الَّذِيْنَ اَشْرَكُوْا لَوْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ مَآ اَشْرَكْنَا وَ لَآ اٰبَآؤُنَا وَ لَا حَرَّمْنَا مِنْ شَىْءٍ  كَذٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ حَتّٰى ذَاقُوْا بَاْسَنَا  قُلْ هَلْ عِنْدَكُم مِّنْ عِلْمٍ فَتُخْرِجُوْهُ لَنَآ اِنْ تَتَّبِْعُونَ اِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَ اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا تَخْرُصُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Say: (Now you do not have any argument), argument which can take you to Allah, is exclusive for Allah, if He pleased, He would have guided you all.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ فَلِلّٰهِ الْحُجَّةُ الْبَالِغَةُ  ۚ فَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدٰكُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Say: Present your witnesses and they should testify that whatever things you say unlawful, Allah has made them unlawful, and (in case) even if they testify, O Prophet, you don't testify with them; and do not follow their low-desires who deny our verses and do not believe on the Hereafter, and make others partner with their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ هَلُمَّ شُهَدَآءَكُمُ الَّذِيْنَ يَشْهَدُوْنَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ حَرَّمَ هٰذَا  ۚ فَاِنْ شَهِدُوْا فَلَا تَشْهَدْ مَعَهُمْ ۚ وَ لَا تَتَّبِعْ اَهْوَآءَ الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيَاتِنَا وَ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ وَ هُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Say: Come I will read and recite for you that thing which Allah have made unlawful; and that make not anything partner with Allah; and show kindness to parents, and out of fear of poverty do not kill your child (because) it is We, who provide sustenance to you; and go not near evil whether openly or secretly, and do not kill anybody whose killing has been made unlawful by Allah; except in punishment; these are the thing which Allah has commanded so you understand.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ تَعَالَوْا اَتْلُ مَا حَرَّمَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ اَلَّا تُشْرِكُوْا بِهِ شَيْئًا   وَ بِالْوَالِدَيْنِ اِحْسَانًا  ۚ وَ لَا تَقْتُلُوْٓا اَوْلَادَكُمْ مِّنْ اِمْلَاقٍ   نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكُمْ وَ اِيَّاهُمْ  ۚ وَ لَا تَقْرَبُوْا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَ مَا بَطَنَ  ۚ وَ لَا تَقْتُلُوْا النَّفْسَ الَّتِى حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ  ذٰلِكُمْ وَصّٰكُم بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And do not go near the property of an orphan, only if it is beneficial for him, until he reaches his youth, and do the measure and weight justly, We do not give discomfort to anyone more than what he can bear; let anything happen but speak justly, even if it is against your kin, and fulfill the covenant of Allah, these are the things which Allah has enjoined you that you take lesson.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَقْرَبُوْا مَالَ الْيَتِيْمِ اِلَّا بِالَّتِى هِىَ اَحْسَنُ حَتّٰى يَبْلُغَ اَشُدَّهُ  ۚ وَ اَوْفُوْا الْكَيْلَ وَ الْمِيْزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ  ۚ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا اِلَّا وُسْعَهَا  ۚ وَ اِذَا قُلْتُمْ فَاعْدِلُوْا وَ لَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبٰى  ۚ وَ بِعَهْدِ اللّٰهِ اَوْفُوْا  ذٰلِكُمْ وَصّٰكُم بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And be mindful that this is My straight path, tread on this path and follow no other paths because it will divert your attention and make you go astray, these are the things which Allah have enjoined so that you become pious.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَنَّ هٰذَا صِرَاطِىْ مُسْتَقِيْمًا فَاتَّبِعُوْهُ  ۚ وَ لَا تَتَّبِعُوا السُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَنْ سَبِيْلِهِ  ذٰلِكُمْ وَصّٰكُم بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Then to complete Blessings We bestowed the book (Taurait) upon Moosa and in it described everything, and it was total guidance and Mercy for the people so that people should believe that they will be presented before their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ تَمَامًا عَلَى الَّذِىْٓ اَحْسَنَ وَ تَفْصِيْلًا لِّكُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَّ هُدًى وَّ رَحْمَةً لَّعَلَّهُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And this Book (Quran) which We have revealed now, is full of Blessings, you should follow it and keep fearing your Lord so you are shown Mercy.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هٰذَا كِتٰبٌ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ مُبٰرَكٌ فَاتَّبِعُوْهُ وَ اتَّقُوْا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (O Polytheists, We sent this book because) you may not say that earlier books were revealed for two groups (Jews and Christians), and we were unaware to read it.
verses.arabic_text: اَنْ تَقُوْلُوْٓا اِنَّمَآ اُنْزِلَ الْكِتٰبُ عَلَٰى طَآئِفَتَيْنِ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا وَ اِن كُنَّا عَنْ دِرَاسَتِهِمْ لَغٰفِلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Or may say: if the book was revealed to us, we would have been better followers of the straight path, now (see) the bright argument and book and Mercy had come to you from your Lord, now who will be more unjust who will deny the verses of Allah and turn their face from it, who turn their face away from our verses, We will shortly punish them for turning their face away.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ تَقُوْلُوْا لَوْ اَنَّآ اُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْكِتٰبُ لَكُنَّآ اَهْدٰى مِنْهُمْ   فَقَدْ جَآءَكُم بَيِّنَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ وَ هُدًى وَّ رَحْمَةٌ  ۚ فَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَّبَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَ صَدَفَ عَنْهَا  ۚ سَنَجْزِى الَّذِيْنَ يَصْدِفُوْنَ عَنْ اٰيَاتِنَا سُوْٓءَ الْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَصْدِفُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), Are they waiting that the angels should come to them or your Lord Himself (shall come to you), or some signs of your Lord should come, however, the day when signs will come and till that day whosoever would not had believed, or the believers didn't do any good work after believing, now their faith would not benefit them, so now (O Prophet) tell them, you wait and I am also waiting.
verses.arabic_text: هَلْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَّآ اَنْ تَاتِيَهُمُ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ اَوْ يَاْتِىَ رَبُّكَ اَوْ يَاتِىَ بَعْضُ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّكَ  يَوْمَ يَاتِى بَعْضُ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّكَ لَا يَنْفَعُ نَفْسًا اِيْمَانُهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ اٰمَنَتْ مِنْ قَبْلُ اَوْ كَسَبَتْ فِىْٓ اِيْمانِهَا خَيْرًا  قُلِ انْتَظِرُوْٓا اِنَّا مُنْتَظِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), you have nothing to do with them who caused division in the faith and made sects; their case is with Allah only, then whatever they were doing in the world (good or bad) will be told to them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ فَرَّقُوْا دِيْنَهُمْ وَ كَانُوْا شِيَعًا لَّسْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِى شَىْءٍ ۚ اِنَّمَآ اَمْرُهُمْ اِلَى اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (Look at his Mercy), Whoever will do a good deed, Allah will give tenfold reward for it, but whoever will do a bad deed then Allah will punish him for that much only, and nothing unjust will be done to him.
verses.arabic_text: مَنْ جَآءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ اَمْثَالِهَا  ۚ وَ مَنْ جَآءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزٰٓى اِلَّا مِثْلَهَا وَ هُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), say to them: My Allah has guided me to a straight path, e. g. towards a strong religion, religion of Ibrahim, who used to walk avoiding falsehood and was not among the polytheists.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّنِى هَدٰنِىْ رَبِّٓىْ اِلَٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ دِيْنًا قِيَمًا مِّلَّةَ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ حَنِيْفًا  ۚ وَ مَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), You (tell to these people): my prayer, my worship, my life, my death, everything is only for Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّ صَلَاتِى وَ نُسُكِى وَ مَحْيَاىَ وَ مَمَاتِى لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: He does not have any partner, this is what I have been commanded, and I am the first believer.
verses.arabic_text: لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ   وَ بِذٰلِكَ اُمِرْتُ وَ اَنَاْ اَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet, ask them, should I search for any other god leaving Allah Who is the Master of everything, whoever commits a sin his blame is on him only, and nobody else will bear the burden of others’ sins, then all of you will be presented before your Lord, then He will tell you all the things in which you disputed.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَغَيْرَ اللّٰهِ اَبْغِى رَبًّا وَّ هُوَ رَبُّ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۚ وَ لَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ اِلَّا عَلَيْهَا  ۚ وَ لَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِّزْرَ اُخْرٰى ۚ ثُمَّ اِلَٰى رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنْتُمْ فِيْهِ تَخْتَلِفُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And that is He who made you His vicegerent on the earth; and among you We raised the degree of some (prophets) over some (prophets), that We may test you with our Blessings, undoubtedly your Lord is quick in punishment, and also there is no doubt that He is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هُوَ الَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلٰٓئِفَ الْاَرْضِ وَ رَفَعَ بَعْضَكُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍۢ دَرَجٰتٍ لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِىْ مَآ اٰتٰكُمْ  اِنَّ رَبَّكَ سَرِيْعُ الْعِقَابِ   وَ اِنَّهُ لَغَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Alif Laam Meem Sa’ad.
verses.arabic_text: الٓمٓصٓ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), This book of Allah has been revealed to you so that you warn (people from wrath of Allah) and cause the advice for the believers; and because of this you should not feel straitness of heart.
verses.arabic_text: كِتٰبٌ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكَ فَلَا يَكُنْ فِىْ صَدْرِكَ حَرَجٌ مِّنْهُ لِتُنْذِرَ بِهِ وَ ذِكْرٰى لِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: (O People), follow whatever has been revealed to you from your Lord, and except Him do not follow other (false) guardians (gods), you people only accept advice a little.
verses.arabic_text: اتَّبِعُوْا مَآ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكُم مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ وَ لَا تَتَّبِعُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهِٓ اَوْلِيَآءَ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (You do not know), there are many settlements which We have destroyed, Our punishment reached (at a time) when they were fast asleep at night or they were taking a siesta during the day.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَمْ مِّنْ قَرْيَةٍ اَهْلَكْنٰهَا فَجَآءَهَا بَاْسُنَا بَيَاتًا اَوْ هُمْ قَآئِلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: So, when our punishment befell them, they could not say anything except, Verily, we were unjust.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا كَانَ دَعْوٰهُمْ اِذْ جَآءَهُم بَاْسُنَآ اِلَّآ اَنْ قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Then We will Verily question those for each and every thing, to whom we had sent prophets, We will also question prophets.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَنَسْئَلَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اُرْسِلَ اِلَيْهِمْ وَ لَنَسْئَلَنَّ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And with deep thinking We will ask them reality and will repeat every particle of it, and We were not absent.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَنَقُصَّنَّ عَلَيْهِم بِعِلْمٍ وَّ مَا كُنَّا غَآئِبِيْنَ

verses.english_text: It is a truthful thing of weighing the deeds on that day, then whose good deeds will be heavy he will be successful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الْوَزْنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحَقُّ  ۚ فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِيْنُهُ فَاُوْلٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And whose scale of deeds will be light then Verily they had harmed themselves by disobeying Our verses.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَاُوْلٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيْنَ خَسِرُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْا بِاٰيَاتِنَا يَظْلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (And O children of Adam) We established and gave you power on the earth and provided stuff for livelihood, but you thank very less.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ مَكَّنّٰكُمْ فِىْ الْاَرْضِ وَ جَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيْهَا مَعَايِشَ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: There is no doubt that We created you (your father Adam) and made faces for you then We told the angels to prostrate before Adam, so they all prostrated except Iblis, he was not among those who prostrated.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنٰكُمْ ثُمَّ صَوَّرْنٰكُمْ ثُمَّ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اسْجُدُوا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا اِلَّآ اِبْلِيسَ لَمْ يَكُن مِّنَ السّٰجِدِينَ

verses.english_text: Allah said: When We have ordered you to prostrate, then what prevented you from prostrating. (Iblis) said: I am better than him, You created me of fire (subtle element) and created him of clay (dirty element).
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ اَلَّا تَسْجُدَ اِذْ اَمَرْتُكَ قَالَ اَنَاْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ  ۚ خَلَقْتَنِىْ مِنْ نَّارٍ وَّ خَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ طِيْنٍ

verses.english_text: Allah said: (you behaved proudly) get down from here (from Paradise), because you have no right to be proud of, get out from here, you are among the humiliated ones.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَاهْبِطْ مِنْهَا فَمَا يَكُونُ لَكَ اَن تَتَكَبَّرَ فِيهَا فَاخْرُجْ اِنَّكَ مِنَ الصّٰغِرِينَ

verses.english_text: He said: give me the respite until the day when all the people will be raised again.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَنْظِرْنِىٓ اِلَٰى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (Allah) said: you are given respite.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Said he: Since You have disrupted my path, also I will sit on the straight path (to misguide them).
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَبِمَآ اَغْوَيْتَنِى لَاَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَاطَكَ الْمُسْتَقِيْمَ

verses.english_text: And I shall target the children of Adam; and will come to them (to cause them to go astray); from their front, from their rear, from their right and from their left; many among them will not be Your thankful.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَاٰتِيَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَيْنِ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَ مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ وَ عَنْ اَيْمَانِهِمْ وَ عَنْ شَمَآئِلِهِمْ وَ لَا تَجِدُ اَكْثَرَهُمْ شٰكِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Allah said: get away from here with contempt and reproach, whoever will follow you; Hell will I fill with you all.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اخْرُجْ مِنْهَا مَذْءُوْمًا مَّدْحُوْرًا لَّمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ لَاَمْلَئَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And told Adam: O Adam you dwell with your wife in Paradise and may eat from wherever you want, but beware go not near that tree otherwise you will be among the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَ يٰٓاٰدَمُ اسْكُنْ اَنتَ وَ زَوْجُكَ الْجَنَّةَ فَكُلَا مِنْ حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَ لَا تَقْرَبَا هٰذِهِ الشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Then Satan caused whisper to both so the things of their body may become exposed which were covered by the Heavenly clothes, he said to them: your Lord has prevented to consume the fruits of that tree that you may not become angels or may not live forever.
verses.arabic_text: فَوَسْوَسَ لَهُمَا الشَّيْطٰنُ لِيُبْدِىَ لَهُمَا مَا وُرِىَ عَنْهُمَا مِنْ سَوْاٰتِهِمَا وَ قَالَ مَا نَهٰكُمَا رَبُّكُمَا عَنْ هٰذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ اِلَّآ اَنْ تَكُوْنَا مَلَكَيْنِ اَوْ تَكُوْنَا مِنَ الْخٰلِدِينَ

verses.english_text: And swore before them both that he is their well-wisher.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَاسَمَهُمَآ اِنِّى لَكُمَآ لَمِنَ النّٰصِحِيْنَ

verses.english_text: So with deception he made them inclined to eat it (from that tree); so as soon as both of them tasted it (fruit from that tree), their Heavenly clothes fell down and their private parts were exposed, they both started to cover themselves with leaves of Heaven, then their Lord called out to told them: did not I told you not to go near that tree and that Satan is your open enemy?
verses.arabic_text: فَدَلّٰهُمَا بِغُرُوْرٍ ۚ فَلَمَّا ذَاقَا الشَّجَرَةَ بَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْاٰتُهُمَا وَ طَفِقَا يَخْصِفٰنِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِنْ وَّرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ وَ نَادٰهُمَا رَبُّهُمَآ اَلَمْ اَنْهَكُمَا عَنْ تِلْكُمَا الشَّجَرَةِ وَ اَقُل لَّكُمَآ اِنَّ الشَّيْطٰنَ لَكُمَآ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيْنٌ

verses.english_text: Then both started pleading: O our Lord we have harmed ourselves, and if You will not forgive us and will not show Mercy then we will only be at loss.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ اَنْفُسَنَا وَ اِنْ لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَ تَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Command came: you all (Adam, Eve and Satan) get down from the Paradise, you are enemy of one another, and until a term of time your stay and means of livelihood is there.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اهْبِطُوْا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ وَ لَكُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَ مَتَاعٌ اِلَٰى حِيْنٍ

verses.english_text: Said Allah: you will live life on earth and there shall you die, and you shall be given life again and extracted from there.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فِيهَا تَحْيَوْنَ وَ فِيْهَا تَمُوْتُوْنَ وَ مِنْهَا تُخْرَجُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O children of Adam! We sent clothing for you, to hide your private parts; and clothing of adornment; and clothing of piety, and this is the best among all the clothing, and this clothing is the power and sign of Allah so that people get advice and lessons.
verses.arabic_text: يٰبَنِىْْٓ اٰدَمَ قَدْ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ لِبَاسًا يُوَارِى سَوْاٰتِكُمْ وَ رِيْشًا وَ لِبَاسُ التَّقْوٰى ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ ۚ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O children of Adam! Beware, let Satan not misguide you, like he had misguided your parents and became a caused to expel them from Heaven, he pulled down their clothing to expose their private parts; he and his clan see you but you cannot see them, I made Satan the friend of those who do not believe.
verses.arabic_text: يٰبَنِىْٓ اٰدَمَ لَا يَفْتِنَنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطٰنُ كَمَآ اَخْرَجَ اَبَوَيْكُمْ مِّنَ الْجَنَّةِ يَنْزِعُ عَنْهُمَا لِبَاسَهُمَا لِيُرِيَهُمَا سَوْاٰتِهِمَآ اِنَّهُ يَرٰكُمْ هُوَ وَ قَبِيْلُهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا تَرَوْنَهُمْ اِنَّا جَعَلْنَا الشَّيٰطِيْنَ اَوْلِيَآءَ لِلَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And when they commit any bad deed, they say we found our forefathers practicing these traditions and Allah has also commanded this; (O Prophet) you tell them clearly Allah never commands for any bad deed; do you say against Allah those things which you do not know.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا فَعَلُوْا فَاحِشَةً قَالُوْا وَ جَدْنَا عَلَيْهَآ اٰبَآءَنَا وَ اللّٰهُ اَمَرَنَا بِهَا  قُلْ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَاْمُرُ بِالْفَحْشَآءِ ۚ اَتَقُوْلُوْنَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) say: My Lord has commanded for justice. (and He has also said) turn your face straight (towards direction of prayer) and be sincere in your prayer and supplicate with him; as He has created you (in the beginning), you will be brought to life again.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَمَرَ رَبِّى بِالْقِسْطِ وَ اَقِيْمُوْا وُجُوْهَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَّادْعُوْهُ مُخْلِصِيْنَ لَهُ الدِّيْنَ   كَمَا بَدَاَكُمْ تَعُوْدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: He has guided one group, and another group adopted misguidance - they took Satan as their guardian instead of Allah, and yet they think they are on the right path.
verses.arabic_text: فَرِيقًا هَدٰى وَ فَرِيْقًا حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الضَّلٰلَةُ  اِنَّهُمُ اتَّخَذُوا الشَّيٰطِيْنَ اَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ اللّٰهِ وَ يَحْسَبُونَ اَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O children of Adam! At the time of prayer dress up nicely; and eat and drink, and be not wasteful spender, Allah does not like wasteful spenders.
verses.arabic_text: يٰبَنِيْٓ آدَمَ خُذُوْا زِيْنَتَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَّ كُلُوْا وَ اشْرَبُوْا وَ لَا تُسْرِفُوْا ۚ اِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْرِفِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! ask them, who has prohibited things of adornment, and good provision, which have been created by Allah for His servants? You tell them that these good provisions are purely for them on the Day of Judgement who were believers in the life of this world, in this way we explain Our verses for the sensible persons.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ مَنْ حَرَّمَ زِيْنَةَ اللّٰهِ الَّتِىْٓ اَخْرَجَ لِعِبَادِهِ وَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ مِنَ الرِّزْقِ ۚ قُلْ هِىَ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوا فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا خَالِصَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْاٰيٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَّعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet tell them My Lord has prohibited immorality whether openly or secretly; and from all sins and from unjust excesses and that you make anybody partner with Allah on which no argument has come; and that you be slanderous on Allah without understanding.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّىَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَ مَا بَطَنَ وَ الْاِثْمَ وَ الْبَغْىَ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَ اَنْ تُشْرِكُوْا بِاللّٰهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ سُلْطٰنًا وَ اَنْ تَقُوْلُوْا عَلَى اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And there is a fixed time for every nation, when their time comes; it cannot be postponed or preponed, even for a second.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لِكُلِّ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلٌ فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَاخِرُوْنَ سَاعَةً وَّ لَا يَسْتَقْدِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Children of Adam! When Our prophets from among you come to you and describe Our commands, obey them, because whoever will guard against sins and perform good deeds (on the Day of Judgement) these people will not have any fear nor they will grieve.
verses.arabic_text: يٰبَنِىْٓ اٰدَمَ اِمَّا يَاْتِيَنَّكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنْكُمْ يَقُصُّوْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ اٰيٰتِى  فَمَنِ اتَّقٰى وَ اَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ لَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And whoever will deny our verses and will show pride, these are Hellish people, and they shall remain forever in it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيَاتِنَا وَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْا عَنْهَآ اُوْلٰٓئِكَ اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِ  ۚ هُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Who can be more unjust that who deny the verses of Allah and slander on Allah, these are the people who gets their share (sustenance) what had been written for them, until our angel will reach to extract their soul, and ask them where are those, whom you were used to call instead of Allah, they will reply: they are all gone away and they will testify against themselves that Verily we were unbelievers.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اَوْ كَذَّبَ بِاٰيٰتِهِ  ۚ اُوْلٰٓئِكَ يَنَالُهُمْ نَصِيْبُهُم مِّنَ الْكِتٰبِ  حَتٰٓى اِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنَا يَتَوَفَّوْنَهُمْ قَالُوْٓا اَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ قَالُوْا ضَلُّوْا عَنَّا وَ شَهِدُوْا عَلَىٰٓ اَنْفُسِهِمْ اَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا كٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: (Then Allah) will tell them: those from jinns and men who have gone away before you; go and get mingled with them and go to Hell; when one group will enter, it will curse the other group, when all groups will reach inside (Hell) then the previous group will curse their previous group and say: O Lord, they have misguided us, so double their punishment, Allah will say: punishment is double for all of you, but you do not know.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ ادْخُلُوْا فِىْٓ اُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْاِنْسِ فِى النَّارِ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَتْ اُمَّةٌ لَّعَنَتْ اُخْتَهَا حَتّٰى اِذَا ادَّارَكُوْا فِيْهَا جَمِيْعًا قَالَتْ اُخْرٰهُمْ لِاُوْلٰهُمْ رَبَّنَا هٰٓؤُلَآءِ اَضَلُّوْنَا فَاٰتِهِمْ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا مِّنَ النَّارِ قَالَ لِكُلٍّ ضِعْفٌ وَّ لٰكِنْ لَّا تَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And among them first group will address the previous group and say: now you do not have any preference over us, you also taste the punishment for your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالَتْ اُولٰهُمْ لِاُخْرٰهُمْ فَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِن فَضْلٍۢ فَذُوْقُوْا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Verily, who denied Our verses and displayed haughtiness, for them neither gates of skies will open nor they can enter Paradise, so much so until camel pass through the eye of the needle, and We give such punishments to the guilty.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيَاتِنَا وَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْا عَنْهَا لَا تُفَتَّحُ لَهُمْ اَبْوَابُ السَّمَآءِ وَ لَا يَدْخُلُوْنَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتّٰى يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِى سَمِّ الْخِيَاطِ ۚ وَ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِىْ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And for them will be a mattress of fire and (also) a sheet of fire to cover them, and We give punishment to unjust like this.
verses.arabic_text: لَهُم مِّنْ جَهَنَّمَ مِهَادٌ وَّ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ غَوَاشٍ   وَ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And those who believed, and performed good deeds, so We do not burden anybody more than his capacity, these are the people of Paradise and shall remain in Paradise forever.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوْا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا اِلَّا وُسْعَهَآ اُوْلٰٓئِكَ اَصْحٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And We will remove whatever of ill-feeling will be in their hearts, and there will flow rivers beneath their palaces, and they will be saying: thanks be to Allah who made us reach us to our destination, and if Allah has not guided, we could not have reached here, Verily the prophets of our Lord brought the truthful religion; and that they will be informed loudly that this is that Paradise, to which you have been made heirs and owners, in reward to your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ نَزَعْنَا مَا فِىْ صُدُوْرِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ تَجْرِى مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ الْاَنْهٰرُ وَ قَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِى هَدٰنَا لِهٰذَا وَ مَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِىَ لَوْلَآ اَنْ هَدٰنَا اللّٰهُ لَقَدْ جَآءَتْ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَ نُوْدُوْا اَنْ تِلْكُمُ الْجَنَّةُ اُوْرِثْتُمُوْهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And people of Paradise will call out to people of Hell and say: whatever was promised by our Lord, we have received all, did you also received all, what was promised by your Lord? People of Hell will reply: yes, we got it. Then a crier will cry out: curses of Allah on unjust who had hindered people from the path of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ نَادٰٓى اَصْحٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ اَصْحٰبَ النَّارِ اَنْ قَدْ وَجَدْنَا مَا وَعَدَنَا رَبُّنَا حَقًّا فَهَلْ وَجَدتُّم مَّا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّا قَالُوا نَعَمْ ۚ فَاَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ بَيْنَهُمْ اَنْ لَّعْنَةُ اللّٰهِ عَلَى الظّٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And unnecessary they wanted to distort it and they had denied the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ وَ يَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَ هُمْ بِالْآخِرَةِ كٰفِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: There is a partition between Paradise and Hell and on (that) Elevated Place (Araaf) there will be some people and who will identify them with the writing on their foreheads, and they will call salutations to the people of Paradise, and those who will be on an elevated place, they have not entered Paradise but they Verily have desire for it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ بَيْنَهُمَا حِجَابٌ ۚ وَ عَلَى الْاَعْرَافِ رِجَالٌ يَعْرِفُوْنَ كُلًّا بِسِيْمٰهُمْ ۚ وَ نَادَوْا اَصْحٰبَ الْجَنَّةِ اَنْ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ  ۚ لَمْ يَدْخُلُوْهَا وَ هُمْ يَطْمَعُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And when they will suddenly see people of Hell, they will say: O my Lord, do not make us companion of wrongdoers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا صُرِفَتْ اَبْصَارُهُمْ تِلْقَآءَ اَصْحٰبِ النَّارِ قَالُوا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And the people of the Elevated Place, by identifying Hellish people by blackness of the faces, will say: now neither your group is of any use to you nor your pride which you used to do in the world.
verses.arabic_text: وَ نَادٰى اَصْحٰبُ الْاَعْرَافِ رِجَالًا يَعْرِفُوْنَهُمْ بِسِيْمَاهُمْ قَالُوْا مَآ اَغْنٰى عَنْكُمْ جَمْعُكُمْ وَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Are they the same people for them you used to swear that Allah will not show Mercy to them, look these are the same people, who have been told: Enter Paradise, there is no fear for you nor you will grieve.
verses.arabic_text: اَهٰٓؤُلَآءِ الَّذِيْنَ اَقْسَمْتُمْ لَا يَنَالُهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ  اُدْخُلُوْا الْجَنَّةَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ لَا اَنْتُمْ تَحْزَنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And people of Hell (with coyness) say to the people of Paradise: pour some water on us or give us some from what Allah has granted to you; people of Paradise will reply: Allah has completely forbidden the food and water of the Paradise for the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: وَ نَادٰٓى اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِ اَصْحٰبَ الْجَنَّةِ اَنْ اَفِيْضُوْا عَلَيْنَا مِنَ الْمَآءِ اَوْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُ ۚ قَالُوْا اِنَّ اللّٰهَ حَرَّمَهُمَا عَلَى الْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Who had made their religion a play and the life of world has deceived them, so today (Day of Judgement) We will intentionally forget them, the way they had forgotten that they will be presented today, and used to deny Our verses.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ اتَّخَذُوْا دِيْنَهُمْ لَهْوًا وَ لَعِبًا وَّ غَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَيٰوةُ الدُّنْيَا فَالْيَوْمَ نَنْسٰهُمْ كَمَا نَسُوا لِقَآءَ يَوْمِهِمْ هٰذَا وَ مَآ كَانُوا بِاٰيَاتِنَا يُجْحَدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Although, We had sent Book to them and described it in detail with knowledge, and it is guidance and mercy for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ جِئْنٰهُم بِكِتٰبٍ فَصَّلْنٰهُ عَلَٰى عِلْمٍ هُدًى وَّ رَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Are they only waiting for the result (Day of Judgement), although when time and day will come, they will immediately say that Verily all prophets of Allah had brought just truth, so now someone is there for our intercession who will intercede for us, or could we be sent back to the world where we will do other deeds, other than what we earlier did; Verily, they greatly harmed themselves, and which they have forged has gone away.
verses.arabic_text: هَلْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَّا تَاْوِيْلَهُ  ۚ يَوْمَ يَاْتِى تَاْوِيْلُهُ يَقُوْلُ الَّذِيْنَ نَسُوْهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ قَدْ جَآءَتْ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِالْحَقِّ  ۚ فَهَل لَّنَا مِن شُفَعَآءَ فَيَشْفَعُوْاْ لَنَآ اَوْ نُرَدُّ فَنَعْمَلَ  غَيْرَ الَّذِى كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ  ۚ قَدْ خَسِرُوٓاْ اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَ ضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفْتَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Verily, your Lord is Allah Who created the skies and the earth in six days; and He is firmly established on the Throne, He throws day as veil over the night, as if night is intensely searching for the day, and He created Sun, Moon and stars, they are all obedient of Allah's order, look, Kingdom and Creation is exclusive for Him only; He is blessed and Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِى خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ  يُغْشِى الَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُ حَثِيْثًا وَ الشَّمْسَ وَ الْقَمَرَ وَ النُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرٰتٍۭ بِاَمْرِهِ  ۗ اَلَا لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَ الْاَمْرُ  ۗ تَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: (O People) Supplicate with your Lord by imploring with tears in secret; He Verily does not like those who exceed the limit.
verses.arabic_text: ادْعُوا رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًا وَ خُفْيَةً اِنَّهُ لاَ يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And do not do mischief after reform on earth; and supplicate with hope while fearing Allah, because Mercy of Allah is near to those who do good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تُفْسِدُوا فِي الاَرْضِ بَعْدَ اِصْلَاحِهَا وَ ادْعُوْهُ خَوْفًا وَ طَمَعًا اِنَّ رَحْمَةَ اللّٰهِ قَرِيْبٌ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: This is He who sends glad tiding winds before His Mercy; until when they blow with loaded clouds; We drives it to a dead land; then We sends rain; then We bring out on the earth all types of fruits, similarly We will raise the dead on the Day of Judgement, so you get advice and lesson.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِي يُرْسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ حَتّٰى اِذَا اَقَلَّتْ سَحَابًا ثِقَالًا سُقْنٰهُ لِبَلَدٍ مَّيِّتٍ فَاَنْزَلْنَا بِهِ الْمَآءَ فَاَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ كَذٰلِكَ نُخْرِجُ الْمَوْتَى لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And good land, sprouts out good vegetation by the command of Allah; and the bad land, gives out bad yield, like this We describe Our verses in diversified manner for those, who are thankful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الْبَلَدُ الطَّيِّبُ يَخْرُجُ نَبَاتُهُ بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهِ  ۚ وَ الَّذِي خَبُثَ لَا يَخْرُجُ اِلَّا نَكِدًا  ۚ كَذٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ الْاٰيٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَّشْكُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Verily, We sent Nooh to his nation and he told them: O my nation, worship Allah, and you do not have any other Lord, and I warn you of the big day of punishment.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا اِلَٰى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ اِنِّيْٓ اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ

verses.english_text: So some chiefs of his tribe said: we Verily see you in manifest misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ الْمَلَاُ مِن قَوْمِهِٓ اِنَّا لَنَرٰكَ فِيْ ضَلَالٍ مُّبِيْنٍ

verses.english_text: Nooh said: O my nation, I do not have any misguidance, but I am a prophet from the Lord.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِى ضَلٰلَةٌ وَّ لٰكِنِّى رَسُوْلٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And I am reaching to you the message from my Lord, and I am desirous of welfare for you, and the things which I know from Allah, you do not know.
verses.arabic_text: اُبَلِّغُكُم رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّي وَ اَنْصَحُ لَكُم وَ اَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ مَا لاَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And, do you wonder that command of Allah has come to you through a male from among you to warn you from the punishment of your Lord so you become pious and so that Mercy may be shown to you.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَعَجِبْتُمْ اَنْ جَاءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِّنْ رَبِّكُمْ عَلَٰى رَجُلٍ مِّنْكُمْ لِيُنْذِرَكُمْ وَ لِتَتَّقُوا وَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Even then the people denied him, then We delivered him and those who were on ark, and drowned all others whoever have rejected Our verses, and Verily they were all blind.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَنْجَيْنٰهُ وَ الَّذِينَ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ وَ اَغْرَقْنَا الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيَاتِنَا اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمًا عَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And We sent his brother Hud to the nation of Aad, also he told them: O my People! worship Allah, there is no god except Him, don't you fear Him?
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِلَٰى عَادٍ اَخَاهُمْ هُودًا قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۚ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: So some of the chiefs of their tribe who were infidels said: we Verily see you in stupidity; and we definitely consider you a liar.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ الْمَلَاُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِٓ اِنَّا لَنَرٰكَ فِي سَفَاهَةٍ وَ اِنَّا لَنَظُنُّكَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Hud said: I did not say any stupid words, rather I am a prophet of Lords of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِي سَفَاهَةٌ وَ لٰكِنِّي رَسُوْلٌ مِّنْ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: I bring to you the messages, from your Lord and I am your true advisor.
verses.arabic_text: اُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّي وَ اَنَا لَكُم نَاصِحٌ اَمِيْنٌ

verses.english_text: And, do you wonder that command of Allah has come to you through a male from among you to warn you from punishment; and remember the time when He made you vicegerent after Nooh; and did increase your creation extensively; so do remember bounties of Allah so you become successful.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَعَجِبْتُمْ اَنْ جَاءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَٰى رَجُلٍ مِّنْكُمْ لِيُنْذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَ اذْكُرُوْا اِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ مِنْ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوْحٍ وَ زَادَكُمْ فِي الْخَلْقِ بَصْطَةً فَاذْكُرُوْٓا اٰلَآءَ اللّٰهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَ

verses.english_text: They said: have you come to us so that we worship Allah only, and leave them whom our forefathers have worshipped? So if you are truthful, bring Him to us from Whom you warn us.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا اَجِئْتَنَا لِنَعْبُدَ اللّٰهَ وَحْدَهُ وَ نَذَرَ مَا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ اٰبَآؤُنَا  ۚ فَاْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Hud replied: punishment and wrath had already come to you from your Lord, do you dispute with me because of some names (of presumed idols), which your forefathers have (unnecessarily) created, whereas Allah has not sent any argument for them, so you just wait (for punishment of Allah), and I am also waiting.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ قَدْ وَ قَعَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ رِجْسٌ وَ غَضَبٌ اَتُجَادِلُوْنَنِي فِيْٓ اَسْمَآءٍ سَمَّيْتُمُوْهَآ اَنْتُمْ وَ اٰبَآؤُكُمْ مَّا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ بِهَا مِنْ سُلْطٰنٍ فَانْتَظِرُوْا اِنِّي مَعَكُمْ مِّنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Finally, We delivered those who were with him and uprooted them who denied our verses; and that also they would not have accepted faith.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَنْجَيْنٰهُ وَ الَّذِيْنَ مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَ قَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوا بِاٰيَاتِنَا وَ مَا كَانُوا مُؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And We sent his brother Saleh towards nation of Samood (as a prophet), so he said: O my nation, worship Allah, there is not any other Lord of yours except Him; Verily manifest and bright signs have come to you from your Lord; this Allah's she-camel is a miracle for you, so set her free to graze anywhere she wants, and do not give harm her otherwise you will be afflicted with painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِلَٰى ثَمُوْدَ اَخَاهُمْ صٰلِحًا قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ اِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ قَدْ جَآءَتْكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ هٰذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللّٰهِ لَكُمْ آيَةً فَذَرُوْهَا تَاْكُلْ فِيْٓ اَرْضِ اللّٰهِ وَ لَا تَمَسُّوْهَا بِسُوْٓءٍ فَيَاْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: And remember the time, when We made you successor after the nation of Aad; and settled you on the land on which you construct huge palaces on the soft and plain land; and make houses by carving out the mountains, then do remember the benefits of Allah, and do not cause mischief on the land.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اذْكُرُوْٓا اِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنْ بَعْدِ عَادٍ وَ بَوَّاَكُمْ فِي الْاَرْضِ تَتَّخِذُوْنَ مِنْ سُهُوْلِهَا قُصُوْرًا وَ تَنْحِتُونَ الْجِبَالَ بُيُوتًا ۚ فَاذْكُرُوْا آلَآءَ اللّٰهِ وَ لَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: So the leaders of that nation asked those who were poor believers, do you know that Saleh is in fact the true prophet of his Lord? They replied we already have believed on whatever he preaches.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ الْمَلَاُ الَّذِيْنَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لِلَّذِيْنَ اسْتُضْعِفُوْا لِمَنْ آمَنَ مِنْهُمْ اَتَعْلَمُوْنَ اَنَّ صٰلِحًا مُرْسَلٌ مِنْ رَّبِّهِ قَالُوْا اِنَّا بِمَآ اُرْسِلَ بِهِ مُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Then those who were haughty (on their worldly wealth) said: we do not accept him on whom you believe.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ الَّذِيْنَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْٓا اِنَّا بِالَّذِي آمَنْتُمْ بِهِ كٰفِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: After all they cut the legs of she-camel, and they showed haughtiness against the command of their Lord, and (shamelessly) said: if you are truthful prophet, then bring us your Lord with Whom you had warned us.
verses.arabic_text: فَعَقَرُوْا النَّاقَةَ وَ عَتَوْا عَنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَ قَالُوْا يٰصٰلِحُ ائْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Then the earthquake overtook them, and they sat down in their homes while their heads were on their knees.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَاَصْبَحُوا فِيْ دِارِهِمْ جٰثِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Then Saleh left them and told them: O my nation, alas, I conveyed the messages from Allah to you, and wanted your welfare; and had explained the good and bad to you; but you did not even consider him a friend, who was desirous of welfare for you.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَوَلّٰى عَنْهُمْ وَ قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ لَقَدْ اَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَالَةَ رَبِّيْ وَ نَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ وَ لٰكِنْ لَّا تُحِبُّوْنَ النّٰصِحِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And We sent Lut (as a messenger) and he told his nation, it is a concern, that you commit such an act which nobody has not committed before you in the kingdom of Allah so far.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لُوْطًا اِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِٓ اَتَاْتُوْنَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُمْ بِهَا مِنْ اَحَدٍ مِّنَ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: You turn to men leaving women for your carnal desires (whereas it is not necessary); but you are vulgar, who waste (sperm).
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّكُمْ لَتَاْتُوْنَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّنْ دُوْنِ النِّسَآءِ بَلْ اَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُوْنَ

verses.english_text: On this, the nation did not have any reply, that they started discussing to expel them from their settlement because these are the people who think they are pure.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ اِلَّآ اَنْ قَالُوْآ اَخْرِجُوْهُمْ مِّنْ قَرْيَتِكُمْ ۚ اِنَّهُمْ اُنَاسٌ يَّتَطَهَّرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Then We delivered him and his family, except his wife because she was among those who would stay back.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَنَْجَّيْنٰهُ وَ اَهْلَهُٓ اِلَّا امْرَاَتَهُ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغٰبِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: The We sent rain of specific stones on them, now see what will be the outcome of the sinners.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: We sent his brother Shoaib towards Madyan, so he said: worship Allah, there is no god except Him, argument from your Lord has come to you, now do the measure and weight properly and do not sell short-weight, and do not make mischief on the land after reform, this is better for you, if you are going to be believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِلَٰى مَدْيَنَ اَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ اِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ قَدْ جَآءَتْكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ مِنْ رَّبِّكُمْ فَاَوْفُوْا الْكَيْلَ وَ الْمِيْزَانَ وَ لَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَ لَا تُفْسِدُوْا فِيْ الْاَرْضِ بَعْدَ اِصْلَاحِهَا ذٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Beware, do not sit on the roads to frighten and threaten the believers; and desist from diverting them from the path of Allah; and seeking crookedness in it, and remember, you were few, We multiplied your number; and do look what happens to the mischief makers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَقْعُدُوا بِكُلِّ صِرَاطٍ تُوْعِدُوْنَ وَ تَصُدُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ مَنْ آمَنَ بِهِ وَ تَبْغُوْنَهَا عِوَجًا ۚ وَ اذْكُرُوْا اِذْ كُنْتُمْ قَلِيْلًا فَكَثَّرَكُمْ وَ انْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And one group among you believed on the message brought by me and another group did not believed, then wait, Allah will decide between us; and He is Best Decider.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنْ كَانَ طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنْكُمْ آمَنُوْا بِالَّذِيْٓ اُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ وَ طَآئِفَةٌ لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوْا فَاصْبِرُوْا حَتّٰى يَحْكُمَ اللّٰهُ بَيْنَنَا ۚ وَ هُوَ خَيْرُ الْحٰكِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And the arrogant people of the nation said: O Shoaib, we will drive you and whoever have believed with you, out of our settlement or else you return to our religion; they replied: even if we do not like;
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ الْمَلَاُ الَّذِيْنَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْاْ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكَ يٰشُعَيْبُ وَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْاْ مَعَكَ مِنْ قَرْيَتِنَآ اَوْ لَتَعُوْدُنَّ فِىْ مِلَّتِنَا  قَالَ اَوَ لَوْ كُنَّا كٰرِهِيْنَ

verses.english_text: It will be a great blame on Allah that we return to your religion, when He had delivered us from that religion; and we have no right that we come on your religion until Allah Himself does not wishes, knowledge of our Lord is predominant on everything, and we trust on Him only; O Allah decide between us and our nation with truth; you are the Best decider.
verses.arabic_text: قَدِ افْتَرَيْنَا عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اِنْ عُدْنَا فِيْ مِلَّتِكُمْ بَعْدَ اِذْ نَجّٰنَا اللّٰهُ مِنْهَا وَ مَا يَكُوْنُ لَنَآ اَنْ نَعُوْدَ فِيْهَا اِلَّآ اَنْ يَشَآءَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّنَا وَ سِعَ رَبُّنَا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا عَلَى اللّٰهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَ اَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْفٰتِحِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Then the infidels of their nation said: if you will obey Shoaib, then you will be counted among the people who are losers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالَ الْمَلَاُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتُمْ شُعَيْبًا اِنَّكُمْ اِذًا لَّخٰسِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Resultant, an earthquake overtook them, and they sat down in their homes while their heads were on their knees.
verses.arabic_text: ۚ فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَاَصْبَحُوْا فِيْ دَارِهِمْ جٰثِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Whoever denied Shoaib they were destroyed in such a way as if they have never lived there, whoever denied Shoaib were among losers.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا شُعَيْبًا كَاَنْ لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيْهَا ۚ الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوا شُعَيْبًا كَانُوا هُمُ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Then Shoaib turned away from them and said; O nation, I had delivered the messages of my Lord and also advised you, now how I should concern on their condition.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَوَلّٰى عَنْهُمْ وَ قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ لَقَدْ اَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّيْ وَ نَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ ۚ فَكَيْفَ اٰسٰى عَلَى قَوْمٍ كٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And whenever We sent a prophet in any village, we Verily made their people suffer if they disobey, so may they implore with humility in Our Court.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَا فِيْ قَرْيَةٍ مِّنْ نَّبِيٍّ اِلَّا اَخَذْنَآ اَهْلَهَا بِالْبَاْسَآءِ وَ الضَّرَّآءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَضَّرَّعُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Then We gave them goodness in place of evil, and they multiplied; and said: this affliction and ease had come to our elders also, then suddenly We seized them, and also they could not have understood.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ بَدَّلْنَا مَكَانَ السَّيِّئَةِ الْحَسَنَةَ حَتّٰى عَفَوْا وَّ قَالُوْا قَدْ مَسَّ اٰبَآءَنَا الضَّرَّآءُ وَ السَّرَّآءُ فَاَخَذْنٰهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَ هُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And if the people of the village believed and guard themselves against evil, then We open the doors of Blessings of skies and the earth, but if they deny then We seize them, in their own deeds only.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ اَنَّ اَهْلَ الْقُرٰٓى اٰمَنُوا وَ اتَّقَوْا لَفَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَرَكٰتٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ لٰكِن كَذَّبُوا فَاَخَذْنٰهُم بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ

verses.english_text: Does the people of village feel secure from punishment of Allah coming to them at night, when they are asleep?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَاَمِنَ اَهْلُ الْقُرٰىٓ اَنْ يَّاْتِيَهُمْ بَاْسُنَا بَيَاتًا وَّ هُمْ نَآئِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Or they are sure that Our punishment will befall during the day when they will be busy in play.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَاَمِنَ اَهْلُ الْقُرٰٓى اَنْ يَّاْتِيَهُمْ بَاْسُنَا ضُحًى وَّ هُمْ يَلْعَبُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Are they secure from the planning of Allah; whereas those who feel secure from Allah's planning; those are at a loss.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَاَمِنُوْا مَكْرَ اللّٰهِ  ۚ فَلَا يَاْمَنُ مَكْرَ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْخٰسِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Does not the people who inherit earlier people of the earth get guidance from them; that if We pleased We would have afflicted them with punishment due to their sins, and have sealed their hearts, then they could not have heard anything.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لِلَّذِيْنَ يَرِثُوْنَ الْاَرْضَ مِنْ بَعْدِ اَهْلِهَا اَنْ لَوْ نَشَآءُ اَصَبْنٰهُمْ بِذُنُوْبِهِمْ  ۚ وَ نَطْبَعُ عَلَٰى قُلُوْبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ

verses.english_text: These settlements of which we are giving you the news, where Our prophets came with miracles, now they would not believe because they have denied earlier, like this we sealed the hearts of unbelievers.
verses.arabic_text: تِلْكَ الْقُرٰى نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ اَنْبَآئِهَا ۚ وَ لَقَدْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ فَمَا كَانُوا لِيُؤْمِنُوْا بِمَا كَذَّبُوا مِنْ قَبْلُ ۚ كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللّٰهُ عَلَٰى قُلُوبِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: We did not find most of them who would adhere to the covenants; and found most of them are transgressors, and (they) are not obedient.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا وَجَدْنَا لِاَكْثَرِهِمْ مِنْ عَهْدٍ وَ اِنْ وَجَدْنَا اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَفٰسِقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Then after them We sent Moosa with Our miracles to Firaun and his people, so they also did unjust, now see the result of the mischief makers.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ مُوسٰى بِاٰيَاتِنَآ اِلَٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَ مَلَئِهِ فَظَلَمُوا بِهَا فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And Moosa told Firaun: I am a Prophet of the Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالَ مُوسٰى يٰفِرْعَوْنُ اِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: It is imperative for me not to speak anything about Allah except the truth; I have come to you with the miracles from your Lord, so send Bani Israel with me.
verses.arabic_text: حَقِيقٌ عَلَىٰٓ اَنْ لَّا اَقُوْلَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الْحَقَّ ۚ قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَاَرْسِلْ مَعِيَ بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَآئِيْلَ

verses.english_text: He said if you have come with miracles, then show it; if you are truthful.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنْ كُنْتَ جِئْتَ بِآيَةٍ فَاْتِ بِهَآ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: So Moosa threw his staff, and suddenly it became a manifest snake.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَلْقٰى عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُبِيْنٌ

verses.english_text: Then he pulled out his hand and people saw it was shiny and bright.
verses.arabic_text: وَّ نَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنّٰظِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Chiefs of Firaun said he is a sensible magician;
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ الْمَلَاُ مِنْ قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَسٰحِرٌ عَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Who wants to drive you away from your land, now what is your opinion?
verses.arabic_text: يُرِيْدُ اَنْ يُّخْرِجَكُمْ مِنْ اَرْضِكُمْ فَمَاذَا تَاْمُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: They said withhold him and his brother, and send collectors into cities;
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوْٓا اَرْجِهْ وَ اَخَاهُ وَ اَرْسِلْ فِي الْمَدَآئِنِ حٰشِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: So they may bring from their expert magicians.
verses.arabic_text: يَاْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سٰحِرٍ عَلِيْمٍ

verses.english_text: Magicians came to Firaun, and they said: if we prevail upon him what reward will we get?
verses.arabic_text: وَ جَآءَ السَّحَرَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ قَالُوْآ اِنَّ لَنَا لَاَجْرًا اِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغٰلِبِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Firaun said, Verily you shall be close to me in my court.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَ اِنَّكُمْ لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ

verses.english_text: They said: Moosa, will you throw down your staff or shall we begin our work.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوْا يٰمُوسٰٓى اِمَّٓا اَنْ تُلْقِيَ وَ اِمَّٓا اَنْ نَّكُوْنَ نَحْنُ الْمُلْقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: you begin your work, so they threw the ropes and they cast magic on their eyes and frightened them, then they demonstrated great magic.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَلْقُوْا فَلَمَّٓا اَلْقَوْا سَحَرُوْآ اَعْيُنَ النَّاسِ وَ اسْتَرْهَبُوهُمْ وَ جَآءُوْ  بِسِحْرٍ عَظِيْمٍ

verses.english_text: Then We indicated to Moosa to throw his staff also, and it will swallow all their magic snakes.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَٰى مُوسٰٓى اَنْ اَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَاِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَاْفِكُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Result was that truth got established, and their affairs were nullified.
verses.arabic_text: فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ وَ بَطَلَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: They were all defeated and they returned with humiliation.
verses.arabic_text: فَغُلِبُوْا هُنَالِكَ وَ انْقَلَبُوْا صٰغِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And magicians all went down in prostration.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سٰجِدِينَ

verses.english_text: They said: we believe on Lord of the worlds;
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Means, on the Lord of Moosa and Haroon.
verses.arabic_text: رَبِّ مُوسٰى وَ هٰرُونَ

verses.english_text: Firaun said: how you accepted faith before my permission, this is your deceit which you are spreading in the city, that you can take the people out of city, so shortly you will know its result.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ آمَنْتُمْ بِهِ قَبْلَ اَنْ آذَنَ لَكُمْ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَمَكْرٌ مَكَرْتُمُوهُ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ لِتُخْرِجُوا مِنْهَآ اَهْلَهَا فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: I will cut your hand and feet from opposite directions, and then will I crucify you all.
verses.arabic_text: لَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيْدِيَكُمْ وَ اَرْجُلَكُمْ مِنْ خِلَافٍ ثُمَّ لَاُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ

verses.english_text: They replied: Anyway, we have to return to the court of our Lord.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوْآ اِنَّآ اِلَٰى رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And you are angry with us that we believed in the signs of our Lord, O Lord, pour out upon us patience and let us die as Muslims.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا تَنْقِمُ مِنَّآ اِلَّا اَنْ آمَنَّا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّنَا لَمَّا جَآءَتْنَا  رَبَّنَآ اَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَّ تَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And a group of Firaun said, will you leave Moosa and his people like this to cause mischief in the land that they may forsake you and your gods; he said: shortly I will slay their sons and keep alive their women; and I have power and dominance over them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالَ الْمَلَاُمِنْ قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ اَتَذَرُ مُوسٰى وَ قَوْمَهُ لِيُفْسِدُوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَ يَذَرَكَ وَ اٰلِهَتَكَ  قَالَ سَنُقَتِّلُ اَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَ نَسْتَحْىِ نِسَآءَهُمْ وَ اِنَّا فَوْقَهُمْ قٰهِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Moosa told his people to seek help from Allah and have patience, land belongs to Allah and He makes it to whoever He pleases, and anyway the result is for the pious ones.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ مُوْسٰى لِقَوْمِهِ اسْتَعِيْنُوا بِاللّٰهِ وَ اصْبِرُوْا اِنَّ الْاَرْضَ لِلّٰهِ يُورِثُهَا مَنْ يَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَ الْعَاقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: They (people of Moosa) said, we have been persecuted before your arrival; and also after you came; Moosa replied: shortly your Lord will destroy your enemy, and will make you inherit him on this land, then He will see how you behave.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوْآ اُوْذِيْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ تَاْتِيَنَا وَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جِئْتَنَا  قَالَ عَسٰى رَبُّكُمْ اَنْ يُهْلِكَ عَدُوَّكُمْ وَ يَسْتَخْلِفَكُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And then We afflicted Firaun in famine, and also in shortage of fruits, so that they may take lesson.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَخَذْنَآ اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّنِيْنَ وَ نَقْصٍ مِنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Thereafter, when any good came to them they said it is our right, and if any evil came, they say: it is ill-luck of Moosa and his companions, beware, their ill-luck was already written only from Allah, but most of them do not know.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا جَآءَتْهُمُ الْحَسَنَةُ قَالُوْا لَنَا هٰذِهِ وَ اِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَّطَّيَّرُوْا بِمُوسٰى وَ مَنْ مَعَهُ اَلَآ اِنَّمَا طٰٓئِرُهُمْ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And the people said: O Moosa you may bring any number of signs for magic; we are not going to believe you.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُوا مَهْمَا تَاْتِنَا بِهِ مِنْ اٰيَةٍ لِتَسْحَرَنَا بِهَا فَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Then We sent on them flood, locust, lice, frogs, and blood as clear signs, but they denied, and Verily they were sinful people.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الطُّوْفَانَ وَ الْجَرَادَ وَ الْقُمَّلَ وَ الضَّفَادِعَ وَ الدَّمَ اٰيٰتٍ مُفَصَّلٰتٍ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَ كَانُوا قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And when punishment befell them they said: O Moosa, pray to your Lord what He has promised, if He will remove punishment from us, then we will certainly believe in you, and will also send Bani Israel with you.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَمَّا وَ قَعَ عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّجْزُ قَالُوا يٰمُوسَى ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنْدَكَ لَئِنْ كَشَفْتَ عَنَّا الرِّجْزَ لَنُؤْمِنَنَّ لَكَ وَ لَنُرْسِلَنَّ مَعَكَ بَنِىْٓ اِسْرَآئِيلَ

verses.english_text: And when We removed punishment for a period of time, then again they became among the people who break their covenant.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْزَ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ هُمْ بٰلِغُوهُ اِذَا هُمْ يَنْكُثُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Then We took revenge on them and drowned them in the sea, and they had denied our verses and they were negligent of them.
verses.arabic_text: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَاَغْرَقْنٰهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا بِاٰيَاتِنَا وَ كَانُوا عَنْهَا غٰفِلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And We caused to make heirs on the land of East and West to the deprived ones and gave Blessing to them, and like this We completed Our saying on Bani Israel because they showed patience, and destroyed whatever Firaun and his people were planning; and demolished their tall buildings.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَوْرَثْنَا الْقَوْمَ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا يُسْتَضْعَفُوْنَ مَشَارِقَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَغَارِبَهَا الَّتِي بٰرَكْنَا فِيْهَا وَ تَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ الْحُسْنٰى عَلَٰى بَنِىْٓ اِسْرَآئِيلَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا وَ دَمَّرْنَا مَا كَانَ يَصْنَعُ فِرْعَوْنُ وَ قَوْمُهُ وَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْرِشُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And we took Bani Israel across the river; and they reached to such people who were sitting around their idols, these people said to Moosa: also make for us a god, like of theirs, he replied: you are totally ignorant.
verses.arabic_text: وَ جٰوَزْنَا بِبَنِىْٓ اِسْرَآئِيْلَ الْبَحْرَ فَاَتَوْا عَلَٰى قَوْمٍ يَعْكُفُوْنَ عَلَىٰٓ اَصْنَامٍ لَهُمْ ۚ قَالُوا يٰمُوسَى اجْعَلْ لَّنَآ اِلٰهًا كَمَا لَهُمْ آلِهَةٌ ۚ قَالَ اِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Their system is going to be destroyed and their deeds are invalid.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ مُتَبَّرٌ مَّا هُمْ فِيْهِ وَ بٰطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: What, shall I seek for you, another god except Allah? when He has made you excel over the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَغَيْرَ اللّٰهِ اَبْغِيْكُمْ اِلٰهًا وَّ هُوَ فَضَّلَكُمْ عَلَى الْعٰلَمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And When We delivered you from people of Firaun, who subjected you to severe torment, they killed your sons and kept your women for service, in this there was your tough trial from your Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ اَنجَيْنٰكُم مِّنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُوْمُوْنَكُمْ سُوٓءَ الْعَذَابِ يُقَتِّلُونَ اَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَ يَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمْ ۚ وَ فِيْ ذٰلِكُم بَلَآءٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: And We promised for thirty nights to Moosa and completed with additional ten days, so the promise of his Lord became the promise of forty days, and he told his brother Haroon to be his deputy and continue reforms, and beware follow not the path of mischief makers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ وٰعَدْنَا مُوسٰى ثَلٰثِيْنَ لَيْلَةً وَّ اَتْمَمْنٰهَا بِعَشْرٍ فَتَمَّ مِيْقَاتُ رَبِّهِٓ اَرْبَعِيْنَ لَيْلَةً ۚ وَ قَالَ مُوسٰى لِاَخِيْهِ هٰرُوْنَ اخْلُفْنِىْ فِىْ قَوْمِى وَ اَصْلِحْ وَ لَا تَتَّبِعْ سَبِيْلَ الْمُفْسِدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: So thereafter when Moosa came to complete his covenant, so his Lord spoke to him, he said O my Lord show your glimpse, He said: you can never see Me, look at that Mountain, if it remains at its place, then you can see me; when His manifestation fell on the mountain, it turned into particles and Moosa fell unconscious; when he came to consciousness, he said: O Lord, you are clean and pure and I repent in Your court, and I am first to believe.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَمَّا جَآءَ مُوسٰى لِمِيقَاتِنَا وَ كَلَّمَهُ رَبُّهُ قَالَ رَبِّ اَرِنِىٓ اَنْظُرْ اِلَيْكَ ۚ قَالَ لَنْ تَرٰنِى وَ لٰكِنِ انْظُرْ اِلَى الْجَبَلِ فَاِنِ اسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهُ فَسَوْفَ تَرٰنِىْ ۚ فَلَمَّا تَجَلّٰى رَبُّهُ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُ دَكًّا وَّ خَرَّ مُوْسٰى صَعِقًا ۚ فَلَمَّآ اَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبْحٰنَكَ تُبْتُ اِلَيْكَ وَ اَنَاْ اَوَّلُ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: He said: O Moosa! We selected you for our prophethood and to address you, now take this book and be among thankful servants of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يٰمُوسٰٓى اِنِّى اصْطَفَيْتُكَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بِرِسٰلٰتِى وَ بِكَلَامِى فَخُذْ مَآ اٰتَيْتُكَ وَ كُنْ مِّنَ الشّٰكِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And in Tablets of Taurait we ordained all parts of advice and did mentioned details of everything, so hold them firmly and adopt good things written in it; and very soon We will show you the houses of transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَتَبْنَا لَهُ فِى الْاَلْوَاحِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْعِظَةً وَّ تَفْصِيْلًا لِّكُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَخُذْهَا بِقُوَّةٍ وَّاْمُرْ قَوْمَكَ يَاْخُذُوْا بِاَحْسَنِهَا ۚ سَاُورِيْكُمْ دَارَ الْفٰسِقِيْنَ
