verses.english_text: And shortly We will make them turn away from our verses who roam on the land haughtily, and if they see every sign, they will not believe in it, their condition is such that if they will see the path of guidance, they will not adapt to it, but if they see any path of misguidance, they immediately adapt to it, this is because they have denied our signs and were negligent of them.
verses.arabic_text: سَاَصْرِفُ عَنْ اٰيٰتِىَ الَّذِيْنَ يَتَكَبَّرُوْنَ فِى الْاَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَ اِنْ يَّرَوْا كُلَّ اٰيَةٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوْا بِهَا وَ اِنْ يَرَوْا سَبِيْلَ الرُّشْدِ لَا يَتَّخِذُوْهُ سَبِيْلًا وَ اِنْ يَّرَوْا سَبِيْلَ الْغَىِّ يَتَّخِذُوْهُ سَبِيْلًا ۚ ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيَاتِنَا وَ كَانُوْا عَنْهَا غٰفِلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And whoever denied our verses and meeting of the Hereafter, their deeds are a waste, and they will be given the reward as per their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيَاتِنَا وَ لِقَآءِ الْاٰخِرَةِ حَبِطَتْ اَعْمَالُهُمْ ۚ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ اِلَّا مَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: After Moosa went (to Mount Tur [Sinai]) his people made an idol of calf by melting their gold ornaments and in which was a sound also, did not the people see that it could neither talk nor show the way, they considered it to be god, and they Verily were unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اتَّخَذَ قَوْمُ مُوْسٰى مِنۢ بَعْدِهِ مِنْ حُلِيِّهِمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَّهُ خُوَارٌ ۚ اَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّهُ لَا يُكَلِّمُهُمْ وَ لَا يَهْدِيْهِمْ سَبِيْلًا  ۘ اِتَّخَذُوْهُ وَ كَانُوا ظٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And when they felt remorse and they saw that they have are diverted from the path, then they said: if our Lord will not show mercy on us and will not forgive us, then we shall certainly be of the losers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَمَّا سُقِطَ فِىٓ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَ رَاَوْا اَنَّهُمْ قَدْ ضَلُّوْا قَالُوا لَئِنْ لَّمْ يَرْحَمْنَا رَبُّنَا وَ يَغْفِرْ لَنَا لَنَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And when Moosa returned to his people, he said with anger and wrath you have done very bad in my absence; you did haste in receiving the command of Allah, and threw down the tablets and dragged his brother by his head; Haroon said: O brother, these people did weaken me, and they were about to kill me, what would I have done, don't give a chance to enemies for taunts on me, and do not consider me with the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَمَّا رَجَعَ مُوسٰى اِلَٰى قَوْمِهِ غَضْبَانَ اَسِفًا قَالَ بِئْسَمَا خَلَفْتُمُوْنِي مِنْ بَعْدِي اَعَجِلْتُمْ اَمْرَ رَبِّكُمْ وَ اَلْقَى الْاَلْوَاحَ وَ اَخَذَ بِرَاْسِ اَخِيْهِ يَجُرُّهُ اِلَيْهِ قَالَ ابْنَ اُمَّ اِنَّ الْقَوْمَ اسْتَضْعَفُوْنِيْ وَ كَادُوْا يَقْتُلُوْنَنِي فَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِيَ الْاَعْدَآءَ وَ لَا تَجْعَلْنِي مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: O Lord! forgive me and my brother, and enter us into Your Mercy that You are the Best among who show mercy.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَ لِاَخِيْ وَ اَدْخِلْنَا فِي رَحْمَتِكَ وَ اَنْتَ اَرْحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Verily, whoever adopted (idol of) calf, wrath of Allah will shortly befall on them, there is humiliation for them in this world also; and like this that We give punishment to those who falsely accuse.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّخَذُوا الْعِجْلَ سَيَنَالُهُمْ غَضَبٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَ ذِلَّةٌ فِي الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُفْتَرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And those who did evil deeds, then repented and believed; then after repentance your Lord is Great Forgiver and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ عَمِلُوا السَّيِّاٰتِ ثُمَّ تَابُوْا مِنْ بَعْدِهَا وَ اٰمَنُوْٓا اِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنْ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: When Moosa's anger calmed down he picked up the tablets, and in it there were things of guidance and mercy for the people who fear their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَمَّا سَكَتَ عَنْ مُّوسَى الْغَضَبُ اَخَذَ الْاَلْوَاحَ وَ فِي نُسْخَتِهَا هُدًى وَّ رَحْمَةٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ هُمْ لِرَبِّهِمْ يَرْهَبُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And for his appointment with Me Moosa chose 70 men of his people, then when a jerk of earthquake took them, he said: O Lord if You wanted You could have destroyed them earlier and myself too, what! now would You destroy us because of these fools, so this is how you tested us, you leave in misguidance to whoever you please and guide to whoever you please, You are our Master, forgive us and show mercy on us, You are Great Forgiver.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اخْتَارَ مُوْسٰى قَوْمَهُ سَبْعِيْنَ رَجُلًا لِّمِيْقَاتِنَا فَلَمَّآ اَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ قَالَ رَبِّ لَوْ شِئْتَ اَهْلَكْتَهُمْ مِّنْ قَبْلُ وَ اِيَّايَ اَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ السُّفَهَآءُ مِنَّا اِنْ هِيَ اِلَّا فِتْنَتُكَ تُضِلُّ بِهَا مَنْ تَشَآءُ وَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَآءُ اَنْتَ وَ لِيُّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَ ارْحَمْنَا وَ اَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْغٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And do write for us good in this world and the Hereafter, we turn to You only; said He: my punishment, it will reach to those to whoever I please, and My Mercy has spread over everything and I will shortly write it for who have fear of Allah, pays poor-rate, and are believers of our signs.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اكْتُبْ لَنَا فِي هٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ اِنَّا هُدْنَآ اِلَيْكَ قَالَ عَذَابِٓي اُصِيْبُ بِهِ مَنْ اَشَآءُ وَ رَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فَسَاَكْتُبُهَا لِلَّذِيْنَ يَتَّقُوْنَ وَ يُؤْتُوْنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَ الَّذِينَ هُم بِاٰيَاتِنَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And those who follow messenger, the Prophet who (in this world) neither read nor wrote; whose mention is found in Taurait and Injeel, that he orders for good and stop you from the evil, and makes lawful for you the pure things, and makes unlawful the bad things, and removes the burden and restriction of difficult orders, so whoever believed in him, respected him and helped him, and followed the light which came with him; Verily those are the people who will prosper.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ يَتَّبِعُوْنَ الرَّسُوْلَ النَّبِيَّ الْاُمِّيَّ الَّذِي يَجِدُوْنَهُ مَكْتُوْبًا عِنْدَهُمْ فِي التَّوْرٰةِ وَ الْاِنْجِيْلِ يَاْمُرُهُم بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ وَ يَنْهٰهُمْ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَ يُحِلُّ لَهُمُ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَ يُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْخَبٰٓئِثَ وَ يَضَعُ عَنْهُمْ اِصْرَهُمْ وَ الْاَغْلٰلَ الَّتِي كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ فَالَّذِيْنَ آمَنُوْا بِهِ وَ عَزَّرُوْهُ وَ نَصَرُوْهُ وَ اتَّبَعُوْا النُّوْرَ الَّذِي اُنْزِلَ مَعَهُٓ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Say: I have been sent towards you as a representative and Prophet of Allah, Who is the Owner of the earth and the skies, there is no god but He; only He gives life and causes death, hence, have belief on Allah and His ummi Prophet who believe on communications of Allah, so that you may be guided.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يَا اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنِّي رَسُولُ اللّٰهِ اِلَيْكُمْ جَمِيْعًا الَّذِيْ لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ يُحِْي وَ يُمِيْتُ فَاٰمِنُوْا بِاللّٰهِ وَ رَسُولِهِ النَّبِيِّ الْاُمِّيِّ الَّذِىْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللّٰهِ وَ كَلِمٰتِهِ وَ اتَّبِعُوْهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And there is also a party within the people of Moosa who guide with truth, and who are truthful and just in the affairs.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِنْ قَوْمِ مُوْسٰٓى اُمَّةٌ يَّهْدُوْنَ بِالْحَقِّ وَ بِهِ يَعْدِلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And We divided Bani Israel's twelve children of Yaqoob into twelve tribes; and revealed to Moosa: when they ask for water, strike the staff on the ground and twelve springs will start flowing and every group identified their own places of water, and We sent clouds to give shade on their heads; and sent them favors such as Mann-va-Salwa so that they eat Our pure sustenance; and with their opposition they did no injustice to Us, whereas they did injustice to their own souls.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَطَّعْنٰهُمُ اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ اَسْبَاطًا اُمَمًا ۚ وَ اَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَٰى مُوسٰٓى اِذِ اسْتَسْقٰهُ قَوْمُهُ اَنِ اضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ الْحَجَرَ فَانْبَجَسَتْ مِنْهُ اثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنًا قَدْ عَلِمَ كُلُّ اُنَاسٍ مَّشْرَبَهُمْ ۚ وَ ظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الْغَمَامَ وَ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَنَّ وَ السَّلْوٰى كُلُوْا مِنْ طَيِّبٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنٰكُمْ ۚ وَ مَا ظَلَمُونَا وَ لٰكِنْ كَانُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And remember the time when We told them to enter that village and eat whatever you want, and while you enter say 'hitta' and prostrate, so that We forgive your mistakes, and shortly We will also increase the reward of those who do good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ قِيْلَ لَهُمُ اسْكُنُوْا هٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةَ وَ كُلُوْا مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمْ وَ قُوْلُوْا حِطَّةٌ وَ ادْخُلُوْا الْبَابَ سُجَّدًا نَّغْفِرْ لَكُمْ خَطِيْٓئٰتِكُمْ ۚ سَنَزِيْدُ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: But the unjust (among them) started uttering something else, other than what was spoken to them, so We sent upon them punishment from sky because they were disobeying.
verses.arabic_text: فَبَدَّلَ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مِنْهُمْ قَوْلًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي قِيْلَ لَهُمْ فَاَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِجْزًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَظْلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And ask them about the village which was on the seashore, and whose residents exceeded the limit on Sabbath, that their fish used to come on surface on the day of Sabbath, but next day they don't come, so they used trickery, and like this We tried them, that they were doing disobedience.
verses.arabic_text: وَسْئَلْهُمْ عَنِ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِيْ كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ الْبَحْرِ اِذْ يَعْدُوْنَ فِي السَّبْتِ اِذْ تَاْتِيْهِمْ حِيْتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًا وَ يَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُوْنَ لَا تَاْتِيْهِمْ ۚ كَذٰلِكَ نَبْلُوْهُم بِمَا كَانُوْا يَفْسُقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And when one party among them told reformers why do you preach such a people whom Allah will destroy or send severe punishment on them, they said: they want to be free from blame before their Lord so these people also may fear Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ قَالَتْ اُمَّةٌ مِّنْهُمْ لِمَ تَعِظُوْنَ قَوْمًا اللّٰهُ مُهْلِكُهُمْ اَوْ مُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيْدًا قَالُوْا مَعْذِرَةً اِلَٰى رَبِّكُمْ وَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And when they forgot the reminders then We saved the reformers, and encircled those who were unjust in severest punishment because of their disobedience.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا نَسُوْا مَا ذُكِّرُوْا بِهِٓ اَنْجَيْنَا الَّذِيْنَ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ السُّوْٓءِ وَ اَخَذْنَا الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا بِعَذَابٍ بَئِيْسٍ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَفْسُقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: When despite prohibition they rebelled a second time, then in disgrace We ordained them to become apes.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا عَتَوْا عَنْ مَّا نُهُوْا عَنْهُ قُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُوْنُوْا قِرَدَةً خٰسِئِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And remember the time when your Lord has openly announced that until the Day of Judgement evil governors will be imposed on them who will give them worst trouble; and your Lord is He Who gives quick punishment also, and is very Forgiving and Merciful also.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ تَاَذَّنَ رَبُّكَ لَيَبْعَثَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ اِلَٰى يَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِ مَنْ يَّسُوْمُهُمْ سُوْٓءَ الْعَذَابِ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَسَرِيْعُ الْعِقَابِ وَ اِنَّهُ لَغَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: And We divided Bani-Israel in different tribes, some of them were righteous but others were that of the opposite, and We tested them with comfort and difficulties so they may come on the (right) path.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَطَّعْنٰهُمْ فِي الْاَرْضِ اُمَمًا مِّنْهُمُ الصّٰلِحُونَ وَ مِنْهُمْ دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَ وَ بَلَوْنٰهُم بِالْحَسَنٰتِ وَ السَّيِّاٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Later a posterity came into existence who inherited the book, but took all the wealth of the world and said shortly they will be forgiven, and when they got the wealth again, they took it again, so were not the covenant of the book taken from them. Beware! do not say anything about Allah but truth, and they too have read the book; and the Hereafter is the best for the pious people; and don’t you understand this.
verses.arabic_text: فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ وَ رِثُوْا الْكِتٰبَ يَاْخُذُوْنَ عَرَضَ هٰذَا الْاَدْنٰى وَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ سَيُغْفَرُ لَنَا وَ اِنْ يَّاْتِهِمْ عَرَضٌ مِّثْلُهُ يَاْخُذُوْهُ  اَلَمْ يُؤْخَذْ عَلَيْهِم مِّيثَاقُ الْكِتٰبِ اَنْ لَّا يَقُولُوا عَلَى اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الْحَقَّ وَ دَرَسُوْا مَا فِيْهِ وَ الدَّارُ الْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ يَتَّقُوْنَ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And those who adhere to the book and establish prayer, so We do not waste the reward of good character and righteous people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ يُمَسِّكُوْنَ بِالْكِتٰبِ وَ اَقَامُوا الصَّلٰوةَ اِنَّا لَا نُضِيْعُ اَجْرَ الْمُصْلِحِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And remind the time when We raised the mountain like a canopy and hung over them and they thought it was going to fall over them, so We said: hold Taurait firmly and remember whatever is written in it, you may guard yourself against evil and become pious.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ نَتَقْنَا الْجَبَلَ فَوْقَهُمْ كَاَنَّهُ ظُلَّةٌ وَّ ظَنُّوْا اَنَّهُ وَ اقِعٌ بِهِمْ ۚ خُذُوْا مَآ آتَيْنٰكُم بِقُوَّةٍ وَّ اذْكُرُوْا مَا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And when your Lord took out children of Adam from their loins - their descendants, and made them witness concerning themselves only and asked: am I not your Lord? Everyone said: yes, we testify it; We took this covenant lest they should say on the Day of Judgement that we were unaware of this covenant.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ اَخَذَ رَبُّكَ مِنۢ بَنِىْٓ اٰدَمَ مِنْ ظُهُوْرِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَ اَشْهَدَهُمْ عَلَٰىٓ اَنْفُسِهِمْ اَلَسْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ قَالُوْا بَلَىٰ شَهِدْنَآ  اَنْ تَقُوْلُوْا يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ اِنَّا كُنَّا عَنْ هٰذَا غٰفِلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Or say: our ancestors were polytheist, and we are their children, so would You destroy us because of deeds of those who were unjust?
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ تَقُوْلُوْٓا اِنَّمَآ اَشْرَكَ اٰبَآؤُنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَ كُنَّا ذُرِّيَّةً مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ اَفَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ الْمُبْطِلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And like this we describe our verses in detail so you may come back.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْاٰيٰتِ وَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And give them the news of the person to whom We gave our verses, but he totally separated from it, so Satan caught hold of him and he became among misguided people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَاَ الَّذِىْٓ اٰتَيْنٰهُ اٰيَاتِنَا فَانسَلَخَ مِنْهَا فَاَتْبَعَهُ الشَّيْطٰنُ فَكَانَ مِنَْ الْغٰوِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And if We pleased We would have elevated him because of the verses but he himself leaned towards the ground, and he followed his low-desires, now his example is like a dog that he gives out his tongue if you attack him, and (if you) leave him (still) he gives out his tongue, this is the example of people who denied our verses, so now you narrate these incidents, so they might ponder.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ شِئْنَا لَرَفَعْنٰهُ بِهَا وَ لٰكِنَّهُٓ اَخْلَدَ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ وَ اتَّبَعَ هَوٰهُ ۚ فَمَثَلُهُ كَمَثَلِ الْكَلْبِ اِنْ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْهِ يَلْهَثْ اَوْ تَتْرُكْهُ يَلْهَثْ ۚ ذّٰلِكَ مَثَلُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيَاتِنَا ۚ فَاقْصُصِ الْقَصَصَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: How evil is the example of the people who deny our verses, and those people are being unjust on their souls.
verses.arabic_text: سَآءَ مَثَلًا الْقَوْمُ الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوا بِاٰيَاتِنَا وَ اَنْفُسَهُمْ كَانُوا يَظْلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: To whoever Allah guides is the guided ones, and to whoever Allah leaves in misguidance then they are from those who are in loss.
verses.arabic_text: مَنْ يَّهْدِ اللّٰهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِى وَ مَنْ يُّضْلِلْ فَاُوْلٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخٰسِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And as if We have created a large number of men and jinns for Hell, that they have hearts but they don't understand, they have eyes but they don't look, they have ears but they don't hear, these are like four-footed animals and even more misguided than them, and actually these are people who are negligent.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ذَرَاْنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ كَثِيْرًا مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْاِنْسِ لَهُمْ قُلُوْبٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُوْنَ بِهَا وَ لَهُمْ اَعْيُنٌ لَّا يُبْصِرُوْنَ بِهَا وَ لَهُمْ اٰذَانٌ لَّا يَسْمَعُوْنَ بِهَآ ۚ اُوْلٰٓئِكَ كَالْاَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ اَضَلُّ ۚ اُوْلٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْغٰفِلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And all good names are for Allah so do call Him with those names, and leave them out who violate the sanctity of His names, shortly they will be given reward for their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لِلّٰهِ الْاَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنٰى فَادْعُوْهُ بِهَا وَ ذَرُوْا الَّذِيْنَ يُلْحِدُوْنَ فِىْٓ اَسْمَآئِهِ ۚ سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And those are from Our Creation only who guide with truth and do justice with truth.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا اُمَّةٌ يَّهْدُوْنَ بِالْحَقِّ وَ بِهِ يَعْدِلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And whosoever denied our verses, We will shortly wrap them in such a way that they will not even understand.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوا بِاٰيَاتِنَا سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And We are giving them respite, because Our scheming is very stable.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اُمْلِي لَهُمْ ۚ اِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِيْنٌ

verses.english_text: Did not they notice that their companion messenger does not have any lunacy, he only clearly warns you from the punishment of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوْا مَا بِصَاحِبِهِم مِّنْ جِنَّةٍ ۚ اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ

verses.english_text: And didn't they think about the kingdom of earth and sky and all the creations of Allah, and that if their end nears, so on what announcement they will believe, after this.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَنْظُرُوْا فِي مَلَكُوتِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَّ اَنْ عَسٰٓى اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ اَجَلُهُمْ فَبِاَيِّ حَدِيْثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: To whoever Allah leaves in misguidance, no one can guide him, and He leaves them in rebellion so they may blindly wander on.
verses.arabic_text: مَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ ۚ وَ يَذَرُهُمْ فِيْ طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! they ask you about the Day of Judgement that when will it be established, so tell them its knowledge is with Allah, He will reveal it at an appointed time, this Day of Judgement is to be very difficult for both, earth and the skies, and it will come suddenly to you, these people ask you about it as if you are totally in know; say: its knowledge is with Allah, but most of the people even do not know this.
verses.arabic_text: يَسْئلُوْنَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ اَيَّانَ مُرْسٰهَا قُلْ اِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ رَبِّي لَا يُجَلِّيْهَا لِوَقْتِهَا اِلَّا هُوَ ۚ ثَقُلَتْ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ لَا تَاْتِيْكُمْ اِلَّا بَغْتَةً يَسْئَلُوْنَكَ كَاَنَّكَ حَفِيٌّ عَنْهَا قُلْ اِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Say: I do not control any benefit or evil over my own soul, only Allah wills; if I knew the evil, I would have done lots of good, and no evil could have reached me, I am only to give glad tidings to the believers and to warn them of the punishment of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لَّا اَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي نَفْعًا وَّ لَا ضَرًّا اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ اللّٰهُ ۚ وَ لَوْ كُنْتُ اَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ لَاسْتَكْثَرْتُ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ وَ مَا مَسَّنِيَ السُّوْٓءُ ۚ اِنْ اَنَا اِلَّا نَذِيْرٌ وَّ بَشِيْرٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: He is Allah who has created all of you from one soul, then created its pair from it so they get rest from it, then husband cohabited with wife so light pregnancy was created which she carries everywhere and when pregnancy became heavy and when birth time near, then both prayed to their Lord: we will be among thankful if You give us a righteous child.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّنْ نَّفْسٍ وَّاحِدَةٍ وَّجَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا لِيَسْكُنَ اِلَيْهَا ۚ فَلَمَّا تَغَشّٰهَا حَمَلَتْ حَمْلًا خَفِيْفًا فَمَرَّتْ بِهِ فَلَمَّآ اَثْقَلَتْ دَّعَوَا اللّٰهَ رَبَّهُمَا لَئِنْ آتَيْتَنَا صالِحًا لَّنَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الشّٰكِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And when We gave righteous child, then made partners with Allah in whatever He gave, whereas Allah is much above and superior than (his purported) partners.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ اٰتٰهُمَا صَالِحًا جَعَلَا لَهُ شُرَكَآءَ فِيْمَا اٰتٰهُمَا ۚ فَتَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ

verses.english_text: These people make them partners with Allah, who cannot create anything and also themselves are creatures.
verses.arabic_text: اَيُشْرِكُونَ مَا لَا يَخْلُقُ شَيْئًا وَّ هُمْ يُخْلَقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And they do not have the ability to help themselves nor they can help anybody else.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ لَهُمْ نَصْرًا وَّ لَآ اَنْفُسَهُمْ يَنْصُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: If you invite them for guidance they will not come along, whether you invite them or be silent, it is one and the same for them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنْ تَدْعُوْهُمْ اِلَى الْهُدٰى لَا يَتَّبِعُوْكُمْ ۚ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ اَدَعَوْتُمُوْهُمْ اَمْ اَنْتُمْ صَامِتُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Those whom you call upon instead of Allah are all servants like you, call upon them, and if you are truthful in your thinking they should respond to your calls.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ تَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُونِ اللّٰهِ عِبَادٌ اَمْثَالُكُمْ فَادْعُوْهُمْ فَلْيَسْتَجِيْبُوْا لَكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Do they have feet with which they walk, hands with which they attack, eyes with which they look, and ears with which they hear, which they can use; say: you call upon your partners and do whatever plotting you want, and do not give Me any respite (will see what you can do).
verses.arabic_text: اَلَهُمْ اَرْجُلٌ يَّمْشُوْنَ بِهَآ اَمْ لَهُمْ اَيْدٍ يَّبْطِشُوْنَ بِهَآ اَمْ لَهُمْ اَعْيُنٌ يُّبْصِرُوْنَ بِهَآ اَمْ لَهُمْ اٰذَانٌ يَّسْمَعُوْنَ بِهَا قُلِ ادْعُوْا شُرَكَآءَكُمْ ثُمَّ كِيْدُوْنِ فَلَا تُنْظِرُوْنِ

verses.english_text: Verily, my Lord and Master is Allah, who revealed the Book, and He is Master of and heir of good servants.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ وَلِىَِّ اللّٰهُ الَّذِى نَزَّلَ الْكِتٰبَ وَ هُوَ يَتَوَلَّى الصّٰلِحِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And you call upon whom except Allah, they neither can help you nor can they be useful to themselves.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ تَدْعُوْنَ مِن دُونِهِ لَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ نَصْرَكُمْ وَ لَآ اَنْفُسَهُمْ يَنْصُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And if you invite them for guidance then they will not be able to hear, and if you look at them it will seem they are looking at you, whereas they are not even able to see.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنْ تَدْعُوْهُمْ اِلَى الْهُدٰى لَا يَسْمَعُوا وَ تَرٰىهُمْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَيْكَ وَ هُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: You follow the way of forgiving and order for good, and keep away from the ignorant.
verses.arabic_text: خُذِ الْعَفْوَ وَاْمُرْ بِالْعُرْفِ وَ اَعْرِضْ عَنِْ الْجٰهِلِينَ

verses.english_text: And if any wrong thought is created from Satan then seek refuge in Allah, and He is Who Hears and Knows everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِمَّا يَنْزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطٰنِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللّٰهِ ۚ اِنَّهُ سَمِيْعٌ عَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Even if any wrong thought wants to touch the pious people, they remember Allah and look at the facts.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا اِذَا مَسَّهُمْ طٰٓئِفٌ مِّنَ الشَّيْطٰنِ تَذَكَّرُوْا فَاِذَا هُمْ مُّبْصِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And the brethren of Satan, polytheists, are pulling them towards misguidance, and do not show any laziness in it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِخْوَانُهُمْ يَمُدُّوْنَهُمْ فِي الْغَيِّ ثُمَّ لَا يُقْصِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And if you do not bring a sign to them they say why don't you select any (sign); say: I follow only whatever is revealed to me from my Lord, this Quran from your Lord is proof of guidance and has the status of Mercy for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا لَمْ تَاْتِهِم بِآيَةٍ قَالُوا لَوْلَا اجْتَبَيْتَهَا ۚ قُلْ اِنَّمَا اَتَّبِعُ مَا يُوْحٰٓى اِلَيَّ مِن رَّبِّي ۚ هٰذَا بَصَآئِرُ مِنْ رَّبِّكُمْ وَ هُدًى وَ رَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: (O People) When Quran is recited then listen to it attentively, so the Mercy be shown to you.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا قُرِئَ الْقُرْاٰنُ فَاسْتَمِعُوْا لَهُ وَ اَنْصِتُوْا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And implore our Lord within your heart silently (and) fearfully, and not with high tone but with low tone, remember him in the morning and the evening, and don't be among the negligent ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اذْكُرْ رَّبَّكَ فِيْ نَفْسِكَ تَضَرُّعًا وَّ خِيْفَةً وَّ دُوْنَ الْجَهْرِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَ الْآصالِ وَ لَا تَكُنْ مِّنَ الْغٰفِلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Verily,those who are near to your Lord and don't transgress from His worship, and glorify Him and prostrate before Him only.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِ وَ يُسَبِّحُوْنَهُ وَ لَهُ يَسْجُدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! They ask you about the spoils of war; say: spoils of war are all for Allah and Prophet, so fear Allah and reform among yourselves, and obey Allah and His Prophet, if you believe in Him.
verses.arabic_text: يَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْاَنْفَالِ قُلِ الْاَنْفَالُ لِلّٰهِ وَ الرَّسُوْلِ فَاتَّقُوْا اللّٰهَ وَ اَصْلِحُوا ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ وَ اَطِيْعُوا اللّٰهَ وَ رَسُولَهُ اِنْ كُنْتُم مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And believers are in fact those when Allah is mentioned in front of them; fear of Allah is created in their hearts, and if His verses are recited their belief increases, and they trust upon Allah only.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ اِذَا ذُكِرَ اللّٰهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوْبُهُمْ وَ اِذَا تُلِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتُهُ زَادَتْهُمْ اِيمَانًا وَّ عَلَٰى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: They establish prayer and also spend (without seeking any favor) from the subsistence given by Us.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ يُقِيمُوْنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَ مِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ

verses.english_text: These are in fact believers, for whom there are ranks and forgiveness and an honorable sustenance.
verses.arabic_text: اُوْلٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ حَقًّا ۚ لَّهُمْ دَرَجٰتٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَّ رِزْقٌ كَرِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: As your Lord took you from your house with truth, whereas a group of believers disliked it.
verses.arabic_text: كَمَآ اَخْرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِن بَيْتِكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَ اِنَّ فَرِيْقًا مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ لَكٰرِهُوْنَ

verses.english_text: These people are arguing with you, in spite of the truth being obvious to them in this regard, as if they are being sent towards death and they are looking with regret.
verses.arabic_text: يُجَادِلُوْنَكَ فِى الْحَقِّ بَعْدَمَا تَبَيَّنَ كَاَنَّمَا يُسَاقُونَ اِلَى الْمَوْتِ وَ هُمْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And remember the time when Allah was taking covenant with you that out of two one group is for your, and you had wished it may not be that of powerful one; and Allah pleases to prove His words through truth and wants to cut off series of the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ يَعِدُكُمُ اللّٰهُ اِحْدَى الطَّآئِفَتَيْنِ اَنَّهَا لَكُمْ وَ تَوَدُّوْنَ اَنَّ غَيْرَ ذَاتِ الشَّوْكَةِ تَكُونُ لَكُمْ وَ يُرِيْدُ اللّٰهُ اَنْ يُّحِقَّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمٰتِهِ وَ يَقْطَعَ دَابِرَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: So that truth may be proved and falsehood is destroyed, even if the guilty dislike it.
verses.arabic_text: لِيُحِقَّ الْحَقَّ وَ يُبْطِلَ الْبَاطِلَ وَ لَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: When you were beseeching the Lord, He heard your beseeching that We are helping you with one thousand angels who are coming one after another.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ تَسْتَغِيْثُوْنَ رَبَّكُمْ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ اَنِّى مُمِدُّكُمْ بِاَلْفٍۢ مِّنَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ مُرْدِفِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And it was just a glad tiding so that your hearts are satisfied, and aid is only from Allah, only Allah is possessor of honor and has wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا جَعَلَهُ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بُشْرٰى وَ لِتَطْمَئِنَّ بِهِ قُلُوْبُكُمْ ۚ وَ مَا النَّصْرُ اِلَّا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ ۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَزِيْزٌ حَكِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: When Allah caused you to sleep which was restful for you, and was sending water from sky to purify you, and to take you away from uncleanness of Satan; and to cause satisfaction to your hearts and make you steadfast.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ يُغَشِّيْكُمُ النُّعَاسَ اَمَنَةً مِّنْهُ وَ يُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً لِّيُطَهِّرَكُم بِهِ وَ يُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمْ رِجْزَ الشَّيْطٰنِ وَ لِيَرْبِطَ عَلَٰى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَ يُثَبِّتَ بِهِ الْاَقْدَامَ

verses.english_text: When your Lord revealed to angels: I am with you, so make the feet of the believers steady; I will shortly cast fear in the hearts of infidels; you therefore attack necks of infidels, and cut-off every part of their fingers.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ يُوْحِى رَبُّكَ اِلَى الْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اَنِّى مَعَكُمْ فَثَبِّتُوْا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا ۚ سَاُلْقِى فِى قُلُوْبِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا الرُّعْبَ فَاضْرِبُوا فَوْقَ الْاَعْنَاقِ وَ اضْرِبُوا مِنْهُمْ كُلَّ بَنَانٍ

verses.english_text: This is because they opposed Allah and His Prophet, and whoever will oppose Allah and his Prophet, Allah will cause severe punishment for it.
verses.arabic_text: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ شَآقُّوْا اللّٰهَ وَ رَسُوْلَهُ ۚ وَ مَنْ يُّشَاقِقِ اللّٰهَ وَ رَسُوْلَهُ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ شَدِيْدُ الْعِقَابِ

verses.english_text: This is the punishment of the world - taste it, and later there is punishment of Hell also for infidels.
verses.arabic_text: ذٰلِكُمْ فَذُوْقُوْهُ وَ اَنَّ لِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ عَذَابَ النَّارِ

verses.english_text: O Believers! When you meet the infidels in the battlefield, never show them your back.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوٓا اِذَا لَقِيْتُمُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا زَحْفًا فَلَا تُوَلُّوْهُمُ الْاَدْبارَ

verses.english_text: And today whoever will show their back (to infidels) will deserve the wrath of Allah and his place will be Hell, which is the worst outcome, except for those who retreat due to the planning of war or to take refuge with some other group.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَنْ يُّوَلِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ دُبُرَهُٓ اِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفًا لِّقِتَالٍ اَوْ مُتَحَيِّزًا اِلَٰى فِئَةٍ فَقَدْ بَآءَ بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَ مَاْوٰهُ جَهَنَّمُ وَ بِئْسَ الْمَصِيْرُ

verses.english_text: So, you have not killed those infidels, but Allah has killed them, and O Prophet, you have not thrown the pebbles, but Allah thrown the pebbles, that He may show abundant favors on the believers, because He hears everyone and knows the condition of everyone.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمْ تَقْتُلُوْهُمْ وَ لٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ قَتَلَهُمْ ۚ وَ مَا رَمَيْتَ اِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَ لٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ رَمٰى ۚ وَ لِيُبْلِىَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ مِنْهُ بَلَآءً حَسَنًا ۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَمِيْعٌ عَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: This and that is indeed favor, and Allah is the weakener of the plotting of the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: ذٰلِكُمْ وَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ مُوْهِنُ كَيْدِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And you wanted victory, so the victory has come, and if you desist from war than there is good in it for you, and if you will repeat it than We are also returning; how large your group may be, but it is not going to benefit you, and Allah is always with the believers.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ تَسْتَفْتِحُوا فَقَدْ جَآءَكُمُ الْفَتْحُ وَ اِنْ تَنْتَهُوْا فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ وَ اِنْ تَعُوْدُوْا نَعُدْ وَ لَنْ تُغْنِىَ عَنْكُمْ فِئَتُكُمْ شَيْئًا وَّ لَوْ كَثُرَتْ وَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Obey Allah and the Prophet and do not desert him, when you are also hearing.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوٓا اَطِيْعُوا اللّٰهَ وَ رَسُولَهُ وَ لَا تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَ اَنْتُمْ تَسْمَعُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And do not be like those who say: we heard although (in fact) they are not hearing.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَكُوْنُوْا كَالَّذِيْنَ قَالُوْا سَمِعْنَا وَ هُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Worst people near Allah walking on the earth are deaf and dumb who do not use wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَآبِّ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ الصُّمُّ الْبُكْمُ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يَعْقِلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And if Allah would have seen any good in them the Verily, He would cause them to hear, but if He would cause them to hear they would turn their faces and would have avoided.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ عَلِمَ اللّٰهُ فِيْهِمْ خَيْرًا لَّاَسْمَعَهُمْ وَ لَوْ اَسْمَعَهُمْ لَتَوَلَّوْا وَّ هُمْ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Answer to the calls of Allah and Prophet when they invite you towards the matter in which there is life for you, and remember, Allah comes in between man and his heart, and you will all be made to be presented before Him.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا اسْتَجِيْبُوا لِلّٰهِ وَ لِلرَّسُولِ اِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيْكُمْ وَ اعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَحُوْلُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَ قَلْبِهِ وَ اَنَّهُٓ اِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And avoid that mischief, which is not exclusive to the unjust only; and remember Allah is the owner of the strongest punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اتَّقُوْا فِتْنَةً لَّا تُصِيْبَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مِنْكُمْ خَآصَّةً وَ اعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ شَدِيْدُ الْعِقَابِ

verses.english_text: O Muslims, remember the time when in Makkah you were weak and few in number, and were always fearful that they will take you away, then Allah shielded you and verified you with His help, gave you pure sustenance so you may thank.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اذْكُرُوا اِذْ اَنْتُمْ قَلِيْلٌ مُّسْتَضْعَفُوْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِ تَخَافُونَ اَنْ يَّتَخَطَّفَكُمُ النَّاسُ فَاٰوٰكُمْ وَ اَيَّدَكُم بِنَصْرِهِ وَ رَزَقَكُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Do not be disloyal, towards Allah and Prophet and your trust; when you know.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاٰيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ آمَنُوْا لَا تَخُوْنُوْا اللّٰهَ وَ الرَّسُوْلَ وَ تَخُوْنُوْآ اَمٰنٰتِكُمْ وَ اَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And know that your children and your wealth is a test, and Allah is He, with whom lies the great reward.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اعْلَمُوْا اَنَّمَا اَمْوَالُكُمْ وَ اَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ عِنْدَهُٓ اَجْرٌ عَظِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: O Believers! If you will guard against evil, then He will grant you, ability to differentiate between truth and falsehood, and will cover up your shortcomings, will forgive your sins, He is of mighty Grace.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ آمَنُوْا اِنْ تَتَّقُوْا اللّٰهَ يَجْعَل لَّكُمْ فُرْقَانًا وَّ يُكَفِّرْ عَنكُمْ سَيِّاٰتِكُمْ وَ يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَ اللّٰهُ ذُوْ الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيْمِ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet! remember the time, when infidels were plotting to confine you or exile you or kill you; along with their plotting, Allah was also planning, and He is best among planners.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ يَمْكُرُ بِكَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لِيُثْبِتُوْكَ اَوْ يَقْتُلُوْكَ اَوْ يُخْرِجُوكَ ۚ وَ يَمْكُرُوْنَ وَ يَمْكُرُ اللّٰهُ وَ اللّٰهُ خَيْرُ الْمٰكِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And their condition is such that when Our verses are recited, they say: we heard and we also can say the same if we want, and this is nothing but tales of the earlier people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيَاتُنَا قَالُوا قَدْ سَمِعْنَا لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَقُلْنَا مِثْلَ هٰذَآ ۙ اِنْ هٰذَآ اِلَّا اَسَاطِيرُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And remember the time when they said: O Allah, if this truth is from you then rain stones on us from sky or send on us painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ قَالُوا اللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ كَانَ هٰذَا هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ فَاَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنَا حِجَارَةً مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اَوِ ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ

verses.english_text: Although, O Prophet, Allah will not send punishment until you are in their midst, and Allah will not punish them if they repent and seek forgiveness.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَ اَنْتَ فِيْهِمْ ۚ وَ مَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And what are in them that Allah will not punish them, whereas they stop people from entering Sacred Mosque and are not its trustee also, its guardians are only pious people but most of them are even unaware from this.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا لَهُمْ اَلَّا يُعَذِّبَهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَ هُمْ يَصُدُّوْنَ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَ  مَا كَانُوا اَوْلِيَآءَهُ  اِنْ اَوْلِيَآؤُهُٓ اِلَّا الْمُتَّقُوْنَ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And their prayer in the Sacred Mosque is nothing but clapping and whistles, so now taste the punishment because of your infidelity.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كَانَ صَلَاتُهُمْ عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ اِلَّا مُكَآءً وَ تَصْدِيَةً ۚ فَذُوْقُوْا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Those who adopted infidelity they spend their wealth to desist people from the path of Allah, so they will spend and it will become a matter of regret for them, also they will be defeated in the end; and those who adopted infidelity they will be taken towards Hell.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُنْفِقُوْنَ اَمْوَالَهُمْ لِيَصُدُّوْا عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ ۚ فَسَيُنْفِقُوْنَهَا ثُمَّ تَكُوْنُ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسْرَةً ثُمَّ يُغْلَبُونَ وَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا اِلَٰى جَهَنَّمَ يُحْشَرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: So, Allah would separate impure ones from the pure ones; and then impure ones will be put one upon another and they will become one pile, and they will all together be put in Hell, these are the people who will be deprived and in loss.
verses.arabic_text: لِيَمِيزَ اللّٰهُ الْخَبِيْثَ مِنَ الطَّيِّبِ وَ يَجْعَلَ الْخَبِيْثَ بَعْضَهُ عَلَٰى بَعْضٍ فَيَرْكُمَهُ جَمِيْعًا فَيَجْعَلَهُ فِيْ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخٰسِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Tell the infidels if they will desist from infidelity, their past sins will be forgiven, but if they turned their back, then tradition of the earlier people have also passed by.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْا اِنْ يَنْتَهُوْا يُغْفَرْ لَهُمْ مَّا قَدْ سَلَفَ وَ اِنْ يَّعُوْدُوْا فَقَدْ مَضَتْ سُنَّت الْاَوَّلِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And you fight with infidels until the mischief is uprooted, and whole religion remains for Allah only, but if they desist, the Allah sees their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَاتِلُوهُمْ حَتّٰى لَا تَكُوْنَ فِتْنَةٌ وَّ يَكُوْنَ الدِّيْنُ كُلُّهُ لِلّٰهِ ۚ فَاِنِ انْتَهَوْا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِيْرٌ

verses.english_text: And if they revert again, then remember Allah is your Master and Guardian, and He is the Best Master and Guardian and Helper.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ مَوْلٰكُمْ ۚ نِعْمَ الْمَوْلَٰى وَ نِعْمَ النَّصِيْرُ

verses.english_text: And know that whatever benefit you get, one-fifth of it is for Allah, Prophet, and his near ones of Prophet, orphans, poor and travelers who are in distress; if your faith is on Allah and that help which We had sent on Our servant on the day to decide between truth and falsehood, when two parties were quarreling among them, and Allah has power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اعْلَمُوا اَنَّمَا غَنِمْتُم مِّنْ شَيْءٍ فَاَنَّ لِلّٰهِ خُمُسَهُ وَ لِلرَّسُولِ وَ لِذِي الْقُرْبٰى وَ الْيَتٰمٰى وَ الْمَسٰكِيْنِ وَ ابْنِ السَّبِيْلِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ اٰمَنْتُم بِاللّٰهِ وَ مَآ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَٰى عَبْدِنَا يَوْمَ الْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعٰنِ وَ اللّٰهُ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ

verses.english_text: At the time you were nearer side of valley in battlefield, and those people were far away in battlefront, and caravan was on a slope from you, if you would have earlier left for fighting that you Verily would have done to the contrary, but Allah wanted to decide about the happenings, that whoever is killed might be killed by clear proof and whoever would live might live by clear proof, and Allah hear all and know the condition of hearts.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ اَنْتُم بِالْعُدْوَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَ هُم بِالْعُدْوَةِ الْقُصْوٰى وَ الرَّكْبُ اَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ ۚ وَ لَوْ تَوَاعَدتُّمْ لَاخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِي الْمِيْعٰدِ وَ لٰكِنْ لِّيَقْضِيَ اللّٰهُ اَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُوْلًا لِّيَهْلِكَ مَنْ هَلَكَ عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ وَّ يَحْيٰى مَنْ حَيَّ عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ وَ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَسَمِيْعٌ عَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: When Allah made them appear less in your eyes, if He would have shown you more in number in your eyes, then you might have become lazy and would have disputed among yourselves, but Allah saved you from this dispute; because He is aware about secrets of your hearts.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ يُرِيْكَهُمُ اللّٰهُ فِي مَنَامِكَ قَلِيْلًا وَ لَوْ اَرٰكَهُمْ كَثِيْرًا لَّفَشِلْتُمْ وَ لَتَنَازَعْتُمْ فِي الْاَمْرِ وَ لٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَلَّمَ اِنَّهُ عَلِيْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ

verses.english_text: And at the time of battle, Allah made enemies appear less in your eyes, and made you appear less in their eyes, so that matter might be decided which was bound to happen, and all the matters are to return to Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ يُرِيْكُمُوْهُمْ اِذِ الْتَقَيْتُمْ فِيٓ اَعْيُنِكُمْ قَلِيْلًا وَّ يُقَلِّلُكُمْ فِيٓ اَعْيُنِهِمْ لِيَقْضِيَ اللّٰهُ اَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُوْلًا وَ اِلَى اللّٰهِ تُرْجَعُ الْاُمُوْرُ

verses.english_text: And O Believers! whenever you may face any group, then face it with steadiness, and remember Allah in abundance, may be in this way you become successful.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ آمَنُوْا اِذَا لَقِيْتُمْ فِئَةً فَاثْبُتُوْا وَ اذْكُرُوْا اللّٰهَ كَثِيْرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And obey Allah and his Prophet and do not dispute among yourself lest you become weak and your strength is affected, and have patience, Allah is with those who have patience.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَطِيْعُوْا اللّٰهَ وَ رَسُولَهُ وَ لَا تَنَازَعُوا فَتَفْشَلُوْا وَ تَذْهَبَ رِيْحُكُمْ وَ اصْبِرُوْا ۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ مَعَ الصّٰبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And be not like those who comes out from their houses with pride to show the people; and continue stopping people from the path of Allah, Allah has encompassed their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ خَرَجُوا مِنْ دِيَارِهِم بَطَرًا وَّ رِئَآءَ النَّاسِ وَ يَصُدُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ ۚ وَ اللّٰهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُوْنَ مُحِيْطٌ

verses.english_text: And remember the time when Satan decorated their deeds for them, and said today no one can overpower you and I am your helper, and when both groups came face to face, he fled and said: I am free from you; and I am seeing that what you do not see, and I fear Allah, and He is severe punisher.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذْ زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطٰنُ اَعْمَالَهُمْ وَ قَالَ لَا غَالِبَ لَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَ اِنِّي جَارٌ لَّكُمْ فَلَمَّا تَرَآءَتِ الْفِئَتٰنِ نَكَصَ عَلَٰى عَقِبَيْهِ وَ قَالَ اِنِّي بَرِيْٓءٌ مِّنْكُمْ اِنِّي اَرٰى مَا لَا تَرَوْنَ اِنِّيْٓ اَخَافُ اللّٰهَ ۚ وَ اللّٰهُ شَدِيْدُ الْعِقَابِ

verses.english_text: When hypocrites who had deviation in their hearts were saying: their religion have deceived them, however those who believe on Allah, Allah is Predominant on everything and has great Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ يَقُوْلُ الْمُنٰفِقُوْنَ وَ الَّذِيْنَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ غَرَّ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ دِيْنُهُمْ وَ مَنْ يَّتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللّٰهِ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَزِيْزٌ حَكِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Wish you could see, when angels were taking their souls, they were smiting on their face and back (and saying) now taste (the punishment of) Hell.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ تَرٰٓى اِذْ يَتَوَفَّى الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ يَضْرِبُوْنَ وُجُوْهَهُمْ وَ اَدْبَارَهُمْ وَ ذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيْقِ

verses.english_text: This is because the reward for your earlier deeds is this only, and Allah will not be unjust to His servants.
verses.arabic_text: ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ اَيْدِيْكُمْ وَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِيْدِ

verses.english_text: That condition was of people of Firaun and people earlier than them that they denied verses of Allah; so, Allah seized them of their sins, and Allah is Strong and giver of severe punishment.
verses.arabic_text: كَدَاْبِ اٰلِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَفَرُوْا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِذُنُوْبِهِمْ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيْدُ الْعِقَابِ

verses.english_text: This is because Allah does not change the favor shown on any people until they create the change themselves.
verses.arabic_text: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًا نِّعْمَةً اَنْعَمَهَا عَلَٰى قَوْمٍ حَتّٰى يُغَيِّرُوْا مَا بِاَنفُسِهِمْ وَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ سَمِيْعٌ عَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: As were the consequences of people of Firaun, and people earlier than them, they denied verses of the Lord, then We destroyed them on account of their sins, and drowned the people of Firaun, and all of them were unjust.
verses.arabic_text: كَدَاْبِ اٰلِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ فَاَهْلَكْنٰهُم بِذُنُوبِْهِمْ وَ اَغْرَقْنَا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ وَ كُلٌّ كَانُوا ظٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Worst people walking on the earth are those who adopted infidelity and now they will not believe.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَآبِّ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Those who made covenant with you and they break their covenant every time, and they do not fear Allah.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ عٰهَدتَّ مِنْهُمْ ثُمَّ يَنْقُضُوْنَ عَهْدَهُمْ فِيْ كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ وَ هُمْ لَا يَتَّقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And in war if they come into your possession, then exile them and their supporters, so they may take lessons.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِيْ الْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِم مَّنْ خَلْفَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And if you fear treachery of covenant and betrayal from the people of any tribe then throw their covenants towards them, Allah does not like the people who betray.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِنْ قَوْمٍ خِيَانَةً فَانْبِذْ اِلَيْهِمْ عَلَٰى سَوَآءٍ ۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْخَآئِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And infidels should not feel that they have gone ahead; they can never humble the Muslims.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا سَبَقُوْا ۚ اِنَّهُمْ لَا يُعْجِزُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And to face them collect your possible strength and arrange line of horses, and with that frighten the enemies of Allah, your enemy, and to those (enemy) whom you do not know but Allah know them; and whatever you will spend in the way of Allah will be fully compensated and no unjust will be done to you.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَعِدُّوْا لَهُم مَّا اسْتَطَعْتُم مِّنْ قُوَّةٍ وَ مِنْ رِّبَاطِ الْخَيْلِ تُرْهِبُوْنَ بِهِ عَدُوَّ اللّٰهِ وَ عَدُوَّكُمْ وَ اٰخَرِيْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهِمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَهُمُ اللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُهُمْ ۚ وَ مَا تُنْفِقُوا مِنْ شَيْءٍ فِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ يُوَفَّ اِلَيْكُمْ وَ اَنْتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And if they incline towards peace then you too bend, and trust in Allah, He Hears all and Know (everything).
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنْ جَنَحُوْا لِلسَّلْمِ فَاجْنَحْ لَهَا وَ تَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللّٰهِ ۚ اِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ

verses.english_text: And if they wish to deceive you then Allah is enough for you, He verified you, through His help and through the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنْ يُرِيْدُوا اَنْ يَخْدَعُوْكَ فَاِنَّ حَسْبَكَ اللّٰهُ ۚ هُوَ الَّذِيْٓ اَيَّدَكَ بِنَصْرِهِ وَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And he has created love in their hearts, even if you had spent the entire world, you could not have created such mutual love, but Allah has created this love, and He is Predominant over everything and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوْبِهِمْ ۚ لَوْ اَنْفَقْتَ مَا فِي الْاَرْضِ جَمِيْعًا مَّا اَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَ لٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ اَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ اِنَّهُ عَزِيْزٌ حَكِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet! For you enough is Allah and those believers who follow you.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَسْبُكَ اللّٰهُ وَ مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Prepare the believers for war, even if you might get twenty persons who have patience, then they will dominate two hundred, and if they will be (one) hundred they will dominate (one) thousand infidels, because infidels are not sensible people.
verses.arabic_text: يَٰاَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَرِّضِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ عَلَى الْقِتَالِ ۚ اِنْ يَّكُنْ مِّنْكُمْ عِشْرُوْنَ صٰبِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوْا مِائَتَيْنِ ۚ وَ اِنْ يَّكُنْ مِّنْكُم مِّائَةٌ يَّغْلِبُوْٓا اَلْفًا مِّنَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِاَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Now Allah has lightened your burden, He saw that there is weakness among you (people), so if you are one hundred and have patience, you will dominate over two hundred, and if you will be one thousand then you will dominate over two thousand by the command of Allah, and Allah is with those who have patience.
verses.arabic_text: اَلْئٰنَ خَفَّفَ اللّٰهُ عَنْكُمْ وَ عَلِمَ اَنَّ فِيْكُمْ ضَعْفًا فَاِنْ يَّكُنْ مِّنْكُم مِّائَةٌ صَابِرَةٌ يَغْلِبُوْاْ مِائَتَيْنِ ۚ وَ اِنْ يَّكُنْ مِّنْكُمْ اَلْفٌ يَّغْلِبُوْآ اَلْفَيْنِ بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ ۗ وَ اللّٰهُ مَعَ الصّٰبِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: No prophet is allowed to take prisoner until he faces difficulties of fighting on the earth; you people wish only for the wealth of this world whereas Allah wishes for the Hereafter (for you) and only He is having Honor and Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: مَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ لَهُٓ اَسْرٰى حَتّٰى يُثْخِنَ فِىْ الْاَرْضِ ۚ تُرِيْدُوْنَ عَرَضَ الدُّنْيَا وَ اللّٰهُ يُرِيدُ الْاٰخِرَةَ ۗ وَ اللّٰهُ عَزِيْزٌ حَكِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Had it not been the previous decision of Allah; so, because of the ransom you have taken, His punishment would have reached you.
verses.arabic_text: لَّوْلَا كِتٰبٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيْمَآ اَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: So now you can consume whatever war-booty you have got since it is lawful and pure, and adopt to the piety of Allah, and Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: فَكُلُوْاْ مِمَّا غَنِمْتُمْ حَلٰلًا طَيِّبًا ۚ وَّ اتَّقُوْاْ اللّٰهَ ۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Say to the captives of your hand: If Allah will see goodness in your hearts, then whatever wealth has been taken from you, Allah will bestow upon you seventy-fold goodness and will forgive you, because He is very forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ قُل لِّمَنْ فِىْٓ اَيْدِيْكُم مِّنَ الْاَسْرٰٓى اِنْ يَّعْلَمِ اللّٰهُ فِىْ قُلُوْبِكُمْ خَيْرًا يُؤْتِكُمْ خَيْرًا مِّمَّآ اُخِذَ مِنْكُمْ وَ يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۗ وَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: And now if they wish to betray you, so before this they have betrayed Allah; thereafter Allah granted power over them (to you), Allah Knows everything and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: ْوَ اِن يُّرِيْدُوْاْ خِيَانَتَكَ فَقَدْ خَانُوْاْ اللّٰهَ مِن قَبْلُ فَاَمْكَنَ مِنْهُمْ ۗ وَ اللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌ حَكِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: Verily, those who believe and they migrated and they fought with their life and wealth in the way of Allah, and those who sheltered and helped, these are all friends of each other, and those who believed but did not migrate, you are free from their guardianship unless they migrate; and if they seek your help in religious matters, then it is imperative on you to help them; except against those people, between you and them there is a treaty; and Allah sees your deeds well.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْاْ وَ هَاجَرُوْاْ وَ جٰهَدُوْاْ بِاَمْوَالِهِمْ وَ اَنْفُسِهِمْ فِىْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ وَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰوَوْاْ وَّ نَصَرُوٓاْ اُوْلٰٓئِكَ بَعْضُهُمْ اَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ وَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُواْ وَ لَمْ يُهَاجِرُوْاْ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ وَّ لَا يَتِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ حَتّٰى يُهَاجِرُواْ ۚ وَ اِنِ اسْتَنْصَرُوْكُمْ فِى الدِّيْنِ فَعَلَيْكُمُ النَّصْرُ اِلَّا عَلَٰى قَوْمٍ بَيْنَكُمْ وَ بَيْنَهُمْ مِّيْثَاقٌ ۗ وَ اللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِيْرٌ

verses.english_text: These unbelievers are helpers of one another, and if you will not help the believers; then there shall be in the land persecution and great mischief.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْاْ بَعْضُهُمْ اَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ اِلَّا تَفْعَلُوْهُ تَكُنْ فِتْنَةٌ فِىْ الْاَرْضِ وَ فَسَادٌ كَبِيْرٌ

verses.english_text: And those who are believers, migrated, fought in the way of Allah, sheltered, and helped, actually they are the real believers, and for them is forgiveness and honorable sustenance.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُواْ وَ هَاجَرُوْاْ وَ جَاهَدُوْاْ فِىْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ وَ الَّذِيْنَ اوَوّاْ وَّ نَصَرُوْٓاْ اُوْلٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ حَقًّا ۚ لَّهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَّ رِزْقٌ كَرِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: And those who believed later and migrated and fought alongside you, they are from among you, and they are near ones of the Book of Allah, and have more priority and nearness over one another; Verily Allah is the Best Knower of everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْاْ مِنْ بَعْدُ وَ هَاجَرُوْاْ وَ جَاهَدُوْاْ مَعَكُمْ فَاُوْلٰٓئِكَ مِنْكُمْ ۚ وَ اُوْلُوْاْ الْاَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ اَوْلَٰى بِبَعْضٍ فِى كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ ۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: O Muslims! Whatever covenants and treaties you had entered with the polytheists, Allah and His Prophet are declaring their disassociation with them.
verses.arabic_text: بَرَآءَةٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَ رَسُولِهِٓ اِلَى الَّذِيْنَ عٰهَدتُّم مِّنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ

verses.english_text: So, O Infidels! You can roam around freely on the earth for four months, and remember you cannot save yourself from Allah, and Allah will disgrace infidels.
verses.arabic_text: فَسِيحُوا فِيْ الْاَرْضِ اَرْبَعَةَ اَشْهُرٍ وَّ اعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِى اللّٰهِ وَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ مُخْزِى الْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: It is a general announcement on the day of Great Hajj that Allah and His Prophet are disassociated from the polytheists, but if you repent it will be better for you, and if you will deviate then remember you cannot humble Allah, and O Prophet, give good news of painful punishment to the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَذَانٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَ رَسُولِهِٓ اِلَى النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْحَجِّ الْاَكْبَرِ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ بَرِىْٓءٌ مِّنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ وَ رَسُولُهُ ۚ فَاِنْ تُبْتُمْ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ وَ اِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَاعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِى اللّٰهِ وَ بَشِّرِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ

verses.english_text: Except for those people with whom, O Muslims, you have made covenant, and they have not shown any sloth, and have not helped each other against you, so instead of four months, complete your covenant until end of the term, that Allah likes those, who adapt to piousness.
verses.arabic_text: الَّا الَّذِينَ عٰهَدْتُّم مِّنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْقُصُوْكُمْ شَيْئًا وَّ لَمْ يُظَاهِرُوْاْ عَلَيْكُمْ اَحَدًا فَاَتِمُّوْٓاْ الَيْهِمْ عَهْدَهُمْ الَٰى مُدَّتِهِمْ ۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: So, when the sacred months passed by, kill infidels wherever you find them, and take them captive and sit on every road and stop them, but if they repent and establish prayers and give poor rate; then leave their way, Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا انْسَلَخَ الْاَشْهُرُ الْحُرُمُ فَاقْتُلُوْاْ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ حَيْثُ وَ جَدْتُّمُوْهُمْ وَ خُذُوْهُمْ وَ احْصُرُوْهُمْ وَ اقْعُدُواْ لَهُمْ كُلَّ مَرْصَدٖۚ فَاِنْ تَابُوْاْ وَ اَقَامُواْ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَ اٰتَوُاْ الزَّكٰوةَ فَخَلُّوْاْ سَبِيْلَهُمْ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: And if polytheists seek protection from you, give them, so that they listen to the Book of Allah and then reach them to their place of refuge, this concession is because these ignorant people are not aware of truth.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنْ اَحَدٌ مِّنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ اسْتَجَارَكَ فَاَجِرْهُ حَتّٰى يَسْمَعَ كَلٰمَ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ اَبْلِغْهُ مَاْمَنَهُ ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: How can the covenants of treaty-breaker unbelievers may remain good with Allah and His Prophet, but if you have taken a covenant from anyone near Sacred Mosque, and if they remain on it, you also remain on your covenant, and Allah likes those who are pious, and guards themselves against sins.
verses.arabic_text: كَيْفَ يَكُوْنُ لِلْمُشْرِكِيْنَ عَهْدٌ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ وَ عِنْدَ رَسُولِهِ اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ عٰهَدتُّمْ عِنْدَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ  فَمَا اسْتَقَامُوْاْ لَكُمْ فَاسْتَقِيْمُوْاْ لَهُمْ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: How can be any concession given to them that if they will overpower you, they will neither have any consideration for your neighborhood, and nearness and nor they will honor any covenant; they are just pleasing you with their talk otherwise their hearts are Verily denying; and most of them are transgressors and treaty-breakers.
verses.arabic_text: كَيْفَ وَ اِنْ يَظْهَرُوْاْ عَلَيْكُمْ لَا يَرْقُبُوْاْ فِيْكُمْ اِلّاً وَّ لَا ذِمَّةً  يُرْضُوْنَكُم بِاَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَ تَاْبٰى قُلُوْبُهُمْ وَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ فٰسِقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: They have taken a small benefit in exchange of the verses of Allah, now they are hindering people from the way of Allah, they are doing very evil work.
verses.arabic_text: اِشْتَرَوْاْ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيْلًا فَصَدُّوْاْ عَنْ سَبِيْلِهِ اِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: They do not respect the nearness, word and treaty of any believer, these are those who just exceed.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يَرْقُبُوْنَ فِىْ مُؤْمِنٍ اِلًّا وَّ لَا ذِمَّةٌ  وَ اُوْلٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُعْتَدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Even then, if they repent, establish prayer, and give poor-rate, then they are your brethren in religion, and We describe our verses in detail for the knowledgeable persons.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِن تَابُوا وَ اَقَامُوْا الصَّلٰوةَ وَ آتَوُا الزَّكٰوةَ فَاِخْوَانُكُمْ فِى الدِّيْنِ وَ نُفَصِّلُ الْاٰيٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And if they break their oaths after treaty and use taunts in the religion, then fight openly with leaders of infidelity, there is not any trust in their oaths, they might desist from their deeds in this way.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِن نَّكَثُوا اَيْمَانَهُم مِّنْ بَعْدِ عَهْدِهِمْ وَ طَعَنُوْا فِى دِيْنِكُمْ فَقَاتِلُوٓا اَئِمَّةَ الْكُفْرِ اِنَّهُمْ لَا اَيْمَانَ لَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَنْتَهُونَ

verses.english_text: Will not you fight with the people, who had broken their covenant and treaty, and they have also decided to expel the Prophet, and they attacked you first, are you afraid from them; then Allah is more deserving that you create His fear (in your hearts); if you are believer.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَا تُقَاتِلُونَ قَوْمًا نَّكَثُوٓا اَيْمَانَهُمْ وَ هَمُّوْا بِاِخْرَاجِ الرَّسُوْلِ وَ هُم بَدَءُوْكُمْ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ اَتَخْشَوْنَهُمْ فَاللّٰهُ اَحَقُّ اَنْ تَخْشَوْهُ اِنْ كُنْتُم مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Fight with them, Allah will punish them through your hands and will disgrace them, and will give you victory over them, and will comfort hearts of the believers.
verses.arabic_text: قَاتِلُوْهُمْ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِاَيْدِيْكُمْ وَ يُخْزِهِمْ وَ يَنْصُرْكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ يَشْفِ صُدُوْرَ قَوْمٍ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ

verses.english_text: And will calm the anger of their hearts, and Allah accepts repentance of whom He pleases; and He has Knowledge and Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَ يُذْهِبْ غَيْظَ قُلُوْبِهِمْ وَ يَتُوْبُ اللّٰهُ عَلَٰى مَنْ يَّشَاءُ وَ اللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌ حَكِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: And do you think you will be left like this, whereas Allah has not observed yet that who among you are the strugglers in the way of Allah, and they have not befriended anybody leaving Allah and His Prophet and the believers; and Allah is well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ اَنْ تُتْرَكُوا وَ لَمَّا يَعْلَمِ اللّٰهُ الَّذِينَ جٰهَدُوا مِنْكُمْ وَ لَمْ يَتَّخِذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ وَ لَا رَسُولِهِ وَ لَا الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ لِيْجَةً وَ اللّٰهُ خَبِيْرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ

verses.english_text: This is not the job of polytheists that they would populate the mosques of Allah, whereas they themselves are witness of infidelity of their own souls, their deeds are a waste, and they will abide in Hell forever.
verses.arabic_text: مَا كَانَ لِلْمُشْرِكِيْنَ اَنْ يَّعْمُرُوْا مَسٰجِدَ اللّٰهِ شٰهِدِيْنَ عَلَىٰٓ اَنْفُسِهِم بِالْكُفْرِ ۚ اُولٰئِكَ حَبِطَتْ اَعْمَالُهُمْ وَ فِى النَّارِ هُمْ خٰلِدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Mosques of Allah are populated by those who believe in Allah and on the Day of Judgement; and who established prayer and gave poor-rate, and did not fear anybody except Allah, these are the people who will be counted among the guided ones.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا يَعْمُرُ مَسٰجِدَ اللّٰهِ مَنْ اٰمَنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَ الْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَ اَقَامَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَ اٰتَى الزَّكٰوةَ وَ لَمْ يَخْشَ اِلَّا اللّٰهَ فَعَسٰٓى اُوْلٰٓئِكَ اَنْ يَّكُوْنُوْا مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Do you make giver of water to pilgrims, and population of Sacred Mosque equal in status with those who have faith on Allah and on the Day of Judgement, and struggle hard in the way of Allah; no, Allah does not consider them both equal, and Allah never guides the unjust people.
verses.arabic_text: اَجَعَلْتُمْ سِقَايَةَ الْحَآجِّ وَ عِمَارَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ كَمَنْ اٰمَنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَ الْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَ جٰهَدَُ فِى سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ لَا يَسْتَوُوْنَ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ وَ اللّٰهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Verily who believed and migrated and struggled hard with their life and wealth in the way of Allah; they have great status near Allah, and in fact they are successful.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِيْنَ آمَنُوْا وَ هَاجَرُوْا وَ جٰهَدُوْا فِى سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ بِاَمْوَالِهِمْ وَ اَنْفُسِهِمْ اَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ ۚ وَ اُوْلٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْفَائِزُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Allah is giving glad tidings of Mercy, approval, and gardens to them; where there will be perpetual pleasures for them.
verses.arabic_text: يُبَشِّرُهُمْ رَبُّهُم بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنْهُ وَ رِضْوَانٍ وَّ جَنّٰتٍ لَّهُمْ فِيْهَا نَعِيْمٌ مُّقِيمٌ

verses.english_text: They will always remain in those gardens because there is great reward with Allah.
verses.arabic_text: خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا اَبَدًا اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عِنْدَهُ اَجْرٌ عَظِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: O believers! Do not befriend your father, grandfather and brothers if they like infidelity against faith, and who will keep them befriended, these people will be counted among the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ آمَنُوْا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا آبَآءَكُمْ وَ اِخْوَانَكُمْ اَوْلِيَآءَ اِنِ اسْتَحَبُّوا الْكُفْرَ عَلَى الْاِيْمَانِ ۚ وَ مَنْ يَّتَوَلَّهُم مِّنْكُمْ فَاُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Say: If your fathers, children, brothers, spouses, your relatives, the wealth which you have collected, and loss in business you fear, and houses you like; are more important in your eyes than Allah, His Prophet and struggling hard in the way of Allah, then wait till the command of Allah comes, and Allah does not guide the people who are unjust.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنْ كَانَ آبَاؤُكُمْ وَ اَبْنَاؤُكُمْ وَ اِخْوَانُكُمْ وَ اَزْوَاجُكُمْ وَ عَشِيْرَتُكُمْ وَ اَمْوَالٌ اقْتَرَفْتُمُوْهَا وَ تِجَارَةٌ تَخْشَوْنَ كَسَادَهَا وَ مَسٰكِنُ تَرْضَوْنَهَآ اَحَبَّ اِلَيْكُم مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَ رَسُولِهِ وَ جِهَادٍ فِىْ سَبِيْلِهِ فَتَرَبَّصُوْا حَتّٰى يَاْتِيَ اللّٰهُ بِاَمْرِهِ وَ اللّٰهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفٰسِقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Verily, Allah helped you on a lot number of places; and on the day of (battle of) Hunain when you were feeling pride on your numbers, but it didn't benefit you, and earth even with all its spaciousness became strait for you, then you showed your back and fled.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللّٰهُ فِى مَوَاطِنَ كَثِيرَةٍ ۙ وَّ يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ اِذْ اَعْجَبَتْكُمْ كَثْرَتُكُمْ فَلَمْ تُغْنِ عَنْكُمْ شَيْئًا وَ ضَاقَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْاَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ ثُمَّ وَ لَّيْتُم مُّدْبِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Then after this, Allah sent down his tranquility on His Prophet and on believers, and send the armies which you did not see, and sent punishment on those who adopted infidelity, and this is the reward and result for infidels.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَٰى رَسُولِهِ وَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ اَنْزَلَ جُنُوْدًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا وَ عَذَّبَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا ۚ وَ ذٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: After that, Allah will accept the repentance of whoever he pleases, He is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ يَتُوْبُ اللّٰهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ عَلَٰى مَنْ يَّشَاءُ وَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيمٌ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Polytheists are totally impure, so beware, they should not enter the Sacred Mosque after this year, and if you fear poverty, then Allah will shortly enrich you with his Grace and Mercy, He has Knowledge and Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا اِنَّمَا الْمُشْرِكُوْنَ نَجَسٌ فَلَا يَقْرَبُوْا الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ بَعْدَ عَامِهِمْ هٰذَا ۚ وَ اِنْ خِفْتُمْ عَيْلَةً فَسَوْفَ يُغْنِيْكُمُ اللّٰهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ اِنْ شَاءَ ۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيْمٌ حَكِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: And struggle hard against those who do not have faith, on Allah and on the Day of Judgement, and whatever have been made unlawful by Allah and His Prophet do not consider it unlawful, and in spite of being people of Book they do not follow the truthful religion; and with their own hands they agree to pay ‘jizya’ to you with disgrace.
verses.arabic_text: قَاتِلُوا الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللّٰهِ وَ لَا بِالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَ لَا يُحَرِّمُوْنَ مَا حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ وَ لَا يَدِيْنُوْنَ دِيْنَ الْحَقِّ مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوْا الْكِتٰبَ حَتّٰى يُعْطُوْا الْجِزْيَةَ عَنْ يَّدٍ وَ هُمْ صٰغِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And Jews say that Uzair is son of Allah and Christians say Maseeh is son of Allah, these are their verbal talks, this is similar to the talk which infidels used to say, may Allah slay them all, where are they heading?
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ عُزَيْرٌ ابْنُ اللّٰهِ وَ قَالَتِ النَّصٰرَى الْمَسِيْحُ ابْنُ اللّٰهِ ذٰلِكَ قَوْلُهُم بِاَفْوَاهِهِمْ يُضَاهِئُوْنَ قَوْلَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ ۚ قٰتَلَهُمُ اللّٰهُ ۚ اَنّٰى يُؤْفَكُونَ

verses.english_text: They have adopted their monks and Rabbis as their Lord, leaving Allah and Maseeh son of Maryam, whereas they were ordained to worship one and only Allah, there is no Lord except Allah, He is Alone and Self-Sufficient; and He is clean and pure from thinking of the polytheists.
verses.arabic_text: اتَّخَذُوْا اَحْبارَهُمْ وَ رُهْبَانَهُمْ اَرْبَابًا مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ وَ الْمَسِيْحَ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَ مَا اُمِرُوْا اِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوْٓا اِلٰهًا وَّاحِدًا لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ۚ سُبْحٰنَهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ

verses.english_text: They wish to extinguish the Light of Allah from their mouth by blowing, and Allah will not consent until He perfect his Light, no matter how much the infidels dislike it.
verses.arabic_text: يُرِيدُونَ اَنْ يُّطْفِؤُا نُوْرَ اللّٰهِ بِاَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَ يَاْبَى اللّٰهُ اِلَّآ اَنْ يُّتِمَّ نُوْرَهُ وَ لَوْ كَرِهَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: This is that Allah who sent His Prophet with guidance and truthful religion, to make His religion dominate over all religions, no matter how much the infidels dislike it.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِىٓ اَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدٰى وَ دِيْنِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ وَ لَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Many monks and rabbis illegitimately eat up the wealth of many persons, and they stop people from the way of Allah, and those who hoard gold and silver and do not spend in the way of Allah, O Prophet, give them the good news of painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوا اِنَّ كَثِيْرًا مِّنَ الْاَحْبَارِ وَالرُّهْبَانِ لَيَاْكُلُوْنَ اَمْوَالَ النَّاسِ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَ يَصُدُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ وَ الَّذِيْنَ يَكْنِزُوْنَ الذَّهَبَ وَ الْفِضَّةَ وَ لَا يُنْفِقُوْنَهَا فِىْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ

verses.english_text: The day when that gold and silver melted in hellfire and they will be branded on their foreheads and on their waists with it, that this is the treasure which you used to hoard, now taste your treasures and hoardings.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يُحْمٰى عَلَيْهَا فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ فَتُكْوٰى بِهَا جِبَاهُهُمْ وَ جُنُوْبُهُمْ وَ ظُهُوْرُهُمْ هٰذَا مَا كَنَزْتُمْ لِاَنفُسِكُمْ فَذُوْقُوْا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْنِزُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Verily, numbers of months near Allah in His Book are twelve, from the day he has created skies and the earth, among them four months are sacred, this is the straight and strong religion, so beware do not be unjust to yourselves in these months, and fight the polytheists in same way as they fight with you; and remember Allah is only with pious people.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ عِدَّةَ الشُّهُوْرِ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ اثْنَا عَشَرَ شَهْرًا فِى كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ مِنْهَا اَرْبَعَةٌ حُرُمٌ ۚ ذٰلِكَ الدِّيْنُ الْقَيِّمُ ۚ فَلَا تَظْلِمُوْا فِيْهِنَّ اَنْفُسَكُمْ ۚ وَ قَاتِلُوْا الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ كَآفَّةً كَمَا يُقَاتِلُوْنَكُمْ كَآفَّةً ۚ وَ اعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ مَعَ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Transposition of sacred months is a kind of addition in unbelief, through which infidels are misguided, one year they make it lawful and another year they make it unlawful, so it becomes equal to what Allah has made unlawful; and also Allah's unlawful is made lawful; and their worst doings have been decorated for their eyes, and Allah does not guide the unbelieving people.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا النَّسِيءُ زِيَادَةٌ فِىْ الْكُفْرِ يُضَلُّ بِهِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا يُحِلُّوْنَهُ عَامًا وَّ يُحَرِّمُوْنَهُ عَامًا لِيُوَاطِئُوْا عِدَّةَ مَا حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ فَيُحِلُّوْا مَا حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ ۚ زُيِّنَ لَهُمْ سُوْٓءُ اَعْمَالِهِمْ وَاللّٰهُ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: O Believers! What has happened to you, when you were told to come out and fight in the way of Allah, you glued to the ground, are you satisfied with this worldly life in exchange of the Hereafter; then remember, in the Hereafter, provision of this worldly life is very little compared to actual reality of this world.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مَا لَكُمْ اِذَا قِيْلَ لَكُمُ انْفِرُوْا فِى سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ اثَّاقَلْتُمْ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ ۚ اَرَضِيْتُم بِالْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا مِنَ الْاٰخِرَةِ ۚ فَمَا مَتَاعُ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا فِى الْاٰخِرَةِ اِلَّا قَلِيْلٌ

verses.english_text: If you will not come out in the way of Allah, then Allah will grip you in painful punishment, and will bring other people in your place, and you cannot harm Him in any way, He has Power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا تَنْفِرُوا يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا اَلِيْمًا وَّ يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَ لَا تَضُرُّوْهُ شَيْئًا وَ اللّٰهُ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ

verses.english_text: If you will not help the Prophet, Allah have helped him when infidels expelled him, he left with one person and both were in a cave, he was saying to his friend: grieve not Allah is with us, then Allah bestowed tranquility upon his Prophet from Himself; and aided him with the armies which you could not see, and Allah made lowest the words of infidels, and words of Allah in fact are the highest, He is all Dominant and all Wise.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا تَنصُرُوهُ فَقَدْ نَصَرَهُ اللّٰهُ اِذْ اَخْرَجَهُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا ثَانِيَ اثْنَيْنِ اِذْ هُمَا فِى الْغَارِ اِذْ يَقُولُ لِصَاحِبِهِ لَا تَحْزَنْ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ مَعَنَا فَاَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ سَكِيْنَتَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اَيَّدَهُ بِجُنُوْدٍ لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا وَ جَعَلَ كَلِمَةَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا السُّفْلَٰى وَ كَلِمَةُ اللّٰهِ هِيَ الْعُلْيَا وَاللّٰهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيْمٌ

verses.english_text: O Muslims! Whether you are light or heavy, come out of your homes and fight in the way of Allah with your life and property, this is better for you; if you know anything.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْفِرُوْا خِفَافًا وَّ ثِقَالًا وَّ جَاهِدُوْا بِاَمْوَالِكُمْ وَ اَنْفُسِكُمْ فِى سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ ذٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! If there is a short advantage or easy journey, they would Verily follow you, but long journey becomes difficult for them, and shortly they will swear on Allah and say that if we had been able, we would Verily have come with you, they are destroying their souls, and Allah knows well that they are lying.
verses.arabic_text: لَوْ كَانَ عَرَضًا قَرِيْبًا وَ سَفَرًا قَاصِدًا لَّاتَّبَعُوْكَ وَ لٰكِنْ بَعُدَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الشُّقَّةُ وَ سَيَحْلِفُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ لَوِ اسْتَطَعْنَا لَخَرَجْنَا مَعَكُمْ يُهْلِكُوْنَ اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَ اللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ اِنَّهُمْ لَكٰذِبُوْنَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Allah acquitted you, why did you allow them to stay back, without verifying who is truthful and who is a liar.
verses.arabic_text: عَفَا اللّٰهُ عَنْكَ لِمَ اَذِنْتَ لَهُمْ حَتّٰى يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكَ الَّذِيْنَ صَدَقُوْا وَ تَعْلَمَ الْكٰذِبِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Those who believe in Allah and the Day of Judgement, they will never seek permission in opposition to fight in the way of Allah with their lives and wealth, Allah knows the pious people very well.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يَسْتَاْذِنُكَ الَّذِيْنَ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَ الْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ اَنْ يُّجَاهِدُوْا بِاَمْوَالِهِمْ وَ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ اللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌ بِالْمُتَّقِيْنَ

verses.english_text: This permission may be sought by those who have no belief in Allah and the Day of Judgement, there is doubt in their hearts, and they are struck in their doubt.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا يَسْتَاْذِنُكَ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَ الْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَ ارْتَابَتْ قُلُوْبُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىْ رَيْبِهِمْ يَتَرَدَّدُوْنَ

verses.english_text: If they had intended to go, they would have made arrangements, but only Allah did not like their going, that's why Allah has weakened their thoughts, and now they were told to keep sitting with those who are sitting.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ اَرَادُوا الْخُرُوْجَ لَاَعَدُّوْا لَهُ عُدَّةً وَ لٰكِنْ كَرِهَ اللّٰهُ انْبِعَاثَهُمْ فَثَبَّطَهُمْ وَ قِيْلَ اقْعُدُوْا مَعَ الْقٰعِدِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Even if they had gone, they would have increased your fear, and they would be searching the dissention among you, and among you are the people who would have listened to them, and Allah knows well to the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: لَوْ خَرَجُوْا فِيْكُم مَّا زَادُوْكُمْ اِلَّا خَبَالًا وَ لَاَوْضَعُوْا خِلٰلَكُمْ يَبْغُوْنَكُمُ الْفِتْنَةَ وَ فِيْكُمْ سَمّٰعُوْنَ لَهُمْ وَ اللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌ بِالظّٰلِمِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Verily, earlier also they have tried to create mischief and wanted to disturb your affairs; until the truth came and command of Allah became manifest, whereas people were disliking it.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدِ ابْتَغَوُا الْفِتْنَةَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَ قَلَّبُوْا لَكَ الْاُمُوْرَ حَتّٰى جَآءَ الْحَقُّ وَ ظَهَرَ اَمْرُ اللّٰهِ وَ هُمْ كٰرِهُونَ

verses.english_text: And there are people who say: give us permission and do not put us in mischief, then know: they have already fallen into mischief, and Hell has encircled infidels from every side.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِنْهُمْ مَّنْ يَّقُوْلُ ائْذَنْ لِّى وَ لَا تَفْتِنِّى اَلَا فِى الْفِتْنَةِ سَقَطُوْا وَ اِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيْطَةٌ بِالْكٰفِرِيْنَ

verses.english_text: Their condition is such; that they feel bad if any good comes to you, but if any difficulty comes towards you they say: we had already arranged our affairs, and returned happily.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ تُصِبْكَ حَسَنَةٌ تَسُؤْهُمْ وَ اِنْ تُصِبْكَ مُصِيبَةٌ يَقُولُوْا قَدْ اَخَذْنَآ اَمْرَنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَ يَتَوَلَّوْا وَّ هُم فَرِحُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Say: Only those matters reach to us which have been written for us by Allah, He is our Master, and the believers trust in Him only.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لَّنْ يُّصِيْبَنَآ اِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللّٰهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلٰنَا  ۚ وَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Say: In whatever matter you are waiting for us, of the two one is good, we are (also) awaiting this in your matter, that Allah Himself or through us will afflict you with punishment, so now await the punishment, we are also awaiting with you.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ هَلْ تَرَبَّصُوْنَ بِنَآ اِلَّآ اِحْدَى الْحُسْنَيَيْنِ وَ نَحْنُ نَتَرَبَّصُ بِكُمْ اَنْ يُّصِيْبَكُمُ اللّٰهُ بِعَذَاب مِّنْ عِنْدِهِ اَوْ بِاَيْدِيْنَا  ۖ فَتَرَبَّصُوٓاْ اِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّتَرَبِّصُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Say: Whether you spend willingly or spend unwillingly, your action is not going to be accepted, because you are a people who are transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَنْفِقُوْاْ طَوْعًا اَوْ كَرْهًا لَّنْ يُّتَقَبَّلَ مِنْكُمْ اِنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا فٰسِقِينَ

verses.english_text: And non-acceptance of their alms is just because they have denied Allah and His Prophet, and they perform prayer with weariness and laziness, and spend (wealth) in the way of Allah, with distaste.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا مَنَعَهُمْ اَنْ تُقْبَلَ مِنْهُمْ نَفَقٰتُهُمْ اِلَّآ اَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوْاْ بِاللّٰهِ وَ بِرَسُوْلِهِ وَ لَا يَاْتُوْنَ الصَّلَوٰةَ اِلَّا وَ هُمْ كُسَالَٰى وَ لَا يُنْفِقُوْنَ اِلَّا وَ هُمْ كٰرِهُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Their wealth and children should not surprise you, this is the will of Allah to punish them through these in their life of this world and they will die as unbelievers.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا تُعْجِبْكَ اَمْوَالُهُمْ وَ لَآ اَوْلادُهُمْ اِنَّمَا يُرِيْدُ اللّٰهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُم بِهَا فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَ تَزْهَقَ اَنْفُسُهُمْ وَ هُمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And they swear that they are from among you, but they are not from you; they are cowards.
verses.arabic_text: وَ يَحْلِفُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ اِنَّهُمْ لَمِنْكُمْ وَ مَا هُمْ مِّنْكُمْ وَ لٰكِنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ يَّفْرَقُوْنَ

verses.english_text: If they will find refuge place, cave or any hiding place, they will hurriedly run towards it.
verses.arabic_text: لَوْ يَجِدُوْنَ مَلْجَاً اَوْ مَغٰرٰتٍ اَوْ مُدَّخَلًا لَّوَلَّوْاْ اِلَيْهِ وَ هُمْ يَجْمَحُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And they are also from those who blame regarding alms, that they will agree if they are given something; and will disagree if they are not given something.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِنْهُمْ مَّنْ يَّلْمِزُكَ فِى الصَّدَقٰتِ فَاِنْ اُعْطُوْاْ مِنْهَا رَضُوْاْ وَ اِنْ لَّمْ يُعْطَوْاْ مِنْهَآ اِذَا هُمْ يَسْخَطُوْنَ

verses.english_text: Although, We wish they had agreed on whatever was given by Allah and His Prophet and would have said: we are satisfied by what has been given to us by Allah; shortly, He and His Prophet will give us from their Mercy and Grace; and we only desire Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ اَنَّهُمْ رَضُوْاْ مَآ اٰتٰهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَ رَسُوْلُهُ وَ قَالُوْاْ حَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ سَيُؤْتِيْنَا اللّٰهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَ رَسُوْلُهُٓ اِنَّآ اِلَى اللّٰهِ رٰغِبُوْنَ
