verses.english_text: The example of unbeliever and believer is like: who are blind and deaf, and who are seeing and hearing, are they equal if they are compared? Then where is your consciousness?
verses.arabic_text: مَثَلُ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ كَالْاَعْمَىٰ وَ الْاَصَمِّ وَ الْبَصِيرِ وَ السَّمِيعِ ۚ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيٰنِ مَثَلًا ۚ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: And We sent Nooh to his people with the message; that I am a warner for you from open punishment of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا اِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ اِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

verses.english_text: And that beware you, do not worship anyone except Allah, and that I have the fear of a painful punishment for you.
verses.arabic_text: اَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا اِلَّا اللّٰهَ ۖ اِنِّي اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ اَلِيمٍ

verses.english_text: So elders of their people who adopted infidelity said, we have considered you a mortal like us; and we see your followers are simple and subjugated persons from among us, and we do not see your superiority over us; and we consider you a liar.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَالَ الْمَلَاُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن قَوْمِهِ مَا نَرَاكَ اِلَّا بَشَرًا مِّثْلَنَا وَ مَا نَرَاكَ اتَّبَعَكَ اِلَّا الَّذِينَ هُمْ اَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِيَ الرَّاْيِ وَ مَا نَرَىٰ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِن فَضْلٍ بَلْ نَظُنُّكُمْ كَاذِبِينَ

verses.english_text: He replied, O People, what do you think, if I am having an argument from my Lord; and He bestows mercy on me which you could not see, so, can I impose this on you in spite of your dislike?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اَرَاَيْتُمْ اِن كُنتُ عَلَٰى بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّي وَآتَانِي رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِهِ فَعُمِّيَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ اَنُلْزِمُكُمُوهَا وَاَنتُمْ لَهَا كَارِهُونَ

verses.english_text: O People! I do not want any wealth from you, my reward is with Allah, and I cannot separate the believers also because they are going to meet their Lord, although I consider you a people who are ignorant.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَا قَوْمِ لَا اَسْاَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مَالًا ۖ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلَى اللّٰهِ ۚ وَ مَا اَنَا بِطَارِدِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ۚ اِنَّهُم مُّلَاقُو رَبِّهِمْ وَلٰكِنِّي اَرَاكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ

verses.english_text: O People! If I will drive them away, then who will be my helper from Allah, don't you have senses.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَا قَوْمِ مَن يَنصُرُنِي مِنَ اللّٰهِ اِن طَرَدتُّهُمْ ۚ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: And I am not telling you that I have all the treasures of Allah, and neither I claim to know the unseen, nor I say, I am an angel, nor I say that Allah will not give good to them who are lower in your eyes, and only Allah knows their hearts well; if I will say this, I will be among the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا اَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِي خَزَائِنُ اللّٰهِ وَلَا اَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ وَلَا اَقُولُ اِنِّي مَلَكٌ وَلَا اَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزْدَرِي اَعْيُنُكُمْ لَن يُؤْتِيَهُمُ اللّٰهُ خَيْرًا ۖ اللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِي اَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ اِنِّي اِذًا لَّمِنَ الظّٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: They said O Nooh, you quarreled with us and you quarreled much, so now bring the thing what you have promised, if you are truthful in your promise.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا يَا نُوحُ قَدْ جَادَلْتَنَا فَاَكْثَرْتَ جِدَالَنَا فَاْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا اِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Nooh said: If Allah pleases, He will bring it and you cannot frustrate Him.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنَّمَا يَاْتِيكُم بِهِ اللّٰهُ اِن شَاءَ وَ مَا اَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ

verses.english_text: And even if I wish to advise you, my advice will not work for you, if Allah wishes to leave you in misguidance, and that is your Lord and to whom you have to return.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا يَنفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِي اِنْ اَرَدتُّ اَنْ اَنصَحَ لَكُمْ اِن كَانَ اللّٰهُ يُرِيدُ اَن يُغْوِيَكُمْ ۚ هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ وَاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: Do they say, He has forged, then say: if I have forged, its guilt is on me, and I am free and clear of your crimes.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرٰهُ ۖ قُلْ اِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَعَلَيَّ اِجْرَامِي وَاَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِّمَّا تُجْرِمُونَ

verses.english_text: It was revealed to Nooh, none from your people will believe now except for those who have already believed; so do not grieve on their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَاُوحِيَ اِلَىٰ نُوحٍ اَنَّهُ لَن يُؤْمِنَ مِن قَوْمِكَ اِلَّا مَن قَدْ آمَنَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Make an ark in front of Our Eyes under the guidance of Our revelation, and do not talk to Us regarding unjust people, they are all going to be drowned.
verses.arabic_text: وَاصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِاَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا ۚ اِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ

verses.english_text: When Nooh was making the ark, whenever any party from his people passed from there they used to ridicule him, Nooh said: if you are ridiculing us today then tomorrow likewise we will ridicule you also.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَصْنَعُ الْفُلْكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَاٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِ سَخِرُوا مِنْهُ ۚ قَالَ اِن تَسْخَرُوا مِنَّا فَاِنَّا نَسْخَرُ مِنكُمْ كَمَا تَسْخَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then shortly you will come to know that on whom punishment comes he becomes disgraced, and then punishment will be lasting one.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَاْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ

verses.english_text: So much so when Our command came and water started gushing out from the oven ; We told Nooh to take two of every kind, a pair, and also take your family, except those against whom destruction has been decided, and also take the believers with you; and believers were a few.
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰ اِذَا جَاءَ اَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ قُلْنَا احْمِلْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَاَهْلَكَ اِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ وَمَنْ آمَنَ ۚ وَ مَا آمَنَ مَعَهُ اِلَّا قَلِيلٌ

verses.english_text: Nooh said: now all of you board the ark, it will sail with the Name of Allah and it will also be anchoring, and Verily my Lord is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ ارْكَبُوا فِيهَا بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا ۚ اِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

verses.english_text: And Ark was sailing carrying them in the waves like mountain, Nooh called out to his son who was on a separate place: O my son, board the Ark with us and do not be among the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: وَهِيَ تَجْرِي بِهِمْ فِي مَوْجٍ كَالْجِبَالِ وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ ابْنَهُ وَكَانَ فِي مَعْزِلٍ يَا بُنَيَّ ارْكَب مَّعَنَا وَلَا تَكُن مَّعَ الْكٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: He (Nooh's son) said I will take shelter on mountain, which will save me from water, Nooh said: today nobody can be saved from the command of Allah, except on whom Allah shows His Mercy; then a wave came in between (and separated both of) them; and he became among the drowning ones.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ سَآوِي اِلَىٰ جَبَلٍ يَعْصِمُنِي مِنَ الْمَاءِ ۚ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ اَمْرِ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ۚ وَحَالَ بَيْنَهُمَا الْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُغْرَقِينَ

verses.english_text: And the command of Allah came that earth may swallow the water and sky may stop its water, then water receded and mission was completed, Ark rested on the Mountain of Judi, and came the sound that destruction is for the unjust nation.
verses.arabic_text: وَقِيلَ يَا اَرْضُ ابْلَعِي مَاءَكِ وَيَا سَمَاءُ اَقْلِعِي وَغِيضَ الْمَاءُ وَقُضِيَ الْاَمْرُ وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And Nooh cried out O my Lord, my son is from me, and Your promise truth, and You are the best decider.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ رَّبَّهُ فَقَالَ رَبِّ اِنَّ ابْنِي مِنْ اَهْلِي وَ اِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ وَاَنتَ اَحْكَمُ الْحَاكِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Came the reply: Nooh he is not from your family, his conduct is unrighteous; so do not ask from Me of which you do not have any knowledge, I give you counsel lest you may not be counted among ignorant.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يَا نُوحُ اِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ اَهْلِكَ ۖ اِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ ۖ فَلَا تَسْاَلْنِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۖ اِنِّي اَعِظُكَ اَن تَكُونَ مِنَ الْجَاهِلِينَ

verses.english_text: Nooh said, O Allah, I seek your refuge from seeking something of which I do not have any knowledge, and if You will not forgive me and do not show Mercy, then I will be among the losers.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّي اَعُوذُ بِكَ اَنْ اَسْاَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۖ وَاِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي اَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Said (Allah): Nooh, with peace and mercy from Us get down from the Ark, and blessings are on your people, and there are some nations whom We will give rest first, and then painful punishment will afflict them.
verses.arabic_text: قِيلَ يَا نُوحُ اهْبِطْ بِسَلَامٍ مِّنَّا وَبَرَكَاتٍ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَٰى اُمَمٍ مِّمَّن مَّعَكَ ۚ وَاُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! These are news of the unseen, which We reveal to you; whose knowledge neither you had nor your people; so now have patience, outcome is in the hands of pious people.
verses.arabic_text: تِلْكَ مِنْ اَنبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهَا اِلَيْكَ ۖ مَا كُنتَ تَعْلَمُهَا اَنتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِن قَبْلِ هٰذَا ۖ فَاصْبِرْ ۖ اِنَّ الْعَاقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

verses.english_text: And We sent to the people of Aad, his brother Hood, he said O People, worship Allah, there is no god except Him, you people are only slanderers.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِلَىٰ عَادٍ اَخَاهُمْ هُودًا ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ اِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ اِنْ اَنتُمْ اِلَّا مُفْتَرُونَ

verses.english_text: O my people! I do not ask you any price for this, my reward is with Him, Who have created me, so do you not then understand.
verses.arabic_text: يَا قَوْمِ لَا اَسْاَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ اَجْرًا ۖ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلَى الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي ۚ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: And O my people! Pray for forgiveness from your Lord, then repent in His Court then He will send heavy downpour from the sky, and will increase in your strength, and don't turn away from Him like guilty.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَا قَوْمِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا اِلَيْهِ يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا وَيَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً اِلَىٰ قُوَّتِكُمْ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوْا مُجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Those people said: You have not brought any proof, and we are not going to desert our gods on your saying and neither we are going to believe you.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا يَا هُودُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِي آلِهَتِنَا عَن قَوْلِكَ وَ مَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: We are only saying that one of our gods has made you insane, Hood said: Verily, I take Allah as witness and you also be my witness that I am free from your act of believing others except Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِن نَّقُولُ اِلَّا اعْتَرَاكَ بَعْضُ آلِهَتِنَا بِسُوءٍ ۗ قَالَ اِنِّي اُشْهِدُ اللّٰهَ وَاشْهَدُوا اَنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: So you plan against me and do not give me any respite.
verses.arabic_text: مِن دُونِهِ ۖ فَكِيدُونِي جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنظِرُونِ

verses.english_text: Because I trust in Allah only who is my Lord and also your Lord; and the forelock of every walking creature on the earth is in His hand; and there is no doubt that only His path is right path.
verses.arabic_text: اِنِّي تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللّٰهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ ۚ مَا مِن دَابَّةٍ اِلَّا هُوَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا ۚ اِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

verses.english_text: Even then if you are turning your face; with that command I was sent to you; I have delivered to you that command, and (if you would not believe then) my Lord will bring another nation in your place; and you cannot harm Him in anyway, and my Lord is guardian over everything.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِن تَوَلَّوْا فَقَدْ اَبْلَغْتُكُم مَّا اُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ اِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّي قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُ شَيْئًا ۚ اِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ

verses.english_text: And when Our command came; then We delivered Hood and those who have believed with him, with Our Mercy and saved them from punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ اَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا هُودًا وَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَنَجَّيْنٰهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ

verses.english_text: These conditions are of the nation of Aad who denied the verses of their Lord and disobeyed messengers, and they followed the rebellious enemies of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَتِلْكَ عَادٌ ۖ جَحَدُوا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا رُسُلَهُ وَاتَّبَعُوا اَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ

verses.english_text: And curses are on them in this world, and it will also be with them in the Hereafter, see, Aad's nation denied their Lord, and there is reprimand, for Hood's nation of Aad.
verses.arabic_text: وَاُتْبِعُوا فِي هٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۗ اَلَا اِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوا رَبَّهُمْ ۗ اَلَا بُعْدًا لِّعَادٍ قَوْمِ هُودٍ

verses.english_text: And We sent towards nation of Samood; his brother Saleh (as a prophet), so he said to his people: O my people, worship Allah only, there is no god except Him, He has created you from dust of earth and settled you in it, so ask for forgiveness from Him, and pray for repentance in His court, Verily my Allah is very near and listens and accept prayers.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ اَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ اِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ هُوَ اَنشَاَكُم مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ وَاسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا اِلَيْهِ ۚ اِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ

verses.english_text: They said: O Saleh! Before this we had expectations from you, now you deter us from worshipping of that, to whom our forefathers have worshipped, you call us to the religion which have put us in such a doubt, that we are astonished.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا يَا صَالِحُ قَدْ كُنتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّا قَبْلَ هٰذَا ۖ اَتَنْهَانَا اَن نَّعْبُدَ مَا يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُنَا وَاِنَّنَا لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَا اِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ

verses.english_text: Saleh replied: O my people just see that I am on clear proof, from my Lord, He has bestowed upon me Mercy (prophethood) from His Court, even now if I disobey Him, then who will help me to save from His punishment, then you cannot increase anything except my loss.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اَرَاَيْتُمْ اِن كُنتُ عَلَٰى بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّي وَآتَانِي مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً فَمَن يَنصُرُنِي مِنَ اللّٰهِ اِنْ عَصَيْتُهُ ۖ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِي غَيْرَ تَخْسِيرٍ

verses.english_text: O my people, this is the she-camel sent by Allah as a sign for my prophethood, set her free and let her graze anywhere in the land of Allah, and do not trouble her, otherwise, punishment will afflict you immediately.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَا قَوْمِ هٰذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللّٰهِ لَكُمْ آيَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَاْكُلْ فِي اَرْضِ اللّٰهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَاْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ قَرِيبٌ

verses.english_text: Even then they killed her, Saleh said: now enjoy for three days in your homes (then you will be ruined), this is the promise which is never falsified.
verses.arabic_text: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوا فِي دَارِكُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ اَيَّامٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍ

verses.english_text: Then, when Our command (punishment) came, so We delivered Saleh and those people who had believed with Our mercy and saved from disgrace of that day, undoubtedly your Lord is greatly Predominant.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ اَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا صَالِحًا وَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَمِنْ خِزْيِ يَوْمِئِذٍ ۗ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ

verses.english_text: Then the unjust became afflicted with a very mighty blast and were lying upside down in their homes.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَخَذَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّيْحَةُ فَاَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ

verses.english_text: As if they never lived there, so look, people of Samood disobeyed their Lord; listen properly, people of Samood are the rebuked people.
verses.arabic_text: كَاَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا ۗ اَلَا اِنَّ ثَمُودَ كَفَرُوا رَبَّهُمْ ۗ اَلَا بُعْدًا لِّثَمُودَ

verses.english_text: And angels who were sent by Us brought glad tidings to Ibrahim; they gave salutations and Ibrahim replied to their salutations, then immediately Ibrahim brought roasted meat of a calf.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا اِبْرَاهِيمَ بِالْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوا سَلَامًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَامٌ ۖ فَمَا لَبِثَ اَن جَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِيذٍ

verses.english_text: And when he (Ibrahim) saw that they were not touching it; he became distrustful and started fearing from inside; they said: fear not, we have been deputed towards the people of Lut. (for their punishment).
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَاَىٰ اَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ اِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَاَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۚ قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ اِنَّا اُرْسِلْنَا اِلَىٰ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ

verses.english_text: And Ibrahim's wife (Sarah) was standing there, he laughed on hearing this news, then We gave her good news of Ishaq, and after Ishaq, of Yaqoob.
verses.arabic_text: وَامْرَاَتُهُ قَائِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَاهَا بِاِسْحَاقَ وَمِن وَرَاءِ اِسْحَاقَ يَعْقُوبَ

verses.english_text: She said: now will I deliver a child? I am old and my husband is also old, and this is very surprising news.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَتْ يَا وَيْلَتَىٰ اَاَلِدُ وَاَنَا عَجُوزٌ وَهٰذَا بَعْلِي شَيْخًا ۖ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ

verses.english_text: Angels said: you are wondering about the power of Allah? O people of the house (of prophet) may Allah's Blessings and Mercy be upon you, undoubtedly, He is worthy of Praise and He is Great.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا اَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ اَمْرِ اللّٰهِ ۖ رَحْمَتُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ اَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ ۚ اِنَّهُ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ

verses.english_text: When Ibrahim's fear had gone and he received the good news (of the child), then he started pleading with regard to the people of Lut with Us.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ اِبْرَاهِيمَ الرَّوْعُ وَجَاءَتْهُ الْبُشْرَىٰ يُجَادِلُنَا فِي قَوْمِ لُوطٍ

verses.english_text: Verily Ibrahim was very tolerant and soft hearted, and he was always turning towards Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اِبْرَاهِيمَ لَحَلِيمٌ اَوَّاهٌ مُّنِيبٌ

verses.english_text: O Ibrahim! Do not insist in this matter, the command of your Lord has certainly come, and undoubtedly such punishment is coming on them which cannot be averted.
verses.arabic_text: يَا اِبْرَاهِيمُ اَعْرِضْ عَنْ هٰذَا ۖ اِنَّهُ قَدْ جَاءَ اَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَاِنَّهُمْ آتِيهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَيْرُ مَرْدُودٍ

verses.english_text: When our angels came to Lut as young boys, with their thoughts he became sad and straiten at heart, and he said today's day is very hard and troublesome.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالَ هٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ

verses.english_text: (Upon hearing the news of young boys) His people came running to him, before this also they were doing evil works, Lut said: O my people, there are my daughters (marry them), they are pure and allowed for you; don't disgrace me, about my guests, don't you have any sensible person among you?
verses.arabic_text: وَجَاءَهُ قَوْمُهُ يُهْرَعُونَ اِلَيْهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّاٰتِ ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ هٰؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي هُنَّ اَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِي ضَيْفِي ۖ اَلَيْسَ مِنكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَّشِيدٌ

verses.english_text: They said: you know we do not have any requirement of your girls, and whatever we want, you know better.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِي بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ وَاِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ

verses.english_text: Lut said: I wish I had strength to confront you or I could have taken refuge in a strong fort.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَوْ اَنَّ لِي بِكُمْ قُوَّةً اَوْ آوِي اِلَىٰ رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ

verses.english_text: Angels said: O Lut, don't be afraid, we have been sent from your Lord, they can never reach you, after the passage of part of the night take your boys and wealth and leave from here; (and while going) do not turn your back to see, but your wife, who will Verily be afflicted with the same punishment which will befell on those people, and morning is for the promise (for their punishment), is not morning near?
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا يَا لُوطُ اِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَن يَصِلُوا اِلَيْكَ ۖ فَاَسْرِ بِاَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ اَحَدٌ اِلَّا امْرَاَتَكَ ۖ اِنَّهُ مُصِيبُهَا مَا اَصَابَهُمْ ۚ اِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الصُّبْحُ ۚ اَلَيْسَ الصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍ

verses.english_text: When Our Command (punishment) came then We turned the surface of the earth of (that) town to its bottom and continuously rained on them stones of baked clay.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ اَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ مَّنضُودٍ

verses.english_text: The signs of your Lord were engraved on them (stones), and that town is not far away from the unjust (infidels of Makkah).
verses.arabic_text: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَ مَا هِيَ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٍ

verses.english_text: And We sent to the people of Madyan, his brother Shoaib (as a messenger), he said to his people: O my people, worship Allah, there is no god except Him, and do not shorten the weight and measures, I am seeing you in prosperity, and I fear for the day of punishment which will encircle everybody.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ اَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ اِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ وَلَا تَنقُصُوا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ ۚ اِنِّي اَرَاكُم بِخَيْرٍ وَاِنِّي اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُّحِيطٍ

verses.english_text: O my people, keep measures and scales full; and do not give people their things less (in weight or measure), and do not create mischief in the land.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَا قَوْمِ اَوْفُوا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ ۖ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ

verses.english_text: If you are true believers, then what remains with Allah is much better for you; and I am not any of your guardians.
verses.arabic_text: بَقِيَّتُ اللّٰهِ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ اِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۚ وَ مَا اَنَا عَلَيْكُم بِحَفِيظٍ

verses.english_text: They said: O Shoaib, does your prayer command that we should leave off whom our forefathers had worshipped, or we cannot spend our wealth as we want, and that you only have remained tolerant and sensible?
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا يَا شُعَيْبُ اَصَلَاتُكَ تَاْمُرُكَ اَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُنَا اَوْ اَن نَّفْعَلَ فِي اَمْوَالِنَا مَا نَشَاءُ ۖ اِنَّكَ لَاَنتَ الْحَلِيمُ الرَّشِيدُ

verses.english_text: Shoaib said: O my people, I have clear proof from my Lord and He has given me sustenance, and I do not want to do the same in opposition to you from which I am preventing you; I only desire your correction; until possible and I do not want anything else, and nobody can verify me except Allah, I have trusted Him, and turns to Him only.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اَرَاَيْتُمْ اِن كُنتُ عَلَٰى بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَ مَا اُرِيدُ اَنْ اُخَالِفَكُمْ اِلَىٰ مَا اَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ ۚ اِنْ اُرِيدُ اِلَّا الْاِصْلَاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ ۚ وَ مَا تَوْفِيقِي اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَاِلَيْهِ اُنِيبُ

verses.english_text: O my people, your opposition to me, may not make you guilty so that there may befall you affliction like of what befell the people of Nooh; or the people of Hood; or the people of Saleh; and people of Lut is not far away from you, you may take lesson from them.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَا قَوْمِ لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِي اَن يُصِيبَكُم مِّثْلُ مَا اَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ اَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ اَوْ قَوْمَ صَالِحٍ ۚ وَ مَا قَوْمُ لُوطٍ مِّنكُم بِبَعِيدٍ

verses.english_text: And ask for forgiveness from your Lord only, then repent in His Court, Verily my Lord is very Kind and Loving.
verses.arabic_text: وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا اِلَيْهِ ۚ اِنَّ رَبِّي رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ

verses.english_text: Those people were saying: O Shoaib, whatever you say, much of it we don't understand, and certainly we consider you very weak among us, if your clan was not there we would already had stoned you, and you cannot dominate us.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا يَا شُعَيْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا تَقُولُ وَاِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفًا وَلَوْلَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنَاكَ وَ مَا اَنْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِعَزِيزٍ

verses.english_text: O my people, you have more pressure of my clan than Allah? And you have put Allah behind you, Verily my Lord has encircled all over your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اَرَهْطِي اَعَزُّ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ اللَّـهِ وَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ وَرَاءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا اِنَّ رَبِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ

verses.english_text: And O my people, you do whatever you want and I am doing mine, shortly you will come to know on whom punishment will befall, which will disgrace him and make clear who is liar, you also await, I am waiting with you.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَا قَوْمِ اعْمَلُوا عَلَٰى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّي عَامِلٌ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَاْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ وَارْتَقِبُوا اِنِّي مَعَكُمْ رَقِيبٌ

verses.english_text: And when Our command (of punishment) came, then with Our Grace We saved Shoaib and those who have belief with him; and those who were unjust were affected with a mighty blast, and they were lying upside down in their homes.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ اَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًا وَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَاَخَذَتِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّيْحَةُ فَاَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ

verses.english_text: As if they have never dwelt here; be aware; for the nation of Madyan is also the same destruction as the nation of Samood was destroyed.
verses.arabic_text: كَاَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا ۗ اَلَا بُعْدًا لِمَدْيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُودُ

verses.english_text: Verily, I sent Moosa with Our signs and clear proofs;
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰى بِاٰيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

verses.english_text: To Firaun and his chiefs, but they followed Firaun and did not listen to Moosa, however, the order of Firaun was not wise.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَاِيْهِ فَاتَّبَعُوا اَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ مَا اَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِيدٍ

verses.english_text: On the Day of Judgement, he will walk ahead of his people, and will lead them all to Hell, and how bad is that place.
verses.arabic_text: يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَاَوْرَدَهُمُ النَّارَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْوِرْدُ الْمَوْرُودُ

verses.english_text: And curses are behind them (in this world) which will follow them on the Day of Judgement also, and what a bad reward they got.
verses.arabic_text: وَاُتْبِعُوا فِي هَٰذِهِ لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ بِئْسَ الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُودُ

verses.english_text: These are the conditions of some towns which We are describing to you, out of those some are still settled and some of them have been destroyed.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ اَنبَاءِ الْقُرَىٰ نَقُصُّهُ عَلَيْكَ ۖ مِنْهَا قَائِمٌ وَحَصِيدٌ

verses.english_text: And We did not do any injustice to them, but they were unjust unto themselves, and when the command (of punishment) of your Lord came then those gods were of no use, whom they used to call instead of Allah; and neither those gods helped them, except destroying them. (they were punished because they worshipped false gods).
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلٰكِن ظَلَمُوا اَنفُسَهُمْ فَمَا اَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ آلِهَتُهُمُ الَّتِي يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللّٰهِ مِن شَيْءٍ لَّمَّا جَاءَ اَمْرُ رَبِّكَ وَ مَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), when your Lord grips people of towns because of their transgression; His grip is like this, Verily His grip is very painful and strong.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ اَخْذُ رَبِّكَ اِذَا اَخَذَ الْقُرَىٰ وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ ۚ اِنَّ اَخْذَهُ اَلِيمٌ شَدِيدٌ

verses.english_text: Undoubtedly, there is a sign in it for the person, who fears the punishment of the Hereafter, this will be the day when all the people (of the world) will be gathered; and this will be the day when everybody will be presented in Our Court.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ الْآخِرَةِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّجْمُوعٌ لَّهُ النَّاسُ وَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّشْهُودٌ

verses.english_text: And We are just delaying it until an appointed term.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا نُؤَخِّرُهُ اِلَّا لِاَجَلٍ مَّعْدُودٍ

verses.english_text: When that day will come, then nobody will be able to speak without the command of Allah, and some of them will be unlucky and some will be lucky.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَاْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهِ ۚ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِيٌّ وَسَعِيدٌ

verses.english_text: Those who are unlucky will be in Hell and there will be crying and wailing in it for them;
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّا الَّذِينَ شَقُوا فَفِي النَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَشَهِيقٌ

verses.english_text: They will always remain there; as long as skies and the earth will be there, Verily, whatever your Lord pleases, He certainly does.
verses.arabic_text: خٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالْاَرْضُ اِلَّا مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ ۚ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِمَا يُرِيدُ

verses.english_text: And whoever is lucky will be in Paradise, and they will always abide there, as long as skies and the earth will be there; but if your Lord pleases otherwise; this is His never-ending Gift.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمَّا الَّذِينَ سُعِدُوا فَفِي الْجَنَّةِ خٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالْاَرْضُ اِلَّا مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ ۖ عَطَاءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوذٍ

verses.english_text: Those who worship others except Allah, so you should not be in doubt, these people worship as their forefathers had worshipped, and We will give them their full share without any deficiency.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِّمَّا يَعْبُدُ هَٰؤُلَاءِ ۚ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ اِلَّا كَمَا يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُهُم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ وَاِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ غَيْرَ مَنقُوصٍ

verses.english_text: And We gave Moosa the book of Taurait, but they disputed that, and had your Lord not definitely decided earlier (to delay punishment), then matter had been decided between them, and these people (infidels of Makkah) are also in disquieting doubt about it (Quran).
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتٰبَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَاِنَّهُمْ لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ

verses.english_text: And there is not an iota of doubt that your Lord will Verily (and suitably) reward them for their (whatever) deeds, because He is fully aware of their doings.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنَّ كُلًّا لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ اَعْمَالَهُمْ ۚ اِنَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

verses.english_text: and (O Prophet), whatever you have been commanded for show perseverance in it, and those who have repented with you, they should not exceed, because Allah is Verily watching all their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: فَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا اُمِرْتَ وَ مَن تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا ۚ اِنَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

verses.english_text: And (O believers), whoever were unjust on themselves (by disobeying Allah), do not get inclined towards them, otherwise the fire of Hell will touch you also, and you have no Guardian except Allah; no one even can help you.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَرْكَنُوا اِلَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُ وَ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ اَوْلِيَاءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! establish prayer in both part of the day and after passage of some part of night, because good acts Verily drive away evils, and it is an advice and lesson for those who remember Us.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ ۚ اِنَّ الْحَسَنٰتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّاٰتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ذِكْرَىٰ لِلذَّاكِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), be patient because Allah does not waste the good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَاصْبِرْ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُضِيعُ اَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Those who have passed by before you, why some of them were not sensible, who could have deterred people from spreading corruption. (there were such people, but very few), and those were they whom We saved (from punishment), and those who had disobeyed, they were enjoying plenty from what We have given them; and those were guilty people.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَوْلَا كَانَ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ اُولُو بَقِيَّةٍ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْفَسَادِ فِي الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِمَّنْ اَنجَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۗ وَاتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مَا اُتْرِفُوا فِيهِ وَكَانُوا مُجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And your Lord was never such (unjust) that He will destroy the towns of which people have acted well.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهْلِكَ الْقُرَىٰ بِظُلْمٍ وَاَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: And if your Lord please He could have made all people one Ummah, but Allah never uses coercion, that (because of this) they would always differ among them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ اُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً ۖ وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ

verses.english_text: Only if your Lord shows Mercy, and He has created them for that, and because of this your Lord's definite command is completed, We will certainly fill the Hell, with the jinn and men.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَ ۚ وَلِذَٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ ۗ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَاَمْلَاَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), We relate to you all the tales of previous messengers, to strengthen your heart; and in these tales have come the truth (Quran) for you and exhortations and reminders for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كُلًّا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ اَنبَاءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ ۚ وَجَاءَكَ فِي هَٰذِهِ الْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), those who do not believe, say to them: you do your deeds and I am doing my deeds;
verses.arabic_text: وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ اعْمَلُوا عَلَٰى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنَّا عٰمِلُونَ

verses.english_text: And you also wait (for result) and I am awaiting.
verses.arabic_text: وَانتَظِرُوا اِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And all the knowledge of the unseen of skies and the earth is exclusive to Allah, and every work eventually returns to Him only, so worship Him and put your trust in Him, and whatever you do, Allah is not unaware of it.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِلّٰهِ غَيْبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَاِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ الْاَمْرُ كُلُّهُ فَاعْبُدْهُ وَ تَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَ مَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Alif Laam Ra, these are the verses of explicit book.
verses.arabic_text: الر ۚ تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ

verses.english_text: We have revealed this book in Arabic language, so that you may understand.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا اَنزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), We relate you a very good tale by revealing Quran to you, however earlier you were totally unaware of it.
verses.arabic_text: نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ اَحْسَنَ الْقَصَصِ بِمَا اَوْحَيْنَا اِلَيْكَ هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ وَاِن كُنتَ مِن قَبْلِهِ لَمِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ

verses.english_text: And remember that time, when Yusuf said to his father: O father, I saw (in dream) eleven stars, sun and the moon, I saw that they are all prostrating before me.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِاَبِيهِ يَا اَبَتِ اِنِّي رَاَيْتُ اَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ رَاَيْتُهُمْ لِي سَاجِدِينَ

verses.english_text: Yaqoob said: O (my) son, do not repeat your dream to your brothers; (or else) they will make deceitful plans for you, there is no doubt that Satan is open enemy of men.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُؤْيَاكَ عَلَىٰ اِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا لَكَ كَيْدًا ۖ اِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لِلْاِنسَانِ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ

verses.english_text: And it will happen (as you have seen), your Lord will choose you and will teach you interpretation of dreams, and as He has completed his blessings before you on your forefathers, Ibrahim and Ishaq, similarly on you and children of Yaqoob He will complete His blessings, certainly your Lord is knowledgeable and wise.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِن تَاْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِيثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ يَعْقُوبَ كَمَا اَتَمَّهَا عَلَىٰ اَبَوَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ اِبْرَاهِيمَ وَاِسْحَاقَ ۚ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), Certainly for those who ask there are signs of your prophethood, in the tale of Yusuf and his brothers.
verses.arabic_text: لَّقَدْ كَانَ فِي يُوسُفَ وَاِخْوَتِهِ آيَاتٌ لِّلسَّائِلِينَ

verses.english_text: (Yusuf's brothers) said: in spite of our majority; Yusuf and his brother (Benjamin) are more beloved to our father; there is no doubt that our father is in clear error.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالُوا لَيُوسُفُ وَاَخُوهُ اَحَبُّ اِلَىٰ اَبِينَا مِنَّا وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ ۖ اِنَّ اَبَانَا لَفِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ

verses.english_text: (They said) Either kill Yusuf of throw him in some land, then attention of your father will turn towards you, then you will become righteous people.
verses.arabic_text: اقْتُلُوا يُوسُفَ اَوِ اطْرَحُوهُ اَرْضًا يَخْلُ لَكُمْ وَجْهُ اَبِيكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا مِن بَعْدِهِ قَوْمًا صَالِحِينَ

verses.english_text: One of them (Lavi) said: do not kill Yusuf, if you want to do this, then throw him in some blind well, some traveler may take him (with them).
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ لَا تَقْتُلُوا يُوسُفَ وَاَلْقُوهُ فِي غَيَابَتِ الْجُبِّ يَلْتَقِطْهُ بَعْضُ السَّيَّارَةِ اِن كُنتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ

verses.english_text: They all said: O Father, what it is that you do not trust us with regards to Yusuf whereas we are his well-wishers.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا يَا اَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَاْمَنَّا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَاِنَّا لَهُ لَنَاصِحُونَ

verses.english_text: Tomorrow, you send him with us so he might eat something and play and we will guard him.
verses.arabic_text: اَرْسِلْهُ مَعَنَا غَدًا يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ وَاِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ

verses.english_text: (Yaqoob) said: It really saddens me that you take him (away); and I fear you become unaware of him and a wolf may tear and devour on him.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنِّي لَيَحْزُنُنِي اَن تَذْهَبُوا بِهِ وَاَخَافُ اَن يَاْكُلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَاَنتُمْ عَنْهُ غَافِلُونَ

verses.english_text: We are a big party, even then if wolf will devour him, then certainly we will be among the big losers.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا لَئِنْ اَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ اِنَّا اِذًا لَّخَاسِرُونَ

verses.english_text: When they took Yusuf with them, they decided to throw him in a blind well (and they did it), then We revealed to Yusuf: Do not get frightened; certainly, you will inform them about their (bad) deeds, and they wouldn't know.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوا بِهِ وَاَجْمَعُوا اَن يَجْعَلُوهُ فِي غَيَابَتِ الْجُبِّ وَاَوْحَيْنَا اِلَيْهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُم بِاَمْرِهِمْ هَٰذَا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: They returned crying to their father at night.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَاءُوا اَبَاهُمْ عِشَاءً يَبْكُونَ

verses.english_text: And said: O Father, we went for a race and had left Yusuf to guard our goods, and in between a wolf came and devoured him, and however we may be truthful, but you will not believe us.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا يَا اَبَانَا اِنَّا ذَهَبْنَا نَسْتَبِقُ وَتَرَكْنَا يُوسُفَ عِندَ مَتَاعِنَا فَاَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَ مَا اَنتَ بِمُؤْمِنٍ لَّنَا وَ لَوْ كُنَّا صَادِقِينَ

verses.english_text: And they also brought shirt of Yusuf, with false blood on it; Yaqoob said: wolf has not devoured on him but you have forged the thing from your heart for your defense, then I have way of patience and thanks on what you describe, and I seek help from Allah only.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَاءُوا عَلَىٰ قَمِيصِهِ بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍ ۚ قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ اَنفُسُكُمْ اَمْرًا ۖ فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ ۖ وَاللَّهُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ

verses.english_text: There comes a caravan and they sent their watercarrier to fetch water, he let down the bucket (in the well) and Yusuf sat in it, when he pulled it up he shouted wow there is a boy (in it), and they concealed Yusuf as a valuable investment, and Allah knew whatever they were doing.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَاءَتْ سَيَّارَةٌ فَاَرْسَلُوا وَارِدَهُمْ فَاَدْلَىٰ دَلْوَهُ ۖ قَالَ يَا بُشْرَىٰ هَٰذَا غُلَامٌ ۚ وَاَسَرُّوهُ بِضَاعَةً ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: When brothers of Yusuf became aware, they came forth and said: Yusuf is their slave, and they sold him for a few coins as they were already frustrated with Yusuf.
verses.arabic_text: وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍ بَخْسٍ دَرَاهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ وَكَانُوا فِيهِ مِنَ الزَّاهِدِينَ

verses.english_text: (They took Yusuf and reached Egypt and sold him for a hefty price) And of the people of Egypt who brought him and gifted him to his wife (Zulekha), and told her to keep him honorably, he might benefit us, or we might take him as son; and like this We made him powerful in Egypt, and that We teach him interpretation of dreams, and like this Allah is Predominant and Powerful but many of them do not know (Him).
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اشْتَرَاهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِامْرَاَتِهِ اَكْرِمِي مَثْوَاهُ عَسَىٰ اَن يَنفَعَنَا اَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُ مِن تَاْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰ اَمْرِهِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And when Yusuf reached his youth We gave him command (prophethood) and knowledge, and We reward the good doers like this.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ اَشُدَّهُ آتَيْنَاهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And the lady (Zulekha) in whose home Yusuf was living; wanted to get her illegitimate desire fulfilled from him and she closed all the doors, and lustily said: come forward, Yusuf said: Allah forbid, your husband is my master and he has kept me well, Verily the unjust never prosper.
verses.arabic_text: وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الَّتِي هُوَ فِي بَيْتِهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِ وَغَلَّقَتِ الْاَبْوَابَ وَقَالَتْ هَيْتَ لَكَ ۚ قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ ۖ اِنَّهُ رَبِّي اَحْسَنَ مَثْوَايَ ۖ اِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And Zulekha had decided on her evil intention; had he not seen the argument of his Lord, he would also have inclined. (We saved him) that We keep away evil and indecency from him, Verily he was from Our sincere servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ هَمَّتْ بِهِ وَهَمَّ بِهَا لَوْلَا اَن رَّاَىٰ بُرْهَانَ رَبِّهِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنَصْرِفَ عَنْهُ السُّوءَ وَالْفَحْشَاءَ ۚ اِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُخْلَصِينَ

verses.english_text: And both hastened towards the door, Zulekha (grabbed and) tore his shirt from behind; and both found Zulekha's husband standing on the door, she spontaneously said (to her husband) who has bad intention for your wife, his penalty is nothing but imprisonment or infliction of painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَاسْتَبَقَا الْبَابَ وَقَدَّتْ قَمِيصَهُ مِن دُبُرٍ وَاَلْفَيَا سَيِّدَهَا لَدَا الْبَابِ ۚ قَالَتْ مَا جَزَاءُ مَنْ اَرَادَ بِاَهْلِكَ سُوءًا اِلَّا اَن يُسْجَنَ اَوْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Yusuf said: she herself had desired for me, and a person (an infant) from among household of Zulekha testified: 'if his shirt is torn from front than she (Zulekha) is truthful and he (Yusuf) is a liar;
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ هِيَ رَاوَدَتْنِي عَن نَّفْسِي ۚ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِّنْ اَهْلِهَا ۚ اِن كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِن قُبُلٍ فَصَدَقَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ

verses.english_text: And if his shirt is torn from behind then she (Zulekha) is liar and he (Yusuf) is truthful'.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِن دُبُرٍ فَكَذَبَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ

verses.english_text: When he saw his shirt torn from behind, he said to his wife: this is your guile, and no doubt that your guiles are big (and amazing).
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَاَىٰ قَمِيصَهُ قُدَّ مِن دُبُرٍ قَالَ اِنَّهُ مِن كَيْدِكُنَّ ۖ اِنَّ كَيْدَكُنَّ عَظِيمٌ

verses.english_text: He said (to Yusuf): turn away from this, and said to his wife: seek forgiveness because you are in error for all this.
verses.arabic_text: يُوسُفُ اَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَٰذَا ۚ وَاسْتَغْفِرِي لِذَنبِكِ ۖ اِنَّكِ كُنتِ مِنَ الْخَاطِئِينَ

verses.english_text: And ladies of the city (of Egypt) started discussing that wife of Aziz (mighty one of Egypt - 'Aziz-e-Misr') is desirous of (illicit) relationship with her slave, Verily slave have entangled her in love. (but) we see her in clear error.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ نِسْوَةٌ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ امْرَاَتُ الْعَزِيزِ تُرَاوِدُ فَتَاهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِ ۖ قَدْ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّا ۖ اِنَّا لَنَرَاهَا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ

verses.english_text: When Zulekha heard their taunts, she called them and arranged a banquet for them, and gave each of them a knife (and an orange and said: when he comes in front of you, cut and give him a piece of orange), and said to Yusuf: pass by in front of them, when ladies saw, they found him very handsome, and they all cut their hands, and said: by god he is not human but he is a noble angel.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتْ بِمَكْرِهِنَّ اَرْسَلَتْ اِلَيْهِنَّ وَاَعْتَدَتْ لَهُنَّ مُتَّكَاً وَآتَتْ كُلَّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِّنْهُنَّ سِكِّينًا وَقَالَتِ اخْرُجْ عَلَيْهِنَّ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَاَيْنَهُ اَكْبَرْنَهُ وَقَطَّعْنَ اَيْدِيَهُنَّ وَقُلْنَ حَاشَ لِلّٰهِ مَا هَٰذَا بَشَرًا اِنْ هَٰذَا اِلَّا مَلَكٌ كَرِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Then Zulekha told the ladies: this is that because of whom you accused me, yes, Verily I wanted to get my desire from him, but he saved himself, but whatever order I am giving he did not comply, then Verily he will be imprisoned and will be in state of ignominy.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَتْ فَذَٰلِكُنَّ الَّذِي لُمْتُنَّنِي فِيهِ ۖ وَ لَقَدْ رَاوَدتُّهُ عَن نَّفْسِهِ فَاسْتَعْصَمَ ۖ وَلَئِن لَّمْ يَفْعَلْ مَا آمُرُهُ لَيُسْجَنَنَّ وَلَيَكُونًا مِّنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ

verses.english_text: (On hearing all this Yusuf implored in My Court): O my Lord! I will prefer imprisonment over the demand of these ladies; if You will not deflect their deception from me, then (I fear) I may incline towards them; and be counted among the ignorant.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ السِّجْنُ اَحَبُّ اِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِي اِلَيْهِ ۖ وَاِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّي كَيْدَهُنَّ اَصْبُ اِلَيْهِنَّ وَاَكُن مِّنَ الْجَاهِلِينَ

verses.english_text: So his Lord heard him, and deflected the deception of the ladies from him, there is no doubt that He Hears and Knows.
verses.arabic_text: فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُ رَبُّهُ فَصَرَفَ عَنْهُ كَيْدَهُنَّ ۚ اِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: Then in spite of witnessing the signs, they thought to imprison him for some time.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُم مِّن بَعْدِ مَا رَاَوُا الْآيَاتِ لَيَسْجُنُنَّهُ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

verses.english_text: And along with Yusuf two other young men entered the prison. (After some days), one of them said I saw a dream that I am squeezing grapes to make wine, the second one said; I saw myself carrying bread on my head in a dream, which birds are devouring. (Yusuf) tell us its interpretation; we consider you from the good ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ السِّجْنَ فَتَيَانِ ۖ قَالَ اَحَدُهُمَا اِنِّي اَرَانِي اَعْصِرُ خَمْرًا ۖ وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ اِنِّي اَرَانِي اَحْمِلُ فَوْقَ رَاْسِي خُبْزًا تَاْكُلُ الطَّيْرُ مِنْهُ ۖ نَبِّئْنَا بِتَاْوِيلِهِ ۖ اِنَّا نَرَاكَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Yusuf said: before any food comes to you (in prison), I will interpret it that what food you will be getting, this (interpretation of dreams) is among other things which my Lord has taught me; I have left them behind who do not believe in Allah, and they also deny the Hereafter.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَا يَاْتِيكُمَا طَعَامٌ تُرْزَقَانِهِ اِلَّا نَبَّاْتُكُمَا بِتَاْوِيلِهِ قَبْلَ اَن يَاْتِيَكُمَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِي رَبِّي ۚ اِنِّي تَرَكْتُ مِلَّةَ قَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَهُم بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ

verses.english_text: I follow the religion of my forefathers Ibrahim, Ishaq and Yaqoob, it is not appropriate for me to consider anybody partner with Allah, this is also one of the kindnesses of Allah - on us and on all people, but many of them do not thank also.
verses.arabic_text: وَاتَّبَعْتُ مِلَّةَ آبَائِي اِبْرَاهِيمَ وَاِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۚ مَا كَانَ لَنَا اَن نُّشْرِكَ بِاللَّهِ مِن شَيْءٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِن فَضْلِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: O my prison friends, just think who can be stronger, many gods or One God?
verses.arabic_text: يَا صَاحِبَيِ السِّجْنِ اَاَرْبَابٌ مُّتَفَرِّقُونَ خَيْرٌ اَمِ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ

verses.english_text: Alas! You are worshipping the names except Allah, who have been forged by your forefathers, Allah has not sent any proof for them, governance is just for Allah only, He has commanded that do not worship anybody except Him, this is the righteous religion, but many of the people do not know.
verses.arabic_text: مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِهِ اِلَّا اَسْمَاءً سَمَّيْتُمُوهَا اَنتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُم مَّا اَنزَلَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَانٍ ۚ اِنِ الْحُكْمُ اِلَّا لِلّٰهِ ۚ اَمَرَ اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا اِلَّا اِيَّاهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ وَلَٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: O my both friends of the prison. (now listen to interpretation): one of you (who saw grapes) will be the bartender of his master; another (who carried bread on his head) will be hanged, and birds will eat from his head; this is the matter of what you were asking which has already been decided.
verses.arabic_text: يَا صَاحِبَيِ السِّجْنِ اَمَّا اَحَدُكُمَا فَيَسْقِي رَبَّهُ خَمْرًا وَاَمَّا الْآخَرُ فَيُصْلَبُ فَتَاْكُلُ الطَّيْرُ مِن رَّاْسِهِ ۚ قُضِيَ الْاَمْرُ الَّذِي فِيهِ تَسْتَفْتِيَانِ

verses.english_text: And Yusuf said to the one who would be free, that to speak to his master regarding him (that he is imprisoned without any crime), and Satan made him forget to mention to his master, so Yusuf remained imprisoned for a few years.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ لِلَّذِي ظَنَّ اَنَّهُ نَاجٍ مِّنْهُمَا اذْكُرْنِي عِندَ رَبِّكَ فَاَنسَاهُ الشَّيْطَانُ ذِكْرَ رَبِّهِ فَلَبِثَ فِي السِّجْنِ بِضْعَ سِنِينَ

verses.english_text: During that period king saw a dream that there are seven healthy cows which are being eaten by seven lean cows, and he saw seven green ears (of grain) and later saw seven dried ears (of grain); he said: O chiefs of my court, if you can do the interpretation of dreams, then interpret my this dream.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ اِنِّي اَرَىٰ سَبْعَ بَقَرَاتٍ سِمَانٍ يَاْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌ وَسَبْعَ سُنبُلَاتٍ خُضْرٍ وَاُخَرَ يَابِسَاتٍ ۖ يَا اَيُّهَا الْمَلَاُ اَفْتُونِي فِي رُؤْيَايَ اِن كُنتُمْ لِلرُّؤْيَا تَعْبُرُونَ

verses.english_text: They said, this is a confused dream and we do not know the interpretation of confused dreams.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا اَضْغَاثُ اَحْلَامٍ وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِتَاْوِيلِ الْاَحْلَامِ بِعَالِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Who was released recently (bartender) after a period he remembered (Yusuf) and said: let me go to prison, I will tell you (bring) its interpretation.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِي نَجَا مِنْهُمَا وَادَّكَرَ بَعْدَ اُمَّةٍ اَنَا اُنَبِّئُكُم بِتَاْوِيلِهِ فَاَرْسِلُونِ

verses.english_text: (At last he went to prison and said): O Yusuf, O truthful. (tell us the interpretation of this dream) that seven lean cows are eating to seven healthy cows, and seven ears (of grain) are there and seven dry ears (of grain) are there, so that I return (and describe) so they also know it (and your value also).
verses.arabic_text: يُوسُفُ اَيُّهَا الصِّدِّيقُ اَفْتِنَا فِي سَبْعِ بَقَرَاتٍ سِمَانٍ يَاْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌ وَسَبْعِ سُنبُلَاتٍ خُضْرٍ وَاُخَرَ يَابِسَاتٍ لَّعَلِّي اَرْجِعُ اِلَى النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Yusuf said: (this is its interpretation) You will do farming for seven years continuously and whatever you reap save that with ears (do not break them), and do consume some of it.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ تَزْرَعُونَ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ دَاَبًا فَمَا حَصَدتُّمْ فَذَرُوهُ فِي سُنبُلِهِ اِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّمَّا تَاْكُلُونَ

verses.english_text: Thereafter, there will come seven difficult years of drought, and you will consume whatever you have saved in (previous) seven years, except some which you will save for (further) sowing.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ يَاْتِي مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ سَبْعٌ شِدَادٌ يَاْكُلْنَ مَا قَدَّمْتُمْ لَهُنَّ اِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّمَّا تُحْصِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And after that one year will come when there will be good rain. (when there will be more grapes) and people will squeeze them for wine.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ يَاْتِي مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ عَامٌ فِيهِ يُغَاثُ النَّاسُ وَفِيهِ يَعْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: On hearing this interpretation, the king ordered to present Yusuf to him; when the messenger came to Yusuf (again), Yusuf said: you go to your master and ask him whether he knew something about the ladies who had cut their hands. (did I desired for them or they desired for me), no doubt that my Lord was well aware of their guile.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ ائْتُونِي بِهِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ الرَّسُولُ قَالَ ارْجِعْ اِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَسْاَلْهُ مَا بَالُ النِّسْوَةِ الَّاتِي قَطَّعْنَ اَيْدِيَهُنَّ ۚ اِنَّ رَبِّي بِكَيْدِهِنَّ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: So, the king (gathered those ladies) and asked: when you wanted to get your desire fulfilled by Yusuf, what had happened? They all said: God forbid we did not see any evil intention from Yusuf, then (Zulekha) wife of Aziz (Aziz-e-Misr) said: now that the matter has come into light; fact is that I wanted to get my desire fulfilled from him; but Verily he is truthful.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ اِذْ رَاوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِ ۚ قُلْنَ حَاشَ لِلّٰهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوءٍ ۚ قَالَتِ امْرَاَةُ الْعَزِيزِ الْآنَ حَصْحَصَ الْحَقُّ اَنَا رَاوَدتُّهُ عَن نَّفْسِهِ وَاِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ

verses.english_text: (Messenger narrated this incident to Yusuf in prison, so Yusuf said: by this I just wanted) That king should know that I did not betray his trust in the absence of Aziz; and Allah never lets the guile of the people succeed.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ لِيَعْلَمَ اَنِّي لَمْ اَخُنْهُ بِالْغَيْبِ وَاَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي كَيْدَ الْخَائِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And I do not consider my soul free from need, because soul always incite towards evil, but on whom my Lord shows Mercy, there is no doubt that my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا اُبَرِّئُ نَفْسِي ۚ اِنَّ النَّفْسَ لَاَمَّارَةٌ بِالسُّوءِ اِلَّا مَا رَحِمَ رَبِّي ۚ اِنَّ رَبِّي غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

verses.english_text: King ordered to bring Yusuf to him so I will appoint him for my works, then, when he spoke to Yusuf (he realized value of Yusuf) and he ordered that from today you will hold a high and reliable position in my administration.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ ائْتُونِي بِهِ اَسْتَخْلِصْهُ لِنَفْسِي ۖ فَلَمَّا كَلَّمَهُ قَالَ اِنَّكَ الْيَوْمَ لَدَيْنَا مَكِينٌ اَمِينٌ

verses.english_text: Yusuf said: appoint me on your treasures of land, because I am trustworthy and know its affairs also. (Yusuf was appointed as the imperial treasury officer).
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اجْعَلْنِي عَلَىٰ خَزَائِنِ الْاَرْضِ ۖ اِنِّي حَفِيظٌ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: And like this We empowered Yusuf in Egypt that he may live wherever he wants; We bestow Our Grace on whoever We please, and We do not waste the reward of the good doers.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِي الْاَرْضِ يَتَبَوَّاُ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ يَشَاءُ ۚ نُصِيبُ بِرَحْمَتِنَا مَن نَّشَاءُ ۖ وَلَا نُضِيعُ اَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Whosoever believed and continued their good deeds, for them reward of the Hereafter is much better than this.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَاَجْرُ الْآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَكَانُوا يَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: (Since there was drought in Kanaan also) When (step) brothers of Yusuf came to Egypt to purchase grain, he recognized them, but they could not recognize him.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَاءَ اِخْوَةُ يُوسُفَ فَدَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ فَعَرَفَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُ مُنكِرُونَ

verses.english_text: When Yusuf arranged grain for them (and they wanted to leave), he told them: next time when you come bring your stepbrother to me (whom you have left home), didn't you see that I am good in giving full measure, and also a good host.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمْ قَالَ ائْتُونِي بِاَخٍ لَّكُم مِّنْ اَبِيكُمْ ۚ اَلَا تَرَوْنَ اَنِّي اُوفِي الْكَيْلَ وَاَنَا خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ

verses.english_text: Then if you will not bring him to me then you will not get any grain, and neither can you come near to me.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِن لَّمْ تَاْتُونِي بِهِ فَلَا كَيْلَ لَكُمْ عِندِي وَلَا تَقْرَبُونِ

verses.english_text: They said: We will request our father as soon as we reach there, and we will Verily do this work.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا سَنُرَاوِدُ عَنْهُ اَبَاهُ وَاِنَّا لَفَاعِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Yusuf said: keep their money in their bags, so when they will go back to their families, they will recognize it and they might come back again.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ لِفِتْيَانِهِ اجْعَلُوا بِضَاعَتَهُمْ فِي رِحَالِهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَعْرِفُونَهَا اِذَا انقَلَبُوا اِلَىٰ اَهْلِهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: When they returned to their father, they said: O father, we have been prohibited from getting the grain again, so (next time) send our brother Benjamin (with us), so that we can bring the grain (again), and we will fully protect him.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوا اِلَىٰ اَبِيهِمْ قَالُوا يَا اَبَانَا مُنِعَ مِنَّا الْكَيْلُ فَاَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا اَخَانَا نَكْتَلْ وَاِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ

verses.english_text: Yaqoob said: Shall I trust you for him, like I have trusted you before for his brother (Yusuf)? (Anyway) Allah is his best protector, and He shows Mercy more than anybody else.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ هَلْ آمَنُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ اِلَّا كَمَا اَمِنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ اَخِيهِ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ فَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ حَافِظًا وَهُوَ اَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

verses.english_text: When they opened their luggage and they found their money was returned as it was. (they went to their father and said), O father, what else we want, our money has been returned to us; and we have also brought grain for our families. (now send Benjamin with us) we will protect him and will bring one load of camel more and what we brought this time was less, and his presence will make this easier.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا فَتَحُوا مَتَاعَهُمْ وَجَدُوا بِضَاعَتَهُمْ رُدَّتْ اِلَيْهِمْ ۖ قَالُوا يَا اَبَانَا مَا نَبْغِي ۖ هَٰذِهِ بِضَاعَتُنَا رُدَّتْ اِلَيْنَا وَنَمِيرُ اَهْلَنَا وَنَحْفَظُ اَخَانَا وَنَزْدَادُ كَيْلَ بَعِيرٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ كَيْلٌ يَسِيرٌ

verses.english_text: Yaqoob said: Unless you will not make covenant in the name of Allah that you will bring him back without any harm, but only if you are surrounded in trouble yourself; I will not send him with you, then they made covenant that whatever they are saying Allah is witness to it.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَنْ اُرْسِلَهُ مَعَكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تُؤْتُونِ مَوْثِقًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ لَتَاْتُنَّنِي بِهِ اِلَّا اَن يُحَاطَ بِكُمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا آتَوْهُ مَوْثِقَهُمْ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٌ

verses.english_text: And Yaqoob said to his sons: do not enter all together from one door, but enter (separately) from different doors, because I cannot avert the trouble which may befall on you from Allah; command is from Allah only and I have reposed my trust in Him; and all those who trust should trust in Him.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ يَا بَنِيَّ لَا تَدْخُلُوا مِن بَابٍ وَاحِدٍ وَادْخُلُوا مِنْ اَبْوَابٍ مُّتَفَرِّقَةٍ وَ مَا اُغْنِي عَنكُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ مِن شَيْءٍ ۖ اِنِ الْحُكْمُ اِلَّا لِلّٰهِ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَعَلَيْهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ

verses.english_text: And when all the brothers entered (in Egypt) as per direction of their father, but Yaqoob could not avert the command of Allah which was to come, but there was a desire in his heart which he fulfilled in this way; because Verily We have given knowledge to him, but many of them does not know even this.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا مِنْ حَيْثُ اَمَرَهُمْ اَبُوهُمْ مَا كَانَ يُغْنِي عَنْهُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ مِن شَيْءٍ اِلَّا حَاجَةً فِي نَفْسِ يَعْقُوبَ قَضَاهَا ۚ وَاِنَّهُ لَذُو عِلْمٍ لِّمَا عَلَّمْنَاهُ وَلَٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And when they reached Yusuf, he made his real brother sit beside him, and slyly told him: I am your brother; therefore, do not be sad about what they do.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ آوَىٰ اِلَيْهِ اَخَاهُ قَالَ اِنِّي اَنَا اَخُوكَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: When Yusuf asked to make their travel arrangement (grain, etc.). (on Yusuf's instruction) they hid a water bowl in the sack of his brother (Benjamin); then a crier challenged them: O people of caravan Verily you are thieves.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمْ جَعَلَ السِّقَايَةَ فِي رَحْلِ اَخِيهِ ثُمَّ اَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ اَيَّتُهَا الْعِيرُ اِنَّكُمْ لَسَارِقُونَ

verses.english_text: (On hearing this), they turned towards them and asked: what have you lost?
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا وَاَقْبَلُوا عَلَيْهِم مَّاذَا تَفْقِدُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: we are not finding a bowl of the king, and I am responsible that whoever will bring that bowl I will give him a camel-load (of grain) as reward.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا نَفْقِدُ صُوَاعَ الْمَلِكِ وَلِمَن جَاءَ بِهِ حِمْلُ بَعِيرٍ وَاَنَا بِهِ زَعِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Then they said: By Allah we did not come to your land to create mischief, we are not thieves.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتُم مَّا جِئْنَا لِنُفْسِدَ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا كُنَّا سَارِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Then those servants asked if your lies are proved, what will be the punishment of the liar?
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا فَمَا جَزَاؤُهُ اِن كُنتُمْ كَاذِبِينَ

verses.english_text: They (fearlessly) said, from whoever's sack the bowl is found, he will himself be the reward of that (he will be taken into slavery), we punish the unjust (thieves) in our land like this.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا جَزَاؤُهُ مَن وُجِدَ فِي رَحْلِهِ فَهُوَ جَزَاؤُهُ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الظَّالِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Yusuf, before searching his (real) brother's sack, he searched other brothers' sacks, and in the end, he took out bowl from his (real) brother's luggage, to withhold his brother We taught the planning to Yusuf; otherwise as per king's laws, he could not have withheld him, but only if Allah wills; (thus Benjamin was withheld) We raise the rank of whosoever we please; there is also all-knowing one above all the knowledgeable of the world.
verses.arabic_text: فَبَدَاَ بِاَوْعِيَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعَاءِ اَخِيهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَخْرَجَهَا مِن وِعَاءِ اَخِيهِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كِدْنَا لِيُوسُفَ ۖ مَا كَانَ لِيَاْخُذَ اَخَاهُ فِي دِينِ الْمَلِكِ اِلَّا اَن يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَاتٍ مَّن نَّشَاءُ ۗ وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِي عِلْمٍ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: They said: if he stole. (there is no surprise), before him his brother (Yusuf) had stolen, Yusuf concealed it in his heart (and did not reply) and did not disclose it to them, but he said that you are in an evil condition as what you describe for your brother.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا اِن يَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ اَخٌ لَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ فَاَسَرَّهَا يُوسُفُ فِي نَفْسِهِ وَلَمْ يُبْدِهَا لَهُمْ ۚ قَالَ اَنتُمْ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَاللَّهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: O Aziz (mighty one of Egypt - 'Aziz-e-Misr') his father is very old and love him very much; so retain one of us instead (as slave, and let him go); because we consider you as great doer of good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا يَا اَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ اِنَّ لَهُ اَبًا شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا فَخُذْ اَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهُ ۖ اِنَّا نَرَاكَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Yusuf said: Allah forbid, how can we withheld someone else other than from whose sack the bowl was found, if we do this we will be considered unjust.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ اَن نَّاْخُذَ اِلَّا مَن وَجَدْنَا مَتَاعَنَا عِندَهُ اِنَّا اِذًا لَّظَالِمُونَ

verses.english_text: When they were disappointed by Yusuf, they stepped aside for discussion privately among them; eldest among them said: O brothers, don't you know that our father has taken covenant in the name of Allah from us, and before this what mistake you have done about Yusuf, unless my father does not allow or Allah command Himself, I won't leave this land, and Allah is best to command.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْاَسُوا مِنْهُ خَلَصُوا نَجِيًّا ۖ قَالَ كَبِيرُهُمْ اَلَمْ تَعْلَمُوا اَنَّ اَبَاكُمْ قَدْ اَخَذَ عَلَيْكُم مَّوْثِقًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ مَا فَرَّطتُمْ فِي يُوسُفَ ۖ فَلَنْ اَبْرَحَ الْاَرْضَ حَتَّىٰ يَاْذَنَ لِي اَبِي اَوْ يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ لِي ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحَاكِمِينَ

verses.english_text: You return to father and inform him that your son stole, and the covenant we had to bring him back, but we were not the guardian of the unseen.
verses.arabic_text: ارْجِعُوا اِلَىٰ اَبِيكُمْ فَقُولُوا يَا اَبَانَا اِنَّ ابْنَكَ سَرَقَ وَ مَا شَهِدْنَا اِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمْنَا وَ مَا كُنَّا لِلْغَيْبِ حَافِظِينَ

verses.english_text: You may ask the people of the land in which we were, and also from the people of caravan with which we travelled that we Verily are truthful.
verses.arabic_text: وَاسْاَلِ الْقَرْيَةَ الَّتِي كُنَّا فِيهَا وَالْعِيرَ الَّتِي اَقْبَلْنَا فِيهَا وَاِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ

verses.english_text: (When they went back and described) Yaqoob said: (he did not steal) but you forged it with your heart, so I have patience and thanks Allah, I hope Allah will cause to reach to me all my sons, Verily He is knowing and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ اَنفُسُكُمْ اَمْرًا ۖ فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ ۖ عَسَى اللَّهُ اَن يَاْتِيَنِي بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا ۚ اِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: And Yaqoob turned his face from them and said weeping: Alas! Yusuf, and cried so much that his eyes turned white with sadness; and he was a great suppresser of the grief.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَا اَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَابْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ

verses.english_text: His sons said: You always remember Yusuf so much that you may fall sick or you might die.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا تَاللَّهِ تَفْتَاُ تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا اَوْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْهَالِكِينَ

verses.english_text: Yaqoob said: (I do not say anything to you), I complain of uneasiness and sadness to my Allah, and whatever I know from Allah, you do not know.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنَّمَا اَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي اِلَى اللَّهِ وَاَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: O my sons! Go (to Egypt again) and find and bring Yusuf and his brother, and do not be hopeless from the mercy of Allah, because nobody becomes hopeless from the mercy of Allah except infidels.
verses.arabic_text: يَا بَنِيَّ اذْهَبُوا فَتَحَسَّسُوا مِن يُوسُفَ وَاَخِيهِ وَلَا تَيْاَسُوا مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ ۖ اِنَّهُ لَا يَيْاَسُ مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ اِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكَافِرُونَ

verses.english_text: When they went to Yusuf again (third time) they said: O mighty one (of Egypt - 'Aziz-e-Misr') we and our families are facing difficulties due to drought, and we have brought some money, ask them to give us full grain, and not only in exchange of money, but as charity and alms also, Verily Allah reward those who do charity.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ قَالُوا يَا اَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ مَسَّنَا وَاَهْلَنَا الضُّرُّ وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَاعَةٍ مُّزْجَاةٍ فَاَوْفِ لَنَا الْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ اِنَّ اللَّهَ يَجْزِي الْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ

verses.english_text: (Now Yusuf could not control and said) You know what you have done to Yusuf and his brother when you were ignorant.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ هَلْ عَلِمْتُم مَّا فَعَلْتُم بِیُوسُفَ وَاَخِيهِ اِذْ اَنتُمْ جَاهِلُونَ

verses.english_text: (They were surprised on hearing this and) said: are you our brother Yusuf? (Said Yusuf) Yes, I am Yusuf and this is my brother, Verily Allah bestowed Mercy on me and Verily whoever fears Him and has patience (on difficulties), so Allah never waste the reward of such people.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا اَاِنَّكَ لَاَنتَ يُوسُفُ ۖ قَالَ اَنَا يُوسُفُ وَهَٰذَا اَخِي ۖ قَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا ۖ اِنَّهُ مَن يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ اَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: They said certainly Allah gave you superiority over us and Verily, we were completely at fault.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ آثَرَكَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَاِن كُنَّا لَخَاطِئِينَ

verses.english_text: Yusuf said: Now from today there is no blame on you, Allah may forgive you, Allah is Merciful than anyone else.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ ۖ يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَهُوَ اَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Take my shirt and go and put it on the face of (our) father so he will be able to see, and come (back) to me with all your family members.
verses.arabic_text: اذْهَبُوا بِقَمِيصِي هَٰذَا فَاَلْقُوهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِ اَبِي يَاْتِ بَصِيرًا وَاْتُونِي بِاَهْلِكُمْ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: As soon as the caravan started from Egypt, then their father (Yaqoob) said, if you don’t consider me weak (from mind), I can feel the smell of Yusuf.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ الْعِيرُ قَالَ اَبُوهُمْ اِنِّي لَاَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ لَوْلَا اَن تُفَنِّدُونِ

verses.english_text: They said: By Allah, you are still in the same old error.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا تَاللَّهِ اِنَّكَ لَفِي ضَلَالِكَ الْقَدِيمِ

verses.english_text: Then came the giver of good news, and put the shirt on his face, and Yaqoob immediately regained his eyesight; then Yaqoob told his sons: did not I was saying whatever matter I know from Allah, you don't know.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا اَن جَاءَ الْبَشِيرُ اَلْقَاهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ فَارْتَدَّ بَصِيرًا ۖ قَالَ اَلَمْ اَقُل لَّكُمْ اِنِّي اَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: O father, pray for our forgiveness (in the Court of Allah), we are totally at fault.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوا يَا اَبَانَا اسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا اِنَّا كُنَّا خَاطِئِينَ

verses.english_text: Yaqoob said: very soon I will pray to Allah for your forgiveness, undoubtedly, He is very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ سَوْفَ اَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّي ۖ اِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: When those people (Yaqoob and his clan reached and Yusuf came out to receive them) reach to Yusuf, he made them sit beside him and said: if Allah pleases, now enter peacefully in Egypt.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ آوَىٰ اِلَيْهِ اَبَوَيْهِ وَقَالَ ادْخُلُوا مِصْرَ اِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ آمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Finally he made them sit on the throne, and they all fell in prostration before him in his honor, he said, O father, this is the interpretation (of my dream) which my Lord has made it come true; Verily He did do favor to me, when He delivered me from prison, in spite of Satan created mischief between me and my brothers, He brought you people from village (to me in the town); Verily my Lord plans well for whatever He pleases to do; indeed, He is Knowing and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: وَرَفَعَ اَبَوَيْهِ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوا لَهُ سُجَّدًا ۖ وَقَالَ يَا اَبَتِ هَٰذَا تَاْوِيلُ رُؤْيَايَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ قَدْ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّي حَقًّا ۖ وَ قَدْ اَحْسَنَ بِي اِذْ اَخْرَجَنِي مِنَ السِّجْنِ وَجَاءَ بِكُم مِّنَ الْبَدْوِ مِن بَعْدِ اَن نَّزَغَ الشَّيْطَانُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ اِخْوَتِي ۚ اِنَّ رَبِّي لَطِيفٌ لِّمَا يَشَاءُ ۚ اِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: (Later Yusuf prayed) O my Lord, You also granted me kingdom, you also taught me interpretation of dreams, O Creator of skies and the earth, You are my Master and my Guardian in the world and in the Hereafter; let me die as a Muslim and count me with the righteous ones.
verses.arabic_text: رَبِّ قَدْ آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِي مِن تَاْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِيثِ ۚ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۖ اَنتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ ۖ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَاَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), this tale is from the unseen, which we sent to you as revelation (and you come to know), when Yusuf's brothers were discussing among themselves and planning (to kill him).
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ اَنبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ اِلَيْكَ ۖ وَ مَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ اِذْ اَجْمَعُوا اَمْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَمْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: You were not present there, and how much you may say, but most of the people are not going to believe.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا اَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ وَ لَوْ حَرَصْتَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: However, you do not ask for any reward (for propagation of prophethood); and this (Quran) is admonition for the entire world.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا تَسْاَلُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ ۚ اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And there are many signs in the skies and the earth which they pass by (day and night), but they turn their face from it.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَاَيِّن مِّنْ آيَةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهَا وَهُمْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضُونَ

verses.english_text: And such is the condition of most of the people that they don't believe in Allah but they make out His partners.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يُؤْمِنُ اَكْثَرُهُم بِاللَّهِ اِلَّا وَهُم مُّشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: Are they satisfied that punishment of Allah befalls on them and become cover over them; or suddenly the Day of Judgment comes on them without any notice.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَاَمِنُوا اَن تَاْتِيَهُمْ غَاشِيَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ اَوْ تَاْتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet say: my way is to call (the people) towards Allah, I and my followers (both) are on strong arguments, and Allah is pure and purer (from all defect and deficiency) and I am not from polytheists.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ هَٰذِهِ سَبِيلِي اَدْعُو اِلَى اللَّهِ ۚ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ اَنَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَنِي ۖ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَ مَا اَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), before you also We have sent some village dweller men (as messengers), on whom We sent revelations; so didn't these people who walk on the land ponder that what happened to those who had passed by; and those who guarded themselves (from sins), reward of the Hereafter for them is comparatively better (than this world), don't they understand?
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا اَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِي اِلَيْهِم مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْقُرَىٰ ۗ اَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْاَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۗ وَلَدَارُ الْآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا ۗ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: (Earlier messengers propagated so much) that when they were disappointed (because people didn't believe them) and they understood that they have been denied, Our help reached them; and We delivered whosoever We pleased; and Our punishment cannot be averted from the sinners.
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰ اِذَا اسْتَيْاَسَ الرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوا اَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُوا جَاءَهُمْ نَصْرُنَا فَنُجِّيَ مَن نَّشَاءُ ۖ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَاْسُنَا عَنِ الْقَوْمِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Undoubtedly, in their tales there are lesson (and advice) for the knowledgeable people, this (Quran) is not any narrative which can be forged, rather it confirms the earlier books, and it describes everything and for believers it is guidance and mercy.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِّاُولِي الْاَلْبَابِ ۗ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثًا يُفْتَرَىٰ وَلَٰكِن تَصْدِيقَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Alif Laam Meem Ra, these are the perfect verses of the Book which your Lord has revealed to you, but most of the people do not believe.
verses.arabic_text: الٓمٓر ۚ تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ الْكِتٰبِ ۗ وَالَّذِىٓ اُنزِلَ اِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ الْحَقُّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah which have raised the skies without any pillar which you see; He is firmly established on Throne; and He made sun and the moon to obey Him, that they rotate for fixed period, He regulates all affairs of the world and describes His verses with details so that you may believe that (one day) you will be presented before your Lord.
verses.arabic_text: اللّٰهُ الَّذِى رَفَعَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍۢ تَرَوْنَهَا ۖ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِاَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ يُدَبِّرُ الْاَمْرَ يُفَصِّلُ الْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّكُمْ تُوقِنُونَ

verses.english_text: He is Allah who spread the earth and established mountains on it, and made rivers to flow, and made pairs of fruits, and covers the day with the veil of night, and signs are found in it for the people who ponder.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِى مَدَّ الْاَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَاَنْهَـٰرًا ۖ وَمِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَٰتِ جَعَلَ فِيهَا زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ ۖ يُغْشِى الَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: And different pieces of land which are adjacent to each other; and gardens of grapes are there and farming and date trees, some of them have two branches and some of them have single branch; and all of them are irrigated with one water; and We give preference to some fruits over some fruits for eating; and in it signs are also found for the wise people.
verses.arabic_text: وَفِى الْاَرْضِ قِطَعٌۭ مُّتَجَـٰوِرَٰتٌۭ وَجَنَّـٰتٌۭ مِّنْ اَعْنَـٰبٍۢ وَزَرْعٌۭ وَنَخِيلٌۭ صِنْوَانٌۭ وَغَيْرُ صِنْوَانٍۢ يُسْقَىٰ بِمَآءٍۢ وَٰحِدٍۢ وَنُفَضِّلُ بَعْضَهَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فِى الْاُكُلِ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: If you wonder (on anything), then you should wonder, on saying of infidels that 'after mingling with dust how we will come to life again', these are the people who disbelieved in Allah, and there will be shackles in their necks (on the Day of Judgement), these are the Hellish people and shall abide in it forever.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَاِن تَعْجَبْ فَعَجَبٌۭ قَوْلُهُمْ اَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًا اَءِنَّا لَفِى خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍ ۗ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الْاَغْلَـٰلُ فِىٓ اَعْنَاقِهِمْ ۖ وَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ اَصْحَـٰبُ النَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet) they ask you for hastening on the evil before good; however, many punishments had earlier befallen earlier (on many people), and Verily your Lord is very Forgiving, in spite of people's injustice, and undoubtedly your Lord is giver of severe punishment also.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ وَ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِمُ الْمَثُلَـٰتُ ۗ وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍۢ لِّلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ ظُلْمِهِمْ ۖ وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَشَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
