verses.english_text: And these infidels say why does not any sign come to them; then say: you are only a warner; and there is a guide for every nation.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوْلَآ اُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِٓ ۗ اِنَّمَآ اَنتَ مُنذِرٌۭ ۖ وَلِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ هَادٍ

verses.english_text: And Allah knows what is in the womb of a woman, and what things continue to decrease or continue to increase in her womb, and before Him everything is with a fixed measure.
verses.arabic_text: اللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ اُنثَىٰ وَ مَا تَغِيضُ الْاَرْحَامُ وَ مَا تَزْدَادُ ۖ وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ عِندَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ

verses.english_text: He knows the hidden and the obvious, and He is the Great and Most High.
verses.arabic_text: عَـٰلِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَـٰدَةِ الْكَبِيرُ الْمُتَعَالِ

verses.english_text: Anyone among you who calls upon Him silently or loudly, and who has hidden himself in the darkness of night, and is walking in daylight, everything is the same for Him. (He hears all and sees all).
verses.arabic_text: سَوَآءٌۭ مِّنكُم مَّنْ اَسَرَّ الْقَوْلَ وَمَن جَهَرَ بِهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ مُسْتَخْفٍۭ بِالَّيْلِ وَسَارِبٌۢ بِالنَّهَارِ

verses.english_text: (You may be in any condition), there are forces angels are appointed as guardians to protect him from front and from the back by His command; and He does not change condition of a people unless they themselves change; and when Allah decides to punish somebody then nobody can avert it and neither they do have any guardian except Him.
verses.arabic_text: لَهُ مُعَقِّبَـٰتٌۭ مِّنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ يَحْفَظُونَهُ مِنْ اَمْرِ اللّٰهِ ۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُواْ مَا بِاَنفُسِهِمْ ۗ وَاِذَآ اَرَادَ اللّٰهُ بِقَوْمٍۢ سُوٓءًۭا فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ ۚ وَ مَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِ مِن وَالٍ

verses.english_text: It is Allah who shows lightnings and creates water-laden heavy clouds as warning and luring.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِى يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًۭا وَطَمَعًۭا وَيُنشِئُ السَّحَابَ الثِّقَالَ

verses.english_text: Thundering repeats His praise, and angels continue praising Him with His fear, and when He sends lightning, it strikes to whoever He pleases; and they talk for Allah with crookedness; whereas He has strong power and has mighty strength.
verses.arabic_text: وَيُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ وَيُرْسِلُ الصَّوَٰعِقَ فَيُصِيبُ بِهَا مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُمْ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِى اللّٰهِ وَهُوَ شَدِيدُ الْمِحَالِ

verses.english_text: Calling is call to Allah only; and those people who call to others except Allah, nothing will be accepted from them; it is like the person who stretches his palm towards water that it may reach his mouth, but it will never reach, and prayers of infidels are always in misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: لَهُ دَعْوَةُ الْحَقِّ ۖ وَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ لَا يَسْتَجِيبُونَ لَهُم بِشَىْءٍ اِلَّا كَبَـٰسِطِ كَفَّيْهِ اِلَى الْمَآءِ لِيَبْلُغَ فَاهُ وَ مَا هُوَ بِبَـٰلِغِهِ ۚ وَ مَا دُعَآءُ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ اِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ

verses.english_text: All of the beings of skies and the earth are prostrating for Allah either willingly or unwillingly, and morning and evening their shadows are also prostrating.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِلّٰهِ يَسْجُدُ مَن فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ طَوْعًۭا وَكَرْهًۭا وَظِلَـٰلُهُم بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْـَٔاصَالِ ۩

verses.english_text: {Prostrate, Non-Obligatory} O Prophet, ask: who is the Lord of skies and the earth? And inform them, that is only Allah, and say: to whom you adopt leaving Allah, they are neither beneficial nor harmful even for themselves, and ask (them): can blind and seeing-one be alike; or can light and darkness be equal; or whom they consider partner of Allah have they created a similar world, and (Our) creation have become doubtful (for them), say: only Allah has created everything; He is the One and Predominant over all.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ قُلِ اللّٰهُ ۚ قُلْ اَفَاتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِهِٓ اَوْلِيَآءَ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِاَنفُسِهِمْ نَفْعًۭا وَلَا ضَرًّۭا ۚ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى الْاَعْمَىٰ وَالْبَصِيرُ اَمْ هَلْ تَسْتَوِى الظُّلُمَـٰتُ وَالنُّورُ ۗ اَمْ جَعَلُواْ لِلّٰهِ شُرَكَآءَ خَلَقُواْ كَخَلْقِهِ فَتَشَـٰبَهَ الْخَلْقُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ قُلِ اللّٰهُ خَـٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ الْوَٰحِدُ الْقَهَّـٰرُ

verses.english_text: He rains water from the sky, then watercourses flow according to their measure; and it created waves in deluge and foam was formed, and foam formed from the metal which was melted in fire to make ornaments and other things; like this Allah describes the just and the unjust; foam dries and vanish away, and whatever is beneficial for mankind remains on the land; and likewise Allah describes the examples.
verses.arabic_text: اَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَسَالَتْ اَوْدِيَةٌۢ بِقَدَرِهَا فَاحْتَمَلَ السَّيْلُ زَبَدًۭا رَّابِيًۭا ۚ وَمِمَّا يُوقِدُونَ عَلَيْهِ فِى النَّارِ ابْتِغَآءَ حِلْيَةٍ اَوْ مَتَـٰعٍۢ زَبَدٌۭ مِّثْلُهُ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللّٰهُ الْحَقَّ وَالْبَـٰطِلَ ۚ فَاَمَّا الزَّبَدُ فَيَذْهَبُ جُفَآءًۭ ۖ وَاَمَّا مَا يَنفَعُ النَّاسَ فَيَمْكُثُ فِى الْاَرْضِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللّٰهُ الْاَمْثَالَ

verses.english_text: Those who accept the words of Allah, there is good for them, those who do not accept His words, if they get all the treasures of the world, and they get similarly more, and they give everything as ransom; but their reckoning will be the worst, and their place is Hell, and it is a very evil place.
verses.arabic_text: لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُواْ لِرَبِّهِمُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُواْ لَهُ لَوْ اَنَّ لَهُم مَّا فِى الْاَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافْتَدَوْاْ بِهِٓ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ الْحِسَابِ وَمَاْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ

verses.english_text: Can the person who knows whatever has been revealed to you from the Lord is the truth, be like him who is blind? (Never, but) Only wise-ones would understand.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اَفَمَن يَعْلَمُ اَنَّمَآ اُنزِلَ اِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ الْحَقُّ كَمَنْ هُوَ اَعْمَىٰٓ ۚ اِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ اُو۟لُواْ الْاَلْبَـٰبِ

verses.english_text: Those who honor the covenant with Allah, they never break the covenant.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يُوفُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللّٰهِ وَلَا يَنقُضُونَ الْمِيثَـٰقَ

verses.english_text: Those who maintain such relations which have been commanded by Allah and are fearful of Him and fear the severe reckoning.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ مَآ اَمَرَ اللّٰهُ بِهِٓ اَن يُوصَلَ وَيَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ وَيَخَافُونَ سُوٓءَ الْحِسَابِ

verses.english_text: And those who had patience for the Will of Allah and established prayer; and (in the way of Allah) spends openly and secretly from the sustenance given by Us; and repels evil with good; abode of the Hereafter is for them only.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ ابْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِمْ وَاَقَامُواْ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَاَنفَقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ السَّيِّئَةَ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ

verses.english_text: These are the everlasting gardens, in which they will enter, and along with them from among their forefathers, ancestors, spouses and children the good servants (of Allah) will enter; and angels will be at their service from every door.
verses.arabic_text: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ يَدْخُلُونَهَا وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَاَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمْ ۖ وَالْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن كُلِّ بَابٍۢ

verses.english_text: They will say: salutations to you that you had patience, now abode of the Hereafter is your best destination.
verses.arabic_text: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُم بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ ۚ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ

verses.english_text: And those who break covenant, and breaks the relation from those, with whom they were commanded to maintain the relation, and create mischief in the land, for them there is curses and evil abode.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ اللّٰهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مِيثَـٰقِهِ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَآ اَمَرَ اللّٰهُ بِهِٓ اَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِى الْاَرْضِ ۙ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوٓءُ الدَّارِ

verses.english_text: Allah amplifies or straitens the sustenance for whom as He pleases; these people are happy on the life of this world; whereas in comparison to the Hereafter life of this world is a temporary enjoyment, and that's it.
verses.arabic_text: اللّٰهُ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ وَفَرِحُواْ بِالْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا وَ مَا الْحَيَوٰةُ الدُّنْيَا فِى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ اِلَّا مَتَـٰعٌۭ

verses.english_text: And infidels say why do not signs of their choice come to them, O Prophet say: to whoever Allah wills leave him in misguidance; and He guides those who turn to Him.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوْلَآ اُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِ ۗ قُلْ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ اِلَيْهِ مَنْ اَنَابَ

verses.english_text: These are the people who believed, and their hearts get satisfied with the remembrance of Allah, and be aware that satisfaction is with remembrance of Allah only.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ اللّٰهِ ۗ اَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللّٰهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ

verses.english_text: Those who believed and did good works, for them is the best place (Paradise) and best return.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ طُوبَىٰ لَهُمْ وَحُسْنُ مَـَٔابٍۢ

verses.english_text: Likewise, We sent you among a people where many a people have passed, so that you recite the things which We sent you through revelation, however, they will deny the Merciful, you say: He is my Lord and there is no god except Him, I rely on him and to Him is our return.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ اَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ فِىٓ اُمَّةٍۢ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهَآ اُمَمٌۭ لِّتَتْلُوَاْ عَلَيْهِمُ الَّذِىٓ اَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَيْكَ وَهُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ بِالرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ قُلْ هُوَ رَبِّى لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَاِلَيْهِ مَتَابِ

verses.english_text: If there is such Quran which can move mountains from their place, or can be travelled on the land, or dead can be talked with. (this is that Quran), however, all the affairs are for Allah, does it not became clear to the believers; that if Allah pleased He would have guided all the people; and on these infidels troubles of some kind or other will continue to befall them because of their deeds; or troubles shall befell on their region; until the time of promise of Allah comes, because Allah never does against His promise.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ اَنَّ قُرْءَانًۭا سُيِّرَتْ بِهِ الْجِبَالُ اَوْ قُطِّعَتْ بِهِ الْاَرْضُ اَوْ كُلِّمَ بِهِ الْمَوْتَىٰ ۗ بَل لِّلَّهِ الْاَمْرُ جَمِيعًا ۗ اَفَلَمْ يَاْيْـَٔسِ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ اللّٰهُ لَهَدَى النَّاسَ جَمِيعًۭا ۗ وَلَا يَزَالُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ تُصِيبُهُم بِمَا صَنَعُواْ قَارِعَةٌ اَوْ تَحُلُّ قَرِيبًۭا مِّن دَارِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَاْتِىَ وَعْدُ اللّٰهِ ۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Before you, many prophets were mocked at, We gave small respite to the infidels, and thereafter took them in Our grip, so what a severe punishment it was.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَاَمْلَيْتُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ثُمَّ اَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ

verses.english_text: That is He Who watches the deeds of every soul; and they have forged partners for Him, then say: tell the names of His partners, you are informing Him about His partners, about whom He does not have any news in the whole land, these are only the words. (whereas) fact is that their planning has been decorated for them, and they have been barred from guidance, and to whom Allah does not guide, nobody can guide him.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَمَنْ هُوَ قَآئِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۗ وَجَعَلُواْ لِلّٰهِ شُرَكَآءَ قُلْ سَمُّوهُمْ ۚ اَمْ تُنَبِّـُٔونَهُ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِى الْاَرْضِ اَم بِظَـٰهِرٍۢ مِّنَ الْقَوْلِ ۗ بَلْ زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مَكْرُهُمْ وَصُدُّواْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍۢ

verses.english_text: There is punishment for them in the life of this world also, and punishment of the Hereafter is even more severe, and then there is no one to save (them) from Allah.
verses.arabic_text: لَّهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ فِى الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ اَشَقُّ ۖ وَ مَا لَهُم مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِن وَاقٍۢ

verses.english_text: The Paradise, which the pious people have been promised, will be like this, that beneath which rivers will be flowing, and its fruits will be permanent; and shadow will be everlasting; such is the end of the pious ones, and the end of the infidels is Hell.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ مَّثَلُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِى وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ اُكُلُهَا دَآئِمٌۭ وَظِلُّهَا ۚ تِلْكَ عُقْبَى الَّذِينَ اتَّقَواْ ۖ وَّعُقْبَى الْكَـٰفِرِينَ النَّارُ

verses.english_text: And to whom We gave the book they are happy with its revelation, and there are some groups which deny some part of it, so say: I have been ordained to worship Allah, and not to make anybody His partner, and to Him I invite (you), and to Him is the return of everybody.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَآ اُنزِلَ اِلَيْكَ ۖ وَمِنَ الْاَحْزَابِ مَن يُنكِرُ بَعْضَهُ ۚ قُلْ اِنَّمَآ اُمِرْتُ اَنْ اَعْبُدَ اللّٰهَ وَلَآ اُشْرِكَ بِهِٓ ۚ اِلَيْهِ اَدْعُواْ وَاِلَيْهِ مَـَٔابِ

verses.english_text: And thus We revealed the Quran as command in Arabic language, and after receiving knowledge if you will follow their desires; so there will not be any guardian and defender against Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ اَنزَلْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًا عَرَبِيًّۭا ۚ وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ اَهْوَآءَهُم بَعْدَ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ اللّٰهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا وَاقٍۢ

verses.english_text: Before you, We have sent many messengers and given wives and children to them, and it is not possible for any messenger that without command of Allah he can bring any sign, and for every period and term there is decree (from Allah).
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًۭا مِّن قَبْلِكَ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ اَزْوَٰجًۭا وَذُرِّيَّةًۭ ۚ وَ مَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ اَن يَاْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ ۗ لِكُلِّ اَجَلٍۢ كِتَابٌۭ

verses.english_text: And whatever Allah pleases He erases or maintains, that the real Book is with Him only.
verses.arabic_text: يَمْحُواْ اللّٰهُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيُثْبِتُ ۖ وَعِندَهُٓ اُمُّ الْكِتٰبِ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet, whether We show you Our promise of punishment of infidels, or may cause death to you; your mission is only to deliver the command (of Allah), and their accounting is Our responsibility.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن مَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ اَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَاِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلَـٰغُ وَعَلَيْنَا الْحِسَابُ

verses.english_text: Didn't they see how We reduce the land from all directions (with victory of Islam), and only Allah gives the command, no one can avert His command, and He is swift in taking account.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ اَنَّا نَاْتِى الْاَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ اَطْرَافِهَا ۚ وَاللّٰهُ يَحْكُمُ لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكْمِهِ ۚ وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ

verses.english_text: And those who were before them Verily did they plan, but reward for their planning is with Allah, He is aware of the deeds of every soul, shortly infidels will also know that good of the Hereafter is for whom.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَدْ مَكَرَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَلِلّٰهِ الْمَكْرُ جَمِيعًۭا ۖ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ الْكُفَّـٰرُ لِمَنْ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), infidels say that you are not a Prophet, so say: Allah and the person who has knowledge of the Book is sufficient for witness between me and you.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَسْتَ مُرْسَلًۭا ۚ قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِاللّٰهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَمَنْ عِندَهُ عِلْمُ الْكِتٰبِ

verses.english_text: Alif Laam Ra. (O Prophet) this Quran is the Book which We have revealed to you so that with the command of Allah you bring the people out of darkness of infidelity to the light of believing; guide them to the path of that Who is Predominant and worthy of Praise.
verses.arabic_text: الٓر ۚ كِتٰبٌ اَنزَلْنَـٰهُ اِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ النَّاسَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَـٰتِ اِلَى النُّورِ بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ اِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ

verses.english_text: Allah is that who is the owner of whatever is in the skies and on the earth (means everything), but alas! there is severe punishment for the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: اللّٰهِ الَّذِى لَهُ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ ۗ وَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍ

verses.english_text: Those infidels who prefer life of this world over the Hereafter, and hinder people from the path of Allah, and wants to create crookedness in it, these are the people who are in utter misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يَسْتَحِبُّونَ الْحَيَوٰةَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: And We did not send any prophet to the people but who spoke their language, so that he may explain Our commands to them, Allah leaves in misguidance to whoever He pleases, and guides to whoever He pleases; and He is Predominant over everybody and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَآ اَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ اِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ ۖ فَيُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: And We sent Moosa with Our signs. (and ordained him) to bring his people from darkness (of infidelity) to the light (of believing); and remind them of those days (wherein Allah's sent down His blessings), there is no doubt that there are many signs (of Allah) in it for those who are patient and are thankful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ اَنْ اَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَـٰتِ اِلَى النُّورِ وَذَكِّرْهُم بِاَيَّىٰمِ اللّٰهِ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍۢ

verses.english_text: And remind them the time when Moosa said to his people: remembers the favors of Allah, when He delivered you from the people of Firaun who subjected you to severe torture, he was slaying your sons but spared your women (for his service), and in it there was great trial (of your patience) from your Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ اذْكُرُواْ نِعْمَةَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ اِذْ اَنجَىٰكُم مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوٓءَ الْعَذَابِ وَيُذَبِّحُونَ اَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمْ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And (remember) when your Lord told you: If you are grateful, Verily, I will increase My favors, and if you will be ungrateful then certainly My punishment is severe.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ تَاَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَاَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ اِنَّ عَذَابِى لَشَدِيدٌۭ

verses.english_text: And Moosa told his people: if you and all the people of the earth will be ungrateful to Allah. (even then) He is Self-Sufficient and Praiseworthy.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ اِن تَكْفُرُوٓاْ اَنتُمْ وَمَن فِى الْاَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَغَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ

verses.english_text: Didn't the news of the earlier people reach you. (as) people of Nooh, Aad and Samood. (and other) who came after them, nobody knows them except Allah, messengers came to them with miracles; but these people thrust their hands into their mouth and said: you say you have been sent by Allah but we do not believe; and we are in deep doubt, towards the religion you invite us.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ يَاْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُاْ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٍۢ وَثَمُودَ ۛ وَ الَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۛ لَا يَعْلَمُهُمْ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ ۚ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَرَدُّوٓاْ اَيْدِيَهُمْ فِىٓ اَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَقَالُوٓاْ اِنَّا كَفَرْنَا بِمَآ اُرْسِلْتُم بِهِ وَاِنَّا لَفِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَنَآ اِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍۢ

verses.english_text: Their prophets said: you are doubting Allah who has created the skies and the earth, and also he calls you towards Himself so that He forgive your sins, and allow you to remain in the world till an appointed time, they said: you are a mortal like us, you want us to leave the gods whom our forefathers had worshipped, if you are truthful than bring and show us any open and explicit miracle.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قَالَتْ رُسُلُهُمْ اَفِى اللّٰهِ شَكٌّۭ فَاطِرِ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۖ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِيَغْفِرَ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمْ اِلَىٰٓ اَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ قَالُوٓاْ اِنْ اَنتُمْ اِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا تُرِيدُونَ اَن تَصُدُّونَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا فَاْتُونَا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Their prophets said in their reply: there is no doubt that we are mortals like you, but among his servants Allah shows His Grace to whoever He pleases (and bestows prophethood); and we do not have authority to bring any miracle except the command of Allah, and all the believers should rely on Allah.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَتْ لَهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ اِن نَّحْنُ اِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَمُنُّ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ۖ وَ مَا كَانَ لَنَآ اَن نَّاْتِيَكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ ۚ وَعَلَى اللّٰهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And what is in it that we should not believe because certainly He has shown us the way (of deliverance), and whatever persecution we have tolerated from you (we were patient on it), and in future also we shall be patient; and those who trust, should trust upon Allah only.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا لَنَآ اَلَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ وَ قَدْ هَدَىٰنَا سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَلَنَصْبِرَنَّ عَلَىٰ مَآ ءَاذَيْتُمُونَا ۚ وَعَلَى اللّٰهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ

verses.english_text: And who adopted infidelity they said to prophets (of their time) we will Verily expel you from our land, until you come back to our religion, their Lord revealed to them (don't be afraid) We will certainly destroy the transgressors;
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِرُسُلِهِمْ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُم مِّنْ اَرْضِنَآ اَوْ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِى مِلَّتِنَا ۖ فَاَوْحَىٰٓ اِلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ لَنُهْلِكَنَّ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And after them, Verily, We will settle you in this land; this promise is for him who is afraid to stands (to give account to Us); and who fears from (Our) punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَنُسْكِنَنَّكُمُ الْاَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامِى وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ

verses.english_text: And prophets prayed to us for their victory, and every hostile and transgressor was disappointed;
verses.arabic_text: وَاسْتَفْتَحُواْ وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: And immediately after that there is Hell and in it they will be given water mixed with pus and blood to drink.
verses.arabic_text: مِّن وَرَآئِهِ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسْقَىٰ مِن مَّآءٍۢ صَدِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: And sip by sip he will have to drink it; and he will not be able to swallow it down his throat easily; and he will see death coming from everywhere, but he will not be able to die, and immediately thereafter the punishment will become severe.
verses.arabic_text: يَتَجَرَّعُهُ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُ وَيَاْتِيهِ الْمَوْتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍۢ وَ مَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍۢ ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌۭ

verses.english_text: And those who have denied their Lord, their example is such, that their deeds are like a heap of ash, and on one stormy day a strong wind will blow it away, and whatever they did in the world nothing will be in their control; and this is utter misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: مَّثَلُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمْ ۖ اَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ كَرَمَادٍ اشْتَدَّتْ بِهِ الرِّيحُ فِى يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَقْدِرُونَ مِمَّا كَسَبُواْ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلَـٰلُ الْبَعِيدُ

verses.english_text: Didn't you notice that Allah has created the skies and the earth prudently, and if He pleases He can destroy everything and settle new creation;
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ اِن يَشَاْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَاْتِ بِخَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: And this is not difficult for Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ بِعَزِيزٍۢ

verses.english_text: And they will all come out in front of Allah on the Day of Judgement, the weak will say to those who were arrogant in the world: we had walked along with you so now can you avert some part of punishment of Allah from us, they will reply: we wish Allah would have guided us, so we also would have guided you, whether we are patient or restless, it is same for us, because we cannot escape from punishment of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَبَرَزُواْ لِلّٰهِ جَمِيعًۭا فَقَالَ الضُّعَفَـٰٓؤُاْ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوٓاْ اِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًۭا فَهَلْ اَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا مِنْ عَذَابِ اللّٰهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ قَالُواْ لَوْ هَدَىٰنَا اللّٰهُ لَهَدَيْنَـٰكُمْ ۖ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ اَجَزِعْنَآ اَمْ صَبَرْنَا مَا لَنَا مِن مَّحِيصٍۢ

verses.english_text: When their end fate will be decided (they will blame Satan), so Satan will say: Allah has promised to you was truth (which is completed), and I have also promised you but I have breached my promise, and I had no authority on you, but only I invited you towards bad deeds and you obeyed me, so don't blame me now, blame on your soul, today neither I can help you nor you can help me; and before also I hate you that you made me partner with Allah; Verily there is painful punishment for those who are disobedient.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الشَّيْطَـٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِىَ الْاَمْرُ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ الْحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمْ فَاَخْلَفْتُكُمْ ۖ وَ مَا كَانَ لِىَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍ اِلَّآ اَن دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَاسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِى ۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِى وَلُومُوٓاْ اَنفُسَكُم ۖ مَّآ اَنَا۠ بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَآ اَنتُم بِمُصْرِخِىَّ ۖ اِنِّى كَفَرْتُ بِمَآ اَشْرَكْتُمُونِ مِن قَبْلُ ۗ اِنَّ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And those who believed and did good deeds, they will enter in to the gardens of Paradise beneath which rivers will be flowing and with the command of their Lord they will forever abide in it, and gift of their meeting will be salutation.
verses.arabic_text: وَاُدْخِلَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ تَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَـٰمٌ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), didn't you see that Allah has likened goodly saying with goodly tree, whose root is strong, and its branches are reaching sky.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ ضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلًۭا كَلِمَةًۭ طَيِّبَةًۭ كَشَجَرَةٍۢ طَيِّبَةٍ اَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌۭ وَفَرْعُهَا فِى السَّمَآءِ

verses.english_text: With the command of Allah this tree bears fruits at all times, and Allah describes examples for the people so they may take advice and learn.
verses.arabic_text: تُؤْتِىٓ اُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍۭ بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهَا ۗ وَيَضْرِبُ اللّٰهُ الْاَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: And the example of evil sayings is with the evil tree (whose root is weak) which is on the ground and it should be uprooted because it does not have stability.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍۢ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ اجْتُثَّتْ مِن فَوْقِ الْاَرْضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارٍۢ

verses.english_text: Those who believed on sure talk, Allah will certainly make them stand firm in this world as well as in the Hereafter, and Allah leaves transgressors in misguidance, and Allah do whatever He pleases.
verses.arabic_text: يُثَبِّتُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِى الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ وَيُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ ۚ وَيَفْعَلُ اللّٰهُ مَا يَشَآءُ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), didn't you ponder on their condition who were ungrateful on Our favours and they pushed their people in the pit of destruction;
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِينَ بَدَّلُواْ نِعْمَتَ اللّٰهِ كُفْرًا وَاَحَلُّواْ قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ الْبَوَارِ

verses.english_text: And they all went to Hell, and what an evil place it is.
verses.arabic_text: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ

verses.english_text: And they have made similar gods; so that they deviate people from His path, say: enjoy (for a few days) eventually you have to return to Hell.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلُواْ لِلّٰهِ اَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِهِ ۗ قُلْ تَمَتَّعُواْ فَاِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمْ اِلَى النَّارِ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), tell My servants who believed: to keep up prayer, and spend from the sustenance given by Us. (in the way of Allah, whether) openly or secretly; before the establishment of the Day of Judgement where trading, friendship or love - nothing will be of any use.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لِّعِبَادِىَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يُقِيمُواْ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ مِّن قَبْلِ اَن يَاْتِىَ يَوْمٌۭ لَّا بَيْعٌۭ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَـٰلٌ

verses.english_text: That is the only Allah Who has created skies and the earth, and rained water from the sky and (through different trees) created fruits for your sustenance; and made ships subservient for you, that they sail on water from His command, and gave you authority over the rivers.
verses.arabic_text: اللّٰهُ الَّذِى خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَاَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَاَخْرَجَ بِهِ مِنَ الثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًۭا لَّكُمْ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْفُلْكَ لِتَجْرِىَ فِى الْبَحْرِ بِاَمْرِهِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْاَنْهَـٰرَ

verses.english_text: And made the sun and moon subservient to you that they always circulate; and also gave night and the day under your control.
verses.arabic_text: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيْنِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ

verses.english_text: And whatever you asked from Him, He gave you, you cannot count the favors of Allah even if you wish to, Verily mankind is unjust and ungrateful.
verses.arabic_text: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَاَلْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَاِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعْمَتَ اللّٰهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ اِنَّ الْاِنسَـٰنَ لَظَلُومٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ

verses.english_text: And (remember the time) when Ibrahim prayed: O Lord, make this city (Makkah) a place of peace, and save me and my children that we may not worship idols.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ قَالَ اِبْرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَـٰذَا الْبَلَدَ ءَامِنًۭا وَاجْنُبْنِى وَبَنِىَّ اَن نَّعْبُدَ الْاَصْنَامَ

verses.english_text: O my Lord, Verily these idols have misguided many, and whoever follow me is from me and who disobey me. (then) you are all forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: رَبِّ اِنَّهُنَّ اَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ ۖ فَمَن تَبِعَنِى فَاِنَّهُ مِنِّى ۖ وَمَنْ عَصَانِى فَاِنَّكَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: O my Lord, I have settled leaving some of my family near your Holy Home in a deserted field, that O my Lord, they may make up prayer regularly, You make some people's hearts inclined towards them. (so they may also come and settle here), and bestow upon them different fruits so they may be grateful to You.
verses.arabic_text: رَّبَّنَآ اِنِّىٓ اَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِى بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ الْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُواْ الصَّلَوٰةَ فَاجْعَلْ اَفْـِٔدَةًۭ مِّنَ النَّاسِ تَهْوِىٓ اِلَيْهِمْ وَارْزُقْهُم مِّنَ الثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: O my Lord, You are well aware of whatever we conceal and whatever we show, neither anything in skies nor on earth is hidden from Allah.
verses.arabic_text: رَبَّنَآ اِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِى وَ مَا نُعْلِنُ ۗ وَ مَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى اللّٰهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَا فِى السَّمَآءِ

verses.english_text: Thanks to Allah, who increased me by giving me two sons; Ishaq and Yaqoob, there is no doubt that Allah Hears the prayers.
verses.arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى الْكِبَرِ اِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَاِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ اِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ الدُّعَآءِ

verses.english_text: O my Lord, make me and my children obligated in prayer and O my Lord accept our supplication.
verses.arabic_text: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ الصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ

verses.english_text: O my Lord, on the day of accounting forgive me, my parents and all the believers.
verses.arabic_text: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ

verses.english_text: Never think that Allah is oblivious to deeds of infidels; (punishment did not befall just because), Allah have given them respite till on the day when their eyes will freeze.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللَّهَ غَـٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ الظَّـٰلِمُونَ ۚ اِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍۢ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ الْاَبْصَـٰرُ

verses.english_text: They will be running holding their heads; and their eyes will not return to them (they will be fixedly staring), and their hearts will be gasping void.
verses.arabic_text: مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِى رُءُوسِهِمْ لَا يَرْتَدُّ اِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ ۖ وَاَفْـِٔدَتُهُمْ هَوَآءٌۭ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), warn the people of the day, when punishment will befall them, then they will implore O my Lord give us some more respite, we will definitely respond upon your call and will follow the prophet; (they will get the reply); are not you the same people who used to swear that there is no downfall for you;
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنذِرِ النَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَاْتِيهِمُ الْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ رَبَّنَآ اَخِّرْنَآ اِلَىٰٓ اَجَلٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ نُّجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ الرُّسُلَ ۗ اَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوٓاْ اَقْسَمْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٍۢ

verses.english_text: Are not you those people who were unjust unto yourselves (by disobeying Allah), and you also stayed in their homes, whereas you had known how We dealt with them, and We told (you) examples also.
verses.arabic_text: وَسَكَنتُمْ فِى مَسَـٰكِنِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ اَنفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ الْاَمْثَالَ

verses.english_text: And the people continued their plotting; however, their plotting was watched by Allah, so strong were their plotting that the mountain will move from their place.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَدْ مَكَرُواْ مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِندَ اللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَاِن كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ الْجِبَالُ

verses.english_text: Never think that Allah will ever promise against his prophet; Verily Allah is strong avenger.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِ رُسُلَهُٓ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌۭ ذُو انتِقَامٍۢ

verses.english_text: The day when the earth will be changed with another earth and likewise skies (will also be changed with new skies); and everyone will stand in their places before One (and only) Conqueror Allah.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْاَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْاَرْضِ وَالسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ ۖ وَبَرَزُواْ لِلّٰهِ الْوَٰحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ

verses.english_text: And on that day, you will see that sinners will be tied up in chains.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَرَى الْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِى الْاَصْفَادِ

verses.english_text: Their garments will be made of pitch, and fire will cover their face from every side.
verses.arabic_text: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍۢ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ

verses.english_text: Allah will reward everyone (whether good or bad), Verily Allah is very swift in taking account.
verses.arabic_text: لِيَجْزِىَ اللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا كَسَبَتْ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ

verses.english_text: This (Quran) is a kind of information, so the people may be warned (from punishment of Allah) from it, so they should trust that Allah is the only Lord; so those who are wise should take advice from it (and also lesson).
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا بَلَـٰغٌۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُواْ بِهِ وَلِيَعْلَمُوٓاْ اَنَّمَا هُوَ اِلَـٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ اُو۟لُواْ الْاَلْبَـٰبِ

verses.english_text: Alif Laam Ra, these are (few) verses of the book (of Allah) and Quran.
verses.arabic_text: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ الْكِتٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: (A Day will come when) most of those who are infidels will think, we wish we would have been Muslims.
verses.arabic_text: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوْ كَانُواْ مُسْلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) leave them as they are; that they may eat and enjoy (life of the world for a few days) and let their desires keep them busy in play.
verses.arabic_text: ذَرْهُمْ يَاْكُلُواْ وَيَتَمَتَّعُواْ وَيُلْهِهِمُ الْاَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Shortly they will know its result, we have not destroyed any town but its term appointed was already written.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ اِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ

verses.english_text: No nation can go ahead or go back before its appointed time.
verses.arabic_text: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَ مَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet, these infidels) say: O you on whom the Quran has been revealed, you are insane.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ اِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ

verses.english_text: And if you are truthful in your saying, why don't you bring angels in front?
verses.arabic_text: لَّوْ مَا تَاْتِينَا بِالْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ اِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: We send angels openly for judgement with the punishment, and if the angels come (to them) then they will not get any respite.
verses.arabic_text: مَا نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَ مَا كَانُوٓاْ اِذًۭا مُّنظَرِينَ

verses.english_text: Certainly, We revealed Quran, and We are its Guardian.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَ اِنَّا لَهُ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) before you also we sent many prophets for earlier nations.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: No prophet came to them, but they mocked at them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يَاْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ اِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

verses.english_text: (As if) we put the misguidance, in the hearts of sinners.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ فِى قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: These infidels will not believe Quran, and this has been method of earlier people also.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ ۖ وَ قَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: And if open even one gate of the sky and they ascend to it;
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّواْ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ

verses.english_text: Yet they will say our eyes may have been distracted (hypnotized), and we have been magicked upon.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَالُوٓاْ اِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ اَبْصَـٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌۭ مَّسْحُورُونَ

verses.english_text: And only We created constellations in sky and for the watchers, decorated it (with stars).
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى السَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And safeguarded them from the passing of every accursed Satan.
verses.arabic_text: وَحَفِظْنَـٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍ

verses.english_text: But if any Satan hear them slyly, then flame of a shooting star drives them away.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ فَاَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And spread the earth and fixed it with the anchors of Mountains and grew on it all the appropriate things.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْاَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَاَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَاَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مَّوْزُونٍۢ

verses.english_text: And in it created all things for life, and (for animals also) to whom you do not give sustenance.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرَٰزِقِينَ

verses.english_text: We have got innumerable treasures of everything, and We send from it in ascertainable quantity.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن مِّن شَىْءٍ اِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُ وَ مَا نُنَزِّلُهُٓ اِلَّا بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ

verses.english_text: And we sent winds which fill clouds with water, then We rained down the water from the sky, then We gave you that water to drink, and you had not stored it.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيَـٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَاَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَاَسْقَيْنَـٰكُمُوهُ وَ مَآ اَنتُمْ لَهُ بِخَـٰزِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And there is no doubt that We give life and We give death, and then We are the Heir.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ الْوَٰرِثُونَ

verses.english_text: And We have known the people who have gone by and We also know the people who will come.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And undoubtedly your Lord is that who will bring them to life (from the graves on the Day of Judgement), and He knows and is Wise.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ اِنَّهُ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Verily, We created man from waste clay, which gives tinkling sound (upon drying).
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ

verses.english_text: And We created jinn earlier than man, from smokeless fire.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ السَّمُومِ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet) remember the time when your Lord told the angels that from kneaded clay when it will make tinkling sound I am going to create a man.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ اِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَـٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ

verses.english_text: And when will I complete it from all sides and breathe in him My Spirit; then all of you fall down before him in prostration.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُواْ لَهُ سَـٰجِدِينَ

verses.english_text: So all the angels fell down in prostration (before him).
verses.arabic_text: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ اَجْمَعُونَ

verses.english_text: Except Iblis, he refused to be among those who prostrated.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّآ اِبْلِيسَ اَبَىٰٓ اَن يَكُونَ مَعَ السَّـٰجِدِينَ

verses.english_text: (On this Allah) said: O Iblis what has happened to you that you were not among those who prostrated?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يَـٰٓاِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ اَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ السَّـٰجِدِينَ

verses.english_text: He said: I am not such a lowly that I will prostrate before a man whom you have created from waste mud which makes a tinkling sound.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَمْ اَكُن لِّاَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ

verses.english_text: (Allah) said: get out from the Paradise, Verily you are accursed.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And Verily curses shall be on you, till the day of reward.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ عَلَيْكَ اللَّعْنَةَ اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ

verses.english_text: (Iblis) said: give me the respite till the day (when You raise the people again).
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنظِرْنِىٓ اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

verses.english_text: Allah replied: you have been given respite.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنظَرِينَ

verses.english_text: Till the day of Appointed Time.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ

verses.english_text: (Iblis) said: O my Lord, you have separated me from the path; I will also decorate the materials (of bad deeds) for your servants, and shall misguide them.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ اَغْوَيْتَنِى لَاُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَاُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: Except your pure servants.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

verses.english_text: Allah said: this is the straight path which reaches Me.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ

verses.english_text: You shall not have any control over my pure servants, but those who will be misguided shall follow you.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ

verses.english_text: And for all of them the final promise is Hell.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: Which have seven gates and separate groups shall enter from them.
verses.arabic_text: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ اَبْوَٰبٍۢ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌۭ مَّقْسُومٌ

verses.english_text: And Verily pious ones shall be amidst the gardens and rivers of Paradise.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ

verses.english_text: They will be commanded to enter into it with peace and security.
verses.arabic_text: ادْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Whatever sadness will be in their hearts, we shall remove all; they will be sitting on the couches, face to face with each other like brothers.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ اِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ

verses.english_text: None of the trouble will touch them, and they shall never be expelled from it.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَ مَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Inform my servants that I am very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ اَنِّىٓ اَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: But remember at the same time Verily my punishment is also very painful.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ الْعَذَابُ الْاَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: Inform them about the guests of Ibrahim.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ

verses.english_text: When they came they gave a salutation, Ibrahim replied and said: I am apprehensive of you.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَـٰمًۭا قَالَ اِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: do not be apprehensive of us; we consider you a learned one, and we are giving you glad tiding of a son to you.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ لَا تَوْجَلْ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Now you are giving good news (of a son), when the old age has reached me, so of what then you give me good news.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ اَن مَّسَّنِىَ الْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: we have given you correct good news, so do not be hopeless (in the Court of Allah).
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ بَشَّرْنَـٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ الْقَـٰنِطِينَ

verses.english_text: Ibrahim said: who else can be hopeless from the Mercy of Allah except the misguided ones.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِٓ اِلَّا الضَّآلُّونَ

verses.english_text: Then Ibrahim said: O angels on what mission you are?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ اَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: We have been sent towards misguided people (with punishment).
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ اِنَّآ اُرْسِلْنَآ اِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: For the family of Lut – that we will save them all.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ اِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: Except for his wife, whom we have targeted, and she will Verily stay back (with those who will be in punishment).
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا امْرَاَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ اِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الْغَـٰبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: When the angels came to the family of Lut.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Lut said: you look strangers to me.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Angels said: rather we have come to you with (punishment) for which your people were in doubt.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ بَلْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And we have come to you with the definite command of punishment, and we are truthful.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَتَيْنَـٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَ اِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ

verses.english_text: So when night remain a little take your children and move and you walk in their rear, and nobody should turn their back and see; and go to (the place) for which you have been commanded.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَسْرِ بِاَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ الَّيْلِ وَاتَّبِعْ اَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ اَحَدٌۭ وَامْضُواْ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And We informed Lut about Our definite command that by the dawn their roots will be cut.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَضَيْنَآ اِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ الْاَمْرَ اَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌۭ مُّصْبِحِينَ

verses.english_text: And (upon hearing news of the guests) people of the city came to them celebrating.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَآءَ اَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Lut said: they are my guests; and do not defame me by troubling them.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ

verses.english_text: Fear Allah and do not disgrace me.
verses.arabic_text: وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ

verses.english_text: Why? had not we forbidden you from any guest?
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ اَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Lut said: if you want to do anything, daughters of my people are there (marry them).
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ اِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), by your soul, these people (people of Lut) were intoxicated in their madness
verses.arabic_text: لَعَمْرُكَ اِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

verses.english_text: However, before sunrise Lut left and a mighty blast took them away.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We turned the surface of the earth of (that) town to its bottom and continuously rained stones of baked clay on them.
verses.arabic_text: فَجَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

verses.english_text: There is no doubt that for the people who understand the talk, there are many signs of Authority in it.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ

verses.english_text: And that (town which was punished) is the pathway for people to traverse on it.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍۢ مُّقِيمٍ

verses.english_text: There is not any doubt that for believers there is a big sign (of authority of Allah) in it.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And people of Aika i.e. woods (people of Shoaib), were transgressors like people of Lut.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن كَانَ اَصْحَـٰبُ الْاَيْكَةِ لَظَـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: So We required from them also (for their disobedience), and these two towns are still existing on the main passageway.
verses.arabic_text: فَانتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَاِنَّهُمَا لَبِاِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: (And likewise) dwellers of Hijr (people of Saleh) also denied prophets.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ كَذَّبَ اَصْحَـٰبُ الْحِجْرِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: We gave them Our signs; but in spite of that they continued in their turning away from them.
verses.arabic_text: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ اٰيٰتِنَا فَكَانُواْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

verses.english_text: And diligently they carved the mountains and made their homes.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَانُواْ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ

verses.english_text: (But) at last near the dawn a mighty blast took them away.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ

verses.english_text: And whatever planning they were doing for their security was of no use to them.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَآ اَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ

verses.english_text: And We created skies and the earth and whatever is in between (them) with truth, and the Day of Judgement will Verily come; so you (O Prophet) overlook fault of infidels with gracious forgiveness.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَآ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ ۗ وَاِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌۭ ۖ فَاصْفَحِ الصَّفْحَ الْجَمِيلَ

verses.english_text: Certainly, your Lord is a great Creator and Knower.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْخَلَّـٰقُ الْعَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: Verily, We have given you oft-repeated seven verses and Great Quran.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًۭا مِّنَ الْمَثَانِى وَالْقُرْءَانَ الْعَظِيمَ

verses.english_text: And We have made some infidels happy (with the wealth of the world), don't even see them, and nor even feel sorry for them (on their infidelity), and meet politely with believers (even if they are poor).
verses.arabic_text: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ اِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِٓ اَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Say: I am an explicit warner. (from the punishment of Allah).
verses.arabic_text: وَقُلْ اِنِّىٓ اَنَا النَّذِيرُ الْمُبِينُ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet, We will punish infidels as); Like We punished the dividers.
verses.arabic_text: كَمَآ اَنزَلْنَا عَلَى الْمُقْتَسِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Who divided the Quran in parts.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ جَعَلُواْ الْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) By your Lord, We will definitely question them.
verses.arabic_text: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: For what they were doing.
verses.arabic_text: عَمَّا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Whatever you have been commanded, explain clearly, and turn your face away from the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: فَاصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَاَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ

verses.english_text: We are enough, for those who scoff (at you).
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا كَفَيْنَـٰكَ الْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ

verses.english_text: Those who make partners with Allah, they will understand shortly.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ اِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: We are aware that you feel straitness in your chest because of their talk.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ اَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ

verses.english_text: So celebrate the praise of your Lord and be among those who prostrate in His Court.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ السَّـٰجِدِينَ

verses.english_text: And until death reaches you, continue to worship your Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَاعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَاْتِيَكَ الْيَقِينُ

verses.english_text: Command of Allah has come, so do not ask for haste unnecessarily, Allah is Pure and Exalted and free from their polytheism.
verses.arabic_text: اَتَىٰٓ اَمْرُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: Among His servants He sends revelation with His command on whosoever He pleases so that they should warn the people that there is no god except Me, so therefore fear Me only.
verses.arabic_text: يُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ بِالرُّوحِ مِنْ اَمْرِهِ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِٓ اَنْ اَنذِرُوٓاْ اَنَّهُ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّآ اَنَا۠ فَاتَّقُونِ

verses.english_text: That is He Who has created skies and the earth with truth, He is Exalted from those partners which they make for Him.
verses.arabic_text: خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ تَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: He created humans with sperm; then suddenly he becomes a manifest opponent.
verses.arabic_text: خَلَقَ الْاِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَاِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: He also created cattle, their skin (and wool) is for you, which is goods for winter, and there are other benefits also, and you eat some of them.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْاَنْعَـٰمَ خَلَقَهَا ۗ لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌۭ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَاْكُلُونَ

verses.english_text: Because of them there is brilliance in your life, when you take them home at dusk after grazing, and when you take them for grazing in the morning.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ

verses.english_text: And to the cities you could not had reach without difficulty, these cattle carry your loads there; most Verily your Lord is most Compassionate and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَحْمِلُ اَثْقَالَكُمْ اِلَىٰ بَلَدٍۢ لَّمْ تَكُونُواْ بَـٰلِغِيهِ اِلَّا بِشِقِّ الْاَنفُسِ ۚ اِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And He created, horses, mules and donkeys, that you may ride on them, and as use of show; and creates other things also which you do not know.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْخَيْلَ وَالْبِغَالَ وَالْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةًۭ ۚ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Guidance to the straight path is on Allah only; but some of the paths are crooked, and if Allah pleased, He might have reached you all to the destination.
verses.arabic_text: وَعَلَى اللَّهِ قَصْدُ السَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌۭ ۚ وَ لَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: That is He, Who rained water from the sky which you drink, and trees (pastures) become fresh in which you graze your cattle.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِىٓ اَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ ۖ لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌۭ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌۭ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ

verses.english_text: From this water He grows for you farming, olive and dates and all types of fruits; there is not any doubt that in it is a great sign (of Power of Allah), for those who ponder.
verses.arabic_text: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ الزَّرْعَ وَالزَّيْتُونَ وَالنَّخِيلَ وَالْاَعْنَـٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَٰتِ ۗ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: He made night and day, sun and moon subservient to you; and stars are also by His command obey you, there is not any doubt that in it are many signs (of Power of Allah) for those who ponder.
verses.arabic_text: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۖ وَالنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتٌۢ بِاَمْرِهِٓ ۗ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: And different colorful things which have been created for your benefit; undoubtedly there is great sign (of Power of Allah) for those who wish to get advice and lessons.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا ذَرَاَ لَكُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا اَلْوَٰنُهُٓ ۗ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَذَّكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: And that is Allah who made the rivers and the seas subservient to you, so you may consume fresh meat of fish, and you get ornaments from it which you wear; and you see ships which rip through water and traverse on sea; and made them subservient to you so you go in search of His bounty (business); and that you be thankful.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِى سَخَّرَ الْبَحْرَ لِتَاْكُلُواْ مِنْهُ لَحْمًۭا طَرِيًّۭا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُواْ مِنْهُ حِلْيَةًۭ تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى الْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُواْ مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And that is He, Who fixed heavy mountains on the earth so that it may not move from its place (and you are unable to stand on it); and created rivers and ways that you may reach your destinations.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَلْقَىٰ فِى الْاَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ اَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَاَنْهَـٰرًا وَسُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ

verses.english_text: And created many signs (on the ways); and by the stars many people find their ways.
verses.arabic_text: وَعَلَـٰمَـٰتٍۢ ۚ وَبِالنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

verses.english_text: Can such Creator be equaled with those who cannot create anything; can't you understand even this?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَمَن يَخْلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخْلُقُ ۗ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: You cannot count the Blessings of Allah, even if you wish; Verily He is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Whatever you do openly or secretly, Allah knows everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَ مَا تُعْلِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who call others for their needs, leaving Allah, they cannot create anything.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ

verses.english_text: And they themselves are lifeless, even they do not know when they will be raised again.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْوَٰتٌ غَيْرُ اَحْيَآءٍۢ ۖ وَ مَا يَشْعُرُونَ اَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ

verses.english_text: Your Lord is One only, and who do not believe on the Day of Judgement; denial is from their hearts, and they are arrogant.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَـٰهُكُمْ اِلَـٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۚ فَالَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْـَٔاخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌۭ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Whatever they do secretly and whatever they do openly, Allah knows it Verily, and He does not like those who are arrogant.
verses.arabic_text: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَ مَا يُعْلِنُونَ ۚ اِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And when they are told what is that your Lord has revealed; they say: it is (nothing but) only the tales of earlier ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَآ اَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۙ قَالُوٓاْ اَسَـٰطِيرُ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: (Let them say); On the Day of Judgement, they will carry the load of their sins and the load of sins of those whom they have misguided without knowledge; look, what a bad load they are carrying.
verses.arabic_text: لِيَحْمِلُوٓاْ اَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةًۭ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ وَمِنْ اَوْزَارِ الَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۗ اَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, those who were before them also plotted, so (command of) Allah uprooted the foundation of their mansions and roof fell upon them, and they did not realize from which side the punishment had come.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ مَكَرَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَاَتَى اللَّهُ بُنْيَـٰنَهُم مِّنَ الْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّقْفُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَاَتَىٰهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Thereafter, on the Day of Judgement Allah will disgrace them; and will say: (now say) where are they, to whom you made My partner, and regarding whom you fought with the believers, and on that day who have been given knowledge will say: today, disgrace and evil, all is for the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ اَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ الَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تُشَـٰٓقُّونَ فِيهِمْ ۚ قَالَ الَّذِينَ اُوتُواْ الْعِلْمَ اِنَّ الْخِزْىَ الْيَوْمَ وَالسُّوٓءَ عَلَى الْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: They are those people, when angels extract their soul, so those who were unjust to themselves, seems ready for obedience, will say: we were not doing any evil, then angels will reply: whatever you did, Allah is well aware of it.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِىٓ اَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ فَاَلْقَوُاْ السَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِن سُوٓءٍۭ ۚ بَلَىٰٓ اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Now enter the gate of Hell and shall remain there forever, what an evil place it is for those who are arrogant.
verses.arabic_text: فَادْخُلُوٓاْ اَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

verses.english_text: And when the pious people are asked what have your Lord revealed, they say: everything better than the best, those who did good deeds; there is good for them in this world and in the Hereafter (also) their abode is better, and what an excellent abode is that for the pious ones;
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ مَاذَآ اَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۚ قَالُواْ خَيْرًا ۗ لِّلَّذِينَ اَحْسَنُواْ فِى هَـٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌۭ ۚ وَلَدَارُ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌۭ ۚ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ الْمُتَّقِينَ

verses.english_text: They will reach without hesitation in the evergreen gardens beneath which rivers will be flowing, for whatever thing they will desire will be presented (to them), like this Allah will bestow the reward upon the pious ones.
verses.arabic_text: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْزِى اللَّهُ الْمُتَّقِينَ

verses.english_text: When angels come to take the souls of those who are pure (from infidelity); they spontaneously give salutation and say: in reward for your good deeds that you had been doing in the world. (without hesitation) enter Paradise.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ ۙ يَقُولُونَ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ادْخُلُواْ الْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), are they waiting that angels come to them to extract their souls, or punishment of your Lord comes to them, people of earlier times also had talked like this; Allah had not been unjust to them, but they were unjust to themselves (because of their infidelity).
verses.arabic_text: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ اِلَّآ اَن تَاْتِيَهُمُ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ اَوْ يَاْتِىَ اَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَ مَا ظَلَمَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ اَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And whatever they were doing, they got an evil reward for that; and that (punishment) gripped them from every side, of which they were making fun.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

verses.english_text: And polytheists say: if Allah pleased, we would not have worshipping anything except Him, nor our forefathers; nor would we have forbidden anything without His permission; those who have gone by. (had also) done such talk; (so let them say); prophets' responsibility is only to deliver His commands clearly, and nothing else.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ اَشْرَكُواْ لَوْ شَآءَ اللَّهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِن دُونِهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ نَّحْنُ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن دُونِهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ فَهَلْ عَلَى الرُّسُلِ اِلَّا الْبَلَـٰغُ الْمُبِينُ

verses.english_text: And We Verily sent a prophet for each nation; so that they tell them to worship Allah and desist from (worshipping) idols; to some of them Allah guided and some of them remained in misguidance, so you travel in the land and see (for yourself) what was the end of those who denied (prophets of Allah).
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ اُمَّةٍۢ رَّسُولًا اَنِ اعْبُدُواْ اللَّهَ وَاجْتَنِبُواْ الطَّـٰغُوتَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ هَدَى اللَّهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الضَّلَـٰلَةُ ۚ فَسِيرُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَانظُرُواْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: (It is no use) if you desire to bring them to the right path, because Allah will never guide the person whom He has left in misguidance, and nobody will help him also.
verses.arabic_text: اِن تَحْرِصْ عَلَىٰ هُدَىٰهُمْ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَن يُضِلُّ ۖ وَ مَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ

verses.english_text: These infidels by all swearing on Allah say: those who die, Allah will not raise them again. (O Prophet) say: Verily Allah will do this; it is imperative on Him to complete his promise, but most of the people do not know this.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَقْسَمُواْ بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ اَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ ۙ لَا يَبْعَثُ اللَّهُ مَن يَمُوتُ ۚ بَلَىٰ وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّۭا وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: In the matter they were quarreling that will be explained before them, so the infidels should know that they were liars.
verses.arabic_text: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِى يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ اَنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ كَـٰذِبِينَ

verses.english_text: When We intend to create something, Our saying is that only, We say to it, Be, and that becomes spontaneously.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَىْءٍ اِذَآ اَرَدْنَـٰهُ اَن نَّقُولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ

verses.english_text: And those who tolerated persecution and migrated in the way of Allah; shortly We shall bestow upon them best place in the world; and reward of the Hereafter is Verily much greater; wish they were aware of this reality;
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ فِى اللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِى الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةًۭ ۖ وَلَاَجْرُ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ اَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُواْ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: These are the people who were patient and trust their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), before you we sent men as prophets to whom We revealed, so say: If you do not know, ask them who know.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ اِلَيْهِمْ ۚ فَسْـَٔلُوٓاْ اَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ اِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: We sent prophets with the miracles and books, and to you also We revealed the Book, so that you explain the commands which have been sent for them, perhaps they may ponder over it.
verses.arabic_text: بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَالزُّبُرِ ۗ وَاَنزَلْنَآ اِلَيْكَ الذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ اِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: Are those who do plotting have become satisfied (from punishment) Allah may cause the earth to swallow them, or punishment comes to them and they do not understand.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَاَمِنَ الَّذِينَ مَكَرُواْ السَّيِّـَٔاتِ اَن يَخْسِفَ اللَّهُ بِهِمُ الْاَرْضَ اَوْ يَاْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Or they are confident that He will not catch them while they are walking, they cannot humble Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ يَاْخُذَهُمْ فِى تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ

verses.english_text: Or they are confident that Allah will not catch them slowly? Your Lord is Compassionate and All-Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ يَاْخُذَهُمْ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفٍۢ فَاِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Did they see something among the creations of Allah, whose shadow sometimes turns left and sometimes turns right as if they fell in prostration before Allah and they are expressing their obedience towards Him.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ اِلَىٰ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍۢ يَتَفَيَّؤُاْ ظِلَـٰلُهُ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَالشَّمَآئِلِ سُجَّدًۭا لِّلَّهِ وَهُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Whatever is in the skies and on the earth and all the animals on the earth, all of them are prostrating before Allah, and angels (are already doing), and they do not transgress from the command of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ وَالْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And they fear their Lord, and obey immediately whatever is commanded by Him, Who is much more exalted than them.
verses.arabic_text: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ ۩

verses.english_text: {Prostrate Non-Obligatory} And Allah ordained that do not make two Lords, Lord is only that’s Allah; then fear Me only.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَقَالَ اللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوٓاْ اِلَـٰهَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ ۖ اِنَّمَا هُوَ اِلَـٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ فَاِيَّـٰىَ فَارْهَبُونِ

verses.english_text: And whatever is in the skies and on the earth, everything is His, and exclusive obedience is always imperative for Him, then do you fear anybody other than Allah?
verses.arabic_text: وَلَهُ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَلَهُ الدِّينُ وَاصِبًا ۚ اَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: And whatever good you have is all from Allah, and if any evil touches you, you implore before Him.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍۢ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ ۖ ثُمَّ اِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فَاِلَيْهِ تَجْـَٔرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then, when He wards off trouble from you, then some of you make His partners.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِذَا كَشَفَ الضُّرَّ عَنكُمْ اِذَا فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: They become ungrateful for the favors granted by Us; they will enjoy for some days in the world, then shortly you will know.
verses.arabic_text: لِيَكْفُرُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُواْ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: From sustenance given by Us, they make a part for idols also, and their reality they do not know; for the slander you did, by Allah you shall most certainly be questioned for it on the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ نَصِيبًۭا مِّمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ تَاللَّهِ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَفْتَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And these people make daughters for Allah, Praise be to Allah, He is clean and pure from it; and for themselves (son) what they desire.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ الْبَنَـٰتِ سُبْحَـٰنَهُ ۙ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

verses.english_text: And when they are given the good news of a girl being born to them, then with sadness their faces turn black, as if they have swallowed a sip of poison.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا بُشِّرَ اَحَدُهُم بِالْاُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّۭا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Upon hearing the good news (of a female child) he hides his face from the people; (and thinks) whether to let her live with disgrace or bury her alive; Verily they are taking bad decisions.
verses.arabic_text: يَتَوَٰرَىٰ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ مِن سُوٓءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِٓ ۚ اَيُمْسِكُهُ عَلَىٰ هُونٍ اَمْ يَدُسُّهُ فِى التُّرَابِ ۗ اَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ

verses.english_text: Evil talk is more suitable for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, and for Allah are loftiest qualities (such as Oneness and Lordship); and He is Predominant and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْـَٔاخِرَةِ مَثَلُ السَّوْءِ ۖ وَلِلَّهِ الْمَثَلُ الْاَعْلَىٰ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: And if Allah will seize them on their disobedience, then He will not leave any mortal on the earth, but He have given all of them, respite until an appointed time; when their appointed time will come then it will neither move forward or backward even for a second.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ اِلَىٰٓ اَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۖ فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةًۭ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And they attribute to Allah what they abhor (themselves); and their tongues also lie for them that there is good for them in the Hereafter, whereas Verily Hell is for them, and prior to all they will be thrown in it.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ اَلْسِنَتُهُمُ الْكَذِبَ اَنَّ لَهُمُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّ لَهُمُ النَّارَ وَاَنَّهُم مُّفْرَطُونَ

verses.english_text: By Allah before you, We sent prophets to the different peoples, so Satan decorated their affairs for them, and today also he is their guardian, and for them is great painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَآ اِلَىٰٓ اُمَمٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَـٰنُ اَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And We revealed the Book to you so that you explain their problems in which they dispute; and this Book is entirely guidance and mercy for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ اِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِى اخْتَلَفُواْ فِيهِ ۙ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And Allah sent down water from the sky and through which He relived the dead earth, undoubtedly for those who hear there is a great sign in it.
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ اَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَاَحْيَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَسْمَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And there is no doubt that in four-footed animals there is a lesson for you; that in their belly from between dung and blood We give you milk to drink which is tasteful for drinkers.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى الْاَنْعَـٰمِ لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍۢ وَدَمٍۢ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًۭا سَآئِغًۭا لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ

verses.english_text: And we give you dates and grapes (to drink juices), of which sometimes make wine and sometime use it for business, and certainly in it also there is great sign (of Power of Allah) for wise people.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ النَّخِيلِ وَالْاَعْنَـٰبِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۗ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), your Lord indicated to honeybee to make hives on mountains and trees and heighted houses.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ اِلَى النَّحْلِ اَنِ اتَّخِذِى مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًۭا وَمِنَ الشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ

verses.english_text: Then suck the essence from all flowers and travel with the obedience of your Lord; there comes out a drink (honey) of different colors from the bellies of bees, in it there is healing for people (from illness); there is no doubt that in this there is a great sign (of Power of Allah) for the people who ponder.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ كُلِى مِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَٰتِ فَاسْلُكِى سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًۭا ۚ يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌۭ مُّخْتَلِفٌ اَلْوَٰنُهُ فِيهِ شِفَآءٌۭ لِّلنَّاسِ ۗ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: And Allah created you and He will cause you to die; and some of them are brought back to the worst part of their lives (very old age); that in spite of having much knowledge, you will not know anything, certainly Allah is all knowing and Powerful.
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمْ ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ اِلَىٰٓ اَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَىْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍۢ شَيْـًٔا ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۭ قَدِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And it is Allah, Who has given preference (to some of you) over others in sustenance (and wealth), however who have been given more sustenance do not give to those who are their subordinates (workers and slaves, etc.); whereas, everyone has a part in that sustenance, so do they deny the favor of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فِى الرِّزْقِ ۚ فَمَا الَّذِينَ فُضِّلُواْ بِرَآدِّى رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ ۚ اَفَبِنِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ

verses.english_text: And Allah made your wives of your nature from among you, and He made your sons and grandsons from your wives, and gave you pure sustenance to consume, so do they totally believe in falsehood, and deny the favor of Allah?
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ اَنفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَٰجًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ اَزْوَٰجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةًۭ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبَـٰتِ ۚ اَفَبِالْبَـٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ اللَّهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And except Allah they worship those which are neither capable to give any sustenance to them in skies and the earth nor can acquire such capacity.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًۭا مِّنَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

verses.english_text: Do not create examples for Allah, indeed Allah knows everything which you do not know.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا تَضْرِبُواْ لِلَّهِ الْاَمْثَالَ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ وَاَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
