verses.english_text: Allah describes an example: that one slave who is property of another, and does not have any authority, and another person whom We have given from Our Court good sustenance, and he spends from in (in the way of Allah), openly and secretly, can these two be equal. (never), Praise be to Allah, but most of them do not even know this.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًۭا مَّمْلُوكًۭا لَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ وَمَن رَّزَقْنَـٰهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًۭا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّۭا وَجَهْرًا ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوُنَ ۚ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And Allah describes another example of two men: a slave who is dumb and is incapable of doing anything, and he is a burden on his master that wherever he sends him, he does not bring any good; does this slave and a person who advises justice to the people and is himself on right path can (these two) be equal? (Never).
verses.arabic_text: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا رَّجُلَيْنِ اَحَدُهُمَآ اَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَىٰ مَوْلَىٰهُ اَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَاْتِ بِخَيْرٍ ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى هُوَ وَمَن يَاْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ ۙ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And all the unseen of the skies and the earth is exclusive for Allah only, and happening on the Day of Judgement is like blinking and even sooner than that, indeed Allah is Predominant over everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ وَ مَآ اَمْرُ السَّاعَةِ اِلَّا كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ اَوْ هُوَ اَقْرَبُ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And Allah brought you out of the wombs of your mothers, when you were unaware, and gave you ears, eyes and heart, so that you be grateful.
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ اَخْرَجَكُم مِّنۢ بُطُونِ اُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَـٰرَ وَالْاَفْـِٔدَةَ ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Didn't you ponder over the birds, who fly under the skies encircle in air, and Allah prevents them (from falling), Verily in this also there are many signs for those who believe.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ اِلَى الطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَٰتٍۢ فِى جَوِّ السَّمَآءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ اِلَّا اللَّهُ ۗ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And Allah made home your place (to stay), and he provided for you hides of cattle from which you make tents; that you carry while you travel, and He made wool and fur and hair and other useful things which you can use until appointed time.
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ الْاَنْعَـٰمِ بُيُوتًۭا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ اِقَامَتِكُمْ ۙ وَمِنْ اَصْوَافِهَا وَاَوْبَارِهَا وَاَشْعَارِهَآ اَثَـٰثًۭا وَمَتَـٰعًا اِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: And Allah made shades of his creations for your rest, He made for you caves in the mountains for you to retreat, He made garments to save you from heat (and cold), and gave you coats of mails to protect you from weapons' attack; like this Allah completes His favours that you may become obedient.
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَـٰلًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْجِبَالِ اَكْنَـٰنًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ الْحَرَّ وَسَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَاْسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Even after this if they turn their face (from you), then your responsibility is just to deliver (the commands) clearly.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِن تَوَلَّوْاْ فَاِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلَـٰغُ الْمُبِينُ

verses.english_text: These people know the favors of Allah, still (knowingly) they deny and most of them are ungrateful.
verses.arabic_text: يَعْرِفُونَ نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَاَكْثَرُهُمُ الْكَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And that day We will raise every Ummah from their graves and will make their prophets their witness, then the infidels will not be allowed to speak, nor their excuse will be heard.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِن كُلِّ اُمَّةٍۢ شَهِيدًۭا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who had spearheaded mischief in the world, when they will see the punishment, so neither their punishment will be lessened, nor they will be given respite.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا رَءَا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ الْعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who made partners of Allah, when they will see those partners (on the Day of Judgement) will say: O our Lord, these are our partners whom we called upon in the time of difficulties instead of You, but they will retort that you are great liars.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا رَءَا الَّذِينَ اَشْرَكُواْ شُرَكَآءَهُمْ قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ شُرَكَآؤُنَا الَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدْعُواْ مِن دُونِكَ ۖ فَاَلْقَوْاْ اِلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلَ اِنَّكُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ

verses.english_text: And that day they will all fell down and prostrate before Allah and the slandering which they did in the world will become useless and shall vanish.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَلْقَوْاْ اِلَى اللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ السَّلَمَ ۖ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفْتَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Those who adopted infidelity and prohibited people from the way of Allah, and in reward of the mischief they spread, their punishment shall be increased.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ زِدْنَـٰهُمْ عَذَابًۭا فَوْقَ الْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يُفْسِدُونَ

verses.english_text: And (remember the day) when We will raise up in every people a witness from among them to testify against themselves, and (O Prophet), will make you witness against them, We revealed the Book on you and described everything in it, and for Muslims, this is guidance, mercy and glad tidings.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ فِى كُلِّ اُمَّةٍۢ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ اَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَىٰ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ۚ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ تِبْيَـٰنًۭا لِّكُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةًۭ وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Indeed, Allah ordains for doing justice, and for doing good and being generous towards the relatives; and prohibits from evil and indecency and transgression; and admonishes you that you may get the advised.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اِنَّ اللَّهَ يَاْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْاِحْسَـٰنِ وَاِيتَآئِ ذِى الْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَآءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ وَالْبَغْىِ ۚ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: And when you enter into covenants, then complete the covenant with Allah and do not break the oaths after taking them, whereas you had made Allah surety for you; and whatever you do, Allah Verily knows.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَوْفُواْ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ اِذَا عَـٰهَدتُّمْ وَلَا تَنقُضُواْ الْاَيْمَـٰنَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيدِهَا وَ قَدْ جَعَلْتُمُ اللَّهَ عَلَيْكُمْ كَفِيلًا ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ

verses.english_text: You do not be like those females (in breaking oaths) who spun the yarn then breaks it into pieces, do you make your covenant with means of deceit that one group get more benefit than other group; Allah is testing you through this, and He will Verily make this clear on the Day of Judgement in which you had differed.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَكُونُواْ كَالَّتِى نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ اَنكَـٰثًۭا تَتَّخِذُونَ اَيْمَـٰنَكُمْ دَخَلًۢا بَيْنَكُمْ اَن تَكُونَ اُمَّةٌ هِىَ اَرْبَىٰ مِنْ اُمَّةٍ ۚ اِنَّمَا يَبْلُوكُمُ اللَّهُ بِهِ ۚ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ مَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ

verses.english_text: And if Allah pleases, He would have made you all one nation; but He leaves in misguidance to whoever He pleases, and to whosoever He pleases He guides, and whatever you had been doing in the world, certainly you will be questioned about it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ شَآءَ اللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ اُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَلَـٰكِن يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَلَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: And do not make your oaths basis for your mutual mischief, that after your foot is stable, foot of Islam is weaken; and (then on the Day of Judgement); and in reward of you desisting people from the way of Lord, you will taste the punishment, and for you will be the severe punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوٓاْ اَيْمَـٰنَكُمْ دَخَلًۢا بَيْنَكُمْ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌۢ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِهَا وَتَذُوقُواْ السُّوٓءَ بِمَا صَدَدتُّمْ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And do not take a small amount in exchange for the covenant of Allah, and if you know then understand that whatever is with Allah is much better that what you have.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَشْتَرُواْ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًۭا قَلِيلًا ۚ اِنَّمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ اِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And whatever you have (one day) will be over, and the reward of Allah is everlasting, and those who are patient in the world; on the Day of Judgement, We will bestow upon them the best reward for what they did in the world.
verses.arabic_text: مَا عِندَكُمْ يَنفَدُ ۖ وَ مَا عِندَ اللَّهِ بَاقٍۢ ۗ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّ الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوٓاْ اَجْرَهُم بِاَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Whoever will do good work, whether men or women, will also be believers; We will make their lives pure in this world, and will reward them better than the best for good work they did.
verses.arabic_text: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا مِّن ذَكَرٍ اَوْ اُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُ حَيَوٰةًۭ طَيِّبَةًۭ ۖ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ اَجْرَهُم بِاَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: And when you recite the Quran, seek refuge from Allah, from the cursed Satan (from his evil whispering).
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا قَرَاْتَ الْقُرْءَانَ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَـٰنِ الرَّجِيمِ

verses.english_text: There is no doubt he cannot control those who are believers and rely on Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهُ سُلْطَـٰنٌ عَلَى الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

verses.english_text: His control is only on those who befriends him and those who indulge in polytheism.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا سُلْطَـٰنُهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُ وَ الَّذِينَ هُم بِهِ مُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), when We change a verse with another verse then what We reveal (We know its prudence well), but these people say you are a forger, but most of them know nothing about it.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا بَدَّلْنَآ ءَايَةًۭ مَّكَانَ ءَايَةٍۢ ۙ وَاللَّهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوٓاْ اِنَّمَآ اَنتَ مُفْتَرٍۭ ۚ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet) make it clear to them that this (Quran) has been revealed to you by Sacred Spirit from your Lord with truth; so those who have believed should be steadfast, and for the Muslims it is entirely guidance and glad tidings.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ نَزَّلَهُ رُوحُ الْقُدُسِ مِن رَّبِّكَ بِالْحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَهُدًۭى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet) in reality We know that these infidels say some man teaches you Quran; (whereas it is totally wrong), to the person they refer to is a non-Arab, while this (Quran) is clearly in Arabic language.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ اَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ اِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُ بَشَرٌۭ ۗ لِّسَانُ الَّذِى يُلْحِدُونَ اِلَيْهِ اَعْجَمِىٌّۭ وَهَـٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِىٌّۭ مُّبِينٌ

verses.english_text: Indeed, those who do not believe the signs of Allah, He does not guide them and there is also painful punishment for them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ اللَّهِ لَا يَهْدِيهِمُ اللَّهُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Indeed, those who falsely blame do not believe in Allah, and they are liars also.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا يَفْتَرِى الْكَذِبَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ اللَّهِ ۖ وَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْكَـٰذِبُونَ

verses.english_text: And who will adopt infidelity after believing; except that he is compelled for it but his heart is content; and have space for infidelity in his chest, there is wrath of Allah on him and grievous punishment for him.
verses.arabic_text: مَن كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ اِيمَـٰنِهِٓ اِلَّا مَنْ اُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهُ مُطْمَئِنٌّۢ بِالْاِيمَـٰنِ وَلَـٰكِن مَّن شَرَحَ بِالْكُفْرِ صَدْرًا فَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌۭ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: This is because of those people who preferred worldly life over the Hereafter, and Allah never guides transgressing nations.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمُ اسْتَحَبُّواْ الْحَيَوٰةَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَاَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: These are those, whose hearts, eyes and ears have been stamped with infidelity, and they are in reality negligent of truth.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَسَمْعِهِمْ وَاَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ ۖ وَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْغَـٰفِلُونَ

verses.english_text: And these people are among the losers in the Hereafter.
verses.arabic_text: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّهُمْ فِى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمُ الْخَـٰسِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily your Lord, those who were persecuted and later they migrated, and fought (in the way of Allah), and were patient, there is no doubt that your Lord is Oft Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا فُتِنُواْ ثُمَّ جَـٰهَدُواْ وَصَبَرُوٓاْ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And on that day when every mortal will be quarrelling for himself, and every person will get full reward for whatever he has done, and no unjust will be done to them.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ يَوْمَ تَاْتِى كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ تُجَـٰدِلُ عَن نَّفْسِهَا وَتُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Allah has described the example of a village, where people were very comfortable and sustenance were in abundance for them and came to them (from everywhere), then they showed ungratefulness towards the favors so because of their deeds Allah made the hunger and fear like cloth to cover them with it from all sides.
verses.arabic_text: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا قَرْيَةًۭ كَانَتْ ءَامِنَةًۭ مُّطْمَئِنَّةًۭ يَاْتِيهَا رِزْقُهَا رَغَدًۭا مِّن كُلِّ مَكَانٍۢ فَكَفَرَتْ بِاَنْعُمِ اللَّهِ فَاَذَٰقَهَا اللَّهُ لِبَاسَ الْجُوعِ وَالْخَوْفِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَصْنَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And a prophet came from among them, and they denied him, then punishment (of Allah) overtook them, and they were unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَاَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَهُمْ ظَـٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And Allah have given you some pure and lawful sustenance, you may consume them, and if you claim to worship Allah then be grateful to Him.
verses.arabic_text: فَكُلُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ حَلَـٰلًۭا طَيِّبًۭا وَاشْكُرُواْ نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ اِن كُنتُمْ اِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ

verses.english_text: Allah has made unlawful for you dead (animal), blood, flesh of swine and that animals on whom (at the time of slaughter) somebody else's name except Allah was taken; but if someone is helpless (from hunger) but is neither rebellious or exceeds the limit, if he consumes it (in bare minimum required quantity) then Allah is Oft-Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَيْتَةَ وَالدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ الْخِنزِيرِ وَ مَآ اُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ بِهِ ۖ فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍۢ وَلَا عَادٍۢ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: If anything comes on your tongue that it is lawful or unlawful but do not say it (without understanding) lest because of that you may falsely blame Allah, there is no doubt that who falsely blame on Allah can never succeed.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَقُولُواْ لِمَا تَصِفُ اَلْسِنَتُكُمُ الْكَذِبَ هَـٰذَا حَلَـٰلٌۭ وَهَـٰذَا حَرَامٌۭ لِّتَفْتَرُواْ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ ۚ اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: There is little benefit in the world but painful punishment (in the Hereafter) for them.
verses.arabic_text: مَتَـٰعٌۭ قَلِيلٌۭ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And on Jews We made unlawful the things which We have already explained to you, We did no injustice to them but they were unjust to themselves.
verses.arabic_text: وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ هَادُواْ حَرَّمْنَا مَا قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَ مَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ اَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Then those who committed sins unknowingly but repent (wholeheartedly) and amended themselves; so (O Prophet), indeed your Lord after this is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ عَمِلُواْ السُّوٓءَ بِجَهَـٰلَةٍۢ ثُمَّ تَابُواْ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَاَصْلَحُوٓاْ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ

verses.english_text: There is not any doubt that Ibrahim was (comprehensive) leader, obedient of Allah, and (always) treading aside from the falsehood, and he was not among the polytheists.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ كَانَ اُمَّةًۭ قَانِتًۭا لِّلَّهِ حَنِيفًۭا وَلَمْ يَكُ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ

verses.english_text: Grateful for His favors, Allah chose them and have guided them to His straight path.
verses.arabic_text: شَاكِرًا لِّاَنْعُمِهِ ۚ اجْتَبَىٰهُ وَهَدَىٰهُ اِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And We bestowed upon them the good, and in the Hereafter also they will be among the good ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ فِى الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةًۭ ۖ وَاِنَّهُ فِى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصَّـٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), then we revealed on you that you follow the way of Ibrahim; he used to walk aside from the path of falsehood and was not among the polytheists.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَيْكَ اَنِ اتَّبِعْ مِلَّةَ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَ مَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), respect for the day of Sabbath was for those (Jews and Christians) who disputed in it, nothing else, and your Lord will decide between them on the Day of Judgement in which they were disputing.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا جُعِلَ السَّبْتُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اخْتَلَفُواْ فِيهِ ۚ وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), Invite people to your Lord through wisdom and good talk and exhortation, and debate with them in the best manner; indeed, those who went astray from the path of Allah, your Lord know them well; and those who were guided He know them well also.
verses.arabic_text: ادْعُ اِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ ۖ وَجَـٰدِلْهُم بِالَّتِى هِىَ اَحْسَنُ ۚ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ ۖ وَهُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ

verses.english_text: If your opponents are being hard with you then you also be hard with them in the same way, but if you will be patient, then it will be better for those who keep patience.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُواْ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبْتُم بِهِ ۖ وَلَئِن صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لِّلصَّـٰبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet, be patient; and you cannot be patient without the help of Allah; and don't feel sad on the plotting of the opponents and do not straiten your heart on it.
verses.arabic_text: وَاصْبِرْ وَ مَا صَبْرُكَ اِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ۚ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِى ضَيْقٍۢ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Indeed, Allah is the companion of those who are pious and do good works.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَواْ وَّ الَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Glory be to Him who made his servant travel from Sacred Mosque to Aqsa Mosque during the night; around which We have made available every blessing; to show him the Our signs (of Power), indeed He is all Hearing and Seeing.
verses.arabic_text: سُبْحَـٰنَ الَّذِىٓ اَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِ لَيْلًۭا مِّنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ اِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ الْاَقْصَا الَّذِى بَـٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُ لِنُرِيَهُ مِنْ اٰيٰتِنَآ ۚ اِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: We gave the book (Taurait) to Moosa and appointed him leader of Bani Israel; do not make anybody your benefactor except Me.
verses.arabic_text: وَءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هُدًۭى لِّبَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ اَلَّا تَتَّخِذُواْ مِن دُونِى وَكِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: (And ordained that) O children of the people whom I made them board the Ark of Nooh; indeed, Nooh was a grateful servant.
verses.arabic_text: ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ عَبْدًۭا شَكُورًا

verses.english_text: And We had told Bani Israel in the book (Taurait) that you will create the mischief on the earth twice and will do great transgression.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَضَيْنَآ اِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ فِى الْكِتٰبِ لَتُفْسِدُنَّ فِى الْاَرْضِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلَتَعْلُنَّ عُلُوًّۭا كَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: When the time of first mischief came, We imposed upon you some of Our servants (Bakht al-Nasr and his army), who were very hard fighters, they broke into your houses (and carried out bloodshed) and promise of Allah (of punishment) was accomplished.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ اُولَىٰهُمَا بَعَثْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ عِبَادًۭا لَّنَآ اُو۟لِى بَاْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ فَجَاسُواْ خِلَـٰلَ الدِّيَارِ ۚ وَكَانَ وَعْدًۭا مَّفْعُولًۭا

verses.english_text: Then again, We made you prevail over them and changed your days; and helped you with wealth and sons and made you a great group.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَا لَكُمُ الْكَرَّةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاَمْدَدْنَـٰكُم بِاَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَجَعَلْنَـٰكُمْ اَكْثَرَ نَفِيرًا

verses.english_text: If you do good work, then you do the good work for yourselves; and if you do evil work, then it will also be for yourselves; and when the time of second promise came; then We made another nation overpower you that they may damage your faces (so you cannot be recognized), and they broke into the mosque (Bait al-Maghdas) again as previous time, and that they may destroyed completely whatever they find.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ اَحْسَنتُمْ اَحْسَنتُمْ لِاَنفُسِكُمْ ۖ وَاِنْ اَسَاْتُمْ فَلَهَا ۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ لِيَسُـٓـُٔواْ وُجُوهَكُمْ وَلِيَدْخُلُواْ الْمَسْجِدَ كَمَا دَخَلُوهُ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ وَلِيُتَبِّرُواْ مَا عَلَوْاْ تَتْبِيرًا

verses.english_text: (Even now if you live peacefully) it may be that your Lord may have mercy on you, but if you will create mischief again, then We too will take on you again, and We have made ready Hell a prison for the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ اَن يَرْحَمَكُمْ ۚ وَاِنْ عُدتُّمْ عُدْنَا ۘ وَجَعَلْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ حَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: Indeed, Quran guides to the path, which is the straightest path, and give glad tidings to the believers who do good works, for them is the great reward existing.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَـٰذَا الْقُرْءَانَ يَهْدِى لِلَّتِى هِىَ اَقْوَمُ وَيُبَشِّرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمْ اَجْرًا كَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: And this is also, that there is painful punishment for those, who do not believe on the Day of Judgment.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْـَٔاخِرَةِ اَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابًا اَلِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: And human (after getting irritated) asks for evil for himself in such a way as if he is asking for good, and human is a haste maker.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَدْعُ الْاِنسَـٰنُ بِالشَّرِّ دُعَآءَهُ بِالْخَيْرِ ۖ وَكَانَ الْاِنسَـٰنُ عَجُولًۭا

verses.english_text: Two of our signs are the night and the day, then We made dim light, as sign of the night (moon); and made illumination as sign of day (sun), so you may search the grace (sustenance) of your Lord, and you may count the years and do accounting; and We have explained everything with details.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ءَايَتَيْنِ ۖ فَمَحَوْنَآ ءَايَةَ الَّيْلِ وَجَعَلْنَآ ءَايَةَ النَّهَارِ مُبْصِرَةًۭ لِّتَبْتَغُواْ فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلِتَعْلَمُواْ عَدَدَ السِّنِينَ وَالْحِسَابَ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ فَصَّلْنَـٰهُ تَفْصِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And We cling human's deeds on his neck and will keep it before them on the Day of Judgement, and they will see it, as an open book in front of them.
verses.arabic_text: وَكُلَّ اِنسَـٰنٍ اَلْزَمْنَـٰهُ طَـٰٓئِرَهُ فِى عُنُقِهِ ۖ وَنُخْرِجُ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ كِتٰبًۭا يَلْقَىٰهُ مَنشُورًا

verses.english_text: And (We will tell him) read your deeds, today you yourself is sufficient for your accounting.
verses.arabic_text: اقْرَاْ كِتٰبَكَ كَفَىٰ بِنَفْسِكَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ حَسِيبًۭا

verses.english_text: And whoever comes on the straight path, comes for his own benefit, and if somebody went astray, then he harms himself only, and nobody will carry the burden (of sins) of others; and We punish no one unless we send the prophet (to complete the need).
verses.arabic_text: مَّنِ اهْتَدَىٰ فَاِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَاِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ اُخْرَىٰ ۗ وَ مَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتَّىٰ نَبْعَثَ رَسُولًۭا

verses.english_text: And when We wish to destroy any town; We give command to the wealthy people, and when they start disobeying; then that town becomes deserving of punishment, and We destroy them completely.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَآ اَرَدْنَآ اَن نُّهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً اَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا فَفَسَقُواْ فِيهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيْهَا الْقَوْلُ فَدَمَّرْنَـٰهَا تَدْمِيرًا

verses.english_text: And how many generations We destroyed after Nooh, and (O Prophet), your Lord is sufficient to know and see the sins of His servants (and there is no need for any witness).
verses.arabic_text: وَكَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنَ الْقُرُونِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ نُوحٍۢ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: And whoever is desirous of this world We give him what he wishes soon, but then We have assigned Hell for them, and they will enter into it with disgrace and disrespect.
verses.arabic_text: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلْنَا لَهُ فِيهَا مَا نَشَآءُ لِمَن نُّرِيدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا لَهُ جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَىٰهَا مَذْمُومًۭا مَّدْحُورًا

verses.english_text: And whoever is desirous of the Hereafter and endeavor also for it and is a believer also, so these are the people whose endeavor will be accepted.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَنْ اَرَادَ الْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعْيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ كَانَ سَعْيُهُم مَّشْكُورًا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) Your Lord helps them and those with His forgiveness; and the forgiveness of your Lord is not restricted for anyone (it is open for all).
verses.arabic_text: كُلًّۭا نُّمِدُّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مِنْ عَطَآءِ رَبِّكَ ۚ وَ مَا كَانَ عَطَآءُ رَبِّكَ مَحْظُورًا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) Look, how We have made some of them to excel others; and the grades of the Hereafter are much more than here, and preferences of there are also much greater.
verses.arabic_text: انظُرْ كَيْفَ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ اَكْبَرُ دَرَجَـٰتٍۢ وَاَكْبَرُ تَفْضِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And see, do not make anybody partner of Allah; or else you will be sitting in destitution and disgrace.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ اللَّهِ اِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَقْعُدَ مَذْمُومًۭا مَّخْذُولًۭا

verses.english_text: And your Lord has ordained that do not worship anyone else except Him, and be good to your parents, and if both or anyone reached the old age with you, then do not even say even 'Ogh' to them (in reply), and do not reprimand them. (and whatever you have to say) say with respect.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓاْ اِلَّآ اِيَّاهُ وَبِالْوَٰلِدَيْنِ اِحْسَـٰنًا ۚ اِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ الْكِبَرَ اَحَدُهُمَآ اَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ اُفٍّۢ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًۭا كَرِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: And in front of them be submissive and show humbleness, and pray: O my Lord, how they nourished me when I was small, likewise You also show Mercy on them.
verses.arabic_text: وَاخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا

verses.english_text: Allah knows whatever is in your hearts, if you have become really good, the He is the forgiver of those who repent.
verses.arabic_text: رَّبُّكُمْ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِى نُفُوسِكُمْ ۚ اِن تَكُونُواْ صَـٰلِحِينَ فَاِنَّهُ كَانَ لِلْاَوَّٰبِينَ غَفُورًا

verses.english_text: And give their dues to the relatives and needy foreigners; and beware do not be wasteful spender.
verses.arabic_text: وَءَاتِ ذَا الْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُ وَالْمِسْكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيرًا

verses.english_text: Because wasteful spender are brothers of Satan, and Satan is very ungrateful to his Lord.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوٓاْ اِخْوَٰنَ الشَّيَـٰطِينِ ۖ وَكَانَ الشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِرَبِّهِ كَفُورًا

verses.english_text: And when you are awaiting the Grace and Mercy of your Lord in hope and (by force) have to turn your face from poor; then make them understand politely.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِمَّا تُعْرِضَنَّ عَنْهُمُ ابْتِغَآءَ رَحْمَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ تَرْجُوهَا فَقُل لَّهُمْ قَوْلًۭا مَّيْسُورًا

verses.english_text: Do not close your hand tightly to your neck (do not give anything) or open them completely (give everything) so you have to sit down blamed.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً اِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ الْبَسْطِ فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُومًۭا مَّحْسُورًا

verses.english_text: To whoever Allah pleases increases his sustenance, and to whoever He pleases keep straitens (his sustenance); and indeed, He is Knowing and takes care of his servants.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: Do not kill your child for fear of poverty, because We give sustenance to you all, indeed killing of child is a grave crime.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓاْ اَوْلَـٰدَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ اِمْلَـٰقٍۢ ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَاِيَّاكُمْ ۚ اِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ كَانَ خِطْـًۭٔا كَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: And do not go near the adultery, because indeed it is great indecency and an evil habit.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَقْرَبُواْ الزِّنَىٰٓ ۖ اِنَّهُ كَانَ فَـٰحِشَةًۭ وَسَآءَ سَبِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And do not kill a soul whose killing Allah have forbidden; except in just manner (according to Islamic law of retaliation); and who is killed unlawfully We have given authority (of retaliation) to his heir but he should not exceed (in taking revenge of murder); anyway, he will be aided.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَقْتُلُواْ النَّفْسَ الَّتِى حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ ۗ وَمَن قُتِلَ مَظْلُومًۭا فَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِوَلِيِّهِ سُلْطَـٰنًۭا فَلَا يُسْرِف فِّى الْقَتْلِ ۖ اِنَّهُ كَانَ مَنصُورًا

verses.english_text: And do not go near the wealth of an orphan until he attains the puberty but only for his benefit and complete the covenants because on the Day of Judgement Verily you shall be questioned about covenants.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَقْرَبُواْ مَالَ الْيَتِيمِ اِلَّا بِالَّتِى هِىَ اَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ اَشُدَّهُ ۚ وَاَوْفُواْ بِالْعَهْدِ ۖ اِنَّ الْعَهْدَ كَانَ مَسْـُٔولًۭا

verses.english_text: And if you have to give something in measure, then measure properly. (and if it is to be given in weight) then weigh properly, this is the best way of transaction, and its result is also good.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَوْفُواْ الْكَيْلَ اِذَا كِلْتُمْ وَزِنُواْ بِالْقِسْطَاسِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ وَاَحْسَنُ تَاْوِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Of which you have no knowledge, do not pursue it, because (on the Day of Judgement) Allah will certainly question about (your) ear, eye and heart.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۚ اِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْـُٔولًۭا

verses.english_text: And don't walk haughtily on the earth, because neither you can ever break the earth, nor you can be tall as mountains.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى الْاَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ اِنَّكَ لَن تَخْرِقَ الْاَرْضَ وَلَن تَبْلُغَ الْجِبَالَ طُولًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) among the talks which is evil, is hateful near your Lord.
verses.arabic_text: كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ كَانَ سَيِّئُهُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ مَكْرُوهًۭا

verses.english_text: This is from Wisdom of your Lord what has been sent to you as revelation, and do not make another lord with Allah, lest be thrown into Hell with reproach and disgrace.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ مِمَّآ اَوْحَىٰٓ اِلَيْكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ الْحِكْمَةِ ۗ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ اللَّهِ اِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتُلْقَىٰ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَلُومًۭا مَّدْحُورًا

verses.english_text: What! Your Lord chose sons for you, and created for Himself daughters from angels, indeed you are saying harsh words.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَاَصْفَىٰكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِالْبَنِينَ وَاتَّخَذَ مِنَ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ اِنَـٰثًا ۚ اِنَّكُمْ لَتَقُولُونَ قَوْلًا عَظِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: And We have explained in different ways in this Quran so that they may understand, but only their hate increased.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِى هَـٰذَا الْقُرْءَانِ لِيَذَّكَّرُواْ وَ مَا يَزِيدُهُمْ اِلَّا نُفُورًا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) say to these people: if there would have been more gods as they say, till now their gods would certainly be able to find a way to the Master of Throne.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ مَعَهُٓ ءَالِهَةٌۭ كَمَا يَقُولُونَ اِذًۭا لَّابْتَغَوْاْ اِلَىٰ ذِى الْعَرْشِ سَبِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Allah is most High, exalted, and pure, then what vulgar these people talk about Him.
verses.arabic_text: سُبْحَـٰنَهُ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ عُلُوًّۭا كَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: And whoever is in the seven skies and on the earth, they all glorify Him; and there is nothing in the world which do not glorify His Praise, but you do not understand their glorification, indeed He is very Forbearing and Forgiving.
verses.arabic_text: تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتُ السَّبْعُ وَالْاَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ وَاِن مِّن شَىْءٍ اِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تَفْقَهُونَ تَسْبِيحَهُمْ ۗ اِنَّهُ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا

verses.english_text: And when you recite Quran, We create a thick veil between you and those who have no belief on the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا قَرَاْتَ الْقُرْءَانَ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْـَٔاخِرَةِ حِجَابًۭا مَّسْتُورًا

verses.english_text: And We cover up their hearts so they can't understand the Quran, and We make their ears hard (so they can't hear), and when you talk alone about your Lord in Quran, they turn back and run away.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ اَكِنَّةً اَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا ۚ وَاِذَا ذَكَرْتَ رَبَّكَ فِى الْقُرْءَانِ وَحْدَهُ وَلَّوْاْ عَلَىٰٓ اَدْبَـٰرِهِمْ نُفُورًا

verses.english_text: We know what they hear when they hear you talk, and when they converse privately among them, they say: you are following a person affected by magic.
verses.arabic_text: نَّحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَسْتَمِعُونَ بِهِٓ اِذْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ اِلَيْكَ وَاِذْ هُمْ نَجْوَىٰٓ اِذْ يَقُولُ الظَّـٰلِمُونَ اِن تَتَّبِعُونَ اِلَّا رَجُلًۭا مَّسْحُورًا

verses.english_text: Just see what examples they have made for you, and like this they have gone astray, and they are not finding any way.
verses.arabic_text: انظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُواْ لَكَ الْاَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّواْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: They say when we will become dust and bone then will we be raised again as new creatures?
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالُوٓاْ اَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًۭا وَرُفَـٰتًا اَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًۭا جَدِيدًۭا

verses.english_text: Say: become stone or iron.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قُلْ كُونُواْ حِجَارَةً اَوْ حَدِيدًا

verses.english_text: Or anything else which you think is stronger, so these people will shortly ask you, who will raise us again? Tell them: That Lord who created you for the first time, on this they will shake their heads at you, and say: when? Say: it will shortly happen.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ خَلْقًۭا مِّمَّا يَكْبُرُ فِى صُدُورِكُمْ ۚ فَسَيَقُولُونَ مَن يُعِيدُنَا ۖ قُلِ الَّذِى فَطَرَكُمْ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۚ فَسَيُنْغِضُونَ اِلَيْكَ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هُوَ ۖ قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ اَن يَكُونَ قَرِيبًۭا

verses.english_text: On the day when Allah will call you (through Israfil), then with His Praise you will obey Him (and will come out of graves), and you will think you stayed there for a short while.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَدْعُوكُمْ فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ بِحَمْدِهِ وَتَظُنُّونَ اِن لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), say to my (true) servants that when they talk to infidels, talk decently, because Satan creates dissensions among them, indeed Satan is the manifest enemy of man.
verses.arabic_text: وَقُل لِّعِبَادِى يَقُولُواْ الَّتِى هِىَ اَحْسَنُ ۚ اِنَّ الشَّيْطَـٰنَ يَنزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ اِنَّ الشَّيْطَـٰنَ كَانَ لِلْاِنسَـٰنِ عَدُوًّۭا مُّبِينًۭا

verses.english_text: Your Lord is aware of your conditions, if He pleases, He will grant Mercy on you, if He pleases, He will punish you, and (O Prophet), We have not sent you as their responsible (for their affairs).
verses.arabic_text: رَّبُّكُمْ اَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ ۖ اِن يَشَاْ يَرْحَمْكُمْ اَوْ اِن يَشَاْ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ ۚ وَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And whoever is in the skies and on the earth, your Lord knows (all of them) well, and indeed We gave excellence to some prophets over other prophets, and it is We, who have given Zaboor to Dawood.
verses.arabic_text: وَرَبُّكَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۗ وَ لَقَدْ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَ النَّبِيِّـۧنَ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُدَ زَبُورًا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), You say to those people: to whom you consider lord, call upon them in your difficult time and see that they neither they can repel your trouble nor change it.
verses.arabic_text: قُلِ ادْعُواْ الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِهِ فَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ كَشْفَ الضُّرِّ عَنكُمْ وَلَا تَحْوِيلًا

verses.english_text: And to whom these polytheists consider lord and worship them, they themselves are seeking the ways for access to their lord, those who have more nearness to Him and expect (His) Mercy and fears Him; indeed, punishment of your Lord is something which is to be feared about.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ اِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمُ الْوَسِيلَةَ اَيُّهُمْ اَقْرَبُ وَيَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَهُ وَيَخَافُونَ عَذَابَهُٓ ۚ اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ كَانَ مَحْذُورًا

verses.english_text: And there is no town, but We will destroy it before the Day of Judgement or will send severe punishment on it; and this has (already) been written in the Divine Book.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ اِلَّا نَحْنُ مُهْلِكُوهَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ اَوْ مُعَذِّبُوهَا عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا ۚ كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى الْكِتٰبِ مَسْطُورًا

verses.english_text: We refrain from sending miracles because of the denial of earlier peoples; We bestowed she-camel to the people of Samood, which was a sign of (Our Power), but they persecuted her, and We send miracles only as a warning (to the people).
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا مَنَعَنَآ اَن نُّرْسِلَ بِالْـَٔايَـٰتِ اِلَّآ اَن كَذَّبَ بِهَا الْاَوَّلُونَ ۚ وَءَاتَيْنَا ثَمُودَ النَّاقَةَ مُبْصِرَةًۭ فَظَلَمُواْ بِهَا ۚ وَ مَا نُرْسِلُ بِالْـَٔايَـٰتِ اِلَّا تَخْوِيفًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), remember when We told you that We have prevented people from all sides (from you); and the dream We showed you was for the trial (of faith) of such people, likewise the tree which is cursed in Quran and We warn people in different ways, but it only increases their inordinate transgression.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ اَحَاطَ بِالنَّاسِ ۚ وَ مَا جَعَلْنَا الرُّءْيَا الَّتِىٓ اَرَيْنَـٰكَ اِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَالشَّجَرَةَ الْمَلْعُونَةَ فِى الْقُرْءَانِ ۚ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ اِلَّا طُغْيَـٰنًۭا كَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: And when We asked angels to prostrate before Adam; everyone prostrated except Iblis and said: do I prostrate in front to whom you have created with dust?
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ اسْجُدُواْ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ اِلَّآ اِبْلِيسَ قَالَ ءَاَسْجُدُ لِمَنْ خَلَقْتَ طِينًۭا

verses.english_text: (Iblis) said: see this is he, whom you have excelled over me; if you give me respite till the Day of Judgement; I will most Verily cut the roots of his progeny except a few.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا الَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ اَخَّرْتَنِ اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَاَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُٓ اِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Said Allah: Go (be gone), whoever will follow you, place of all of you is Hell, this is your full recompense.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اذْهَبْ فَمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ فَاِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ جَزَآؤُكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ مَّوْفُورًا

verses.english_text: And to whoever you can get control with your smooth talk, attack them with your riders and infantry, and have a share in their wealth and children, and make (false) promise to them; and the promise of Satan is nothing but deception.
verses.arabic_text: وَاسْتَفْزِزْ مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ مِنْهُم بِصَوْتِكَ وَاَجْلِبْ عَلَيْهِم بِخَيْلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ وَشَارِكْهُمْ فِى الْاَمْوَٰلِ وَالْاَوْلَـٰدِ وَعِدْهُمْ ۚ وَ مَا يَعِدُهُمُ الشَّيْطَـٰنُ اِلَّا غُرُورًا

verses.english_text: And you cannot have control over My (true) servants, and your Lord is sufficient as disposer of affairs.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌۭ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Your Lord is that who runs the ships for you in the seas, that you may search for His Blessings and Mercy (sustenance), indeed He is very Kind to you.
verses.arabic_text: رَّبُّكُمُ الَّذِى يُزْجِى لَكُمُ الْفُلْكَ فِى الْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُواْ مِن فَضْلِهِٓ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: And when you faced trouble in the sea, they went missing to whom you worshipped, but He, and when He delivered you from the trouble and reached you on the land, again you turned your face from Him, and human is very ungrateful.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فِى الْبَحْرِ ضَلَّ مَن تَدْعُونَ اِلَّآ اِيَّاهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰكُمْ اِلَى الْبَرِّ اَعْرَضْتُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ الْاِنسَـٰنُ كَفُورًا

verses.english_text: Have you become content that He will not sink you in the earth after taking you there (like Qaroon) or will not rain on you the stones (like nation of Lut), and at that time you will not find any protector.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَاَمِنتُمْ اَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمْ جَانِبَ الْبَرِّ اَوْ يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُواْ لَكُمْ وَكِيلًا

verses.english_text: Have you become content that Allah will not take you to the sea again then will send a strong breeze which will break your ship into pieces; then because of your infidelity He will drown you, then you will not find anyone who will help you against Us.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ اَمِنتُمْ اَن يُعِيدَكُمْ فِيهِ تَارَةً اُخْرَىٰ فَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ قَاصِفًۭا مِّنَ الرِّيحِ فَيُغْرِقَكُم بِمَا كَفَرْتُمْ ۙ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُواْ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا بِهِ تَبِيعًۭا

verses.english_text: Indeed, We gave honor to the children of Adam and they roamed on the land and the sea (with animals and ships), and gave them good things to eat; and We appropriately excelled them appropriately over Our many creations.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَ لَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍۢ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And remember the day when We will call the people with their leaders, and they will read their deeds (happily) whose record book (of deeds) will be given in their right hand, and they will not be persecuted even like a single hair.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ نَدْعُواْ كُلَّ اُنَاسٍۭ بِاِمَـٰمِهِمْ ۖ فَمَنْ اُوتِىَ كِتٰبَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَقْرَءُونَ كِتٰبَهُمْ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ فَتِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: The man who (knowingly) lived like a blind in the world, he will be blind in the Hereafter also, and he will go far away from the path (of deliverance).
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن كَانَ فِى هَـٰذِهِٓ اَعْمَىٰ فَهُوَ فِى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ اَعْمَىٰ وَاَضَلُّ سَبِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Indeed, they wish to deviate you from the conversation which We sent to you through revelation, so that you say something other than this (Quran) which may not be true, and if that would have happened, they would have considered you as friend.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن كَادُواْ لَيَفْتِنُونَكَ عَنِ الَّذِىٓ اَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَيْكَ لِتَفْتَرِىَ عَلَيْنَا غَيْرَهُ ۖ وَاِذًۭا لَّاتَّخَذُوكَ خَلِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And if it was not that we kept you steadfast, you would have somehow inclined towards them.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَوْلَآ اَن ثَبَّتْنَـٰكَ لَقَدْ كِدتَّ تَرْكَنُ اِلَيْهِمْ شَيْـًۭٔا قَلِيلًا

verses.english_text: Then We would have made you taste in life as well as in death double the punishment, and you would not have found any helper against Us.
verses.arabic_text: اِذًۭا لَّاَذَقْنَـٰكَ ضِعْفَ الْحَيَوٰةِ وَضِعْفَ الْمَمَاتِ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ عَلَيْنَا نَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: And these people want you to be disheartened from the land (of Makkah) and they want to expel you (towards Syria), and if they would have done it; they themselves could not have stayed there, except for a few days.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن كَادُواْ لَيَسْتَفِزُّونَكَ مِنَ الْاَرْضِ لِيُخْرِجُوكَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَاِذًۭا لَّا يَلْبَثُونَ خِلَـٰفَكَ اِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And before you, We have sent the prophets; they also had followed the same course, and you cannot find any change in the course set by Us.
verses.arabic_text: سُنَّةَ مَن قَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَا ۖ وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّتِنَا تَحْوِيلًا

verses.english_text: Keep up the prayer from the decline of sun until the darkness of night. (Zohr, Asr, Maghrib & Isha); and morning prayer (also); because morning prayer is testified upon (by angels of night and day both).
verses.arabic_text: اَقِمِ الصَّلَوٰةَ لِدُلُوكِ الشَّمْسِ اِلَىٰ غَسَقِ الَّيْلِ وَقُرْءَانَ الْفَجْرِ ۖ اِنَّ قُرْءَانَ الْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًۭا

verses.english_text: And during the night time keep up late night prayer; this addition is your excellence, soon (on the Day of Judgement) your Lord may reach you to the highly praiseworthy position.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِ نَافِلَةًۭ لَّكَ عَسَىٰٓ اَن يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًۭا مَّحْمُودًۭا

verses.english_text: Say: O my Lord! Make my entry with goodliness (in Madina) and make my departure with goodliness (from Makkah), and bestow upon me from Your Court a power which will be my helper.
verses.arabic_text: وَقُل رَّبِّ اَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍۢ وَاَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍۢ وَاجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَـٰنًۭا نَّصِيرًا

verses.english_text: Say: Truth has come and falsehood has vanished; indeed, falsehood was destined to vanish.
verses.arabic_text: وَقُلْ جَآءَ الْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الْبَـٰطِلُ ۚ اِنَّ الْبَـٰطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقًۭا

verses.english_text: And what We reveal in the Quran which is healing and mercy for the believers; and nothing adds up for disobedience but the loss.
verses.arabic_text: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌۭ وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۙ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ اِلَّا خَسَارًا

verses.english_text: And when We bestowed favor on humans (instead) he turned his face away from Us and becomes remote, and is disappointed if any trouble touches him.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَآ اَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْاِنسَـٰنِ اَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِ ۖ وَاِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ كَانَ يَـُٔوسًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) Say: everyone is doing the deeds in his own way, but your Lord knows who is best on the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ كُلٌّۭ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِ فَرَبُّكُمْ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ اَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), these people ask you about the soul, tell them that soul is a command of my Lord, and you have been given a little knowledge.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ ۖ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّى وَ مَآ اُوتِيتُم مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ اِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), if We please, We will take back this (Quran) which We revealed to you, then you will not find any helper against Us.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَئِن شِئْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِالَّذِىٓ اَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا وَكِيلًا

verses.english_text: But this is only great Mercy of your Lord (that He has not taken it back), indeed His grace and Mercy is on you.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ اِنَّ فَضْلَهُ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet) say: if all the men and jinn of the world gather on this, to bring a similar Quran. (it is impossible) they could not bring a similar one (Quran), and some of them may help others.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لَّئِنِ اجْتَمَعَتِ الْاِنسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَىٰٓ اَن يَاْتُواْ بِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا الْقُرْءَانِ لَا يَاْتُونَ بِمِثْلِهِ وَ لَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍۢ ظَهِيرًا

verses.english_text: And We explain examples differently for the people (to make them understand), but still, most of them do not stop being ungrateful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا الْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍۢ فَاَبَىٰٓ اَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ اِلَّا كُفُورًا

verses.english_text: And they (infidels of Makkah) say: we will not believe on you unless you do not flow a fountain for us from the earth.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ الْاَرْضِ يَنۢبُوعًا

verses.english_text: Or you should have a garden of dates and grapes; in the middle of it you cause rivers to flow and show us.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ تَكُونَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌۭ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَعِنَبٍۢ فَتُفَجِّرَ الْاَنْهَـٰرَ خِلَـٰلَهَا تَفْجِيرًا

verses.english_text: Or break the sky into pieces on us, or bring angels of Allah in front of us (to prove your words).
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ تُسْقِطَ السَّمَآءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا اَوْ تَاْتِىَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ قَبِيلًا

verses.english_text: Or you should have a house of gold or you ascend to the sky and we will not be convinced of your ascension unless you send to us a book (from there) and we read it; (O Prophet) say: Praises to my Lord, what I am except a human and a prophet (of Allah)?
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌۭ مِّن زُخْرُفٍ اَوْ تَرْقَىٰ فِى السَّمَآءِ وَلَن نُّؤْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتَّىٰ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتٰبًۭا نَّقْرَؤُهُ ۗ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّى هَلْ كُنتُ اِلَّا بَشَرًا رَّسُولًۭا

verses.english_text: And after the arrival of guidance nothing is stopping them from believing except, their saying that Allah has sent a human as a prophet.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ اَن يُؤْمِنُوٓاْ اِذْ جَآءَهُمُ الْهُدَىٰٓ اِلَّآ اَن قَالُوٓاْ اَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ بَشَرًا رَّسُولًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) Say: If angels had settled and walked peacefully on the earth, We would have sent to them an angel as a prophet.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ فِى الْاَرْضِ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةٌۭ يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ مَلَكًۭا رَّسُولًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), say: indeed, Allah is enough between you and me as a witness, there is no doubt that He is Aware of conditions of His servants; and He Sees.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: And to whoever Allah guides, only he is the guided one, and to whoever He leave in misguidance, then (remember) you will not find any guardian other than Him; and on the Day of Judgement, We will raise them upside down, blind, dumb and deaf (from their graves), their abode will be Hellfire, and if it will ever (begin to) extinguish; We will flare it up again.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ اَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِهِ ۖ وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ عُمْيًۭا وَبُكْمًۭا وَصُمًّۭا ۖ مَّاْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنَـٰهُمْ سَعِيرًا

verses.english_text: This is their punishment because of their denial of our verses; and their saying that: after our death when we will become bones and decayed particles, will we be raised as new creation?
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم بِاَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَقَالُوٓاْ اَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًۭا وَرُفَـٰتًا اَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًۭا جَدِيدًا

verses.english_text: Do they not ponder that Allah who has created the skies and the earth is also have power to create similar humans again, and without any doubt We have fixed the term for them (their death), even then these unjust continue to deny this.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ اَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِى خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ اَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ اَجَلًۭا لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ فَاَبَى الظَّـٰلِمُونَ اِلَّا كُفُورًا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) Say: Even if you had treasures of my Lord's Mercy, you would have kept it locked for fear of spending it, and man is very strait hearted.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لَّوْ اَنتُمْ تَمْلِكُونَ خَزَآئِنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّىٓ اِذًۭا لَّاَمْسَكْتُمْ خَشْيَةَ الْاِنفَاقِ ۚ وَكَانَ الْاِنسَـٰنُ قَتُورًا

verses.english_text: And We gave nine manifest miracles to Moosa, so (O Prophet) ask Bani Israel, when Moosa came to them, Firaun said: O Moosa, I think somebody has cast magic on you and made you mad.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ اٰيٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ اِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُ فِرْعَوْنُ اِنِّى لَاَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًا

verses.english_text: Said Moosa: you Verily know that all these miracles have been sent by the Lord of the skies and the earth, these are things for pondering; O Firaun, I believe your misfortune has begun.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَآ اَنزَلَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ اِلَّا رَبُّ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ بَصَآئِرَ وَاِنِّى لَاَظُنُّكَ يَـٰفِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُورًا

verses.english_text: Then Firaun decided to extern Bani Israel from the land (of Egypt), so We drowned Firaun and the people who were with him.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَرَادَ اَن يَسْتَفِزَّهُم مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ فَاَغْرَقْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُ جَمِيعًۭا

verses.english_text: Thereafter We told Bani Israel to live peacefully in this land; and when the promise of the Hereafter will come, We will bring you all together.
verses.arabic_text: وَقُلْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِ لِبَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ اسْكُنُواْ الْاَرْضَ فَاِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًۭا

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), We revealed it (Quran) with truth, and it (Quran) was revealed with truth (too), and We have made you who gives glad tidings (of Paradise) and a warner (of punishment).
verses.arabic_text: وَبِالْحَقِّ اَنزَلْنَـٰهُ وَبِالْحَقِّ نَزَلَ ۗ وَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا

verses.english_text: We revealed Quran on you in parts, so you may recite it before the people as per requirement, and We revealed it slowly, slowly.
verses.arabic_text: وَقُرْءَانًۭا فَرَقْنَـٰهُ لِتَقْرَاَهُ عَلَى النَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍۢ وَنَزَّلْنَـٰهُ تَنزِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Say: whether you believe on it or not, indeed those who were given the knowledge (of Heavenly Books) before this; when it was recited, they used to fell down on their faces in prostration.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ ءَامِنُواْ بِهِٓ اَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوٓاْ ۚ اِنَّ الَّذِينَ اُوتُواْ الْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهِٓ اِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّونَ لِلْاَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًۭا

verses.english_text: {Prostrate Non-Obligatory} And they say: Glory be to Allah; indeed, the promise of our Lord was to be completed.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ اِن كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًۭا

verses.english_text: And these people fall on their faces in prostration and weep and this Quran increases their humbleness.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلْاَذْقَانِ يَبْكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ خُشُوعًۭا ۩

verses.english_text: {Prostrate Non-Obligatory} (O Prophet), say: either you call Him Allah or Merciful (Raheem), all His (all) names are Beautiful, and don't recite your prayer very loudly, and neither recite your prayer with complete silence, but adopt a medium tone.
verses.arabic_text: قُلِ ادْعُواْ اللَّهَ اَوِ ادْعُواْ الرَّحْمَـٰنَ ۖ اَيًّۭا مَّا تَدْعُواْ فَلَهُ الْاَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And say: all praises are due to Allah only, He neither has a child, nor does He have any partner in (His) Kingdom of the world, and He does not have any weakness that He should have a guardian; and continue to proclaim His Greatness in best manner.
verses.arabic_text: وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًۭا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ شَرِيكٌۭ فِى الْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ وَلِىٌّۭ مِّنَ الذُّلِّ ۖ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًۢا

verses.english_text: All praises are worthy for Allah only Who revealed the Book (Quran) on His servant (Mohammad [SAW]); and did not keep any crookedness in it.
verses.arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِىٓ اَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ الْكِتٰبَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُ عِوَجَا ۜ

verses.english_text: (But kept it) straight so that He may warn of severe punishment from Him (to the infidels), and to give glad tidings of best reward to believers who perform the good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: قَيِّمًۭا لِّيُنذِرَ بَاْسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا مِّن لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمْ اَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا

verses.english_text: They shall forever abide in it (with serenity).
verses.arabic_text: مَّـٰكِثِينَ فِيهِ اَبَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And those who believe that Allah has a son, warn them (about the punishment).
verses.arabic_text: وَيُنذِرَ الَّذِينَ قَالُواْ اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ وَلَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And they have no knowledge of it, nor do their forefathers had any knowledge; (these are) strong words which they utter; they do not utter (anything) except lie.
verses.arabic_text: مَّا لَهُم بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا لِـَٔابَآئِهِمْ ۚ كَبُرَتْ كَلِمَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ اَفْوَٰهِهِمْ ۚ اِن يَقُولُونَ اِلَّا كَذِبًۭا

verses.english_text: So (O Prophet), perhaps you may kill yourself with grief following after them, if they do not believe this.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَـٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ اِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُواْ بِهَـٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ اَسَفًا

verses.english_text: Whatever is on the earth We made it its adornment, so that We test people that who is best among them based on their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى الْاَرْضِ زِينَةًۭ لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ اَيُّهُمْ اَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا

verses.english_text: Then one day whatever is on it (will destroy) and We will make it chattel plains
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّا لَجَـٰعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيْهَا صَعِيدًۭا جُرُزًا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), do you think the companions of the Cave and the Inscription were a wonder among Our signs?
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ حَسِبْتَ اَنَّ اَصْحَـٰبَ الْكَهْفِ وَالرَّقِيمِ كَانُواْ مِنْ اٰيٰتِنَا عَجَبًا

verses.english_text: That suddenly some youth came in the cave and prayed: O my Lord, grant us Mercy from Your Court and bestow upon us success in our affairs.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ اَوَى الْفِتْيَةُ اِلَى الْكَهْفِ فَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةًۭ وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ اَمْرِنَا رَشَدًۭا

verses.english_text: Then We covered their ears with a veil in the cave for many years. (put them to sleep)
verses.arabic_text: فَضَرَبْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ فِى الْكَهْفِ سِنِينَ عَدَدًۭا

verses.english_text: Then We woke them up to see that between the two groups who is more aware of their period of stay.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَـٰهُمْ لِنَعْلَمَ اَىُّ الْحِزْبَيْنِ اَحْصَىٰ لِمَا لَبِثُوٓاْ اَمَدًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), We describe their condition with truth, and they were a few youths who believed in their truthful Lord, and We increased their guidance.
verses.arabic_text: نَّحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ نَبَاَهُم بِالْحَقِّ ۚ اِنَّهُمْ فِتْيَةٌ ءَامَنُواْ بِرَبِّهِمْ وَزِدْنَـٰهُمْ هُدًۭى

verses.english_text: And We strengthened their hearts (with patience and liberty), so they stood up and said: our Lord is master of the skies and the earth, and we will never worship any god except Him; if we do this then it would be irrational.
verses.arabic_text: وَرَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ اِذْ قَامُواْ فَقَالُواْ رَبُّنَا رَبُّ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ لَن نَّدْعُوَاْ مِن دُونِهِٓ اِلَـٰهًۭا ۖ لَّقَدْ قُلْنَآ اِذًۭا شَطَطًا

verses.english_text: (Alas!) these are people of our nation who have made other gods beside Him, then why they do not present a manifest sign for them; and who can be more unjust than who falsely blame Allah?
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمُنَا اتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ ۖ لَّوْلَا يَاْتُونَ عَلَيْهِم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍۭ بَيِّنٍۢ ۖ فَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا

verses.english_text: (They said among themselves) Since you have deviated from the gods they worshipped. (let’s go) take refuge in the cave and your Lord will expand His Mercy on you and will make things easy for you.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذِ اعْتَزَلْتُمُوهُمْ وَ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ اِلَّا اللَّهَ فَاْوُٓاْ اِلَى الْكَهْفِ يَنشُرْ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِ وَيُهَيِّئْ لَكُم مِّنْ اَمْرِكُم مِّرْفَقًۭا

verses.english_text: (At last they settled in the cave) When sun rises you will see that it inclines towards right side of their cave, and when it set, it tilts towards their left; and they are staying in spacious place in the cave; this is one sign out of (Many) signs of Allah, and to whomsoever Allah guides, only he is the guided one, and to whomsoever He misguides then you can never find a guardian for him.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَتَرَى الشَّمْسَ اِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَٰوَرُ عَن كَهْفِهِمْ ذَاتَ الْيَمِينِ وَاِذَا غَرَبَت تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ وَهُمْ فِى فَجْوَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ اٰيٰتِ اللَّهِ ۗ مَن يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُ وَلِيًّۭا مُّرْشِدًۭا

verses.english_text: You will think that they are awake, but they are deep asleep, and sometimes We make them turn on their right side and sometimes on their left side, and their dog lay on threshold outstretching his front legs; (their condition is such) that if you will look at them (peek into their cave) you will run back and your heart will be filled with fright.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ اَيْقَاظًۭا وَهُمْ رُقُودٌۭ ۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ الْيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ ۖ وَكَلْبُهُم بَـٰسِطٌۭ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِالْوَصِيدِ ۚ لَوِ اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًا وَلَمُلِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ رُعْبًۭا

verses.english_text: And (as We put them to sleep) likewise We raised them (woke them up) that they may question each other, and one speaker among them said: for how long you stayed (here). (another one) said: one day or even less than that. (thereafter they) said: your Lord knows for how long you have stayed, now send one of us to the city with some coins so he goes and see which is the best food (available), and bring some provision for you, he should go discreetly, that no one should come to know about you.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ بَعَثْنَـٰهُمْ لِيَتَسَآءَلُواْ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ ۖ قَالُواْ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا اَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ ۚ قَالُواْ رَبُّكُمْ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثْتُمْ فَابْعَثُوٓاْ اَحَدَكُم بِوَرِقِكُمْ هَـٰذِهِٓ اِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَلْيَنظُرْ اَيُّهَآ اَزْكَىٰ طَعَامًۭا فَلْيَاْتِكُم بِرِزْقٍۢ مِّنْهُ وَلْيَتَلَطَّفْ وَلَا يُشْعِرَنَّ بِكُمْ اَحَدًا

verses.english_text: Indeed if they come to know about you, they will either stone you or take you back towards their religion, and if this happens then you can never get the deliverance.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُمْ اِن يَظْهَرُواْ عَلَيْكُمْ يَرْجُمُوكُمْ اَوْ يُعِيدُوكُمْ فِى مِلَّتِهِمْ وَلَن تُفْلِحُوٓاْ اِذًا اَبَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And in this way We made them know their condition so they should see that promise of Allah is true, and that there is no doubt in the Day of Judgement. (after getting their news) they disputed among themselves; some of them said that an edifice should be erected on the cave in their remembrance, their Lord knows of their condition well, and those who prevailed over others said: we will make a mosque on it.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ اَعْثَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَعْلَمُوٓاْ اَنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَاَنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَآ اِذْ يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ اَمْرَهُمْ ۖ فَقَالُواْ ابْنُواْ عَلَيْهِم بُنْيَـٰنًۭا ۖ رَّبُّهُمْ اَعْلَمُ بِهِمْ ۚ قَالَ الَّذِينَ غَلَبُواْ عَلَىٰٓ اَمْرِهِمْ لَنَتَّخِذَنَّ عَلَيْهِم مَّسْجِدًۭا

verses.english_text: Shortly these people will say they are three and their dog is fourth, and some will say they are five and their dog is sixth, they speculate in the unseen, and some people will say they are seven and eighth is their dog. (O Prophet) say: their number is only known to my Lord, few people are aware of their (actual) number, so (O Prophet) do not argue with them regarding Companions of the Cave except a superficial talk, and do not enquire from these people about them (Companions of the Cave).
verses.arabic_text: سَيَقُولُونَ ثَلَـٰثَةٌۭ رَّابِعُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ خَمْسَةٌۭ سَادِسُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ رَجْمًۢا بِالْغَيْبِ ۖ وَيَقُولُونَ سَبْعَةٌۭ وَثَامِنُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ ۚ قُل رَّبِّىٓ اَعْلَمُ بِعِدَّتِهِم مَّا يَعْلَمُهُمْ اِلَّا قَلِيلٌۭ ۗ فَلَا تُمَارِ فِيهِمْ اِلَّا مِرَآءًۭ ظَـٰهِرًا وَلَا تَسْتَفْتِ فِيهِم مِّنْهُمْ اَحَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And do not say for any work that you will do it tomorrow.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَاْىْءٍ اِنِّى فَاعِلٌۭ ذَٰلِكَ غَدًا

verses.english_text: But say it with if Allah pleases; in case you forget, then remember your Lord (say Allah Willing), and say: I hope my Lord will guide me to that whichever is nearer to the reality.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّآ اَن يَشَآءَ اللَّهُ ۚ وَاذْكُر رَّبَّكَ اِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰٓ اَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّى لِاَقْرَبَ مِنْ هَـٰذَا رَشَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And Companions of the Cave stayed in their cave for 309 years.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَبِثُواْ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِاْئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَازْدَادُواْ تِسْعًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet, if they do not believe say): Allah knows well their period of stay, knowledge of the unseen of the skies and the earth is exclusive for Allah only, how clear He sees and how clear He hears; there is no guardian for them except Him, and He does not associate anybody in His commands.
verses.arabic_text: قُلِ اللَّهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُواْ ۖ لَهُ غَيْبُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۖ اَبْصِرْ بِهِ وَاَسْمِعْ ۚ مَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا يُشْرِكُ فِى حُكْمِهِٓ اَحَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), recite the Book which has been sent to you through revelation, no one can alter its content, and except Him you will not find shelter anywhere.
verses.arabic_text: وَاتْلُ مَآ اُوحِىَ اِلَيْكَ مِن كِتَابِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَـٰتِهِ وَلَن تَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), you also be patient along with those who remember Allah early morning and at dusk and desire His pleasure, and do not turn your sight from them that you (also) desire beauty of world's life; and whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance, he follows his worldly desires, his act is to commit manifest excesses.
verses.arabic_text: وَاصْبِرْ نَفْسَكَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَدَوٰةِ وَالْعَشِىِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ ۖ وَلَا تَعْدُ عَيْنَاكَ عَنْهُمْ تُرِيدُ زِينَةَ الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا تُطِعْ مَنْ اَغْفَلْنَا قَلْبَهُ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ وَكَانَ اَمْرُهُ فُرُطًۭا

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet) say: the truth has been revealed to you from your Lord, whoever wish may believe and whoever wish may not believe, We have prepared the fire for the unjust whose walls will encircle them; and if they will cry for help, they will be given (boiling) water which will be like molten copper that will scald their mouths; what an evil water is this and what an evil place is this (Hell).
verses.arabic_text: وَقُلِ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ فَلْيُؤْمِن وَمَن شَآءَ فَلْيَكْفُرْ ۚ اِنَّآ اَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ نَارًا اَحَاطَ بِهِمْ سُرَادِقُهَا ۚ وَاِن يَسْتَغِيثُواْ يُغَاثُواْ بِمَآءٍۢ كَالْمُهْلِ يَشْوِى الْوُجُوهَ ۚ بِئْسَ الشَّرَابُ وَسَآءَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا

verses.english_text: Indeed, those who believed and performed good deeds; We never waste the reward of those who do good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ اِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ اَجْرَ مَنْ اَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا

verses.english_text: These are the people for whom there are evergreen gardens in Paradise, wherein rivers will be flowing beneath their mansions where they will adorn the bright gold bracelets and they will be given fine and thick silk robes of green colour; and they will be reclining on couches with cushions, and what a good reward it is, and what a good place it is (Paradise).
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمُ الْاَنْهَـٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ اَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍۢ وَيَلْبَسُونَ ثِيَابًا خُضْرًا مِّن سُندُسٍۢ وَاِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْاَرَآئِكِ ۚ نِعْمَ الثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), tell them the examples of two persons, to one of them We have given two gardens of grapes, We have surrounded them with palm trees, and also there is farming between the gardens.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَاضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًۭا رَّجُلَيْنِ جَعَلْنَا لِاَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ اَعْنَـٰبٍۢ وَحَفَفْنَـٰهُمَا بِنَخْلٍۢ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمَا زَرْعًۭا

verses.english_text: And both gardens yielded a good crop of fruits, and there was no shortage, and We have also flown rivers between those two gardens.
verses.arabic_text: كِلْتَا الْجَنَّتَيْنِ ءَاتَتْ اُكُلَهَا وَلَمْ تَظْلِم مِّنْهُ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَفَجَّرْنَا خِلَـٰلَهُمَا نَهَرًا

verses.english_text: And when he got the yield, he said to whom he was talking, I have more wealth than you and my group is also larger than you.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَانَ لَهُ ثَمَرٌۭ فَقَالَ لِصَـٰحِبِهِ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُٓ اَنَا۠ اَكْثَرُ مِنكَ مَالًۭا وَاَعَزُّ نَفَرًا

verses.english_text: (While talking this) he entered into the garden, however his condition was such that he was being unjust upon him and said: I do not think this garden can ever perish.
verses.arabic_text: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِ قَالَ مَآ اَظُنُّ اَن تَبِيدَ هَـٰذِهِٓ اَبَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And I do not even think that the Day of Judgement will ever happen, and if ever I will be returned to Lord then indeed He will give me much better place than this.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةًۭ وَلَئِن رُّدِدتُّ اِلَىٰ رَبِّى لَاَجِدَنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهَا مُنقَلَبًۭا

verses.english_text: His companion who was talking to him said: Do you deny your Lord who created you by dust and took you out from sperm then made you a perfect man.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَهُ صَاحِبُهُ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُٓ اَكَفَرْتَ بِالَّذِى خَلَقَكَ مِن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰكَ رَجُلًۭا

verses.english_text: (But we say), that Allah is my Lord, and I do not make anybody His partner.
verses.arabic_text: لَّـٰكِنَّا۠ هُوَ اللَّهُ رَبِّى وَلَآ اُشْرِكُ بِرَبِّىٓ اَحَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And when you entered the garden why didn't you say: it is all as Allah pleased (nothing is mine), because without the help of Allah no one has any power, even if you consider me inferior to you in wealth and children.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَوْلَآ اِذْ دَخَلْتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلْتَ مَا شَآءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ۚ اِن تَرَنِ اَنَا۠ اَقَلَّ مِنكَ مَالًۭا وَوَلَدًۭا

verses.english_text: So, shortly my Lord will give me a garden which will be better than your garden, and will send a pestilence from sky which will make your garden a chattel plain.
verses.arabic_text: فَعَسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ اَن يُؤْتِيَنِ خَيْرًا مِّن جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهَا حُسْبَانًۭا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فَتُصْبِحَ صَعِيدًۭا زَلَقًا

verses.english_text: Or will decrease the water level which you will not be able to find it.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ يُصْبِحَ مَآؤُهَا غَوْرًا فَلَن تَسْتَطِيعَ لَهُ طَلَبًۭا

verses.english_text: (So the punishment came), and the fruits (of his garden) became affected by a pestilence, then he regretfully rubbed his hands on the wealth which he had spent on preparation of his garden, and condition of the garden was such, that it had fallen upside down on its branches, and he said, alas! would that I had not made any partner with Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَاُحِيطَ بِثَمَرِهِ فَاَصْبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَىٰ مَآ اَنفَقَ فِيهَا وَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ اُشْرِكْ بِرَبِّىٓ اَحَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And except Allah there was not any group which would have helped him (against Allah), neither he could take revenge.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُ فِئَةٌۭ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَ مَا كَانَ مُنتَصِرًا

verses.english_text: And it was proved here that guardianship is only for Allah; who is truthful, and He is best in requiting and is better in giving the end result.
verses.arabic_text: هُنَالِكَ الْوَلَـٰيَةُ لِلَّهِ الْحَقِّ ۚ هُوَ خَيْرٌۭ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌ عُقْبًۭا

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), describe to them examples of the world also, its condition is like water which We rain down from the sky which will be absorbed by earth's vegetation, then in the end it will become particles which will be blown by the wind, and Allah has Power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلَ الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا كَمَآءٍ اَنزَلْنَـٰهُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَبَاتُ الْاَرْضِ فَاَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًۭا تَذْرُوهُ الرِّيَـٰحُ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرًا

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), wealth and children are adornments of life of the world, and good deeds are much better with your Lord in regards to hopes and rewards.
verses.arabic_text: الْمَالُ وَالْبَنُونَ زِينَةُ الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَالْبَـٰقِيَـٰتُ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌ اَمَلًۭا

verses.english_text: (Fear that day) when We will move the mountains and you will see the earth as an open ground, and We will gather them all and will not leave even a single one.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ نُسَيِّرُ الْجِبَالَ وَتَرَى الْاَرْضَ بَارِزَةًۭ وَحَشَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَلَمْ نُغَادِرْ مِنْهُمْ اَحَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And (they all) will be presented in different queues before your Lord. (then We will remind them) as We created you earlier, at last you had to come to Us; and you thought that for your re-creation We will not appoint a time.
verses.arabic_text: وَعُرِضُواْ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ صَفًّۭا لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا كَمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۭ ۚ بَلْ زَعَمْتُمْ اَلَّن نَّجْعَلَ لَكُم مَّوْعِدًۭا

verses.english_text: And the book (of deeds of people) will be kept before them, then you will see that sinners will become fearful to look at whatever would be written therein; Oh our misfortune! which book is this, no smaller or greater sins have been omitted from writing in it, whatever they have done in the world they shall find written in it; and your Lord is not unjust on anyone.
verses.arabic_text: وَوُضِعَ الْكِتٰبُ فَتَرَى الْمُجْرِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِيهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَـٰوَيْلَتَنَا مَالِ هَـٰذَا الْكِتٰبِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةًۭ وَلَا كَبِيرَةً اِلَّآ اَحْصَىٰهَا ۚ وَوَجَدُواْ مَا عَمِلُواْ حَاضِرًا ۗ وَلَا يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ اَحَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And remember the time when We commanded to angels to prostrate before Adam, so except Iblis everyone prostrated; he (Iblis) was from jinn who ran away from the command of his Lord, so (O people) do you make him and his children your friend; whereas they are your enemies, but unjust befriended him instead of Allah; this swap is worst for the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ اسْجُدُواْ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ اِلَّآ اِبْلِيسَ كَانَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّهِٓ ۗ اَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُٓ اَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِى وَهُمْ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۢ ۚ بِئْسَ لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بَدَلًۭا

verses.english_text: I did not called upon them (as witness) when I was creating the skies and the earth, and I did not called them (as witness) when I was creating them; I was not like that who would make helpers to those who go astray.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ مَّآ اَشْهَدتُّهُمْ خَلْقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَلَا خَلْقَ اَنفُسِهِمْ وَ مَا كُنتُ مُتَّخِذَ الْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدًۭا

verses.english_text: (And fear that day) when Allah will say: call upon those whom you considered My partner; they will call them, but they will not listen to them any; and We will make a strong curtain between them.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ نَادُواْ شُرَكَآءِىَ الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُواْ لَهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّوْبِقًۭا

verses.english_text: Upon seeing the fire the guilty ones will understand that they will be thrown into it, and they shall not find a way to avoid it.
verses.arabic_text: وَرَءَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ النَّارَ فَظَنُّوٓاْ اَنَّهُم مُّوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمْ يَجِدُواْ عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًۭا

verses.english_text: And for their understanding We have described the parables in different ways, but human is more quarrelling than other creations.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِى هَـٰذَا الْقُرْءَانِ لِلنَّاسِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍۢ ۚ وَكَانَ الْاِنسَـٰنُ اَكْثَرَ شَىْءٍۢ جَدَلًۭا

verses.english_text: And when guidance has come to them, only tradition of their earlier people is preventing them from believing and from seeking forgiveness from their Lord; or punishment should come in front of them?
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ اَن يُؤْمِنُوٓاْ اِذْ جَآءَهُمُ الْهُدَىٰ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُواْ رَبَّهُمْ اِلَّآ اَن تَاْتِيَهُمْ سُنَّةُ الْاَوَّلِينَ اَوْ يَاْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ قُبُلًۭا

verses.english_text: And We send prophets only to give glad tidings (of deliverance) and warn (from punishment), and infidels quarrel on false things with the intention to uproot the truth, and they make fun of those verses of Ours in which We have warn them (of punishment).
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ ۚ وَيُجَـٰدِلُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِالْبَـٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُواْ بِهِ الْحَقَّ ۖ وَاتَّخَذُوٓاْ اٰيٰتِى وَ مَآ اُنذِرُواْ هُزُوًۭا

verses.english_text: And who can be more unjust than who is reminded of verses of his Lord but he turns away, and he has forgotten his earlier deeds, as if We have curtained their hearts so that they don't understand, and made their ears hard of hearing (that they don't listen), and if you will call them to the right path but they are never going to get the guidance.
