verses.arabic_text: وَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ فَاَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا وَنَسِىَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ ۚ اِنَّا جَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ اَكِنَّةً اَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا ۖ وَاِن تَدْعُهُمْ اِلَى الْهُدَىٰ فَلَن يَهْتَدُوٓاْ اِذًا اَبَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), your Lord is all forgiving and Merciful; and if because of their deeds Allah will catch hold of them, then He will send punishment on them immediately, but for them a term is fixed, and from that they will not get shelter anywhere except Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَرَبُّكَ الْغَفُورُ ذُو الرَّحْمَةِ ۖ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُهُم بِمَا كَسَبُواْ لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابَ ۚ بَل لَّهُم مَّوْعِدٌۭ لَّن يَجِدُواْ مِن دُونِهِ مَوْئِلًۭا

verses.english_text: The settlements which you see with your eyes, we destroyed them, when their people transgressed, and We had fixed the term for their destruction.
verses.arabic_text: وَتِلْكَ الْقُرَىٰٓ اَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُواْ وَجَعَلْنَا لِمَهْلِكِهِم مَّوْعِدًۭا

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), remember the tale when Moosa (went to meet Khizr) said to his young assistant (Yosh'e) that I will not stop unless I reach the junction where two rivers meet; I will walk for years (until I do not meet him).
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَىٰهُ لَآ اَبْرَحُ حَتَّىٰٓ اَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ اَوْ اَمْضِىَ حُقُبًۭا

verses.english_text: When they reached the junction of the rivers, he left their (barbeque) fish, it made its way and swam away.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِى الْبَحْرِ سَرَبًۭا

verses.english_text: When they walked some distance Moosa asked his young assistant to give his breakfast to him (and said), we have met with fatigue on our today's journey.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَىٰهُ ءَاتِنَا غَدَآءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَـٰذَا نَصَبًۭا

verses.english_text: (Yosh'e) said: did you see that when we halted near the stone, I left the fish there, and Satan made me to forget and I could not tell this to you, in a strange way it made its way in the river.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَرَءَيْتَ اِذْ اَوَيْنَآ اِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ فَاِنِّى نَسِيتُ الْحُوتَ وَ مَآ اَنسَىٰنِيهُ اِلَّا الشَّيْطَـٰنُ اَنْ اَذْكُرَهُ ۚ وَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِى الْبَحْرِ عَجَبًۭا

verses.english_text: Moosa said: That was the place we were looking for, then both of them returned back to that place (retracing their own footsteps, where they had left the fish).
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ ۚ فَارْتَدَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًۭا

verses.english_text: Both of them found one from among Our servants (Khizr) upon whom We granted Mercy and taught him a part of Our Exclusive Knowledge.
verses.arabic_text: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا

verses.english_text: Moosa said to him: I have come with the purpose to accompany you, so that you can teach me some from the knowledge of guidance which you have been taught by Allah.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَهُ مُوسَىٰ هَلْ اَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَىٰٓ اَن تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ رُشْدًۭا

verses.english_text: I will teach you, but you may not have patience with me.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًا

verses.english_text: And how you can be patient on the things which are not in your knowledge.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ خُبْرًا

verses.english_text: If Allah pleases, you will find me patient and I will not oppose any of your orders.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ اِن شَآءَ اللَّهُ صَابِرًا وَلَآ اَعْصِى لَكَ اَمْرًا

verses.english_text: That servant (Khizr) said: if you want to accompany me, do not question me about anything, until I do not begin the talk myself.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَاِنِ اتَّبَعْتَنِى فَلَا تَسْـَٔلْنِى عَن شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ اُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا

verses.english_text: So they began to walk together until they reached a ship in which that servant (of Mine) made a hole in it, you made a hole in it to drown the people, this is a strange act.
verses.arabic_text: فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا رَكِبَا فِى السَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا ۖ قَالَ اَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ اَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًٔا اِمْرًا

verses.english_text: That servant of Allah said: did not I tell you, you cannot not be patient with me.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَلَمْ اَقُلْ اِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًا

verses.english_text: Moosa said: whatever has happened has happened, do not rebuke me on my negligence and do not be so strict in this matter.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِى بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِى مِنْ اَمْرِى عُسْرًا

verses.english_text: Then they both went ahead until they met a boy, then that servant of Allah killed him, Moosa said: did you kill an innocent person, and that's too without any revenge for a blood, indeed your act was strange.
verses.arabic_text: فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَـٰمًۭا فَقَتَلَهُ قَالَ اَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا زَكِيَّةًۢ بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍۢ لَّقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًۭٔا نُّكْرًا

verses.english_text: (Khizr) said: didn't I tell you that you can never have patience while accompanying me.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قَالَ اَلَمْ اَقُل لَّكَ اِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًا

verses.english_text: Moosa said: (okay) now if I ask you anything then do not allow me to accompany you, Verily you have reached a level of excuses from me.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِن سَاَلْتُكَ عَن شَىْءٍۭ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَـٰحِبْنِى ۖ قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِن لَّدُنِّى عُذْرًا

verses.english_text: At last both of them went ahead and reached near the people of (a) village, he asked for some food but they refused to host both of them, then both of them saw a wall in that village which was about to fall which he (Khizr) straightened. (on this) Moosa said: if you wanted you could have taken the wage for this.
verses.arabic_text: فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَآ اَتَيَآ اَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ اسْتَطْعَمَآ اَهْلَهَا فَاَبَوْاْ اَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًا يُرِيدُ اَن يَنقَضَّ فَاَقَامَهُ ۖ قَالَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ اَجْرًا

verses.english_text: (Khizr) said: Now separation between us, on the things you didn't have patience, I am telling their reality.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ هَـٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنِكَ ۚ سَاُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَاْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا

verses.english_text: That ship (in which I made a hole) belonged to few poor (people) who used to toil on it for their sustenance in the river; I wished to make it faulty because an unjust king was in his pursuit who used to seize the ships by force (and take it in his possession).
verses.arabic_text: اَمَّا السَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَـٰكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِى الْبَحْرِ فَاَرَدتُّ اَنْ اَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكٌۭ يَاْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًۭا

verses.english_text: And about that boy, both his parents are believers, and I thought (that he will grow up and) entangle them in infidelity and transgression.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمَّا الْغُلَـٰمُ فَكَانَ اَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَآ اَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَـٰنًۭا وَكُفْرًا

verses.english_text: So I desired that their Lord will give them a such a son in return who will be pure, and better in nearness to them.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَرَدْنَآ اَن يُبْدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهُ زَكَوٰةًۭ وَاَقْرَبَ رُحْمًۭا

verses.english_text: And about that wall, it belonged two orphan boys and there was a treasure of them buried beneath it, and their father was a righteous person, so Allah pleased that both boys reach their youth then with the grace of your Lord they will dug out that treasure, and whatever I did was not out of my free will (but I did it with the command of Allah), this is the reality of those incidents on which you did not had patience.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمَّا الْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَـٰمَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِى الْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُ كَنزٌۭ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ اَبُوهُمَا صَـٰلِحًۭا فَاَرَادَ رَبُّكَ اَن يَبْلُغَآ اَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسْتَخْرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ وَ مَا فَعَلْتُهُ عَنْ اَمْرِى ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَاْوِيلُ مَا لَمْ تَسْطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) they ask you about Zulqarnain, you say in reply to them: I am telling you some of his tales.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِى الْقَرْنَيْنِ ۖ قُلْ سَاَتْلُواْ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْهُ ذِكْرًا

verses.english_text: (Allah says) We gave him power on the earth, and We gave him stuff of everything.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ سَبَبًۭا

verses.english_text: He utilized this stuff.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا

verses.english_text: So while walking he reached the place of sunset, it appeared to him that it was setting in a stream of black mud, and near that stream he also found a nation there, We said to him: O Zulqarnain. (you have a choice) whether to punish them or behave nicely with them.
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغْرُبُ فِى عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍۢ وَوَجَدَ عِندَهَا قَوْمًۭا ۗ قُلْنَا يَـٰذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ اِمَّآ اَن تُعَذِّبَ وَاِمَّآ اَن تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمْ حُسْنًۭا

verses.english_text: Zulqarnain said: Verily I will punish him who will do transgression, then at last they will all be returned before their Lord (on the Day of Judgement) and He will give them the worst punishment.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ اِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ فَيُعَذِّبُهُ عَذَابًۭا نُّكْرًا

verses.english_text: There is best reward for those who adopted faith and did good deeds, and shortly We will ask him to follow our commands which will be easier for him.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا فَلَهُ جَزَآءً الْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُ مِنْ اَمْرِنَا يُسْرًا

verses.english_text: And then he took another way.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا

verses.english_text: He walked (further) that he reached the place where the sun rises, so it appeared to him that it is rising upon them and We have not made any curtains in front of the sun.
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ لَّمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتْرًا

verses.english_text: And it was like this, and whatever was with Zulqarnain We were totally aware of it.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ وَ قَدْ اَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًا

verses.english_text: Then he took another way.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا

verses.english_text: Until he reached between the walls, he found people living on this side of the walls who could not understand any talk.
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا بَلَغَ بَيْنَ السَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًۭا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًۭا

verses.english_text: Those people said (somehow): O Zulqarnain, on that side of the trench lives Gog and Magog who create mischief in the land, if you permit us, we will provide some expenses for you so that you make some hurdle between us and them.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ يَـٰذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ اِنَّ يَاْجُوجَ وَمَاْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ اَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا

verses.english_text: Said (Zulqarnain), the power of provision of expenses which my Lord has given me is much better than your contribution; you only help me with (man) power, I will make a barrier between you and them.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَاَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ اَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا

verses.english_text: Now bring to me iron sheets. (and they brought and a big wall was made) so the wall was levelled between the two mountains; he said light the fire and flare it, so when it (iron wall) became red, he said now bring me copper, melt and pour over this wall.
verses.arabic_text: ءَاتُونِى زُبَرَ الْحَدِيدِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيْنَ الصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ انفُخُواْ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا جَعَلَهُ نَارًا قَالَ ءَاتُونِىٓ اُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًا

verses.english_text: So neither Gog and Magog can scale it, nor can they pierce it.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا اسْطَـٰعُوٓاْ اَن يَظْهَرُوهُ وَ مَا اسْتَطَـٰعُواْ لَهُ نَقْبًۭا

verses.english_text: Zulqarnain said (on seeing the wall): this blessing of my Lord and when the promise of my Lord (Day of Judgement) will come; He will make it level with the ground, and promise of my Lord is truth.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ هَـٰذَا رَحْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّى ۖ فَاِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى جَعَلَهُ دَكَّآءَ ۖ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى حَقًّۭا

verses.english_text: On that day We let them on their condition, and by clashing one over another they will become like waves of the river, and when the trumpet will blow then We will gather them all together.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَمُوجُ فِى بَعْضٍۢ ۖ وَنُفِخَ فِى الصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَـٰهُمْ جَمْعًۭا

verses.english_text: And on that day We will present Hell explicitly in front of the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَرْضًا

verses.english_text: Whose eyes were behind the veils and also they do not want to hear anything.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ كَانَتْ اَعْيُنُهُمْ فِى غِطَآءٍ عَن ذِكْرِى وَكَانُواْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا

verses.english_text: And those who did not believe, do they think We have left them to make My servants as their guardians? So listen We have prepared Hell to host the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَحَسِبَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ اَن يَتَّخِذُواْ عِبَادِى مِن دُونِىٓ اَوْلِيَآءَ ۚ اِنَّآ اَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ نُزُلًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) tell them: shall I tell you about those who are the losers as per their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِالْاَخْسَرِينَ اَعْمَـٰلًا

verses.english_text: Those are the people whose endeavours of the world have gone waste, and they are thinking that Verily they are doing good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِى الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ اَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا

verses.english_text: These are the people who denied the verses of their Lord and His meeting (of the Day of Judgement); so all their deeds have gone waste; and therefore we will not even set a balance for them on the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَآئِهِ فَحَبِطَتْ اَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَزْنًۭا

verses.english_text: (And straight away will throw them in Hell), this Hell is reward for their deeds that they adopted infidelity and mocked at My verses and My prophets.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُواْ وَاتَّخَذُوٓاْ اٰيٰتِى وَرُسُلِى هُزُوًا

verses.english_text: Indeed, who believed and did good works they will be hosted in the gardens of Paradise.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ الْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا

verses.english_text: They will abide in it forever and would never like to leave it.
verses.arabic_text: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet, tell these people), if for writing the words of my Lord the sea becomes ink, then before the words of my Lord finishes, the sea shall be over, even if you bring another sea to help it.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ الْبَحْرُ مِدَادًۭا لِّكَلِمَـٰتِ رَبِّى لَنَفِدَ الْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ اَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَـٰتُ رَبِّى وَ لَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِ مَدَدًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) say: I am also a human (in appearance) like you, only difference that my origin is different and revelation came to me that your Lord is only One; so whoever is desirous of appearing before his Lord should do good deeds, and do not make anybody partner in His worshipping.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّمَآ اَنَا۠ بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ اِلَىَّ اَنَّمَآ اِلَـٰهُكُمْ اِلَـٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُواْ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًۭا صَـٰلِحًۭا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِٓ اَحَدًۢا

verses.english_text: Kaaf Ya Ha Ain Saad.
verses.arabic_text: كٓهيعٓصٓ

verses.english_text: This is the tale of the Mercy of your Lord which He did on His servant Zakaria.
verses.arabic_text: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُ زَكَرِيَّآ

verses.english_text: When Zakaria called his Lord in low voice.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And said: O my Lord my bones have become weak, and my head is flared up, with old age, and O my Lord I was never deprived after praying to You.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّى وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّاْسُ شَيْبًۭا وَلَمْ اَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And I fear for my heirs that (they might destroy the religion) and my wife is a barren, so give to me an heir (child) from Your Court.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنِّى خِفْتُ الْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ امْرَاَتِى عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Who would inherit mine and Yaqoob's generation and O my Lord, with whom You are pleased.
verses.arabic_text: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَاجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: (Allah said) O Zakaria, We give you glad tidings of a son whose name shall be Yahya; and We have not created anybody before this with a similar name.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰزَكَرِيَّآ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ اسْمُهُ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Zakaria said: O my Lord, how will a son be born out of me? Condition is such that my wife is barren and I myself have reached an extreme old age.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ اَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَكَانَتِ امْرَاَتِى عَاقِرًا وَ قَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ الْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Allah said: it will happen, your Lord is saying that it is easy for Me, before this you were created when you were nothing.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ وَ قَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا

verses.english_text: Zakaria said: O my Lord! give some sign for me; the command arrived : your sign is that for three nights (and days) you will not be able to speak to the people.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةًۭ ۚ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ اَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلَـٰثَ لَيَالٍۢ سَوِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Then Zakaria came out from his place of worship to go to his people, and he said to them in sign language: glorify Him morning and evening (continuously).
verses.arabic_text: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ مِنَ الْمِحْرَابِ فَاَوْحَىٰٓ اِلَيْهِمْ اَن سَبِّحُواْ بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: (Yahya was born and he was commanded), O Yahya! Hold the book (Taurait) tightly and granted him prophethood when he was a child.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ الْكِتٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ الْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And granted him soft-heartedness and purity and he was himself pious.
verses.arabic_text: وَحَنَانًۭا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةًۭ ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: He was kind to his parents and was not disobedient and transgressor.
verses.arabic_text: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And salutations are on him (from Our side) when he was born and when he will die and when he will be raised again.
verses.arabic_text: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا

verses.english_text: (And O Prophet), Also described in the book about Maryam when she separated from her people and went to her Eastern place.
verses.arabic_text: وَاذْكُرْ فِى الْكِتٰبِ مَرْيَمَ اِذِ انتَبَذَتْ مِنْ اَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Then she drew a curtain before them, then We sent Our Spirit to her, and he went in front of her as a well-made human.
verses.arabic_text: فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًۭا فَاَرْسَلْنَآ اِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: She was frightened to see him and said: if you are pious then I seek refuge in Allah from you (get away from me).
verses.arabic_text: قَالَتْ اِنِّىٓ اَعُوذُ بِالرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِنكَ اِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Gabriel said: I am just a messenger of your Lord to give you a pure son.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنَّمَآ اَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِاَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَـٰمًۭا زَكِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: How can I bear a son when no human has ever touched me and neither I am evil-doer.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَتْ اَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌۭ وَلَمْ اَكُ بَغِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: It will happen, your Lord has said that this is easy for me (giving a son without a husband); so that We make him Our sign for the people, and (a source of) Our Mercy, and this has already been decided.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُٓ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ اَمْرًا مَّقْضِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Then she conceived on her own, and she withdrew herself from the people, and went to a remote house.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَانتَبَذَتْ بِهِ مَكَانًۭا قَصِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: (When the time for childbirth neared), labor-pain brought her to a dried palm tree, she said: I wish I would have died before this; and I would have been a forgotten thing.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَجَآءَهَا الْمَخَاضُ اِلَىٰ جِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَـٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًۭا مَّنسِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Then Gabriel called out from below, do not grieve, see that your Lord has made to flow for you a fountain beneath you.
verses.arabic_text: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ اَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And shake the branch of the palm tree towards you, so it will drop fresh and ripe dates.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُزِّىٓ اِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَـٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًۭا جَنِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Then eat, and drink water from the fountain and cool your eyes with your son, then if you see any man, say (with a hint): I have promised a fast in the name of Allah and I cannot not speak to anyone today.
verses.arabic_text: فَكُلِى وَاشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًۭا ۖ فَاِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الْبَشَرِ اَحَدًۭا فَقُولِىٓ اِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ صَوْمًۭا فَلَنْ اُكَلِّمَ الْيَوْمَ اِنسِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Then Maryam came to her nation carrying the boy in her lap. (upon seeing her) they said: O Maryam! You have done an evil thing.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَتَتْ بِهِ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُ ۖ قَالُواْ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًۭٔا فَرِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: O Sister of Haroon, neither your father was not a bad man nor your mother was an evil-doer (what is this you have done).
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰٓاُخْتَ هَـٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ اَبُوكِ امْرَاَ سَوْءٍۢ وَ مَا كَانَتْ اُمُّكِ بَغِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Then Maryam pointed towards the boy (ask him, whatever you want to ask), how can we speak to a child in the lap?
verses.arabic_text: فَاَشَارَتْ اِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُواْ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: (Upon this the child spoke with the command of Allah) Verily I am servant of Allah, and He has given me the book (Injeel) and made me a Prophet.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنِّى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ الْكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And He made me blessed wherever I may be, and till I am alive I have been emphasized to establish prayer, and give charity.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا اَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَاَوْصَـٰنِى بِالصَّلَوٰةِ وَالزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And made me obedient to my mother, and (thank Allah) He has not made me a transgressor and disobedient.
verses.arabic_text: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And salutation is on me (from Allah) on the day when I was born, the day when I will die and the day when I will be raised to life again.
verses.arabic_text: وَالسَّلَـٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ اَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ اُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا

verses.english_text: This is the true tale of the son of Maryam, Isa, in which these people doubt (unnecessarily).
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ الْحَقِّ الَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ

verses.english_text: It is not befitting for Allah to make anybody His son, He is pure and purest, and when He decides to do something, he just says: Be, and it becomes.
verses.arabic_text: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ اَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍۢ ۖ سُبْحَـٰنَهُٓ ۚ اِذَا قَضَىٰٓ اَمْرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ

verses.english_text: And there is not any doubt that Allah is my Lord and your Lord also, so all of you worship Him, this is the straight path (of Oneness).
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ اللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then different groups disputed among themselves, and woe unto them who adopted infidelity, and they will have to face a Great Day (Day of Judgement).
verses.arabic_text: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْاَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

verses.english_text: When they will come in My Presence then they shall well listen and see, but these unjust are in manifest misguidance today.
verses.arabic_text: اَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَاَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَاْتُونَنَا ۖ لَـٰكِنِ الظَّـٰلِمُونَ الْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: (And O Prophet), Warn them of the day of intense regret when definite judgement will be made, and now they are in the state of negligence and are not believing.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْحَسْرَةِ اِذْ قُضِىَ الْاَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: There is not any doubt that one day We will inherit earth and whatever is on it. (and everything will be decimated) and everyone will be returned to Us.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ الْاَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَاِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), mention Ibrahim in the Quran who was indeed a very truthful prophet.
verses.arabic_text: وَاذْكُرْ فِى الْكِتٰبِ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّا

verses.english_text: When he said to his (step) father: O father! why do you worship this which neither can hear nor can see, nor it can be of any use to you.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِيهِ يَـٰٓاَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًۭٔا

verses.english_text: O my father! Verily that knowledge has come to me which you do not have; so follow me, I will show you the right path.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰٓاَبَتِ اِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَاْتِكَ فَاتَّبِعْنِىٓ اَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًۭا سَوِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: O my father! Do not worship Satan, Satan is a disobedient servant of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰٓاَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ الشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ اِنَّ الشَّيْطَـٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَصِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: O my father! I fear that punishment of the Beneficent may befell on you and you become companion of Satan.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰٓاَبَتِ اِنِّىٓ اَخَافُ اَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌۭ مِّنَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَـٰنِ وَلِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: (Azar) Said: O Ibrahim, don't you believe in my gods? If you will not desist from these things, then remember I will stone you; and get away from me forever.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَرَاغِبٌ اَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَـٰٓاِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَاَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَاهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Ibrahim said: accept my salutation, still I will pray for your forgiveness from my Lord because He is very gracious to me.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَاَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ اِنَّهُ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And I am leaving you and those whom you make partner with Allah, and I shall worship my Lord only, I hope that I will not be deprived of worshipping.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَ مَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَاَدْعُواْ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ اَلَّآ اَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: When Ibrahim left those people who worshipped others leaving Allah, then We gave him Ishaq and Yaqoob (as sons), and made each of them prophet.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا اعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُٓ اِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And We bestowed upon them part of Our mercy; and appointed for them highest mention of truthfulness.
verses.arabic_text: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And mention Moosa in the Book that he was Our humble servant, was sent as a prophet.
verses.arabic_text: وَاذْكُرْ فِى الْكِتٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ مُخْلَصًۭا وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And We called him from the right side of Mount Tur (Sinai); and called him near to Us to converse with him.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ الطُّورِ الْاَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَـٰهُ نَجِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And with Our special Mercy gave him his brother Haroon, a prophet.
verses.arabic_text: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ اَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ نَبِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: (And O Prophet), mention Ismail in the Book, indeed he was truthful in his promise, and he was sent as a prophet.
verses.arabic_text: وَاذْكُرْ فِى الْكِتٰبِ اِسْمَـٰعِيلَ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And he used to urge his family for establishing up prayer and giving poor-rate, and he was a favourite in the Court of his Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَانَ يَاْمُرُ اَهْلَهُ بِالصَّلَوٰةِ وَالزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِ مَرْضِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), also mention Idris in the Book, indeed he was a truthful prophet.
verses.arabic_text: وَاذْكُرْ فِى الْكِتٰبِ اِدْرِيسَ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And We raised him, and reached him to a very lofty place (Paradise).
verses.arabic_text: وَرَفَعْنَـٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا

verses.english_text: These prophets upon whom Allah bestowed His Mercy are the children of Adam, and from the generation of those, to whom We had made to embark on the Ark of Nooh, and are the children of Ibrahim and Yaqoob; and are from the people to whom We have guided and chosen, when verses of (Allah) the Beneficent are recited in front of them, they fall down in prostration while crying.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ اَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ النَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۢ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَاِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَاجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ اِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتُ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ خَرُّواْ سُجَّدًۭا وَبُكِيًّۭا ۩

verses.english_text: {Prostrate Non-Obligatory} Thereafter, some wicked people became their heirs, who neglected prayer; and became the followers of their desires; shortly they will meet their misguidance (they will face punishment of their misguidance).
verses.arabic_text: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ اَضَاعُواْ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَاتَّبَعُواْ الشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا

verses.english_text: But whose repentance is accepted and they did the good deeds; these people shall enter the Paradise; no unjust will be done to them.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا

verses.english_text: And they shall abide in ever-green gardens for which Beneficent Allah has promised to His servants in the unseen, and Verily His promise is going to come to the fore.
verses.arabic_text: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِى وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ عِبَادَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَاْتِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: They will not listen to anything vulgar there but only salutations (of peace), their sustenance shall be ready morning and evening whenever they want.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا اِلَّا سَلَـٰمًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: This is that Paradise and from among Our servants who would be pious, We will make them inherit this.
verses.arabic_text: تِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet, said Gabriel), we do not descend without the command of your Lord, whatever is in our front and rear, and whatever is in between them. (i.e. everything) belongs to Him; and your Lord is not forgetful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا نَتَنَزَّلُ اِلَّا بِاَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِينَا وَ مَا خَلْفَنَا وَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَ مَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: He is Lord of skies and the earth and whatever is in between them, so you worship Him, and be steadfast in worshipping Him; do you know anybody with a similar name?
verses.arabic_text: رَّبُّ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَاعْبُدْهُ وَاصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَـٰدَتِهِ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُ سَمِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And some humans are amazed and say that when I die, soon I will be raised alive again from the grave?
verses.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُ الْاِنسَـٰنُ اَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ اُخْرَجُ حَيًّا

verses.english_text: So, does not he remember that when We created him before this when he was nothing?
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ الْاِنسَـٰنُ اَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) by your Lord, We will gather them together with Satans; then We will present them around Hell on their knees.
verses.arabic_text: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَالشَّيَـٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Then We will separate those persons from among every group, who were most disobedient to the Beneficent (Allah).
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ اَيُّهُمْ اَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحْمَـٰنِ عِتِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Then Verily We are aware who deserves more to be thrown in Hell.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِالَّذِينَ هُمْ اَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And there is no one among you who shall not pass over it (because the Bridge of Siraat is set upon that); this is an unavoidable promise of your Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن مِّنكُمْ اِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Then We will deliver the pious ones, and shall throw the disobedient ones in it on their knees.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى الَّذِينَ اتَّقَواْ وَّنَذَرُ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: And when our manifest verses are recited before them so those who adopt infidelity ask the believers: whose rank is better between us, and whose assembly is best.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اَىُّ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌۭ مَّقَامًۭا وَاَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّۭا

verses.english_text: Although, We have destroyed many parties before them, who were much better in equipment and showcasing.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ اَحْسَنُ اَثَـٰثًۭا وَرِءْيًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), say: if a person is in misguidance, then the Beneficent (Allah) gives him respite; until he will see with his own eyes the thing which is promised for him - either punishment or the Hour (Day of Judgement), then they will realize who is worst in the rank, and who is weaker in forces.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى الضَّلَـٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا رَاَوْاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ اِمَّا الْعَذَابَ وَاِمَّا السَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَاَضْعَفُ جُندًۭا

verses.english_text: And those who are on the right path, Allah increases their guidance, and good deeds which remain, are better than the way of reward, and are also better with regards to the consequences.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَزِيدُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْاْ هُدًۭى ۗ وَالْبَـٰقِيَـٰتُ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌۭ مَّرَدًّا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), did you notice the man who denied Our verses and said: I will Verily get wealth and children (even if the Day of Judgement is established).
verses.arabic_text: اَفَرَءَيْتَ الَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَاُوتَيَنَّ مَالًۭا وَوَلَدًا

verses.english_text: Has he come to know the unseen, or made any covenant with the Beneficent Allah?
verses.arabic_text: اَطَّلَعَ الْغَيْبَ اَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِندَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًۭا

verses.english_text: Never. We are writing what he says and increasing his punishment more.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ مَدًّۭا

verses.english_text: And whatever he is saying We will inherit all, and he shall come to Us alone.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَرِثُهُ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَاْتِينَا فَرْدًۭا

verses.english_text: And they have made others their god instead of Allah so that they become the cause of their honor.
verses.arabic_text: وَاتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لِّيَكُونُواْ لَهُمْ عِزًّۭا

verses.english_text: Never! (But) instead these gods will deny their worshipping and will become their opponent.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), did not you see the thing, that We have left Satan on the infidels so that he misguides them.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَا الشَّيَـٰطِينَ عَلَى الْكَـٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ اَزًّۭا

verses.english_text: Make no haste against them (for punishment); We are just counting the days for their punishment.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ اِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّۭا

verses.english_text: The day when Beneficent Allah will gather the pious people before Him like guests.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ الْمُتَّقِينَ اِلَى الرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَفْدًۭا

verses.english_text: And (We) will drive away the sinners towards Hell like thirsty (animals).
verses.arabic_text: وَنَسُوقُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ اِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًۭا

verses.english_text: On that day these people will not be able to intercede, except the person who have made covenant with the Beneficent Allah.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ الشَّفَـٰعَةَ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِندَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًۭا

verses.english_text: And these people (Jews) say that Beneficent (Allah) has made a son (to Uzair).
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), say: You have said such a strong thing (by your forging).
verses.arabic_text: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا اِدًّۭا

verses.english_text: It is near that skies may burst and earth may crack, and mountains may fall down in pieces.
verses.arabic_text: تَكَادُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ الْاَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ الْجِبَالُ هَدًّا

verses.english_text: Because of the thing that they have made a son to the Beneficent (Allah).
verses.arabic_text: اَن دَعَوْاْ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدًۭا

verses.english_text: Whereas, it is not in any way appropriate for the Beneficent (Allah) that He (take) somebody as son.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ اَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا

verses.english_text: Everything of the skies and the earth come before the Beneficent (Allah) as servant only.
verses.arabic_text: اِن كُلُّ مَن فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ اِلَّآ ءَاتِى الرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَبْدًۭا

verses.english_text: Verily, He has encompassed them all in His knowledge, and He has well counted them all.
verses.arabic_text: لَّقَدْ اَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّۭا

verses.english_text: And they all will present themselves before Him individually on the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَرْدًا

verses.english_text: Verily, those who believe and did good deeds, shortly the Beneficent (Allah) will make their love imperative on people.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وُدًّۭا

verses.english_text: Verily, We have made this Quran easy in your language, so that you give glad tidings (of Paradise) to the pious people, and warn the contentious people (of Arab from punishment of Allah).
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِ قَوْمًۭا لُّدًّۭا

verses.english_text: And before them how many parties We have destroyed; do you see any of them or hear even any whisper of them.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ اَحَدٍ اَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا

verses.english_text: O Ta’ha.
verses.arabic_text: طه

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), We have not revealed the Quran for your distress.
verses.arabic_text: مَآ اَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: But it is advice for those who are fearful.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا تَذْكِرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ

verses.english_text: This has been revealed from Him Who has created earth and high skies.
verses.arabic_text: تَنزِيلًۭا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ الْاَرْضَ وَالسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ الْعُلَى

verses.english_text: The Beneficent (Allah) is firmly on the Throne with all attention.
verses.arabic_text: الرَّحْمَـٰنُ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوَىٰ

verses.english_text: Whatever is on the skies, and whatever is on earth, and whatever is in between them, and whatever is beneath the earth, everything is His.
verses.arabic_text: لَهُ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَ مَا تَحْتَ الثَّرَىٰ

verses.english_text: If you call upon Him (loudly or slowly), He knows the secrets, and more hidden things.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن تَجْهَرْ بِالْقَوْلِ فَاِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ وَاَخْفَى

verses.english_text: Allah is that (Lord), and there is no god except Him; all beautiful names are His.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ الْاَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), did the news of Moosa reach you?
verses.arabic_text: وَهَلْ اَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: That when he saw the fire from afar, and said to his family (you wait here) I have seen the strange fire; let me go and bring a flame of it to you; or may find some way there.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ رَءَا نَارًا فَقَالَ لِاَهْلِهِ امْكُثُوٓاْ اِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ اَوْ اَجِدُ عَلَى النَّارِ هُدًۭى

verses.english_text: When he reached near the fire came the sound: O Moosa!
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ اَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: I am your Lord, take off your footwear, because right now you are in the chattel plain of Sacred Valley, Tuwa.
verses.arabic_text: اِنِّىٓ اَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَاخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ اِنَّكَ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًۭى

verses.english_text: And I have chosen you (to be Our messenger); listen to Our revelation attentively.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَا اخْتَرْتُكَ فَاسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Indeed, I am that Allah and there is no god except Me, worship Me and establish prayer to remember Me.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّنِىٓ اَنَا اللَّهُ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّآ اَنَا۠ فَاعْبُدْنِى وَاَقِمِ الصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ

verses.english_text: Verily, the Day of Judgement is going to come, and necessarily I will keep it hidden, that every person might be rewarded as he would strive.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ السَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ اَكَادُ اُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ

verses.english_text: So let it not be that a person who does not believe in it and follows his psychological desires, and he may deviate you from this, and you may be destroyed.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ

verses.english_text: What is in your right hand, O Moosa?
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ

verses.english_text: (Moosa) said: this is my staff, I recline on it, and with it I break leaves (of trees), for my sheep and I have other uses for it also.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ اَتَوَكَّؤُاْ عَلَيْهَا وَاَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ اُخْرَىٰ

verses.english_text: (Allah) Said: O Moosa, throw it on the ground.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَلْقِهَا يَـٰمُوسَىٰ

verses.english_text: Moosa threw it down and it turned into a serpent and started moving.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَلْقَىٰهَا فَاِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌۭ تَسْعَىٰ

verses.english_text: (Moosa got frightened, Allah) said: pick it up, do not fear, We will restore it to its earlier state.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا الْاُولَىٰ

verses.english_text: Press your hands under your arms, then you will see that without any illness your hand will come out white and shining, this is the second miracle.
verses.arabic_text: وَاضْمُمْ يَدَكَ اِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً اُخْرَىٰ

verses.english_text: So that We show you Our bigger signs.
verses.arabic_text: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ اٰيٰتِنَا الْكُبْرَى

verses.english_text: Now you go to Firaun, he has transgressed the limits.
verses.arabic_text: اذْهَبْ اِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّهُ طَغَىٰ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: O my Lord! broaden my chest for me.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى

verses.english_text: And make my task easy for me.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ اَمْرِى

verses.english_text: And untangle the knots of my tongue.
verses.arabic_text: وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةًۭ مِّن لِّسَانِى

verses.english_text: so that people may understand my words properly.
verses.arabic_text: يَفْقَهُواْ قَوْلِى

verses.english_text: and make a minister from among my family.
verses.arabic_text: وَاجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًا مِّنْ اَهْلِى

verses.english_text: Haroon, my brother.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰرُونَ اَخِى

verses.english_text: strengthen my back through him.
verses.arabic_text: اشْدُدْ بِهِٓ اَزْرِى

verses.english_text: And make him a partner in my task.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ اَمْرِى

verses.english_text: That we both would Glorify You too much.
verses.arabic_text: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا

verses.english_text: And that we may remember You in abundance.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا

verses.english_text: That You are seeing our condition.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: (Allah) said: O Moosa! All your requests are granted.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ قَدْ اُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ

verses.english_text: And We had already bestowed favour to you once.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً اُخْرَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: And We inspired your mother which is being told to you through revelation.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ اَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَىٰٓ اُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Saying: put him (Moosa) into a chest and then cast it in the river, then river will push it ashore, there Moosa's enemy and my enemy (Firaun) will pick him up, and We had put a shadow of Our love on you. (whoever will see will love you); so that under Our guardianship you might be brought up.
verses.arabic_text: اَنِ اقْذِفِيهِ فِى التَّابُوتِ فَاقْذِفِيهِ فِى الْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ الْيَمُّ بِالسَّاحِلِ يَاْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُ ۚ وَاَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةًۭ مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ

verses.english_text: Then your sister went there and said: if you want I can introduce to you a midwife who will take good care of this child; in this way we returned you to your mother that her eyes remain cool; that she does not grieve on your separation (then) you killed a person (and you were very depressed), then We delivered you from depression, and We tried you severely, then you lived for some years among the people of Madyan; then you reached an age (and became capable for prophethood), O Moosa.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ تَمْشِىٓ اُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ اَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَـٰكَ اِلَىٰٓ اُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا فَنَجَّيْنَـٰكَ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّـٰكَ فُتُونًۭا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ اَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ

verses.english_text: And I have chosen you for Our prophethood.
verses.arabic_text: وَاصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى

verses.english_text: Go, you and your brother with My miracles; and be not lazy in remembering Me.
verses.arabic_text: اذْهَبْ اَنتَ وَاَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى

verses.english_text: Both of you go to Firaun he has become severe transgressor.
verses.arabic_text: اذْهَبَآ اِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّهُ طَغَىٰ

verses.english_text: Go and talk to him softly, so he may take guidance or be fearful.
verses.arabic_text: فَقُولَا لَهُ قَوْلًۭا لَّيِّنًۭا لَّعَلَّهُ يَتَذَكَّرُ اَوْ يَخْشَىٰ

verses.english_text: (They) both said: O our Lord, we fear that he may exceed his limits upon us and he may become more transgressing.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ اِنَّنَا نَخَافُ اَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ اَوْ اَن يَطْغَىٰ

verses.english_text: (Allah) Said: fear not, I am with you, and I hear and see everything.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ اِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ اَسْمَعُ وَاَرَىٰ

verses.english_text: You both go to him and say: we are the messengers of your Lord, send Bani Israel with us and do not persecute them and we have come with the miracle of your Lord; and whoever will follow the right path, peace is for him.
verses.arabic_text: فَاْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ اِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَاَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَالسَّلَـٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الْهُدَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: It has been revealed on us from Lord that Verily (Allah's) punishment is for him, who deny His communication and turn his face away (from His commands).
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا قَدْ اُوحِىَ اِلَيْنَآ اَنَّ الْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

verses.english_text: Firaun asked: after all who is your Lord, O Moosa?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَـٰمُوسَىٰ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: our Lord is He who gave everything its proper form and then guided them (to their goals).
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِىٓ اَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ

verses.english_text: Firaun asked: tell us about the condition of earlier generations.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ الْقُرُونِ الْاُولَىٰ

verses.english_text: Said Moosa: knowledge of all these things is with my Lord written in a Book (i.e. Laoh-e-Mahfooz), He neither forgets nor errs.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتٰبٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى

verses.english_text: That is He, Who spread the earth and made ways in it for you, and He rained water from the sky, then (says Allah): from that water made different vegetations.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا وَاَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَاَخْرَجْنَا بِهِٓ اَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّن نَّبَاتٍۢ شَتَّىٰ

verses.english_text: That you also eat and let your cattle also graze, indeed there are many signs in it for those who understand.
verses.arabic_text: كُلُواْ وَارْعَوْاْ اَنْعَـٰمَكُمْ ۗ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّاُو۟لِى النُّهَىٰ

verses.english_text: We created you from it (dust) and will return you to it (dust), and (on the Day of Judgement) We will raise you once again from it (dust).
verses.arabic_text: ۞ مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً اُخْرَىٰ

verses.english_text: And verily We showed all Our signs to Firaun, but still he denied and did not believe.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرَيْنَـٰهُ اٰيٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَاَبَىٰ

verses.english_text: Said Firaun: O Moosa you have come to us; so that you may drive us away (from Egypt), on the strength of your magic?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ اَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ

verses.english_text: So we are also presenting the same magic to you, then make an appointment between us and you; that neither we break it, nor you; and meeting place should be an open ground.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَنَاْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍۢ مِّثْلِهِ فَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُ نَحْنُ وَلَآ اَنتَ مَكَانًۭا سُوًۭى

verses.english_text: (Moosa) said: your appointment (for confronting) is the day of elegance (Festivity) and let all the people be gathered together before noon.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ الزِّينَةِ وَاَن يُحْشَرَ النَّاسُ ضُحًۭى

verses.english_text: Then Firaun returned to his place and started concerting his plans, then he came back (for confronting).
verses.arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُ ثُمَّ اَتَىٰ

verses.english_text: Moosa said (to Firaun): you perish, do not falsely blame on Allah, otherwise you will be decimated by the punishment; and indeed (remember) he who slanders (on Allah) never attains (his desire).
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُواْ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍۢ ۖ وَ قَدْ خَابَ مَنِ افْتَرَىٰ

verses.english_text: On this they quarreled and started whispering.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَنَـٰزَعُوٓاْ اَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَاَسَرُّواْ النَّجْوَىٰ

verses.english_text: And they said: indeed, they both are magicians, and they want to expel you from your land through their magic, and want to destroy your well-established religion.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ اِنْ هَـٰذَٰنِ لَسَـٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ اَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ اَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ الْمُثْلَىٰ

verses.english_text: So collect all your planning and come in battle-line, whoever will overpower (the other) today, he shall be successful.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَجْمِعُواْ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ائْتُواْ صَفًّۭا ۚ وَ قَدْ اَفْلَحَ الْيَوْمَ مَنِ اسْتَعْلَىٰ

verses.english_text: (At last magicians said) O Moosa, will you throw; or shall we be the first (in throwing magic)?
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ اِمَّآ اَن تُلْقِىَ وَاِمَّآ اَن نَّكُونَ اَوَّلَ مَنْ اَلْقَىٰ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: you throw first (when they threw), with effect of their magic it appeared to Moosa that their sticks are moving.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ بَلْ اَلْقُواْ ۖ فَاِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ اِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ اَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ

verses.english_text: Moosa felt some fear in his heart.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِ خِيفَةًۭ مُّوسَىٰ

verses.english_text: (Allah said to Moosa), fear not, indeed you will have the upper hand.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ اِنَّكَ اَنتَ الْاَعْلَىٰ

verses.english_text: And throw down whatever (staff) is in your right hand, it will swallow their tricks, because the tricks they have shown are the tricks of magician, and magician cannot be successful wherever he will go.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓاْ ۖ اِنَّمَا صَنَعُواْ كَيْدُ سَـٰحِرٍۢ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ اَتَىٰ

verses.english_text: (So staff of Moosa swallowed everything), all the magicians fell in prostration and said: we (now) believe in the Lord of Haroon and Moosa.
verses.arabic_text: فَاُلْقِىَ السَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ

verses.english_text: Firaun said to them: you believed before I gave permission to you? Verily he is your chief who has taught the magic to you; indeed, I will cut you hand and leg from opposite sides and will Verily crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, then you will come to see that who is more severe and more lasting between us in punishment.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ اَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ اِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ الَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ ۖ فَلَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيْدِيَكُمْ وَاَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍۢ وَلَاُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ النَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ اَيُّنَآ اَشَدُّ عَذَابًۭا وَاَبْقَىٰ

verses.english_text: Magicians said: we cannot prefer you over the explicit and bright miracles which have come to us, and over Him, Who created us; you may do whatever you wish because you can only govern the (little) life of this world.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ الْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَالَّذِى فَطَرَنَا ۖ فَاقْضِ مَآ اَنتَ قَاضٍ ۖ اِنَّمَا تَقْضِى هَـٰذِهِ الْحَيَوٰةَ الدُّنْيَآ

verses.english_text: And we believe on our Lord that He may forgive all our sins and (especially) sins of our magic on which you compelled us, and Allah is The Best and He is Everlasting.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَا وَ مَآ اَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ السِّحْرِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌۭ وَاَبْقَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Indeed whoever comes before his Lord as a sinner, Verily there is Hell for him, in which neither he shall die nor he shall live.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ مَن يَاْتِ رَبَّهُ مُجْرِمًۭا فَاِنَّ لَهُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ

verses.english_text: And whoever will come to him as a believer, and has done good deeds, these are the people who shall have high ranks.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن يَاْتِهِ مُؤْمِنًۭا قَدْ عَمِلَ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ الدَّرَجَـٰتُ الْعُلَىٰ

verses.english_text: They will forever abide in evergreen-gardens beneath which the rivers will be flowing; and this is the reward for those who kept themselves purified (from the sins).
verses.arabic_text: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ

verses.english_text: And We revealed to Moosa that: take My servants out of (Egypt) during night time, touch the river with staff and make a dry path in it for them; and you will not have any fear of chase or drowning.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ اَنْ اَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى الْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ

verses.english_text: Firaun chased them with his army, then water of the river completely overwhelmed and covered them.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ الْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ

verses.english_text: And Firaun led his people astray and destroyed them and did not guide them.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُ وَ مَا هَدَىٰ

verses.english_text: O Bani Israel! We delivered from the claws of your enemy, and made an appointment with you for the right side of Mount Tur (Sinai), and sent upon you Mann-va-Salwa.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰبَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدْ اَنجَيْنَـٰكُم مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَٰعَدْنَـٰكُمْ جَانِبَ الطُّورِ الْاَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَنَّ وَالسَّلْوَىٰ

verses.english_text: Eat (and drink) out of pure sustenance We have given to you; and don't create any mischief in it, otherwise Our wrath will befall upon you, and remember, on whoever my wrath befell he is indeed misguided (i.e. perished).
verses.arabic_text: كُلُواْ مِن طَيِّبَـٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْاْ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِى ۖ وَمَن يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِى فَقَدْ هَوَىٰ

verses.english_text: And whoever will repent and believe and will do good deeds and be steadfast, then We will Verily forgive him.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌۭ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا ثُمَّ اهْتَدَىٰ

verses.english_text: (And when Moosa went ahead with seventy people, We said): what made you hurry from your people! O Moosa?
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَ مَآ اَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ

verses.english_text: (Moosa) said: they were walking close to me; and O my Lord! I hastened (towards you), so that You be pleased with me.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ هُمْ اُو۟لَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ اَثَرِى وَعَجِلْتُ اِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ

verses.english_text: And We tested your people in your absence, and Samri led them astray.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَاِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَاَضَلَّهُمُ السَّامِرِىُّ

verses.english_text: Then Moosa returned regretfully and wrathfully towards his people and said: O my people! did not your Lord make a good promise to you (to give Taurait); did the time seem lengthy to you; and you wanted the wrath of your Lord befall on you; and you did exactly opposite of your promise.
verses.arabic_text: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ اِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ غَضْبَـٰنَ اَسِفًۭا ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ اَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا ۚ اَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْعَهْدُ اَمْ اَرَدتُّمْ اَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَاَخْلَفْتُم مَّوْعِدِى

verses.english_text: And they said we have not broken our promise on our own, but instead we were laden with the jewelry of the people (when we had fled from Firaun), on his advice (Samri) we threw them in fire; then Samri also threw (in fire) likewise;
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ مَآ اَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلَـٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَآ اَوْزَارًا مِّن زِينَةِ الْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَـٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ اَلْقَى السَّامِرِىُّ

verses.english_text: Then he (Samri) made an idol of calf (from this jewelry), its sound was also like a calf, on this some people said this is your lord and Lord of Moosa, but he forgot.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًۭا جَسَدًۭا لَّهُ خُوَارٌۭ فَقَالُواْ هَـٰذَآ اِلَـٰهُكُمْ وَاِلَـٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِىَ

verses.english_text: They did not think this much that the calf cannot reply to their talk and neither it is capable of any harm nor any benefit to them.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ اَلَّا يَرْجِعُ اِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًۭا وَلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا نَفْعًۭا

verses.english_text: Haroon has said earlier to them that O my people, you are being tested by this; and indeed your Lord is the Beneficent Allah, so you follow me and obey my order.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هَـٰرُونُ مِن قَبْلُ يَـٰقَوْمِ اِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِ ۖ وَاِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَاتَّبِعُونِى وَاَطِيعُوٓاْ اَمْرِى

verses.english_text: They said: unless Moosa returns to us, we will not stop worshipping this.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ لَن نَّبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَـٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ اِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ

verses.english_text: Moosa said (to Haroon): what prevented you from following me (i.e. killing them) when you saw that they were misguided?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يَـٰهَـٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اِذْ رَاَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوٓاْ

verses.english_text: Did you disobey my orders?
verses.arabic_text: اَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ ۖ اَفَعَصَيْتَ اَمْرِى

verses.english_text: Haroon said: O son of my mother! do not catch my beard nor my head, I feared only one thing that you might not say on your return that I caused division among Bani Israel and didn't respect your words.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يَبْنَؤُمَّ لَا تَاْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِى وَلَا بِرَاْسِىٓ ۖ اِنِّى خَشِيتُ اَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِى

verses.english_text: Then he asked Samri: what is your condition?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَـٰسَـٰمِرِىُّ

verses.english_text: He replied: I saw the thing which others could not see. (when Gabriel was going on his horse) I picked a handful of dust from beneath the feet of Gabriel (his horse) (and threw it in the mouth of the idol, and he started talking), then my soul commanded me this.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُواْ بِهِ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةًۭ مِّنْ اَثَرِ الرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِى نَفْسِى

verses.english_text: Moosa said: get away! your punishment in this world is that you would say: 'do not touch me' (or else I will get fever); and Verily (in the Hereafter also) there is promise for punishment for you, which you cannot oppose, and look at your lord on whose worship you persist, indeed we will bring it to ashes by burning, then we will scatter it in rivers.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَاذْهَبْ فَاِنَّ لَكَ فِى الْحَيَوٰةِ اَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَاِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُ ۖ وَانظُرْ اِلَىٰٓ اِلَـٰهِكَ الَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُ فِى الْيَمِّ نَسْفًا

verses.english_text: Your god is only Allah, there is no truthful god except He, His knowledge is encompassing over everything.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَآ اِلَـٰهُكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِى لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet!) And like this We relate the tales which have gone by; and from Our Court We bestowed upon you the Quran.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ اَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ ۚ وَ قَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًا

verses.english_text: Whoever will turn his face away from it, he shall certainly bear the burden of his own bad deeds on the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: مَّنْ اَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَاِنَّهُ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ وِزْرًا

verses.english_text: They will forever remain in this condition, and what a bad burden it is which they will be carrying on the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهِ ۖ وَسَآءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ حِمْلًۭا

verses.english_text: The day when the trumpet shall be blown, We will gather the guilty together with their eyes turned blue (in blind condition); and present them before Us.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى الصُّورِ ۚ وَنَحْشُرُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ زُرْقًۭا

verses.english_text: They will talk softly among themselves that we stayed a maximum period of ten days (in the world or the grave).
verses.arabic_text: يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ اِن لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا عَشْرًا

verses.english_text: Whatever they will say that day, We know well; and clever among them will say you stayed there (maximum) just for a day.
verses.arabic_text: نَّحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ اِذْ يَقُولُ اَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً اِن لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا يَوْمًۭا

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), People ask you that what will happen to the mountains (on the Day of Judgement), so you tell them: Allah will make them small particles and scatter them.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ الْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّى نَسْفًۭا

verses.english_text: And He will make the earth a barren land.
verses.arabic_text: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًۭا صَفْصَفًۭا

verses.english_text: And (O man), you shall not see any crookedness or any twist in it.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًۭا وَلَآ اَمْتًۭا

verses.english_text: That day everyone will run towards the sound of the Caller (Israfil) in a straight queue - and there will not be any crookedness in it, that day all the sounds will be silenced before Him, the Beneficent; and there won't be any sound except whispering (commotion).
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَّبِعُونَ الدَّاعِىَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُ ۖ وَخَشَعَتِ الْاَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ اِلَّا هَمْسًۭا

verses.english_text: On that day nobody's intercession will be of any use; except for those to whom Allah has allowed and whose words Allah is pleased with.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا تَنفَعُ الشَّفَـٰعَةُ اِلَّا مَنْ اَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُ قَوْلًۭا

verses.english_text: He knows whatever is before them and whatever is behind them, He knows everything, and they cannot dominate Him with their knowledge.
verses.arabic_text: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيهِمْ وَ مَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِ عِلْمًۭا

verses.english_text: The faces of all will be humbled before Ever-Living, Everlasting Lord; and he who bears the burden of oppression will be unsuccessful.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَعَنَتِ الْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ الْقَيُّومِ ۖ وَ قَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًۭا

verses.english_text: And whoever did good deeds and was also a believer; he shall not have fear for any unjust or any loss.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًۭا وَلَا هَضْمًۭا

verses.english_text: And We sent Quran in Arabic language and described in it the different types of punishments so that these people become pious, or it creates a reminder in their minds.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ اَنزَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ اَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًا

verses.english_text: Allah is truthful and most-High, the real Master (of the two worlds). (O Prophet!) do not haste in reciting the Quran before the revelation is completed on you; and pray: O my Lord! increase my knowledge.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَعَـٰلَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ ۗ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِالْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ اَن يُقْضَىٰٓ اِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُ ۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًۭا

verses.english_text: And We have taken covenant from Adam before (that not to go near that tree), but Adam forgot it, and We did not find in him stability and independence.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ عَهِدْنَآ اِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبْلُ فَنَسِىَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُ عَزْمًۭا

verses.english_text: And when We said to the angels to prostrate before Adam, then everyone prostrated but Iblis refused.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ اسْجُدُواْ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ اِلَّآ اِبْلِيسَ اَبَىٰ

verses.english_text: Then We told Adam: O Adam! indeed he is your enemy and enemy of your wife see that he may not become the cause for you to leave Paradise, and you fall in affliction (of the world).
verses.arabic_text: فَقُلْنَا يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ اِنَّ هَـٰذَا عَدُوٌّۭ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Indeed, there is ease for you here (in Paradise) that you will neither remain hungry nor will be unclothed.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ لَكَ اَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ

verses.english_text: And neither you shall be thirsty here nor will you feel the heat of the sun.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَؤُاْ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَىٰ

verses.english_text: So Satan whispered in his heart and said: O Adam! shall I guide you to the tree of everlasting life and to the kingdom which will never decline.
verses.arabic_text: فَوَسْوَسَ اِلَيْهِ الشَّيْطَـٰنُ قَالَ يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلْ اَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ الْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍۢ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ

verses.english_text: So, they both ate from the tree, then their private parts became manifest, and they began to hide them with garden leaves, and Adam disobeyed his Lord so he went away from the way of comfort.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ ۚ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُ فَغَوَىٰ

verses.english_text: Then his Lord chose him and accepted his repentance and guided him.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَىٰ

verses.english_text: Allah said: both of you have to descend from Paradise, all of you are enemy to another, when My guidance reaches you, then you follow it; whoever will follow My guidance can never go astray and nor fall in trouble.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۢا ۖ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّۭ ۖ فَاِمَّا يَاْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًۭى فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَىٰ

verses.english_text: And whoever turns away his face from My remembrance, his life will be spent in severe straitness, and We will raise him on the Day of Judgement, blind.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَنْ اَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِى فَاِنَّ لَهُ مَعِيشَةًۭ ضَنكًۭا وَنَحْشُرُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ اَعْمَىٰ

verses.english_text: He will say: O my Lord! I had eyes in the world, why have you raised me as blind?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِىٓ اَعْمَىٰ وَ قَدْ كُنتُ بَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: Allah will say: it should be like this, you forgot when Our verses had come to you; likewise, you will be forgotten today.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ اَتَتْكَ اٰيٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَا ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمَ تُنسَىٰ

verses.english_text: And whoever transgressed and did not believe in his Lord's verses, then We will recompense him similarly, and punishment of the Hereafter is very severe and long lasting.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَنْ اَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ۚ وَلَعَذَابُ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ اَشَدُّ وَاَبْقَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Did not that Lord tell inhabitants of Makkah that in whose dwellings these people go about, how many people He has destroyed before them; indeed, there are many signs in it for those who understand.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ الْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَـٰكِنِهِمْ ۗ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّاُو۟لِى النُّهَىٰ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet), if Allah had not appointed the time earlier (for their punishment), immediate punishment was imperative because of their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌۭ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًۭا وَاَجَلٌۭ مُّسَمًّۭى

verses.english_text: (O Prophet), be patient on whatever they say to you, and praise with glorification to your Lord, before rising of the sun and before it is set; and glorify Him in the parts of the night and during the parts of the day so that you become well pleased.
verses.arabic_text: فَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ۖ وَمِنْ ءَانَآئِ الَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَاَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet!) we have provided some with the splendor of this world, so that We test them, you do not stretch your eyes towards them, because sustenance given by your Lord is much better and lasting than this.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ اِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِٓ اَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ وَاَبْقَىٰ

verses.english_text: And enjoin to establish prayer to your household, and you also adhere to it, We do not ask for sustenance from you, but We bestow sustenance on you, and the consequence of piousness is good.
verses.arabic_text: وَاْمُرْ اَهْلَكَ بِالصَّلَوٰةِ وَاصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا ۖ لَا نَسْـَٔلُكَ رِزْقًۭا ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ ۗ وَالْعَـٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ

verses.english_text: And they (inhabitants of Makkah) say why don't you bring a miracle (of our choice) to us, so the prophecies which are in the earlier books (Taurait and Injeel) did not reach them?
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ لَوْلَا يَاْتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِٓ ۚ اَوَلَمْ تَاْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِى الصُّحُفِ الْاُولَىٰ

verses.english_text: And if We would have destroyed them with punishment before (sending) this Prophet, then they would have said: O our Lord! why didn't You send (your) Prophet to us, we would have followed your verses before our disgrace and shame.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ اَنَّآ اَهْلَكْنَـٰهُم بِعَذَابٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِهِ لَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ اَرْسَلْتَ اِلَيْنَا رَسُولًۭا فَنَتَّبِعَ اٰيٰتِكَ مِن قَبْلِ اَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet!) say: everyone is awaiting his consequences; so you also wait, then you will come to know soon that which are the people of straight path (and who is on crookedness), who is guided one (and who is misguided).
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ كُلٌّۭ مُّتَرَبِّصٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُواْ ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ اَصْحَـٰبُ الصِّرَٰطِ السَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ

verses.english_text: The reckoning of people came to them (at a time) and they are turning away their face in heedlessness state.
verses.arabic_text: اقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مُّعْرِضُونَ

verses.english_text: When any new commandment comes from their Lord, they just listen with an ear and then make mockery of it.
verses.arabic_text: مَا يَاْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ اِلَّا اسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ

verses.english_text: Their hearts are totally unaware (from the Day of the Judgement), and these unjust secretly whisper that this man (Mohammad [SAW]) is nothing but a mortal like you, then will you entangle in manifest magic knowingly.
verses.arabic_text: لَاهِيَةًۭ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَاَسَرُّواْ النَّجْوَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ هَلْ هَـٰذَآ اِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ اَفَتَاْتُونَ السِّحْرَ وَاَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: On this Prophet said: My Lord knows whatever is spoken in the sky and on earth (then what whispering you do); and he is all Hearing and Knowing.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ الْقَوْلَ فِى السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: They did not stop here but said: this is (Quran) a compilation of anxious dreams, looks like he has forged it on his own; rather he is a poet. (if he is really a prophet) then let him bring the miracles (of our choice) like earlier prophets were sent.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ قَالُوٓاْ اَضْغَـٰثُ اَحْلَـٰمٍۭ بَلِ افْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌۭ فَلْيَاْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ كَمَآ اُرْسِلَ الْاَوَّلُونَ

verses.english_text: We destroyed the earlier people. (but they did not believe) even after seeing the miracles, then what will these people believe?
verses.arabic_text: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ اَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ ۖ اَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And we sent earlier than you males as prophets on whom We used to send revelations, so if you do not know then ask the knowledgeable.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ اِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓاْ اَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ اِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And We did not make their body like that they do not eat, and neither did they remain in this world forever.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ جَسَدًۭا لَّا يَاْكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ وَ مَا كَانُواْ خَـٰلِدِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We showed them our promise (of punishment) come true; and when punishment came then We delivered the prophets and to whoever We pleased, and destroyed the transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَـٰهُمُ الْوَعْدَ فَاَنجَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَاَهْلَكْنَا الْمُسْرِفِينَ

verses.english_text: And We revealed that book (Quran) to you in which your good mention is also there; so don't you understand this much?
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ اَنزَلْنَآ اِلَيْكُمْ كِتٰبًۭا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: We destroyed many settlements whose dwellers were transgressors and created other people in their place.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍۢ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةًۭ وَاَنشَاْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

verses.english_text: And when they felt our punishment coming, they started running suddenly.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ اَحَسُّواْ بَاْسَنَآ اِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ

verses.english_text: (We said) do not run (now), go back to your homes where you lived an easy life, so that something is enquired with you.
verses.arabic_text: لَا تَرْكُضُواْ وَارْجِعُوٓاْ اِلَىٰ مَآ اُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَـٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: Oh!, our misfortune, verily we were transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: They continue to say this, until We pushed them, and made them like the field which has been harvested (and burnt), as heap of silent ash, which is drenched.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَـٰمِدِينَ

verses.english_text: Whatever is in the skies and on earth and in between them, We have not created useless.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَآءَ وَالْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ

verses.english_text: If We wanted to create any play then indeed, We would have done it with our proposition, if We pleased (but it was not suitable for our Stature).
verses.arabic_text: لَوْ اَرَدْنَآ اَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًۭا لَّاتَّخَذْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ اِن كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
