verses.english_text: And We hurl the Truth over the falsehood, which crushes the head of the falsehood, and it perishes there itself; woe unto you, what unjust things you describe.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّ عَلَى الْبَـٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُ فَاِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌۭ ۚ وَلَكُمُ الْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ

verses.english_text: Whereas. (Angels) who are in the skies and on earth are all His servants; (the angels) who are in His (very) Presence they neither feel proud about their prayers, nor do they ever get weary.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَهُ مَن فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Day and night glorify Him and never show laziness.
verses.arabic_text: يُسَبِّحُونَ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who have made gods on the earth, will they bring them to life?
verses.arabic_text: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَالِهَةًۭ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Even if there were gods besides Allah in the skies and on the earth, then both would have been perished long back, so Glory be to Him, He is much above than what they attribute to Him.
verses.arabic_text: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ اِلَّا اللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَـٰنَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

verses.english_text: He cannot be questioned about whatever he does, but people will be questioned.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ

verses.english_text: Or have they made other gods leaving Allah? O Prophet say: bring your argument, who are with me, their book (Quran) and who were before me, their books (Taurait and Injeel) are present, but most of them do not know the truth and they turn their face.
verses.arabic_text: اَمِ اتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ ۖ قُلْ هَاتُواْ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَـٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ الْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ

verses.english_text: And before you, whichever prophet We sent, We continuously sent revelation that nobody is worthy of worship except Me, so worship Me (only).
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ اِلَّا نُوحِىٓ اِلَيْهِ اَنَّهُ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّآ اَنَا۠ فَاعْبُدُونِ

verses.english_text: And dwellers of Makkah say: Beneficent Allah has taken angels as His children, whereas He is much Higher than this, and angels are His noble servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًۭا ۗ سُبْحَـٰنَهُ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌۭ مُّكْرَمُونَ

verses.english_text: They do not speak over His talk, and they act only on His command.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِاَمْرِهِ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Whatever is in front of them and whatever is behind them, Allah knows everything, and they do not do intercession except for those with whom Allah is pleased, and they themselves tremble with His fear.
verses.arabic_text: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيهِمْ وَ مَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ اِلَّا لِمَنِ ارْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِ مُشْفِقُونَ

verses.english_text: If somebody say that Allah does not exist, but I am the lord, then he is rejected one (from Allah) and We will give him punishment of Hell, and We give such punishment to the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ اِنِّىٓ اِلَـٰهٌۭ مِّن دُونِهِ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And whoever have become infidels, don't they ponder that skies and the earth were closed, then We opened them up, and it is We Who created every living thing from water, so will they not then believe yet?
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَرَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ اَنَّ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًۭا فَفَتَقْنَـٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ اَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And only We created heavily loaded mountains so that the earth does not tilt on any side with them, and We created long and wide ways so that they may travel to their destinations.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى الْاَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ اَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًۭا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

verses.english_text: And We made the sky their roof which is secure from all sides, and these people are turning their face away on the sky signs.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا السَّمَآءَ سَقْفًۭا مَّحْفُوظًۭا ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ اٰيٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ

verses.english_text: And That's That (predominantly powerful) who has created the night and the day, sun and the moon, they are all circumambulating in the celestial sphere.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِى خَلَقَ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! (Even) before you We did not give everlasting life to any mortal, so when you die, will they live forever?
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ الْخُلْدَ ۖ اَفَاِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ الْخَـٰلِدُونَ

verses.english_text: Every soul shall taste death (one day), and We test you with difficulty and ease, and (eventually) you have to return to Us only.
verses.arabic_text: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ذَآئِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِالشَّرِّ وَالْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةًۭ ۖ وَاِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet!) When infidels see you, they make fun of you and say: is it the person who remembers (badly) to your gods, whereas they themselves deny the remembrance of the Beneficent Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا رَءَاكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ اِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ اِلَّا هُزُوًا اَهَـٰذَا الَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Man is created of haste, soon We will show you signs of Our Power, then you will not do the haste.
verses.arabic_text: خُلِقَ الْاِنسَـٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍۢ ۚ سَاُو۟رِيكُمْ اٰيٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

verses.english_text: And they say: when the promise of the Day of the Judgement will be fulfilled, if you are truthful?
verses.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: And who have become infidels, wish they were aware of the condition of time when they will stand in the Hellfire and they will not be able to ward off fire from their faces and their backs, and they shall not be helped.
verses.arabic_text: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ النَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

verses.english_text: The Day of Judgement will not come with information but it will come suddenly and will make them astonished, then they cannot stop it nor they will be given any respite.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ تَاْتِيهِم بَغْتَةًۭ فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet!) Not only you, but before you they have mocked the prophets; then those who mocked them were afflicted with the punishment of what they used to make fun of.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِالَّذِينَ سَخِرُواْ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! ask them who can keep you safe from punishment (of Allah) during the night, or during the day? Yet these people continue to turn their face away from remembrance of the Beneficent Allah.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِالَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مِنَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ

verses.english_text: Do they have other gods who can defend them against Us, these people cannot defend themselves nor they will be given any respite from Our punishment.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌۭ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا ۚ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ اَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ

verses.english_text: Whereas We have given their elders ease and comfort until they reached the advance age, then do not they see that We have dominated the earth from (all) four sides, and continue victory over it, so still do they think they are winning and prevailing?
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعُمُرُ ۗ اَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ اَنَّا نَاْتِى الْاَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ اَطْرَافِهَآ ۚ اَفَهُمُ الْغَـٰلِبُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Say: I warn you as per revelation. (and as if you are deaf, because) when deaf are warned, they do not listen to the calling.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّمَآ اُنذِرُكُم بِالْوَحْىِ ۚ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ الصُّمُّ الدُّعَآءَ اِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet!) say: even if a little air of punishment of your Lord touches them, then suddenly they will say, woe to us, indeed we were unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌۭ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And on the Day of Judgement (to measure the good and the bad deeds of Our servants) we will establish Scale of the Justice, then no unjust will be done to anybody; and if anybody would have done anything (whether good or bad) even as a weight of mustard seed, we shall bring it forth, and We are sufficient to take account.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَضَعُ الْمَوَٰزِينَ الْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَاِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍۢ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ اَتَيْنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَـٰسِبِينَ

verses.english_text: And Verily, We gave Moosa and Haroon the book (Taurait) so that they can differentiate (between truth and falsehood); and We bestowed upon pious people, advice and total light.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ الْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءًۭ وَذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

verses.english_text: Who fear their Lord without seeing Him, and these people fear the Day of Judgement also.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ السَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ

verses.english_text: This (Quran) is a greatly blissful word, which We have revealed, so do you not believe in it?
verses.arabic_text: وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ مُّبَارَكٌ اَنزَلْنَـٰهُ ۚ اَفَاَنتُمْ لَهُ مُنكِرُونَ

verses.english_text: There is no doubt that We had given patience and understanding to Ibrahim earlier, and We were fully aware of his condition.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَ لَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِ عَـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: When he said to his people and his father that the idols which you worship, what is this (rubbish)?
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا هَـٰذِهِ التَّمَاثِيلُ الَّتِىٓ اَنتُمْ لَهَا عَـٰكِفُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: we (do not know anything else, but) had seen our elders worship them.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَـٰبِدِينَ

verses.english_text: Ibrahim said: you and your elders were all in manifest misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ اَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: They said: have you come to us with truth or you also doing amusement?
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ اَجِئْتَنَا بِالْحَقِّ اَمْ اَنتَ مِنَ اللَّـٰعِبِينَ

verses.english_text: Ibrahim said (not joking) but these idols are not your lords, but your Lord is the Master of the skies and the earth, who created them, and I, myself, a witness of this in front of you.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ الَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَاَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ الشَّـٰهِدِينَ

verses.english_text: Ibrahim said: after your turning away I will do plotting against these idols.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَاللَّهِ لَاَكِيدَنَّ اَصْنَـٰمَكُم بَعْدَ اَن تُوَلُّواْ مُدْبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Ibrahim broke all idols into pieces except the big one, so that when they come back from festival, they should go to him.
verses.arabic_text: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا اِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ اِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: (When infidels came to know) they said: whoever has done this misbehaviour with our gods has certainly done great unjust.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ اِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: (Some of them said): we have seen a youth called Ibrahim who were ill-speaking about these idols.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا فَتًۭى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُٓ اِبْرَٰهِيمُ

verses.english_text: They said: arrest and bring him in front of all, so whatever he will say, people might witness to his talk.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ فَاْتُواْ بِهِ عَلَىٰٓ اَعْيُنِ النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ

verses.english_text: (When Ibrahim came), they said: O Ibrahim have you done this to our gods?
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ ءَاَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَـٰٓاِبْرَٰهِيمُ

verses.english_text: Ibrahim said: this has been done by the big idol, so ask them if they can speak.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ اِن كَانُواْ يَنطِقُونَ

verses.english_text: Then they thought and said: (to each other) Verily only you yourselves are unjust.
verses.arabic_text: فَرَجَعُوٓاْ اِلَىٰٓ اَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓاْ اِنَّكُمْ اَنتُمُ الظَّـٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Then their heads were caused to bow down (in the misguidance) and they could not do anything and said: you know that idols cannot speak.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ نُكِسُواْ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ

verses.english_text: So do you worship these things leaving Allah, which neither can benefit you nor they can cause any harm to you.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ

verses.english_text: Curses on you, and on the things you worship, leaving Allah; so don't you understand this.
verses.arabic_text: اُفٍّۢ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ ۖ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: They said (to one to another): if you can do anything, burn Ibrahim in fire and help your gods.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ حَرِّقُوهُ وَانصُرُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ اِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ

verses.english_text: (After all they threw Ibrahim in fire), so We said: O Fire! be cool and be a means of safety to Ibrahim.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ

verses.english_text: And they wanted to plot against Ibrahim but We failed them all.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَرَادُواْ بِهِ كَيْدًۭا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ الْاَخْسَرِينَ

verses.english_text: And it was We who delivered Ibrahim and Lut (from transgressors) towards safety and peace and reached them to this land (Bait al-Maqdas), where We kept different blessings for the entire world.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَلُوطًا اِلَى الْاَرْضِ الَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And We rewarded Ibrahim with (son) Ishaq and (grandson) Yaqoob; and We made them all good.
verses.arabic_text: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُٓ اِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةًۭ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا صَـٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: We made them all leaders (of the people), who used to guide them on Our Command; and We sent revelation on them for doing good work. (establishing) prayer and giving poor-rate, and they used to do Our worship only.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ اَئِمَّةًۭ يَهْدُونَ بِاَمْرِنَا وَاَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَٰتِ وَاِقَامَ الصَّلَوٰةِ وَاِيتَآءَ الزَّكَوٰةِ ۖ وَكَانُواْ لَنَا عَـٰبِدِينَ

verses.english_text: And to Lut also We gave patience and understanding and prophethood, and We delivered him from the town whose residents were wicked, and there is no doubt that those people were very evil and transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ الْخَبَـٰٓئِثَ ۗ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍۢ فَـٰسِقِينَ

verses.english_text: And We gave place to Lut in Our Mercy and there is no doubt that he was from the good people.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَدْخَلْنَـٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ اِنَّهُ مِنَ الصَّـٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet! before Lut) We gave prophethood to Nooh, when he called Me then We heard his prayer, and delivered him and his companions from great distress (of typhoon).
verses.arabic_text: وَنُوحًا اِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَاَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ

verses.english_text: And whoever has denied our verses We helped him against them, indeed they were bad people, and We drowned them all and killed them.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۚ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍۢ فَاَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet!) remind them the tale of Dawood and Suleiman, when they both sat to decide about incident, when people's sheep intruded at night into the field and grazed it, and We were witnessing their judgement.
verses.arabic_text: وَدَاوُدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ اِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى الْحَرْثِ اِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ الْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَـٰهِدِينَ

verses.english_text: (When they disputed among) so We told the right judgement to Suleiman, and (like this) only We give wisdom and understanding and knowledge to all, and We directed mountains to obey Dawood, and they were used to glorify (Allah) with him, and We directed birds to obey him, and only We do such things.
verses.arabic_text: فَفَهَّمْنَـٰهَا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُدَ الْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَالطَّيْرَ ۚ وَكُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ

verses.english_text: And We taught him how to make iron armor, to save you from attack of one another, so now will you then be His grateful?
verses.arabic_text: وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍۢ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَاْسِكُمْ ۖ فَهَلْ اَنتُمْ شَـٰكِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And We directed violent winds to obey Suleiman, and they were pursuing their course towards this land (Bait al-Maqdas) with his command, which We had blessed differently, and We are the knower of all the things.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ الرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِاَمْرِهِٓ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ الَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And the Jinn who were diving to bring out gems, and were doing other works also; We directed them to obey Suleiman, and We were watching over them (so that they may not run away).
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنَ الشَّيَـٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet! remember the tale of Ayub, when he prayed to his Lord that ailment has afflicted me, and You are the most Merciful among the mercifuls.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَاَيُّوبَ اِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُٓ اَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ الضُّرُّ وَاَنتَ اَرْحَمُ الرَّٰحِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We accepted his prayer and warded off his pain and difficulties, and gave him his family and similarly much more from Our Grace; this is a reminder for worshippers.
verses.arabic_text: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِ مِن ضُرٍّۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ اَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰبِدِينَ

verses.english_text: And gave him Ismael and Idris and Zulkafal, remember! they were all among those who had patience.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَاِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ الصَّـٰبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And We had entered all of them in our Mercy; Verily, they were all Our good character servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ اِنَّهُم مِّنَ الصَّـٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: And remember Yunus when he went in anger thinking We will not straiten his sustenance; then he went into darkness and called Us: O Lord there is no god except You, Glory be to You, the Self-Sufficient, and I was among those who were unjust on their own souls.
verses.arabic_text: وَذَا النُّونِ اِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَـٰضِبًۭا فَظَنَّ اَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى الظُّلُمَـٰتِ اَن لَّآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّآ اَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ اِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We accepted his prayer and delivered him from grief, and thus We deliver the believers.
verses.arabic_text: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ الْغَمِّ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And remember Zakaria, when he prayed to his Lord: O my Lord, leave me not alone (without a child); and you are the best heir among heirs.
verses.arabic_text: وَزَكَرِيَّآ اِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًۭا وَاَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَٰرِثِينَ

verses.english_text: So We heard his prayer, and We gave him a son such as Yahya, and We made good his wife for him, indeed they used to do haste in the good works, and used to call Us with utmost love and fear and used to implore before Us.
verses.arabic_text: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ يَحْيَىٰ وَاَصْلَحْنَا لَهُ زَوْجَهُٓ ۚ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى الْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًۭا وَرَهَبًۭا ۖ وَكَانُواْ لَنَا خَـٰشِعِينَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet!) remember the Lady, who saved her chastity, so We breathed Our Spirit into her womb, and made her and her son (Isa) signs of Our Power for the world.
verses.arabic_text: وَالَّتِىٓ اَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا وَابْنَهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Indeed, this your religion (Islam) is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me (only).
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَـٰذِهِٓ اُمَّتُكُمْ اُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَاَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُونِ

verses.english_text: And yet the people disputed it and divided it; and (eventually) they all have to return to Us (there it will be decided).
verses.arabic_text: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓاْ اَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلٌّ اِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: He who does good deeds and is also a believer, his endeavour will not go waste, and We are writing his deeds.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِ وَ اِنَّا لَهُ كَـٰتِبُونَ

verses.english_text: And the settlements which We destroyed. (they may go anywhere) but it is not possible that on the Day of Judgement they will not come back to Us.
verses.arabic_text: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ اَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ اَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: When Gog and Magog will be let loose, and they will come out from every height of the land.
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَاْجُوجُ وَمَاْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍۢ يَنسِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Then the promise of the Day of Judgement will draw near, then infidels' eyes will become like stone, and will say: Oh our misfortune, we were in state of negligence of this day, and in fact we were the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَاقْتَرَبَ الْوَعْدُ الْحَقُّ فَاِذَا هِىَ شَـٰخِصَةٌ اَبْصَـٰرُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: That day the sound will come and say: you and those (all) whom you had worshipped leaving Allah will be the fuel of Hellfire, you shall all go down this.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّكُمْ وَ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ اَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ

verses.english_text: If they were true gods, they would not have to go to Hell. (now) they shall all abide in it forever.
verses.arabic_text: لَوْ كَانَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةًۭ مَّا وَرَدُوهَا ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

verses.english_text: They will shout and groan in Hell, and in the commotion, they shall not hear anything.
verses.arabic_text: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌۭ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ

verses.english_text: Yes, however, for whom good is already written in fate by Us, they will be kept away from Hell.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا الْحُسْنَىٰٓ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ

verses.english_text: They will not hear even the slightest sound of it, and they will forever live in desires of their choice.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا ۖ وَهُمْ فِى مَا اشْتَهَتْ اَنفُسُهُمْ خَـٰلِدُونَ

verses.english_text: They shall not have the fear of the great fearful Day of the Judgement and angels will meet them happily and will give them glad tidings that this is that day of happiness which was promised to you.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ الْفَزَعُ الْاَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ هَـٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ الَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

verses.english_text: That will be the day when We will roll up the skies, like a scroll of writings are rolled. (and) like We had made the creatures earlier, We shall reproduce them again, and this is the promise which was imperative on us (to complete), and We shall Verily bring it about.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى السَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ ۚ كَمَا بَدَاْنَآ اَوَّلَ خَلْقٍۢ نُّعِيدُهُ ۚ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ ۚ اِنَّا كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ

verses.english_text: And We had written an admonition in Zaboor after (Taurait) that Our inheritors on the land will be righteous people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى الزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ الذِّكْرِ اَنَّ الْاَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ الصَّـٰلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: Indeed, in it there is a message (of the commandments of Allah) for the worshippers.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِى هَـٰذَا لَبَلَـٰغًۭا لِّقَوْمٍ عَـٰبِدِينَ

verses.english_text: And (O Prophet!) We sent you as complete mercy for people of the world.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ اِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet!) Say: I have received the revelation that your Lord is only One Allah, so are you becoming his obedient servants?
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ اِلَىَّ اَنَّمَآ اِلَـٰهُكُمْ اِلَـٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ فَهَلْ اَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Still if they turn their faces, then say: I have told you all in fairness. (and) that I do not know whether the promise of punishment which is made to you, is near or yet it is still far.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِن تَوَلَّوْاْ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍۢ ۖ وَاِنْ اَدْرِىٓ اَقَرِيبٌ اَم بَعِيدٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ

verses.english_text: There is no doubt that He knows the things which you say loudly or which you hide secretly, He knows that also.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ

verses.english_text: And I also do not know whether this delay is a trial for you and for a period there may be ease for you.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنْ اَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُ فِتْنَةٌۭ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَـٰعٌ اِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Prophet prayed: O my Lord judge justly between me and the infidels, and our Lord is most Beneficent, and from Whom the help is sought, against what you describe (for Him).
verses.arabic_text: قَـٰلَ رَبِّ احْكُم بِالْحَقِّ ۗ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحْمَـٰنُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ

verses.english_text: O people! Keep fearing Allah, because the earthquake of the Day of Judgement is not ordinary but a very severe thing.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ اِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شَىْءٌ عَظِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: When you will see it that day, when all breastfeeding mothers shall forget her breastfed children, and (due to fright that day) all pregnant women will abort their children; in panic people will appear as intoxicated whereas they will not be drunk, but the punishment of Allah is most severe.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّآ اَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرَى النَّاسَ سُكَـٰرَىٰ وَ مَا هُم بِسُكَـٰرَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ اللَّهِ شَدِيدٌۭ

verses.english_text: And there are some people who dispute (without knowledge) regarding Allah and follow every transgressor Satan.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يُجَـٰدِلُ فِى اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَـٰنٍۢ مَّرِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: It has been written for them that whoever will befriend him, Verily, he will misguide them and will Verily reach them to the punishment of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ اَنَّهُ مَن تَوَلَّاهُ فَاَنَّهُ يُضِلُّهُ وَيَهْدِيهِ اِلَىٰ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ

verses.english_text: O People, if you have any doubt in raising again after (your) death, then indeed you were created earlier with dust, then sperm, then frozen blood, then lump of flesh (which came into shape), complete and incomplete to show you (Our Power). (then what is the difficulty in your re-production) and in the womb of women We keep sperm for an appointed period, then bring you out as babies. (then We nourish you) so you reach your youth, some of you die (before reaching old age), and some of you are brought to the worst part of life (old age); that in spite of having knowledge (due to your age) you don't understand anything; and you are seeing the barren land, when we send rain on it, it flourishes and rises (once) again, and beautiful things of all kinds are grown.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍۢ مِّنَ الْبَعْثِ فَاِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضْغَةٍۢ مُّخَلَّقَةٍۢ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍۢ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ ۚ وَنُقِرُّ فِى الْاَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَآءُ اِلَىٰٓ اَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًۭا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓاْ اَشُدَّكُمْ ۖ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ اِلَىٰٓ اَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَتَرَى الْاَرْضَ هَامِدَةًۭ فَاِذَآ اَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَآءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَاَنۢبَتَتْ مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ

verses.english_text: (These powers We show you that you should know) This is because indeed Allah is Truth, and then Verily, He brings to life again the dead ones, and He has power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَاَنَّهُ يُحْىِ الْمَوْتَىٰ وَاَنَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And the Hour shall Verily come and there is no doubt in it, and who are in graves Allah will bring them to life again.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّ السَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌۭ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَاَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَن فِى الْقُبُورِ

verses.english_text: And there are some people who dispute about Allah without understanding and getting guidance from the enlightening Book.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يُجَـٰدِلُ فِى اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا هُدًۭى وَلَا كِتٰبٍۢ مُّنِيرٍۢ

verses.english_text: (Unnecessarily) they are disputing about Allah that they may misguide people from the path of Allah, for such people there is disgrace in this world as well as on the Day of Judgement, We will make him taste the punishment of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: ثَانِىَ عِطْفِهِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ لَهُ فِى الدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌۭ ۖ وَنُذِيقُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ

verses.english_text: At that time it will be said: this is the punishment for your deeds, which your hands had done earlier, and Verily Allah do not do injustice to his servants.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاكَ وَاَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّـٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

verses.english_text: And there are some among the people who worship on an edge, and if any good reaches him he becomes satisfied, but if any difficulty touches him, he immediately turns his face (towards infidelity); he is in loss in this world as well as in the Hereafter, this is the manifest loss.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرْفٍۢ ۖ فَاِنْ اَصَابَهُ خَيْرٌ اطْمَاَنَّ بِهِ ۖ وَاِنْ اَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ انقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ خَسِرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ

verses.english_text: Whoever calls those things at the time of his desires besides Allah, which can neither can harm him nor it can cause any benefit, this is the utter misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: يَدْعُواْ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُ وَ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلَـٰلُ الْبَعِيدُ

verses.english_text: And to whom he calls (for his desires) whose loss is nearer than benefit, Verily such master and friend (both) are evil.
verses.arabic_text: يَدْعُواْ لَمَن ضَرُّهُٓ اَقْرَبُ مِن نَّفْعِهِ ۚ لَبِئْسَ الْمَوْلَىٰ وَلَبِئْسَ الْعَشِيرُ

verses.english_text: Indeed, who believed and did good works, Allah will take them and enter them into lush-green gardens beneath which the rivers will be flowing, Verily Allah does whatever he pleases.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ

verses.english_text: (Due to anger) whoever has misconception that Allah would not help him in this world and in the Hereafter, he may ascend towards sky through a rope, then cut it off, then see that struggle can ward off that thing or not; on which he was enraged.
verses.arabic_text: مَن كَانَ يَظُنُّ اَن لَّن يَنصُرَهُ اللَّهُ فِى الدُّنْيَا وَالْـَٔاخِرَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ اِلَى السَّمَآءِ ثُمَّ لْيَقْطَعْ فَلْيَنظُرْ هَلْ يُذْهِبَنَّ كَيْدُهُ مَا يَغِيظُ

verses.english_text: And We have sent the Quran like manifest argument and bright sign, indeed, Allah guides to whoever He pleases.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ اَنزَلْنَـٰهُ اٰيٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ وَاَنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يُرِيدُ

verses.english_text: Indeed, whoever believed (Muslims) and (those who are) Jews, and Atheists and Christians and Fire Worshippers (Majoosi) and polytheists, Verily, Allah will judge between them on the Day of Judgement, and there is no doubt that Allah is seeing everything.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَ الَّذِينَ هَادُواْ وَالصَّـٰبِـِٔينَ وَالنَّصَـٰرَىٰ وَالْمَجُوسَ وَ الَّذِينَ اَشْرَكُوٓاْ اِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ

verses.english_text: Did not you see that whoever is in the skies and whoever is on the earth, Sun, Moon and Stars, Mountains and Trees, and cattle (in fact all creatures) and many from among the human beings, they all prostrate before Allah; and there are many for whom punishment has become imperative due to their disobedience, whoever Allah disgraces then nobody can give honor to him, there is no doubt that Allah does whatever He pleases.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللَّهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهُ مَن فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى الْاَرْضِ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ وَالنُّجُومُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَالشَّجَرُ وَالدَّوَآبُّ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنَ النَّاسِ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ الْعَذَابُ ۗ وَمَن يُهِنِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِن مُّكْرِمٍ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۩

verses.english_text: {Prostrate Non-Obligatory} These are two adversaries (Believers and Non-Believers), they dispute among them regarding Allah; whoever have become non-believer, for them garment of fire will be cut, which they will be made to wear, and boiling water will be poured over their heads.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ هَـٰذَانِ خَصْمَانِ اخْتَصَمُواْ فِى رَبِّهِمْ ۖ فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِيَابٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ يُصَبُّ مِن فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ الْحَمِيمُ

verses.english_text: (Because of its heat) whatever is in their bellies (intestine, etc.) will be melted.
verses.arabic_text: يُصْهَرُ بِهِ مَا فِى بُطُونِهِمْ وَالْجُلُودُ

verses.english_text: And there will be iron mace to hit them.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَهُم مَّقَـٰمِعُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: Due to shock when they try to flee, they will be hit by mace and pushed inside (again), and they will be told: (now) taste the burning punishment.
verses.arabic_text: كُلَّمَآ اَرَادُوٓاْ اَن يَخْرُجُواْ مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ اُعِيدُواْ فِيهَا وَذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ

verses.english_text: Who believed and did the good works too, Allah will make them enter into (lush green Paradise's) Gardens beneath which the rivers will be flowing; there they will be adorned therein with the gold bracelet and (garlands) of pearls, and they shall wear the silky dress over there.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ اَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍۢ وَلُؤْلُؤًۭا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: (This is because) in the world they were guided towards good words (Monotheism) and they were shown the correct way to praise (Allah).
verses.arabic_text: وَهُدُوٓاْ اِلَى الطَّيِّبِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَهُدُوٓاْ اِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ الْحَمِيدِ

verses.english_text: Verily, who have become infidels and stop people from the way of Allah and Sacred Mosque (Ka'aba), which We have made the place of worship, on which everyone has an equal share whether people of inland or visitors and who misguide them mischievously, We will make him taste the grievous punishment.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ الَّذِى جَعَلْنَـٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَآءً الْعَـٰكِفُ فِيهِ وَالْبَادِ ۚ وَمَن يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِاِلْحَادٍۭ بِظُلْمٍۢ نُّذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ اَلِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! remember the time when We identified the place of Kaaba through a cloud, and told him not to associate anything with Me; and keep it neat and clean for those who perform circumambulation, stand, bow and prostrate.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ بَوَّاْنَا لِاِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَكَانَ الْبَيْتِ اَن لَّا تُشْرِكْ بِى شَيْـًۭٔا وَطَهِّرْ بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَالْقَآئِمِينَ وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُودِ

verses.english_text: And give the people news of the Hajj, who will come to you on foot in groups, and on the lean animals coming from far off areas.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَذِّن فِى النَّاسِ بِالْحَجِّ يَاْتُوكَ رِجَالًۭا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٍۢ يَاْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍۢ

verses.english_text: So, they may see their benefits, then during some appointed days. (sacrifice) the animals which Allah has given you as sustenance and take Allah's name and eat from it, then feed the hungry and needy from it.
verses.arabic_text: لِّيَشْهَدُواْ مَنَـٰفِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُواْ اسْمَ اللَّهِ فِىٓ اَيَّامٍۢ مَّعْلُومَـٰتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ الْاَنْعَـٰمِ ۖ فَكُلُواْ مِنْهَا وَاَطْعِمُواْ الْبَآئِسَ الْفَقِيرَ

verses.english_text: Then people should clean away the dirtiness of their bodies and complete their offerings and circumambulate the ancient House (Kaaba).
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُواْ تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُواْ نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُواْ بِالْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ

verses.english_text: And this is a command of Allah, whoever will respect the sacred ordinances of Allah, for him there will be great reward with Allah, and all the animals are lawful for you except for those which have been described to you, so prevent yourself from unclean idols and avoid useless and nonsense talks such as singing etc.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ حُرُمَـٰتِ اللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّهُ عِندَ رَبِّهِ ۗ وَاُحِلَّتْ لَكُمُ الْاَنْعَـٰمُ اِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَاجْتَنِبُواْ الرِّجْسَ مِنَ الْاَوْثَـٰنِ وَاجْتَنِبُواْ قَوْلَ الزُّورِ

verses.english_text: Be purely for Allah, and do not make anyone His partner, whoever made (anyone) His partner (as if) he has fallen from the sky, and a bird of prey snatches him (in between) or strong wind throws him far away.
verses.arabic_text: حُنَفَآءَ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِ ۚ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ فَكَاَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ الطَّيْرُ اَوْ تَهْوِى بِهِ الرِّيحُ فِى مَكَانٍۢ سَحِيقٍۢ

verses.english_text: (Remember) whoever respects the signs of Allah, undoubtedly, it gets through the piousness of hearts.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ شَعَـٰٓئِرَ اللَّهِ فَاِنَّهَا مِن تَقْوَى الْقُلُوبِ

verses.english_text: And there is benefit in cattle for an appointed period then their place of sacrifice is Ancient House (Ka'aba) of worship.
verses.arabic_text: لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ اِلَىٰٓ اَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَآ اِلَى الْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ

verses.english_text: We have told the ritual of slaughter to every Ummah, so the four-footed cattle which Allah has given them, mention the name of Allah at the time of slaughter, your Lord is only One Allah so become His obedient, and (O Prophet!) give glad tiding of Paradise to Our servants who humbly implore.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِكُلِّ اُمَّةٍۢ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًۭا لِّيَذْكُرُواْ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ الْاَنْعَـٰمِ ۗ فَاِلَـٰهُكُمْ اِلَـٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ فَلَهُٓ اَسْلِمُواْ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُخْبِتِينَ

verses.english_text: These are the people whose hearts get frightened when Allah's name is mentioned before them, they show patience when affliction befalls them, are continuous in prayer, and spend from the sustenance given by Us in the way of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ اِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَالصَّـٰبِرِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ اَصَابَهُمْ وَالْمُقِيمِى الصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ

verses.english_text: And We have made the sacrificial camels as (one of) Our signs, there is benefit for you in it, so mention the name of Allah while they stand and when all parts fall down then eat from it, and give to the poor whether they show contentment or ask for it, we have made them subservient to you so that you become grateful servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنَـٰهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَـٰٓئِرِ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ فِيهَا خَيْرٌۭ ۖ فَاذْكُرُواْ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَآفَّ ۖ فَاِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُواْ مِنْهَا وَاَطْعِمُواْ الْقَانِعَ وَالْمُعْتَرَّ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنَـٰهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: In the Court of Allah neither flesh will reach nor their blood, only your piousness will reach his Court, and like this We made animals subservient to you, that you may proclaim His Greatness on the guidance given by Allah, and give glad tiding to those who do good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: لَن يَنَالَ اللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَلَـٰكِن يَنَالُهُ التَّقْوَىٰ مِنكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُواْ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Verily, Allah defend those who are believers; and indeed, Allah never befriends those who betray or are ungrateful.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍۢ كَفُورٍ

verses.english_text: The people who are continuously under war, they have been given permission to defend themselves on account of getting oppressed, and Verily Allah is well able to defend them.
verses.arabic_text: اُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَـٰتَلُونَ بِاَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُواْ ۚ وَاِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ

verses.english_text: These are the people who have been unjustly expelled from their homes, except because they say that their Lord is only Allah, if Allah would not have stopped the people by some others, then all the synagogues of Jews, all fire temples of Majoosi and all mosques, all would have been demolished, and Allah Verily will aid His helpers (His cause), and He is indeed Powerful and Honourable.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ اُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِم بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ اِلَّآ اَن يَقُولُواْ رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ۗ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ اللَّهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍۢ لَّهُدِّمَتْ صَوَٰمِعُ وَبِيَعٌۭ وَصَلَوَٰتٌۭ وَمَسَـٰجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا اسْمُ اللَّهِ كَثِيرًا ۗ وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ اللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُٓ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ

verses.english_text: And these are the people whom We gave power on earth that they established prayer and gave poor-rate, and enjoin good, and prohibit evil, and this is sure that Allah has the power to do everything.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ اِن مَّكَّنَّـٰهُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ اَقَامُواْ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُاْ الزَّكَوٰةَ وَاَمَرُواْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْاْ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَـٰقِبَةُ الْاُمُورِ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet!) there is no surprise if these (infidels) deny you; before that people of Nooh and Aad and Samood.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ

verses.english_text: And people of Ibrahim and people of Lut.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَوْمُ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ

verses.english_text: And companions of Madyan, had denied their prophets; and Moosa was also rejected (by his people), then We gave some respite to infidels and caught hold of them, then everyone saw how (severe) Our punishment is.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَصْحَـٰبُ مَدْيَنَ ۖ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰ فَاَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ثُمَّ اَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

verses.english_text: So many settlements We destroyed because they were unjust, now they are lying upside down on their roofs, their wells dried, and their strong palaces are lying in a demolished state.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَاَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ اَهْلَكْنَـٰهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌۭ فَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍۢ مُّعَطَّلَةٍۢ وَقَصْرٍۢ مَّشِيدٍ

verses.english_text: Have not they travelled in land so they would have such hearts which could understand, they would have such ears which could hear, in fact eyes that are not blind, but hearts are blind which are found in their breasts.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌۭ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَآ اَوْ ءَاذَانٌۭ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا ۖ فَاِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى الْاَبْصَـٰرُ وَلَـٰكِن تَعْمَى الْقُلُوبُ الَّتِى فِى الصُّدُورِ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! These people are asking for haste in punishment, whereas Allah could never do the opposite to His promise, and one day near Allah is equal to one thousand years to them.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخْلِفَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ ۚ وَاِنَّ يَوْمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَاَلْفِ سَنَةٍۢ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ

verses.english_text: And there were many settlements to which We gave respite even though they were unjust, then We seized them, after all everyone has to return to Us.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَاَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ اَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌۭ ثُمَّ اَخَذْتُهَا وَاِلَىَّ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: Say: O People! I am a manifest warner for you.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنَّمَآ اَنَا۠ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then whoever believed, and did good works, there is forgiveness and best sustenance for him.
verses.arabic_text: فَالَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَرِزْقٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Whosoever tried to frustrate Us with regards to Our verses, they are the companions of hell.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ سَعَوْاْ فِىٓ اٰيٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ اَصْحَـٰبُ الْجَحِيمِ

verses.english_text: And We did not send any messenger or prophet before you who desired something good and Satan created impediment in the way of his desire, then Allah removed that impediment created by Satan, then made (His) verses firm, and He is all knowing and having Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ وَلَا نَبِىٍّ اِلَّآ اِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ اَلْقَى الشَّيْطَـٰنُ فِىٓ اُمْنِيَّتِهِ فَيَنسَخُ اللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِى الشَّيْطَـٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ اللَّهُ اٰيٰتِهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: So that He makes Satanic inspiration their trial whose hearts are sick, and whose hearts have become stiff; and unjust indeed are involved in the long-term disobedience.
verses.arabic_text: لِّيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِى الشَّيْطَـٰنُ فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَالْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَاِنَّ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَفِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: And those who have been given knowledge should know that the revelation is truth from the Lord, and like this they believed, and then their hearts humbly implore in His Court, and Verily Allah is the Guide for the believers towards the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ اُوتُواْ الْعِلْمَ اَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُواْ بِهِ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَاِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهَادِ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And those who adopted infidelity, they will always be in doubt until suddenly the Day of Judgment reaches them, or punishment of an inauspicious day befall them.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا يَزَالُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِى مِرْيَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ حَتَّىٰ تَاْتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً اَوْ يَاْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ

verses.english_text: That day the Kingdom will be purely of Allah only, He will judge the dispute among the people, so those who have accepted the faith, and did good works, they will be living in the Gardens full of bliss.
verses.arabic_text: الْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ فَالَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فِى جَنَّـٰتِ النَّعِيمِ

verses.english_text: And who adopted infidelity and denied our verses, these are the people for whom is the disgraceful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: Who migrated from their cities for the cause of Allah then were martyred or died (naturally) Allah shall certainly give them best sustenance in the Hereafter, and He is the Best among the sustenance givers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ فِى سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوٓاْ اَوْ مَاتُواْ لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ اللَّهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَاِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّٰزِقِينَ

verses.english_text: And certainly, He will reach them to such a place (Paradise) that they will be happy, and Verily Allah is all Knowing and Forbearing.
verses.arabic_text: لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُم مُّدْخَلًۭا يَرْضَوْنَهُ ۗ وَاِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: This is proper that a person should trouble him in retaliation to his enemy as much as he was troubled by him; if he is given more trouble, then Allah will Verily help him; Allah is One that erase sins and is Forgiving.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِ ثُمَّ بُغِىَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ اللَّهُ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌۭ

verses.english_text: Because Allah is all Powerful; He cause to enter the night into the day, and He cause to enter the day into the night, and there is no doubt that Allah Knows everything.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللَّهَ يُولِجُ الَّيْلَ فِى النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِى الَّيْلِ وَاَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And because Allah is certainly the Truth, and besides Him to whoever they call, they are all falsehood, and this is also sure that Allah is Most High, the Great.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَاَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ هُوَ الْبَـٰطِلُ وَاَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْعَلِىُّ الْكَبِيرُ

verses.english_text: Oh, did not you see this much that Allah sends the rain from the sky (clouds) so that land becomes lush green, certainly Allah is the most Beneficent on his servants and knows everything.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللَّهَ اَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَتُصْبِحُ الْاَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: Whatever is in the skies and whatever in on earth, all is His, there is no doubt that Allah is most Self-Sufficient and worthy of Praise.
verses.arabic_text: لَّهُ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ ۗ وَاِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُوَ الْغَنِىُّ الْحَمِيدُ

verses.english_text: Didn't you notice that Allah has made subservient to you whatever is on the earth and also the ships sailing in the sea with His command, and He is holding the skies that they do not fall on the earth but when His command will be. (it will fall), there is no doubt that Allah is most Benignant and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى الْاَرْضِ وَالْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى الْبَحْرِ بِاَمْرِهِ وَيُمْسِكُ السَّمَآءَ اَن تَقَعَ عَلَى الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهِٓ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ بِالنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And He is having Absolute Power that in the beginning He brought you to life in the wombs, then He will cause you to die, and shall bring you to life again, indeed man is very ungrateful.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِىٓ اَحْيَاكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ۗ اِنَّ الْاِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌۭ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet!) We have appointed a method for every Ummah to which they follow, therefore they should not dispute in this religion (Islam), you call people towards your Lord, indeed you are on the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: لِّكُلِّ اُمَّةٍۢ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ ۖ فَلَا يُنَـٰزِعُنَّكَ فِى الْاَمْرِ ۚ وَادْعُ اِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ اِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Still if people quarrel with you then say: whatever I am doing, Allah is well aware of it.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن جَـٰدَلُوكَ فَقُلِ اللَّهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: In which you were disputing, on the Day of Judgment Allah will judge between you people.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet!) Don't you know whatever is in the skies and on earth Allah Verily knows it, indeed it all is all secure in this Book, verily this is easy for Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ اَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۗ اِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِى كِتٰبٍ ۚ اِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And these people worship other things leaving Allah, for which neither Allah has sent any argument, nor they have knowledge of their being true, on the Day of Judgement no one will help the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ سُلْطَـٰنًۭا وَ مَا لَيْسَ لَهُم بِهِ عِلْمٌۭ ۗ وَ مَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍۢ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet!) When Our manifest and bright verses are recited in front of them then you see unhappiness on faces of the infidels, almost that they may attack those who are reciting Our verses; (O Prophet!) Say: shall I tell you worse than this, listen, that is Hell, Allah has promised infidels to send them to Hell, and how evil is the place.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ الْمُنكَرَ ۖ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِالَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتِنَا ۗ قُلْ اَفَاُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّۢ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُ ۗ النَّارُ وَعَدَهَا اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: O People! When an example is described so listen to it attentively, to whom you call besides Allah, even if they come all together, they cannot create even a fly, and if a fly snatches something from them, they cannot even rescue it (what a fun) seeker and the giver both are weak.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌۭ فَاسْتَمِعُواْ لَهُٓ ۚ اِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُواْ ذُبَابًۭا وَلَوِ اجْتَمَعُواْ لَهُ ۖ وَاِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ الذُّبَابُ شَيْـًۭٔا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ۚ ضَعُفَ الطَّالِبُ وَالْمَطْلُوبُ

verses.english_text: They should appreciate Allah which they didn't; there is no doubt that Allah is all Powerful and Predominant.
verses.arabic_text: مَا قَدَرُواْ اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِٓ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ

verses.english_text: Allah chose among the angels to reach His message; and likewise, among the men, Verily Allah Hear and See everything.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ يَصْطَفِى مِنَ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًۭا وَمِنَ النَّاسِ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And whatever is in front of them and whatever has happened before them, Allah Knows Everything, and all the matters are turned to Allah only.
verses.arabic_text: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيهِمْ وَ مَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۗ وَاِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْاُمُورُ

verses.english_text: O Believers, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord, and do good works so you become successful.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ارْكَعُواْ وَاسْجُدُواْ وَاعْبُدُواْ رَبَّكُمْ وَافْعَلُواْ الْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ۩

verses.english_text: {Prostrate Non-Obligatory} And do the struggle in the way of Allah as it should be, He chose and did not force you in any way for religious affairs, and made religion of your father Ibrahim, your religion, and that Allah named you Muslim (obedient servant) before, and strive hard in this Quran also so that Prophet become a witness for you, and you become the witness for all men, keep up prayer, continue to give poor-rate, and hold fast commands of Allah, He is your Guardian, and what a good Guardian and good Helper He is.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَـٰهِدُواْ فِى اللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ ۚ هُوَ اجْتَبَىٰكُمْ وَ مَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى الدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍۢ ۚ مِّلَّةَ اَبِيكُمْ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِى هَـٰذَا لِيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُواْ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ ۚ فَاَقِيمُواْ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ الزَّكَوٰةَ وَاعْتَصِمُواْ بِاللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَنِعْمَ الْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ

verses.english_text: Indeed, believers became successful.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ اَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Who humbly implore in their prayers.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَـٰشِعُونَ

verses.english_text: And who objects to the useless talks.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ

verses.english_text: And who are givers of poor-rate.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَـٰعِلُونَ

verses.english_text: And who protect their private parts.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ

verses.english_text: Except for their wives and their lady-slaves, they Verily are not blamable.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ اَزْوَٰجِهِمْ اَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَاِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ

verses.english_text: Then if anybody will find another way (for his carnal desires), he shall commit excesses.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ

verses.english_text: And those believers who keep their trusts and promises.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ لِاَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who keep up their prayer regularly.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ

verses.english_text: Indeed, these are the inheritors of Paradise.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْوَٰرِثُونَ

verses.english_text: They shall inherit Firdaus, and they are going to abide in it forever.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

verses.english_text: And We created man with the wet clay.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنسَـٰنَ مِن سُلَـٰلَةٍۢ مِّن طِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then we placed it as sperm at a secure place.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُطْفَةًۭ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then made sperm a clot, then We made clot into a lump of flesh, then We made lump of bones, then We covered the bones with flesh, then We made it another creature, so how Blessed is that Allah; Who is the Best of the Creators.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا النُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا الْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظَـٰمًۭا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظَـٰمَ لَحْمًۭا ثُمَّ اَنشَاْنَـٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ اَحْسَنُ الْخَـٰلِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Then you are all going to die.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ

verses.english_text: Then you will be raised once again on the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ

verses.english_text: And We have created atop you, seven skies one upon another; and We are not oblivious from our Creatures.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَ مَا كُنَّا عَنِ الْخَلْقِ غَـٰفِلِينَ

verses.english_text: And We have sent water from the sky in a fixed quantity, then We caused it to collect on the earth, whereas We were also capable of taking it back.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَاَسْكَنَّـٰهُ فِى الْاَرْضِ ۖ وَ اِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then with this water We created the gardens of palms and grapes in which ample of fruits are found, and you eat also some from them.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَنشَاْنَا لَكُم بِهِ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَاَعْنَـٰبٍۢ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَاْكُلُونَ

verses.english_text: And created that tree which is found on the Mount Tur (Sinai), oil is also extracted from it, that it is also a curry for the eaters.
verses.arabic_text: وَشَجَرَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍۢ لِّلْـَٔاكِلِينَ

verses.english_text: And verily there is a lesson for you in the animals, and in their bellies, there is substance for your fulfilment, and there are many advantages in it and you also eat from it.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى الْاَنْعَـٰمِ لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَاْكُلُونَ

verses.english_text: And on ships and animals you mount.
verses.arabic_text: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: And We sent Nooh to his people, he said: O my people! worship Allah, that for it you do not have any other god, why you do not fear Him.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا اِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُواْ اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ اِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُٓ ۖ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: Infidel chiefs of his people said: this Nooh is just a mortal like you, who wish to take superiority on you, if Allah pleased, He could have sent down the angels, this we have not heard from our forefathers.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَالَ الْمَلَؤُاْ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَوْمِهِ مَا هَـٰذَآ اِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ اَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ لَوْ شَآءَ اللَّهُ لَاَنزَلَ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةًۭ مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: In fact, he is a mortal who has become insane, so wait for some days for his condition.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِ جِنَّةٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُواْ بِهِ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: So, Nooh prayed: O my Lord! help me against their denial.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ انصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

verses.english_text: So We revealed to him: make an ark in front of my eyes according to my direction, when Our command comes and water start to gush out from the oven, take two from each pair, and take your family and go, except for those people against whom Our judgement has already come, and do not speak to me about the unjust - they all shall be drowned.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَيْهِ اَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِاَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ ۙ فَاسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّۢ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَاَهْلَكَ اِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَـٰطِبْنِى فِى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ ۖ اِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ

verses.english_text: After this, when you board the Ark with your companions and be comfortably seated then say: thanks to the Lord who delivered us from the unjust people.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا اسْتَوَيْتَ اَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And say: O my Lord! cause us to disembark on a blessed place, because you are the Best who cause to disembark.
verses.arabic_text: وَقُل رَّبِّ اَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًۭا مُّبَارَكًۭا وَاَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ

verses.english_text: In this there are many of Our signs, We only take tests (from you).
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ وَاِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We created other nations.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَنشَاْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ

verses.english_text: And We sent prophets among them so you all worship Allah that you do not have any god except Him, will not you become pious?
verses.arabic_text: فَاَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ اَنِ اعْبُدُواْ اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ اِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُٓ ۖ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: Chiefs of their tribes who have adopted infidelity and were denying the meeting of Allah in the Hereafter and We had given them life of ease, said: he is nothing but a mortal like you, he eats like you and drinks like you do.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الْمَلَاُ مِن قَوْمِهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِلِقَآءِ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَاَتْرَفْنَـٰهُمْ فِى الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا مَا هَـٰذَآ اِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَاْكُلُ مِمَّا تَاْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ

verses.english_text: And if you obey a mortal like you then Verily you will be at loss.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَئِنْ اَطَعْتُم بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ اِنَّكُمْ اِذًۭا لَّخَـٰسِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Does he promise to you that after you die and become dust and bones, you will be raised again?
verses.arabic_text: اَيَعِدُكُمْ اَنَّكُمْ اِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَـٰمًا اَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ

verses.english_text: Far, far away! What matter is being promised to you?
verses.arabic_text: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ

verses.english_text: This is a worldly life where we will die and are not going to be raised again.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ هِىَ اِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ

verses.english_text: This is such a man who blames God, and we do not believe in him.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلٌ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا وَ مَا نَحْنُ لَهُ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: The Prophet said: O my Lord! help me, they are denying me.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ انصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

verses.english_text: Allah said: Shortly they will become remorseful.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍۢ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَـٰدِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Resultant, they were overtaken by a truthful mighty cry, and we made them rubbish, for there is death and destruction for the unjust people.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ بِالْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ غُثَآءًۭ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We created the new nations.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَنشَاْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ

verses.english_text: No nation can go ahead or lag from the appointed time.
verses.arabic_text: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَ مَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Thereafter, we continuously sent the prophets, whenever any prophet came to them, they accused him of falsehood, and We also went on killing them (those people, one after another) and made them tales, because there is destruction for the nation who do not believe.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ اُمَّةًۭ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَاَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًۭا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ اَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Then We sent Moosa and his brother Haroon with our manifest arguments.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَاَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

verses.english_text: Towards Firaun and his chiefs of the government, they also showed arrogance, and they were people of haughty type.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَاِي۟هِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُواْ وَكَانُواْ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ

verses.english_text: So they said: shall we believe in two men like us, when their people are worshipping us.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَالُوٓاْ اَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَـٰبِدُونَ

verses.english_text: They denied them with this, and they became among the people who perished.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُواْ مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِينَ

verses.english_text: And We gave Moosa the Book, so that they may believe like this.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

verses.english_text: And We made the son of Maryam and his mother, our signs; We gave them a place to settle on the height, where a fountain was also there.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَاُمَّهُٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ اِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: O my Prophets! eat pure things and do good work, We are well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُواْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَاعْمَلُواْ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ اِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And religion of all of you is one religion and I am the Lord of all, so fear Me only.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ هَـٰذِهِٓ اُمَّتُكُمْ اُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَاَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَاتَّقُونِ

verses.english_text: Then they divided the religion into sects, and every sect is happy and satisfied with whatever they have.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓاْ اَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ

verses.english_text: Now you leave them in this misguidance for a period.
verses.arabic_text: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

verses.english_text: Do they think that (because) We are giving them wealth and children?
verses.arabic_text: اَيَحْسَبُونَ اَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِ مِن مَّالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ

verses.english_text: We are hastening in their good work, never, they are unaware of the respite given to them.
verses.arabic_text: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى الْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily who keep shivering from the fear of their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who believe in the signs of their Lords.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who do not make anyone a partner of their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who keep giving in the way of Allah according to their capacity, and they keep fearing that they have to return to His Court.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَواْ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ اَنَّهُمْ اِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: These are the people who excel in doing good; and these are the people who are going to go ahead from the rest.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى الْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَـٰبِقُونَ

verses.english_text: We do not burden any soul more than his capacity, and We have the book which speaks the truth, and no unjust will be done to them.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا اِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتٰبٌۭ يَنطِقُ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Whereas their hearts are drowned in total ignorance, and they have a different set of deeds which they follow.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا وَلَهُمْ اَعْمَـٰلٌۭ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَـٰمِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Since We took their wealthy ones in Our punishment, now they are all pleading.
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَآ اَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِالْعَذَابِ اِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ

verses.english_text: Now do whatever wailing (you want), today help will not come from Our side.
verses.arabic_text: لَا تَجْـَٔرُواْ الْيَوْمَ ۖ اِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ

verses.english_text: When Our verses were recited in front of you then you were running on your back foot.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ كَانَتْ اٰيٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ اَعْقَـٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ

verses.english_text: Arrogantly, while talking uselessly and telling tales.
verses.arabic_text: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِ سَـٰمِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Did not they ponder over our talk; did they receive anything which their forefathers had not received?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُواْ الْقَوْلَ اَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَاْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: Or it is because they did not recognize their prophet, that they deny.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُواْ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُ مُنكِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Or their saying that there is madness in the prophet, whereas he has brought truth to them, and their majority does not like the truth.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِالْحَقِّ وَاَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ

verses.english_text: If truth would have followed their desires, then whatever is in between skies and on earth and in between them would have been destroyed, whereas We have given them admonition, but they have turned away from the admonition.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الْحَقُّ اَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَالْاَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ اَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ

verses.english_text: Are you asking for expenses from them! Absolutely not, because expenses given by Allah are better for you, and He is the Best provider of sustenance.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًۭا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّٰزِقِينَ

verses.english_text: And you are the inviter to the straight path for them.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ اِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And those who do not believe on the Hereafter, have gone astray.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَٰطِ لَنَـٰكِبُونَ

verses.english_text: And if We show Mercy on them and ward off their distress, still they will stay on their transgression, and will go in further misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَ لَوْ رَحِمْنَـٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّۢ لَّلَجُّواْ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

verses.english_text: We caught them with our punishment, but they neither bowed down before their Lord nor they humbly implored.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِالْعَذَابِ فَمَا اسْتَكَانُواْ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَ مَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ

verses.english_text: Until We opened the door of severe punishment (for them), but they sat disappointed in it.
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا ذَا عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍ اِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ

verses.english_text: And that is Allah Who made ears, eyes and hearts for you, but you are very less grateful.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِىٓ اَنشَاَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَـٰرَ وَالْاَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And He spread you on the whole land, and you (all) will be collected in His Court.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِى ذَرَاَكُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَاِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

verses.english_text: That is He, Who gives life and death, and coming and going of the day and night is in His Power, then why do not you use wisdom?
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِى يُحْىِ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ اخْتِلَـٰفُ الَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ ۚ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: But they said the same words which their earlier ones have said.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ قَالُواْ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ الْاَوَّلُونَ

verses.english_text: That if we die and become dust and bones, will we be raised again?
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ اَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَـٰمًا اَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

verses.english_text: Certainly, the promise has been made to us also, and the promise has been made to earlier ones also, but this is the tale of the old ones.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَـٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ اِنْ هَـٰذَآ اِلَّآ اَسَـٰطِيرُ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: So then you ask: this land and its creatures are for whom, if you have any knowledge?
verses.arabic_text: قُل لِّمَنِ الْاَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ اِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: They will immediately say: Allah's, then say: then why do you not understand?
verses.arabic_text: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then further say: who is the owner of the seven skies and the Great Throne?
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ

verses.english_text: They will again say: Allah, say: then why do you not fear (Him)?
verses.arabic_text: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: Then say: who has the Kingdom of Power over everything that he gives [you] refuge. (but) nobody is going to give refuge from his punishment, if you have any sort of knowledge.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ اِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: So they will immediately reply: this is all for Allah, then say: then who is doing the magic on you (who is deceiving you).
verses.arabic_text: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَاَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Whereas I have brought the truth, and they are all liars.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ اَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِالْحَقِّ وَاِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, Allah has not made anybody his son, and neither there is another god besides Him, otherwise every god would have separated along with his creations, and would think about superiority over other, and the universe would have been destroyedAllah, the Glorified, is Most High than all this.
verses.arabic_text: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍۢ وَ مَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ اِلَـٰهٍ ۚ اِذًۭا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ اِلَـٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

verses.english_text: He knows the unseen and the seen and He is Exalted than any kind of polytheism.
verses.arabic_text: عَـٰلِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَـٰدَةِ فَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: And say: O my Lord, if you have promised them any punishment, please show it to me.
verses.arabic_text: قُل رَّبِّ اِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ

verses.english_text: So O Lord, do not place me along with the unjust nation.
verses.arabic_text: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى الْقَوْمِ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And the promise of punishment which We are making with them, We have power to show you.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ اَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ

verses.english_text: You prevent evil with good, We know these things very well.
verses.arabic_text: ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِى هِىَ اَحْسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ

verses.english_text: And say: O my Lord I seek your refuge from the whispering of Satan.
verses.arabic_text: وَقُل رَّبِّ اَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ الشَّيَـٰطِينِ

verses.english_text: And seek refuge from You that Satan should come near to me.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ اَن يَحْضُرُونِ

verses.english_text: So much so when death came to any of them he says: O Lord send us back (to the world).
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا جَآءَ اَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارْجِعُونِ

verses.english_text: I may do some good deeds, ney, this is one thing which he is saying; and behind them there is a Barrier, which will remain until the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: لَعَلِّىٓ اَعْمَلُ صَـٰلِحًۭا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ اِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

verses.english_text: Then, when the trumpet will be blown, there will not be any relations nor will they enquire about each other.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا نُفِخَ فِى الصُّورِ فَلَآ اَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Then whose good deeds' scale will be heavy they will be the one who will be delivered.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: And whose scale of good deeds' will be light, those will be people who have put their souls into loss, they will abide in Hell forever.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ اَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ

verses.english_text: Hellfire shall scorch their faces, and for them will be severe affliction.
