verses.arabic_text: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَـٰلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: Is it not so that when Our verses were recited before you, you denied them?
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَكُنْ اٰيٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

verses.english_text: They will say: O my Lord, bad luck had dominated us and we had gone astray.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًۭا ضَآلِّينَ

verses.english_text: O Lord, take us out of Hell, if we sin again then Verily we are unjust.
verses.arabic_text: رَبَّنَآ اَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَاِنْ عُدْنَا فَاِنَّا ظَـٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Allah will say: now live with this disgrace and do not talk.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اخْسَـُٔواْ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ

verses.english_text: There was one group among our servants who were saying: O Lord! we have believed, so forgive our sins and have Mercy on us, you are the Best among Merciful ones.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ كَانَ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَاَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّٰحِمِينَ

verses.english_text: So you people had made fun of them, so much so, that made you negligent from our remembrance, and you are still making fun of them.
verses.arabic_text: فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ اَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ

verses.english_text: Today We have rewarded them and they are clearly successful.
verses.arabic_text: اِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ الْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓاْ اَنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْفَآئِزُونَ

verses.english_text: Then Allah will ask: how many years you stayed on the earth?
verses.arabic_text: قَـٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ

verses.english_text: They will reply: One day or a part of it, You may ask those who keep account.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا اَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ فَسْـَٔلِ الْعَآدِّينَ

verses.english_text: Allah will say: Verily you stayed for a short period, wish you had some understanding.
verses.arabic_text: قَـٰلَ اِن لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا ۖ لَّوْ اَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Do you think We have created you useless, and you will not be brought back to Us?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَحَسِبْتُمْ اَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ عَبَثًۭا وَاَنَّكُمْ اِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: Allah is Most High and True King, and there is no god except Him, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَعَـٰلَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ

verses.english_text: Whoever call anybody besides Allah without any argument, his accounting is with the Lord, and there is no deliverance for the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ اِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَـٰنَ لَهُ بِهِ فَاِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُ عِندَ رَبِّهِٓ ۚ اِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Say: O my Lord forgive me and have Mercy on me and you the Best of the Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَقُل رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَاَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّٰحِمِينَ

verses.english_text: This is a Surah that We have revealed and made obligatory, and in which We have revealed manifest signs, maybe you take some lesson (from it).
verses.arabic_text: سُورَةٌ اَنزَلْنَـٰهَا وَفَرَضْنَـٰهَا وَاَنزَلْنَا فِيهَآ اٰيٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: Man, who commit fornication, and woman who commit fornication should get 100 lashes each, beware and in this regard do not show any pity on them in the affairs of the religion of Allah; if you have faith on Allah and the Day of Judgement, then a party of believers should be present there to witness it.
verses.arabic_text: الزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِى فَاجْلِدُواْ كُلَّ وَٰحِدٍۢ مِّنْهُمَا مِاْئَةَ جَلْدَةٍۢ ۖ وَلَا تَاْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَاْفَةٌۭ فِى دِينِ اللَّهِ اِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْـَٔاخِرِ ۖ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: A fornicator (man) can marry only an fornicatress (woman) or a polytheist, and a fornicatress (woman) can marry only a fornicator (man) or a polytheist; this is forbidden for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: الزَّانِى لَا يَنكِحُ اِلَّا زَانِيَةً اَوْ مُشْرِكَةًۭ وَالزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ اِلَّا زَانٍ اَوْ مُشْرِكٌۭ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Those who falsely accuse a chaste woman of fornication, and cannot bring four witnesses, those should be given eighty lashes, then never accept them as witness because they are manifest transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَاْتُواْ بِاَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَـٰنِينَ جَلْدَةًۭ وَلَا تَقْبَلُواْ لَهُمْ شَهَـٰدَةً اَبَدًۭا ۚ وَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْفَـٰسِقُونَ

verses.english_text: Except for those who may repent and correct themselves, Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا الَّذِينَ تَابُواْ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَاَصْلَحُواْ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Those who accuse their wives and they do not have four witnesses, then they are equal to four witnesses provided they take oath four times and say they are the truthful ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ اَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَآءُ اِلَّآ اَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَـٰدَةُ اَحَدِهِمْ اَرْبَعُ شَهَـٰدَٰتٍۭ بِاللَّهِ ۙ اِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Curses be upon him, if the fifth time he says he is a liar.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْخَـٰمِسَةُ اَنَّ لَعْنَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اِن كَانَ مِنَ الْكَـٰذِبِينَ

verses.english_text: Then punishment can be averted from a woman, if she takes the oath four times that the man is among the liars.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَدْرَؤُاْ عَنْهَا الْعَذَابَ اَن تَشْهَدَ اَرْبَعَ شَهَـٰدَٰتٍۭ بِاللَّهِ ۙ اِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْكَـٰذِبِينَ

verses.english_text: And if the fifth time (she says) that he is from the truthful ones, then the wrath of Allah be upon me.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْخَـٰمِسَةَ اَنَّ غَضَبَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَآ اِن كَانَ مِنَ الصَّـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: If Grace and Mercy of Allah would not be on you then He would not have been Wise who accept the repentance; and then recompense of this accusation would have been worse.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَاَنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Verily those who are accused of falsehood were a group among you, do not think of them as evil in fact it is good for you, and for every man's sin is that much as much he has earned, and whoever has got a big part in it shall have the grievous punishment.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ جَآءُو بِالْاِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌۭ مِّنكُمْ ۚ لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّۭا لَّكُم ۖ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۚ لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُم مَّا اكْتَسَبَ مِنَ الْاِثْمِ ۚ وَالَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ كِبْرَهُ مِنْهُمْ لَهُ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Why this did not happen that when you heard that accusation, then believer men and women should have thought good for themselves and should have said: this is a manifest accusation.
verses.arabic_text: لَّوْلَآ اِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَـٰتُ بِاَنفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًا وَ قَالُواْ هَـٰذَآ اِفْكٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then why did this not happen? they should have brought four witnesses, when they did not bring witnesses then they are the liars in front of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: لَّوْلَا جَآءُو عَلَيْهِ بِاَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ ۚ فَاِذْ لَمْ يَاْتُواْ بِالشُّهَدَآءِ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عِندَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْكَـٰذِبُونَ

verses.english_text: If Allah's Grace would not have been in the world and the Hereafter and Mercy was not there then grievous punishment would have afflicted you on account of discourse you describe.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ فِى الدُّنْيَا وَالْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِى مَآ اَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

verses.english_text: When you were doing discourse, you uttered such a talk of which you had no knowledge, you were taking it as an easy matter whereas for Allah it was a grievous talk.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُ بِاَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِاَفْوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِ عِلْمٌۭ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُ هَيِّنًۭا وَهُوَ عِندَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And why it didn't happen when you have heard it, you should have said: we have no right to say this, Allah is Glorified and Self-Sufficient and it is a grievous accusation.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَوْلَآ اِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُم مَّا يَكُونُ لَنَآ اَن نَّتَكَلَّمَ بِهَـٰذَا سُبْحَـٰنَكَ هَـٰذَا بُهْتَـٰنٌ عَظِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Allah is advising you, if you are a believer, you should never repeat such an act again.
verses.arabic_text: يَعِظُكُمُ اللَّهُ اَن تَعُودُواْ لِمِثْلِهِٓ اَبَدًا اِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And Allah describes his signs manifestly and He is the master of Knowledge and master of Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَيُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الْـَٔايَـٰتِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Who wishes to spread the evil discourse among the believers, for them there is painful punishment in the world and also in the Hereafter, and Allah Knows everything, only you do not know anything.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ اَن تَشِيعَ الْفَـٰحِشَةُ فِى الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۭ فِى الدُّنْيَا وَالْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَاَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And if Allah's Grace and Beneficence had not come to you, he would not have been Compassionate and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَاَنَّ اللَّهَ رَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: O Believers! do not follow the footsteps of Satan, whoever will follow his footsteps then he will command him for all the evil, if Allah's Grace and Mercy would not be on you than nobody would have been chaste among you, but Allah makes him chaste, with whoever He pleases, Allah hears everyone and is aware of everyone's heart's condition.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَّبِعُواْ خُطُوَٰتِ الشَّيْطَـٰنِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَٰتِ الشَّيْطَـٰنِ فَاِنَّهُ يَاْمُرُ بِالْفَحْشَآءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنكُم مِّنْ اَحَدٍ اَبَدًۭا وَلَـٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يُزَكِّى مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And beware, no one should take oath that he will not help his relatives, needy and those who migrate in the way of Allah, on whoever Allah has shown favors and given abundance; everyone should forgive (others), don't you want that Allah to forgive you? Certainly, Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا يَاْتَلِ اُو۟لُواْ الْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَالسَّعَةِ اَن يُؤْتُوٓاْ اُو۟لِى الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْمَسَـٰكِينَ وَالْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ فِى سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ وَلْيَعْفُواْ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓاْ ۗ اَلَا تُحِبُّونَ اَن يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Those who are chaste, and unknowingly accuse women, Verily, there are curses on them and great punishment for them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَـٰتِ الْغَـٰفِلَـٰتِ الْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ لُعِنُواْ فِى الدُّنْيَا وَالْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: On the Day of Judgement, their tongues, hands and legs will testify against them for what they were doing.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ اَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَاَيْدِيهِمْ وَاَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: That day Allah will recompense them fully, and they will realize that Allah is Truth, and He is the revealer of the truth.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يُوَفِّيهِمُ اللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ الْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ اَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِينُ

verses.english_text: Evil things are for evil people, evil people are for evil talk, and pure talk is for pure people, and pure people are for pure talk, and pure people are free from the accusation of the evil people, and there is forgiveness and honorable sustenance for them.
verses.arabic_text: الْخَبِيثَـٰتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ وَالْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَـٰتِ ۖ وَالطَّيِّبَـٰتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَالطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَ ۖ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَرِزْقٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: O believers! beware, do not enter houses other than yours', unless you take permission from the owner of the house and unless you wish a salutation to him; this is good for you that maybe you take a lesson from it.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَدْخُلُواْ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوتِكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تَسْتَاْنِسُواْ وَتُسَلِّمُواْ عَلَىٰٓ اَهْلِهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then if there is no one in the house, do not enter unless you get the permission, and if you are told to go back. (then) go back, this is a purer act for you, and Allah is well aware of your acts.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِن لَّمْ تَجِدُواْ فِيهَآ اَحَدًۭا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا حَتَّىٰ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَاِن قِيلَ لَكُمُ ارْجِعُواْ فَارْجِعُواْ ۖ هُوَ اَزْكَىٰ لَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: You may enter the house which is not inhabited and (if) any of your luggage is there; and Allah knows whatever you say openly, and Allah also knows whatever you hide.
verses.arabic_text: لَّيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ اَن تَدْخُلُواْ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍۢ فِيهَا مَتَـٰعٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ

verses.english_text: And, O Prophet! tell the believers, keep lowered your eyes and guard your private parts, this is the purer thing, and Allah is Verily aware of their affairs.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَغُضُّواْ مِنْ اَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ وَيَحْفَظُواْ فُرُوجَهُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ اَزْكَىٰ لَهُمْ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And say to the believing women to keep lowered the eyes guard their purity, and do not show your beauty, except that which are obvious, and hang the scarf in your neck, and do not show off your beauty except for husband, father, grandfather, father-in-law and your children, and children of your husband, your brother and children of your brother, children of your sisters, your women, slaves and lady-slaves, and such men who do not have any desire for women, and those children who do not know what is hidden of women, and beware do not walk by striking feet on the ground that the beauty you are hiding become obvious (by ornamental sound); and O believers! all of you keep seeking forgiveness in the Court of Allah, that in this way you might get prosperity and salvation.
verses.arabic_text: وَقُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ اَبْصَـٰرِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ اِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَىٰ جُيُوبِهِنَّ ۖ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ اِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ اَوْ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ اَوْ ءَابَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ اَوْ اَبْنَآئِهِنَّ اَوْ اَبْنَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ اَوْ اِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ اَوْ بَنِىٓ اِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ اَوْ بَنِىٓ اَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ اَوْ نِسَآئِهِنَّ اَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَـٰنُهُنَّ اَوِ التَّـٰبِعِينَ غَيْرِ اُو۟لِى الْاِرْبَةِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ اَوِ الطِّفْلِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُواْ عَلَىٰ عَوْرَٰتِ النِّسَآءِ ۖ وَلَا يَضْرِبْنَ بِاَرْجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعْلَمَ مَا يُخْفِينَ مِن زِينَتِهِنَّ ۚ وَتُوبُوٓاْ اِلَى اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا اَيُّهَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: Arrange for Nikah of eligible singles among your free and among your slaves and lady-slaves; if they are poor Allah will make them prosper with His Grace and Mercy, Allah is Ample-giving and All Knowing.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنكِحُواْ الْاَيَـٰمَىٰ مِنكُمْ وَالصَّـٰلِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَاِمَآئِكُمْ ۚ اِن يَكُونُواْ فُقَرَآءَ يُغْنِهِمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Who do not have the capacity for Nikah, they must also guard their purity until Allah make them rich with His Grace and Mercy, and slaves and lady-slaves who wish to make covenant, see if they are good, make covenant with them, then whatever riches Allah has given you, give them also something from it; and beware do not compel your lady-slaves into prostitution for your own benefit, and whoever will compel them (for prostitution) and they desire to keep their chastity, then Verily after their compulsion Allah is greatly Forgiving and Merciful with regards to women.
verses.arabic_text: وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ الَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحًا حَتَّىٰ يُغْنِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ ۗ وَ الَّذِينَ يَبْتَغُونَ الْكِتٰبَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَـٰنُكُمْ فَكَاتِبُوهُمْ اِنْ عَلِمْتُمْ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا ۖ وَءَاتُوهُم مِّن مَّالِ اللَّهِ الَّذِىٓ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۚ وَلَا تُكْرِهُواْ فَتَيَـٰتِكُمْ عَلَى الْبِغَآءِ اِنْ اَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّنًۭا لِّتَبْتَغُواْ عَرَضَ الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا ۚ وَمَن يُكْرِههُّنَّ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ اِكْرَٰهِهِنَّ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And We have sent Our manifest signs and examples of the earlier people who have passed before you, as the material of admonition for pious people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَنزَلْنَآ اِلَيْكُمْ اٰيٰتٍۢ مُّبَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ وَمَثَلًۭا مِّنَ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْاْ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَوْعِظَةًۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

verses.english_text: Allah is the Light of the skies and the Earth, example of His light like a niche on which a lamp is kept and lamp is inside the glass lantern, and lantern is heightened as brightly shining star, which is lit up from the graceful tree of olive, which the neither eastern nor western, its oil is about to flare up, and fire does touch it also, this is Light upon Light, and Allah guides to His Light to whoever he pleases, like this He explains the examples, and He is Cognizant of everything.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكَوٰةٍۢ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ ۖ الْمِصْبَاحُ فِى زُجَاجَةٍ ۖ الزُّجَاجَةُ كَاَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌۭ دُرِّىٌّۭ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةٍۢ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍۢ زَيْتُونَةٍۢ لَّا شَرْقِيَّةٍۢ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍۢ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِىٓءُ وَ لَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌۭ ۚ نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورٍۢ ۗ يَهْدِى اللَّهُ لِنُورِهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَيَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْاَمْثَـٰلَ لِلنَّاسِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: This lamp is lit in those houses which Allah has commanded to be raised to honor, and therein His name is recited, in them He is Glorified in the mornings and in the evenings.
verses.arabic_text: فِى بُيُوتٍ اَذِنَ اللَّهُ اَن تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا اسْمُهُ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ فِيهَا بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْـَٔاصَالِ

verses.english_text: Men who are not negligent even while doing business, buying and selling from reciting the name of Allah, establishing prayer, and giving poor-rate, these are the people who are afraid of the Day's (Day of Judgement) fright when people's eyes and hearts will turn about.
verses.arabic_text: رِجَالٌۭ لَّا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَـٰرَةٌۭ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَن ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَاِقَامِ الصَّلَوٰةِ وَاِيتَآءِ الزَّكَوٰةِ ۙ يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ وَالْاَبْصَـٰرُ

verses.english_text: So that Allah could reward for their best deeds and can also increase with His Grace, and Allah gives uncountable sustenance to whom Allah pleases.
verses.arabic_text: لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ اَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ

verses.english_text: Who adopted infidelity, there deeds are like mirage in desert, that thirsty man thinks it is water but when he reaches near, there is nothing. (but) he finds Allah who will do his accounting, and He is very quick in accounting.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ اَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ كَسَرَابٍۭ بِقِيعَةٍۢ يَحْسَبُهُ الظَّمْـَٔانُ مَآءً حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا جَآءَهُ لَمْ يَجِدْهُ شَيْـًۭٔا وَوَجَدَ اللَّهَ عِندَهُ فَوَفَّىٰهُ حِسَابَهُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ

verses.english_text: This is an example of utter darkness in the deep sea which is covered by the waves upon waves, and atop that there are layers of clouds also, that when he raises his hand, he could not see anything due to darkness, for whom Allah does not give light, there is no light for him.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ كَظُلُمَـٰتٍۢ فِى بَحْرٍۢ لُّجِّىٍّۢ يَغْشَىٰهُ مَوْجٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهِ مَوْجٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهِ سَحَابٌۭ ۚ ظُلُمَـٰتٌۢ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ اِذَآ اَخْرَجَ يَدَهُ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرَىٰهَا ۗ وَمَن لَّمْ يَجْعَلِ اللَّهُ لَهُ نُورًا فَمَا لَهُ مِن نُّورٍ

verses.english_text: Did not you see that all the creatures of earth and the sky and all the birds in queue in the atmosphere are glorifying Him, and they are aware of their own prayer and glorifying, and Allah is also Cognizant of deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَن فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَالطَّيْرُ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٍۢ ۖ كُلٌّۭ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُ وَتَسْبِيحَهُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Kingdom of the earth and the sky is only for Allah, and everyone has to return to Him only.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۖ وَاِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: Did not you see that only Allah moves the clouds, then gather them together and make layers, you will see rain coming amidst it, and He rains it in between mountains of snow, then reaches it to whom He pleases and turns it to wherever He pleases, its lightning is so bright that man become near blind.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللَّهَ يُزْجِى سَحَابًۭا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ رُكَامًۭا فَتَرَى الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَـٰلِهِ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مِن جِبَالٍۢ فِيهَا مِنۢ بَرَدٍۢ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَصْرِفُهُ عَن مَّن يَشَآءُ ۖ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِ يَذْهَبُ بِالْاَبْصَـٰرِ

verses.english_text: It is Allah only that flips the day and night, for the people who have insight there is a lesson in it.
verses.arabic_text: يُقَلِّبُ اللَّهُ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّاُو۟لِى الْاَبْصَـٰرِ

verses.english_text: And it is only Allah that has created every walking thing on the earth from water, out of them some of them walk on their bellies and some on two feet and some walk on all four hands and feet, and Allah creates what He pleases, and has Power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةٍۢ مِّن مَّآءٍۢ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰٓ اَرْبَعٍۢ ۚ يَخْلُقُ اللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: Verily We have revealed manifest verses, and Allah guides to the straight path to whoever He pleases.
verses.arabic_text: لَّقَدْ اَنزَلْنَآ اٰيٰتٍۢ مُّبَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ اِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And these people say that they believe in Allah and His Prophet and obeyed them, and then one sect turned away and they are in fact not the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَبِالرَّسُولِ وَاَطَعْنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَ مَآ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And when they are called towards Allah and His Prophet, that they decide between them, but one party gets aside.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا دُعُوٓاْ اِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ اِذَا فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ

verses.english_text: However, if they were persistent on truthhood they would have come with their heads bowed down.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ الْحَقُّ يَاْتُوٓاْ اِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Is there ailment of infidelity in their hearts, or they are doubting, or they are afraid that Allah and His Prophet will be unjust to them, whereas in fact they themselves are unjust.
verses.arabic_text: اَفِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ اَمِ ارْتَابُوٓاْ اَمْ يَخَافُونَ اَن يَحِيفَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُ ۚ بَلْ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الظَّـٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Believers are called towards Allah and His Prophet that if they will judge they will say: we heard and obeyed, in fact these are the people who will get prosperity.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اِذَا دُعُوٓاْ اِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ اَن يَقُولُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَاَطَعْنَا ۚ وَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: And whoever will obey Allah and His Prophet, he will have fear of Allah and will adopt piety, so he will be called the successful.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيَخْشَ اللَّهَ وَيَتَّقْهِ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْفَآئِزُونَ

verses.english_text: And these people have sworn that if you will command, they will come out of their houses, so say: swearing is not necessary, as a general law, obeying is enough, certainly Allah is Cognizant of what you do.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَاَقْسَمُواْ بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ اَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ لَئِنْ اَمَرْتَهُمْ لَيَخْرُجُنَّ ۖ قُل لَّا تُقْسِمُواْ ۖ طَاعَةٌۭ مَّعْرُوفَةٌ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Say: Obey Allah and His Prophet, and if you will deviate from it then responsibility of Prophet is on him and your responsibility on you, if you will obey you will get guidance; Prophet's responsibility is just to clearly preach.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَطِيعُواْ اللَّهَ وَاَطِيعُواْ الرَّسُولَ ۖ فَاِن تَوَلَّوْاْ فَاِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيْكُم مَّا حُمِّلْتُمْ ۖ وَاِن تُطِيعُوهُ تَهْتَدُواْ ۚ وَ مَا عَلَى الرَّسُولِ اِلَّا الْبَلَـٰغُ الْمُبِينُ

verses.english_text: Allah has promised that believers and who do good deeds to make them on the earth His vicegerents as he has made the earlier ones, and to make their religion dominant which he has chosen form them; and will replace their fear with security that they will all only worship Me and will not make anyone My partner, and even after that if anybody become infidel, then only these people are transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ كَمَا اسْتَخْلَفَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِينَهُمُ الَّذِى ارْتَضَىٰ لَهُمْ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ اَمْنًۭا ۚ يَعْبُدُونَنِى لَا يُشْرِكُونَ بِى شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْفَـٰسِقُونَ

verses.english_text: And establish prayer and give poor-rate and obey Prophet, perhaps in this way Allah may have Mercy on you.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَقِيمُواْ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ الزَّكَوٰةَ وَاَطِيعُواْ الرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Beware! Never think that people who adopt infidelity can make Us helpless on the earth, their abode is Hell, and that is the worst recompense.
verses.arabic_text: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مُعْجِزِينَ فِى الْاَرْضِ ۚ وَمَاْوَىٰهُمُ النَّارُ ۖ وَلَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: O Believers! Your slaves and lady-slaves, and children who have not reached puberty, they should ask for your permission to meet you on three occasions: before morning prayer, in the afternoon when you take off cloth for rest and after the Isha prayer. (because) these are three times of privacy for you; apart from this there is no harm for you or them to go around to meet each other, like this, Allah describes His verses clearly and is all Knowing of your affairs and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لِيَسْتَـْٔذِنكُمُ الَّذِينَ مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَـٰنُكُمْ وَ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُواْ الْحُلُمَ مِنكُمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مَرَّٰتٍۢ ۚ مِّن قَبْلِ صَلَوٰةِ الْفَجْرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُم مِّنَ الظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِنۢ بَعْدِ صَلَوٰةِ الْعِشَآءِ ۚ ثَلَـٰثُ عَوْرَٰتٍۢ لَّكُمْ ۚ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا عَلَيْهِمْ جُنَاحٌۢ بَعْدَهُنَّ ۚ طَوَّٰفُونَ عَلَيْكُم بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الْـَٔايَـٰتِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And when your children also attain puberty they should also take permission like this, as earlier people were taking permission. (your) Lord describes His verses clearly that Allah is Knowing and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا بَلَغَ الْاَطْفَـٰلُ مِنكُمُ الْحُلُمَ فَلْيَسْتَـْٔذِنُواْ كَمَا اسْتَـْٔذَنَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ اٰيٰتِهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And due to old age the women who do not have any desire for marriage, there is no harm for them if they discard their outer garments (Hijab), provided they do not wear any makeup and guard their chastity; this is better for them, Allah is all Hearing and all Cognizant.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْقَوَٰعِدُ مِنَ النِّسَآءِ الَّـٰتِى لَا يَرْجُونَ نِكَاحًۭا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ اَن يَضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجَـٰتٍۭ بِزِينَةٍۢ ۖ وَاَن يَسْتَعْفِفْنَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّهُنَّ ۗ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: There is no blame on the people who are blind, lame, sick, and for yourself to eat from your houses, and the houses of your fathers and grandfathers, your maternal-grandfather, etc. or eat from houses of your mothers, paternal-grandmother or maternal-grandmothers, or eat from houses of your brothers, your sisters or your paternal uncles, or from houses oh your paternal-aunts, or maternal-uncles, or maternal-aunts, or from the houses whose keys are with you, or in the houses of your friends; and there is no harm if you eat all together or eat separately; when you enter houses at least give salutation to yourself, this is a pure gift for you from your Lord; and Allah describes His verses clearly like this that you may use your wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: لَّيْسَ عَلَى الْاَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى الْاَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَىٰٓ اَنفُسِكُمْ اَن تَاْكُلُواْ مِنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوتِ ءَابَآئِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوتِ اُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوتِ اِخْوَٰنِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوتِ اَخَوَٰتِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوتِ اَعْمَـٰمِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوتِ عَمَّـٰتِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوتِ اَخْوَٰلِكُمْ اَوْ بُيُوتِ خَـٰلَـٰتِكُمْ اَوْ مَا مَلَكْتُم مَّفَاتِحَهُٓ اَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْ ۚ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ اَن تَاْكُلُواْ جَمِيعًا اَوْ اَشْتَاتًۭا ۚ فَاِذَا دَخَلْتُم بُيُوتًۭا فَسَلِّمُواْ عَلَىٰٓ اَنفُسِكُمْ تَحِيَّةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ مُبَـٰرَكَةًۭ طَيِّبَةًۭ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Believers are only those who believe on Allah and His Prophet, and those who are engaged in the community work should not go anywhere unless they take permission, and those who take permission from you have belief on Allah and His Prophet, if they seek permission from you, give permission to whomever you wish; and also seek forgiveness for them from Allah, Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَاِذَا كَانُواْ مَعَهُ عَلَىٰٓ اَمْرٍۢ جَامِعٍۢ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُوهُ ۚ اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُونَكَ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ۚ فَاِذَا اسْتَـْٔذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَاْنِهِمْ فَاْذَن لِّمَن شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ اللَّهَ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: O Muslims! Beware, don't call upon the Prophet as you people call upon others among yourselves; Allah knows them very well who sneak away silently (from congregation), so whoever opposes command of Allah should be afraid of this matter, that any affliction catches them or painful punishment comes upon them.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا تَجْعَلُواْ دُعَآءَ الرَّسُولِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَآءِ بَعْضِكُم بَعْضًۭا ۚ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمْ لِوَاذًۭا ۚ فَلْيَحْذَرِ الَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنْ اَمْرِهِٓ اَن تُصِيبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ اَوْ يُصِيبَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: And, remember all the universe of the sky and earth is His, and is cognizant of your condition, and that day when everyone will be returned to His Court, He will tell them about their deeds, and He is Knower of all things.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَآ اِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۖ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَآ اَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَيَوْمَ يُرْجَعُونَ اِلَيْهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُواْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۢ

verses.english_text: Blessed is that Allah, who has sent The Criterion on His servants, that he becomes the warner for the world from the punishment of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِى نَزَّلَ الْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ نَذِيرًا

verses.english_text: All the Kingdom of the sky and the earth is His, He does not have any son, nor does he have any partner in His Kingdom, He has created everything and has made everything perfectly in size.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِى لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًۭا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ شَرِيكٌۭ فِى الْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ فَقَدَّرَهُ تَقْدِيرًا

verses.english_text: And they have made gods leaving Allah, who have not created anything but they themselves have been created, and they are not able to cause any loss or benefit even to themselves, and neither they control death nor resurrection.
verses.arabic_text: وَاتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِاَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا نَفْعًۭا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًۭا وَلَا حَيَوٰةًۭ وَلَا نُشُورًا

verses.english_text: These infidels say that this Quran is a lie, which he has fabricated, and another nation has helped him in this matter, whereas they themselves have done unjust and forged.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ اِنْ هَـٰذَآ اِلَّآ اِفْكٌ افْتَرَىٰهُ وَاَعَانَهُ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ ءَاخَرُونَ ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءُو ظُلْمًۭا وَزُورًا

verses.english_text: These people say: these are the tales of the earlier people - which he has got them written and that he recites to them morning and evening.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالُوٓاْ اَسَـٰطِيرُ الْاَوَّلِينَ اكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِىَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةًۭ وَاَصِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Say: Quran is revealed by Who is aware of the secrets of skies and the earth, and indeed He is very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَنزَلَهُ الَّذِى يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: And these people say: what has happened to Prophet who eats and goes about in market also, and why no angel was sent for him, which may prove as warner of the punishment of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ مَالِ هَـٰذَا الرَّسُولِ يَاْكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِى فِى الْاَسْوَاقِ ۙ لَوْلَآ اُنزِلَ اِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌۭ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُ نَذِيرًا

verses.english_text: Or some treasure should have been dropped on him, or he should have some garden from which could eat, then these unjust say that you are obeying a magician.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ يُلْقَىٰٓ اِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ اَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُ جَنَّةٌۭ يَاْكُلُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَقَالَ الظَّـٰلِمُونَ اِن تَتَّبِعُونَ اِلَّا رَجُلًۭا مَّسْحُورًا

verses.english_text: See how people have said examples for you, they have gone astray, now they cannot get the (right) way.
verses.arabic_text: انظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُواْ لَكَ الْاَمْثَـٰلَ فَضَلُّواْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Blessed is He, Who, if pleases could provide for you much better material than this, and provide you such Paradise beneath which rivers will be flowing, then could make large palaces for you (people).
verses.arabic_text: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِىٓ اِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًۢا

verses.english_text: Reality is that they have denied the Day of Judgement, and We have provided Hell for the deniers of the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ كَذَّبُواْ بِالسَّاعَةِ ۖ وَاَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا

verses.english_text: When the Hellfire will see them from afar then they will hear the rumbling and vehement roaring sounds.
verses.arabic_text: اِذَا رَاَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ سَمِعُواْ لَهَا تَغَيُّظًۭا وَزَفِيرًا

verses.english_text: And when they would be tied up in the chains and thrown in a strait place then they will ask for death.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَآ اُلْقُواْ مِنْهَا مَكَانًۭا ضَيِّقًۭا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْاْ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا

verses.english_text: Then it will be said to them: don't call out one death but call out too many deaths.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا تَدْعُواْ الْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَٰحِدًۭا وَادْعُواْ ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Ask them: punishment is better or everlasting Paradise? For which pious people have been promised, and that is their reward and their abode.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ اَمْ جَنَّةُ الْخُلْدِ الَّتِى وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَمَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: Every material of their desire is available there and they are going to abide there forever, this is an imperative promise on their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَـٰلِدِينَ ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًۭا مَّسْـُٔولًۭا

verses.english_text: The day when He shall gather them and those at one place whom they had called besides Allah, and shall ask them whether you misguided my servants or they went astray by their own?
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَاَنتُمْ اَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِى هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ اَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّواْ السَّبِيلَ

verses.english_text: So they will all say: Glory to You; You are Self-Sufficient; who has given us the authority to make guardian of anybody else except You? Fact is that they became negligent of Your remembrance because of honor You gave to them and their elders in the world; for these people were going to be destroyed.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِى لَنَآ اَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ اَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَـٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُواْ الذِّكْرَ وَكَانُواْ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا

verses.english_text: Did you see, they are denying you also whom you had made your gods, now you neither can avert the punishment nor you can help yourself; and whoever will be unjust We will make them taste the severe punishment.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًۭا وَلَا نَصْرًا ۚ وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًۭا كَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: And before you also, the prophets We had sent, they were also eating food and went about in the market; and We have made some of you trial for others; and O Muslims! Can you be patience, whereas your Lord is Master of Great Insight.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ اِلَّآ اِنَّهُمْ لَيَاْكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى الْاَسْوَاقِ ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍۢ فِتْنَةً اَتَصْبِرُونَ ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: And those who do not hope to meet Us, they say: why not the angels come to us or why we cannot see Allah, in fact they have become very haughty, and they are doing the revolt of highest degree.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ اُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ اَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ اسْتَكْبَرُواْ فِىٓ اَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّۭا كَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: The day they will see angels, then there won't be any good news for the guilty ones, and angels will say: get away.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا

verses.english_text: Then We will turn to their deeds; and will make them all like flying particles of dust.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَدِمْنَآ اِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُواْ مِنْ عَمَلٍۢ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هَبَآءًۭ مَّنثُورًا

verses.english_text: That day only the people of Paradise will be there for whom will be best abode for resting.
verses.arabic_text: اَصْحَـٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌۭ مُّسْتَقَرًّۭا وَاَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: That day the sky will burst apart because of clouds, and angels will come in groups (after groups).
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَآءُ بِالْغَمَـٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا

verses.english_text: That day the kingdom will be in the hands of the Lord, and that day will be very severe for the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: الْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى الْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًا

verses.english_text: That day unjust will cut their hand and say: Alas! I would have taken the path with the prophet.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى اتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ الرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Oh Alas! I would not have made that man a friend.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ اَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: He misguided me even after the revelation of the verses, and Satan always brings disgrace to human beings.
verses.arabic_text: لَّقَدْ اَضَلَّنِى عَنِ الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ اِذْ جَآءَنِى ۗ وَكَانَ الشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِلْاِنسَـٰنِ خَذُولًۭا

verses.english_text: That day the prophet will call out: O Lord! my people have neglected this Quran.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَـٰرَبِّ اِنَّ قَوْمِى اتَّخَذُواْ هَـٰذَا الْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًا

verses.english_text: And like this We have made some enemies of every prophet among the guilty ones; and for your guidance and help your Lord is Sufficient.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّۭا مِّنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًۭا وَنَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: And infidels also say this that why this Quran has not been revealed on them all at once, but We reveal it gradually so we can strengthen your hearts, and We have revealed it slowly.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَـٰهُ تَرْتِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: They will not bring any example, but in their reply, We will describe the truth and better talk.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا يَاْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ اِلَّا جِئْنَـٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَاَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا

verses.english_text: Those who will be brought to Hell dragging on their face, their abode is the worst, and they are strayed to a great extent.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ اِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَاَضَلُّ سَبِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And We gave Moosa the book and made his brother his minister with him.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُٓ اَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًا

verses.english_text: Then We said both of you go towards the nation who are denying our verses, and We have destroyed them.
verses.arabic_text: فَقُلْنَا اذْهَبَآ اِلَى الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا

verses.english_text: And to the people of Nooh also when they denied the messengers, then We drown them also and made them a sign for the people, and We have prepared very painful punishment for unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُواْ الرُّسُلَ اَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَاَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا اَلِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: And We have also destroyed nations of Aad and Samood and companion of Rass and many people between them.
verses.arabic_text: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَاْ وَاَصْحَـٰبَ الرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا

verses.english_text: And We explained examples for all of them, and We destroyed them all.
verses.arabic_text: وَكُلًّۭا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ الْاَمْثَـٰلَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا

verses.english_text: And they came towards the town on which We have rained the stones, so did not they saw them, fact is that they do not believe in the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَتَوْاْ عَلَى الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِىٓ اُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ السَّوْءِ ۚ اَفَلَمْ يَكُونُواْ يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُواْ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا

verses.english_text: And when they see you, they want to make fun of you that is the person whom Allah has sent as a prophet?
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا رَاَوْكَ اِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ اِلَّا هُزُوًا اَهَـٰذَا الَّذِى بَعَثَ اللَّهُ رَسُولًا

verses.english_text: He has nearly deviated us from our gods, had We not been constant with them; "shortly they would know when they will see the punishment, that who has gone more astray".
verses.arabic_text: اِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ اَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَ مَنْ اَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

verses.english_text: Did you see the person who has made his desires, his god? Are you ready to take his responsibility also?
verses.arabic_text: اَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ اِلَـٰهَهُ هَوَىٰهُ اَفَاَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا

verses.english_text: Do you think the majority of them listen and understand, no, never, they are like animals, and they are straying further off the path.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ تَحْسَبُ اَنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ اَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ اِنْ هُمْ اِلَّا كَالْاَنْعَـٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ اَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

verses.english_text: Didn't you see that how your Lord spread the shadow, if He pleased, He could have made it stagnant at one place, then We made sun its argument.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ وَ لَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُ سَاكِنًۭا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا الشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Then We pulled it slowly towards Us.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَـٰهُ اِلَيْنَا قَبْضًۭا يَسِيرًا

verses.english_text: And that Allah Who made night your veil and made sleep for your rest, and made day time for standing you up.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا وَالنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًۭا وَجَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُورًا

verses.english_text: And that is He Who sent wind with glad tidings of Mercy, and We rain pure water from the skies.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِىٓ اَرْسَلَ الرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ وَاَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ طَهُورًا

verses.english_text: Through this make the dead city come to life again, and out of our creatures quench the thirst of humans and the animal.
verses.arabic_text: لِّنُحْـِۧىَ بِهِ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا وَنُسْقِيَهُ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ اَنْعَـٰمًۭا وَاَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًا

verses.english_text: And We divided the water differently among them so that they take admonition from this, but most men denied and accept nothing but disbelief or ingratitude.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَـٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُواْ فَاَبَىٰٓ اَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ اِلَّا كُفُورًا

verses.english_text: We could have sent a warner in every town if we please.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍۢ نَّذِيرًا

verses.english_text: So do not listen to infidels, and struggle hard with them till the last minute.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَجَـٰهِدْهُم بِهِ جِهَادًۭا كَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: And that is Allah who has flown both the rivers whose water is tasty and sweet, and salty and bitter, and between the inviolable obstruction is made.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَهُوَ الَّذِى مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌۭ فُرَاتٌۭ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ اُجَاجٌۭ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًۭا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا

verses.english_text: And that is He, Who created man from water, made his family and in-laws, and your Lord is the owner of Great Power.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ الْمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُ نَسَبًۭا وَصِهْرًا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا

verses.english_text: And these people worship those besides Allah, who neither can benefit them nor can cause any loss, and infidels always support [those who are] against the Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ الْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِ ظَهِيرًا

verses.english_text: We have only sent you as a giver of glad tidings and as a warner.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا

verses.english_text: Say: I do not want any recompense from you people, but whoever wants he can adopt the path of their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ مَآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ اِلَّا مَن شَآءَ اَن يَتَّخِذَ اِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And believe in Allah, the Truth and Self-Existing One who is not going to die, and continue glorifying Him; and He is sufficient (as witness) for the sins of His servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْحَىِّ الَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: He created the skies and the earth and all the creatures which are in between them within six days, then He established the Throne of His Kingdom, He is Beneficent and ask Him, Who knows about His creatures.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِى خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۚ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِ خَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: And when they are asked to prostrate before Beneficent Allah, they ask what is that Beneficent that we prostrate about whom you are commanding, like this their hatred increases.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اسْجُدُواْ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ قَالُواْ وَ مَا الرَّحْمَـٰنُ اَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَاْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا ۩

verses.english_text: {Prostrate Non-Obligatory} Blessed is He, who made a constellation in the sky and made a Lamp and bright Moon in it.
verses.arabic_text: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى السَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًۭا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا

verses.english_text: And that is He, Who made day and night to follow each other, for the man who wishes to take lessons or wishes to thank his Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِى جَعَلَ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةًۭ لِّمَنْ اَرَادَ اَن يَذَّكَّرَ اَوْ اَرَادَ شُكُورًا

verses.english_text: Servants of Allah are those who walk slowly on earth, and when ignorant speak to them they give a message of peace.
verses.arabic_text: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْاَرْضِ هَوْنًۭا وَاِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجَـٰهِلُونَ قَالُواْ سَلَـٰمًۭا

verses.english_text: These people spend their night while prostrating or standing in the Court of their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًۭا وَقِيَـٰمًۭا

verses.english_text: And they say: O Lord! Avert the punishment of Hell from us because it is very severe and everlasting.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ اِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا

verses.english_text: That is the worst place and abode.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا

verses.english_text: These people when they spend, they neither over spend nor with stinginess, but take a middle way out of it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ اِذَآ اَنفَقُواْ لَمْ يُسْرِفُواْ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُواْ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًۭا

verses.english_text: And they do not call upon another god with Allah, and do not unjustly kill any soul whom Allah has forbidden, and they do not commit fornication, who will do such an act shall bear the punishment for the same.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ اِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِى حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ اَثَامًۭا

verses.english_text: Which will be doubled on the Day of Judgement, and they shall remain in it with disgrace forever.
verses.arabic_text: يُضَـٰعَفْ لَهُ الْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِ مُهَانًا

verses.english_text: Except for those who repent and believe and do good deeds also, Allah will change his bad deeds with good deeds, and Allah is very Forgiving.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًۭا صَـٰلِحًۭا فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَـٰتٍۢ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: And he who will repent and do good works and will really turn towards Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا فَاِنَّهُ يَتُوبُ اِلَى اللَّهِ مَتَابًۭا

verses.english_text: And they do not go near lie and deception, and when they come across the useless work, they pass by in a sensible manner.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ وَاِذَا مَرُّواْ بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّواْ كِرَامًۭا

verses.english_text: And when they are reminded of the verses of Allah they do not fall as deaf and blind.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّواْ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّۭا وَعُمْيَانًۭا

verses.english_text: And they continuously pray that, O Lord! give coolness in our eyes from our wives and children and make us the leader of the pious ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ اَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ اَعْيُنٍۢ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ اِمَامًا

verses.english_text: These are the people who will be granted the high places in the Paradise for their patience, and there they shall be offered greetings and salutations.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةًۭ وَسَلَـٰمًا

verses.english_text: They will abide there forever because that is the best abode and most beautiful place of residence.
verses.arabic_text: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Say: My Lord would not have turned to you if it was not for your prayers, you have denied His prophet, then shortly you would have to bear the punishment for that.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُاْ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا

verses.english_text: Ta Seen Meem.
verses.arabic_text: طسٓمٓ

verses.english_text: These are the verses of the manifest Book (Quran).
verses.arabic_text: تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ الْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِينِ

verses.english_text: Will you put your soul in danger that these people are not believing?
verses.arabic_text: لَعَلَّكَ بَـٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ اَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: If We pleased, we would have send a verse from the sky that their necks would have bend by humbleness.
verses.arabic_text: اِن نَّشَاْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ اَعْنَـٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَـٰضِعِينَ

verses.english_text: But whenever any new verse comes from the Beneficent Allah, they object to it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يَاْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ اِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ

verses.english_text: Indeed, they denied; shortly the news will come to them that they had been mocking at.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَاْتِيهِمْ اَنۢبَـٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

verses.english_text: Did not they see towards the earth that how beautiful things We have grown.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ كَمْ اَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ

verses.english_text: There is Our sign in it, but majority of them is not going to believe.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And your Lord is Honorable and have Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: And remember the time when your Lord called out to Moosa saying: go to that unjust nation.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ اَنِ ائْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: This is the nation of Firaun, will not they become pious?
verses.arabic_text: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ اَلَا يَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: O my Lord, I fear that they may not deny me.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّىٓ اَخَافُ اَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

verses.english_text: My heart is becoming strait, my tongue is not fluent, send Haroon with this message.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَاَرْسِلْ اِلَىٰ هَـٰرُونَ

verses.english_text: There is a crime on me from them, I am afraid that they may not kill me.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَاَخَافُ اَن يَقْتُلُونِ

verses.english_text: Allah said: Never, both of you take Our signs and go, and We are also listening with you everything.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَاذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۖ اِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ

verses.english_text: Go to Firaun and say: we both have been sent by the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.arabic_text: فَاْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ اِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Send Bani Israel with us.
verses.arabic_text: اَنْ اَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

verses.english_text: He said: did not I brought you up and have not you spent some years of your life among us.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًۭا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And you did what you did, are not you among the grateful.
verses.arabic_text: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَاَنتَ مِنَ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: when I killed, I was negligent of killing.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ اِذًۭا وَاَنَا۠ مِنَ الضَّآلِّينَ

verses.english_text: Then out of fear I went aside from you, now my Lord has sent me, He has made me among His messengers.
verses.arabic_text: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًۭا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: Favor that you are reminding for my upbringing, you did bad that you took Bani Israel as slaves.
verses.arabic_text: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ اَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

verses.english_text: Firaun said: what is this Lord of the Worlds?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَ مَا رَبُّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: He is the Lord of the skies and the earth and whatever is in between them, if you can believe.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ اِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Firaun said to his companions: are you listening something?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُٓ اَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: He is your Lord and also the Lord of your fathers.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: Firaun said: this messenger which has been sent among you is mad.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ الَّذِىٓ اُرْسِلَ اِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: He is the Lord of East and the West and whatever is in between them, if you have wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ اِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Firaun said: if you accept any other god than me, then I will send you among prisoners.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذْتَ اِلَـٰهًا غَيْرِى لَاَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُونِينَ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: even if I show you manifest signs?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَوَ لَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Firaun said: what is the argument, if you are truthful, present it.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَاْتِ بِهِٓ اِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Moosa put down his staff on the ground and it turned into a serpent and started moving.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And when he took out his hand it appeared white and bright.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَاِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Firaun told his companions: he seems to be an expert magician.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لِلْمَلَاِ حَوْلَهُٓ اِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَـٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: His aim is to drive you out of your land on the strength of his magic, now what is your opinion?
verses.arabic_text: يُرِيدُ اَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ اَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِ فَمَاذَا تَاْمُرُونَ

verses.english_text: They said to stop him and his brother and send someone to gather the magicians from the city.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ اَرْجِهْ وَاَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِى الْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ

verses.english_text: They brought the expert magicians.
verses.arabic_text: يَاْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And at the appointed time all magicians came together.
verses.arabic_text: فَجُمِعَ السَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ

verses.english_text: And they said: will you gather together on this issue?
verses.arabic_text: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ اَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ

verses.english_text: We may follow the magicians, perhaps we may dominate.
verses.arabic_text: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ اِن كَانُواْ هُمُ الْغَـٰلِبِينَ

verses.english_text: When they got together, they asked Firaun: what will be our reward if we are victorious?
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُواْ لِفِرْعَوْنَ اَئِنَّ لَنَا لَاَجْرًا اِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغَـٰلِبِينَ

verses.english_text: Firaun said: Verily you will be counted among my close ones.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَاِنَّكُمْ اِذًۭا لَّمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ

verses.english_text: Moosa said to them: whatever you wish to throw, throw.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ اَلْقُواْ مَآ اَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ

verses.english_text: So they threw ropes and sticks and said: by the honor and glory of Firaun we are going to be victorious.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَلْقَوْاْ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَ قَالُواْ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْغَـٰلِبُونَ

verses.english_text: Then Moosa also threw his staff, then suddenly they saw it is swallowing all the magic.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَاْفِكُونَ

verses.english_text: After seeing this all the magicians fell in prostration.
verses.arabic_text: فَاُلْقِىَ السَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ

verses.english_text: And they said we believe in the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Lord of Moosa and Haroon.
verses.arabic_text: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ

verses.english_text: Firaun said: you believed before I gave you permission, he is greater magician than you who has taught you the magic; I will cut your hand and leg from opposite sides and will hang you on the gallows.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ اَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ اِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ الَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيْدِيَكُمْ وَاَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍۢ وَلَاُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: They said, no problem, we shall all return and reach to our Lord.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ اِنَّآ اِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ

verses.english_text: We only wish that our Lord may forgive our sins, that we are the first among those who believed.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا نَطْمَعُ اَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ اَن كُنَّآ اَوَّلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: We revealed to Moosa: take my servants and leave in the night that you will be pursued.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَاَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ اَنْ اَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ اِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

verses.english_text: Then Firaun sent men to gather the armies from the different cities.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى الْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ

verses.english_text: That these few people are a party.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌۭ قَلِيلُونَ

verses.english_text: And they have enraged us.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ

verses.english_text: And we are with all ready with our equipment.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَـٰذِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Resultant We drove them out of gardens and rivers.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَخْرَجْنَـٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ

verses.english_text: From treasures and honourable places also.
verses.arabic_text: وَكُنُوزٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And We punish like this, and We made Bani Israel to inherit the land.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ وَاَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا بَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

verses.english_text: And they pursued Moosa and his people early in the morning.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ

verses.english_text: When both could see each other, people of Moosa said: now Verily we will be overtaken.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا الْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ اَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ اِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: never, our Lord is with us, He will guide us.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ اِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ

verses.english_text: Then We revealed to Moosa: strike the river with your staff, and river cracked up and every part seems like a mountain.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ اَنِ اضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ ۖ فَانفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ

verses.english_text: And We made nearer also to the second party.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ الْـَٔاخَرِينَ

verses.english_text: And We delivered Moosa and all his companions.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُٓ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: Rest of them were drowned.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَغْرَقْنَا الْـَٔاخَرِينَ

verses.english_text: There is also Our sign in it, and majority among Bani Israel were not going to believe.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And your Lord is Honorable and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: And recite Ibrahim's news to them.
verses.arabic_text: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَاَ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ

verses.english_text: When he told his father (who brought him up) and the people, whose worship you are doing?
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

verses.english_text: They said we are worshipping the idols and we are their keepers.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ نَعْبُدُ اَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ

verses.english_text: Ibrahim asked: when you call them, do they listen to you?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ اِذْ تَدْعُونَ

verses.english_text: Do they give you any benefit or any harm?
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ اَوْ يَضُرُّونَ

verses.english_text: They said: we have seen our forefathers do this.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Do you know whom you worship.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ

verses.english_text: You and your elders of the clan.
verses.arabic_text: اَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ الْاَقْدَمُونَ

verses.english_text: They are all my enemies except Lord of the Worlds.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّىٓ اِلَّا رَبَّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Who created me and then He guides me.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ

verses.english_text: He gives food and He gives water.
verses.arabic_text: وَالَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ

verses.english_text: When I fell sick, he cures me.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ

verses.english_text: He gives death then He gives life.
verses.arabic_text: وَالَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ

verses.english_text: And it is hoped from Him that He will forgive our sins on the Day of Accounting.
verses.arabic_text: وَالَّذِىٓ اَطْمَعُ اَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ الدِّينِ

verses.english_text: O Lord, give me knowledge and wisdom and count me among the righteous ones.
verses.arabic_text: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَاَلْحِقْنِى بِالصَّـٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: And ordain good tongue, and good mention in my forthcoming progeny.
verses.arabic_text: وَاجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى الْـَٔاخِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Count me among the inheritors of the Paradise.
verses.arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ

verses.english_text: And forgive my father, who brought me up, he is among the misguided ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَاغْفِرْ لِاَبِىٓ اِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّآلِّينَ

verses.english_text: Do not disgrace me when everyone will be raised from their graves.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ

verses.english_text: The day when mother and children would not be of any help (to you).
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ

verses.english_text: Only if he is present in the Court of Allah with pure heart.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا مَنْ اَتَى اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: The day when Paradise will be made nearer to the pious ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَاُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

verses.english_text: And Hell will be placed before the misguided ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ

verses.english_text: And it will be said to the Hellish People where are those whom you used to worship?
verses.arabic_text: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ اَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ

verses.english_text: Besides Allah, will they help you or will they help themselves?
verses.arabic_text: مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ اَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then they all with the misguided ones will be thrown in to Hell, with their faces down.
verses.arabic_text: فَكُبْكِبُواْ فِيهَا هُمْ وَالْغَاوُنَ

verses.english_text: And all the soldiers of Iblis.
verses.arabic_text: وَجُنُودُ اِبْلِيسَ اَجْمَعُونَ

verses.english_text: They will all be quarrelling in the Hell and say:
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ

verses.english_text: By god we were in manifest misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: تَاللَّهِ اِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

verses.english_text: When they were paralleling you with the Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Nobody misguided us except the guilty ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَضَلَّنَآ اِلَّا الْمُجْرِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Now there is no one who can do intercession for us.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ

verses.english_text: And neither any friend.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Oh, Alas! If we could return, we will become believers.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَوْ اَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةًۭ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Therein is one of our signs, whereas majority of them were not the believers.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And your lord is Predominant on all and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: And people of Nooh also denied the messengers.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: When his brother Nooh said: why you do not adopt piety?
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: I am a trustworthy messenger of Lord for you.
verses.arabic_text: اِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ اَمِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: So fear Allah, and obey me.
verses.arabic_text: فَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ وَاَطِيعُونِ

verses.english_text: And I do not want any recompense of this preaching, my reward is with the Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ ۖ اِنْ اَجْرِىَ اِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: So you fear Allah, and obey me.
verses.arabic_text: فَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ وَاَطِيعُونِ

verses.english_text: They said, how can we believe in you when all your followers are lowest class of people.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قَالُوٓاْ اَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَاتَّبَعَكَ الْاَرْذَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Nooh said: what do I know what they do?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ وَ مَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Their account is with my Lord, if you have wisdom of this.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ اِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And I am not going to drive away the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: I am only a manifest warner from the punishment of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ اَنَا۠ اِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: They said: Nooh! If you do not desist from this talk, we will stone you.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُومِينَ

verses.english_text: Upon hearing this Nooh complaint, O Lord! my nation has denied me.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ

verses.english_text: Now judge openly between me and them, and deliver me and my believing companions.
verses.arabic_text: فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We delivered him and his companions in a laden Ark.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُ فِى الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ

verses.english_text: Thereafter, drowned all of them.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ الْبَاقِينَ

verses.english_text: Verily, in it also there is Our sign; and their majority were not going to believe.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And your Lord is only Predominant on all and is Merciful (too).
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: And nation of Aad also have denied the messengers.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: When their brother Hood said why you don't develop the fear Allah?
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
verses.arabic_text: اِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ اَمِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: So fear Allah, and obey me.
verses.arabic_text: فَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ وَاَطِيعُونِ

verses.english_text: I do not want any reward from you for preaching, my recompense is with the Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ ۖ اِنْ اَجْرِىَ اِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Do you make the memorial at high place for play?
verses.arabic_text: اَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةًۭ تَعْبَثُونَ

verses.english_text: And you are making big palaces thinking that perhaps you will remain in this world forever.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ

verses.english_text: And when you attack you attack with tyranny.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ

verses.english_text: Now, fear Allah, and obey me.
verses.arabic_text: فَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ وَاَطِيعُونِ

verses.english_text: And develop His fear, Who has assisted you with everything, which you know very well.
verses.arabic_text: وَاتَّقُواْ الَّذِىٓ اَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: (He) helped you with animals and with (your) children.
verses.arabic_text: اَمَدَّكُم بِاَنْعَـٰمٍۢ وَبَنِينَ

verses.english_text: And did help from gardens and rivers.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ

verses.english_text: I am fearful for you, for a big day of severe punishment.
verses.arabic_text: اِنِّىٓ اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: They said: it is the same for us whether you do admonition or you are not counted among those who admonished.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ اَوَعَظْتَ اَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ الْوَٰعِظِينَ

verses.english_text: This fear and warning is the work of earlier people.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ هَـٰذَآ اِلَّا خُلُقُ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: Punishment is not going to come on us.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

verses.english_text: Then nation denied and We destroyed them, in it there is one of Our signs, and majority of them were not the believers.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَاَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And your Lord is Predominant and also Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: And nation of Samood also denied the prophets.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: When his brother Saleh said: why don't you fear Allah?
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
verses.arabic_text: اِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ اَمِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.arabic_text: فَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ وَاَطِيعُونِ

verses.english_text: I do not want any reward from you for this work, my recompense is with the Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ ۖ اِنْ اَجْرِىَ اِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Will you be left in favors and rest (forever)?
verses.arabic_text: اَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ

verses.english_text: In these gardens and rivers?
verses.arabic_text: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ

verses.english_text: In these fields and amid the trees of palms, whose buds are soft and fragile?
verses.arabic_text: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَنَخْلٍۢ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And these houses which you are making by carving out the mountains for your rest.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًۭا فَـٰرِهِينَ

verses.english_text: It will never happen, so fear Allah, and obey me.
verses.arabic_text: فَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ وَاَطِيعُونِ

verses.english_text: And do not follow who do the excesses.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓاْ اَمْرَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ

verses.english_text: Who create mischief in the land and do not amend.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: you had been cast a magic spell upon you, and that's it.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ اِنَّمَآ اَنتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ

verses.english_text: You are a human being like us, so if you are truthful then bring some sign or miracle.
verses.arabic_text: مَآ اَنتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا فَاْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ اِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Saleh said: this is a she-camel, one day's water is for her and one appointed day's water is for you.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِ نَاقَةٌۭ لَّهَا شِرْبٌۭ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ

verses.english_text: And beware, do not harm her, otherwise the punishment of severe day will afflict you.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ فَيَاْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then they cut her feet and later were ashamed.
verses.arabic_text: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَاَصْبَحُواْ نَـٰدِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And punishment afflicted them, and Verily there is our sign in it, and most of them were not going to believe.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ ۗ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And your Lord is Predominant on everyone and also very Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: And nation of Lut also denied the messengers.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: When his brother Lut said: why you do not fear Allah?
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
verses.arabic_text: اِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ اَمِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: Fear Allah, and obey me.
verses.arabic_text: فَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ وَاَطِيعُونِ

verses.english_text: And I do not want any recompense from you for this, my reward is with my Allah, who is the Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ ۖ اِنْ اَجْرِىَ اِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ
