verses.english_text: Do you cohabit with men in the whole world.
verses.arabic_text: اَتَاْتُونَ الذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And leave those wives whom your Lord has created for you, indeed you do very excesses.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ اَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ اَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: Lut, if you do not stop preaching, they you will be expel from the town.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِينَ

verses.english_text: Lut said: after all I abhor your act.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنِّى لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ الْقَالِينَ

verses.english_text: O my Lord! secure me and my family from the punishment of this act.
verses.arabic_text: رَبِّ نَجِّنِى وَاَهْلِى مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: So, We delivered him and his family.
verses.arabic_text: فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَاَهْلَهُٓ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: Except that old lady who stayed behind.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا عَجُوزًۭا فِى الْغَـٰبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We destroyed them all.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْـَٔاخَرِينَ

verses.english_text: And strongly rained stones on them, this is the worst rain for the people who are warned.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنذَرِينَ

verses.english_text: And in this also there is Our sign, and majority of them were not the believers.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And your Lord is most Mighty and most Merciful also.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: And people of forest also denied the messengers.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبَ اَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: When Shoaib told them: why you do not fear Allah?
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
verses.arabic_text: اِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ اَمِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: So, fear Allah, and obey me.
verses.arabic_text: فَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ وَاَطِيعُونِ

verses.english_text: I do not want any recompense from you for this, my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ ۖ اِنْ اَجْرِىَ اِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And see, keep the measurement proper, and do not be those who give less to the people.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اَوْفُواْ الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُواْ مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Weight should be proper, and on the true scale.
verses.arabic_text: وَزِنُواْ بِالْقِسْطَاسِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ

verses.english_text: And do not give less (in measurement) to the people, and do not create mischief on the earth.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَبْخَسُواْ النَّاسَ اَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْاْ فِى الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ

verses.english_text: And fear that Lord who has created you and the people before you.
verses.arabic_text: وَاتَّقُواْ الَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَالْجِبِلَّةَ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: They said: you seem to be person who has been cast a spell upon him.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ اِنَّمَآ اَنتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ

verses.english_text: And you are a human being like us, and you seem to be a liar to us.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَنتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَاِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكَـٰذِبِينَ

verses.english_text: And if you are truthful then bring a piece upon us from the sky.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: He said: my Lord is well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: When they denied, they were afflicted by punishment on the day of shadow, and it was a punishment of a severe day.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَاَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

verses.english_text: Verily, there is a sign in this only, and majority of them were not going to believe.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: You Lord is very Honorable and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: This Quran has been revealed from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّهُ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: This was revealed through trustworthy Gabriel.
verses.arabic_text: نَزَلَ بِهِ الرُّوحُ الْاَمِينُ

verses.english_text: This is revealed on your chest that you warn the people of punishment of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُنذِرِينَ

verses.english_text: This is in manifest Arabic language.
verses.arabic_text: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: It is mentioned in the previous books also.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّهُ لَفِى زُبُرِ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: Is this the sign is not enough that scholars of Bani Israel know it.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً اَن يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُاْ بَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

verses.english_text: If we had revealed on a non-Arab.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ نَزَّلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ الْاَعْجَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And he would have recited, then they would not have believed.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَرَاَهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And like this (as if) we made a way, to the hearts for denial for the guilty ones?
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَـٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: That they are not going to believe unless they see the painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ الْعَذَابَ الْاَلِيمَ

verses.english_text: That punishment may fell upon them suddenly and they could not comprehend.
verses.arabic_text: فَيَاْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then they will say: can we be given respite?
verses.arabic_text: فَيَقُولُواْ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Are they hastening in Our punishment?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Don't you know We have given the respite for some years.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَرَءَيْتَ اِن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ سِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Then the punishment will come which they are promised.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ

verses.english_text: Then the enjoyment given to them will not be of any use to them.
verses.arabic_text: مَآ اَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ

verses.english_text: We did not destroy any town until We sent a warner to them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ اِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ

verses.english_text: This was a reminder and we never do unjust.
verses.arabic_text: ذِكْرَىٰ وَ مَا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And this Quran was not brought by the Satans.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ الشَّيَـٰطِينُ

verses.english_text: This is not suitable for them and they do not have any power of this.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَ مَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

verses.english_text: They are even deprived of hearing revelation.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ

verses.english_text: So do not call anyone god with Allah, otherwise you will be afflicted with punishment.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ اِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Warn your near relatives.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الْاَقْرَبِينَ

verses.english_text: Put down your shoulders for the believers who obey you.
verses.arabic_text: وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Later if they disobey, say: you are free from their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ اِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: And trust in the Mighty and Merciful Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ

verses.english_text: Who sees you when you are standing.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

verses.english_text: Then He sees you mingling with the people who prostrate themselves before Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى السَّـٰجِدِينَ

verses.english_text: He is all Hearing and all Seeing.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: Shall We tell you, on whom Satans come?
verses.arabic_text: هَلْ اُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيَـٰطِينُ

verses.english_text: They come on all liars and bad doers.
verses.arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ اَفَّاكٍ اَثِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Who tries to hear the angels talk, and most of among them are liars.
verses.arabic_text: يُلْقُونَ السَّمْعَ وَاَكْثَرُهُمْ كَـٰذِبُونَ

verses.english_text: Misguided people follow the poets.
verses.arabic_text: وَالشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغَاوُنَ

verses.english_text: Don’t you see that they roam in every valley of thought.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍۢ يَهِيمُونَ

verses.english_text: And whatever they say, do not follow.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Except those poets who are believers and did good works; and recite the name of Allah aplenty, and took revenge after tolerating the unjust, and shortly unjust will know where they are going to be returned.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَذَكَرُواْ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَانتَصَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ اَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍۢ يَنقَلِبُونَ

verses.english_text: Ta Seen, This is Quran and its manifest verses.
verses.arabic_text: طسٓ ۚ تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ الْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

verses.english_text: This is admonition and glad tidings for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: هُدًۭى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Who keep up prayers, give poor-rate and believe on the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِالْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, those who do not believe on the Day of Judgement, We have decorated their deeds and they are roaming in those deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْـَٔاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ اَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

verses.english_text: For them is the worst punishment, and they are losers on the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ الْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمُ الْاَخْسَرُونَ

verses.english_text: This Quran is being given to you from Knowing and Wise Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى الْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ

verses.english_text: Remember the time when Moosa said to his family: I have seen a fire and shortly I will bring the news of its way or bring an ember of it so that you can warm yourselves up.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِاَهْلِهِٓ اِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ اَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍۢ قَبَسٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ

verses.english_text: When he came near the Fire, a sound came, blessed is the Lord who shows his miracle inside and around the fire, and Glory be to Allah who is nourisher of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِىَ اَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِى النَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَـٰنَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Moosa! I am the Lord, Predominant on all and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ اِنَّهُٓ اَنَا اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: Now throw your staff on the ground, when Moosa saw it was moving serpent, he turned back footed and didn't saw back, came the sound, Moosa do not be afraid, messengers do not fear in My Court.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَاَنَّهَا جَآنٌّۭ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ اِنِّى لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ الْمُرْسَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Yes, if anybody sins, then repent and exchange bad work with the good works, then I am all forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًۢا بَعْدَ سُوٓءٍۢ فَاِنِّى غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Put your hand in collar and take out then you will see without any sickness it is white and bright, this is one of the miracles (out of many) which have been given for the nation of Firaun, they have become a very wicked nation.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍۢ ۖ فِى تِسْعِ اٰيٰتٍ اِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِٓ ۚ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْمًۭا فَـٰسِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Whenever manifest signs came to them, they said it is just open magic.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ اٰيٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةًۭ قَالُواْ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: They denied because of haughtiness and unjustness whereas their hearts were believing, now see what will happen to the mischief-makers.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَحَدُواْ بِهَا وَاسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ اَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًۭا وَعُلُوًّۭا ۚ فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ

verses.english_text: And We gave knowledge to Dawood and Suleiman, both thanked Allah and said He has excelled us upon many of his servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ عِلْمًۭا ۖ وَقَالَا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Then Suleiman inherited Dawood,and he said: I have been given the knowledge of the language of birds, and have been given a part of every excellence, this is manifest Mercy and Grace of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَـٰنُ دَاوُدَ ۖ وَقَالَ يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ الطَّيْرِ وَاُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ اِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْمُبِينُ

verses.english_text: All the armies of jinns, men and birds were gathered for Suleiman, they were all collected in order.
verses.arabic_text: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ جُنُودُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنسِ وَالطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ

verses.english_text: When they reached the Valley of Naml, then an ant called: all the ants should get into their holes lest an army of Suleiman crush you and they do not even know.
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَآ اَتَوْاْ عَلَىٰ وَادِ النَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌۭ يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّمْلُ ادْخُلُواْ مَسَـٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَـٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Suleiman heard and smiled on this and said: O Lord, give me opportunity that I show gratefulness for your favours which You have granted me and my father; and I do such deeds that you are pleased with and that with You may count me with your Mercy among Your good servants.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًۭا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ اَوْزِعْنِىٓ اَنْ اَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِىٓ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَاَنْ اَعْمَلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَاَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ الصَّـٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: And Suleiman searched for Hoopoe, when he could not see him, he said: what has happened to me; I do not see hoopoe, where has he gone?
verses.arabic_text: وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِىَ لَآ اَرَى الْهُدْهُدَ اَمْ كَانَ مِنَ الْغَآئِبِينَ

verses.english_text: I will give him severe punishment or will slay him, if he will (not) bring any reasonable argument.
verses.arabic_text: لَاُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًا اَوْ لَاَاْذْبَحَنَّهُٓ اَوْ لَيَاْتِيَنِّى بِسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: After some time hoopoe came, he said I have come to know a thing which you also do not know, I have brought a definite news from Saba.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍۢ فَقَالَ اَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍۭ بِنَبَإٍۢ يَقِينٍ

verses.english_text: I have seen a lady who is governing on all and she has got everything of this world, and she also has got a magnificent throne.
verses.arabic_text: اِنِّى وَجَدتُّ امْرَاَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَاُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: I saw that she and her nation are worshipping the sun, and Satan has beautified it in their eyes and has hindered them from the right path; now they don't understand this also.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَـٰنُ اَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ

verses.english_text: Why don't they prostrate before Allah who knows all the secrets of the skies and the earth, and He also knows whatever people are doing openly or secretly.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَّا يَسْجُدُواْ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى يُخْرِجُ الْخَبْءَ فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَ مَا تُعْلِنُونَ

verses.english_text: {Prostrate Non-Obligatory} That is Allah and there is no god except Him, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ ۩

verses.english_text: Suleiman said I will see now, whatever you are saying is truth or you are also among the liars.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ اَصَدَقْتَ اَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ الْكَـٰذِبِينَ

verses.english_text: Take my letter and put it before them, then get aside and see what reply they give.
verses.arabic_text: اذْهَب بِّكِتٰبِى هَـٰذَا فَاَلْقِهْ اِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَانظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: That lady said: O Chief of my Kingdom, I have been sent an honorable letter.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَتْ يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْمَلَؤُاْ اِنِّىٓ اُلْقِىَ اِلَىَّ كِتٰبٌۭ كَرِيمٌ

verses.english_text: It is from Suleiman and its subject is that: I begin in the name of Allah, most Beneficent, most Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ مِن سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَاِنَّهُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

verses.english_text: See, do not transgress against me, and come (to me) as an obedient.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَّا تَعْلُواْ عَلَىَّ وَاْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: O Chief! give us your opinion in this matter, without your opinion I cannot decisively decide.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَتْ يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْمَلَؤُاْ اَفْتُونِى فِىٓ اَمْرِى مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً اَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ

verses.english_text: They said: we are powerful and experts in warfare, but command is in your hands, you say: what is your command?
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ نَحْنُ اُو۟لُواْ قُوَّةٍۢ وَاُو۟لُواْ بَاْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ وَالْاَمْرُ اِلَيْكِ فَانظُرِى مَاذَا تَاْمُرِينَ

verses.english_text: She said: when kings enter a town they destroy it and treat noblest people with disgrace (and make them low), this is their practice.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَتْ اِنَّ الْمُلُوكَ اِذَا دَخَلُواْ قَرْيَةً اَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓاْ اَعِزَّةَ اَهْلِهَآ اَذِلَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ

verses.english_text: And I am sending a gift towards them, then will see what reply to my representative will bring back.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنِّى مُرْسِلَةٌ اِلَيْهِم بِهَدِيَّةٍۢ فَنَاظِرَةٌۢ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ الْمُرْسَلُونَ

verses.english_text: When a representative came to Suleiman, he said: you want to aid me with wealth, whereas whatever My Allah has given is much better, you take your gift and be happy with it yourself.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ قَالَ اَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍۢ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنَِ اللَّهُ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُم بَلْ اَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ

verses.english_text: (Suleiman said:) Go, return, now I will come with the army which you cannot face, then I will expel you all from your town with disgrace and humiliation.
verses.arabic_text: ارْجِعْ اِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَاْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍۢ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ اَذِلَّةًۭ وَهُمْ صَـٰغِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then he said to his chiefs: who among you can bring that throne to me, before they come to me as obedient.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْمَلَؤُاْ اَيُّكُمْ يَاْتِينِى بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ اَن يَاْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: One audacious among the jinn said: I will bring in such a time that you will not move from your place, I am very powerful and trustworthy.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌۭ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ اَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ اَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ ۖ وَاِنِّى عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِىٌّ اَمِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: One person who was having part of knowledge of book said: I will bring before you can bat an eyelid, this is the Grace and Mercy of my Lord that He please to test me that I am thankful or ungrateful for His favours; and whoever will be thankful shall be for his own benefit, and whoever is ungrateful, my Lord is Self-Sufficient from him, and is Bountiful.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ الَّذِى عِندَهُ عِلْمٌۭ مِّنَ الْكِتٰبِ اَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ اَن يَرْتَدَّ اِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَاَشْكُرُ اَمْ اَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَاِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَاِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّۭ كَرِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Suleiman said: that disguise the throne, I want to see whether she can understand, or she is not among the knowledgeable.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ نَكِّرُواْ لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنظُرْ اَتَهْتَدِىٓ اَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ

verses.english_text: When she came, Suleiman asked: is it your throne; she said: it was like this, yes, perhaps this is it, I knew earlier, and I was obedient.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ اَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَاَنَّهُ هُوَ ۚ وَاُوتِينَا الْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And she was held back by God; whom she had accepted as Lord besides Allah, and she was from an infidel nation.
verses.arabic_text: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعْبُدُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ ۖ اِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِن قَوْمٍۢ كَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Then she was told to enter the fort, when she saw it, she thought that it was deep water. (she rolled up her garment) and her shanks were exposed, Suleiman said this is a fort which has been covered with glass, and she (Bilqees) said: I did unjust to my soul, now with Suleiman I believed in God Who is Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِى الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَاَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ اِنَّهُ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ اِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَاَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And We sent towards nation of Samood his brother Saleh that you people worship Allah, then both the parties started quarrelling.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَآ اِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ اَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا اَنِ اعْبُدُواْ اللَّهَ فَاِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Saleh said: O people of nation, why you are hastening for evil before the good, why don't you repent with Allah, perhaps He might show Mercy on you.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ ۖ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

verses.english_text: These people said: we got bad omen from you and your people; he said: it is your bad luck, fate is with Allah, and this was in fact your trial.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ اطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَ ۚ قَالَ طَـٰٓئِرُكُمْ عِندَ اللَّهِ ۖ بَلْ اَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ تُفْتَنُونَ

verses.english_text: In the city there were nine people who were creating mischief and was not amending.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَانَ فِى الْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍۢ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: swear among yourselves, that you will attack Saleh and his family during the night, and afterward tell their inheritors that you were not present at the time of their killing, and we are truthful in our statement.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ تَقَاسَمُواْ بِاللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُ وَاَهْلَهُ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ اَهْلِهِ وَ اِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ

verses.english_text: Then they plotted, and We also made arrangements, and they were (totally) unaware.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكْرًا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Now see, what was the result of their wickedness, we totally destroyed their chiefs along with their nation.
verses.arabic_text: فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ اَنَّا دَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: Now, their homes which are vacant because of their being unjust, there is a sign in it for the people who have knowledge.
verses.arabic_text: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةًۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓاْ ۗ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And We delivered those who were believers and had adopted the piety of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنجَيْنَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَكَانُواْ يَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: And remember Lut, when he said to his nation: you are having eyes, still you are doing the bad deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَلُوطًا اِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِٓ اَتَاْتُونَ الْفَـٰحِشَةَ وَاَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: What, due to carnal desire you are mating with men and leaving the women? In fact, you people are totally ignorant.
verses.arabic_text: اَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَاْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةًۭ مِّن دُونِ النِّسَآءِ ۚ بَلْ اَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ تَجْهَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Lut’s nation had a reply except that they said: expel Lut's followers, they are trying to be pure.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِٓ اِلَّآ اَن قَالُوٓاْ اَخْرِجُوٓاْ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ ۖ اِنَّهُمْ اُنَاسٌۭ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: So We delivered Lut and his family except his wife, she was among those who stayed behind.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَاَهْلَهُٓ اِلَّا امْرَاَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَـٰهَا مِنَ الْغَـٰبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We sent upon them a strange rain from which they are warned, and this rain of punishment is very bad.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنذَرِينَ

verses.english_text: Say: All the Praises are for Allah, and salutations on His servants whom He has chosen; whether Allah is better or those whom they are making His partner?
verses.arabic_text: قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَىٰٓ ۗ ءَآللَّهُ خَيْرٌ اَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: Who is that Who has created the skies and the earth, and has rained water from sky (clouds), then We grew beautiful garden from it that you could not had grown those trees; there is no god except Allah; but these people are paralleling others with Allah on their own.
verses.arabic_text: اَمَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَاَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَاَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍۢ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمْ اَن تُنۢبِتُواْ شَجَرَهَآ ۗ اَءِلَـٰهٌۭ مَّعَ اللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ يَعْدِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Who is He Who made the earth a place of stay, then flown rivers in between, and made mountains for it, and created barrier between the two rivers, is there any other god besides Allah, absolutely not; in fact, majority of them are ignorant.
verses.arabic_text: اَمَّن جَعَلَ الْاَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَـٰلَهَآ اَنْهَـٰرًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا ۗ اَءِلَـٰهٌۭ مَّعَ اللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Who is that who listens to the pleas in the distress when he calls to Him and removes the difficulty, and make you inherit the earth, is there anybody except Allah, then you take very little admonition and lesson.
verses.arabic_text: اَمَّن يُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ اِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ السُّوٓءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ الْاَرْضِ ۗ اَءِلَـٰهٌۭ مَّعَ اللَّهِ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: Who is that who guides to the ways of land and the sea in the darkness, who is that who sends the winds of glad tidings before the rain, is there any god with Allah? (Absolutely not) Allah is much more exalted than what these people make partner with Him.
verses.arabic_text: اَمَّن يَهْدِيكُمْ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَن يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِٓ ۗ اَءِلَـٰهٌۭ مَّعَ اللَّهِ ۚ تَعَـٰلَى اللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: Or Who is there Who began the creation, and once again He will create, and who is that Who gives sustenance from the skies and the earth, is there and God besides Allah? Say: if you are truthful in your claim then bring your argument.
verses.arabic_text: اَمَّن يَبْدَؤُاْ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَمَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۗ اَءِلَـٰهٌۭ مَّعَ اللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ هَاتُواْ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Say: there is no one in the skies and the earth who knows the unseen, except Allah, these people do not know when they will be raised again.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لَّا يَعْلَمُ مَن فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ الْغَيْبَ اِلَّا اللَّهُ ۚ وَ مَا يَشْعُرُونَ اَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ

verses.english_text: Whereas their knowledge about the Day of Judgement is incomplete; nay, they are in doubt about it, nay, they are blind.
verses.arabic_text: بَلِ ادَّٰرَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّنْهَا ۖ بَلْ هُم مِّنْهَا عَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And infidel say: when our forefathers will become dust, will they be raised again?
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ اَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًۭا وَءَابَآؤُنَآ اَئِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ

verses.english_text: This promise has been made to us and to our forefathers for a very long time, these are tales of the earlier people.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَـٰذَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ اِنْ هَـٰذَآ اِلَّآ اَسَـٰطِيرُ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: You say: roam around on the land then see what the recompense of the guilty people was.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ سِيرُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَانظُرُواْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And do not be sad about their condition, they are plotting, and do not be strait hearted from them also.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُن فِى ضَيْقٍۢ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: They say: if you are truthful then when will this promise be completed?
verses.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Then say: for the punishment which you are hastening may be some part is already behind you.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ اَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعْضُ الَّذِى تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

verses.english_text: There is no doubt that your Lord shows great Mercy on you, but many of them are not grateful.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And your Lord knows everything that they have hidden in their hearts or which they speak out.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَ مَا يُعْلِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And there is nothing hidden in the sky and the earth which is not mentioned in this manifest Book.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا مِنْ غَآئِبَةٍۢ فِى السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا فِى كِتٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

verses.english_text: There is no doubt that this Quran declares to Bani Israel many things in which they differ.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَـٰذَا الْقُرْءَانَ يَقُصُّ عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ اَكْثَرَ الَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

verses.english_text: This Quran is admonition and Mercy for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّهُ لَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Your Lord judge between them with His Command, He is Predominant on all and Know everything.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُم بِحُكْمِهِ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: Hence, trust that you are on the path of the clear truth.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۖ اِنَّكَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ الْمُبِينِ

verses.english_text: You cannot make the dead and the deaf hear your voice, if they turn their face and run away.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَآءَ اِذَا وَلَّوْاْ مُدْبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And you cannot bring blinds to the right path; you can make hear your sound only to those who believe our verses and are Our obedient.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَنتَ بِهَـٰدِى الْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَـٰلَتِهِمْ ۖ اِن تُسْمِعُ اِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And when promise will be completed on them, then We will make stand a person walking on the land that he will talk (ask) to them that who is there who do not believe on Our verses.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَاِذَا وَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ اَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَآبَّةًۭ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ اَنَّ النَّاسَ كَانُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا لَا يُوقِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And that day We will collect the army of every Ummah who were denying our verses, then they will be divided separately.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِن كُلِّ اُمَّةٍۢ فَوْجًۭا مِّمَّن يُكَذِّبُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ

verses.english_text: When everyone will come then Allah will say: had you denied Our verses, whereas you were unaware what you were doing.
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا جَآءُو قَالَ اَكَذَّبْتُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِى وَلَمْ تُحِيطُواْ بِهَا عِلْمًا اَمَّاذَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: And their talk will be proved by their unjust and they will not be able to speak.
verses.arabic_text: وَوَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِم بِمَا ظَلَمُواْ فَهُمْ لَا يَنطِقُونَ

verses.english_text: Didn't they see that We created night that they take rest, and made day the cause of light, in this there are big signs for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ اَنَّا جَعَلْنَا الَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُواْ فِيهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: When the trumpet will be blown, whatever is in the earth and the skies will feel tremor, except those whom Allah pleases, and everyone will be presented in His Court, with their heads bowed down.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى الصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا مَن شَآءَ اللَّهُ ۚ وَكُلٌّ اَتَوْهُ دَٰخِرِينَ

verses.english_text: When you see you will think mountains are still, whereas they will be moving as clouds, this is the artistry of that Lord Who have made everything in perfect order and is aware of all your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَرَى الْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةًۭ وَهِىَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِ ۚ صُنْعَ اللَّهِ الَّذِىٓ اَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ ۚ اِنَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Whoever will do the good deed will get the best reward, and they will be secured from the fear of the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: مَن جَآءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَهُم مِّن فَزَعٍۢ يَوْمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And whoever will do bad deeds will be thrown into Hell with their faces down, can anything else be given to you except the recompense of your deeds?
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن جَآءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى النَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: I have been only commanded to worship the owner of this city who has made it honorable and everything is His property, and I have been commanded to be among his obedient.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَآ اُمِرْتُ اَنْ اَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَـٰذِهِ الْبَلْدَةِ الَّذِى حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُ كُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ ۖ وَاُمِرْتُ اَنْ اَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And that I recite the Quran to you, after this whoever will get guidance will do it for his own benefit, and whoever will go astray tell him I am among the warners.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنْ اَتْلُوَاْ الْقُرْءَانَ ۖ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ فَاِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَقُلْ اِنَّمَآ اَنَا۠ مِنَ الْمُنذِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And say: all the Praise is only for Allah, and He will show his signs very soon, then you will understand that your Lord is not oblivious to your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمْ اٰيٰتِهِ فَتَعْرِفُونَهَا ۚ وَ مَا رَبُّكَ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Ta Seen Meem
verses.arabic_text: طسٓمٓ

verses.english_text: These are the verses of the manifest Book.
verses.arabic_text: تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ الْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِينِ

verses.english_text: We are telling you the true news of Moosa and Firaun, for those who are going to believe.
verses.arabic_text: نَتْلُواْ عَلَيْكَ مِن نَّبَاِ مُوسَىٰ وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِالْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Firaun acquired the high place on the land, and he divided the dwellers of the earth on the many parts to weaken one another; he slayed their boys; and kept alive their women, he was Verily a mischief maker.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِى الْاَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ اَهْلَهَا شِيَعًۭا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَآئِفَةًۭ مِّنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ اَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْىِ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ

verses.english_text: And We want to favor those who have been weakened and make them leaders of the people and make them inherit the land.
verses.arabic_text: وَنُرِيدُ اَن نَّمُنَّ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَنَجْعَلَهُمْ اَئِمَّةًۭ وَنَجْعَلَهُمُ الْوَٰرِثِينَ

verses.english_text: And give them the power of the land and show Firaun and Hamaan and their armies the scenes at the hands of those weak from which they were fearing.
verses.arabic_text: وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَنُرِىَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَحْذَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And We revealed to mother of Moosa to feed the milk to her child and when fear comes put the child in the water, and do not have any fear or distress because We are going to turn him to you (again); and he shall be counted among the messengers.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَىٰٓ اُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ اَنْ اَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَاِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَاَلْقِيهِ فِى الْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ اِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ اِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: Then family of Firaun picked him up, which after all resulted in the pain and grief for his enemies; indeed, Firaun, Hamaan and their armies were all evil.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْتَقَطَهُٓ ءَالُ فِرْعَوْنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمْ عَدُوًّۭا وَحَزَنًا ۗ اِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا كَانُواْ خَـٰطِـِٔينَ

verses.english_text: And Firaun's wife said he is the coolness of our eyes, so don’t kill him, he may be beneficial for us, and we will make him our son; and they were not understanding anything.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَتِ امْرَاَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ قُرَّتُ عَيْنٍۢ لِّى وَلَكَ ۖ لَا تَقْتُلُوهُ عَسَىٰٓ اَن يَنفَعَنَآ اَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًۭا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And Moosa's mother's heart became empty, and she was about to reveal the secret if We would not have strengthened her heart; so that she be counted among the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَصْبَحَ فُؤَادُ اُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَـٰرِغًا ۖ اِن كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِى بِهِ لَوْلَآ اَن رَّبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قَلْبِهَا لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And she told his sister that you also follow him, so she saw Moosa from afar, when they were not even slightly aware of it.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَتْ لِاُخْتِهِ قُصِّيهِ ۖ فَبَصُرَتْ بِهِ عَن جُنُبٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And we had already forbidden the milk of foster mothers for Moosa, his sister said shall I tell you about a household who will nourish him and will be his well-wisher also.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ اَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ اَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُ نَـٰصِحُونَ

verses.english_text: Then (in this way) We returned Moosa to his mother so he could see the coolness of her eyes, and she was not upset (also), and she should know that Allah's promise is True, whereas the majority of people do not know this.
verses.arabic_text: فَرَدَدْنَـٰهُ اِلَىٰٓ اُمِّهِ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَلِتَعْلَمَ اَنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And when Moosa reached the strength of youth and became healthy, then We gave him knowledge and wisdom; and like this We recompense to the people who do good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ اَشُدَّهُ وَاسْتَوَىٰٓ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And Moosa entered the city when people were negligently asleep, so he saw two people fighting, one of them was among his friends and other one from his enemies, so who was from among his friends, complaint about the unjust against him; so Moosa hit the man with his fist and he died, he (Moosa) said: Verily it was an act of Satan; Verily Satan is an enemy who openly misguide.
verses.arabic_text: وَدَخَلَ الْمَدِينَةَ عَلَىٰ حِينِ غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ اَهْلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيهَا رَجُلَيْنِ يَقْتَتِلَانِ هَـٰذَا مِن شِيعَتِهِ وَهَـٰذَا مِنْ عَدُوِّهِ ۖ فَاسْتَغَـٰثَهُ الَّذِى مِن شِيعَتِهِ عَلَى الَّذِى مِنْ عَدُوِّهِ فَوَكَزَهُ مُوسَىٰ فَقَضَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ۖ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطَـٰنِ ۖ اِنَّهُ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّضِلٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: O my Lord, I have taken trouble for my soul, please forgive me, so the Lord forgave him; He is very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى فَاغْفِرْ لِى فَغَفَرَ لَهُٓ ۚ اِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: O my Lord, You helped me, so I will never be among the guilty ones.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ فَلَنْ اَكُونَ ظَهِيرًا لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Then in the morning Moosa entered the city while he was fearful and worried and he saw that the person who had called him for help yesterday was again complaining, Moosa said: Verily you are manifest misguided one.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَصْبَحَ فِى الْمَدِينَةِ خَآئِفًۭا يَتَرَقَّبُ فَاِذَا الَّذِى اسْتَنصَرَهُ بِالْاَمْسِ يَسْتَصْرِخُهُ ۚ قَالَ لَهُ مُوسَىٰٓ اِنَّكَ لَغَوِىٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: When Moosa tried to attack him, who is the enemy of both, he said Moosa you want to kill me as you have killed an innocent yesterday, you want to be a transgressed ruler on the land, and you do not want that you should be counted among those who warn.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ اَنْ اَرَادَ اَن يَبْطِشَ بِالَّذِى هُوَ عَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُمَا قَالَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ اَتُرِيدُ اَن تَقْتُلَنِى كَمَا قَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۢا بِالْاَمْسِ ۖ اِن تُرِيدُ اِلَّآ اَن تَكُونَ جَبَّارًا فِى الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا تُرِيدُ اَن تَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: And then from the end of the city a person came running and said: Moosa, elders of the city are planning to kill you so you leave the city, and I am an admonisher for you.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَآءَ رَجُلٌۭ مِّنْ اَقْصَا الْمَدِينَةِ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ اِنَّ الْمَلَاَ يَاْتَمِرُونَ بِكَ لِيَقْتُلُوكَ فَاخْرُجْ اِنِّى لَكَ مِنَ النَّـٰصِحِينَ

verses.english_text: Moosa came out of the city in fear looking right and left and said: O my Lord save me from the unjust nation.
verses.arabic_text: فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا خَآئِفًۭا يَتَرَقَّبُ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِى مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: When Moosa turned towards Madyan, he said: shortly Allah will guide me towards the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلْقَآءَ مَدْيَنَ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ اَن يَهْدِيَنِى سَوَآءَ السَّبِيلِ

verses.english_text: When he reached a stream of Madyan, he saw a group watering their animals; on one side there were two females who were holding back their animals, Moosa asked them what is the matter? They both said: we cannot feed water to our animals unless they take away (their sheep), and our father is an old man.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا وَرَدَ مَآءَ مَدْيَنَ وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ اُمَّةًۭ مِّنَ النَّاسِ يَسْقُونَ وَوَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمُ امْرَاَتَيْنِ تَذُودَانِ ۖ قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُمَا ۖ قَالَتَا لَا نَسْقِى حَتَّىٰ يُصْدِرَ الرِّعَآءُ ۖ وَاَبُونَا شَيْخٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: Moosa watered the animal of both (ladies) then came and sat in a shadow, Verily I stand in need for the thing please send to me.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَقَىٰ لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّىٰٓ اِلَى الظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّى لِمَآ اَنزَلْتَ اِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ فَقِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: In that time one of those two girls came and said shyly: my father is calling you in order to reward you for watering the animals, when Moosa came to him and described his tale, he said do not fear you have been delivered from an unjust nation.
verses.arabic_text: فَجَآءَتْهُ اِحْدَىٰهُمَا تَمْشِى عَلَى اسْتِحْيَآءٍۢ قَالَتْ اِنَّ اَبِى يَدْعُوكَ لِيَجْزِيَكَ اَجْرَ مَا سَقَيْتَ لَنَا ۚ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُ وَقَصَّ عَلَيْهِ الْقَصَصَ قَالَ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ نَجَوْتَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: One of those girls said: father you hire him because he will be best among servants you would hire, he is strong man and trustworthy.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَتْ اِحْدَىٰهُمَا يَـٰٓاَبَتِ اسْتَـْٔجِرْهُ ۖ اِنَّ خَيْرَ مَنِ اسْتَـْٔجَرْتَ الْقَوِىُّ الْاَمِينُ

verses.english_text: He said I desire to marry one of these my two daughters with you provided you serve me for eight years and if you will serve for ten years it will be from you, and I do not want to give any trouble to you; if Allah willing, you will find me among the good servants.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنِّىٓ اُرِيدُ اَنْ اُنكِحَكَ اِحْدَى ابْنَتَىَّ هَـٰتَيْنِ عَلَىٰٓ اَن تَاْجُرَنِى ثَمَـٰنِىَ حِجَجٍۢ ۖ فَاِنْ اَتْمَمْتَ عَشْرًا فَمِنْ عِندِكَ ۖ وَ مَآ اُرِيدُ اَنْ اَشُقَّ عَلَيْكَ ۚ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ اِن شَآءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّـٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: there is a covenant between me and you, whatever period I complete, then I will have no responsibility, and whatever I am saying, Allah is witness to it.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ ۖ اَيَّمَا الْاَجَلَيْنِ قَضَيْتُ فَلَا عُدْوَٰنَ عَلَىَّ ۖ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then, when Moosa completed the period and took his family, he saw a fire from the direction of Mount Tur (Sinai), so he told his family: you stay here I have seen a fire, I may bring news or an ember from it that you may warm yourselves up.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ مُوسَى الْاَجَلَ وَسَارَ بِاَهْلِهِٓ ءَانَسَ مِن جَانِبِ الطُّورِ نَارًا قَالَ لِاَهْلِهِ امْكُثُوٓاْ اِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ اَوْ جَذْوَةٍۢ مِّنَ النَّارِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ

verses.english_text: When he came near the fire, on the right side of the valley from a blessed tree a sound came: I am the Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ اَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ مِن شَـٰطِئِ الْوَادِ الْاَيْمَنِ فِى الْبُقْعَةِ الْمُبَـٰرَكَةِ مِنَ الشَّجَرَةِ اَن يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ اِنِّىٓ اَنَا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And you keep down your staff on the ground, and Moosa sees it is moving like a snake, seeing this Moosa turned away and did not look back, then again came the sound: Moosa come ahead, do not fear, you are fully safe.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنْ اَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَاَنَّهَا جَآنٌّۭ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ اَقْبِلْ وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ اِنَّكَ مِنَ الْـَٔامِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Put your hand in the collar and take out, it will come out white and bright without any illness, fold your shoulder towards you with fear, from your Lord these are two arguments for Firaun and his chiefs, these are all transgressor and bad people.
verses.arabic_text: اسْلُكْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍۢ وَاضْمُمْ اِلَيْكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ الرَّهْبِ ۖ فَذَٰنِكَ بُرْهَـٰنَانِ مِن رَّبِّكَ اِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَاِي۟هِٓ ۚ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْمًۭا فَـٰسِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: I have killed one of their men, I fear that they might kill me and preaching work may stop.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّى قَتَلْتُ مِنْهُمْ نَفْسًۭا فَاَخَافُ اَن يَقْتُلُونِ

verses.english_text: My brother Haroon is more eloquent in language, so make him my helper so he can authenticate me, and I fear that those people may not deny me.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَخِى هَـٰرُونُ هُوَ اَفْصَحُ مِنِّى لِسَانًۭا فَاَرْسِلْهُ مَعِىَ رِدْءًۭا يُصَدِّقُنِىٓ ۖ اِنِّىٓ اَخَافُ اَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

verses.english_text: Allah said: We will strengthen your shoulders with your brother, and will create a domination for you that they will not be able to reach you, and with my signs you and your followers shall be the uppermost.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِاَخِيكَ وَنَجْعَلُ لَكُمَا سُلْطَـٰنًۭا فَلَا يَصِلُونَ اِلَيْكُمَا ۚ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ اَنتُمَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَكُمَا الْغَـٰلِبُونَ

verses.english_text: When Moosa came to them with Our manifest signs, they said it is just a fabricated magic, and we have not heard anything as such from our earlier elders.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ قَالُواْ مَا هَـٰذَآ اِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّفْتَرًى وَ مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: And Moosa said: my Lord knows the best that who has brought guidance from Him, and abode is the Hereafter is for whom, Verily unjust will not be successful.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ اَعْلَمُ بِمَن جَآءَ بِالْهُدَىٰ مِنْ عِندِهِ وَمَن تَكُونُ لَهُ عَـٰقِبَةُ الدَّارِ ۖ اِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الظَّـٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Firaun said: O my chiefs, in my knowledge there is no god for you, except me, O Hamaan, bake the clay and make a lofty tower for me so that I climb on it and bring the news of Moosa's God, and I think Moosa is a liar.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْمَلَاُ مَا عَلِمْتُ لَكُم مِّنْ اِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرِى فَاَوْقِدْ لِى يَـٰهَـٰمَـٰنُ عَلَى الطِّينِ فَاجْعَل لِّى صَرْحًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ اَطَّلِعُ اِلَىٰٓ اِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَاِنِّى لَاَظُنُّهُ مِنَ الْكَـٰذِبِينَ

verses.english_text: And Firaun and his army showed unnecessary haughtiness, and thought that they would not be returned to Our Court.
verses.arabic_text: وَاسْتَكْبَرَ هُوَ وَجُنُودُهُ فِى الْاَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَظَنُّوٓاْ اَنَّهُمْ اِلَيْنَا لَا يُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: Then We caught hold of Firaun and his army, and threw everyone in the river, then see how is the recompense of the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى الْيَمِّ ۖ فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And We have made them the leaders who invite people towards Hell, and they will not be helped on the Day of the Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ اَئِمَّةًۭ يَدْعُونَ اِلَى النَّارِ ۖ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَا يُنصَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And in this world also curses are behind them, and on the Day of Judgement also they will be counted among those whose faces will be disfigured.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَتْبَعْنَـٰهُمْ فِى هَـٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةًۭ ۖ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ هُم مِّنَ الْمَقْبُوحِينَ

verses.english_text: We gave the book to Moosa after destroying the earlier generations, which was a source of insight, guidance and mercy for the people; perhaps they might get the admonition like this.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَآ اَهْلَكْنَا الْقُرُونَ الْاُولَىٰ بَصَآئِرَ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: And at that time. you were not on the western side of Mount Tur (Sinai) when I sent my command to Moosa, and you were not even witness to this story.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ الْغَرْبِىِّ اِذْ قَضَيْنَآ اِلَىٰ مُوسَى الْاَمْرَ وَ مَا كُنتَ مِنَ الشَّـٰهِدِينَ

verses.english_text: But We created many nations, then a long time passed by, and you were not present in Madyan that you would have recited our verses to them, but we were the maker of messengers.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَـٰكِنَّآ اَنشَاْنَا قُرُونًۭا فَتَطَاوَلَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعُمُرُ ۚ وَ مَا كُنتَ ثَاوِيًۭا فِىٓ اَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ تَتْلُواْ عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتِنَا وَلَـٰكِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

verses.english_text: You were not on any side of Tur (Mount Sinai) when we called up Moosa, but this is the Mercy of your Lord that you warn this nation who was not sent any messenger earlier, maybe they take a lesson and admonition from this.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ الطُّورِ اِذْ نَادَيْنَا وَلَـٰكِن رَّحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ اَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: And if any affliction has befallen on them due to their earlier deeds, they would have said: O Lord why any messenger was not sent towards us that we would have followed your signs and we would be among the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَوْلَآ اَن تُصِيبَهُم مُّصِيبَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ اَيْدِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُواْ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ اَرْسَلْتَ اِلَيْنَا رَسُولًۭا فَنَتَّبِعَ اٰيٰتِكَ وَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Then after this, when truth came from Us they said: why we have not been given that what people of Moosa were given, so have not they denied Moosa earlier, now they are saying that Taurait and Quran is a magic which authenticate each other and we are denying both.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُواْ لَوْلَآ اُوتِىَ مِثْلَ مَآ اُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ اَوَلَمْ يَكْفُرُواْ بِمَآ اُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ قَالُواْ سِحْرَانِ تَظَـٰهَرَا وَقَالُوٓاْ اِنَّا بِكُلٍّۢ كَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then say: Okay, you bring a book from the Lord which is more correct than this and I follow that, if you are truthful in your talk.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ فَاْتُواْ بِكِتٰبٍۢ مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ هُوَ اَهْدَىٰ مِنْهُمَآ اَتَّبِعْهُ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Then if they don't accept, understand that they are following their desires, and who have gone more strayed who is following their desires without receiving divine guidance, whereas Allah does not guide the unjust nation.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِن لَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُواْ لَكَ فَاعْلَمْ اَنَّمَا يَتَّبِعُونَ اَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَمَنْ اَضَلُّ مِمَّنِ اتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ بِغَيْرِ هُدًۭى مِّنَ اللَّهِ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And we continuously conveyed Our communication to them, perhaps they take the admonition in this way.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَ لَقَدْ وَصَّلْنَا لَهُمُ الْقَوْلَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: To whoever I gave the book earlier than this they believe in this Quran.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ مِن قَبْلِهِ هُم بِهِ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: When it is recited before them, they say we believe this is truthful from our Lord and we have already accepted it.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِهِٓ اِنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّنَآ اِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلِهِ مُسْلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: These are the people who will be given double the recompense that they showed patience, and they ward off evil with good deeds, and spend from the sustenance given by Us.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُؤْتَوْنَ اَجْرَهُم مَّرَّتَيْنِ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ السَّيِّئَةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ

verses.english_text: And when they hear useless talk they get aside by saying that for you is your deeds and for us is our deeds, our salutation (to you), we do not like to sit with the ignorant.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا سَمِعُواْ اللَّغْوَ اَعْرَضُواْ عَنْهُ وَ قَالُواْ لَنَآ اَعْمَـٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ اَعْمَـٰلُكُمْ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ لَا نَبْتَغِى الْجَـٰهِلِينَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! You cannot guide whoever you want, but Allah guides whomever He pleases, and He is well aware with those, who will get guidance.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِى مَنْ اَحْبَبْتَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَهُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ

verses.english_text: These infidels say that if we follow you, we will be displaced from our land, have not we given them the control over the secured Holy Place (Haram), towards which fruits of every kind come because of our sustenance, but most among them do not understand.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالُوٓاْ اِن نَّتَّبِعِ الْهُدَىٰ مَعَكَ نُتَخَطَّفْ مِنْ اَرْضِنَآ ۚ اَوَلَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّهُمْ حَرَمًا ءَامِنًۭا يُجْبَىٰٓ اِلَيْهِ ثَمَرَٰتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ رِّزْقًۭا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: We have destroyed many settlements because of their economy's pride, and these are their homes which were never populated, except a few, and in fact We are Heir and Master of everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍۭ بَطِرَتْ مَعِيشَتَهَا ۖ فَتِلْكَ مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ لَمْ تُسْكَن مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ اِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا ۖ وَكُنَّا نَحْنُ الْوَٰرِثِينَ

verses.english_text: Your Lord does not destroy any settlement unless We send the messenger to them who recite our communications in front of them, and We are not going to destroy any settlement unless people there are unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ مُهْلِكَ الْقُرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يَبْعَثَ فِىٓ اُمِّهَا رَسُولًۭا يَتْلُواْ عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتِنَا ۚ وَ مَا كُنَّا مُهْلِكِى الْقُرَىٰٓ اِلَّا وَاَهْلُهَا ظَـٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Whatever We have given you is a few days' enjoyment and beauty of this world, and whatever is in the Court of Allah is good and everlasting, don't you even understand this.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَمَتَـٰعُ الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتُهَا ۚ وَ مَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌۭ وَاَبْقَىٰٓ ۚ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Does the servant with whom We have promised the good and he also gets it, can be like the person whom We have given little enjoyment (of world) and on the Day of Judgement he will be dragged and presented in the Court of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَمَن وَعَدْنَـٰهُ وَعْدًا حَسَنًۭا فَهُوَ لَـٰقِيهِ كَمَن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُ مَتَـٰعَ الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ هُوَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ

verses.english_text: That day Allah will call out: where are My partners, whose partnership you perceived.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ اَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ الَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ

verses.english_text: So on whom sentencing of partnership with Allah would have been confirmed will say: O Lord these are the people whom we misguided, and like this we misguided them as we were misguided, but today we want to be free from them, they were not worshipping us.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ الَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ رَبَّنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ الَّذِينَ اَغْوَيْنَآ اَغْوَيْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا غَوَيْنَا ۖ تَبَرَّاْنَآ اِلَيْكَ ۖ مَا كَانُوٓاْ اِيَّانَا يَعْبُدُونَ

verses.english_text: So it will be said: now call out to your partners, they will call out, but there won't be any reply, but they will see the punishment only, alas! had they taken guidance in the world only.
verses.arabic_text: وَقِيلَ ادْعُواْ شُرَكَآءَكُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُواْ لَهُمْ وَرَاَوُاْ الْعَذَابَ ۚ لَوْ اَنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ يَهْتَدُونَ

verses.english_text: And that day Allah will call out and say: what reply you had given to Our messengers?
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَآ اَجَبْتُمُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: So all the news will become darkness for them and they will not be able to speak among themselves.
verses.arabic_text: فَعَمِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْاَنۢبَآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فَهُمْ لَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

verses.english_text: But who repented and believed and did good works, he will Verily be counted among those who will prosper.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا فَعَسَىٰٓ اَن يَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُفْلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: Your Lord creates and likes to whom He pleases, they have no right to choose, Allah is Pure, High and exalted from their polytheism.
verses.arabic_text: وَرَبُّكَ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيَخْتَارُ ۗ مَا كَانَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ اللَّهِ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: And your Lord Knows the things which they have concealed in their breasts, and also Knows what they speak out openly.
verses.arabic_text: وَرَبُّكَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَ مَا يُعْلِنُونَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah and there is no other god except Him, He is the First, He is the Last, and all the Praises are for Him only in this world and in the Hereafter, Judgement is His only; and you all shall have to return to Him only.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ اللَّهُ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِى الْاُولَىٰ وَالْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَهُ الْحُكْمُ وَاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: Say: What is your opinion if Allah continues and prolonged the night until the Day of Judgement so is there any other god besides Him who can bring the light for you, don't you listen to the talk?
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِن جَعَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ الَّيْلَ سَرْمَدًا اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ مَنْ اِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَاْتِيكُم بِضِيَآءٍ ۖ اَفَلَا تَسْمَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And say: if He stretches the day and makes it permanent up to the Day of Judgement, then is there any other god besides Allah who can bring night for you where you can take rest, so don't you see.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِن جَعَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ النَّهَارَ سَرْمَدًا اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ مَنْ اِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَاْتِيكُم بِلَيْلٍۢ تَسْكُنُونَ فِيهِ ۖ اَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: This is part of His Mercy that he made night and day both for you so you can also take rest and even go in search of sustenance, and perhaps be grateful to Him too.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِن رَّحْمَتِهِ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لِتَسْكُنُواْ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُواْ مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And on the Day of Judgement Allah will call out: where are my partners whose partnership you had perceived.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ اَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ الَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ

verses.english_text: And We will bring out a witness from every nation, and will say to the deniers that you also bring your arguments, and when they will know that truth is for Allah, then those who were forging will all vanish away.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَزَعْنَا مِن كُلِّ اُمَّةٍۢ شَهِيدًۭا فَقُلْنَا هَاتُواْ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ فَعَلِمُوٓاْ اَنَّ الْحَقَّ لِلَّهِ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفْتَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, Qaroon was from the nation of Moosa, but he did unjust to his nation; and We had given him such treasures that a powerful party was also unable to lift their very keys; then his nation said do not show boastfulness because Allah does not like the boastful people.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اِنَّ قَـٰرُونَ كَانَ مِن قَوْمِ مُوسَىٰ فَبَغَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ الْكُنُوزِ مَآ اِنَّ مَفَاتِحَهُ لَتَنُوٓاُ بِالْعُصْبَةِ اُو۟لِى الْقُوَّةِ اِذْ قَالَ لَهُ قَوْمُهُ لَا تَفْرَحْ ۖ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْفَرِحِينَ

verses.english_text: And whatever Allah has given you, prepare a house in the Hereafter from it, and do not forget your part in this world, and do good as Allah has done good to you, and do not try to create mischief on the earth; Allah does not like mischief-makers.
verses.arabic_text: وَابْتَغِ فِيمَآ ءَاتَىٰكَ اللَّهُ الدَّارَ الْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۖ وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَاَحْسِن كَمَآ اَحْسَنَ اللَّهُ اِلَيْكَ ۖ وَلَا تَبْغِ الْفَسَادَ فِى الْاَرْضِ ۖ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُفْسِدِينَ

verses.english_text: Qaroon said it has all been given to me because of my knowledge, so does not he know that Allah has destroyed many generations before him who were more powerful and wealthier, and such guilty will not be even questioned about their sins.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنَّمَآ اُوتِيتُهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عِندِىٓ ۚ اَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ اَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ اَهْلَكَ مِن قَبْلِهِ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ مَنْ هُوَ اَشَدُّ مِنْهُ قُوَّةًۭ وَاَكْثَرُ جَمْعًۭا ۚ وَلَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذُنُوبِهِمُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Then Qaroon came out with all the decorations in front of his people, then those who had desire of this world said: we wish we would have such materials which have been given to Qaroon, he is master of mighty parts.
verses.arabic_text: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فِى زِينَتِهِ ۖ قَالَ الَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ الْحَيَوٰةَ الدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ اُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ اِنَّهُ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And whosoever was given the knowledge said: alas! on your condition; Allah's reward is much better for the believers and good doers, and reward is not given to anyone, but to the patient ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ اُوتُواْ الْعِلْمَ وَيْلَكُمْ ثَوَابُ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌۭ لِّمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا وَلَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ اِلَّا الصَّـٰبِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then We made earth swallow him up and his house, and no group could save him, neither he was able to defend himself.
verses.arabic_text: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْاَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَ مَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And those who have desired it yesterday began to say: Ah! Allah expands the sustenance of whoever He pleases and restrict of those whom He pleases; and if His Mercy was not on us, He would have caused the earth to swallow up us also; Ah! indeed infidels will never prosper.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَصْبَحَ الَّذِينَ تَمَنَّوْاْ مَكَانَهُ بِالْاَمْسِ يَقُولُونَ وَيْكَاَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَقْدِرُ ۖ لَوْلَآ اَن مَّنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا لَخَسَفَ بِنَا ۖ وَيْكَاَنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: This is the Hereafter which We have reserved for the people who do not desire high places and mischief in the world, and good-end is only for the pious people.
verses.arabic_text: تِلْكَ الدَّارُ الْـَٔاخِرَةُ نَجْعَلُهَا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُرِيدُونَ عُلُوًّۭا فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَا فَسَادًۭا ۚ وَالْعَـٰقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

verses.english_text: Whoever will do good work shall be rewarded the best, and whoever will do evil his recompense will be as much as his deeds.
verses.arabic_text: مَن جَآءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهَا ۖ وَمَن جَآءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَى الَّذِينَ عَمِلُواْ السَّيِّـَٔاتِ اِلَّا مَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Indeed who have made Quran imperative on you, He will definitely return you to your destination; say: Lord knows better who have brought the guidance and who is in the clear misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِى فَرَضَ عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْءَانَ لَرَآدُّكَ اِلَىٰ مَعَادٍۢ ۚ قُل رَّبِّىٓ اَعْلَمُ مَن جَآءَ بِالْهُدَىٰ وَمَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: You were not hopeful that the book be revealed to you, this is Mercy of Allah, so beware, never side with the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كُنتَ تَرْجُوٓاْ اَن يُلْقَىٰٓ اِلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبُ اِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ ظَهِيرًا لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Let them not stop you from preaching after revelation of a verse, and invite towards your Lord, and beware, do not be among the polytheists.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنْ اٰيٰتِ اللَّهِ بَعْدَ اِذْ اُنزِلَتْ اِلَيْكَ ۖ وَادْعُ اِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ

verses.english_text: Do not call out to any other god with Allah, there is no god except Him, everything is going to be destroyed besides Him; Command is His, and (eventually) you will all be returned toward His Court.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ اِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۘ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ۚ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ هَالِكٌ اِلَّا وَجْهَهُ ۚ لَهُ الْحُكْمُ وَاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: Alif Laam Meem
verses.arabic_text: الٓمٓ

verses.english_text: Does the people think that they will be left just because of their saying that ‘we believe’, and they will not be put to trial?
verses.arabic_text: اَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ اَن يُتْرَكُوٓاْ اَن يَقُولُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ

verses.english_text: Indeed, We also tested people earlier than them, and Allah definitely wish to know that who among those people are truthful and who are liars.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ فَتَنَّا الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ صَدَقُواْ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْكَـٰذِبِينَ

verses.english_text: Does the evil doers think they will go ahead of Us, this is a wrong judgement.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّـَٔاتِ اَن يَسْبِقُونَا ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ

verses.english_text: Whoever hope to meet Allah, he should know that the term appointed is going to come, He is all Hearing and Knowing.
verses.arabic_text: مَن كَانَ يَرْجُواْ لِقَآءَ اللَّهِ فَاِنَّ اَجَلَ اللَّهِ لَـَٔاتٍۢ ۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: Whoever struggled, struggled for himself, Allah is Self-Sufficient from all the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن جَـٰهَدَ فَاِنَّمَا يُجَـٰهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِٓ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِىٌّ عَنِ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Those who believed and did good works We Verily will cover up their sins, and We shall give them best recompense of their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ اَحْسَنَ الَّذِى كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: And We have admonished human being to behave with good manners with parents and have told him: if they force you to make anyone My partner of which you do not know, then beware, do not obey them, and towards Me you shall all return, then I shall tell you what you were doing.
verses.arabic_text: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنسَـٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حُسْنًۭا ۖ وَاِن جَـٰهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌۭ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَآ ۚ اِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَاُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who adopted faith and did good works We will Verily count them among the good servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِى الصَّـٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: And there are some people who say we believe on Allah, after that when they are afflicted with any trouble in the way of Allah, then they consider that mischief as punishment of Allah, whereas if any help comes from the Lord they immediately say: we were with you; so is Allah not aware of the talk which are in the hearts of all creatures.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِاللَّهِ فَاِذَآ اُوذِىَ فِى اللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ النَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ اللَّهِ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ ۚ اَوَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِاَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِى صُدُورِ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And He Verily knows who the believers are, and He also knows who the hypocrites are.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ

verses.english_text: These infidels say to the believers: you follow our ways and we are responsible for your sins (on the day of Judgement), whereas they are not going to carry the burden of anyone's sins, they are plain liars.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اتَّبِعُواْ سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَـٰيَـٰكُمْ وَ مَا هُم بِحَـٰمِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَـٰيَـٰهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۖ اِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ

verses.english_text: And one day they have to carry their own burden; and also along with other's burden, and on the Day of Judgement they will be questioned for what they have blamed.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ اَثْقَالَهُمْ وَاَثْقَالًۭا مَّعَ اَثْقَالِهِمْ ۖ وَلَيُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُواْ يَفْتَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And We sent Nooh towards his nation, and he remained among them for nine hundred fifty years, then his nation was overtaken by the storm, because they were unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا اِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ اَلْفَ سَنَةٍ اِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًۭا فَاَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَـٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Then We delivered Nooh and those who were in the Ark and made it a sign for the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَاَصْحَـٰبَ السَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And remember Ibrahim, when he said to his nation: Worship Allah and fear Him, this is better for you; if you know anything.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِبْرَٰهِيمَ اِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ اعْبُدُواْ اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ ۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ اِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: You worship only idols leaving Allah and forge lies on your own, remember, whomever you worship besides Allah are not the master of your sustenance, seek sustenance with Allah, worship Him, be grateful to Him, that you will all be taken to His Court.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ اَوْثَـٰنًۭا وَتَخْلُقُونَ اِفْكًا ۚ اِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًۭا فَابْتَغُواْ عِندَ اللَّهِ الرِّزْقَ وَاعْبُدُوهُ وَاشْكُرُواْ لَهُٓ ۖ اِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And if you will deny, then many nations have done this before you, and the responsibility of the Prophet is only to reach you the message manifestly.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن تُكَذِّبُواْ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ اُمَمٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ۖ وَ مَا عَلَى الرَّسُولِ اِلَّا الْبَلَـٰغُ الْمُبِينُ

verses.english_text: Did you not see that how Allah creates the creatures, and how he takes it back again, this is all very easy for Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُٓ ۚ اِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: Say: roam on the land and see how Allah has begun the creation, and then He will raise them again in the Hereafter, indeed He has power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ سِيرُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَانظُرُواْ كَيْفَ بَدَاَ الْخَلْقَ ۚ ثُمَّ اللَّهُ يُنشِئُ النَّشْاَةَ الْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: He punishes whom He pleases, He shows Mercy on whom He pleases, you will all be returned towards Him.
verses.arabic_text: يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَاِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ

verses.english_text: You cannot humble him in the earth and in the sky, and you do not have any other Guardian or Helper besides Him.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَا فِى السَّمَآءِ ۖ وَ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا نَصِيرٍۢ

verses.english_text: And those who deny Allah's signs and His meeting (in the Hereafter) are despaired of Our Mercy, and there is painful punishment for them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ اللَّهِ وَلِقَآئِهِٓ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُواْ مِن رَّحْمَتِى وَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: So there was not any reply from his (Ibrahim's) nation, but they said: slay him or burn him; so Allah delivered him from the fire, indeed, in it also there are many signs for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِٓ اِلَّآ اَن قَالُواْ اقْتُلُوهُ اَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَاَنجَىٰهُ اللَّهُ مِنَ النَّارِ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And Ibrahim said: only for the love of life of this world you have adopted idols leaving Allah, and on the Day of Judgement you will deny each other and curse each other, then your abode will be Hell and no one will be your helper.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ اِنَّمَا اتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ اَوْثَـٰنًۭا مَّوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِى الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُم بِبَعْضٍۢ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًۭا وَمَاْوَىٰكُمُ النَّارُ وَ مَا لَكُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Then Lut believed in him (Ibrahim) and said: I am migrating towards Allah and He is the Honorable and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ فَـَٔامَنَ لَهُ لُوطٌۭ ۘ وَقَالَ اِنِّى مُهَاجِرٌ اِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ ۖ اِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: And then We gave him children like Ishaq and Yaqoob, then kept book and prophethood in their progeny, and in the world recompense them and in the Hereafter, they will be counted among the good character people.
verses.arabic_text: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُٓ اِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتٰبَ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ اَجْرَهُ فِى الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَاِنَّهُ فِى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصَّـٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: Then remember Lut, when he said to his nation: you are doing such a bad act which nobody has done in the world before you.
verses.arabic_text: وَلُوطًا اِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِٓ اِنَّكُمْ لَتَاْتُونَ الْفَـٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ اَحَدٍۢ مِّنَ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: You are establishing sexual relations with men and cutting off the way and doing bad acts in your gatherings; then their nation does not have any reply besides that if you are truthful bring divine punishment which you are promising.
verses.arabic_text: اَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَاْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ السَّبِيلَ وَتَاْتُونَ فِى نَادِيكُمُ الْمُنكَرَ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِٓ اِلَّآ اَن قَالُواْ ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ اللَّهِ اِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: So Lut said: O Lord help me against this mischief making nation.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ انصُرْنِى عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ

verses.english_text: And when Our representative angels came to Ibrahim with glad tiding and gave him the news that we want to destroy the people of that settlement (because) they are very unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَآ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ بِالْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوٓاْ اِنَّا مُهْلِكُوٓاْ اَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ ۖ اِنَّ اَهْلَهَا كَانُواْ ظَـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: So Ibrahim said: Lut is also there, they said: we are aware of everybody, we will deliver him and his family except for his wife who is going to remain behind.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطًۭا ۚ قَالُواْ نَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِيهَا ۖ لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُ وَاَهْلَهُٓ اِلَّا امْرَاَتَهُ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَـٰبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: When Our angels came to Lut he got worried about the guests, they said don't fear and don't get worried we will save you and your family except your wife who will be among the people who will remain behind.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّآ اَن جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًۭا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًۭا وَ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ ۖ اِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَاَهْلَكَ اِلَّا امْرَاَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَـٰبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: We are going to send punishment from the sky on this settlement; they are behaving very immorally.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ اَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفْسُقُونَ

verses.english_text: And We left behind the manifest sign for the people of the settlement, who understand.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: And We sent his brother Shoaib towards Madyan, so he said: worship Allah and be hopeful of the Day of Judgement, and do not make mischief in the land.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ اَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُواْ اللَّهَ وَارْجُواْ الْيَوْمَ الْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْاْ فِى الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
