verses.english_text: So they rejected him, resulting in the earthquake overtaking them, and in their homes they fell upside down on their knees.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَاَصْبَحُواْ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And remember Aad and Samood. (after destruction) we made their dwelling appear to you clearly, and Satan had decorated their deeds for them and kept them apart from the path, however they were very intelligent.
verses.arabic_text: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَاْ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَـٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَـٰنُ اَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَكَانُواْ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And remind them of Qaroon, Firaun and Hamaan, to whom Moosa came with a manifest book, so they behaved proudly in the land; however, they were unable to go ahead of Us.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَ لَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا كَانُواْ سَـٰبِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We arrested everyone in their sins; on some, stones rained from the sky, some were overtaken by Mighty Scream from the sky, some were sunk in the ground, some were drowned in water; and Allah is not unjust on anyone, but they are being unjust to their souls themselves.
verses.arabic_text: فَكُلًّا اَخَذْنَا بِذَنۢبِهِ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًۭا وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ اَخَذَتْهُ الصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ اَغْرَقْنَا ۚ وَ مَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ اَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And whoever made guardians other than Allah, their example is like a spider, she made the house, but the weakest house is that of the spider, if they have got knowledge and perception.
verses.arabic_text: مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ اَوْلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ الْعَنكَبُوتِ اتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًۭا ۖ وَاِنَّ اَوْهَنَ الْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ الْعَنكَبُوتِ ۖ لَوْ كَانُواْ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Indeed, Allah knows whom they are calling, besides Him, and He is very Honorable and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: These examples We are describing for the entire world of humanity, but nobody can understand them, except the knowledgeable.
verses.arabic_text: وَتِلْكَ الْاَمْثَـٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ ۖ وَ مَا يَعْقِلُهَآ اِلَّا الْعَـٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Allah has created sky and the earth with the truth, and signs of Power are found in it for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Recite the Book which has been revealed to you, and establish prayer because it stops (you) from every bad deed and evil; and remembrance of Allah is a great thing, and Allah is well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اتْلُ مَآ اُوحِىَ اِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتٰبِ وَاَقِمِ الصَّلَوٰةَ ۖ اِنَّ الصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَآءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ اَكْبَرُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And do not debate with the people of book but in a very decent manner, except with those who are unjust; and say: we believe in whatever is revealed towards us and towards them, and our God and your God is one, and we are all obedient to Him.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَلَا تُجَـٰدِلُوٓاْ اَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ اِلَّا بِالَّتِى هِىَ اَحْسَنُ اِلَّا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَقُولُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِالَّذِىٓ اُنزِلَ اِلَيْنَا وَاُنزِلَ اِلَيْكُمْ وَاِلَـٰهُنَا وَاِلَـٰهُكُمْ وَٰحِدٌۭ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Like this We revealed the Book to you, so to whoever We gave the book earlier they believe in this book, and some of these people (Arabs) also believe in this (book), and Our verses are only denied by the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ اَنزَلْنَآ اِلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ ۚ فَالَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ ۖ وَمِنْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ ۚ وَ مَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ اِلَّا الْكَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet! Before the Quran you have not read any book and did not write anything with your hands otherwise people of falsehood would have doubted.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كُنتَ تَتْلُواْ مِن قَبْلِهِ مِن كِتٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ اِذًۭا لَّارْتَابَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ

verses.english_text: In fact, this Quran is the name of some open verses which are safe in their breasts to whom the knowledge is granted, and nobody deny our verses except the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ هُوَ اٰيٰتٌۢ بَيِّنَـٰتٌۭ فِى صُدُورِ الَّذِينَ اُوتُواْ الْعِلْمَ ۚ وَ مَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ اِلَّا الظَّـٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And these people say why the verses of Quran are not revealed to them, say: verses are all with Allah, I am just a manifest warner from the punishment of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ لَوْلَآ اُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ اٰيٰتٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِ ۖ قُلْ اِنَّمَا الْـَٔايَـٰتُ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَاِنَّمَآ اَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

verses.english_text: Is it not enough for them that We have revealed the Book on you which is recited before them, indeed in this is Mercy and reminder for the faithful nation.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ اَنَّآ اَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَرَحْمَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: You say to them: Allah is enough between me and you as a witness Who is aware of everything of sky and the earth, and those who believe in falsehood and deny Allah, are indeed losers.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًۭا ۖ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۗ وَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِالْبَـٰطِلِ وَكَفَرُواْ بِاللَّهِ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخَـٰسِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And these people are hastening for the punishment, however if its term was not appointed then punishment would have come, and it will come suddenly, and they will not be able to understand.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ ۚ وَلَوْلَآ اَجَلٌۭ مُّسَمًّۭى لَّجَآءَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَلَيَاْتِيَنَّهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: They are hastening for the punishment, whereas Hell is certainly going to encompass infidels in it.
verses.arabic_text: يَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَاِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌۢ بِالْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: The day when punishment will cover them from atop, and the bottom and will say now taste the recompense of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَغْشَىٰهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ اَرْجُلِهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُواْ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: O Our believing servants! My land is very spacious; hence worship Me only.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰعِبَادِىَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اِنَّ اَرْضِى وَٰسِعَةٌۭ فَاِيَّـٰىَ فَاعْبُدُونِ

verses.english_text: Every soul is going to taste death, then you all shall be brought to Our Court.
verses.arabic_text: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ذَآئِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ ۖ ثُمَّ اِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: Whoever believes and they did good work We will give them place in the lofty mansions of the Paradise beneath which rivers will be flowing and they will always abide in them, this is the best recompense for those who do good work.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ الْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًۭا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ نِعْمَ اَجْرُ الْعَـٰمِلِينَ

verses.english_text: Those who show patience and have trust in their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

verses.english_text: Many living creatures who walk on the earth cannot carry the burden of their sustenance, but Allah is giving the sustenance to them and to you, He Hears all and is aware of everyone's condition.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَاَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٍۢ لَّا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا اللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَاِيَّاكُمْ ۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: And if you ask them who has created sky and the earth and who brought about sun and the moon, they will immediately say: Allah did, then where they are deviating.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَئِن سَاَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ ۖ فَاَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ

verses.english_text: Allah create the expansion in whoever's sustenance He pleases of His servants, and straiten whoever's sustenance He pleases, He is well Cognizant of everything.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُٓ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And if you ask them who rained the water from sky, and enlivened earth once again after being dead, they will say: Allah did, then say: all Praises are for Allah, and majority of them do not use their intelligence.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَئِن سَاَلْتَهُم مَّن نَّزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَاَحْيَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ ۚ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: The life of this world is nothing but a play, and the abode of the Hereafter is the center for eternal life, if they would know and understand something.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا هَـٰذِهِ الْحَيَوٰةُ الدُّنْيَآ اِلَّا لَهْوٌۭ وَلَعِبٌۭ ۚ وَاِنَّ الدَّارَ الْـَٔاخِرَةَ لَهِىَ الْحَيَوَانُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُواْ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: When these people are on the ships, they call out to Allah with sincerity believing in Him and with dependence, but when He deliver them and reach them safely to the land, they immediately adopt polytheism.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا رَكِبُواْ فِى الْفُلْكِ دَعَوُاْ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ اِلَى الْبَرِّ اِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: Thus they deny to whatever We have given them and they enjoy in the world, shortly they will come to know of its result.
verses.arabic_text: لِيَكْفُرُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُواْ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Did not these people see that We have made a secure house for them, and that men are being snatched away from all around it; so do they believe in falsehood, and deny the favour (of Allah)?
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ اَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا ءَامِنًۭا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ النَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ ۚ اَفَبِالْبَـٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ يَكْفُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Who is the biggest unjust who attributes falsehood to Allah or denies the truth after its coming, so, is Hell not the abode of the infidels?
verses.arabic_text: وَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا اَوْ كَذَّبَ بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُٓ ۚ اَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًۭى لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And whoever struggled hard in Our way, We will guide them to Our ways, and indeed Allah is with the people who do the best deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ جَـٰهَدُواْ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَاِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Alif Laam Meem
verses.arabic_text: الٓمٓ

verses.english_text: Romans were defeated;
verses.arabic_text: غُلِبَتِ الرُّومُ

verses.english_text: In the nearest area, but after getting defeated, shortly they will dominate again.
verses.arabic_text: فِىٓ اَدْنَى الْاَرْضِ وَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ

verses.english_text: Within a few years, only Allah has the authority over the beginning and the end, and on that day believers shall rejoice.
verses.arabic_text: فِى بِضْعِ سِنِينَ ۗ لِلَّهِ الْاَمْرُ مِن قَبْلُ وَمِنۢ بَعْدُ ۚ وَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَفْرَحُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: With the help and aid of Allah, that He helps whom He pleases; and He is the Mighty and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: بِنَصْرِ اللَّهِ ۚ يَنصُرُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: This is the promise of Allah, and He does not go back on His promise, but majority of humans are unaware of this reality.
verses.arabic_text: وَعْدَ اللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: These people know the obvious of this world, and they are totally oblivious from the Hereafter.
verses.arabic_text: يَعْلَمُونَ ظَـٰهِرًا مِّنَ الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ عَنِ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Did not they reflect within themselves, that Allah has created with truth whatever is in the skies and on earth and in between them; and with an appointed term, but most of them are deniers of the meeting with their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُواْ فِىٓ اَنفُسِهِم ۗ مَّا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَآ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَاَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۗ وَاِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ بِلِقَآئِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Did not they travelled in the earth that they see the recompense of their earlier ones who were stronger from them, and they had populated the land with farming more than them, and Our messengers had come to them with more manifest signs; Verily Allah is not unjust to His servants, but they are unjust on their own souls.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوٓاْ اَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ وَاَثَارُواْ الْاَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوهَآ اَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ اَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: After that the recompense of evil people was bad, that they denied the signs of Allah, and they continue to make fun of them.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةَ الَّذِينَ اَسَـٰٓـُٔواْ السُّوٓاَىٰٓ اَن كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ اللَّهِ وَكَانُواْ بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

verses.english_text: Allah only begins the creation, and then returns them also, then all of you will be taken to His Court.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُاْ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ ثُمَّ اِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: When the Day of Judgment will be established, then all the guilty ones will be disappointed.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يُبْلِسُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And there won't be any intercessor among their partners, and they will deny their own partners.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَآئِهِمْ شُفَعَـٰٓؤُاْ وَكَانُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ كَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: When the Day of Judgement will be established, they will be divided into groups among themselves.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: Then the believers who had done good deeds, they will be happy and joyous in the gardens of Paradise.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَهُمْ فِى رَوْضَةٍۢ يُحْبَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And who adopted infidelity, and who denied Our verses and the Day of Judgement, they will Verily be entangled in the punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَلِقَآئِ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى الْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Therefore, Glorify your Lord in the evening and in the morning.
verses.arabic_text: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ اللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ

verses.english_text: All the Praise of the earth and the sky belong to Him, and at the time of evening and noon.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّۭا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ

verses.english_text: That Allah brings forth living out of the dead, and brings forth the dead from living; and brings to life again the dead earth, and like this you will also be raised one day.
verses.arabic_text: يُخْرِجُ الْحَىَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَىِّ وَيُحْىِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ

verses.english_text: And among His other signs one is that He created you from the dust, and then you expanded into a human being.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِٓ اَنْ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ اِذَآ اَنتُم بَشَرٌۭ تَنتَشِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And among His signs is that He created the pair for you among yourselves that you may find rest in them, then He made love and compassion between you, there are many signs in this for the people who ponder.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِٓ اَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ اَنفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَٰجًۭا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓاْ اِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةًۭ وَرَحْمَةً ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: And among His signs are creation of skies and the earth and difference between your languages and colour, there are many signs in this for the people who ponder.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِ خَلْقُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَـٰفُ اَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَاَلْوَٰنِكُمْ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّلْعَـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Among His signs are that you take rest during the night and the day and then search for the Mercy (Sustenance) of Allah, in this also there are many signs for the nation who hears.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِ مَنَامُكُم بِالَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَابْتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضْلِهِٓ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَسْمَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And He made lightning appear as a centre of fear and hope for you among His signs, and He rains water from the sky, and then through it brings to life the dead earth; indeed, in this also there are many signs for that nation who have intelligence.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِ يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًۭا وَطَمَعًۭا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَيُحْىِ بِهِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: And among His signs is that sky and the earth subsist through His command; and when He will call you, you all will come out of the earth at once.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِٓ اَن تَقُومَ السَّمَآءُ وَالْاَرْضُ بِاَمْرِهِ ۚ ثُمَّ اِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةًۭ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ اِذَآ اَنتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ

verses.english_text: Whatever is in sky and on the earth is his property, and everything is His obedient.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَهُ مَن فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُ قَـٰنِتُونَ

verses.english_text: And that is He, who begins the creation, then brings to life again, and this is very easy for Him, and to Him belongs the loftiest example in the sky and the earth, and He is Predominant on all and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِى يَبْدَؤُاْ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَهُوَ اَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَلَهُ الْمَثَلُ الْاَعْلَىٰ فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: He describes your example for you, that in the sustenance We have given you, you have partners with your slave and lady-slave who are your property, and you should fear them as you fear for your own souls; and Verily We relate Our signs distinctly for the nation who understand.
verses.arabic_text: ضَرَبَ لَكُم مَّثَلًۭا مِّنْ اَنفُسِكُمْ ۖ هَل لَّكُم مِّن مَّا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَـٰنُكُم مِّن شُرَكَآءَ فِى مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ فَاَنتُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌۭ تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ اَنفُسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Fact is that unjust followed their desires without understanding, to whoever Allah leaves in misguidance who can guide him? And they do not have any helpers either.
verses.arabic_text: بَلِ اتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ اَهْوَآءَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ ۖ فَمَن يَهْدِى مَنْ اَضَلَّ اللَّهُ ۖ وَ مَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Keep your face towards the religion, and get aside from the falsehood, this religion is that Divine Nature on which human beings have been created, and there can be no change in the Divine Creation, Verily this the straight and stable religion, but majority of the people are unaware of this.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًۭا ۚ فِطْرَتَ اللَّهِ الَّتِى فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا ۚ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: You all keep your attention towards Allah, and keep fearing Him, establish prayer and beware, do not be among the polytheists.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ مُنِيبِينَ اِلَيْهِ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَاَقِيمُواْ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَلَا تَكُونُواْ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ

verses.english_text: Those who have created the division in the religion, and got divided into groups, then all the groups are rejoicing with whatever they had with them.
verses.arabic_text: مِنَ الَّذِينَ فَرَّقُواْ دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُواْ شِيَعًۭا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ

verses.english_text: When any difficulty afflicts the people, they call upon their Lord with total attention; and thereafter when He makes them taste of His Mercy to them, one group among them shows polytheism.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا مَسَّ النَّاسَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَوْاْ رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ اِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ اِذَآ اَذَاقَهُم مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً اِذَا فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: That whatever We have given them they may deny, so you enjoy, afterwards you all shall come to know.
verses.arabic_text: لِيَكْفُرُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُواْ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Did We send any argument to them that justify their polytheism?
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ اَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنًۭا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُواْ بِهِ يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: When We make them taste Our Mercy, they become happy, and when any harm afflicts them due to their previous deeds, they are disappointed.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَآ اَذَقْنَا النَّاسَ رَحْمَةًۭ فَرِحُواْ بِهَا ۖ وَاِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ اَيْدِيهِمْ اِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ

verses.english_text: So did not these people see that Allah expands the sustenance to whoever He pleases, and straitens the sustenance to whoever He pleases, and in this also there are signs of Allah for the believing nation.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ اَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And give their share to the close relatives, poor, and needy-travelers, that this is good for them whoever desire Allah's pleasure, indeed they will be delivered.
verses.arabic_text: فَـَٔاتِ ذَا الْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُ وَالْمِسْكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ ۖ وَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: Whatever you give as usury that may increase the people's wealth, but it does not increase anything with Allah, but whatever you give as poor-rate with the intention to please Allah, you shall be recompensed with double and quadruple.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن رِّبًۭا لِّيَرْبُوَاْ فِىٓ اَمْوَٰلِ النَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُواْ عِندَ اللَّهِ ۖ وَ مَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن زَكَوٰةٍۢ تُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُضْعِفُونَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah Who has created you, then gave you sustenance, then gives death, then shall bring to life again; is there anyone among your partners who can do this? Allah is much high, exalted and pure, then with whoever they make His partners.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ الَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ۖ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَفْعَلُ مِن ذَٰلِكُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: Corruption has surfaced on the land and the sea because of the earning of the people, that Allah may give them taste of some of their deeds, and that people may come back on the (right) path.
verses.arabic_text: ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِى الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ اَيْدِى النَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعْضَ الَّذِى عَمِلُواْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: Say: travel on the land to see what has happened to the people earlier than you, majority of them were polytheists.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ سِيرُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَانظُرُواْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُم مُّشْرِكِينَ

verses.english_text: Keep your face straight and on the stable religion, before that the day may come when there is no way for return, and the day when people will be upset and separated.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ الْقَيِّمِ مِن قَبْلِ اَن يَاْتِىَ يَوْمٌۭ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ ۖ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصَّدَّعُونَ

verses.english_text: Who will not believe will be responsible for his own infidelity, and whoever is doing good deeds are making the way easy for themselves.
verses.arabic_text: مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا فَلِاَنفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُونَ

verses.english_text: So that Allah may reward with his Mercy to the believers and to those who do good works, and He does not like the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: لِيَجْزِىَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ مِن فَضْلِهِٓ ۚ اِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And one of His signs is that He sends winds of glad tidings so that you may taste His Mercy, and ships sail on his command that you can get your sustenance, and perhaps you may become grateful like this.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِٓ اَن يُرْسِلَ الرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَٰتٍۢ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِ وَلِتَجْرِىَ الْفُلْكُ بِاَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُواْ مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And We sent many messengers before you towards their nations, who came to them with manifest signs, then We took revenge with the guilty ones, and it was imperative on Us to help the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا اِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوهُم بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَانتَقَمْنَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ اَجْرَمُواْ ۖ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah who moves the winds that they fly the clouds, then He spreads the clouds in the sky wherever He pleases, and He breaks them into pieces, and rains water from amidst them, this water reaches those servants whom He pleases; then they become happy.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ الَّذِى يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَـٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًۭا فَيَبْسُطُهُ فِى السَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ وَيَجْعَلُهُ كِسَفًۭا فَتَرَى الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَـٰلِهِ ۖ فَاِذَآ اَصَابَ بِهِ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِٓ اِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Although they were disappointed before the arrival of the rain.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن كَانُواْ مِن قَبْلِ اَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن قَبْلِهِ لَمُبْلِسِينَ

verses.english_text: Now see the signs of Allah's Mercy that how He brings to life the dead earth, Verily, He brings to life the dead ones, and He has Power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: فَانظُرْ اِلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِ رَحْمَتِ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُحْىِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ اِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمُحْىِ الْمَوْتَىٰ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And if We would have blown the poisonous winds and they would have seen the yellow of autumn everywhere, then they would have completely adopted the infidelity.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَئِنْ اَرْسَلْنَا رِيحًۭا فَرَاَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّۭا لَّظَلُّواْ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِ يَكْفُرُونَ

verses.english_text: You cannot make the dead to hear your voice, nor you can make the deaf to hear your voice, when they turn their face and walk away.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَآءَ اِذَا وَلَّوْاْ مُدْبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And you cannot guide from misguidance to the blind, you can only make them hear who believe Our verses, and are Muslims.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَنتَ بِهَـٰدِ الْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَـٰلَتِهِمْ ۖ اِن تُسْمِعُ اِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah who created you out of weakness, then after weakness gave you strength; and (again) after strength gave the weakness, and gave old age; and He creates whatever He pleases, He has Knowledge and Power.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اللَّهُ الَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعْفٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍۢ قُوَّةًۭ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍۢ ضَعْفًۭا وَشَيْبَةًۭ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْقَدِيرُ

verses.english_text: When the Day of Judgement will be established, that day the guilty ones will swear and say we didn't stay in the world for more than an hour, in fact they were blaming such in the world also.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُواْ غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍۢ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَانُواْ يُؤْفَكُونَ

verses.english_text: And who are given the knowledge and faith, they will say: according to the Book of Allah you stayed until the Day of Judgement, this is the Day of Judgement and you are unaware.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ اُوتُواْ الْعِلْمَ وَالْاِيمَـٰنَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى كِتٰبِ اللَّهِ اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْبَعْثِ ۖ فَهَـٰذَا يَوْمُ الْبَعْثِ وَلَـٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Then today no apology will work for them, nor will they be heard.
verses.arabic_text: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يَنفَعُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ

verses.english_text: And we have described the examples of every kind in this Quran, even if you bring all the signs, these people will still say that you are the people of falsehood.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا الْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍۢ ۚ وَلَئِن جِئْتَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍۢ لَّيَقُولَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ اِنْ اَنتُمْ اِلَّا مُبْطِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily Allah seals their hearts who do not have any knowledge.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Therefore, have patience, promise of Allah is Truth; and beware, those who do not believe in this may not shake your firmness.
verses.arabic_text: فَاصْبِرْ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Alif Laam Meem
verses.arabic_text: الٓمٓ

verses.english_text: These are verses of the Book full of wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ الْكِتٰبِ الْحَكِيمِ

verses.english_text: Which is the guidance and mercy for the good character people.
verses.arabic_text: هُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةًۭ لِّلْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Who establish prayer and give poor-rate, and believe in the Hereafter.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِالْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ

verses.english_text: These people are on the guidance from their Lord and are going to prosper.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: There is a person among the people who purchase idle talk to misguide people without knowledge, from the path of Allah and make fun of divine verses, in fact for such people is the painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَشْتَرِى لَهْوَ الْحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And when divine verses are recited before him, he turns his face with pride, as if he has not heard anything, and as there is deafness in his ears; Give good news of painful punishment to such a person.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ اٰيٰتُنَا وَلَّىٰ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَاَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا كَاَنَّ فِىٓ اُذُنَيْهِ وَقْرًا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيمٍ

verses.english_text: Verily who believed and did righteous deeds, for them is the Paradise of bliss.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ النَّعِيمِ

verses.english_text: They will abide in it forever, this is the truthful promise of Allah, and He is Honorable and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقًّۭا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: He has created the skies without the pillars, you can see; He set upon earth huge mountains lest it move with you from its place, and has spread all types of animals, and We rained water from the sky, and through it made all types of fine creatures (vegetation), in pairs.
verses.arabic_text: خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍۢ تَرَوْنَهَا ۖ وَاَلْقَىٰ فِى الْاَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ اَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٍۢ ۚ وَاَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَاَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ

verses.english_text: This is the creation of Allah, so O infidels! Now show, what else can your gods create? Fact is that unjust are in clear misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا خَلْقُ اللَّهِ فَاَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقَ الَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِ ۚ بَلِ الظَّـٰلِمُونَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: And We bestowed wisdom upon Luqman ;that be grateful to Allah, whoever is grateful (to Allah) is for his own benefit, and whoever is ungrateful, he should know that Allah is Self-Sufficient and is worthy of praises also.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ الْحِكْمَةَ اَنِ اشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَاِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ

verses.english_text: And remember the time when Luqman enlightened his son, O son! Do not make any partner with Allah, polytheism is great unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَـٰنُ لِابْنِهِ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُ يَـٰبُنَىَّ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ ۖ اِنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And We have instructed humans about parents that mother has taken trouble over trouble and kept in the womb; and took two years of weaning from breastfeeding; be grateful to Me and your parents, that your return is towards Me only.
verses.arabic_text: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنسَـٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ اُمُّهُ وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍۢ وَفِصَـٰلُهُ فِى عَامَيْنِ اَنِ اشْكُرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَيْكَ اِلَىَّ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: And if your parents compel you to make something My partner of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them; but be kind to them in the world, and follow the path of him which reminds Me, then thereafter return of all of you are towards Me only; then I will inform you what you have done.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن جَـٰهَدَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ اَن تُشْرِكَ بِى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌۭ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا ۖ وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِى الدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًۭا ۖ وَاتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ اَنَابَ اِلَىَّ ۚ ثُمَّ اِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَاُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Son, good or evil, even if it is like a mustard-seed and beneath the stone or on the skies or in the depth of earth, Allah will Verily bring it forth on the Day of Judgement; He is Subtlest and well-aware.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰبُنَىَّ اِنَّهَآ اِن تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍۢ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍۢ فَتَكُن فِى صَخْرَةٍ اَوْ فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ اَوْ فِى الْاَرْضِ يَاْتِ بِهَا اللَّهُ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: O my Son! establish prayer, enjoin good and despise what is wrong, if any trouble afflicts you in the way of Allah, be patient, indeed that it is the matter of courage.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰبُنَىَّ اَقِمِ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَاْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَآ اَصَابَكَ ۖ اِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ الْاُمُورِ

verses.english_text: And do not turn your face away from people with disrespect, and do not walk with proud on earth, because Allah does not like haughty and boasters.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى الْاَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍۢ فَخُورٍۢ

verses.english_text: And pursue the middle course in your behavior, and keep your voice low, the worst sound is that of donkey.
verses.arabic_text: وَاقْصِدْ فِى مَشْيِكَ وَاغْضُضْ مِن صَوْتِكَ ۚ اِنَّ اَنكَرَ الْاَصْوَٰتِ لَصَوْتُ الْحَمِيرِ

verses.english_text: Did not you saw that Allah has made subservient you all the things of sky and the earth, and completed seen and unseen favors for you, and there are some among the people who argue about Allah without knowledge, guidance and the bright book.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَوْاْ اَنَّ اللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ وَاَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُ ظَـٰهِرَةًۭ وَبَاطِنَةًۭ ۗ وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يُجَـٰدِلُ فِى اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا هُدًۭى وَلَا كِتٰبٍۢ مُّنِيرٍۢ

verses.english_text: And when they are told to follow what is revealed by Allah, they say: we follow whatever our forefathers had followed, even if they are invited by Satan towards Hell.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّبِعُواْ مَآ اَنزَلَ اللَّهُ قَالُواْ بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ ۚ اَوَ لَوْ كَانَ الشَّيْطَـٰنُ يَدْعُوهُمْ اِلَىٰ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ

verses.english_text: And who turns his life wholly towards Allah and also has good character, then he has held the rope of guidance firmly, and on Allah is the end of all affairs.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَمَن يُسْلِمْ وَجْهَهُٓ اِلَى اللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌۭ فَقَدِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَىٰ ۗ وَاِلَى اللَّهِ عَـٰقِبَةُ الْاُمُورِ

verses.english_text: (O prophet!) You should not be sad if someone adopts infidelity, that everyone has to return to Us only; then We will inform them what they have done, indeed Allah knows the secrets of hearts also.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ كُفْرُهُٓ ۚ اِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓاْ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

verses.english_text: We will give them rest for some days, then shall drag and bring them towards the severest punishment.
verses.arabic_text: نُمَتِّعُهُمْ قَلِيلًۭا ثُمَّ نَضْطَرُّهُمْ اِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍۢ

verses.english_text: If you ask them who has created the sky and the earth, they will say: Allah did, then say all the Praises are for Allah; and majority of them are totally ignorant.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَئِن سَاَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ ۚ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Everything on the earth and in the sky is for Allah only, and He is Self-Sufficient and worthy of praise.
verses.arabic_text: لِلَّهِ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِىُّ الْحَمِيدُ

verses.english_text: If all the trees on the earth turn to pens, and to support seven more seas may come to assist the (seven) seas, even then words of Allah are not going to end, Verily Allah is Honorable and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ اَنَّمَا فِى الْاَرْضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ اَقْلَـٰمٌۭ وَالْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ اَبْحُرٍۢ مَّا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمَـٰتُ اللَّهِ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Creation of all of you and coming to life once again, is like one man, and Verily Allah is all-Hearing and all-Seeing.
verses.arabic_text: مَّا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلَا بَعْثُكُمْ اِلَّا كَنَفْسٍۢ وَٰحِدَةٍ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ

verses.english_text: Did you not see that it is Allah Who makes night to enter into the day; and makes day enter into the night; He made moon and the sun that they will continue to move until the appointed day, and Allah is Cognizant of your affairs.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللَّهَ يُولِجُ الَّيْلَ فِى النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِى الَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِىٓ اِلَىٰٓ اَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى وَاَنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: This is all because Allah is the truthful Lord, and to whomever they call besides Him are falsehood, Allah is Exalted, High and Great.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَاَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ الْبَـٰطِلُ وَاَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْعَلِىُّ الْكَبِيرُ

verses.english_text: Did you not see that ships are moving in the sea with Allah's Mercy, that He may show you His signs, there are big signs in this for the people who are patient and thankful.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ الْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى الْبَحْرِ بِنِعْمَتِ اللَّهِ لِيُرِيَكُم مِّنْ اٰيٰتِهِٓ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍۢ

verses.english_text: When any wave covers them like a shade they call out to Allah with total religious sincerity, and when he delivers them and reach them to the land, then only some of them remain on moderation, and only traitors and ungrateful people only deny Our verses.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا غَشِيَهُم مَّوْجٌۭ كَالظُّلَلِ دَعَوُاْ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ اِلَى الْبَرِّ فَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌۭ ۚ وَ مَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ اِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٍۢ كَفُورٍۢ

verses.english_text: O People! Fear your Lord, fear the day when father will not be useful to son nor son will be useful to father, Verily, Allah's promise is truth, therefore worldly life should not deceive you; and beware, let no deceiver deceive you.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمْ وَاخْشَوْاْ يَوْمًۭا لَّا يَجْزِى وَالِدٌ عَن وَلَدِهِ وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَن وَالِدِهِ شَيْـًٔا ۚ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَوٰةُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ

verses.english_text: Verily, knowledge of the Day of Judgement is with Allah only, and He rains the water, and He knows the condition inside of womb, and nobody know what he will earn tomorrow, and nobody know on which land he will die, Verily, Allah is Cognizant and is Aware.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللَّهَ عِندَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى الْاَرْحَامِ ۖ وَ مَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌۭ مَّاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًۭا ۖ وَ مَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌۢ بِاَىِّ اَرْضٍۢ تَمُوتُ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌۢ

verses.english_text: Alif Laam Meem
verses.arabic_text: الٓمٓ

verses.english_text: Indeed, revelation of this Book (Quran) is from the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.arabic_text: تَنزِيلُ الْكِتٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: What, are they saying this is all the forging of the prophet, absolutely not; this is the truth from your Lord, that you may warn the nation because no warner prophet has come to them earlier than you, perhaps they may take the guidance.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَىٰهُ ۚ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ اَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah who created skies and the earth and everything in between them within six days, then established His Power on the Throne, and for you there is no guardian and intercessor other than Him; are not you understanding this thing.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ الَّذِى خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ ۚ اَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: That Allah regulates the affairs from sky to the earth, then this plan will be presented in His Court on the day which according to your calculation is equivalent to a thousand years.
verses.arabic_text: يُدَبِّرُ الْاَمْرَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ اِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُٓ اَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah, the knower of all things; present and the unseen, and He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ عَـٰلِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَـٰدَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: He has made everything beautiful, and He has begun the creation of man with clay.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِىٓ اَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُ ۖ وَبَدَاَ خَلْقَ الْاِنسَـٰنِ مِن طِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: After that made his progeny come into existence, from despicable water.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُ مِن سُلَـٰلَةٍۢ مِّن مَّآءٍۢ مَّهِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Thereafter made him in due proportion and blew His spirit in it; and made for you ear, eye and heart, but you pay very less thanks.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِ ۖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَـٰرَ وَالْاَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And they say: if we are lost in the land, will we be raised again as a new creation? Thing is that they are the deniers of meeting with their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالُوٓاْ اَءِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِى الْاَرْضِ اَءِنَّا لَفِى خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۭ ۚ بَلْ هُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Say: Angel of death will reach you to the end of your life, who is deployed for you, thereafter you will all be presented in the Court of the Lord.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قُلْ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم مَّلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الَّذِى وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ اِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: Wish you see how guilty ones will be standing with their head bow down: Our Lord we saw and heard (now) send us back we will do the good work, Verily we are from the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ تَرَىٰٓ اِذِ الْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُواْ رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَآ اَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَارْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا اِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And if We pleases We would have guide every soul forcibly, but it has already been decided from Us that We will fill Hell with jinns and all misguided humans.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ شِئْنَا لَـَٔاتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَىٰهَا وَلَـٰكِنْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ مِنِّى لَاَمْلَاَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: Now you taste the thing that you had forgotten, Our today's meeting, then we have also neglected you, now taste the permanent punishment because of your past deeds.
verses.arabic_text: فَذُوقُواْ بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَآ اِنَّا نَسِينَـٰكُمْ ۖ وَذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Believers of our verses are only those, when they are reminded of Our verses they fall down in prostration, and glorify Allah with praises and are not proud.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا الَّذِينَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِهَا خَرُّواْ سُجَّدًۭا وَسَبَّحُواْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ ۩

verses.english_text: {Prostrate, Obligatory} Their backs are drawn away from their beds and they call out to their Lord out of fear and greed; and they spend in Our way out of what We have given them.
verses.arabic_text: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًۭا وَطَمَعًۭا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ

verses.english_text: And not any soul knows what is hidden for them to comfort their eyes, as a reward for their (good) deeds.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ مَّآ اُخْفِىَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ اَعْيُنٍۢ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: What, that person who is a believer can be like a transgressor, absolutely not, both cannot be the same.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًۭا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًۭا ۚ لَّا يَسْتَوُنَ

verses.english_text: Those who believed and did the good works, for their comfort are Paradises which are in reward to their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اَمَّا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ الْمَاْوَىٰ نُزُلًۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Who adopted transgression, their abode is Hell, when they will try to come out, they will be pushed inside again and will be said: now taste the fire which you had denied (in the world).
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمَّا الَّذِينَ فَسَقُواْ فَمَاْوَىٰهُمُ النَّارُ ۖ كُلَّمَآ اَرَادُوٓاْ اَن يَخْرُجُواْ مِنْهَآ اُعِيدُواْ فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ

verses.english_text: And before bigger punishment Verily We will make them taste the lesser punishment, perhaps like this they might come on the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ الْاَدْنَىٰ دُونَ الْعَذَابِ الْاَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: And who can be bigger unjust than he who is reminded of Divine Verses but he objects; Verily We will take revenge from the guilty ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ثُمَّ اَعْرَضَ عَنْهَآ ۚ اِنَّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنتَقِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And We gave book to Moosa also, therefore you should not doubt that the Quran is from Allah, and We made book of Moosa a guidance for Bani Israel.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتٰبَ فَلَا تَكُن فِى مِرْيَةٍۢ مِّن لِّقَآئِهِ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هُدًۭى لِّبَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

verses.english_text: And among them We made some leaders and chiefs, to guide them by Our command, and because they were patient and they believed in our verses.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ اَئِمَّةًۭ يَهْدُونَ بِاَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُواْ ۖ وَكَانُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, your Lord will decide between them on the Day of Judgement, in the matter they had disputed among them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

verses.english_text: Is it not enough for their guidance that We destroyed many nations before them, in the settlements they are moving around, and there are many signs in this, so do not they listen?
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ الْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَـٰكِنِهِمْ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ ۖ اَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ

verses.english_text: Do they not see that We move the water to the open fields and therewith produce agriculture through it, which they eat themselves and also feed their animals, so are not they seeing it.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ اَنَّا نَسُوقُ الْمَآءَ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًۭا تَاْكُلُ مِنْهُ اَنْعَـٰمُهُمْ وَاَنفُسُهُمْ ۖ اَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And these people say: when that day of victory will come, if you people are truthful?
verses.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْفَتْحُ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Say: those who adopt infidelity, neither their faith will benefit them on the day of victory, nor they will be given any respite.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ لَا يَنفَعُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ اِيمَـٰنُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Therefore, turn away from them, and wait for the time, they are also waiting.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَانتَظِرْ اِنَّهُم مُّنتَظِرُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Keep fearing Allah and beware, do not obey infidels and hypocrites, Verily Allah is Cognizant of everything and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَالْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: And follow whatever is being revealed to you from your Lord, Allah is well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ اِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: And rely on Allah, He is enough for your worries.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Allah has not given two hearts in any man's breast, nor He made your wives as your real mothers, whose back you liken to your mothers, nor He has made your adopted son your son, these are words of your mouth; and Allah says the truth, and guide to the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: مَّا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍۢ مِّن قَلْبَيْنِ فِى جَوْفِهِ ۚ وَ مَا جَعَلَ اَزْوَٰجَكُمُ الَّـٰٓـِٔى تُظَـٰهِرُونَ مِنْهُنَّ اُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۚ وَ مَا جَعَلَ اَدْعِيَآءَكُمْ اَبْنَآءَكُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُم بِاَفْوَٰهِكُمْ ۖ وَاللَّهُ يَقُولُ الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهْدِى السَّبِيلَ

verses.english_text: Call those children with their father's name, this is nearest to justice in the sight of Allah; if you do not know their father then in religion, they are your brothers and friends; there is no harm for you if you have committed any mistake, but you are responsible for whatever you have done knowingly, and Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: ادْعُوهُمْ لِـَٔابَآئِهِمْ هُوَ اَقْسَطُ عِندَ اللَّهِ ۚ فَاِن لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوٓاْ ءَابَآءَهُمْ فَاِخْوَٰنُكُمْ فِى الدِّينِ وَمَوَٰلِيكُمْ ۚ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌۭ فِيمَآ اَخْطَاْتُم بِهِ وَلَـٰكِن مَّا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

verses.english_text: Verily, prophet has much more right over the souls of the believers, and his wives are mothers to all; and among believers and migrants their close relatives are more important, but if you want to do good to friends then there is no harm, this is written and present in the book of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: النَّبِىُّ اَوْلَىٰ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ اَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَاَزْوَٰجُهُٓ اُمَّهَـٰتُهُمْ ۗ وَاُو۟لُواْ الْاَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ اَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍۢ فِى كِتٰبِ اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ اِلَّآ اَن تَفْعَلُوٓاْ اِلَىٰٓ اَوْلِيَآئِكُم مَّعْرُوفًۭا ۚ كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى الْكِتٰبِ مَسْطُورًا

verses.english_text: And remember the time when We took covenant from all prophets, especially with you and Nooh, Ibrahim, Moosa and Isa son of Maryam; and took very strong covenant from all.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ اَخَذْنَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِيثَـٰقَهُمْ وَمِنكَ وَمِن نُّوحٍۢ وَاِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ ۖ وَاَخَذْنَا مِنْهُم مِّيثَـٰقًا غَلِيظًۭا

verses.english_text: That He may question the truthfulness of their truth about sincerity of preaching; and Allah has made available very painful punishment for infidels.
verses.arabic_text: لِّيَسْـَٔلَ الصَّـٰدِقِينَ عَن صِدْقِهِمْ ۚ وَاَعَدَّ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابًا اَلِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: O believers! Remember the favor of Allah when army of infidelity confronted you, and We sent strong winds and such forces for your help which you could not see, and Allah is well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اذْكُرُواْ نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ اِذْ جَآءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌۭ فَاَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا وَجُنُودًۭا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: When infidels came from above and from below you, and eyes were expanded with terror, and hearts rose up to the throats, and you began thinking diversely about Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ جَآءُوكُم مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ اَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ وَاِذْ زَاغَتِ الْاَبْصَـٰرُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِاللَّهِ الظُّنُونَا۠

verses.english_text: That time believers were tested and they were given strong jerks.
verses.arabic_text: هُنَالِكَ ابْتُلِىَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُواْ زِلْزَالًۭا شَدِيدًۭا

verses.english_text: And infidels who had sickness in their hearts said: Allah and His prophet had only made deceptive promises with us.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ يَقُولُ الْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَ الَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ مَّا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُٓ اِلَّا غُرُورًا

verses.english_text: When one group said O people of Madina there is no place here, we should flee, among them one group asked for permission from the Prophet that their houses are empty, whereas they were not empty, but they were only trying to flee.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ قَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ يَـٰٓاَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَارْجِعُواْ ۚ وَيَسْتَـْٔذِنُ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُمُ النَّبِىَّ يَقُولُونَ اِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوْرَةٌۭ وَ مَا هِىَ بِعَوْرَةٍ ۖ اِن يُرِيدُونَ اِلَّا فِرَارًا

verses.english_text: And if such forces would have come from all points from around Madina, and they were asked for mischief, they immediately would have come, and they would have stayed in their houses just for little while.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ اَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُواْ الْفِتْنَةَ لَـَٔاتَوْهَا وَ مَا تَلَبَّثُواْ بِهَآ اِلَّا يَسِيرًا

verses.english_text: And Verily they have made a strong covenant with Allah that they will not turn their backs; and they will be enquired of their covenant with Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ كَانُواْ عَـٰهَدُواْ اللَّهَ مِن قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ الْاَدْبَـٰرَ ۚ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ اللَّهِ مَسْـُٔولًۭا

verses.english_text: Say: your fleeing out of fear of slaying or death will not work for you, you will be able to rest a little in the world.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لَّن يَنفَعَكُمُ الْفِرَارُ اِن فَرَرْتُم مِّنَ الْمَوْتِ اَوِ الْقَتْلِ وَاِذًۭا لَّا تُمَتَّعُونَ اِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Say: if Allah intends to do evil or good for you, then who can save you from Him, and these people cannot find any guardian or helper other than Him.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ مَن ذَا الَّذِى يَعْصِمُكُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ اِنْ اَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوٓءًا اَوْ اَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ ۚ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلِيًّۭا وَلَا نَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: Allah knows those also who hinder people from war and say to their brothers come to us and they themselves come to the battlefield very less.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنكُمْ وَالْقَآئِلِينَ لِاِخْوَٰنِهِمْ هَلُمَّ اِلَيْنَا ۖ وَلَا يَاْتُونَ الْبَاْسَ اِلَّا قَلِيلًا

verses.english_text: They are reluctant from you, when fear will come in front of them, they will see you as if their eyes are turning just as their death is near, when fear will wane away they will attack on you with sharp language, and they will be greedy of war-spoils, they have not believed from the beginning, hence, Allah has negated their deeds, and for Allah this is very easy.
verses.arabic_text: اَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَاِذَا جَآءَ الْخَوْفُ رَاَيْتَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ اِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ اَعْيُنُهُمْ كَالَّذِى يُغْشَىٰ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ ۖ فَاِذَا ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُم بِاَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ اَشِحَّةً عَلَى الْخَيْرِ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُواْ فَاَحْبَطَ اللَّهُ اَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا

verses.english_text: They are still thinking that the coalition forces of infidels have not gone away, and if the army come again, they will think, wish, they would have settled in the desert with villagers, and would get your news from there; and even if they were with you, yet they would have come to fight alongside you only for a little while.
verses.arabic_text: يَحْسَبُونَ الْاَحْزَابَ لَمْ يَذْهَبُواْ ۖ وَاِن يَاْتِ الْاَحْزَابُ يَوَدُّواْ لَوْ اَنَّهُم بَادُونَ فِى الْاَعْرَابِ يَسْـَٔلُونَ عَنْ اَنۢبَآئِكُمْ ۖ وَ لَوْ كَانُواْ فِيكُم مَّا قَـٰتَلُوٓاْ اِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: O Muslims! Life of the Prophet is an excellent example for those who are hopeful of Allah and the Day of Judgement and remember Allah a lot.
verses.arabic_text: لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌۭ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُواْ اللَّهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْـَٔاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا

verses.english_text: And the condition of the believers is such that when they saw the armies of infidelity they called out: this is the thing which Allah and His Prophet had promised, and the promise of Allah and His Prophet is truth; and this mob increased their faith and passion in them.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا رَءَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْاَحْزَابَ قَالُواْ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَصَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ۚ وَ مَا زَادَهُمْ اِلَّآ اِيمَـٰنًۭا وَتَسْلِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: There are many fighters among the believers who have completed the covenant made with Allah, and some of them have completed their time, and some of them are waiting, they have not made any change in their words.
verses.arabic_text: مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌۭ صَدَقُواْ مَا عَـٰهَدُواْ اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن قَضَىٰ نَحْبَهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَنتَظِرُ ۖ وَ مَا بَدَّلُواْ تَبْدِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: So that Allah recompense the truthful for their truth, and as for hypocrites either He may punish them or may accept their repentance, Verily, Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: لِّيَجْزِىَ اللَّهُ الصَّـٰدِقِينَ بِصِدْقِهِمْ وَيُعَذِّبَ الْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ اِن شَآءَ اَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: And Allah returned infidels along with their rage and they could not benefit any, and Allah saved the believers from the war, and Allah is very Powerful and Mighty.
verses.arabic_text: وَرَدَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِغَيْظِهِمْ لَمْ يَنَالُواْ خَيْرًا ۚ وَكَفَى اللَّهُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الْقِتَالَ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيزًۭا

verses.english_text: And he made people of book who were backing the infidels climb down their forts, and casted such a fear in their hearts that you killed some and took some as prisoners.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنزَلَ الَّذِينَ ظَـٰهَرُوهُم مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ مِن صَيَاصِيهِمْ وَقَذَفَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ فَرِيقًۭا تَقْتُلُونَ وَتَاْسِرُونَ فَرِيقًۭا

verses.english_text: And then made you inherit their land, their rivers and their wealth and made you inherit all the lands also in which you had not trodden, and Verily Allah has power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَوْرَثَكُمْ اَرْضَهُمْ وَدِيَـٰرَهُمْ وَاَمْوَٰلَهُمْ وَاَرْضًۭا لَّمْ تَطَـُٔوهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرًا

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Tell your wives: if you are desirous of beauty of this world, then come I will bid you goodbye with decency and wealth of the world.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ قُل لِّاَزْوَٰجِكَ اِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ الْحَيَوٰةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ اُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَاُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًۭا جَمِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And if you are desirous of Allah, Prophet and the Hereafter; then for women of good characters among you Allah has preserved the great reward.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الْـَٔاخِرَةَ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ اَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنَـٰتِ مِنكُنَّ اَجْرًا عَظِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: O wives of the Prophet! Whoever will commit the manifest evil among you, punishment for them will be double, and this is very easy for Allah.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰنِسَآءَ النَّبِىِّ مَن يَاْتِ مِنكُنَّ بِفَـٰحِشَةٍۢ مُّبَيِّنَةٍۢ يُضَـٰعَفْ لَهَا الْعَذَابُ ضِعْفَيْنِ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا

verses.english_text: And whoever among you will obey Allah and His Prophet and will do good deeds, We will give him double the reward, and We have provided the best sustenance for him.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَمَن يَقْنُتْ مِنكُنَّ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًۭا نُّؤْتِهَآ اَجْرَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ وَاَعْتَدْنَا لَهَا رِزْقًۭا كَرِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: O wives of the Prophet! If you are pious, then your status is not like other women, don't be soft in talk with any man, that if he has sickness in his heart he will yearn; and always speak good words.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰنِسَآءَ النَّبِىِّ لَسْتُنَّ كَاَحَدٍۢ مِّنَ النِّسَآءِ ۚ اِنِ اتَّقَيْتُنَّ فَلَا تَخْضَعْنَ بِالْقَوْلِ فَيَطْمَعَ الَّذِى فِى قَلْبِهِ مَرَضٌۭ وَقُلْنَ قَوْلًۭا مَّعْرُوفًۭا

verses.english_text: And stay in your houses and do not wear make-up like ignorant period, establish prayer and give poor-rate, and obey Allah and His Prophet, Allah intends, O people of household, to keep every uncleanness away from you, and purify you in such a way as it should be purified.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَرْنَ فِى بُيُوتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ الْجَـٰهِلِيَّةِ الْاُولَىٰ ۖ وَاَقِمْنَ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتِينَ الزَّكَوٰةَ وَاَطِعْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُٓ ۚ اِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمُ الرِّجْسَ اَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا

verses.english_text: And O Prophet's wives! Remember the Divine Verses and words of wisdom which are recited in your houses, because Allah is a very Meticulous Knower and Cognizant of everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَاذْكُرْنَ مَا يُتْلَىٰ فِى بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنْ اٰيٰتِ اللَّهِ وَالْحِكْمَةِ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ لَطِيفًا خَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: Verily, Muslim men and Muslim women, believing men and believing women, and men who obey and women who obey, and truthful men and truthful women, and patient men and patient women, and men who are humble and women who are humble; and men who give charity and women who give charity; and men who fast and women who fast, and men and women who guard their chastity, and men and women who profusely thank Allah; Allah has made available for them forgiveness and great reward for them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَـٰتِ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَالْقَـٰنِتِينَ وَالْقَـٰنِتَـٰتِ وَالصَّـٰدِقِينَ وَالصَّـٰدِقَـٰتِ وَالصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَالصَّـٰبِرَٰتِ وَالْخَـٰشِعِينَ وَالْخَـٰشِعَـٰتِ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقَـٰتِ وَالصَّـٰٓئِمِينَ وَالصَّـٰٓئِمَـٰتِ وَالْحَـٰفِظِينَ فُرُوجَهُمْ وَالْحَـٰفِظَـٰتِ وَالذَّٰكِرِينَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَالذَّٰكِرَٰتِ اَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةًۭ وَاَجْرًا عَظِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: It is not allowed for any believing man and woman that when Allah and His Prophet have judged in any matter, they should have their own choice, and whoever will be disobedient he/she will be in manifest misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍۢ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ اِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُٓ اَمْرًا اَن يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ اَمْرِهِمْ ۗ وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَـٰلًۭا مُّبِينًۭا

verses.english_text: And remember the time when you will telling him, upon whom Allah has shown the favor and you also have done favor and were telling him to retain your wife to yourself and keep fearing Allah, you are concealing in your heart which Allah wants to bring to light, but you were afraid of people's taunting, whereas Allah has greater right that He should be feared, and when Zaid had accomplished of his want of her, We married that lady to you, that for the believers there is no harm to marry (ex) wives of their adopted sons, when they have accomplished want of them; and Allah's command will however be implemented.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ اَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ اَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَاتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا اللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى النَّاسَ وَاللَّهُ اَحَقُّ اَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ اَزْوَٰجِ اَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ اِذَا قَضَوْاْ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا ۚ وَكَانَ اَمْرُ اللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا

verses.english_text: There is no harm for the prophet for Allah's duties which He has ordained for him, this Divine tradition of earlier prophets, and command of Allah is a decree that is made absolute.
verses.arabic_text: مَّا كَانَ عَلَى النَّبِىِّ مِنْ حَرَجٍۢ فِيمَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ۖ سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ فِى الَّذِينَ خَلَوْاْ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ وَكَانَ اَمْرُ اللَّهِ قَدَرًا مَّقْدُورًا

verses.english_text: They reach the messages of Allah to the people, and keep His fear in their hearts, and do not fear anybody except Him; and Allah is sufficient for accounting.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ اللَّهِ وَيَخْشَوْنَهُ وَلَا يَخْشَوْنَ اَحَدًا اِلَّا اللَّهَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ حَسِيبًۭا

verses.english_text: Mohammad is not the father for any of your men, he is prophet of Allah, and last in the series of the prophets (seal of the prophets), and Allah is well-aware of everything.
verses.arabic_text: مَّا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ اَبَآ اَحَدٍۢ مِّن رِّجَالِكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن رَّسُولَ اللَّهِ وَخَاتَمَ النَّبِيِّـۧنَ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: O believers, mention the name of Allah very frequently.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اذْكُرُواْ اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا

verses.english_text: Glorify Him morning and evening.
verses.arabic_text: وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةًۭ وَاَصِيلًا

verses.english_text: That is He who reveals the Mercy and all the angels also, that He bring you from darkness towards the light, and is very Merciful on the believers.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِى يُصَلِّى عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتُهُ لِيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَـٰتِ اِلَى النُّورِ ۚ وَكَانَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَحِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: The day when they will meet their Lord, their hospitality will be with salutations; and He has made available the best reward for them.
verses.arabic_text: تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهُ سَلَـٰمٌۭ ۚ وَاَعَدَّ لَهُمْ اَجْرًا كَرِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: O Prophet! We have made you witness, giver of glad tidings, and warner from the Divine punishment;
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ اِنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ شَـٰهِدًۭا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا

verses.english_text: And has sent you as inviter with the permission of Allah, and as bright lamp.
verses.arabic_text: وَدَاعِيًا اِلَى اللَّهِ بِاِذْنِهِ وَسِرَاجًۭا مُّنِيرًا

verses.english_text: Give glad tidings to the believers that there is great Grace and Mercy for them.
verses.arabic_text: وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِاَنَّ لَهُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ فَضْلًۭا كَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: And beware! Do not obey infidel and hypocrites, and do not think about their trouble, and rely on Allah that He is sufficient for guardianship.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَالْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَدَعْ اَذَىٰهُمْ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: O Believers, when you marry believing women and divorce them without touching them, then you cannot demand the 'iddat' duration, give some gift to them and bid them good-bye nicely.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اِذَا نَكَحْتُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبْلِ اَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ فَمَا لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ عِدَّةٍۢ تَعْتَدُّونَهَا ۖ فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ سَرَاحًۭا جَمِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: O Prophet! We have made to you lawful your wives whose dower you have paid, and lady-slaves whom Allah has given you without war, and daughters of your uncles, and daughters of your paternal-aunts, and daughters of your maternal-uncles; and daughters of your maternal-aunts who migrated with you, and believing women who gift their soul to the Prophet, if prophet wish to marry them, it is made lawful, but this is specially only for you and not for other believers; and We know what duty we have ordained for these people's wives and lady-slaves that there is no difficulty and trouble for you; and Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ اِنَّآ اَحْلَلْنَا لَكَ اَزْوَٰجَكَ الَّـٰتِىٓ ءَاتَيْتَ اُجُورَهُنَّ وَ مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ مِمَّآ اَفَآءَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمِّكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمَّـٰتِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَالِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَـٰلَـٰتِكَ الَّـٰتِى هَاجَرْنَ مَعَكَ وَامْرَاَةًۭ مُّؤْمِنَةً اِن وَهَبَتْ نَفْسَهَا لِلنَّبِىِّ اِنْ اَرَادَ النَّبِىُّ اَن يَسْتَنكِحَهَا خَالِصَةًۭ لَّكَ مِن دُونِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۗ قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا فَرَضْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِىٓ اَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَ مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ لِكَيْلَا يَكُونَ عَلَيْكَ حَرَجٌۭ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: Among them, from whoever you separate or you give refuge to some, if you like them whom you have separated there is no harm; this is because their eyes should be comforted and may not get sad, they should be happy with whatever you give them, and Allah knows the condition of your hearts, and is Cognizant of everything and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ تُرْجِى مَن تَشَآءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُـْٔوِىٓ اِلَيْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ وَمَنِ ابْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ اَدْنَىٰٓ اَن تَقَرَّ اَعْيُنُهُنَّ وَلَا يَحْزَنَّ وَيَرْضَيْنَ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْتَهُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَلِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: After that other women are not lawful for you, nor is it allowed that you exchange wives however beautiful they may be and you like them, except for those women who are your property (lady-slaves); and Allah is Watchful over everything.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا يَحِلُّ لَكَ النِّسَآءُ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَلَآ اَن تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِنْ اَزْوَٰجٍۢ وَ لَوْ اَعْجَبَكَ حُسْنُهُنَّ اِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ رَّقِيبًۭا

verses.english_text: O Believers! Do not enter the Prophet's house unless permission is given to you for meal, and even then do not keep an eye on the utensils, when you are invited then you can enter, and after food disperse immediately, and do not get busy in talking; because this troubles the Prophet; but he bears with you; however, although Allah is not shy from anything about the right of anybody, and when ask for anything from wives of the Prophet, ask them from behind the curtains; this is purer for you and them both, and you have no right to trouble the Prophet, and you should not marry his wives after him; this is a great talk in the sight of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَدْخُلُواْ بُيُوتَ النَّبِىِّ اِلَّآ اَن يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ اِلَىٰ طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَـٰظِرِينَ اِنَىٰهُ وَلَـٰكِنْ اِذَا دُعِيتُمْ فَادْخُلُواْ فَاِذَا طَعِمْتُمْ فَانتَشِرُواْ وَلَا مُسْتَـْٔنِسِينَ لِحَدِيثٍ ۚ اِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمْ كَانَ يُؤْذِى النَّبِىَّ فَيَسْتَحْىِ مِنكُمْ ۖ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَسْتَحْىِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ ۚ وَاِذَا سَاَلْتُمُوهُنَّ مَتَـٰعًۭا فَسْـَٔلُوهُنَّ مِن وَرَآءِ حِجَابٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ اَطْهَرُ لِقُلُوبِكُمْ وَقُلُوبِهِنَّ ۚ وَ مَا كَانَ لَكُمْ اَن تُؤْذُواْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلَآ اَن تَنكِحُوٓاْ اَزْوَٰجَهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِٓ اَبَدًا ۚ اِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمْ كَانَ عِندَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمًا

verses.english_text: You show anything, or conceal anything, eventually Allah knows everything.
verses.arabic_text: اِن تُبْدُواْ شَيْـًٔا اَوْ تُخْفُوهُ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: For women there is no harm if they come without a veil in front of their father and grandfather, their sons, their brothers, brother's sons, or sister's sons, or in front of their women or female slaves, but you keep fearing Allah, He is Watchful over everything.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِنَّ فِىٓ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ وَلَآ اَبْنَآئِهِنَّ وَلَآ اِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ وَلَآ اَبْنَآءِ اِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ وَلَآ اَبْنَآءِ اَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ وَلَا نِسَآئِهِنَّ وَلَا مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَـٰنُهُنَّ ۗ وَاتَّقِينَ اللَّهَ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدًا

verses.english_text: Indeed Allah and His angels send blessings on the Prophet, so O believers, you should also send blessings and salutations on him.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِىِّ ۚ يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ صَلُّواْ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُواْ تَسْلِيمًا

verses.english_text: Curses are upon them in the world and the Hereafter who trouble Allah and His Prophet, Allah has made available disgraceful punishment for them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِى الدُّنْيَا وَالْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَاَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًۭا مُّهِينًۭا

verses.english_text: And those who trouble believing men and believing women, for something other than what they have done, they are carrying the burden of false accusation and manifest sins on them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ بِغَيْرِ مَا اكْتَسَبُواْ فَقَدِ احْتَمَلُواْ بُهْتَـٰنًۭا وَاِثْمًۭا مُّبِينًۭا

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Say to your wives, daughters and believing women to cast their outer garments over them, this is nearer to their identity and decency, and in this way they will not be given trouble, Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ قُل لِّاَزْوَٰجِكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ وَنِسَآءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يُدْنِينَ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِن جَلَـٰبِيبِهِنَّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ اَدْنَىٰٓ اَن يُعْرَفْنَ فَلَا يُؤْذَيْنَ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: And if hypocrites and those who have sickness in their heart and who spread rumors in Madina, do not desist, then We will impose you upon them, and then these your neighbors will live only for few days.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ لَّئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ الْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَ الَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَالْمُرْجِفُونَ فِى الْمَدِينَةِ لَنُغْرِيَنَّكَ بِهِمْ ثُمَّ لَا يُجَاوِرُونَكَ فِيهَآ اِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: These people will be cursed, they will be seized wherever they are found, and they will be cut into pieces.
verses.arabic_text: مَّلْعُونِينَ ۖ اَيْنَمَا ثُقِفُوٓاْ اُخِذُواْ وَقُتِّلُواْ تَقْتِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: This is a divine tradition which has remained among the people who have gone by, and there cannot be any change in the divine tradition.
verses.arabic_text: سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ فِى الَّذِينَ خَلَوْاْ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: O Prophet! They ask you about the Day of Judgement; say: its knowledge with Allah, and what do you know, it may be near.
verses.arabic_text: يَسْـَٔلُكَ النَّاسُ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ ۖ قُلْ اِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِندَ اللَّهِ ۚ وَ مَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ قَرِيبًا

verses.english_text: Verily Allah has cursed the infidels and has arranged Hell for them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَنَ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَاَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيرًا

verses.english_text: They will remain in it forever, and they will not find guardian and helper.
verses.arabic_text: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ اَبَدًۭا ۖ لَّا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّۭا وَلَا نَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: That day their face will be turned towards Hell, and they will say: wish we would have obeyed Allah and His Prophet.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى النَّارِ يَقُولُونَ يَـٰلَيْتَنَآ اَطَعْنَا اللَّهَ وَاَطَعْنَا الرَّسُولَا۠

verses.english_text: And will say: we obeyed our chiefs and elders, and they strayed us.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ اِنَّآ اَطَعْنَا سَادَتَنَا وَكُبَرَآءَنَا فَاَضَلُّونَا السَّبِيلَا۠

verses.english_text: O Lord! Give them double the punishment and curse them greatly.
verses.arabic_text: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ وَالْعَنْهُمْ لَعْنًۭا كَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: O Believers! do not be like them who troubled Moosa, but Allah cleared him from their saying, and he was a very dignified person near Allah.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَكُونُواْ كَالَّذِينَ ءَاذَوْاْ مُوسَىٰ فَبَرَّاَهُ اللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُواْ ۚ وَكَانَ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَجِيهًۭا

verses.english_text: O Believers! Fear Allah and talk straight.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ وَقُولُواْ قَوْلًۭا سَدِيدًۭا

verses.english_text: So that He put your deeds to the right state and forgive your sins, and whoever will obey Allah and His Prophet will get the status of great success.
verses.arabic_text: يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ اَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا

verses.english_text: Verily, We presented trust to the sky, earth and the mountains, but everyone refused to carry it and expressed fear, it was humans who took it, that human is ignorant and unjust for his soul.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا عَرَضْنَا الْاَمَانَةَ عَلَى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَالْجِبَالِ فَاَبَيْنَ اَن يَحْمِلْنَهَا وَاَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا الْاِنسَـٰنُ ۖ اِنَّهُ كَانَ ظَلُومًۭا جَهُولًۭا

verses.english_text: So that Allah send the punishment on hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and polytheist men and polytheist women; and accept the repentance of believing men and believing women; Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: لِّيُعَذِّبَ اللَّهُ الْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَالْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكَـٰتِ وَيَتُوبَ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًۢا
