verses.english_text: All the Praises are for Allah who is controlling everything of sky and the earth, for Him is the Praise in the Hereafter, and He has Wisdom, and Cognizant of everything.
verses.arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى لَهُ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ

verses.english_text: He knows what things goes inside the earth and what comes out of it, and what things come from the sky and what things are ascended, He is Merciful and Forgiving.
verses.arabic_text: يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَ مَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ وَ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۚ وَهُوَ الرَّحِيمُ الْغَفُورُ

verses.english_text: Infidels say the Day of Judgment is not going to come, say: by Allah, it will Verily come, He has knowledge of the unseen, and no particle of sky and the earth is away from Him; nothing small or bigger than this but everything is present in this manifest Book.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَاْتِينَا السَّاعَةُ ۖ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتَاْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَـٰلِمِ الْغَيْبِ ۖ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍۢ فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَآ اَصْغَرُ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ اَكْبَرُ اِلَّا فِى كِتٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: So that He may reward those who believe and did good work, and for them is forgiveness and honorable sustenance.
verses.arabic_text: لِّيَجْزِىَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَرِزْقٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And whoever strives against our verses, for them We there is painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ سَعَوْ فِىٓ اٰيٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مِّن رِّجْزٍ اَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And whoever is given the knowledge they know that whatever is revealed on you is absolutely truth, and guide towards Allah, who is Predominant and worthy of Praise.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَرَى الَّذِينَ اُوتُواْ الْعِلْمَ الَّذِىٓ اُنزِلَ اِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ هُوَ الْحَقَّ وَيَهْدِىٓ اِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ

verses.english_text: And whoever adopted infidelity say: we will tell you about a person who gives the news that after your death when you will be scattered in parts, then you will be brought to life again as new creation.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ اِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ اِنَّكُمْ لَفِى خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍ

verses.english_text: He is forging on Allah or madness is found in him, no, those who do not believe in the Hereafter, they are suffering from punishment and misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: اَفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا اَم بِهِ جِنَّةٌۢ ۗ بَلِ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْـَٔاخِرَةِ فِى الْعَذَابِ وَالضَّلَـٰلِ الْبَعِيدِ

verses.english_text: Did not they see the skies and the earth, and things of their front and their back? If We wish we can sink them in the earth or make the sky fall on them in pieces, and in these signs of Power of Allah are found for those who ponder.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ اِلَىٰ مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيهِمْ وَ مَا خَلْفَهُم مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ اِن نَّشَاْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ الْاَرْضَ اَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ لِّكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ

verses.english_text: And We have done favour to Dawood that you do glorify with the mountains, and we made the iron soft for him.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَ لَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُدَ مِنَّا فَضْلًۭا ۖ يَـٰجِبَالُ اَوِّبِى مَعَهُ وَالطَّيْرَ ۖ وَاَلَنَّا لَهُ الْحَدِيدَ

verses.english_text: That you may make spacious and complete iron coats (armor) and be careful while joining the rings; and all of you do good deeds, and I am seeing your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اَنِ اعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى السَّرْدِ ۖ وَاعْمَلُواْ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ اِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And We made winds subservient to Soleiman that in the morning he travels the distance of one month and in the evening, he travels the distance of one month; and We made fountain of copper to flow out for him, and there were those among the jinns who worked for him with the command of Allah; and whoever deviated from our command, We will make him taste the Hellfire.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ الرِّيحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهْرٌۭ وَرَوَاحُهَا شَهْرٌۭ ۖ وَاَسَلْنَا لَهُ عَيْنَ الْقِطْرِ ۖ وَمِنَ الْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهِ ۖ وَمَن يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ اَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ

verses.english_text: They make whatever Suleiman wishes, like arcs, pictures; bowls as big as ponds; big pots that are firmly in the ground (and would not move); Dawood! be grateful; among Our servants there are very few who are grateful.
verses.arabic_text: يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُ مَا يَشَآءُ مِن مَّحَـٰرِيبَ وَتَمَـٰثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍۢ كَالْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍۢ رَّاسِيَـٰتٍ ۚ اعْمَلُوٓاْ ءَالَ دَاوُدَ شُكْرًا ۚ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مِّنْ عِبَادِىَ الشَّكُورُ

verses.english_text: Then when We decided for his death, nobody informed this to jinn except termite which were eating his staff, when he fell on the ground then jinns came to know (of his death); if they were aware of the unseen, they would not be suffering the disgraceful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِٓ اِلَّا دَآبَّةُ الْاَرْضِ تَاْكُلُ مِنسَاَتَهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ الْجِنُّ اَن لَّوْ كَانُواْ يَعْلَمُونَ الْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُواْ فِى الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ

verses.english_text: And for the nation of Saba there were Our signs in their city, there were gardens left and right on both sides; you people eat the sustenance given by Him and be thankful to Him, pure city (for you) and Forgiving Lord.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍۢ فِى مَسْكَنِهِمْ ءَايَةٌۭ ۖ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٍۢ وَشِمَالٍۢ ۖ كُلُواْ مِن رِّزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَاشْكُرُواْ لَهُ ۚ بَلْدَةٌۭ طَيِّبَةٌۭ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٌۭ

verses.english_text: But they deviated, and We sent a strong flood, then their two gardens turned such that their fruits were tasteless, some tamarix trees and some ber (jujube) plants were there.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَعْرَضُواْ فَاَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ الْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ اُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَاَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ

verses.english_text: This punishment was because of their ungratefulness, and to whom We give punishment, except the ungrateful.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَـٰهُم بِمَا كَفَرُواْ ۖ وَهَلْ نُجَـٰزِىٓ اِلَّا الْكَفُورَ

verses.english_text: And when We placed between them and the settlements which We had blessed, and appointed for the journey therein, now whenever you wish travel through them securely during the nights and days.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ الْقُرَى الَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا قُرًى ظَـٰهِرَةًۭ وَقَدَّرْنَا فِيهَا السَّيْرَ ۖ سِيرُواْ فِيهَا لَيَالِىَ وَاَيَّامًا ءَامِنِينَ

verses.english_text: On this they said: O Lord, make our journey far away and like this they were unjust on their souls; so We left them as tales and broke them into pieces; and Verily signs are found in them for those who are patient and grateful.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا بَـٰعِدْ بَيْنَ اَسْفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوٓاْ اَنفُسَهُمْ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ اَحَادِيثَ وَمَزَّقْنَـٰهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍۢ

verses.english_text: And Iblis made and showed his doubt as truth to them, so all the believers, except one group, obeyed him.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ اِبْلِيسُ ظَنَّهُ فَاتَّبَعُوهُ اِلَّا فَرِيقًۭا مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And Satan would not have dominated them, but We wanted to know who has belief in the Hereafter, and who is in doubt about it, and your Lord is the Guardian of everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كَانَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍ اِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِالْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِمَّنْ هُوَ مِنْهَا فِى شَكٍّۢ ۗ وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌۭ

verses.english_text: Say: call upon them whom you fancy except Allah, then you will see that they do not have power of even a particle in the skies and the earth, and neither they do have any part in the skies and the earth and nor they have any backer among them.
verses.arabic_text: قُلِ ادْعُواْ الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا لَهُمْ فِيهِمَا مِن شِرْكٍۢ وَ مَا لَهُ مِنْهُم مِّن ظَهِيرٍۢ

verses.english_text: No intercession will be accepted in front of Him, except to those whom He will allow, when fear shall be removed from their hearts they will be asked: what your Lord has said; they will reply: whatever He has said is the Truth, He is Most High and Great.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَنفَعُ الشَّفَـٰعَةُ عِندَهُٓ اِلَّا لِمَنْ اَذِنَ لَهُ ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُواْ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ قَالُواْ الْحَقَّ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَلِىُّ الْكَبِيرُ

verses.english_text: Say: who gives you sustenance from the sky and the earth, then tell them, Allah gives, then say: we or you are on a right path or in manifest misguidance?
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قُلْ مَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۖ قُلِ اللَّهُ ۖ وَاِنَّآ اَوْ اِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى اَوْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Tell them: you will not be questioned about our faults; neither will we be questioned about what you do.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لَّا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّآ اَجْرَمْنَا وَلَا نُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Say: one day Allah will gather us all, then will judge among us with the Truth, and He is the best decider.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَهُوَ الْفَتَّاحُ الْعَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: Say to them: just show us the partners whom you associate with Allah, they will never be able to show, because Lord is only Allah, Mighty and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَرُونِىَ الَّذِينَ اَلْحَقْتُم بِهِ شُرَكَآءَ ۖ كَلَّا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet! We have sent you to all people as a giver of glad tidings and as a warner, this is another matter that most of them are not aware of reality.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ اِلَّا كَآفَّةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And they say if you are truthful then when this promise of the Day of Judgement will be completed?
verses.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Say: for you one day's promise is appointed, you can neither retreat even for one hour from it nor you can go ahead.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لَّكُم مِّيعَادُ يَوْمٍۢ لَّا تَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ عَنْهُ سَاعَةًۭ وَلَا تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And these infidels say: they will not have belief on this Quran and neither on the earlier books, wish you would see when these unjust will be made to stand before the Lord, and everyone will return the talk to another, and those who are considered weak, they will say to the proud-ones that if you had not come in between we would have been believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ بِهَـٰذَا الْقُرْءَانِ وَلَا بِالَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ وَ لَوْ تَرَىٰٓ اِذِ الظَّـٰلِمُونَ مَوْقُوفُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ اِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ الْقَوْلَ يَقُولُ الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُواْ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُواْ لَوْلَآ اَنتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Then proud-ones will say to the weaker ones: after coming of the guidance did we stop you from accepting, never, you yourselves are the guilty.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوٓاْ اَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَـٰكُمْ عَنِ الْهُدَىٰ بَعْدَ اِذْ جَآءَكُم ۖ بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And weaker will say to the proud-ones that this is the result of your planning by night and you told us to deny the Lord, and to make similitude for Him; and after seeing the punishment they will be ashamed in their hearts; and We will put the shackles in the necks of the infidels, will they be given any other recompense for the deeds they had done.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُواْ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُواْ بَلْ مَكْرُ الَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ اِذْ تَاْمُرُونَنَآ اَن نَّكْفُرَ بِاللَّهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهُٓ اَندَادًۭا ۚ وَاَسَرُّواْ النَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَاَوُاْ الْعَذَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا الْاَغْلَـٰلَ فِىٓ اَعْنَاقِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ۚ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ اِلَّا مَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: We did not send any warner in the settlements but the proud-ones said we are the deniers of your message.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَا فِى قَرْيَةٍۢ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ اِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ اِنَّا بِمَآ اُرْسِلْتُم بِهِ كَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And they also said that we are better off with regards to wealth and children, and punishment is not going to come on us.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ نَحْنُ اَكْثَرُ اَمْوَٰلًۭا وَاَوْلَـٰدًۭا وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

verses.english_text: Say: My Lord increases or decreases the sustenance of whoever he pleases and, but many people do not know it.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: There is nothing in your wealth and children which can bring you near in My Presence, except that they believe and did good work, so for them is double the reward for their deeds, and they will be sitting in the high places with peace.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ اَوْلَـٰدُكُم بِالَّتِى تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰٓ اِلَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَآءُ الضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَهُمْ فِى الْغُرُفَـٰتِ ءَامِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And whoever strives in opposing our signs, they will be thrown in the punishment of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِىٓ اٰيٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى الْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily our Lord expands the means of sustenance among His servants He pleases; and straitens the sustenance of whom He pleases, and whatever you will spend in His way Verily He will reward you for that; and He is the Best giver of sustenance.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُ ۚ وَ مَآ اَنفَقْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّٰزِقِينَ

verses.english_text: The day Allah will collect them all and say to the angels: were they worshipping you?
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ اَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ اِيَّاكُمْ كَانُواْ يَعْبُدُونَ

verses.english_text: They will say: You are Pure, Self-Sufficient and our Master, they are nothing to us, they were worshipping jinns, and their majority were believers of them.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ اَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِم ۖ بَلْ كَانُواْ يَعْبُدُونَ الْجِنَّ ۖ اَكْثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: So today nobody will be the master of anybody's benefit or loss, and We will say to the unjust now taste punishment of Hell of which you had denied.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍۢ نَّفْعًۭا وَلَا ضَرًّۭا وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

verses.english_text: When Our clear verses were recited before them, they used to say that this person wants to desist you from worshipping to whom your forefathers had worshipped; this is a forged tale; and infidels always say whenever Truth comes in front of them that this is a manifest magic.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ قَالُواْ مَا هَـٰذَآ اِلَّا رَجُلٌۭ يُرِيدُ اَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَ قَالُواْ مَا هَـٰذَآ اِلَّآ اِفْكٌۭ مُّفْتَرًى ۚ وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ اِنْ هَـٰذَآ اِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And We did not send them any book which they recited, nor did We sent any warner to them before you.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّن كُتُبٍۢ يَدْرُسُونَهَا ۖ وَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَآ اِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِن نَّذِيرٍۢ

verses.english_text: And before them also people had denied messengers, however they did not even have one tenth of it which We had given to them, but they also denied the messengers, then you saw how dangerous was Our punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَ مَا بَلَغُواْ مِعْشَارَ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَذَّبُواْ رُسُلِى ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

verses.english_text: O Prophet, say: I admonish you only for one thing that rises in groups of ones and twos then ponder that your companion does not have any madness, he is only a warner about oncoming of the severest punishment.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قُلْ اِنَّمَآ اَعِظُكُم بِوَٰحِدَةٍ ۖ اَن تَقُومُواْ لِلَّهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُواْ ۚ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍ ۚ اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ لَّكُم بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: Say: the reward I am asking is for you only, my real reward is with the Lord, and He is witness to everything.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ مَا سَاَلْتُكُم مِّنْ اَجْرٍۢ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ ۖ اِنْ اَجْرِىَ اِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌۭ

verses.english_text: Say: my Lord puts the truth in hearts regularly and He is the knower of the unseen.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّ رَبِّى يَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّ عَلَّـٰمُ الْغُيُوبِ

verses.english_text: Say: Truth has come, and falsehood neither can create anything, nor it can return again (anything).
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ جَآءَ الْحَقُّ وَ مَا يُبْدِئُ الْبَـٰطِلُ وَ مَا يُعِيدُ

verses.english_text: Say: if I go astray, it will affect me only, and if I will get guidance, it will be because of revelation, He listens to all and is nearer than anybody else.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِن ضَلَلْتُ فَاِنَّمَآ اَضِلُّ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِى ۖ وَاِنِ اهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِىٓ اِلَىَّ رَبِّىٓ ۚ اِنَّهُ سَمِيعٌۭ قَرِيبٌۭ

verses.english_text: Wish you could see they will be frightened, and they could not be saved, and they will be caught hold of shortly.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ تَرَىٰٓ اِذْ فَزِعُواْ فَلَا فَوْتَ وَاُخِذُواْ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ

verses.english_text: They will say they believe, but how could they receive (Faith) from a position so far off.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِهِ وَاَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: They have denied earlier (the faith), and they speculate regarding the unseen from far off place.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَدْ كَفَرُواْ بِهِ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَيَقْذِفُونَ بِالْغَيْبِ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: And now curtains have been drawn between them and the things they desired, as was done with the earlier ones: that they are in a state of disquieting doubt.
verses.arabic_text: وَحِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِاَشْيَاعِهِم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مُّرِيبٍۭ

verses.english_text: All the Praises are for Allah, the creator of the skies and the earth, who makes angels his messengers, the angels who have two-two, three-three, and four-four wings, and increases the creation as much He pleases; indeed, He has power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ جَاعِلِ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا اُو۟لِىٓ اَجْنِحَةٍۢ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَـٰثَ وَرُبَـٰعَ ۚ يَزِيدُ فِى الْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: If Allah opens the doors of Mercy no one can stop Him, and to whoever He stops no one can send him, He is Predominant on everything, and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: مَّا يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍۢ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَ مَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: O People! Remember the Blessings of Allah, no one is Creator except Him, only He give you sustenance from the skies and the earth, there is no Lord except Him, so where you are deviating.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اذْكُرُواْ نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ هَلْ مِنْ خَـٰلِقٍ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَاَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ

verses.english_text: And if they deny you, before you also, they have denied many prophets and return of all the affairs is to the Lord only.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ۚ وَاِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْاُمُورُ

verses.english_text: O People! Promise of the Lord is Truth, so do not allow the life of the world to deceive you, and no deceiver should deceive you.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَوٰةُ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ

verses.english_text: Verily, Satan is your enemy, so consider him enemy, he invites them to his group that they all become people of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الشَّيْطَـٰنَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ فَاتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا ۚ اِنَّمَا يَدْعُواْ حِزْبَهُ لِيَكُونُواْ مِنْ اَصْحَـٰبِ السَّعِيرِ

verses.english_text: Whoever adopted infidelity there is severe punishment for them, and those who believe and did good work, there is forgiveness and big reward for them.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ وَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَاَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌ

verses.english_text: So can that person whose deeds have been decorated, and he thinks them good, can be same as a believer; to whoever Allah pleases leaves him in misguidance, and to whoever pleases He guides, do not grieve in their concern, Allah is well aware of their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنًۭا ۖ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَٰتٍ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah who sent winds to scatter the clouds, and We take them to the dead cities, and bring the dead land to the life again, and like this people would be raised to life (once again).
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ الَّذِىٓ اَرْسَلَ الرِّيَـٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًۭا فَسُقْنَـٰهُ اِلَىٰ بَلَدٍۢ مَّيِّتٍۢ فَاَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ النُّشُورُ

verses.english_text: Whoever is desirous of honor, should understand that all Honor belongs to the Lord, pure words rise towards Him; and good deeds lift them up, there is severe punishment for those who strive for evil; and their planning is after all going to perish.
verses.arabic_text: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا ۚ اِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ الْكَلِمُ الطَّيِّبُ وَالْعَمَلُ الصَّـٰلِحُ يَرْفَعُهُ ۚ وَ الَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ السَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ وَمَكْرُ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ

verses.english_text: And Allah has created you from dust, then made sperm, then made pair, and whatever a woman carries in her womb, or gives birth, is aware of all, then whoever is given long life or short life; everything is mentioned in the Divine Book, and for Allah it is all very easy.
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ اَزْوَٰجًۭا ۚ وَ مَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ اُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ اِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ ۚ وَ مَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍۢ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِٓ اِلَّا فِى كِتٰبٍ ۚ اِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And two seas cannot be the same, one with sweet and pleasant water and other with salty and bitter water; and yet from both of them you eat fresh meat and take out the jewelry which you wear; you see the ships which swiftly move on the water that you may search for the bounties of Allah (sustenance); perhaps you become thankful in this way.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يَسْتَوِى الْبَحْرَانِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌۭ فُرَاتٌۭ سَآئِغٌۭ شَرَابُهُ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ اُجَاجٌۭ ۖ وَمِن كُلٍّۢ تَاْكُلُونَ لَحْمًۭا طَرِيًّۭا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةًۭ تَلْبَسُونَهَا ۖ وَتَرَى الْفُلْكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُواْ مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And Allah makes to enter the night into the day, and makes to enter day into the night, Allah made subservient to sun and the moon, and they are moving (in the orbit) according to the appointed time, that is your Lord and He is the master of the universe, and besides Him whom you call out, they don't have even the control of the peel of the seed of the palm-date.
verses.arabic_text: يُولِجُ الَّيْلَ فِى النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِى الَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِاَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ ۚ وَ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِن قِطْمِيرٍ

verses.english_text: You will call them but they will not be able to listen to you, and if they hear, they will not be able to reply to you, and on the Day of Judgement they will deny your association, and nobody can say all this, except that Who Knows.
verses.arabic_text: اِن تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُواْ دُعَآءَكُمْ وَ لَوْ سَمِعُواْ مَا اسْتَجَابُواْ لَكُمْ ۖ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍۢ

verses.english_text: O People, you are all needy in the presence of Allah, and Allah is master of wealth and worthy of Praise.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اَنتُمُ الْفُقَرَآءُ اِلَى اللَّهِ ۖ وَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْغَنِىُّ الْحَمِيدُ

verses.english_text: If He pleases, He may take you all away and bring another creation in your place.
verses.arabic_text: اِن يَشَاْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَاْتِ بِخَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: And this is not a difficult task for Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍۢ

verses.english_text: And no one will carry the burden of another's sins, and if somebody will be called to carry this, he will not be able to lift anything, even if they are the kins, you can only warn those people, who fear Allah from the unseen, and who establishes prayer, and whoever will adopt purity will be for his benefit, and all of them have to return to Allah only.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ اُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَاِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ اِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌۭ وَ لَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰٓ ۗ اِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَيْبِ وَاَقَامُواْ الصَّلَوٰةَ ۚ وَمَن تَزَكَّىٰ فَاِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّىٰ لِنَفْسِهِ ۚ وَاِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: And blinds and seeing ones cannot be the same.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يَسْتَوِى الْاَعْمَىٰ وَالْبَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: And darkness and light both cannot be equal.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا الظُّلُمَـٰتُ وَلَا النُّورُ

verses.english_text: And shadow and sunlight cannot be the same.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا الظِّلُّ وَلَا الْحَرُورُ

verses.english_text: And alive and dead cannot be the same, and to whoever Allah pleases makes him hear to His words, you cannot make those hear who are living in the graves.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يَسْتَوِى الْاَحْيَآءُ وَلَا الْاَمْوَٰتُ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَ مَآ اَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍۢ مَّن فِى الْقُبُورِ

verses.english_text: You are just the warner.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ اَنتَ اِلَّا نَذِيرٌ

verses.english_text: We have sent as giver of glad tidings with the Truth, and there is no nation which was not sent a warner.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۚ وَاِن مِّنْ اُمَّةٍ اِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And if they deny you, people earlier than them also have done this, when messengers came to them with miracles, scriptures, clear book.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَبِالزُّبُرِ وَبِالْكِتٰبِ الْمُنِيرِ

verses.english_text: Then We caught hold of the infidels, then how dangerous was Our punishment.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَخَذْتُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

verses.english_text: Didn't you see that Allah sent the water from the sky, then We made fruits of different colors, and made ways in the mountains, white and red, and some of them were of black in color.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللَّهَ اَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَاَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ ثَمَرَٰتٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفًا اَلْوَٰنُهَا ۚ وَمِنَ الْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌۢ بِيضٌۭ وَحُمْرٌۭ مُّخْتَلِفٌ اَلْوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌۭ

verses.english_text: And different color of creatures are found among humans, cattle and animals, and among the people who fear Allah are those who have knowledge and wisdom, Verily, Allah is Honorable and very Forgiving.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ وَالدَّوَآبِّ وَالْاَنْعَـٰمِ مُخْتَلِفٌ اَلْوَٰنُهُ كَذَٰلِكَ ۗ اِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَـٰٓؤُاْ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ

verses.english_text: Verily, those who recite the Book (Quran), and they establish prayer, and spend (in the way of Allah) openly and secretly from whatever sustenance We have given them, they do such a business that will never be destroyed.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتٰبَ اللَّهِ وَاَقَامُواْ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَاَنفَقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ يَرْجُونَ تِجَـٰرَةًۭ لَّن تَبُورَ

verses.english_text: So that Allah give them their reward fully and may increase some with His Mercy and Blessings, indeed, Allah is very Forgiving and Appreciator.
verses.arabic_text: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ اُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِٓ ۚ اِنَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ شَكُورٌۭ

verses.english_text: The Book which We have revealed towards you is the Truth, and confirms its earlier books; indeed, Allah is aware of the condition of His servants; and Seeing.
verses.arabic_text: وَالَّذِىٓ اَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتٰبِ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِ لَخَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then We made to inherit this book to those whom We have chosen, some of them are unjust to their souls, some are moderate, and some of them goes ahead in doing the good work with the permission of Allah; and indeed, this is biggest blessing and excellence.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَوْرَثْنَا الْكِتٰبَ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۖ فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌۭ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌۢ بِالْخَيْرَٰتِ بِاِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ

verses.english_text: These people shall enter the ever-lasting Paradise, they will be given gold bracelet and pearl ornaments to wear, and their dress in the Paradise will be that of silk.
verses.arabic_text: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ اَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍۢ وَلُؤْلُؤًۭا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And they will say: thank Allah, He took us away from sadness, Verily, Allah is very Forgiving and Appreciator.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِىٓ اَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ ۖ اِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌۭ شَكُورٌ

verses.english_text: With His Blessings and Mercy, He has made us reach to a place where there is no tiredness and no trouble can touch us.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِىٓ اَحَلَّنَا دَارَ الْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌۭ

verses.english_text: There is Hellfire for those who adopted infidelity, and there neither death will come to them nor there would be any concession in their punishment, and We give punishment like this to the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُواْ وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى كُلَّ كَفُورٍۢ

verses.english_text: There they will plead: O Lord get us out of here we will do good works, as opposed to what we had been doing; so have not We given you the age, who wanted to take lesson could have taken; and a warner also had come to you; now taste the punishment, there is no help for the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَآ اَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا غَيْرَ الَّذِى كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ ۚ اَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَآءَكُمُ النَّذِيرُ ۖ فَذُوقُواْ فَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ

verses.english_text: Verily, Allah knows the unseen of the skies and the earth, and knows the secrets hidden in the hearts.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَـٰلِمُ غَيْبِ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ اِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

verses.english_text: That is Allah who made you successors of the earlier ones, and whoever will be infidel he will be responsible for himself, and infidelity in the sight of Allah does not increase anything except the divine wrath and loss.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ فِى الْاَرْضِ ۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ اِلَّا مَقْتًۭا ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ اِلَّا خَسَارًا

verses.english_text: Say: have you seen those whom you associate with Allah; show them to me also, that what they have created on earth, or do they have any association in the skies, or We have given them any book through which they can establish any argument; this is nothing, but unjust are deceiving among themselves and making false promises.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَآءَكُمُ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ اَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُواْ مِنَ الْاَرْضِ اَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌۭ فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ اَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتٰبًۭا فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ بَلْ اِن يَعِدُ الظَّـٰلِمُونَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا اِلَّا غُرُورًا

verses.english_text: Verily, Allah upholds skies and the earth from getting perish, apart from Allah if anybody else would have upheld them, they would have been perished, and He is very Forbearing and Forgiving.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ اَن تَزُولَا ۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ اِنْ اَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ اَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِٓ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا

verses.english_text: And these people have sworn strongest that if any warner come to us then we will be the most guided among all the Ummah, but when warner came, so nothing increased but hate.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَقْسَمُواْ بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ اَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ لَّيَكُونُنَّ اَهْدَىٰ مِنْ اِحْدَى الْاُمَمِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مَّا زَادَهُمْ اِلَّا نُفُورًا

verses.english_text: This is the result of proud and evil planning, however big evil plotters will be affected with their own plotting, now what they are awaiting about the method of Allah with regards to the earlier ones, and method of Allah is also not going to be changed, nor can there be any changes.
verses.arabic_text: اسْتِكْبَارًا فِى الْاَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ السَّيِّئِ ۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ الْمَكْرُ السَّيِّئُ اِلَّا بِاَهْلِهِ ۚ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ اِلَّا سُنَّتَ الْاَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًۭا ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا

verses.english_text: So did not they travel in the land to see what had happened to the earlier ones, whereas they were more powerful compared to them; nothing of the earth and the skies can humble Allah, verily, He knows everything and has power over them.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوٓاْ اَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۚ وَ مَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى الْاَرْضِ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ عَلِيمًۭا قَدِيرًا

verses.english_text: And were Allah to punish them all for they have done, then no living being would have been left on the earth, but He gives respite up to an appointed and fixed time, when that time will come then Allah has great insight for His servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُواْ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ اِلَىٰٓ اَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۖ فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَجَلُهُمْ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ بَصِيرًۢا

verses.english_text: Ya Seen
verses.arabic_text: يسٓ

verses.english_text: Swear by the Quran, full of wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْقُرْءَانِ الْحَكِيمِ

verses.english_text: You are from the messengers.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: Verily, you are on the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: This Quran is revealed by the Mighty and Merciful Allah.
verses.arabic_text: تَنزِيلَ الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ

verses.english_text: So that you warn this nation whose forefathers were not warned by any messengers, and they all remained negligent.
verses.arabic_text: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ اُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Indeed, on their majority Our punishment is confirmed, they are not going to believe.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ اَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: We have put shackles in their necks which are up to their chins, and they have raised their heads.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ اَعْنَـٰقِهِمْ اَغْلَـٰلًۭا فَهِىَ اِلَى الْاَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ

verses.english_text: And We have made one wall in front of them and one wall on their back, and then have covered them with punishment, they are unable to see anything.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ اَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّۭا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّۭا فَاَغْشَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Whether you warn them or not it is the same for them, they are not going to believe it.
verses.arabic_text: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَاَنذَرْتَهُمْ اَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: You can warn only those people who follow your admonition, and without seeing keep fearing the unseen Allah; you give glad tidings to those people for forgiveness and honorable reward.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ الرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِالْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَاَجْرٍۢ كَرِيمٍ

verses.english_text: Indeed, only We bring alive to the dead, and write down their deeds and impressions, and We have recorded everything in an explicit leader.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ الْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُواْ وَءَاثَـٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ اَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ فِىٓ اِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet! You mention to the people of the town to whom Our prophets had come.
verses.arabic_text: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا اَصْحَـٰبَ الْقَرْيَةِ اِذْ جَآءَهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Like this we sent two prophets but people denied them, so to help them We sent the third prophet, and all of them together announced that we have been sent to you (from Allah).
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ اَرْسَلْنَآ اِلَيْهِمُ اثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓاْ اِنَّآ اِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: you are all mortals like us, Beneficent (Allah) has not sent anybody, you are telling lies.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ مَآ اَنتُمْ اِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَ مَآ اَنزَلَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ اِنْ اَنتُمْ اِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: Our Lord knows that we have been sent towards you.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ اِنَّآ اِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ

verses.english_text: And our responsibility is to reach you with the message explicitly.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا عَلَيْنَآ اِلَّا الْبَلَـٰغُ الْمُبِينُ

verses.english_text: Those people said: you seem to be ill-omened, if you do not desist from your talk we will stone you, and we will give you severe punishment.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ اِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُواْ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: They replied: your evil fortune is with you; is this reminder any ill-omen, fact is that you are all people who do excesses.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ طَـٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ اَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ اَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّسْرِفُونَ

verses.english_text: From the corner of city a man came running and said: O people follow the prophets.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَآءَ مِنْ اَقْصَا الْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌۭ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ اتَّبِعُواْ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: Follow them, they do not ask any reward from you and are the guided ones.
verses.arabic_text: اتَّبِعُواْ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ اَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ

verses.english_text: And what has happened to me, that I do not worship Him who has created me, and you will all be returned to His Presence.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا لِىَ لَآ اَعْبُدُ الَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: Shall I adopt any other god besides Him, that if He wish to afflict me with any harm then nobody recommendation will be of any use, and nobody can save.
verses.arabic_text: ءَاَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِٓ ءَالِهَةً اِن يُرِدْنِ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ بِضُرٍّۢ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ

verses.english_text: I will be in open misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: اِنِّىٓ اِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

verses.english_text: I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me.
verses.arabic_text: اِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاسْمَعُونِ

verses.english_text: Resultant, that servant was told to enter Paradise, he said: I wish my nation also would have known this.
verses.arabic_text: قِيلَ ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: As to how my Lord has forgiven and has counted me among the honorable people.
verses.arabic_text: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And thereafter on those people We did not send any army, nor did We are going to send any army.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَ مَآ اَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِ مِن جُندٍۢ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَ مَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ

verses.english_text: That was a mighty blast, and then the light of life was extinguished.
verses.arabic_text: اِن كَانَتْ اِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَاِذَا هُمْ خَـٰمِدُونَ

verses.english_text: How sad is the condition of those servants that when any prophet comes to them, they mock him.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى الْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَاْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ اِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

verses.english_text: Did these people not see how many nations we destroyed before them, which are not going to return to them.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ الْقُرُونِ اَنَّهُمْ اِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: Then one day, all of them will be presented to Us.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن كُلٌّۭ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ

verses.english_text: For them one of Our signs is that dead earth, which We brought to life again, and grow seeds in them which they are eating.
verses.arabic_text: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ الْاَرْضُ الْمَيْتَةُ اَحْيَيْنَـٰهَا وَاَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَاْكُلُونَ

verses.english_text: In this land We created gardens of Palms and grapes and gushing springs.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّـٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَاَعْنَـٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ الْعُيُونِ

verses.english_text: So they eat the fruits, whereas it is not the work of their hands, then why do not they thank Us.
verses.arabic_text: لِيَاْكُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِ وَ مَا عَمِلَتْهُ اَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ اَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Pure and Self-Sufficient is that Lord who created all the pairs which grow on earth; and from their souls and from the things of which they do not have any knowledge.
verses.arabic_text: سُبْحَـٰنَ الَّذِى خَلَقَ الْاَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ الْاَرْضُ وَمِنْ اَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And for them night is a sign from which We pull out the day and they all go in darkness.
verses.arabic_text: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ الَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ النَّهَارَ فَاِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And the sun is running on its center point, this movement is established by the Mighty and Knowledgeable Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ

verses.english_text: And for the moon also We have appointed stages, so much so that at the end it becomes like a dry branch of a Palm tree.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَـٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ الْقَدِيمِ

verses.english_text: It is not possible for the sun to catch the moon, neither is it possible for the night to go beyond the day, and they are all floating in the sky and in orbit.
verses.arabic_text: لَا الشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ اَن تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَلَا الَّيْلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ

verses.english_text: And for them this is also a sign that we carried their elders in the laden ship.
verses.arabic_text: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ اَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ

verses.english_text: Like ship created many things on which they mount.
verses.arabic_text: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ

verses.english_text: If We wish We may drown them all, there will not be any helper for them nor they can be rescued.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن نَّشَاْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ

verses.english_text: But only with our Mercy, and We allow them to take rest for a period.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَـٰعًا اِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: And when they are told to fear this punishment, which can come from front or from behind, perhaps Mercy be shown on you.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُواْ مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيكُمْ وَ مَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

verses.english_text: So for them no signs come from the signs of Allah that they get aside from it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا تَاْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ اِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

verses.english_text: And when it is told to spend in His way from whatever sustenance is given by your Lord, then infidels say as a taunt that why we should feed them, if Allah pleased, He would have fed them Himself, you are in manifest misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ اَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ اللَّهُ اَطْعَمَهُٓ اِنْ اَنتُمْ اِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then they say: when this promise of the Day of Judgement will be completed; if you are truthful in your promise.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: In fact they are just waiting for a mighty blast which will seize them; and they will be quarrelling among themselves.
verses.arabic_text: مَا يَنظُرُونَ اِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَاْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ

verses.english_text: Then no one will be able to make a will; nor shall they be able to return to their families.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ اِلَىٰٓ اَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: And when the trumpet will be blown then everyone will rise from their graves and move towards their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَنُفِخَ فِى الصُّورِ فَاِذَا هُم مِّنَ الْاَجْدَاثِ اِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Will say: who raised us from our sleeping place, Verily this is the thing which Allah has promised, and His messengers had said the truth.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Day of the Judgement is a mighty blast, thereafter everyone will be brought in Our Presence.
verses.arabic_text: اِن كَانَتْ اِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَاِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then on this day no unjust will be done to any soul, and you will be given the reward as you had done the deeds.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, people of Paradise shall be enjoying in the different activities.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اَصْحَـٰبَ الْجَنَّةِ الْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَـٰكِهُونَ

verses.english_text: They and their wives shall be sitting in the shade of the Paradise, reclining with cushions on thrones.
verses.arabic_text: هُمْ وَاَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى الْاَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ

verses.english_text: There will be fresh fruits for them and any other things which they would wish.
verses.arabic_text: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ

verses.english_text: The only word from their Merciful Lord will be: Peace.
verses.arabic_text: سَلَـٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And O guilty! Get separated from them.
verses.arabic_text: وَامْتَـٰزُواْ الْيَوْمَ اَيُّهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And O children of Adam, had not we taken covenant from you that not to worship Satan, he is your manifest enemy.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اَلَمْ اَعْهَدْ اِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ اَن لَّا تَعْبُدُواْ الشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ اِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And worship Me only, this is the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنِ اعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: This Satan has misguided many of your generations, so will you also not use wisdom?
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ اَفَلَمْ تَكُونُواْ تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: This is Hell which was being promised to you in the world.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

verses.english_text: Go in it today, you have been practicing infidelity.
verses.arabic_text: اصْلَوْهَا الْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Today We will seal their mouth, their hands will speak, and their legs will testify, that what deeds they had been doing.
verses.arabic_text: الْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ اَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ اَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ اَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ

verses.english_text: And if We please, We would put out their eyes, then they will run about but how would they see?
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ اَعْيُنِهِمْ فَاسْتَبَقُواْ الصِّرَٰطَ فَاَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And if we please, We distort them totally, after that they neither be able to move ahead nor retreat.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا اسْتَطَـٰعُواْ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: And to whoever We give long life, in creation we reduce him to an abject state of childhood, so don't these people understand?
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى الْخَلْقِ ۖ اَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: And We have not taught our Prophet the poetry, and neither poetry is suitable for him, this is an admonition, open and bright Quran.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ الشِّعْرَ وَ مَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُٓ ۚ اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: That you warn the living persons from the punishment of Allah, and argument is completed on the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَى الْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Did not they see that for their benefit We created cattle with power of Our Hand, now they are called their masters.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ اَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ اَيْدِينَآ اَنْعَـٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ

verses.english_text: Then We made the animals submissive to them, so they use some of them for riding and eat some of them.
verses.arabic_text: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَاْكُلُونَ

verses.english_text: And there are many advantages in the animals for them and things for drinking also, then why don't they thank Allah?
verses.arabic_text: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ اَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: These people left Allah and made other gods, perhaps they may be helped.
verses.arabic_text: وَاتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

verses.english_text: However, they do not have the power to help them, and they are such an army that they themselves will also be presented before the Lord.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Therefore, O Prophet! Don't be sad with their talk, We know whatever they are expressing.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ اِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَ مَا يُعْلِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Didn't the humans see that We created them with sperm, and suddenly they become Our manifest enemies.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَرَ الْاِنسَـٰنُ اَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَاِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And describes likeness for Us, and has forgotten his creation and they say: who can bring to life again these decayed bones.
verses.arabic_text: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ الْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Say: who has created you for the first time, He will bring to life again, and He knows better all the creations.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا الَّذِىٓ اَنشَاَهَآ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: He made fire from a green tree for you, so you have been lighting the fire.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الشَّجَرِ الْاَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَاِذَآ اَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ

verses.english_text: So does not He Who created the skies and the earth be able to create the like of them; Verily, He can, he is the Best creator and the Knower.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَيْسَ الَّذِى خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ اَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ الْخَلَّـٰقُ الْعَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: And his command is only that when he intends to do anything He just say: Be and it becomes.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَآ اَمْرُهُٓ اِذَآ اَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا اَن يَقُولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ

verses.english_text: So, pure and Self-Sufficient is that Allah whose Hands possess all the power, and you all will be returned and taken to His Presence.
verses.arabic_text: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ الَّذِى بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: By those who range themselves in ranks.
verses.arabic_text: وَالصَّـٰٓفَّـٰتِ صَفًّۭا

verses.english_text: Then by those who warn them from evil.
verses.arabic_text: فَالزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًا

verses.english_text: Then by those who recite the Quran.
verses.arabic_text: فَالتَّـٰلِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا

verses.english_text: Verily, your Lord is One.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌۭ

verses.english_text: He is Lord of everything, whatever is between the skies and the earth, and master of every East.
verses.arabic_text: رَّبُّ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الْمَشَـٰرِقِ

verses.english_text: Verily We adorned the sky of earth with stars.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا زَيَّنَّا السَّمَآءَ الدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ الْكَوَاكِبِ

verses.english_text: And made them secure against every transgressor Satan.
verses.arabic_text: وَحِفْظًۭا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍۢ مَّارِدٍۢ

verses.english_text: Now Satans cannot try to hear anything from the higher world, and they will be killed from everywhere.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ اِلَى الْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍۢ

verses.english_text: To drive them off; and perpetual punishment for them.
verses.arabic_text: دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ وَاصِبٌ

verses.english_text: Except if anybody snatches off something, then an amber of flaring fire follows them.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ فَاَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌۭ ثَاقِبٌۭ

verses.english_text: Now ask them that they are the difficult creatures whom We have created, We have created them from sticky clay.
verses.arabic_text: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ اَهُمْ اَشَدُّ خَلْقًا اَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ اِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍۢ لَّازِبٍۭ

verses.english_text: Whereas you are surprised, and they mock you.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And when admonition is done (they) do not accept.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And when they see any sign, make a mockery of it.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا رَاَوْاْ ءَايَةًۭ يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And they say this is an open magic.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالُوٓاْ اِنْ هَـٰذَآ اِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

verses.english_text: When we die and become dust and bones, will we be raised again?
verses.arabic_text: اَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَـٰمًا اَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

verses.english_text: Will our forefathers also be brought to life?
verses.arabic_text: اَوَءَابَآؤُنَا الْاَوَّلُونَ

verses.english_text: Say: Verily you shall be humiliated.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَاَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ

verses.english_text: This Day of Judgement is just a challenge, after they shall all see.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَاِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And they will say: Alas! This is the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ

verses.english_text: This is that result which you had been denying.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ الَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ

verses.english_text: Angels! Gather the unjust and their companions and to those whom they had been worshipping leaving Allah.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ احْشُرُواْ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَاَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعْبُدُونَ

verses.english_text: And to all their gods and (also) to them, show the way to Hell.
verses.arabic_text: مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ فَاهْدُوهُمْ اِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ الْجَحِيمِ

verses.english_text: And stop them, they shall be questioned.
verses.arabic_text: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ اِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ

verses.english_text: Now what has happened to you, why don't you help each other?
verses.arabic_text: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Whereas, today everyone has bowed down his head.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ هُمُ الْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And they are questioning looking at each other.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Saying: you used to come from our right side.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ اِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَاْتُونَنَا عَنِ الْيَمِينِ

verses.english_text: They will say: you were not going to believe.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُواْ مُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And we did not had any command over you, you yourselves were a transgressing nation.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا طَـٰغِينَ

verses.english_text: Now Allah's punishment has proved on us, and will have to taste it.
verses.arabic_text: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ اِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ

verses.english_text: What! we misguided you; you were misguided yourselves.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَغْوَيْنَـٰكُمْ اِنَّا كُنَّا غَـٰوِينَ

verses.english_text: So they shall equally share the punishment today.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فِى الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: And we deal like this with the guilty ones.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: They used to behave proudly, when it is said there is no god but Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓاْ اِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا اللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And used to say, shall we leave our gods because of a mad poet?
verses.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ اَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍۢ مَّجْنُونٍۭ

verses.english_text: However, he had brought the Truth, and was confirming all the messengers.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ جَآءَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: Verily, you are going to taste the painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُواْ الْعَذَابِ الْاَلِيمِ

verses.english_text: And you will be given the recompense according to your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا تُجْزَوْنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Except sincere servants of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

verses.english_text: For them is the certain sustenance.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ

verses.english_text: There are fruits and they will live in a dignified manner.
verses.arabic_text: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ

verses.english_text: in the Paradises full of blessings.
verses.arabic_text: فِى جَنَّـٰتِ النَّعِيمِ

verses.english_text: They will be sitting on the thrones facing each other.
verses.arabic_text: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ

verses.english_text: There will be neat and clean beverages around them.
verses.arabic_text: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَاْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ

verses.english_text: Beverage of white color which the drinkers will enjoy.
verses.arabic_text: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍۢ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ

verses.english_text: From it there won't be any headache or loss of consciousness.
verses.arabic_text: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌۭ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ

verses.english_text: With them will be big-eyed Hooris restraining their glances.
verses.arabic_text: وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ الطَّرْفِ عِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: Their color will be like hidden eggs.
verses.arabic_text: كَاَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then they will ask while facing each other.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Then one of them will say there was a companion in the world.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ اِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: He used to say: do you also confirm the Day of Judgement?
verses.arabic_text: يَقُولُ اَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُصَدِّقِينَ

verses.english_text: When we will die and become dust and bones, will we be recompensed for our deeds?
verses.arabic_text: اَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَـٰمًا اَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ

verses.english_text: Will you also see this?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ هَلْ اَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ

verses.english_text: After saying this when they saw, they saw him in the middle of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: فَاطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ الْجَحِيمِ

verses.english_text: By God, it was near that you destroyed us.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ تَاللَّهِ اِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ

verses.english_text: If it was not the favour of Allah then I would also be present there.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ

verses.english_text: Is it not true that we are not going to die now.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ

verses.english_text: Except for the first death, there is no punishment for us now.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا الْاُولَىٰ وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

verses.english_text: Verily this is a big success.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ

verses.english_text: For this day the acts should be done by the act doers.
verses.arabic_text: لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ الْعَـٰمِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Just say, for hospitality it is better or the Zaqqum tree?
verses.arabic_text: اَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ نُّزُلًا اَمْ شَجَرَةُ الزَّقُّومِ

verses.english_text: Which I have made certain for testing of the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهَا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: This is a tree which comes out from the bottom of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌۭ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ اَصْلِ الْجَحِيمِ

verses.english_text: Its produce is as ugly as heads of Satans.
verses.arabic_text: طَلْعُهَا كَاَنَّهُ رُءُوسُ الشَّيَـٰطِينِ

verses.english_text: But people of Hell will eat and fill their bellies with it.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ

verses.english_text: Then there is hot water to drink, which will be mixed with pus, etc.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًۭا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then their final outcome will be Hell.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَاِلَى الْجَحِيمِ

verses.english_text: They had found their forefathers misguided.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُمْ اَلْفَوْاْ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ

verses.english_text: So they followed their footsteps.
verses.arabic_text: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And Verily, earlier a big group of their elders have gone strayed.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ اَكْثَرُ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: And We have sent messengers who warned them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Now see- what happens to those who are warned but they do not obey.
verses.arabic_text: فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ الْمُنذَرِينَ

verses.english_text: Except those who are sincere servants of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

verses.english_text: And Verily, Nooh called upon us, and We are the best Acceptor.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌۭ فَلَنِعْمَ الْمُجِيبُونَ

verses.english_text: We delivered him and his family from a great difficulty.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَاَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ

verses.english_text: And We made their children the survivors.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُ هُمُ الْبَاقِينَ

verses.english_text: And We let remain their mention, in the coming generations.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى الْـَٔاخِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Our salutation to Nooh in all divinity.
verses.arabic_text: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍۢ فِى الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Like this We recompense the good doers.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: He was from our believing servants.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We drowned them all.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَغْرَقْنَا الْـَٔاخَرِينَ

verses.english_text: And Verily Ibrahim was also the follower of Nooh.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَاِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِ لَاِبْرَٰهِيمَ

verses.english_text: When he came to the Presence of Allah with courteous heart.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍ

verses.english_text: When he told his father and his nation to worship Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ

verses.english_text: Are you seeking self-made gods leaving Allah?
verses.arabic_text: اَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةًۭ دُونَ اللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ

verses.english_text: Then what is your opinion about the Lord of the Worlds?
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Then Ibrahim gave a glance to the stars.
verses.arabic_text: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةًۭ فِى النُّجُومِ

verses.english_text: And said, I am sick.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَالَ اِنِّى سَقِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: So they turned their faces and left.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّوْاْ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And Ibrahim turned to their gods and said why don't you eat something?
verses.arabic_text: فَرَاغَ اِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ اَلَا تَاْكُلُونَ

verses.english_text: What has happened to you, why don't you speak?
verses.arabic_text: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ

verses.english_text: Then he started breaking them.
verses.arabic_text: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِالْيَمِينِ

verses.english_text: Then they come running to Ibrahim.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَقْبَلُوٓاْ اِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ

verses.english_text: So Ibrahim said, do you worship the idols crafted by your own hands?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ

verses.english_text: Whereas Allah has created you all.
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَ مَا تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: They said, make a house, light the fire and throw him in the fire.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ ابْنُواْ لَهُ بُنْيَـٰنًۭا فَاَلْقُوهُ فِى الْجَحِيمِ

verses.english_text: They wanted to do plotting, but We degraded and disgraced them.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَرَادُواْ بِهِ كَيْدًۭا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ الْاَسْفَلِينَ

verses.english_text: Ibrahim said, I am going towards my Lord, he will send guidance to me.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ اِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ اِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ

verses.english_text: O Lord, give me a righteous son.
verses.arabic_text: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ الصَّـٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We gave him glad tidings of a righteous son.
verses.arabic_text: فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: When the son reached the age and was able to run about, he told him, son I saw a dream that I am slaughtering you, now say what is your opinion, he said O father, follow, whatever you are commanded; Allah willing, you will find me among the patient ones.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ اِنِّىٓ اَرَىٰ فِى الْمَنَامِ اَنِّىٓ اَذْبَحُكَ فَانظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓاَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ اِن شَآءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّـٰبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: When both of them accepted; then the father made the son lie down upon his forehead.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ اَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ

verses.english_text: We called out: O Ibrahim!
verses.arabic_text: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ اَن يَـٰٓاِبْرَٰهِيمُ

verses.english_text: You made your dream come true, We reward like this for the good doers.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ الرُّءْيَآ ۚ اِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Verily, it is a very big manifest trial.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ الْبَلَـٰٓؤُاْ الْمُبِينُ

verses.english_text: And We have changed it with the Great Sacrifice.
verses.arabic_text: وَفَدَيْنَـٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And reminder of this will remain till the last era.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى الْـَٔاخِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Salutation to Ibrahim.
verses.arabic_text: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ

verses.english_text: Like this We reward doers of the good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Verily, Ibrahim was among our believing servants.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And We gave him glad tidings of Ishaq, who was a prophet and was among good servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِاِسْحَـٰقَ نَبِيًّۭا مِّنَ الصَّـٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: And We sent blessing on him and on Is’haq, and among his children some of them are of good character, and some are those who are openly unjust to their souls.
verses.arabic_text: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ اِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌۭ وَظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِ مُبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And We showed favours on Moosa and Haroon also.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ

verses.english_text: And delivered them and their nations from great difficulty.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ

verses.english_text: And helped them, so they became among those who gained dominance.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَانُواْ هُمُ الْغَـٰلِبِينَ

verses.english_text: We gave them the book of manifest meanings.
verses.arabic_text: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمَا الْكِتٰبَ الْمُسْتَبِينَ

verses.english_text: And have guided both of them towards the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمَا الصِّرَٰطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ

verses.english_text: And kept their remembrance also in their forthcoming generations.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى الْـَٔاخِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Salutations to Moosa and Haroon.
verses.arabic_text: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ

verses.english_text: Like this We reward the people who do good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Verily, those two were among our believing servants.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And Verily Ilyas was also among the messengers.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ اِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: When he said to his nation, why do you not fear Allah?
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِٓ اَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: Do you call out to Baol, leaving the best Creator?
verses.arabic_text: اَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًۭا وَتَذَرُونَ اَحْسَنَ الْخَـٰلِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Whereas Allah is your and your forefathers' Lord.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: Then they denied prophets, so they will all be overtaken by Hell.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَاِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Except for sincere servants of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

verses.english_text: And We also kept their remembrance in the future generations.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى الْـَٔاخِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Salutation on Children of Yaseen (Aal-e-Yaseen).
verses.arabic_text: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ اِلْ يَاسِينَ

verses.english_text: Like this we reward the doers of the good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Verily they were among Our believing servants.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And Lut were Verily was among the messengers.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ لُوطًۭا لَّمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We delivered him and his household.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَاَهْلَهُٓ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: Except for his wife who remained among the people who stayed behind.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا عَجُوزًۭا فِى الْغَـٰبِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We destroyed them all.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْـَٔاخَرِينَ

verses.english_text: You regularly pass by them during the morning.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ

verses.english_text: And at the night time also, so don’t you understand.
verses.arabic_text: وَبِالَّيْلِ ۗ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: And Verily Yunus was also among the messengers.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: When he ran towards a loaded ship.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ اَبَقَ اِلَى الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ

verses.english_text: And people of the ship drew his name and he was embarrassed.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُدْحَضِينَ

verses.english_text: Then fish swallowed him, when he was blaming on his own soul.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْتَقَمَهُ الْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: If he would not be among the glorifying.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَوْلَآ اَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُسَبِّحِينَ

verses.english_text: Then he would have remained in the belly (of fish) till the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِٓ اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

verses.english_text: Then We put him on ground when he was sick also.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُ بِالْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And caused to grow a pumpkin tree for him.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةًۭ مِّن يَقْطِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: And sent him as messenger towards over a lakh or more people.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ اِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ اَلْفٍ اَوْ يَزِيدُونَ

verses.english_text: They believed and We also gave him rest till a certain period.
verses.arabic_text: فَـَٔامَنُواْ فَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ اِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then O Prophet, ask these infidels: do your Lord have girls and you have boys?
verses.arabic_text: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ اَلِرَبِّكَ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ الْبَنُونَ

verses.english_text: Or We have created angels as girls and are they witness to it?
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ خَلَقْنَا الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ اِنَـٰثًۭا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ

verses.english_text: Be aware, this is their own forging.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَآ اِنَّهُم مِّنْ اِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ

verses.english_text: That son has born to Allah, they are all liars.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَدَ اللَّهُ وَاِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ

verses.english_text: That He has selected daughters in place of sons.
verses.arabic_text: اَصْطَفَى الْبَنَاتِ عَلَى الْبَنِينَ

verses.english_text: What has happened you, what you are deciding?
verses.arabic_text: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ

verses.english_text: Don't you ponder over it?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: Or you have more explicit argument?
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then bring your book, if you are truthful.
verses.arabic_text: فَاْتُواْ بِكِتٰبِكُمْ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: They have made a relation between Allah and the jinns, whereas jinns know that they will also be presented before Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًۭا ۚ وَ لَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ الْجِنَّةُ اِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Allah is higher and purer than all these talks.
verses.arabic_text: سُبْحَـٰنَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

verses.english_text: Except for the sincere servants of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

verses.english_text: Then you and whom you worship.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنَّكُمْ وَ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

verses.english_text: All of them together cannot misguide (anyone) against Him.
verses.arabic_text: مَآ اَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَـٰتِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Except those who eventually have to go to Hell.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ الْجَحِيمِ

verses.english_text: And for every one of us a place is certain.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا مِنَّآ اِلَّا لَهُ مَقَامٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ

verses.english_text: And We are all going to be lined up in His Presence.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الصَّآفُّونَ

verses.english_text: And we are all those who glorify Him.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْمُسَبِّحُونَ

verses.english_text: Whereas these people used to say this.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن كَانُواْ لَيَقُولُونَ

verses.english_text: Had we a reminder from those of earlier ones.
verses.arabic_text: لَوْ اَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: Then we also would have been good and sincere servants.
verses.arabic_text: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

verses.english_text: They adopted infidelity, shortly they will come to know of its result.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَفَرُواْ بِهِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And we had already decided with our servants, the prophets.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: Their will Verily be helped.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ الْمَنصُورُونَ

verses.english_text: And Our army is Verily going to dominate.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ الْغَـٰلِبُونَ

verses.english_text: Therefore, you turn your face aside from them for some days.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Keep looking at them, soon they will see their result themselves.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Are they hastening for Our punishment?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

verses.english_text: When the punishment will come in their courtyard, that will be the worst morning for the nation which was warned.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنذَرِينَ

verses.english_text: You turn your face aside from them for some days.
