verses.arabic_text: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: And keep looking, shortly they will see themselves.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Your Lord is honourable, and is purer than this talk.
verses.arabic_text: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

verses.english_text: Our salutations to the messengers.
verses.arabic_text: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.english_text: All praises be to Allah, for the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Saad, by the Quran, full of admonition.
verses.arabic_text: صٓ ۚ وَالْقُرْءَانِ ذِى الذِّكْرِ

verses.english_text: Fact is that infidels are in proud and in disagreement.
verses.arabic_text: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِى عِزَّةٍۢ وَشِقَاقٍۢ

verses.english_text: We have destroyed many generations before them, then they pleaded but no respite was possible.
verses.arabic_text: كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍۢ

verses.english_text: And they are surprised, how a warner has come among them; and infidels clearly said this is a magician and a liar.
verses.arabic_text: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ اَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ الْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌۭ كَذَّابٌ

verses.english_text: Has he merged many gods and made one god, this is very surprising.
verses.arabic_text: اَجَعَلَ الْـَٔالِهَةَ اِلَـٰهًۭا وَٰحِدًا ۖ اِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌۭ

verses.english_text: And one group said this and walked away: be on your own gods, some other thing is found in it.
verses.arabic_text: وَانطَلَقَ الْمَلَاُ مِنْهُمْ اَنِ امْشُواْ وَاصْبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ اِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌۭ يُرَادُ

verses.english_text: We did not hear this among earlier generations, it looks as if it has been forged.
verses.arabic_text: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى الْمِلَّةِ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ اِنْ هَـٰذَآ اِلَّا اخْتِلَـٰقٌ

verses.english_text: Among us only the book has been revealed to him; fact is that they have doubt in Our book, or rather they have not tasted Our punishment yet.
verses.arabic_text: اَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ

verses.english_text: Do they have any treasure from your honorable Allah, the Mighty, the Great Giver.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيزِ الْوَهَّابِ

verses.english_text: Or they have an option between sky and the earth that they climb the sky with a ladder.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُواْ فِى الْاَسْبَـٰبِ

verses.english_text: Of all the groups, one group is going to be defeated here also.
verses.arabic_text: جُندٌۭ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌۭ مِّنَ الْاَحْزَابِ

verses.english_text: The people of Nuh and Aad, and Firaun, the lord of spikes, have all passed by.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْاَوْتَادِ

verses.english_text: And Samood, people of Lut and people of forest, they have all passed by.
verses.arabic_text: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ وَاَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الْاَحْزَابُ

verses.english_text: All of them denied the prophets, so Our punishment was proven on them.
verses.arabic_text: اِن كُلٌّ اِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ

verses.english_text: They are just waiting for a mighty blast and they shall not be given even a little respite.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ اِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍۢ

verses.english_text: And they say: O Lord whatever you have written in our fate give us before the day of accounting.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ

verses.english_text: Be patient in their talk, and remember Our servant Dawood, who was very powerful and was oft-returning in Our Presence.
verses.arabic_text: اصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُدَ ذَا الْاَيْدِ ۖ اِنَّهُٓ اَوَّابٌ

verses.english_text: We made mountains subservient to him, that they may glorify Allah with him in the morning and in the evening.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِىِّ وَالْاِشْرَاقِ

verses.english_text: We made to gather birds around him, they were all his subservient.
verses.arabic_text: وَالطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةًۭ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُٓ اَوَّابٌۭ

verses.english_text: And We made his kingdom stronger, and gave him wisdom, and knowledge to make clear judgement.
verses.arabic_text: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ

verses.english_text: Did you get the news of those who were quarrelling, who entered by jumping the wall of arch.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَهَلْ اَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُاْ الْخَصْمِ اِذْ تَسَوَّرُواْ الْمِحْرَابَ

verses.english_text: When they came in front of Dawood, he felt frightened, they said do not be frightened we are two litigants, one has been unjust towards the other, you decide with truth and do not do injustice, and guide us to the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنَآ اِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ الصِّرَٰطِ

verses.english_text: This is my brother; he has ninety-nine ewes and I have only one; he is saying give that also to me, and he is being difficult in it.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَـٰذَآ اَخِى لَهُ تِسْعٌۭ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةًۭ وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَقَالَ اَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى الْخِطَابِ

verses.english_text: Dawood said: he has been unjust to you by demanding your ewe; and there are many partners who are unjust to each other, except those who are believers and do good deeds, and such people are few; Dawood thought that Allah had tested him, so he repented from Allah and fell in prostration, and turn his attention totally towards Us.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ اِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِ ۖ وَاِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ اِلَّا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُدُ اَنَّمَا فَتَنَّـٰهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًۭا وَاَنَابَ ۩

verses.english_text: {Prostrate Non-Obligatory} So we forgive him, he has nearness to Us and an excellent return.
verses.arabic_text: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَاِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ

verses.english_text: O Dawood! We made you Our vicegerent on the earth, so you do justice among people with truth, and do not follow the desires which deviate you from the path of Allah; Verily those who deviate from the path of Allah, there is severe punishment for them that they have underestimated the Day of Account totally.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰدَاوُدُ اِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰكَ خَلِيفَةًۭ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ

verses.english_text: We have not created skies and the earth and things between them worthless, this is the thinking of infidels, then woe to the infidels on account of the fire.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَآءَ وَالْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَـٰطِلًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ النَّارِ

verses.english_text: Shall We declare those who believed and did good work and those who create mischief on earth as one; or (shall We) declare the pious people as mischief makers and transgressors?
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى الْاَرْضِ اَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِينَ كَالْفُجَّارِ

verses.english_text: This is a blessed book which We have revealed towards you, so that people ponder over its verses and knowledgeable persons may take admonition from it.
verses.arabic_text: كِتٰبٌ اَنزَلْنَـٰهُ اِلَيْكَ مُبَـٰرَكٌۭ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓاْ اٰيٰتِهِ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ اُو۟لُواْ الْاَلْبَـٰبِ

verses.english_text: And We gave to Dawood a son like Suleiman, who is the best servant, and who turns to Us.
verses.arabic_text: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُدَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۖ اِنَّهُٓ اَوَّابٌ

verses.english_text: When in the evening horses of the highest breed were presented to him.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِىِّ الصَّـٰفِنَـٰتُ الْجِيَادُ

verses.english_text: So, he said: I prefer the good remembrance of Allah, and horses vanished from his eyes while running.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَالَ اِنِّىٓ اَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ

verses.english_text: He said: bring them back to me, and he started pressing his hand over their calves and necks.
verses.arabic_text: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِالسُّوقِ وَالْاَعْنَاقِ

verses.english_text: Then We tested Suleiman, We put a lifeless body on his throne, then he turned to Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَاَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِ جَسَدًۭا ثُمَّ اَنَابَ

verses.english_text: And said: O Lord forgive me, and grant me a kingdom which no one else is worthy of after me, and you are the best giver.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًۭا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِاَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ اِنَّكَ اَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ

verses.english_text: Then We made winds subservient to him, and made it his command to run gently wherever he desired.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِاَمْرِهِ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ اَصَابَ

verses.english_text: And all the masons and divers among Satans were made subservient to him.
verses.arabic_text: وَالشَّيَـٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍۢ وَغَوَّاصٍۢ

verses.english_text: And to Satans also were tied up in chains due to their transgression.
verses.arabic_text: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى الْاَصْفَادِ

verses.english_text: This is Our bestowing, either give it to people or keep it with you.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَامْنُنْ اَوْ اَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ

verses.english_text: And for him is the nearness in Our Presence, and the best recompense.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ

verses.english_text: And remember Our servant Ayub, when he called out to his Lord that Satan has troubled him a lot.
verses.arabic_text: وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ اَيُّوبَ اِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُٓ اَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ الشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ

verses.english_text: So We said: rub the legs on the ground, then you will see cold water for bathing and drinking.
verses.arabic_text: ارْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then We bestowed him his family and similarly gave him more, this is Our Mercy for the people who take lesson and admonition.
verses.arabic_text: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُٓ اَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِاُو۟لِى الْاَلْبَـٰبِ

verses.english_text: And, O Ayub, take little grass and strike it, and do not do contrary to the oath; We found Ayub full of patience and best of the servants, who turns to Us.
verses.arabic_text: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًۭا فَاضْرِب بِّهِ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ اِنَّا وَجَدْنَـٰهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۖ اِنَّهُٓ اَوَّابٌۭ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet! Mention Our servants Ibrahim, Ishaq and Yaqoob, who were strong and had insight.
verses.arabic_text: وَاذْكُرْ عِبَـٰدَنَآ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَاِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ اُو۟لِى الْاَيْدِى وَالْاَبْصَـٰرِ

verses.english_text: We distinguished him for his attribute of remembrance of the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَخْلَصْنَـٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍۢ ذِكْرَى الدَّارِ

verses.english_text: He was chosen one near Us; and among the good servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْاَخْيَارِ

verses.english_text: And remember Ismail, Al-Yasa and Zulkafil, they were all Our good servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَاذْكُرْ اِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ مِّنَ الْاَخْيَارِ

verses.english_text: This is an admonition and the best return for the pious ones.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ ۚ وَاِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ

verses.english_text: Paradises of Eternity, doors will be open for them.
verses.arabic_text: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍۢ مُّفَتَّحَةًۭ لَّهُمُ الْاَبْوَٰبُ

verses.english_text: They will be resting there with cushions, and they will demand different fruits and beverages.
verses.arabic_text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَـٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ وَشَرَابٍۢ

verses.english_text: There shall be wives beside them with the equal age with restrained eyes.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ الطَّرْفِ اَتْرَابٌ

verses.english_text: These are things which are promised to you for the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ

verses.english_text: This is Our sustenance which will never end.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُ مِن نَّفَادٍ

verses.english_text: This on one side, and for transgressors there is worst return.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا ۚ وَاِنَّ لِلطَّـٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍۢ

verses.english_text: Hell, where they will enter, and this the worst abode.
verses.arabic_text: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ

verses.english_text: This is the punishment which they will taste, hot water and pus.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌۭ وَغَسَّاقٌۭ

verses.english_text: And many other such things also.
verses.arabic_text: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِٓ اَزْوَٰجٌ

verses.english_text: This is your army which will be pushed into Hell with you, Allah may not do any good to them, they are all going to burn in Hell.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌۭ مُّقْتَحِمٌۭ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ اِنَّهُمْ صَالُواْ النَّارِ

verses.english_text: Then their followers will say to their leaders: may no good be done to you, you made available this punishment for us, therefore, this is the worst abode.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ بَلْ اَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ اَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ

verses.english_text: Then will say more: O Lord, who have propped us ahead, make their punishment double in Hell.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًۭا ضِعْفًۭا فِى النَّارِ

verses.english_text: Then they will say to themselves: what is the matter with us, we don't see them whom we had counted among the mischievous ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًۭا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ الْاَشْرَارِ

verses.english_text: We had unjustly mocked at them, or our eyes have turned away from them.
verses.arabic_text: اَتَّخَذْنَـٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا اَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْاَبْصَـٰرُ

verses.english_text: This quarrelling among the Hellish people is a sure thing.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّۭ تَخَاصُمُ اَهْلِ النَّارِ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) Say: I am just a warner, and there is no god except Allah, the One, the Dominant.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّمَآ اَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌۭ ۖ وَ مَا مِنْ اِلَـٰهٍ اِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَٰحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ

verses.english_text: He is the Lord of the skies and the earth and all the creatures in between them, and He is Honorable and very Forgiving.
verses.arabic_text: رَبُّ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّـٰرُ

verses.english_text: Say: This Quran is an great news.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌاْ عَظِيمٌ

verses.english_text: From which you have turned away.
verses.arabic_text: اَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ

verses.english_text: What do I know what matter is discussed in High Place.
verses.arabic_text: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِالْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلَىٰٓ اِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Only revelation comes to me; I am a man who explicitly warns you from the punishment of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِن يُوحَىٰٓ اِلَىَّ اِلَّآ اَنَّمَآ اَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

verses.english_text: Remind them that when your Lord said to the angels: I am going to create a mortal from the wet clay.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ اِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: When it is completed and I breathe my spirit in it then you all fall down in prostration.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُواْ لَهُ سَـٰجِدِينَ

verses.english_text: Then all angels prostrated.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ اَجْمَعُونَ

verses.english_text: Except Iblis; he showed proud and become among the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّآ اِبْلِيسَ اسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: So Allah said: O Iblis, what prevented you from prostrating before him, I have made him from the power of my hands, you showed haughtiness, you Verily are from the higher ones.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يَـٰٓاِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ اَسْتَكْبَرْتَ اَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ الْعَالِينَ

verses.english_text: He said: I am better than him, you created me out of fire and created him from dust.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍۢ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِن طِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Said Allah: Get out from here, you are rejected.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And Verily you are accursed by Me, until the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ

verses.english_text: He said: my Lord give me respite until the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنظِرْنِىٓ اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

verses.english_text: Said Allah: you are given respite.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنظَرِينَ

verses.english_text: But until a certain time.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ

verses.english_text: He said: by your Honor, I will misguide everyone.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَاُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: Except those of Your servants whom you have made pure.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

verses.english_text: Said Allah: So this is the Truth, and I always say the Truth.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ فَالْحَقُّ وَالْحَقَّ اَقُولُ

verses.english_text: That I will fill Hell with you and your followers.
verses.arabic_text: لَاَمْلَاَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet! Say: I do not want reward for my preaching, nor am I a pretender or a false teller.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ مَآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍۢ وَ مَآ اَنَا۠ مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ

verses.english_text: This Quran is an admonition for the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And after some days you will all know its reality.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَاَهُ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ

verses.english_text: This Book has been revealed by Allah, the Honorable, the Wise.
verses.arabic_text: تَنزِيلُ الْكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ

verses.english_text: We have revealed this Book towards you with the Truth, and you worship Allah with all sincerity.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَنزَلْنَآ اِلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ بِالْحَقِّ فَاعْبُدِ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ الدِّينَ

verses.english_text: Be aware that sincere worshipping is for Allah only; who have made other guardians by saying that their worship will bring us closer to Allah; Allah will decide between them in case of dispute; that Allah does not guide liar and thankless people.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَا لِلَّهِ الدِّينُ الْخَالِصُ ۚ وَ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِٓ اَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ اِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ اِلَى اللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ اِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَـٰذِبٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ

verses.english_text: If He wanted to make His sons, then He could have chosen anyone among His creatures; He is Pure and Self-Sufficient, He is the Only One Allah, the Subduer.
verses.arabic_text: لَّوْ اَرَادَ اللَّهُ اَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًۭا لَّاصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُ ۖ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْوَٰحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ

verses.english_text: He has created skies and the earth with the Truth, He makes the night wrap over the day and makes the day wrap over the night, and He has made subservient to Sun and Moon, they will all keep moving until an appointed period, be aware that He is Predominant on all and very Forgiving.
verses.arabic_text: خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ الَّيْلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَى الَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِاَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۗ اَلَا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّـٰرُ

verses.english_text: He has created you from one soul, then made pairs from it, and sent eight types of cattle; He takes you through different stages in the womb of your mothers, this is all done in triple darkness, that Allah is your Lord who has power over the Kingdom, there is no god but Him, then where you are turning away.
verses.arabic_text: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍۢ وَٰحِدَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَاَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْاَنْعَـٰمِ ثَمَـٰنِيَةَ اَزْوَٰجٍۢ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ اُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًۭا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍۢ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتٍۢ ثَلَـٰثٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ ۖ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَاَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ

verses.english_text: Even if you become infidel, Allah is Self-Sufficient from you, and He does not like infidelity for His servants, He likes if you are thankful to Him, and no one will carry the burden of sins of others; thereafter you will all be returned to your Lord; then He will inform you what you had been doing in the world; He is also aware of the secrets hidden in the hearts.
verses.arabic_text: اِن تَكْفُرُواْ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ الْكُفْرَ ۖ وَاِن تَشْكُرُواْ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ اُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ اِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ اِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

verses.english_text: And when man is afflicted then he calls out to the Lord with full attention, and when He gives any blessings, then he totally forgets for what he has called upon Him, and makes associates for Allah that he may cause them to deviate from the path, then say: enjoy for some days in infidelity, thereafter you Verily are among the Hellish people.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَاِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنسَـٰنَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَا رَبَّهُ مُنِيبًا اِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ اِذَا خَوَّلَهُ نِعْمَةًۭ مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓاْ اِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ اَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ اِنَّكَ مِنْ اَصْحَـٰبِ النَّارِ

verses.english_text: What! that person who prostrates during the night, and worships Allah while standing, and has fear for the Hereafter, and is hopeful of Mercy of his Lord; say: those who know, and those who do not know can be same? Only knowledgeable persons take the admonition from this.
verses.arabic_text: اَمَّنْ هُوَ قَـٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ الَّيْلِ سَاجِدًۭا وَقَآئِمًۭا يَحْذَرُ الْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُواْ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ اِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ اُو۟لُواْ الْاَلْبَـٰبِ

verses.english_text: Say: O my believing servants! Fear your Lord; there is good (in the Hereafter) for them who do good in this world, and Allah's land is very vast; the uncountable reward is only for the patient ones.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ اَحْسَنُواْ فِى هَـٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌۭ ۗ وَاَرْضُ اللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ ۗ اِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّـٰبِرُونَ اَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ

verses.english_text: Say: I have been commanded that I should be sincere to Allah and worship him with total sincerity.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنِّىٓ اُمِرْتُ اَنْ اَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ الدِّينَ

verses.english_text: And I have been commanded that I shall be the first obedient.
verses.arabic_text: وَاُمِرْتُ لِاَنْ اَكُونَ اَوَّلَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Say: if I indulge in sin then I fear the punishment of the difficult day.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنِّىٓ اَخَافُ اِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Say: I only worship Allah, and I am sincere in my worshipping.
verses.arabic_text: قُلِ اللَّهَ اَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ دِينِى

verses.english_text: Now worship whoever you want, say: The losers Verily are those who shall have kept themselves and their families in loss on the Day of Judgement; be aware this is the clear loss.
verses.arabic_text: فَاعْبُدُواْ مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِ ۗ قُلْ اِنَّ الْخَـٰسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ اَنفُسَهُمْ وَاَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ اَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ

verses.english_text: Upon them will be the covering of Hellfire and below the bedding of fire, these are the talks by which Allah warns His servants, so O My servants, fear Me.
verses.arabic_text: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌۭ مِّنَ النَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللَّهُ بِهِ عِبَادَهُ ۚ يَـٰعِبَادِ فَاتَّقُونِ

verses.english_text: Whoever separated from the unjust that they don't worship and turned to Allah, for them is glad tidings from Us, therefore, O Prophet! Give glad tidings to my servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ اجْتَنَبُواْ الطَّـٰغُوتَ اَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَاَنَابُوٓاْ اِلَى اللَّهِ لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَىٰ ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ

verses.english_text: Whoever listens to the talk and follows the good talk, these are the people whom Allah has guided, and these are the people who have knowledge.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ اَحْسَنَهُٓ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ اللَّهُ ۖ وَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ اُو۟لُواْ الْاَلْبَـٰبِ

verses.english_text: What! on whom punishment is proven, and whoever has gone to Hell, can you take him out.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ اَفَاَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِى النَّارِ

verses.english_text: Those who created fear of their Lord, for them are (spacious) rooms in the Paradise, and there are more rooms beneath which rivers will be flowing, this is the promise of Allah, and Allah does not go back on His promise.
verses.arabic_text: لَـٰكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌۭ مَّبْنِيَّةٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ الْمِيعَادَ

verses.english_text: Did not you see that Allah sent the water from sky, then flown it into the different rivers, then made colourful farming from it, then it withers and becomes yellow, He makes it into husk; most Verily there is admonition in this for those who understand.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللَّهَ اَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَسَلَكَهُ يَنَـٰبِيعَ فِى الْاَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًۭا مُّخْتَلِفًا اَلْوَٰنُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّۭا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ حُطَـٰمًا ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِاُو۟لِى الْاَلْبَـٰبِ

verses.english_text: What! A person whose heart Allah has made spacious for Islam, and he has light from his Lord, can be same as the misguided ones, alas, on the condition of those heart have become hardened for remembrance of Allah, so they are in open misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَمَن شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرَهُ لِلْاِسْلَـٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْقَـٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

verses.english_text: Allah has revealed the best words in the form of a Book, whose verses are similar to each other, and have been repeated, that their hairs are raised who have fear of Allah, then their bodies and hearts become soft for remembrance of Allah, this is the real guidance of Allah, He gives to whoever He pleases; and to whoever He leaves in misguidance, nobody can guide him.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ نَزَّلَ اَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتٰبًۭا مُّتَشَـٰبِهًۭا مَّثَانِىَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ اِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى اللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ

verses.english_text: What! the person who will try to save severe punishment from his face on the day of judgement, can be alike to who has been delivered, and it will be said to the unjust to taste the punishment of your own deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَمَن يَتَّقِى بِوَجْهِهِ سُوٓءَ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُواْ مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ

verses.english_text: People earlier than these infidels have also denied the prophets, so punishment came to them in such a way that they couldn't understood.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَاَتَىٰهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then Allah made them taste the disgrace in the world, and punishment of the Hereafter is very severe; if they can understand.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَذَاقَهُمُ اللَّهُ الْخِزْىَ فِى الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ اَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُواْ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And We have described all types of examples for the people in this Quran, perhaps they might get lessons or admonition from this.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا الْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍۢ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: This Quran is in Arabic language, in which there is no crookedness, perhaps they might become pious like this.
verses.arabic_text: قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِى عِوَجٍۢ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: Allah sets an example: There is a slave in whom there are several partners differing with one another; and there is another slave wholly owned by one man. Are conditions of the two alike? All praise is due to Allah but most of them do not know.
verses.arabic_text: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا رَّجُلًۭا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَـٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًۭا سَلَمًۭا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ۚ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Death will come to you also, all of them are going to die.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌۭ وَاِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ

verses.english_text: Thereafter you will all present your dispute in the Presence of Allah on the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Who can be more unjust than who slander on Allah and after advent of truth deny it, so is Hell not the abode of infidels?
verses.arabic_text: ۞ فَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ اِذْ جَآءَهُٓ ۚ اَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًۭى لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Who has brought the message of truth, and who confirms it, in fact they are pious people who guard against evil.
verses.arabic_text: وَالَّذِى جَآءَ بِالصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِٓ ۙ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: For them everything is there with the Lord whatever they wish, this is the recompense of the good deeds.
verses.arabic_text: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: That Allah will do away with the evil which they have done, and give them the reward in a better way then what they have done.
verses.arabic_text: لِيُكَفِّرَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ اَسْوَاَ الَّذِى عَمِلُواْ وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ اَجْرَهُم بِاَحْسَنِ الَّذِى كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Is Allah not enough for His servants? And these people frighten you from others than Him, although, nobody can guide him to whoever Allah leaves in misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُ ۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِالَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍۢ

verses.english_text: And to whoever Allah guides, there is no one who can misguide him, is Allah not all Mighty and an Avenger?
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِن مُّضِلٍّ ۗ اَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍۢ ذِى انتِقَامٍۢ

verses.english_text: And if you will ask them who have created skies and the earth, they will reply: Allah, so say: have you seen their condition whom you worship, that if Allah wish to cause harm, can they stop that harm, or if He desire to show Mercy, who can withhold Him; say: my Allah is sufficient for me; and those who are reliant, rely on Him.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَئِن سَاَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ اَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ اِنْ اَرَادَنِىَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَـٰشِفَـٰتُ ضُرِّهِٓ اَوْ اَرَادَنِى بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَـٰتُ رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ قُلْ حَسْبِىَ اللَّهُ ۖ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ

verses.english_text: And say: O nation you do your deeds accordingly, I am doing my deeds, after that you will come to know the condition of all.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يَـٰقَوْمِ اعْمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّى عَـٰمِلٌۭ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And that onto whom will come the disgraceful punishment and on whom the everlasting punishment comes.
verses.arabic_text: مَن يَاْتِيهِ عَذَابٌۭ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌۭ مُّقِيمٌ

verses.english_text: We have revealed this Book to you with the Truth for guidance of the people, whoever will take guidance will be for his own benefit, and who will go astray will harm himself; and you are not responsible for them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَاِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۖ وَ مَآ اَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ

verses.english_text: That is Allah who calls towards Him the spirits at the time of death, and those who do not die also calls their spirits to Him when they are asleep, and then if He decides anybody's death He withheld that spirit with Him, and releases all other spirits until a certain period, there are many signs in this for the people who ponder.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى الْاَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَالَّتِى لَمْ تَمُتْ فِى مَنَامِهَا ۖ فَيُمْسِكُ الَّتِى قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا الْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ الْاُخْرَىٰٓ اِلَىٰٓ اَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: Have they found the intercessors besides Allah, Say: even though they did not ever have control over anything, nor do they understand.
verses.arabic_text: اَمِ اتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَ ۚ قُلْ اَوَ لَوْ كَانُواْ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Say: authority of intercession is in Allah's hands only, He has the kingdom of the earth and the skies, and after that you all will be returned to His Presence.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لِّلَّهِ الشَّفَـٰعَةُ جَمِيعًۭا ۖ لَّهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۖ ثُمَّ اِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: When the remembrance of One and Only Allah comes before them, those who do not believe in the Hereafter their hearts are disgusted, and if anybody else is remembered they become happy.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَاَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ وَاِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِٓ اِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Now say: O Lord, Creator of the earth and the skies, knower of the seen and unseen, You only can judge the matter among them in which they dispute.
verses.arabic_text: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ عَـٰلِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَـٰدَةِ اَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِى مَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

verses.english_text: And if these unjust get all the wealth of the world, and they get similarly this much more, and they give all this in lieu of punishment on the Day of Judgement, but whatever is from Allah for them will Verily come true; which they do not even think of.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ اَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافْتَدَوْاْ بِهِ مِن سُوٓءِ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُواْ يَحْتَسِبُونَ

verses.english_text: All their bad deeds will become clear on them, and that very thing will encircle them of which they had been making fun of.
verses.arabic_text: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

verses.english_text: And when any difficulty afflicts humans he calls to Us, and when We give any blessing to him, he says it has been given to me because of my knowledge, whereas this is only a trial; and most of them are unaware of this.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنسَـٰنَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ اِذَا خَوَّلْنَـٰهُ نِعْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا قَالَ اِنَّمَآ اُوتِيتُهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۭ ۚ بَلْ هِىَ فِتْنَةٌۭ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: People earlier than them also had said the same thing; it was not of any use to them which they were acquiring.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ قَالَهَا الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَآ اَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ

verses.english_text: Whereas the effects of their bad deeds have reached them; and among infidels also who are unjust their effect will verily reach them, and they cannot humble Allah.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ ۚ وَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ وَ مَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ

verses.english_text: Do they not know that it is Allah who expands the sustenance of whoever He pleases, and straitens the sustenance of whoever He pleases, in these affairs many signs are found for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓاْ اَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Reach the message that O my servants, those who have done excesses on their souls should not be disappointed from the Mercy of Allah; Allah is Forgiver of all the sins, and indeed He is very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِىَ الَّذِينَ اَسْرَفُواْ عَلَىٰٓ اَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُواْ مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ اِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: You all turn towards your Lord, and be entirely submissive to Him, before any punishment comes to you, then you cannot be helped.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنِيبُوٓاْ اِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَاَسْلِمُواْ لَهُ مِن قَبْلِ اَن يَاْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And follow the best system which has been revealed from your Lord, before that any punishment comes to you suddenly, and you could not understand.
verses.arabic_text: وَاتَّبِعُوٓاْ اَحْسَنَ مَآ اُنزِلَ اِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ اَن يَاْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةًۭ وَاَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then among you any soul says, alas! I showed laziness towards Allah, and I was among those who made fun of it.
verses.arabic_text: اَن تَقُولَ نَفْسٌۭ يَـٰحَسْرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِى جَنۢبِ اللَّهِ وَاِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ السَّـٰخِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Or he may say if Allah has guided me he would also have been pious.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ اَنَّ اللَّهَ هَدَىٰنِى لَكُنتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ

verses.english_text: Or after seeing the punishment he may say, if I get a chance to go back again, I would also be among the good character ones.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى الْعَذَابَ لَوْ اَنَّ لِى كَرَّةًۭ فَاَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Yes, yes My verses come to you but you denied them, and behaved with pride, and became infidel.
verses.arabic_text: بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَتْكَ اٰيٰتِى فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And you will see on the Day of Judgement, whoever slander Allah, their faces will be black, and is Hell not the abode of those who show pride?
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ تَرَى الَّذِينَ كَذَبُواْ عَلَى اللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ ۚ اَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًۭى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

verses.english_text: And Allah will deliver the pious people because of their success that no evil will touch them, and neither they will have any kind of sadness.
verses.arabic_text: وَيُنَجِّى اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

verses.english_text: Allah is the Creator of everything, and He is the guardian of everything.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ خَـٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَكِيلٌۭ

verses.english_text: With Him are all the keys of earth and skies, and whoever denies His verses are going to be in loss.
verses.arabic_text: لَّهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۗ وَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ اللَّهِ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخَـٰسِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Say: O ignorant, are you commanding me to worship others than Allah.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَاْمُرُوٓنِّىٓ اَعْبُدُ اَيُّهَا الْجَـٰهِلُونَ

verses.english_text: And Verily, We sent revelation to you and to the people earlier than you that if you will adopt polytheism all your deeds will go waste, and your counting will be among those who are the losers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اُوحِىَ اِلَيْكَ وَاِلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ اَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَـٰسِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Worship only Allah, and become His thankful servant.
verses.arabic_text: بَلِ اللَّهَ فَاعْبُدْ وَكُن مِّنَ الشَّـٰكِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Verily, they did not value Allah, on the Day of Judgement all the earth will be in His fist, and skies will be wrapped upon His hands; He is Pure and Self-Sufficient, He is much higher than what they associate with Him.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا قَدَرُواْ اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالْاَرْضُ جَمِيعًۭا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَالسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ مَطْوِيَّـٰتٌۢ بِيَمِينِهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: And when trumpet will be blown then all the creatures of earth and the skies will fell unconscious, except to those whom Allah will save, after that when trumpet will be blown once again everyone will stand up and start looking.
verses.arabic_text: وَنُفِخَ فِى الصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا مَن شَآءَ اللَّهُ ۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ اُخْرَىٰ فَاِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌۭ يَنظُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And earth will shine with the Light of Allah, and records of deeds will be kept, and messengers and martyrs will be brought; and judgement will be made among them with the Truth, and no unjust will be done on anyone.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَشْرَقَتِ الْاَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ الْكِتٰبُ وَجِاْىٓءَ بِالنَّبِيِّـۧنَ وَالشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Then every soul will be recompensed fully for their deeds, and He is completely aware of everyone's deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Those who had adopted infidelity will be driven away in groups towards Hell until they reach in front of it, then its doors will be opened, its custodian will say did not any prophet came to you who would recite the divine verses to you and warn you from the meeting of today, so all of them will say Verily prophets have come, but sentence of punishment has been proven for the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ اِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ اَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ اَلَمْ يَاْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌۭ مِّنكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا ۚ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ عَلَى الْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Then it will be said: enter into Hell from the gate and remain there forever that this is the worst abode for the proud people.
verses.arabic_text: قِيلَ ادْخُلُوٓاْ اَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

verses.english_text: And those who adopted piousness of Allah, they will be taken towards Paradise in groups, when they will reach near it, its doors will be opened, its custodians will say: Salutations, you are pure, so enter the everlasting Paradise.
verses.arabic_text: وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمْ اِلَى الْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ اَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَادْخُلُوهَا خَـٰلِدِينَ

verses.english_text: And will say: thanks to Allah that he has made his promise come true, and made us inherit His land, that we can rest in Paradise wherever we wish, and Verily this is the best reward for those who have done (good) deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُ وَاَوْرَثَنَا الْاَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّاُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَآءُ ۖ فَنِعْمَ اَجْرُ الْعَـٰمِلِينَ

verses.english_text: And you will see that angels have surrounded the Throne of Allah and they are glorifying Him; and judgement will be done justly among the people, and verdict shall be given between them with justice, and everywhere there will be one sound: All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَرَى الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ الْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِالْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Ha Meem
verses.arabic_text: حمٓ

verses.english_text: This Book has been revealed by Mighty and Knowledgeable Allah.
verses.arabic_text: تَنزِيلُ الْكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ

verses.english_text: He is Forgiver of sins, acceptor of repentance, giver of severe punishment, and owner of Mercy and Blessings, there is no god except Him; everyone must return towards Him.
verses.arabic_text: غَافِرِ الذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ الْعِقَابِ ذِى الطَّوْلِ ۖ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ۖ اِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: Only those who dispute the signs of Allah are infidels, hence, their roaming in the towns may not deceive you.
verses.arabic_text: مَا يُجَـٰدِلُ فِىٓ اٰيٰتِ اللَّهِ اِلَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِى الْبِلَـٰدِ

verses.english_text: Before them, the nation of Nooh and the groups after them denied the prophets; and every nation thought about the prophets to arrest them; and took the help of falsehood and wanted to uproot the Truth, then We also arrested them; and you saw how Our punishment was.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَالْاَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۖ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ اُمَّةٍۭ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَاْخُذُوهُ ۖ وَجَـٰدَلُواْ بِالْبَـٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُواْ بِهِ الْحَقَّ فَاَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ

verses.english_text: Like this the punishment of your Lord has been proven for the infidels that they are going to Hell.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ اَنَّهُمْ اَصْحَـٰبُ النَّارِ

verses.english_text: Those angels who are holding the Divine Throne and those who are surrounding them are all glorifying Allah, and believe on Him only, and are seeking forgiveness for the believers; O Lord, Your Mercy and Knowledge have encompassed all things, therefore forgive them who seek repentance and follow Your path, and save them from punishment of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ الْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ رَّحْمَةًۭ وَعِلْمًۭا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ وَاتَّبَعُواْ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ

verses.english_text: O Lord! make them enter the everlasting Gardens which You have promised to them and to their fathers and their wives and their offspring those who do good, Verily You are Predominant and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: رَبَّنَا وَاَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِى وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَاَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمْ ۚ اِنَّكَ اَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: And save them from evil deeds, and whom You save from evil deeds this day, indeed You did (shower) Mercy on them, and that is the big achievement.
verses.arabic_text: وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ وَمَن تَقِ السَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ

verses.english_text: Verily those who adopted infidelity they shall be called on the Day of Judgement and told: the way you are disgusted from your souls Allah's displeasure is greater than that; you had been invited towards faith, but you adopted infidelity.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ اللَّهِ اَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمْ اَنفُسَكُمْ اِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ اِلَى الْاِيمَـٰنِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ

verses.english_text: They will say O Lord you gave us death two times and life two times, now we have accepted our sins, now is there any way to get rid of it?
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ اَمَتَّنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ وَاَحْيَيْتَنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ فَاعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ اِلَىٰ خُرُوجٍۢ مِّن سَبِيلٍۢ

verses.english_text: This is because when the One and Only Allah's name was mentioned you adopted infidelity, when polytheism was mentioned, you accepted it immediately, now the judgement is in the Hands of Allah, the Great.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكُم بِاَنَّهُٓ اِذَا دُعِىَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ كَفَرْتُمْ ۖ وَاِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِ تُؤْمِنُواْ ۚ فَالْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ الْعَلِىِّ الْكَبِيرِ

verses.english_text: That is He, Who shows you His signs, and sends sustenance to you from the sky, only he takes the admonition from this who turns to Him.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِى يُرِيكُمْ اٰيٰتِهِ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ رِزْقًۭا ۚ وَ مَا يَتَذَكَّرُ اِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ

verses.english_text: Therefore, you call out to Allah with pure worshipping no matter how distasteful infidels may feel.
verses.arabic_text: فَادْعُواْ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَ لَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: That Allah is the owner of Lofty Place and the Throne and sends revelation on whoever He pleases among his servants, that he may warn the people from Day of the Meeting.
verses.arabic_text: رَفِيعُ الدَّرَجَـٰتِ ذُو الْعَرْشِ يُلْقِى الرُّوحَ مِنْ اَمْرِهِ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ لِيُنذِرَ يَوْمَ التَّلَاقِ

verses.english_text: When everyone will come forth and nothing will be hidden from Allah, today's kingdom is whose? Kingdom is of Allah, the One, the Subduer.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ هُم بَـٰرِزُونَ ۖ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَىْءٌۭ ۚ لِّمَنِ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ ۖ لِلَّهِ الْوَٰحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ

verses.english_text: Every soul will be given his recompense, today there won't be any unjust done on anyone; Verily, Allah is the one who takes the account swiftly.
verses.arabic_text: الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۚ لَا ظُلْمَ الْيَوْمَ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ

verses.english_text: And O Prophet, warn them about oncoming of the punishment, when heart will come to the mouth due to suffocation, and for unjust there won't be any friend or intercessor who will be heard.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْـَٔازِفَةِ اِذِ الْقُلُوبُ لَدَى الْحَنَاجِرِ كَـٰظِمِينَ ۚ مَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍۢ وَلَا شَفِيعٍۢ يُطَاعُ

verses.english_text: Allah also knows the betrayal of eyes, and also knows the secrets hidden in the hearts.
verses.arabic_text: يَعْلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ الْاَعْيُنِ وَ مَا تُخْفِى الصُّدُورُ

verses.english_text: He judges with the Truth, and they cannot even judge whom they worship leaving Allah, indeed Allah hears and sees everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ يَقْضِى بِالْحَقِّ ۖ وَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَىْءٍ ۗ اِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: Did not they travel in the land that they could see what had happened to the earlier people who were more powerful and influential than them, then Allah overtook them due to their sins, and there was no one who could save them against Allah.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ كَانُواْ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُواْ هُمْ اَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ وَءَاثَارًا فِى الْاَرْضِ فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَ مَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍۢ

verses.english_text: This happened because prophets have come to them with explicit signs but they denied them, then Allah also overtook them; He is very powerful and giver of severe punishment.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَانَت تَّاْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَكَفَرُواْ فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ ۚ اِنَّهُ قَوِىٌّۭ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ

verses.english_text: We have sent Moosa with Our signs and clear arguments.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

verses.english_text: Towards Firaun, Hamaan and Qaroon, they all said he is a magician and a liar.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ وَقَـٰرُونَ فَقَالُواْ سَـٰحِرٌۭ كَذَّابٌۭ

verses.english_text: So when they come from Us with the truth, they said whoever follow them, kill their boys and keep their girls alive; and planning of the infidels are Verily going to be strayed.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِالْحَقِّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُواْ اقْتُلُوٓاْ اَبْنَآءَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُ وَاسْتَحْيُواْ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَ مَا كَيْدُ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ اِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ

verses.english_text: Firaun said leave me I will kill Moosa and he call his Lord, I am afraid that he may not change your religion and may not create mischief on the land.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُونِىٓ اَقْتُلْ مُوسَىٰ وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهُٓ ۖ اِنِّىٓ اَخَافُ اَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمْ اَوْ اَن يُظْهِرَ فِى الْاَرْضِ الْفَسَادَ

verses.english_text: Moosa said: I am seeking refuge from your Lord and my Lord against all the proud people who do not have faith on the Day of Accounting.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ اِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ

verses.english_text: And one person who was hiding his faith among the people of Firaun said: you are killing somebody just because he is saying his Lord is Allah and have also brought clear arguments from your Lord, and if he is a liar, he is responsible for it, and if what he is saying is truth then from what he is warning that difficulties may afflict you, Verily Allah does not guide anyone who do excesses and is a liar.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ رَجُلٌۭ مُّؤْمِنٌۭ مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ اِيمَـٰنَهُٓ اَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا اَن يَقُولَ رَبِّىَ اللَّهُ وَ قَدْ جَآءَكُم بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ وَاِن يَكُ كَـٰذِبًۭا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهُ ۖ وَاِن يَكُ صَادِقًۭا يُصِبْكُم بَعْضُ الَّذِى يَعِدُكُمْ ۖ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ كَذَّابٌۭ

verses.english_text: O my nation Verily today you have kingdom and domination in the land, but if punishment of Allah comes, I am telling you the things which I understand and I am not guiding you to any other way except the way of wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰقَوْمِ لَكُمُ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ ظَـٰهِرِينَ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِنۢ بَاْسِ اللَّهِ اِن جَآءَنَا ۚ قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَآ اُرِيكُمْ اِلَّا مَآ اَرَىٰ وَ مَآ اَهْدِيكُمْ اِلَّا سَبِيلَ الرَّشَادِ

verses.english_text: And the person who was the believer said: I fear the day of punishment for you which was the day of punishment for other nations.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَـٰقَوْمِ اِنِّىٓ اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُم مِّثْلَ يَوْمِ الْاَحْزَابِ

verses.english_text: Nation of Nooh, nation of Aad, nation of Samood and condition of later ones, indeed Allah does not want to be unjust on His servants.
verses.arabic_text: مِثْلَ دَاْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٍۢ وَثَمُودَ وَ الَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ وَ مَا اللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ

verses.english_text: And O my people, I fear for you for the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ اِنِّىٓ اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ التَّنَادِ

verses.english_text: That day when all of you will turn and run away, no one will be there to save you against Allah; to whoever Allah leaves in misguidance no one can guide him.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍۢ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍۢ

verses.english_text: And before this Yusuf also came to you, and you were in doubt about his message, and when he left the world, you said Allah did not send any prophet after him; like this Allah leaves in misguidance to those who do excesses and doubt.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ

verses.english_text: Those who argue in verses of Allah without having any proof from Him, they are worthy of hate near Allah and the believers; and like this Allah seals the hearts of every person who does excesses and is proud.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ اٰيٰتِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَـٰنٍ اَتَىٰهُمْ ۖ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ اللَّهِ وَعِندَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍۢ جَبَّارٍۢ

verses.english_text: And Firaun said: O Hamaan build for me a fort that I may attain the means of access.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَـٰهَـٰمَـٰنُ ابْنِ لِى صَرْحًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ اَبْلُغُ الْاَسْبَـٰبَ

verses.english_text: From the ways in the sky I may see the Lord of Moosa, I think Moosa is a liar and there is no Allah, and like this Firaun's bad deeds were decorated and he was stopped from his way, and result of plotting of Firaun was nothing but destruction.
verses.arabic_text: اَسْبَـٰبَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَاَطَّلِعَ اِلَىٰٓ اِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَاِنِّى لَاَظُنُّهُ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِ وَصُدَّ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ ۚ وَ مَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ اِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ

verses.english_text: And that person who had believed said: O my people follow me, I will show you the way of guidance.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَـٰقَوْمِ اتَّبِعُونِ اَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ الرَّشَادِ

verses.english_text: O people of the nation, remember the enjoyment of the worldly life is for some days, and everlasting abode is the Hereafter.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰقَوْمِ اِنَّمَا هَـٰذِهِ الْحَيَوٰةُ الدُّنْيَا مَتَـٰعٌۭ وَاِنَّ الْـَٔاخِرَةَ هِىَ دَارُ الْقَرَارِ

verses.english_text: Whoever will commit evil will be recompensed, and whoever will do good deeds whether men or women provided they are believing, shall be entered into Paradise, and there they will get the unaccountable sustenance.
verses.arabic_text: مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةًۭ فَلَا يُجْزَىٰٓ اِلَّا مِثْلَهَا ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا مِّن ذَكَرٍ اَوْ اُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ

verses.english_text: O people of my nation, what has happened to you, I am inviting you towards deliverance and you are inviting me towards Hell.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَيَـٰقَوْمِ مَا لِىٓ اَدْعُوكُمْ اِلَى النَّجَوٰةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِىٓ اِلَى النَّارِ

verses.english_text: Your invitation is that I may deny Allah, and I make His associates whom I do not know; and I am inviting you towards the Allah who is Mighty and very Forgiving.
verses.arabic_text: تَدْعُونَنِى لِاَكْفُرَ بِاللَّهِ وَاُشْرِكَ بِهِ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِ عِلْمٌۭ وَاَنَا۠ اَدْعُوكُمْ اِلَى الْعَزِيزِ الْغَفَّـٰرِ

verses.english_text: Verily you are inviting me towards that who is neither worthy of calling upon in the world nor in the Hereafter, our return is all towards Allah, and who do excesses are Hellish people.
verses.arabic_text: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِىٓ اِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَعْوَةٌۭ فِى الدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَاَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ اِلَى اللَّهِ وَاَنَّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ اَصْحَـٰبُ النَّارِ

verses.english_text: Then shortly you will remember that what I am telling you, I am referring all my affairs to Allah, indeed He is aware of the condition of all his servants.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَآ اَقُولُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَاُفَوِّضُ اَمْرِىٓ اِلَى اللَّهِ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيرٌۢ بِالْعِبَادِ

verses.english_text: So, Allah delivered that believing persons from the harm of plotting of the people; and severe punishment overtook the people of Firaun.
verses.arabic_text: فَوَقَىٰهُ اللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُواْ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ الْعَذَابِ

verses.english_text: They are presented before the Hell every morning and evening, when Day of Judgement will be established then angels will be commanded to put them in the worst stage of punishment in Hell.
verses.arabic_text: النَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّۭا وَعَشِيًّۭا ۖ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ اَدْخِلُوٓاْ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ اَشَدَّ الْعَذَابِ

verses.english_text: And think of the time when they will fight in Hell, and weak people will say to the haughty people that we were following you, so can you save us from some part of Hell, and can you be of any use to us.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ يَتَحَآجُّونَ فِى النَّارِ فَيَقُولُ الضُّعَفَـٰٓؤُاْ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوٓاْ اِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًۭا فَهَلْ اَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًۭا مِّنَ النَّارِ

verses.english_text: So haughty people will say now abode of all of us is this only, Allah has already decided among His servants.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوٓاْ اِنَّا كُلٌّۭ فِيهَآ اِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ الْعِبَادِ

verses.english_text: Thereafter Hellish people will say to its custodians: pray to the Lord that even for a day Allah may lighten our punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ فِى النَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ادْعُواْ رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًۭا مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ

verses.english_text: They will reply: did not prophets come to you with the manifest signs; they will say: Verily, they came; then they will get the reply: so call upon (them) yourselves; whereas calling and pleading of the infidels will go waste.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ اَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَاْتِيكُمْ رُسُلُكُم بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ۖ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ ۚ قَالُواْ فَادْعُواْ ۗ وَ مَا دُعَـٰٓؤُاْ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ اِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ

verses.english_text: Verily, We do help the prophets and the believers in the world, and that day also will help them when all the witnesses will be gathered.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ فِى الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْاَشْهَـٰدُ

verses.english_text: That day when no excuse will be of any use for the unjust, and there will be curse and worst abode for them.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ ۖ وَلَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوٓءُ الدَّارِ

verses.english_text: And Verily, we did guide Moosa, and made Bani Israel inherit the book.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْهُدَىٰ وَاَوْرَثْنَا بَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ الْكِتٰبَ

verses.english_text: That book is entirely guidance, and a matter of admonition for the wise people.
verses.arabic_text: هُدًۭى وَذِكْرَىٰ لِاُو۟لِى الْاَلْبَـٰبِ

verses.english_text: Therefore, be patient, the promise of Allah is the Truth, and seek forgiveness for yourself, and keep praising your Lord morning and evening.
verses.arabic_text: فَاصْبِرْ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِالْعَشِىِّ وَالْاِبْكَـٰرِ

verses.english_text: And Verily those who dispute in the signs of Allah without any argument that have come to them, there is naught in their breasts but a desire to become great which they shall never attain; therefore, seek refuge in Allah, Verily, He is all Hearing and Seeing.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ اٰيٰتِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَـٰنٍ اَتَىٰهُمْ ۙ اِن فِى صُدُورِهِمْ اِلَّا كِبْرٌۭ مَّا هُم بِبَـٰلِغِيهِ ۚ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ ۖ اِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: Verily, creating the earth and the skies is a bigger task than creating human beings, but the majority of people do not know this.
verses.arabic_text: لَخَلْقُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ اَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ النَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And remember, blind and the seeing ones cannot be the same; those who believed and did good works cannot be like wicked people; but you people take very less admonition.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يَسْتَوِى الْاَعْمَىٰ وَالْبَصِيرُ وَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَلَا الْمُسِىٓءُ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, Day of Judgement is going to come, and there is no doubt that majority of people do not believe on it.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌۭ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And your Lord says: supplicate from Me and I will accept it, and Verily those who are arrogant from Our worship, shortly they will enter Hell with disgrace.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِىٓ اَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ ۚ اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah who has created night for you so you take rest, and made day a source of light, indeed He shows lots of grace and blessings on His servants, but majority of them are not thankful to Him.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ الَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُواْ فِيهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: That is your Lord who has created everything, there is no god except Him, then where are you turning away?
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَـٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ لَّآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَاَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ

verses.english_text: Like this they are misguided who deny Allah's signs.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ الَّذِينَ كَانُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah who established the earth for you and the sky a canopy and created you with the best face, and gave you pure sustenance, that is your blessed Allah who is the Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ الَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَالسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءًۭ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَاَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبَـٰتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: He is Ever Living, there is no god but He, therefore worship Him with sincere religion, and all the praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الْحَىُّ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ فَادْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ ۗ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Say: I have been barred from worshipping to those whom you worship leaving Allah; whereas I have received the manifest signs, and I have been commanded that I remain an obedient servant of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قُلْ اِنِّى نُهِيتُ اَنْ اَعْبُدَ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِىَ الْبَيِّنَـٰتُ مِن رَّبِّى وَاُمِرْتُ اَنْ اُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah who created you from dust, then with sperm, then from the frozen blood, then made you a child and brought you out, then keeps you alive that you reach the strength, then become old; some of you are called back (even) before that, and keeps you alive that you reach the appointed period; and that you might understand.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍۢ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًۭا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓاْ اَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُواْ شُيُوخًۭا ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلِتَبْلُغُوٓاْ اَجَلًۭا مُّسَمًّۭى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: That is He; Who gives life and also death, when He decides to do something, He says: Be, and it becomes.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِى يُحْىِ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ فَاِذَا قَضَىٰٓ اَمْرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ

verses.english_text: Did not you see those who quarrel about the verses of Allah, after that to where they are straying?
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ اٰيٰتِ اللَّهِ اَنَّىٰ يُصْرَفُونَ

verses.english_text: Those who denied the Book and other things which We have sent through the Prophet, shortly they will come to know of its result.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِالْكِتٰبِ وَبِمَآ اَرْسَلْنَا بِهِ رُسُلَنَا ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: When shackles and chains will be put in their necks and they will be dragged.
verses.arabic_text: اِذِ الْاَغْلَـٰلُ فِىٓ اَعْنَـٰقِهِمْ وَالسَّلَـٰسِلُ يُسْحَبُونَ

verses.english_text: In the hot water, after that they will be thrown in to Hell.
verses.arabic_text: فِى الْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِى النَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then it will be said: where are those whom you had made associate (with Allah).
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمْ اَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: Besides Allah; so they will reply: they have vanished leaving us (here), but we were not calling upon anyone, and like this Allah leaves infidels in misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ ۖ قَالُواْ ضَلُّواْ عَنَّا بَل لَّمْ نَكُن نَّدْعُواْ مِن قَبْلُ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: This is the result of because on the earth you were happy with the falsehood and walked about with pride.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ فِى الْاَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ

verses.english_text: Now enter from the gates of Hell, and always live there, the abode of arrogant people is very bad.
verses.arabic_text: ادْخُلُوٓاْ اَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

verses.english_text: Now you have patience, the promise of Allah is truthful, so We will show you some of the things of which we are threatening, or will call you back before that, even then they will be brought back here only.
verses.arabic_text: فَاصْبِرْ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ ۚ فَاِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ اَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَاِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And We have sent many prophets before you of which some of them were mentioned to you, and some of them were not even mentioned to you; and no prophet has the ability that he can bring the miracle without the permission of Allah; when the time came then it was decided with the Truth, and then people of falsehood were in loss.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًۭا مِّن قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُم مَّن قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ ۗ وَ مَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ اَن يَاْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَمْرُ اللَّهِ قُضِىَ بِالْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah who has created cattle for you, of which some of them you ride upon and some of them you use for eating.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ الَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَنْعَـٰمَ لِتَرْكَبُواْ مِنْهَا وَمِنْهَا تَاْكُلُونَ

verses.english_text: For you there are many benefits in it, that you may get your desires through them, and you ride upon these animals and (also on) ships.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَلِتَبْلُغُواْ عَلَيْهَا حَاجَةًۭ فِى صُدُورِكُمْ وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: And Allah shows you his signs, so which of His signs will you deny?
verses.arabic_text: وَيُرِيكُمْ اٰيٰتِهِ فَاَىَّ اٰيٰتِ اللَّهِ تُنكِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Did not they travel in the land that they see what We have done to the earlier people who were more in numbers in their comparison and more powerful and also had influence in the land, but whatever they earned did not benefit them and they suffered the punishment.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوٓاْ اَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَاَشَدَّ قُوَّةًۭ وَءَاثَارًا فِى الْاَرْضِ فَمَآ اَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ

verses.english_text: When the prophets brought the miracles, they showed arrogance because of their knowledge, and as a result they were beset by what they were mocking at.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَرِحُواْ بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

verses.english_text: Then, when they saw Our punishment, they said: we believe in the One Allah, and are denying what we used to associate with Him.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَاَوْاْ بَاْسَنَا قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ وَكَفَرْنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِ مُشْرِكِينَ

verses.english_text: So believing after seeing the punishment will not help, this is the constant method of Allah, which has passed by with regards to His servants, and at that time infidels suffer the loss.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمْ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمْ اِيمَـٰنُهُمْ لَمَّا رَاَوْاْ بَاْسَنَا ۖ سُنَّتَ اللَّهِ الَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ فِى عِبَادِهِ ۖ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْكَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Ha Meem
verses.arabic_text: حمٓ

verses.english_text: This is the revelation of Allah, the Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّنَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

verses.english_text: Verses of this Book have been described in detail; in Arabic language for the people who understand.
verses.arabic_text: كِتٰبٌۭ فُصِّلَتْ اٰيٰتُهُ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: This Quran has been revealed as to give glad tidings and to warn the people, but the majority of people object to it and they are not ready to listen to anything.
verses.arabic_text: بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا فَاَعْرَضَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And they say: our hearts are under the veil from the message which you are giving, there is deafness in our ears, and there is a veil between us and you, so you do your work and we are doing our work.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ قُلُوبُنَا فِىٓ اَكِنَّةٍۢ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ اِلَيْهِ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِنَا وَقْرٌۭ وَمِنۢ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌۭ فَاعْمَلْ اِنَّنَا عَـٰمِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Say: I am also a mortal like you, but revelation comes to me on regularly that your Lord is One, therefore be persistent in the right path and seek forgiveness from Him, and woe to the polytheists.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّمَآ اَنَا۠ بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ اِلَىَّ اَنَّمَآ اِلَـٰهُكُمْ اِلَـٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ فَاسْتَقِيمُوٓاْ اِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ۗ وَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُشْرِكِينَ

verses.english_text: Those who do not give poor-rate are the deniers of the Hereafter.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِالْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily those who believe and did good works for them is the recompense which will never be discontinued.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ اَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ

verses.english_text: Say: are you denying the Lord which has created the earth in two days, and make associates for him Who is Lord of the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قُلْ اَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِى خَلَقَ الْاَرْضَ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُٓ اَندَادًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And established mountains on the earth, and has kept blessing, and made therein all provisions of livelihood in four days, which has equal share for all the seekers.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ مِن فَوْقِهَا وَبَـٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ اَقْوَٰتَهَا فِىٓ اَرْبَعَةِ اَيَّامٍۢ سَوَآءًۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ

verses.english_text: Then He turned towards the sky which was like smoke, and He commanded to earth whether willingly or unwillingly come to Us, so both said: we come obediently.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰٓ اِلَى السَّمَآءِ وَهِىَ دُخَانٌۭ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْاَرْضِ ائْتِيَا طَوْعًا اَوْ كَرْهًۭا قَالَتَآ اَتَيْنَا طَآئِعِينَ

verses.english_text: Then made seven skies among the skies in two days, and revealed to each sky about its affairs, and decorated sky of the world with the lamps, and made it secure, this is the decree of Mighty and Knowing Allah.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَاتٍۢ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَاَوْحَىٰ فِى كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ اَمْرَهَا ۚ وَزَيَّنَّا السَّمَآءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَحِفْظًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ

verses.english_text: Still if they object then say, We warned you from the punishment of lightning as We have sent on the nations of Aad and Samood.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنْ اَعْرَضُواْ فَقُلْ اَنذَرْتُكُمْ صَـٰعِقَةًۭ مِّثْلَ صَـٰعِقَةِ عَادٍۢ وَثَمُودَ

verses.english_text: When Our messengers came from front and from behind that do not worship anyone except Allah, they said: if our Lord pleased, He could have sent angels, we are not going to accept your message.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ جَآءَتْهُمُ الرُّسُلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ اَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓاْ اِلَّا اللَّهَ ۖ قَالُواْ لَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَاَنزَلَ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةًۭ فَاِنَّا بِمَآ اُرْسِلْتُم بِهِ كَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then nation of Aad unjustly showed proud in the land and said who is more powerful than us, so did not they see that Who has created everything is more powerful than them, but these people were denying the signs.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَاسْتَكْبَرُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَ قَالُواْ مَنْ اَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ اَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ اَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ

verses.english_text: Then We sent strong winds on them on unlucky days, to taste them the disgraceful punishment in the world and punishment of the Hereafter is more disgraceful, and there they will not be helped also.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًا فِىٓ اَيَّامٍۢ نَّحِسَاتٍۢ لِّنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْىِ فِى الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ اَخْزَىٰ ۖ وَهُمْ لَا يُنصَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And We gave guidance to the nation of Samood also, but they preferred misguidance over guidance; so disgraceful punishment of lightning overtook them; as recompense of the deeds which they were doing.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَاسْتَحَبُّواْ الْعَمَىٰ عَلَى الْهُدَىٰ فَاَخَذَتْهُمْ صَـٰعِقَةُ الْعَذَابِ الْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ

verses.english_text: We delivered them who believed and were pious.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَجَّيْنَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَكَانُواْ يَتَّقُونَ

verses.english_text: The day when enemies of Allah will be sent to Hell that day they will be tortured and reprimanded.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ اَعْدَآءُ اللَّهِ اِلَى النَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ

verses.english_text: When they will all come near Hell, then their ears, their eyes, and their skin will testify against their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا مَا جَآءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَاَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ وَجُلُودُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: They will say to their body parts how you have testified against us, they will say: Allah made us speak Who have given speaking power to everyone, and on the first day He has created you, and now also you will return to his Presence.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ لِجُلُودِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدتُّمْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ قَالُوٓاْ اَنطَقَنَا اللَّهُ الَّذِىٓ اَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ وَاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
