verses.english_text: And you have not drawn any curtain that your ears, your eyes, your flesh, and skin does not testify against you, and you thought that they are not aware about many of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ اَن يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَآ اَبْصَـٰرُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن ظَنَنتُمْ اَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: And these your (evil) thought which you have made about Allah has destroyed you; and you are among the losers.
verses.arabic_text: وَذَٰلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ الَّذِى ظَنَنتُم بِرَبِّكُمْ اَرْدَىٰكُمْ فَاَصْبَحْتُم مِّنَ الْخَـٰسِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Now even if they tolerate their abode is Hell, and if they want to excuse, their excuse will not be accepted.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِن يَصْبِرُواْ فَالنَّارُ مَثْوًۭى لَّهُمْ ۖ وَاِن يَسْتَعْتِبُواْ فَمَا هُم مِّنَ الْمُعْتَبِينَ

verses.english_text: And We have provided them companions who had decorated their earlier deeds in their eyes, and on them also the punishment was proven as it had been proven on their earlier humans and jinns; they are all among the losers.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَيَّنُواْ لَهُم مَّا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيهِمْ وَ مَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِىٓ اُمَمٍۢ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنسِ ۖ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ خَـٰسِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And infidels say do not listen to the Quran at all, and when it is recited make commotion, we might dominate them like this.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَسْمَعُواْ لِهَـٰذَا الْقُرْءَانِ وَالْغَوْاْ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ

verses.english_text: So now We will taste severe punishment to those who indulged in polytheism and shall give punishment to them for their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ اَسْوَاَ الَّذِى كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: This Hell is the right punishment for the enemies of Allah in which their abode is forever, this is the punishment for they had denied the verses of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ اَعْدَآءِ اللَّهِ النَّارُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا دَارُ الْخُلْدِ ۖ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ

verses.english_text: And the infidels will plead O Lord, who among the humans and jinns who had misguided us, so that we trample them beneath our feet, so that they are despised.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ رَبَّنَآ اَرِنَا الَّذَيْنِ اَضَلَّانَا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ اَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ الْاَسْفَلِينَ

verses.english_text: Verily, those who said Allah is our Lord and were steadfast on it, on them angels come with the message that do not fear and do not be sad, and be happy with this Paradise which is being promised to you.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَـٰمُواْ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ اَلَّا تَخَافُواْ وَلَا تَحْزَنُواْ وَاَبْشِرُواْ بِالْجَنَّةِ الَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

verses.english_text: We are with you; in life of this world and we are with you in the Hereafter, and in Paradise everything is available which your heart desires and which you will demand.
verses.arabic_text: نَحْنُ اَوْلِيَآؤُكُمْ فِى الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِىٓ اَنفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ

verses.english_text: From the very Forgiving and Merciful Lord these are the provisions for your hospitality.
verses.arabic_text: نُزُلًۭا مِّنْ غَفُورٍۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: What else can be better that he invites towards Allah, and do good works also and say that I am from the obedient.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَنْ اَحْسَنُ قَوْلًۭا مِّمَّن دَعَآ اِلَى اللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا وَقَالَ اِنَّنِى مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Good and evil cannot be the same, therefore do reply to the evil with good talk, in this way even those who have enmity can become warm friends.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَسْتَوِى الْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا السَّيِّئَةُ ۚ ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِى هِىَ اَحْسَنُ فَاِذَا الَّذِى بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُ عَدَٰوَةٌۭ كَاَنَّهُ وَلِىٌّ حَمِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And none can have this ability except those who are patient, and they get this thing who are very lucky.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ اِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ وَ مَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ اِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Seek refuge from Allah if you get any whispering from Satan, He is all Hearing and Knowing.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَـٰنِ نَزْغٌۭ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ ۖ اِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: And these signs of Allah are night and day, sun and the moon, therefore do not prostrate before sun and the Moon but prostrate before Allah who have created all this, if you are really worshipping Him.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِ الَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ ۚ لَا تَسْجُدُواْ لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَاسْجُدُواْ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى خَلَقَهُنَّ اِن كُنتُمْ اِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ

verses.english_text: {Prostrate, Obligatory} So let them show arrogance if they wish, who are in the presence of Allah glorify Him day and night and they never get tired.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنِ اسْتَكْبَرُواْ فَالَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُ بِالَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْـَٔمُونَ ۩

verses.english_text: This is among His signs that you see the earth plain and dead and when We send water it flourishes again, then you see growth in it. Verily, who brought earth to life, will bring alive the dead (humans) also, indeed He has power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِٓ اَنَّكَ تَرَى الْاَرْضَ خَـٰشِعَةًۭ فَاِذَآ اَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَآءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ ۚ اِنَّ الَّذِىٓ اَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْىِ الْمَوْتَىٰٓ ۚ اِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ

verses.english_text: Verily, those who make changes in our verses cannot hide from Us, think who is better, one who will be put into Hell or the one who will be fearless on the Day of Judgement; you do whatever you wish, Allah is watcher of all your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ اٰيٰتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَآ ۗ اَفَمَن يُلْقَىٰ فِى النَّارِ خَيْرٌ اَم مَّن يَاْتِىٓ ءَامِنًۭا يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ اعْمَلُواْ مَا شِئْتُمْ ۖ اِنَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

verses.english_text: Verily, those who denied the Quran after its revelation their recompense is bad, this is Book of highest status.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِالذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ ۖ وَاِنَّهُ لَكِتٰبٌ عَزِيزٌۭ

verses.english_text: Falsehood cannot come near it, in front or behind it, this Book has been revealed by the Wise and Praiseworthy Allah.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا يَاْتِيهِ الْبَـٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِ ۖ تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: O Prophet, whatever is being said to you has been told to the prophets earlier than you (also), and your Lord is Forgiving and also the owner of the painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ اِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبْلِكَ ۚ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَذُو عِقَابٍ اَلِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And if We would have revealed Quran in non-Arabic language then they would have said why its verses are not clear, and what is the connection of non-Arabic book with the Arabs; say: this book is healing and guidance for the believers, and those who do not believe have deafness in their ears and they are not seeing also, and they will be called out from very far-off place.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَانًا اَعْجَمِيًّۭا لَّقَالُواْ لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ اٰيٰتُهُٓ ۖ ءَا۬عْجَمِىٌّۭ وَعَرَبِىٌّۭ ۗ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ هُدًۭى وَشِفَآءٌۭ ۖ وَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌۭ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: And Verily, We gave the book to Moosa but they created a quarrel in it, and if it was not decided earlier, it would have been decided among them, they were in a very uneasy doubt.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتٰبَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۗ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌۭ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَاِنَّهُمْ لَفِى شَكٍّۢ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍۢ

verses.english_text: Whoever will do good work will do it for oneself, and whoever will do evil will be responsible for it, and your Lord is not unjust on His servants.
verses.arabic_text: مَّنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا فَلِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَنْ اَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۗ وَ مَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّـٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

verses.english_text: To Him is the knowledge of the Day of Judgement; and fruits which come out of the covering or women who get pregnant or the children they bear, this is all according to His Knowledge, that day when He will call out: where are My partners? Polytheists will forcibly say: we have already said that we do not know them.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ ۚ وَ مَا تَخْرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَٰتٍۢ مِّنْ اَكْمَامِهَا وَ مَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ اُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ اِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ ۚ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ اَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِى قَالُوٓاْ ءَاذَنَّـٰكَ مَا مِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: They will all vanish whom they used to call earlier, now they will realize that there is no escaping.
verses.arabic_text: وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَدْعُونَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَظَنُّواْ مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍۢ

verses.english_text: Man does not tire of praying for good, and when any trouble touches him he gets dejected and hopeless.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا يَسْـَٔمُ الْاِنسَـٰنُ مِن دُعَآءِ الْخَيْرِ وَاِن مَّسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوسٌۭ قَنُوطٌۭ

verses.english_text: And after trouble if We taste him Our Mercy, he says it was my right, and I do not think that the Day of Judgement will ever establish, and if I am returned to the Lord there is good for me over there; then We shall tell infidels what they did, and will taste them severe punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَئِنْ اَذَقْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَـٰذَا لِى وَ مَآ اَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةًۭ وَلَئِن رُّجِعْتُ اِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ اِنَّ لِى عِندَهُ لَلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍۢ

verses.english_text: When We show favour to humans, they get aside from Us and get away by turning his side, and when any difficulty afflict them they makes lengthy supplications.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَآ اَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْاِنسَـٰنِ اَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِ وَاِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَآءٍ عَرِيضٍۢ

verses.english_text: Say: do you think if this Quran is from Allah, and you deny it, then who will be more misguided than who is in a prolonged opposition?
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم بِهِ مَنْ اَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: We shortly will show our signs all around the world and in their own souls, that it is proven on them that He is the Truth, and is it not enough for the Lord that He is witness to everything, and all seeing.
verses.arabic_text: سَنُرِيهِمْ اٰيٰتِنَا فِى الْـَٔافَاقِ وَفِىٓ اَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ اَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ ۗ اَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ اَنَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ

verses.english_text: Be aware that they are in doubt from meeting with Allah, and be aware that Allah has encompassed everything.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَآ اِنَّهُمْ فِى مِرْيَةٍۢ مِّن لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ اَلَآ اِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مُّحِيطٌۢ

verses.english_text: Ha Meem
verses.arabic_text: حمٓ

verses.english_text: Ain Seen Qaaf
verses.arabic_text: عٓسٓقٓ

verses.english_text: Likewise, Mighty and Wise Allah send the revelation to you and people earlier than you.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِىٓ اِلَيْكَ وَاِلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: Whatever is on earth and in the sky is His property; and that He is most Great and Most High.
verses.arabic_text: لَهُ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَلِىُّ الْعَظِيمُ

verses.english_text: It is near that sky is rend from above with His awe, and angels are also glorifying their Lord and are seeking forgiveness for people of the earth; and be aware that is Allah who is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: تَكَادُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِن فَوْقِهِنَّ ۚ وَالْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَن فِى الْاَرْضِ ۗ اَلَآ اِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: And whoever have made the guardians other than Him, Allah is watching their condition, and O Prophet, you are not responsible for anyone.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِٓ اَوْلِيَآءَ اللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ مَآ اَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍۢ

verses.english_text: And like this We revealed to you Quran in Arabic language, so you warn people of Makkah and its vicinity, and warn them from the day when everyone will be gathered, and there is not any doubt in it, that day one group will be in Paradise and another group will be in Hell.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ اَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَيْكَ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لِّتُنذِرَ اُمَّ الْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوْمَ الْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ فَرِيقٌۭ فِى الْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌۭ فِى السَّعِيرِ

verses.english_text: And if Allah pleased, He would have made everyone one nation, but to whoever He pleases enters into His Mercy; and for unjust there is no guardian or helper.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ شَآءَ اللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ اُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَلَـٰكِن يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ وَالظَّـٰلِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ

verses.english_text: Have these people made guardians besides Him, whereas He is the guardian of everyone, and He gives life to the dead ones, and He has Power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: اَمِ اتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِٓ اَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ فَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْوَلِىُّ وَهُوَ يُحْىِ الْمَوْتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And in matters you will disagree, the decision of it is in the Hands of Allah, He is my Lord and I rely on Him, and I turn to Him only.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فَحُكْمُهُٓ اِلَى اللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبِّى عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَاِلَيْهِ اُنِيبُ

verses.english_text: He is the Creator of the skies and the earth, He created the pairs from your souls and also made pairs among the animals, He is spreading you in the world with the pairs, nobody is like Him, He hears to all and sees everything.
verses.arabic_text: فَاطِرُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ اَنفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَٰجًۭا وَمِنَ الْاَنْعَـٰمِ اَزْوَٰجًۭا ۖ يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ ۚ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَىْءٌۭ ۖ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: All the keys of the sky and the earth are in His possession, He expands the sustenance of whoever He pleases, and straitens of whoever He pleases, He is well aware of everything.
verses.arabic_text: لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۖ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ اِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: He made the path for you in your religion whose admonition He did to Nooh, and whose revelation sent towards you also, O Prophet; and whose admonition did to Ibrahim, Moosa and Isa also, that establish the religion and no differences should come up in it; and for polytheists it is very difficult to talk that you invite to them, Allah chooses for His Presence to whomever He pleases, and He guides to whoever turns towards Him.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ الدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِ نُوحًۭا وَالَّذِىٓ اَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَيْكَ وَ مَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِٓ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ ۖ اَنْ اَقِيمُواْ الدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُواْ فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ اِلَيْهِ ۚ اللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ اِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ اِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ

verses.english_text: And these people disagreed among themselves, at the time when they had received the knowledge, this was because of enmity among them, and if the Lord had not decided thing for an appointed period, then it would have been decided among them; and Verily those who have been made to inherit the book, they are in severe doubt about it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا تَفَرَّقُوٓاْ اِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌۭ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ اِلَىٰٓ اَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى لَّقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَاِنَّ الَّذِينَ اُورِثُواْ الْكِتٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِى شَكٍّۢ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍۢ

verses.english_text: Therefore, you invite for this, and act with perseverance as you have been commanded, and do not follow their desires, and say: I believe on the Book which has been revealed from Allah and I have been commanded to do justice among you, Allah is Lord of both - mine and yours, my deeds for myself and your deeds for yourselves, there is no wrangling between us, Allah will gather us all one day, and everybody has to return to Him.
verses.arabic_text: فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَادْعُ ۖ وَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ اُمِرْتَ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ اَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۖ وَقُلْ ءَامَنتُ بِمَآ اَنزَلَ اللَّهُ مِن كِتٰبٍۢ ۖ وَاُمِرْتُ لِاَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ ۖ اللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ ۖ لَنَآ اَعْمَـٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ اَعْمَـٰلُكُمْ ۖ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ۖ اللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا ۖ وَاِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: Those who quarrel about Allah after accepting Him, their arguments are null and waste, and there is wrath of Allah on them, and for them punishment is of severe type.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِى اللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌۭ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌ

verses.english_text: That is Allah who revealed with Truth the Book and the balance; and what do you know, may be the Day of Judgement is near.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ الَّذِىٓ اَنزَلَ الْكِتٰبَ بِالْحَقِّ وَالْمِيزَانَ ۗ وَ مَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌۭ

verses.english_text: Those who hasten in it (in the Day of Judgement) do not believe in it, but those who believe are always fearful of it, and know that after all it is the truth, beware! those who doubt in the Day of Judgement, they are in misguidance and have gone far away.
verses.arabic_text: يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا ۖ وَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ اَنَّهَا الْحَقُّ ۗ اَلَآ اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِى السَّاعَةِ لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

verses.english_text: Allah is Merciful on His servants, He gives sustenance to whoever He pleases, and He is Powerful and the Honorable.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ لَطِيفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ الْقَوِىُّ الْعَزِيزُ

verses.english_text: Whoever desires the reward of the Hereafter, We increase (reward) for him, and who desires the reward in the world, We give him here only, then he will not have any share in the Hereafter.
verses.arabic_text: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهُ فِى حَرْثِهِ ۖ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِ مِنْهَا وَ مَا لَهُ فِى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ

verses.english_text: Do they have any partners who have made the paths for which Allah have not given the permission, and if promise of the day was not there, then the matter would have been decided among them, and verily there is painful punishment for the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَـٰٓؤُاْ شَرَعُواْ لَهُم مِّنَ الدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَاْذَنۢ بِهِ اللَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ الْفَصْلِ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَاِنَّ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: You will see, that the unjust are fearful for punishment of their deeds that will Verily come upon them, and those who have believed, and have done good deeds, they will live in the gardens of Paradise; and for them there is everything in the presence of Allah for which they will desire, and this is a great Mercy of the Lord.
verses.arabic_text: تَرَى الظَّـٰلِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُواْ وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْ ۗ وَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فِى رَوْضَاتِ الْجَنَّاتِ ۖ لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ

verses.english_text: This is greatest Mercy of the Lord for which He has given glad tidings to his servants who have adopted faith and have done good deeds; say: I do not want any recompense for preaching of this prophethood except that you love my near ones; and whoever will earn good, We will give more therein, and Verily Allah is very Forgiving and Appreciator.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ الَّذِى يُبَشِّرُ اللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ ۗ قُل لَّآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ اَجْرًا اِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِى الْقُرْبَىٰ ۗ وَمَن يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةًۭ نَّزِدْ لَهُ فِيهَا حُسْنًا ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ شَكُورٌ

verses.english_text: Do they say that Prophet falsely slanders on Allah, whereas if Allah pleases, He can seal your hearts also, and Allah erases the falsehood, and make Truth steadfast and sustainable through His words, Verily He knows the secrets of the hearts.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا ۖ فَاِن يَشَاِ اللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ ۗ وَيَمْحُ اللَّهُ الْبَـٰطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَـٰتِهِٓ ۚ اِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

verses.english_text: And that is He who accepts the repentance of His servants, and forgives their evils, and is well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِى يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَعْفُواْ عَنِ السَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who believe and did good works they accept the Divine Invitation, Allah increases their recompense with His Mercy and Blessings, and infidels shall have the severest punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَسْتَجِيبُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ ۚ وَالْكَـٰفِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ

verses.english_text: And if Allah would have expanded the sustenance of all His servants they would have revolted, but according to His Will, He sends down in a fixed quantity, He is well aware of His servants and watches their conditions.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَ لَوْ بَسَطَ اللَّهُ الرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِ لَبَغَوْاْ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَـٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّا يَشَآءُ ۚ اِنَّهُ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: That is He who sends down the rain after they are disappointed, and spreads His Mercy, and He is worthy of praise - Master and Guardian.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُواْ وَيَنشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُ ۚ وَهُوَ الْوَلِىُّ الْحَمِيدُ

verses.english_text: And among His signs are creation of earth and the sky and all the living beings walking on it, and whenever He pleases, He has the power to collect them all.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِ خَلْقُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمْعِهِمْ اِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And if any difficulty afflicts you that is of your own doing, and He also forgives many things.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَصَـٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍۢ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ اَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُواْ عَن كَثِيرٍۢ

verses.english_text: And you cannot humble Allah in the land, and for you there is no guardian or helper other than Him.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى الْاَرْضِ ۖ وَ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا نَصِيرٍۢ

verses.english_text: And among his signs are sailing ships in the seas which are as high as mountains.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِ الْجَوَارِ فِى الْبَحْرِ كَالْاَعْلَـٰمِ

verses.english_text: And if He pleases, He causes the wind to become still and all of them will be motionless on the surface, Verily in this reality many signs are found for those who are patient and thankful.
verses.arabic_text: اِن يَشَاْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِٓ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍ

verses.english_text: Or He may cause them to perish because of their deeds, and He also forgives many things.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُواْ وَيَعْفُ عَن كَثِيرٍۢ

verses.english_text: Those who quarrel in Our verses should know that there is no way to escape for them.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ اٰيٰتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then whatever has been given to you is for your comfort in this world, and whatever is in His Presence is (more) good and everlasting for those who believe and rely on their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَآ اُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَمَتَـٰعُ الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَ مَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌۭ وَاَبْقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

verses.english_text: And (they) desist from big sins and indecencies and when they get angry, they forgive.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ الْاِثْمِ وَالْفَوَٰحِشَ وَاِذَا مَا غَضِبُواْ هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who accept the talk of their Lord, and establish prayer and discuss their affairs among them, and spend in Our way from whatever sustenance We have given them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُواْ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَاَقَامُواْ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَاَمْرُهُمْ شُورَىٰ بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ

verses.english_text: And they take revenge when any unjust is done to them (defend themselves).
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ اِذَآ اَصَابَهُمُ الْبَغْىُ هُمْ يَنتَصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And recompense of every evil is alike, but if he forgives and makes amends then his reward is with Allah, and Verily, He does not like the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَزَٰٓؤُاْ سَيِّئَةٍۢ سَيِّئَةٌۭ مِّثْلُهَا ۖ فَمَنْ عَفَا وَاَصْلَحَ فَاَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۚ اِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: If any unjust is done to him and he takes the revenge there is no blame on him.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَنِ انتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ

verses.english_text: Blame is on those who do unjust on people and unnecessarily spread excesses, painful punishment is for them only.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا السَّبِيلُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ النَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِى الْاَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And Verily who have patience and forgive then this act is certainly very encouraging.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ اِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ الْاُمُورِ

verses.english_text: And to whoever Allah leaves in misguidance then there is no friend and guardian for him, you will see that the unjust will say after seeing the punishment: is there any way to return.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِ ۗ وَتَرَى الظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَمَّا رَاَوُاْ الْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ اِلَىٰ مَرَدٍّۢ مِّن سَبِيلٍۢ

verses.english_text: You will see that when they will be brought before the Hell their heads will be bowed down in disgrace, and they will be seeing with their eyes, and the believers will say: Verily the losers are they who have lost themselves and their followers on the Day of Judgement. Now Verily the unjust shall remain in lasting punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَرَىٰهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَـٰشِعِينَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرْفٍ خَفِىٍّۢ ۗ وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اِنَّ الْخَـٰسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ اَنفُسَهُمْ وَاَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ اَلَآ اِنَّ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِى عَذَابٍۢ مُّقِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And there will not be any guardian for them who can help them besides Allah, and to whoever Allah leaves in misguidance, there is no way for him.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنْ اَوْلِيَآءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِن سَبِيلٍ

verses.english_text: Accept the words of Allah before the day comes which cannot be averted, and that day there will be no refuge for you, and you will not have the strength to deny the punishment.
verses.arabic_text: اسْتَجِيبُواْ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ اَن يَاْتِىَ يَوْمٌۭ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ ۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلْجَإٍۢ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَ مَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٍۢ

verses.english_text: Now, if they object, We have not sent you as their guardians, your mission was just to reach the message to them, that's it, and when We taste Our Mercy to humans they show arrogance, and when any evil reaches them because of their deeds, then he becomes very ungrateful.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنْ اَعْرَضُواْ فَمَآ اَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا ۖ اِنْ عَلَيْكَ اِلَّا الْبَلَـٰغُ ۗ وَاِنَّآ اِذَآ اَذَقْنَا الْاِنسَـٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةًۭ فَرِحَ بِهَا ۖ وَاِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ اَيْدِيهِمْ فَاِنَّ الْاِنسَـٰنَ كَفُورٌۭ

verses.english_text: Verily authority of sky and the earth is in the hands of Allah only, whatever He pleases He creates, to whoever He pleases gives daughters, to whoever He pleases gives sons.
verses.arabic_text: لِّلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ اِنَـٰثًۭا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ الذُّكُورَ

verses.english_text: Then He gathers sons and daughters both and makes barren to whom He pleases, Verily, He has Knowledge, Power and Authority.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًۭا وَاِنَـٰثًۭا ۖ وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًا ۚ اِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌۭ قَدِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: It is not for any human that Allah should speak to them, but that He send revelation, or talk from behind the curtain, and send an angel as representative, and then with His permission he reaches the message whatever He pleases, He is most High and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَ مَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ اَن يُكَلِّمَهُ اللَّهُ اِلَّا وَحْيًا اَوْ مِن وَرَآئِ حِجَابٍ اَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًۭا فَيُوحِىَ بِاِذْنِهِ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ اِنَّهُ عَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And thus, We revealed spirit (Quran) to you by Our Command, and you didn't know what the book was, and what the faith was, but We made it a light, through which We guide to Our servants to whoever We please, and Verily We are guiding you to the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ اَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَيْكَ رُوحًۭا مِّنْ اَمْرِنَا ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِى مَا الْكِتٰبُ وَلَا الْاِيمَـٰنُ وَلَـٰكِن جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُورًا نَّهْدِى بِهِ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۚ وَاِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِىٓ اِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Path of Allah in whose authority is all things of the earth and the sky, and Verily like this all affairs will return (to Him).
verses.arabic_text: صِرَٰطِ اللَّهِ الَّذِى لَهُ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ ۗ اَلَآ اِلَى اللَّهِ تَصِيرُ الْاُمُورُ

verses.english_text: Ha Meem
verses.arabic_text: حمٓ

verses.english_text: By this enlightened Book.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِينِ

verses.english_text: Verily, We have made this Arabic Quran so that you understand.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: This book is mentioned on "Laoh-e-Mahfooz" with Us, truly elevated and full of wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّهُ فِىٓ اُمِّ الْكِتٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Shall We desist from admonishing you altogether just because you are doing excesses.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا اَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا مُّسْرِفِينَ

verses.english_text: And We sent many messengers to the nations before you.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَمْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّۢ فِى الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: And there came no prophet to them but they mocked them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يَاْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ اِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

verses.english_text: So We destroyed the people more powerful than them, and an example began.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَهْلَكْنَآ اَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: You ask them: who has created the earth and the skies, they will say: the Mighty and the Knowing one has created them.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَئِن سَاَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: That, Who made earth the cradle for you, and made ways in it, that you might find the path in it.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ

verses.english_text: And Who sent water from the sky in a fixed quantity, and then We enliven the dead earths through it, and like this you will also be taken out of the earth.
verses.arabic_text: وَالَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَاَنشَرْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ

verses.english_text: And Who created all the pairs, and made provision for travelling for you in ships and on the animals.
verses.arabic_text: وَالَّذِى خَلَقَ الْاَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْفُلْكِ وَالْاَنْعَـٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ

verses.english_text: That you sit with comfort on their backs, and when you sit with comfort then remember the blessings of Allah, and say: pure and Self-Sufficient is that Lord who made this subservient for our riding, otherwise we could not have controlled it.
verses.arabic_text: لِتَسْتَوُاْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُواْ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ اِذَا اسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُواْ سُبْحَـٰنَ الَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَ مَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And after all we are going to return to the Presence of our Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّآ اِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ

verses.english_text: And these people assigned a part (son) from His servants for the Lord, Verily humans are very ungrateful.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلُواْ لَهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ جُزْءًا ۚ اِنَّ الْاِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

verses.english_text: Say the truth, of all the creatures has the Lord taken for Himself daughters, and liked sons for you?
verses.arabic_text: اَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍۢ وَاَصْفَىٰكُم بِالْبَنِينَ

verses.english_text: And when they are given the good news of a daughter, like they have described the example of the Beneficent Lord, then their faces turn black and they start to swallow the anger.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا بُشِّرَ اَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مَثَلًۭا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّۭا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ

verses.english_text: What! Who are raised in ornaments can they not talk properly at the time of quarreling?
verses.arabic_text: اَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُاْ فِى الْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى الْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: And those people declared Angels as females who are servants of the Beneficent Allah, are they witness to their creation, shortly their testimony will be written and they will be questioned about it.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلُواْ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَـٰدُ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ اِنَـٰثًا ۚ اَشَهِدُواْ خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَـٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ

verses.english_text: And they say if Allah pleased, we would not have worshipped them, they have no knowledge of it, they are just guessing.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ لَوْ شَآءَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَـٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ اِنْ هُمْ اِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ

verses.english_text: What! Have We given any book to them previously to which they are adhering?
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتٰبًۭا مِّن قَبْلِهِ فَهُم بِهِ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ

verses.english_text: No. But their saying is that they found their forefathers in this tradition, and we are following in their footsteps.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ قَالُوٓاْ اِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ اُمَّةٍۢ وَ اِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ

verses.english_text: And thus, We did not send before you any warner in a settlement, but those who led easy lives in it said: Verily we found our forefathers on a course, and Verily we are followers of their footsteps.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ اَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍۢ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ اِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ اِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ اُمَّةٍۢ وَ اِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ

verses.english_text: So the prophet said, even if I bring a better message on which your forefathers were, they replied we are not going to listen to your message.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قَـٰلَ اَوَ لَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِاَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوٓاْ اِنَّا بِمَآ اُرْسِلْتُم بِهِ كَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then We took revenge from them, so now see what was the end of the deniers.
verses.arabic_text: فَانتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: And when Ibrahim told his (step) father and his nation that I am free from all your gods.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ قَالَ اِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِاَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِٓ اِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ

verses.english_text: Except that Lord who created me, He will shortly guide me.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا الَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَاِنَّهُ سَيَهْدِينِ

verses.english_text: And he made his message a permanent word in his progeny, that perhaps they might return to the Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةًۭ فِى عَقِبِهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: Whereas We gave comfort to them and their elders regularly, so much so that the Truth and Prophet came to them.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And when the Truth came, they said: this is magic and we deny it.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ قَالُواْ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ وَ اِنَّا بِهِ كَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And they started saying: why did this Quran not come on a wealthy person of the two towns (Makkah and Madina)?
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا الْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ

verses.english_text: So are they distributing the blessings of Allah? We distribute among them their livelihood in the life of this world, and We have exalted some of them above others, that some of them may take work from one another, and blessings of Allah is much better than the wealth they have collected.
verses.arabic_text: اَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍۢ دَرَجَـٰتٍۢ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًۭا سُخْرِيًّۭا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And were it not that all people would become a single nation, then to those who deny Beneficent Allah We would have certainly made their roofs and stairs of their houses of silver, by which they climb.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَوْلَآ اَن يَكُونَ النَّاسُ اُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمَـٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًۭا مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And doors of their houses and their throne on which they sit with cushions.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ اَبْوَٰبًۭا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ

verses.english_text: And from gold also, but it is the material for enjoyment of life of the world only, and the Hereafter near Allah is only for the pious people.
verses.arabic_text: وَزُخْرُفًۭا ۚ وَاِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَـٰعُ الْحَيَوٰةِ الدُّنْيَا ۚ وَالْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

verses.english_text: And whoever will be blind from the remembrance of Allah, We will appoint one Satan for him who will be his companion and live with him.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطَـٰنًۭا فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And these Satans prevent them from the path, and they think they are the guided ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ اَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ

verses.english_text: So much so, when they will come to us, they will say: Alas! there would have been distance of east and west between us and them, this comes out to be a bad companion.
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرِينُ

verses.english_text: All this talk will be of no use today for you, you are all partners in the punishment, and you have been unjust also.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ اِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ اَنَّكُمْ فِى الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Can you make deaf to listen, or can you show the path to the blind who is in clear error?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَاَنتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ اَوْ تَهْدِى الْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then We shall take you from the world, after all We have to take revenge from them.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَاِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Or We will show the punishment to you and send it, that We have power to do this also.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِى وَعَدْنَـٰهُمْ فَاِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Therefore, hold this command firmly which has been revealed, that this is totally the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: فَاسْتَمْسِكْ بِالَّذِىٓ اُوحِىَ اِلَيْكَ ۖ اِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: This Quran is a provision of admonition for your nation, and shortly you will all be questioned.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّهُ لَذِكْرٌۭ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ

verses.english_text: And you ask the prophets who had been sent before you, had We appointed other gods to be worshipped besides the Beneficent Allah?
verses.arabic_text: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ اَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ ءَالِهَةًۭ يُعْبَدُونَ

verses.english_text: And We sent Moosa with our signs towards Firaun and chiefs of his nation, he said: I am the messenger from the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ اِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَاِي۟هِ فَقَالَ اِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: But when he presented our signs, they all started making fun of it.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ اِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ

verses.english_text: And the sign which We show is greater than the earlier one, and then We took them in punishment, that perhaps they might return on the path like this.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ اِلَّا هِىَ اَكْبَرُ مِنْ اُخْتِهَا ۖ وَاَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِالْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: And they said: O magician (Moosa)! talk to your Lord for us, as He has made the covenant with you, then We would Verily come on the right path.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ يَـٰٓاَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ اِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ

verses.english_text: But when we averted the punishment, they broke the covenant.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ اِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ

verses.english_text: And Firaun called out to his nation and said: O nation, is this country Egypt is not mine, and all these rivers which are beneath my feet are not mine, then why you are not seeing?
verses.arabic_text: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ اَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ الْاَنْهَـٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ ۖ اَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Am I not better than the person who is contemptible; and who cannot even speak properly.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ اَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌۭ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ

verses.english_text: Then why the gold bracelets were not sent on him, and why did not angels come with him?
verses.arabic_text: فَلَوْلَآ اُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ اَسْوِرَةٌۭ مِّن ذَهَبٍ اَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Thus, Firaun made fools of his people, and they obeyed him, they were evil and transgressing people.
verses.arabic_text: فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُ فَاَطَاعُوهُ ۚ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْمًۭا فَـٰسِقِينَ

verses.english_text: When they brought me to wrath then We took recompense from them, then drowned them all together.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا انتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَاَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We made them useless and as examples, for generations to come.
verses.arabic_text: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ سَلَفًۭا وَمَثَلًۭا لِّلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

verses.english_text: When the son of Maryam was presented as an example, then your nation raised a commotion.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا اِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ

verses.english_text: And said: are our gods better, or is He? And they set the example because of stubbornness; they were contentious people.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَاَـٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ اَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلًۢا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Otherwise, Isa was a servant upon whom We have sent blessings, and We made him an example of Our power for Bani Israel.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا عَبْدٌ اَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

verses.english_text: And if We pleased, We would have settled angels on the earth.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَـٰٓئِكَةًۭ فِى الْاَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ

verses.english_text: And verily this is a clear example of the Day of Judgement, therefore do not doubt in it and follow me that this is the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّهُ لَعِلْمٌۭ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And beware, Satan may not stop you from the path of Truth, and he is your open enemy.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطَـٰنُ ۖ اِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And when Isa came to them with the miracles, then he said: I have come to you with wisdom, and that I may explain to you in the part of what you differ in; hence fear Allah and obey me.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَلِاُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ الَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ وَاَطِيعُونِ

verses.english_text: Allah is mine and your Lord, and worship Him only that this is the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then nations started disputing among themselves, alas! on their condition who did unjust, for them is the punishment of the painful day.
verses.arabic_text: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْاَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ اَلِيمٍ

verses.english_text: Are they waiting only for this that the Day of Judgement comes suddenly, and they do not realize it.
verses.arabic_text: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَن تَاْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Today except for the pious people, all friends will turn into enemies against each other.
verses.arabic_text: الْاَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ اِلَّا الْمُتَّقِينَ

verses.english_text: O My servants, there is no fear for you today, neither will you have any sadness or grief.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَآ اَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ

verses.english_text: These are the people who accepted faith in Our signs, and became obedient.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُواْ مُسْلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Now all of you with your wives enter respectfully in Paradise.
verses.arabic_text: ادْخُلُواْ الْجَنَّةَ اَنتُمْ وَاَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Around them there shall be golden trays and drinking cups around them, and that there will be everything which their hearts will desire and which shall be pleasant to their eyes, and you will all be living here forever.
verses.arabic_text: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍۢ مِّن ذَهَبٍۢ وَاَكْوَابٍۢ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ الْاَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الْاَعْيُنُ ۖ وَاَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

verses.english_text: And this is the Paradise which you are given as inheritance on account of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَتِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِىٓ اُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: There are lots of fruits in it which you will eat.
verses.arabic_text: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌۭ كَثِيرَةٌۭ مِّنْهَا تَاْكُلُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, guilty ones are going to abide forever in the punishment of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ

verses.english_text: Punishment shall not be abated from them; they will be living in a state of despair there.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ

verses.english_text: And We have not done any unjust to them, but they were unjust unto themselves.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And they will call out: O Malik, it will be better if your Lord give us death; they will get the reply: now you are going to abide here only.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَادَوْاْ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ اِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily We come to you with the Truth, but majority of you dislike the Truth.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ جِئْنَـٰكُم بِالْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ

verses.english_text: Have they decided firmly something, then We also know this work.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ اَبْرَمُوٓاْ اَمْرًا فَاِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Or they think We cannot hear their planning and secret talks, What We, Our representatives are writing everything.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ اَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

verses.english_text: Say: if the Beneficent Allah was having son; I am the first worshipper.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌۭ فَاَنَا۠ اَوَّلُ الْعَـٰبِدِينَ

verses.english_text: He is master of the skies and the earth and the throne, is pure and aloof from all these talks.
verses.arabic_text: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

verses.english_text: Leave them on their own terms, they are talking and playing, so much so that they face the Day which has been promised to them.
verses.arabic_text: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلْعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُواْ يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

verses.english_text: And that is He who is Allah in the skies and Allah on the earth, and is Wise, and knower of all things.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِى فِى السَّمَآءِ اِلَـٰهٌۭ وَفِى الْاَرْضِ اِلَـٰهٌۭ ۚ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: Blessed is He who is Owner of the skies and the earth and everything in between them, and He has the knowledge of the Day of Judgement, and towards Whom you shall all be returned.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذِى لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And besides Him whom they call, they do not even have the authority of intercession, but those who testify the truth knowingly.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ الشَّفَـٰعَةَ اِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: If you will ask them that who is their creator, they will say: Allah, then where they are deviating.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَئِن سَاَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ ۖ فَاَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ

verses.english_text: And He is also aware of the saying that O Lord, this is the nation who is not going to believe.
verses.arabic_text: وَقِيلِهِ يَـٰرَبِّ اِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Therefore, turn your face from them, and give a message of peace, then shortly they all will come to know.
verses.arabic_text: فَاصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌۭ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Ha Meem
verses.arabic_text: حمٓ

verses.english_text: I swear by the manifest book.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِينِ

verses.english_text: We have revealed this book on a blessed night; Verily We were the one who gave warning from the punishment.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍۢ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ

verses.english_text: On this night all the affairs of wisdom and expediency are decided.
verses.arabic_text: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ اَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ

verses.english_text: This is commanded from Us and We send the prophets.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

verses.english_text: This is the Mercy of your Lord, and Verily He is all Listening and Knowing.
verses.arabic_text: رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ اِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: Whatever is between skies and the earth and between them belong to the Lord, if you are believing.
verses.arabic_text: رَبِّ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ اِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

verses.english_text: There is no god but Him, He gives life and He gives death, He is your Lord and the Lord of your earlier elders also.
verses.arabic_text: لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: But these people are playing in doubt.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ يَلْعَبُونَ

verses.english_text: Hence, you wait for that day when sky shall bring the evident smoke.
verses.arabic_text: فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَاْتِى السَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Which will engulf everybody, and this is the painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: يَغْشَى النَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then everyone will say: O Lord, drive away this punishment from us, we are believers.
verses.arabic_text: رَّبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ اِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Where they have admonition now in their fate, when the prophet with explicit message had come to them.
verses.arabic_text: اَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ الذِّكْرَىٰ وَ قَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And they turn their face from him saying he is a taught insane.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْاْ عَنْهُ وَ قَالُواْ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ

verses.english_text: Well, We will remove the punishment for some time, but you will do the same again what you are doing.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ الْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ اِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ

verses.english_text: One day will come when We shall strictly catch you because Verily We are the Requiter.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَىٰٓ اِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And We, before them, tested the nation of Firaun when a respected messenger came to them.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَ لَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ

verses.english_text: That deliver me the servants of Allah, I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
verses.arabic_text: اَنْ اَدُّوٓاْ اِلَىَّ عِبَادَ اللَّهِ ۖ اِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ اَمِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And do not feel yourself high before Allah, I have brought very explicit argument for you.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَن لَّا تَعْلُواْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۖ اِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: I seek refuge from my Lord and your Lord that you may stone me.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ اَن تَرْجُمُونِ

verses.english_text: And if you are not going to believe, then get aside from me.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُواْ لِى فَاعْتَزِلُونِ

verses.english_text: Then he prayed to his Lord that this nation is a very criminal nation.
verses.arabic_text: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُٓ اَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ مُّجْرِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Then We said: take my servants and leave by night, that you will be pursued.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا اِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And go away, leaving the sea on its condition, this army is going to be drowned.
verses.arabic_text: وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ اِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ

verses.english_text: These people left behind many a garden and rivers.
verses.arabic_text: كَمْ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ

verses.english_text: And left behind many a farm and the best houses.
verses.arabic_text: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And blessings that they were enjoying.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَعْمَةٍۢ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ

verses.english_text: That is the consequence; and We made other nation to inherit this.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَاَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

verses.english_text: Then neither skies nor earth wept on them; and nor they were given the respite.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَآءُ وَالْاَرْضُ وَ مَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ

verses.english_text: And We saved Bani Israel from disgraceful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ

verses.english_text: From the evil of Firaun, who was the highest among the people doing excesses.
verses.arabic_text: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ اِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِيًۭا مِّنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ

verses.english_text: And We chose Bani Israel thoughtfully among all the nations.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And have given them such signs in which clear tests are found.
verses.arabic_text: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ الْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌۭاْ مُّبِينٌ

verses.english_text: Verily, they say this.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ

verses.english_text: That this is the first death, after that we will not be raised again.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ هِىَ اِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْاُولَىٰ وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

verses.english_text: And if you are truthful bring our forefathers from the graves.
verses.arabic_text: فَاْتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Are they better or the nation of Tab’e and people earlier than them, whom We destroyed because they were all criminals.
verses.arabic_text: اَهُمْ خَيْرٌ اَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ وَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ اَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ مُجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: We have not created earth and the skies and all the creatures between them for play.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ

verses.english_text: We have created them only with the Truth, but most of them are unaware of this.
verses.arabic_text: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Indeed, the Day of Judgment is the appointed time for all of them to be raised.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ اَجْمَعِينَ

verses.english_text: The day when no friend will benefit a friend, and neither will they be helped.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًۭى شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Except he to whom Allah shows mercy, Verily, He is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ اللَّهُ ۚ اِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: Verily, in the Hereafter there is the tree of Thor.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّومِ

verses.english_text: Which is food for the sinners
verses.arabic_text: طَعَامُ الْاَثِيمِ

verses.english_text: That shall boil in their bellies like molten copper.
verses.arabic_text: كَالْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى الْبُطُونِ

verses.english_text: Like the water boils.
verses.arabic_text: كَغَلْىِ الْحَمِيمِ

verses.english_text: Angels will be commanded to catch them and take them to the middle of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: خُذُوهُ فَاعْتِلُوهُ اِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ الْجَحِيمِ

verses.english_text: Then pour the boiling water on their heads.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوْقَ رَاْسِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيمِ

verses.english_text: Tell them to taste whatever they have done, that you were called very honourable and respectful.
verses.arabic_text: ذُقْ اِنَّكَ اَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْكَرِيمُ

verses.english_text: This is the punishment in which you were creating doubt.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِ تَمْتَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, those pious people will be in a secure place.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ اَمِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Amidst the gardens and rivers.
verses.arabic_text: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ

verses.english_text: They will be sitting face to face wearing thick and fine silk clothes.
verses.arabic_text: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍۢ وَاِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ

verses.english_text: Thus shall it be; and We shall make their pairs with the big-eyed Hoories.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: They shall ask calmly for all types of fruits.
verses.arabic_text: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And there they will not taste any death after the first one, and Allah will secure them from the punishment of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا الْمَوْتَ اِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْاُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ

verses.english_text: This is all Grace and Mercy of your Lord; this is the biggest success for the human.
verses.arabic_text: فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ

verses.english_text: Then We made this Quran easy in your language; that perhaps you may take admonition.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then you wait; and these people are already waiting.
verses.arabic_text: فَارْتَقِبْ اِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ

verses.english_text: Ha Meem
verses.arabic_text: حمٓ

verses.english_text: Revelation of this Book is from Allah Who is Honorable and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: تَنزِيلُ الْكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ

verses.english_text: Verily, in the skies and the earth many signs are found for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And even in your creation; and the animals which he spread are many signs for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَفِى خَلْقِكُمْ وَ مَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ اٰيٰتٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُوقِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And in alternation of the day and night; and in the sustenance which Allah sends down from the sky, through which dead earth is brought to life, and in the moving of breeze, signs are found for that nation which have wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَاخْتِلَـٰفِ الَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَ مَآ اَنزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزْقٍۢ فَاَحْيَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ الرِّيَـٰحِ اٰيٰتٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: These are verses of Allah which are being recited; then after Allah and His verses, on which thing they are going to believe.
verses.arabic_text: تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ اللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ فَبِاَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَ اللَّهِ وَاٰيٰتِهِ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, Alas! On the condition of every liar sinner.
verses.arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ اَفَّاكٍ اَثِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Who listens to the recitation of verses then shows arrogance as if he has not heard, so give him the glad tiding of painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: يَسْمَعُ اٰيٰتِ اللَّهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَاَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And whenever he comes to know any of Our signs, he makes fun of it; Verily, these are the people for whom there is disgraceful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ اٰيٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا اتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: Hell is behind them, and whatever they have earned and to whom they have made their guardians leaving Allah will not be of any use, and for them is the big punishment.
verses.arabic_text: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُم مَّا كَسَبُواْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا مَا اتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ اَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

verses.english_text: This Quran is guidance, and there is a grievous type of painful punishment for those who deny the verses of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا هُدًۭى ۖ وَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مِّن رِّجْزٍ اَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Allah has made seas subservient to you that ships may sail from His command and you may search the Blessings and Mercy of Allah, and perhaps may be thankful to Him.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اللَّهُ الَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِىَ الْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِاَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُواْ مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: And only He made subservient everything of earth and skies for you; Verily in these, signs are found for that nation which ponder.
verses.arabic_text: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا مِّنْهُ ۚ اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: Say to those who believe that forgive those who do not fear the divine days so Allah may recompense the nation fully for their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَغْفِرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ اَيَّامَ اللَّهِ لِيَجْزِىَ قَوْمًۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ

verses.english_text: Whoever will do good work will do it for his own benefit, and whoever will do bad deeds will do it for his own loss, thereafter you will all be returned to your Lord.
verses.arabic_text: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا فَلِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَنْ اَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۖ ثُمَّ اِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And Verily We gave book, wisdom and prophethood to Bani Israel, and gave them pure sustenance, and made them excel over the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا بَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ الْكِتٰبَ وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَى الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And gave them explicit signs of Our affairs, then after advent of knowledge they disputed among themselves due to stubbornness, so Verily your Lord will judge between them in all the matters on the Day of Judgement, in which they were disputing.
verses.arabic_text: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ مِّنَ الْاَمْرِ ۖ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوٓاْ اِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

verses.english_text: Then We appointed you on the clear course of Our affairs, that you follow it; and beware do not follow the desires of the ignorant.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَـٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍۢ مِّنَ الْاَمْرِ فَاتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ اَهْوَآءَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: These people are not of slightest useful against Allah, these oppressors are friends of each other, so then Allah is Guardian of the pious people.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُمْ لَن يُغْنُواْ عَنكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَاِنَّ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ اَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ وَاللَّهُ وَلِىُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ

verses.english_text: This is the collection of light for the people, and guidance and mercy for the believing nation.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا بَصَـٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُوقِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Are the bad-doers thinking that We will hold them equal with those who believe and do good deeds, that their life and death will be the same, they have judged very badly.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ اجْتَرَحُواْ السَّيِّـَٔاتِ اَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَالَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَوَآءًۭ مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ

verses.english_text: And Allah created the sky and the earth with the Truth, and also because every soul can be recompensed for his deeds, and no unjust shall be done on anyone.
verses.arabic_text: وَخَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Have you seen the person who has taken his desires as God, and Allah has left him in misguidance seeing his condition, and has sealed his ears and heart and there are veils on his eyes; and who can guide him after Allah, don't you even ponder this much?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ اِلَـٰهَهُ هَوَىٰهُ وَاَضَلَّهُ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۢ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِ غِشَـٰوَةًۭ فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ اللَّهِ ۚ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: And these people say that this is worldly life only in which we die and live and time destroys us; they have no knowledge of this, that this is their thinking only, and that's it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ مَا هِىَ اِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَ مَا يُهْلِكُنَآ اِلَّا الدَّهْرُ ۚ وَ مَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ اِنْ هُمْ اِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ

verses.english_text: And when Our clear verses are recited before them, their argument is no other than that if you are truthful bring alive our fathers.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ اِلَّآ اَن قَالُواْ ائْتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Say: Allah has also kept you alive, then one day He will cause death to you, in the end He will gather everybody on the Day of Judgement; and there is no doubt in it, but most of the people even do not understand this.
verses.arabic_text: قُلِ اللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And the Kingdom of the earth and the sky is of Allah, and when the Day of Judgement will be established Verily that day people of falsehood will be at a loss.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَخْسَرُ الْمُبْطِلُونَ

verses.english_text: You will see all the nations kneeling, and everyone shall be called towards their book of deeds that today you will be recompensed for your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ اُمَّةٍۢ جَاثِيَةًۭ ۚ كُلُّ اُمَّةٍۢ تُدْعَىٰٓ اِلَىٰ كِتٰبِهَا الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: This is Our book which speaks with the truth, and We are continuously recording your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا كِتٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيْكُم بِالْحَقِّ ۚ اِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Now, those who believed and did good deeds, Allah will make them enter into His Mercy, this is obvious success.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْمُبِينُ

verses.english_text: And those who adopted infidelity, so were not Our verses being recited in front of you? but you showed arrogance and you were a criminal nation.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ اَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ اٰيٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And when it was said that the promise of Allah is true and there is not any doubt in the Day of Judgement, then you said: we do not know the Day of Judgement and we consider it an imagination and we are not going to believe on this.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا قِيلَ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَالسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُم مَّا نَدْرِى مَا السَّاعَةُ اِن نَّظُنُّ اِلَّا ظَنًّۭا وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And for them evil of their deeds were proven; and that punishment encircled them of which they had made fun of.
verses.arabic_text: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

verses.english_text: And they were told that today We will overlook you the way you had forgotten the meeting of today; and Hell is consequence of all of you, and you do not have any helper.
verses.arabic_text: وَقِيلَ الْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا وَمَاْوَىٰكُمُ النَّارُ وَ مَا لَكُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ

verses.english_text: This is all because you had mocked at the Divine Verses, and worldly life had kept you in deception, today they will not be taken out of punishment, and they will not be even given chance to seek the forgiveness.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكُم بِاَنَّكُمُ اتَّخَذْتُمْ اٰيٰتِ اللَّهِ هُزُوًۭا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ الْحَيَوٰةُ الدُّنْيَا ۚ فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ

verses.english_text: All the praise is for Allah only who is Lord and Master of the skies and the earth and all the worlds.
verses.arabic_text: فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ رَبِّ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ الْاَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Greatness is His in the skies and the earth, and He is Honorable and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَهُ الْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: Ha Meem
verses.arabic_text: حمٓ

verses.english_text: This is the Book revealed by Allah, the Honorable and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: تَنزِيلُ الْكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ

verses.english_text: We have created skies and the earth and all creatures in between with the Truth and with an appointed term, and those who have adopted infidelity have turned aside from which they have been warned.
verses.arabic_text: مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَآ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَاَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ وَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَمَّآ اُنذِرُواْ مُعْرِضُونَ

verses.english_text: So you say to them: have you seen them to whom you call besides Allah, if yes, then show me also that what they have created on earth or what partnership they have in the skies, then if you are truthful show me any earlier book or traces of the knowledge.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ اَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُواْ مِنَ الْاَرْضِ اَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌۭ فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ۖ ائْتُونِى بِكِتٰبٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِ هَـٰذَآ اَوْ اَثَـٰرَةٍۢ مِّنْ عِلْمٍ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Who can be more misguided who call upon others besides Allah who cannot reply to their calls (even) till the Day of Judgement, and they are oblivious of the sound of their calls.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَنْ اَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدْعُواْ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَن لَّا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُٓ اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَهُمْ عَن دُعَآئِهِمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ

verses.english_text: When all the people will gather on the Day of Judgement these gods will become their enemies and will deny of their worshipping.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا حُشِرَ النَّاسُ كَانُواْ لَهُمْ اَعْدَآءًۭ وَكَانُواْ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And when Our bright verses are recited in front of them, so infidels after coming of the Truth say in this regard that this is clear magic.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

verses.english_text: Do they say that the prophet has slandered, so you say: if I have slandered then you are not going to be of any use to me, and Allah knows well what you utter about Him, and He is sufficient as witness between me and you, and He is very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَىٰهُ ۖ قُلْ اِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِى مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۖ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ ۖ كَفَىٰ بِهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: Say: that I am not the prophet of any new kind and I do not know what will be done to me and to you, I only follow the Divine Revelation and I am a plain warner of the Allah's punishment.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ مَا كُنتُ بِدْعًۭا مِّنَ الرُّسُلِ وَ مَآ اَدْرِى مَا يُفْعَلُ بِى وَلَا بِكُمْ ۖ اِنْ اَتَّبِعُ اِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ اِلَىَّ وَ مَآ اَنَا۠ اِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: Say: do you think if this Quran is from Allah and you have denied it, whereas a person of Bani Israel had testified about it and he has also become a believer; even then you showed arrogance, Verily, Allah's guidance is not for the unjust people. ​
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُم بِهِ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثْلِهِ فَـَٔامَنَ وَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ ۖ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And these infidels say to the believers that if this religion was better then they would not have gone ahead of us; and when they did not get the guidance themselves now they say that it is a very old lie.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًا مَّا سَبَقُونَآ اِلَيْهِ ۚ وَاِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُواْ بِهِ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَـٰذَآ اِفْكٌۭ قَدِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Before this, it was the Book of Moosa which was guidance and mercy; and this Book is in Arabic which verifies all that it may warn the unjust from the punishment of Allah, and for the good doers it is complete good news.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِن قَبْلِهِ كِتٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ اِمَامًۭا وَرَحْمَةًۭ ۚ وَهَـٰذَا كِتٰبٌۭ مُّصَدِّقٌۭ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لِّيُنذِرَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Verily, those who called Allah their Lord and are steadfast on it, there is no fear or grief for them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَـٰمُواْ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

verses.english_text: These are in fact the people of Paradise and shall abide in it forever, and this is the real recompense for their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ اَصْحَـٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: And We gave admonition to the man to be good with his parents that his mother had kept him with lots of difficulty in her womb and then with difficulty gave birth, and period from the pregnancy till weaning is thirty months; when he gained maturity and reached forty years then he prayed: O Lord, give me opportunity that I may thank You for Your blessings which You have bestowed upon me and my parents, I may do good that You are pleased with me; and give admonition and piety in my descendants, my attention is towards You only and I may be Your obedient servant.
verses.arabic_text: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنسَـٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ اِحْسَـٰنًا ۖ حَمَلَتْهُ اُمُّهُ كُرْهًۭا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًۭا ۖ وَحَمْلُهُ وَفِصَـٰلُهُ ثَلَـٰثُونَ شَهْرًا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا بَلَغَ اَشُدَّهُ وَبَلَغَ اَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةًۭ قَالَ رَبِّ اَوْزِعْنِىٓ اَنْ اَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِىٓ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَاَنْ اَعْمَلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَاَصْلِحْ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ ۖ اِنِّى تُبْتُ اِلَيْكَ وَاِنِّى مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: These are the people whose good deeds We accept and forgive their bad deeds, they are among the people of Paradise, and this is the promise of Allah which they are being promised continuously.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ اَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَن سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ فِىٓ اَصْحَـٰبِ الْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَعْدَ الصِّدْقِ الَّذِى كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ

verses.english_text: And who said to his parents: woe unto you that you are scaring me from being raised again from the grave whereas many nations have passed before me; and they were crying: O Son, this is very sad, become a believer, Verily promise of Allah is true, but he said: these are the fictions of the ancient people.
