verses.arabic_text: وَالَّذِى قَالَ لِوَٰلِدَيْهِ اُفٍّۢ لَّكُمَآ اَتَعِدَانِنِىٓ اَنْ اُخْرَجَ وَ قَدْ خَلَتِ الْقُرُونُ مِن قَبْلِى وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ اللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ ءَامِنْ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَـٰذَآ اِلَّآ اَسَـٰطِيرُ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: These are the people on whom punishment has proved; in the Ummah of humans and jinns who have passed by, Verily, they will be among the losers.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِىٓ اُمَمٍۢ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنسِ ۖ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ خَـٰسِرِينَ

verses.english_text: For everyone there will be ranks according to their deeds and that Allah will recompense completely for their deeds, and not any kind of unjust will be done on them.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِكُلٍّۢ دَرَجَـٰتٌۭ مِّمَّا عَمِلُواْ ۖ وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ اَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And the day when infidels will be brought before Hell, that you have enjoyed the life in the world and have rested there, so today (you) will be given disgraceful punishment that you were arrogant on the earth and were disobeying the commands of the Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَلَى النَّارِ اَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَـٰتِكُمْ فِى حَيَاتِكُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَاسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهَا فَالْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ الْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِى الْاَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْسُقُونَ

verses.english_text: And remember brother of Aad, Hud that he warned his nation in the sandy plains, that before him and after him many messengers have passed (saying) do not worship anyone except Allah, I am fearful for you from the punishment of a hard day.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَاذْكُرْ اَخَا عَادٍ اِذْ اَنذَرَ قَوْمَهُ بِالْاَحْقَافِ وَ قَدْ خَلَتِ النُّذُرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِٓ اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓاْ اِلَّا اللَّهَ اِنِّىٓ اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Those people said: you have come to us that you may deviate us from our gods; so bring the punishment from which you are warning us, if you are truthful in your talk.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ اَجِئْتَنَا لِتَاْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَاْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ اِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: He said knowledge is only with Allah and I deliver to you His message which is given to me, however, I think you are an ignorant nation.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَاُبَلِّغُكُم مَّآ اُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ وَلَـٰكِنِّىٓ اَرَىٰكُمْ قَوْمًۭا تَجْهَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Thereafter when they saw the cloud which was coming towards their valleys, they said this cloud is going to rain upon us, whereas, this is the same punishment for which you have hastened for, this is the wind in which there is painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَاَوْهُ عَارِضًۭا مُّسْتَقْبِلَ اَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُواْ هَـٰذَا عَارِضٌۭ مُّمْطِرُنَا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ مَا اسْتَعْجَلْتُم بِهِ ۖ رِيحٌۭ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: It will destroy everything by the command of Allah; result was that nothing was seen except the houses, and like this We punish the criminal nation.
verses.arabic_text: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِاَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَاَصْبَحُواْ لَا يُرَىٰٓ اِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الْقَوْمَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And certainly, We had given them the authorities which (We) have not given to you, and We had given them ears, eyes and hearts, but neither ears benefitted them nor eyes and hearts, that they were deniers of the Divine verses; and they were encompassed by the punishment, which they used to mocked at.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ مَكَّنَّـٰهُمْ فِيمَآ اِن مَّكَّنَّـٰكُمْ فِيهِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَمْعًۭا وَاَبْصَـٰرًا وَاَفْـِٔدَةًۭ فَمَآ اَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَلَآ اَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ وَلَآ اَفْـِٔدَتُهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ اِذْ كَانُواْ يَجْحَدُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ اللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, We destroyed many a settlement around you, and showed Our signs repeatedly that perhaps they may come back towards the Truth.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَهْلَكْنَا مَا حَوْلَكُم مِّنَ الْقُرَىٰ وَصَرَّفْنَا الْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

verses.english_text: So why they did not benefitted them whom they have adopted as gods besides Allah to draw near to Him, but instead they disappeared; and this was their lie and slander which they used to fabricate regularly.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَهُمُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ قُرْبَانًا ءَالِهَةًۢ ۖ بَلْ ضَلُّواْ عَنْهُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ اِفْكُهُمْ وَ مَا كَانُواْ يَفْتَرُونَ

verses.english_text: When We made a group of jinn attentive towards you to listen to Quran; when they came, they said among themselves to listen silently, when recitation ended, they returned immediately to their nation as warners.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ صَرَفْنَآ اِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِّنَ الْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقُرْءَانَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوٓاْ اَنصِتُواْ ۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِىَ وَلَّوْاْ اِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ

verses.english_text: (They) said: O people of the nation we have heard the Book which has been revealed after Moosa, it verifies the books before it and guides towards the truth, justice, and the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ يَـٰقَوْمَنَآ اِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتٰبًا اُنزِلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِىٓ اِلَى الْحَقِّ وَاِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: O people of the nation say yes to him who is inviting you towards Allah and become a believer so that Allah forgives your sins and gives you refuge from the painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰقَوْمَنَآ اَجِيبُواْ دَاعِىَ اللَّهِ وَءَامِنُواْ بِهِ يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ اَلِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And whoever will not say yes to the Divine Caller, cannot humble Allah, and for him there is no guardian other than Allah; verily they are in explicit misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن لَّا يُجِبْ دَاعِىَ اللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍۢ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مِن دُونِهِٓ اَوْلِيَآءُ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

verses.english_text: Did not they observed that Allah, Who created the skies and the earth was not helpless from their creation, he also has the power to bring to life the dead, and verily He has power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ اَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِى خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْىَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ اَن يُحْـِۧىَ الْمَوْتَىٰ ۚ بَلَىٰٓ اِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: When these infidels will be presented before Hell, they will all say; is that not the Truth?; by Lord this is all Truth, then (Allah) will say: now taste the punishment because earlier you were denying it.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَلَى النَّارِ اَلَيْسَ هَـٰذَا بِالْحَقِّ ۖ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا ۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُواْ الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Be patient, as the Arch-Prophets were patient, and do not seek haste for the punishment, that day when they will see the punishment from which they are being warned, they will think that they have stayed in the world for one day or only one hour, this Quran is the last argument for them, is any nation will be destroyed other than the transgressors?
verses.arabic_text: فَاصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ اُو۟لُواْ الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِل لَّهُمْ ۚ كَاَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓاْ اِلَّا سَاعَةًۭ مِّن نَّهَارٍۭ ۚ بَلَـٰغٌۭ ۚ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ اِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْفَـٰسِقُونَ

verses.english_text: Whoever adopted infidelity and hindered people from the path of Allah, He shall destroy their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ اَضَلَّ اَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

verses.english_text: And whoever adopted faith and did good deeds and believed on whatever was revealed on Mohammad and which is Truth from the Lord, so Allah will remove their bad deeds and shall improve their condition.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَءَامَنُواْ بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍۢ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۙ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَاَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ

verses.english_text: This is because infidels did follow the falsehood and people of faith did follow the Truth which came from their Lord, and like this Allah describes the examples for the people.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ اتَّبَعُواْ الْبَـٰطِلَ وَاَنَّ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اتَّبَعُواْ الْحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ اَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ

verses.english_text: When the infidels come to confront you, smite their necks until they are injured with wounds do tie their arms, thereafter either leave them as a favour or take ransom (and leave them) until they lay down their weapons, remember, if Allah pleased He would have taken the recompense Himself but He wish to test one through another, those who have been slain in His way Allah cannot waste their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا لَقِيتُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَضَرْبَ الرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَآ اَثْخَنتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّواْ الْوَثَاقَ فَاِمَّا مَنًّۢا بَعْدُ وَاِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ الْحَرْبُ اَوْزَارَهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ وَ لَوْ يَشَآءُ اللَّهُ لَانتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَاْ بَعْضَكُم بِبَعْضٍۢ ۗ وَ الَّذِينَ قُتِلُواْ فِى سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ اَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

verses.english_text: Shortly, He will cause to reach them to their destinations and shall improve their condition.
verses.arabic_text: سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ

verses.english_text: He will cause them to enter Paradise which He has identified to them earlier.
verses.arabic_text: وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ

verses.english_text: O people of faith, if you will help Allah, Allah will help you, and shall make you steadfast.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اِن تَنصُرُواْ اللَّهَ يَنصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ اَقْدَامَكُمْ

verses.english_text: And those who adopt infidelity there is unsteadiness for them and their deeds are a waste.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَتَعْسًۭا لَّهُمْ وَاَضَلَّ اَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

verses.english_text: This is because they thought evil about the commands revealed by Allah, so Allah also rendered their deeds null.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُواْ مَآ اَنزَلَ اللَّهُ فَاَحْبَطَ اَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

verses.english_text: So did not they travelled in the land to see that what has happened to their earlier ones, Verily Allah has ruined them, and for infidels such punishment is fixed.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ دَمَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ وَلِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ اَمْثَـٰلُهَا

verses.english_text: This is all because Allah is the Guardian of the people of the faith and there is no guardian for the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَى الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَاَنَّ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَا مَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ

verses.english_text: Verily, those adopted faith and they did good deeds Allah will cause them to enter such gardens beneath which the rivers will be flowing and those who adopted infidelity they are enjoying, they eat as the animals eat; and in the end their abode is Hell.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ وَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَاْكُلُونَ كَمَا تَاْكُلُ الْاَنْعَـٰمُ وَالنَّارُ مَثْوًۭى لَّهُمْ

verses.english_text: There were many a settlement which were more powerful than this settlement from which you were driven out, when We destroyed them there was no helper for them.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَاَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ هِىَ اَشَدُّ قُوَّةًۭ مِّن قَرْيَتِكَ الَّتِىٓ اَخْرَجَتْكَ اَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ

verses.english_text: So, can the one who has received the clear argument from Allah be like him whose evil deeds are decorated for him; and then they followed their desires.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِ وَاتَّبَعُوٓاْ اَهْوَآءَهُم

verses.english_text: An example of the Paradise which has been promised to the pious people is this that there are rivers of water which does not have smell of any kind, there are also some rivers of milk whose taste never changes, and some rivers are of wine - a joy for those who drink, some rivers are of clear honey, and for them there are also fruits of every kind, and there is forgiveness from the Lord; so can these pious people be like those who will forever abide in Hell, there they will be given boiling water to drink which will break their bowels into pieces.
verses.arabic_text: مَّثَلُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِى وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ فِيهَآ اَنْهَـٰرٌۭ مِّن مَّآءٍ غَيْرِ ءَاسِنٍۢ وَاَنْهَـٰرٌۭ مِّن لَّبَنٍۢ لَّمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُ وَاَنْهَـٰرٌۭ مِّنْ خَمْرٍۢ لَّذَّةٍۢ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ وَاَنْهَـٰرٌۭ مِّنْ عَسَلٍۢ مُّصَفًّۭى ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَٰتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَـٰلِدٌۭ فِى النَّارِ وَسُقُواْ مَآءً حَمِيمًۭا فَقَطَّعَ اَمْعَآءَهُمْ

verses.english_text: And among them are some people who seem to listen to you attentively, and when they go away from you (they) ask those who have been given the knowledge that what was it that he said just now; these are the people whose hearts have been sealed, and they are following their desires.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ اِلَيْكَ حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا خَرَجُواْ مِنْ عِندِكَ قَالُواْ لِلَّذِينَ اُوتُواْ الْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًا ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَاتَّبَعُوٓاْ اَهْوَآءَهُمْ

verses.english_text: Those who took the guidance, Allah increased their guidance, and blessed them with more piety.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْاْ زَادَهُمْ هُدًۭى وَءَاتَىٰهُمْ تَقْوَىٰهُمْ

verses.english_text: Then, are they awaiting the Day of Judgement that it come suddenly to them, whereas its signs have become obvious, even if it come to them, then what admonition they will obtain?
verses.arabic_text: فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَن تَاْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءَ اَشْرَاطُهَا ۚ فَاَنَّىٰ لَهُمْ اِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرَىٰهُمْ

verses.english_text: So understand that there is no god except Allah, and keep seeking forgiveness for you and your men and women who are people of faith; Allah is well aware of your movement and stillness.
verses.arabic_text: فَاعْلَمْ اَنَّهُ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَىٰكُمْ

verses.english_text: Those who adopted faith say why no Chapter (in Quran) has been revealed about (fighting), and when the Chapter was revealed in which fighting was categorically mentioned; then did you see that whose hearts were having sickness were looking at you as if they have fainted because of death, so woe unto them.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَتْ سُورَةٌۭ ۖ فَاِذَآ اُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌۭ مُّحْكَمَةٌۭ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا الْقِتَالُ ۙ رَاَيْتَ الَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ يَنظُرُونَ اِلَيْكَ نَظَرَ الْمَغْشِىِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ ۖ فَاَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ

verses.english_text: Only obedience and good talk is good for them, so when the affair of war gets settled and they remain on their promise to Allah, then it is much better for them.
verses.arabic_text: طَاعَةٌۭ وَقَوْلٌۭ مَّعْرُوفٌۭ ۚ فَاِذَا عَزَمَ الْاَمْرُ فَلَوْ صَدَقُواْ اللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ

verses.english_text: Is it far from you that you become ruler and create mischief in the land and sever ties with relatives?
verses.arabic_text: فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ اِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ اَن تُفْسِدُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوٓاْ اَرْحَامَكُمْ

verses.english_text: These are the people whom Allah has cursed and have made their ears deaf and have made their eyes blind.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فَاَصَمَّهُمْ وَاَعْمَىٰٓ اَبْصَـٰرَهُمْ

verses.english_text: So do they not ponder even a little in the Quran, or their hearts have locks.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْءَانَ اَمْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ اَقْفَالُهَآ

verses.english_text: Verily (as for) those who return on their backs after the guidance has become manifest to them, the Satan has decorated their desires for them; and they have been given ample of respite.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ ارْتَدُّواْ عَلَىٰٓ اَدْبَـٰرِهِم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى ۙ الشَّيْطَـٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمْ وَاَمْلَىٰ لَهُمْ

verses.english_text: This is because, they said to those who did not like the things revealed by Allah that in some matters we would obey you, and Allah is well aware from their secret talks.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ قَالُواْ لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُواْ مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمْ فِى بَعْضِ الْاَمْرِ ۖ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ اِسْرَارَهُمْ

verses.english_text: Then what will happen when death will come, and angels will continuously hit their faces and their backs.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ اِذَا تَوَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَاَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ

verses.english_text: This is because they followed the things which are displeasing to Allah, and (they) disliked His Will, so Allah also made their deeds null.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمُ اتَّبَعُواْ مَآ اَسْخَطَ اللَّهَ وَكَرِهُواْ رِضْوَٰنَهُ فَاَحْبَطَ اَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

verses.english_text: Those in whose hearts sickness are found think that Allah will not bring out the malice of their hearts.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ اَن لَّن يُخْرِجَ اللَّهُ اَضْغَـٰنَهُمْ

verses.english_text: And if We pleased, We would have shown them to you, and you would have recognized them from the expression of their faces, and you would certainly guess by their speech; and Allah is well aware of the deeds of all of you.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَاَرَيْنَـٰكَهُمْ فَلَعَرَفْتَهُم بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ ۚ وَلَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِى لَحْنِ الْقَوْلِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ اَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ

verses.english_text: And certainly, We will try all of you to know that who among you can struggle hard (in the way of Allah) and who can be patient; and like this (We) shall test your condition thoroughly.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَعْلَمَ الْمُجَـٰهِدِينَ مِنكُمْ وَالصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَنَبْلُوَاْ اَخْبَارَكُمْ

verses.english_text: Verily, who adopted infidelity and hindered people from the way of Allah, and even after guidance becoming manifest, they did quarrel with the Prophet, they cannot cause any harm to Allah, shortly Allah will ruin their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَشَآقُّواْ الرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَىٰ لَن يَضُرُّواْ اللَّهَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَسَيُحْبِطُ اَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

verses.english_text: O believers, obey Allah and obey Prophet and beware don't ruin your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اَطِيعُواْ اللَّهَ وَاَطِيعُواْ الرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبْطِلُوٓاْ اَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ

verses.english_text: Verily, who adopted infidelity and creates hindrance in the way of Allah and died in infidelity, so Allah will never forgive them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُواْ وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌۭ فَلَن يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ

verses.english_text: Hence, do not give up, do not propose peace to the enemy, you have upper hand and Allah is with you, He will never lessen the reward of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا تَهِنُواْ وَتَدْعُوٓاْ اِلَى السَّلْمِ وَاَنتُمُ الْاَعْلَوْنَ وَاللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ وَلَن يَتِرَكُمْ اَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ

verses.english_text: This worldly life is just idle sport and play and if you have adopted faith and piety then Allah will give you full reward and would not ask your possessions from you.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا الْحَيَوٰةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌۭ وَلَهْوٌۭ ۚ وَاِن تُؤْمِنُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ يُؤْتِكُمْ اُجُورَكُمْ وَلَا يَسْـَٔلْكُمْ اَمْوَٰلَكُمْ

verses.english_text: Even if He will ask and insist, you will only show your stinginess, and Allah will bring forth your malice.
verses.arabic_text: اِن يَسْـَٔلْكُمُوهَا فَيُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُواْ وَيُخْرِجْ اَضْغَـٰنَكُمْ

verses.english_text: Yes, you are those people that when they are called upon to spend in the way of Allah, some of you show stinginess, and those who are stingy are stingy for themselves, and Allah is Self-Sufficient; you are poor and needy in front of Him, and if you turn your face, Allah will bring another nation in your place who will not be like you.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰٓاَنتُمْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنفِقُواْ فِى سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَمِنكُم مَّن يَبْخَلُ ۖ وَمَن يَبْخَلْ فَاِنَّمَا يَبْخَلُ عَن نَّفْسِهِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ الْغَنِىُّ وَاَنتُمُ الْفُقَرَآءُ ۚ وَاِن تَتَوَلَّوْاْ يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوٓاْ اَمْثَـٰلَكُم

verses.english_text: Verily, We have given you a clear victory.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًۭا مُّبِينًۭا

verses.english_text: So that Allah removes all your past and future blames and complete His favor on you and guide you to the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: لِّيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنۢبِكَ وَ مَا تَاَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَٰطًۭا مُّسْتَقِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: And help you in a magnificent way.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَنصُرَكَ اللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا

verses.english_text: That is Allah who has sent down calm in the hearts of the believers that they might have more faith, all the armies of the earth and skies are of Him and He is all-Knowing and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِىٓ اَنزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ فِى قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوٓاْ اِيمَـٰنًۭا مَّعَ اِيمَـٰنِهِمْ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: That He may cause believing men and believing women to enter into Paradise beneath which rivers are flowing that they always abide in it and shall remove their evil from them, this is the grand success near Allah.
verses.arabic_text: لِّيُدْخِلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عِندَ اللَّهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: May the punishment of Allah be on hypocrite men and hypocrite women and polytheist men and women who have evil thinking about Allah, punishment is circling over their heads and wrath of Allah is on them, Allah has cursed them, and Hell has been provided for them; this is the worst result.
verses.arabic_text: وَيُعَذِّبَ الْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَالْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكَـٰتِ الظَّآنِّينَ بِاللَّهِ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ ۚ عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِرَةُ السَّوْءِ ۖ وَغَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَنَهُمْ وَاَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَسَآءَتْ مَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: And all the forces of the earth and skies are only for Allah, He is Honorable and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا

verses.english_text: O Prophet, We have sent you as a witness, giver of glad tidings and as warner from the punishment of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ شَـٰهِدًۭا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا

verses.english_text: So that you may believe in Allah and His Prophet and help and respect him; and glorify Allah morning and evening.
verses.arabic_text: لِّتُؤْمِنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةًۭ وَاَصِيلًا

verses.english_text: Verily those pay allegiance to you in fact they pay allegiance to Allah, and Allah's Hand is upon their hands, and now whoever breaks the allegiance, he acts against himself; and whoever will fulfil the Divine Promise, Allah will shortly bestow upon him the grand reward.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ اِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ اللَّهَ يَدُ اللَّهِ فَوْقَ اَيْدِيهِمْ ۚ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَاِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَنْ اَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَـٰهَدَ عَلَيْهُ اللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ اَجْرًا عَظِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: Shortly these villagers who stayed behind will say to you: our property and children had kept us busy, so ask forgiveness for us, they are saying this from their tongue which is not in their hearts, so say to them: if Allah intends to harm you or intends to do good then who has the control against Him with regards to your affairs, fact is that Allah is well aware about your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: سَيَقُولُ لَكَ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ الْاَعْرَابِ شَغَلَتْنَآ اَمْوَٰلُنَا وَاَهْلُونَا فَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ۚ يَقُولُونَ بِاَلْسِنَتِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ قُلْ فَمَن يَمْلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا اِنْ اَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرًّا اَوْ اَرَادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعًۢا ۚ بَلْ كَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًۢا

verses.english_text: In fact, you were thinking that Prophet and the believers cannot ever return to their abodes and that thing was decorated in your hearts and you acted distrustfully; and you are a nation doomed to perish.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ ظَنَنتُمْ اَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ الرَّسُولُ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ اِلَىٰٓ اَهْلِيهِمْ اَبَدًۭا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَظَنَنتُمْ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا

verses.english_text: And whoever will not believe on Allah and (His) Prophet, We have prepared the Hell for such infidels.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَاِنَّآ اَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَعِيرًا

verses.english_text: And Kingdom of the earth and the skies is only of Allah's, He forgives whom He pleases and punishes whom He pleases, and Allah is very forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: Shortly these who stayed behind will say: allow us to accompany you when you go for war booty, they want to change the word of Allah; so say: you cannot come with us, Allah has decided this earlier; then they will say: you are envious of us, whereas in fact they understand very little.
verses.arabic_text: سَيَقُولُ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ اِذَا انطَلَقْتُمْ اِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَاْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ ۖ يُرِيدُونَ اَن يُبَدِّلُواْ كَلَـٰمَ اللَّهِ ۚ قُل لَّن تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَٰلِكُمْ قَالَ اللَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلْ تَحْسُدُونَنَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُواْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ اِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Say to these who stayed behind, shortly you will be called towards a hard fighting nation that you continue fighting or they become Muslims, so if you obey Allah, He will give you the best reward; and if you will turn back as you had done earlier then you will be punished through the painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: قُل لِّلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ الْاَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ اِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ اُو۟لِى بَاْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ تُقَـٰتِلُونَهُمْ اَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ ۖ فَاِن تُطِيعُواْ يُؤْتِكُمُ اللَّهُ اَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا ۖ وَاِن تَتَوَلَّوْاْ كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا اَلِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: There is no blame on the blind, and for lame also there is no blame, there is no responsibility for the sick (if they do not join fighting); and those who obey Allah and His Prophet, Allah will cause them to enter such Paradises beneath which rivers will be flowing; and those who will turn back they will be punished with the grievous punishment.
verses.arabic_text: لَّيْسَ عَلَى الْاَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى الْاَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌۭ ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذَابًا اَلِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: Verily Allah was pleased with the believers when they gathered below the tree and were swearing allegiance to you, then He saw everything that was in their hearts and sent calm on them, and in exchange rewarded them the close victory.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ لَّقَدْ رَضِىَ اللَّهُ عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَاَنزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاَثَـٰبَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا قَرِيبًۭا

verses.english_text: And gave many benefits which they will receive, Allah is Predominant on everyone and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةًۭ يَاْخُذُونَهَا ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: He has promised you many benefits which you will receive, then hastened in giving the war booty (of Khaiber) and held back hands of people from you that it may become a sign of power for the people of faith; and He may guide you towards the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: وَعَدَكُمُ اللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةًۭ تَاْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَـٰذِهِ وَكَفَّ اَيْدِىَ النَّاسِ عَنكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَٰطًۭا مُّسْتَقِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: And other booties on which you could not access, Allah is dominant over them also, and Allah has the power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَاُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُواْ عَلَيْهَا قَدْ اَحَاطَ اللَّهُ بِهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرًا

verses.english_text: And if these infidels have fought with you they would have turned their faces and run away, and then they would not have found any guardian and helper.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ قَـٰتَلَكُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوَلَّوُاْ الْاَدْبَـٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّۭا وَلَا نَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: This is a tradition of Allah which has passed, and you can never find a change in the method of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: That is Allah Who held back infidels' hands from you, and your hands from them, at the border of Makkah even after your victory; and Allah is well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِى كَفَّ اَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَاَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ اَنْ اَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: These are the people who adopted infidelity and barred you from entering the Sacred Mosque, and barred the animals of sacrifice from reaching their destinations, and if believing men and believing women were not there whom you didn't know and there was fear of unknowingly trampling upon them, and in this way you may have unintentionally incurred the loss which would not have been stopped, it was stopped because with whomever Allah pleases causes him to enter into His Mercy; if they would have been separated, We would have encompassed infidels into the painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: هُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْهَدْىَ مَعْكُوفًا اَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌۭ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٌۭ مُّؤْمِنَـٰتٌۭ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ اَن تَطَـُٔوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌۢ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ ۖ لِّيُدْخِلَ اللَّهُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُواْ لَعَذَّبْنَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا اَلِيمًا

verses.english_text: This is of that time when infidels who harboured in their hearts the feelings of disdain of the days of ignorance (that they will not allow you to enter Makkah), so Allah sent down tranquility on the Prophet and the people of faith and kept them steady on piety, and they were deserving of this, and Allah is Knower of everything.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ جَعَلَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ الْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ الْجَـٰهِلِيَّةِ فَاَنزَلَ اللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ وَعَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَاَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ التَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓاْ اَحَقَّ بِهَا وَاَهْلَهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: Verily Allah had shown the true dream to His Prophet, Allah pleases, you enter the Sacred Mosque after shaving off the head or trimming your hair and you shall not have any fear; and He knew what you do not know; so He gave you a close victory before the victory of Makkah.
verses.arabic_text: لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ الرُّءْيَا بِالْحَقِّ ۖ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ اِن شَآءَ اللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ ۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُواْ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًۭا قَرِيبًا

verses.english_text: That is Allah Who sent His Prophet with the guidance and the true religion that it dominates all the (previous) religions; and Allah is sufficient for a Witness.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِىٓ اَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًۭا

verses.english_text: Mohammad is the Prophet of Allah, and the people with him are very firm against infidels and very soft hearted among themselves; so you will see that they are bowing down in prostration in His Presence, and are seeking from their Lord Grace and Mercy and His Pleasure; marks of prostration are found on their faces due to frequent prostration, thus is their example in Taurait and thus their virtue in Injeel; as in farming first seed produce then it give out sprouts then strengthen it and becomes thick then it stands on its own stem that make the sowers happy and it becomes a source of envy for infidels; Allah has promised the people of faith and good-doers for forgiveness and grand reward.
verses.arabic_text: مُّحَمَّدٌۭ رَّسُولُ اللَّهِ ۚ وَ الَّذِينَ مَعَهُٓ اَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَىٰهُمْ رُكَّعًۭا سُجَّدًۭا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًۭا ۖ سِيمَاهُمْ فِى وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ اَثَرِ السُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِى التَّوْرَىٰةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِى الْاِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ اَخْرَجَ شَطْـَٔهُ فَـَٔازَرَهُ فَاسْتَغْلَظَ فَاسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِ يُعْجِبُ الزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ الْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةًۭ وَاَجْرًا عَظِيمًۢا

verses.english_text: O People of Faith beware, do not precede your words to Allah and His Prophet, and fear Allah, He is all Hearing and Knowing.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُقَدِّمُواْ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ۖ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: O People of Faith beware, do not raise your voice over the voice of the Prophet and do not speak loudly to him as you call out to one another among yourselves; lest your deeds may go waste, and you are not even aware of it.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَرْفَعُوٓاْ اَصْوَٰتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِىِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُواْ لَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ اَن تَحْبَطَ اَعْمَـٰلُكُمْ وَاَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily those who keep down the tone of their voice in front of the Prophet, these are the people whose hearts Allah has tested for piety, and for them is forgiveness and grand reward.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ اَصْوَٰتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ امْتَحَنَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَاَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Verily those who call out to you from behind the chambers, majority of them do not understand anything.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ الْحُجُرَٰتِ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: And if they had been patient till you come out, it would have been better for them, and Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ اَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُواْ حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ اِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: O people of faith if any transgressor brings any news, then carefully investigate it, lest you reach a nation unknowingly, and then be ashamed of your action.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍۢ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓاْ اَن تُصِيبُواْ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَـٰلَةٍۢ فَتُصْبِحُواْ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَـٰدِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And remember Prophet of Allah is present amidst you, if he listens to you in many of the matters you would have been in trouble, but Allah made the faith beloved for you and adorned it into your hearts; and disliked infidelity, transgression, and disobedience for you, and in fact these people are the guided ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَاعْلَمُوٓاْ اَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ۚ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِى كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنَ الْاَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ حَبَّبَ اِلَيْكُمُ الْاِيمَـٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ اِلَيْكُمُ الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الرَّٰشِدُونَ

verses.english_text: This is Allah's Grace and His Blessings, and Allah is Knower of everything and (He) also has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةًۭ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And if two groups of the believers quarrel then you make peace between them, thereafter if they are unjust on one another then fight unitedly with the group which are doing excesses until they return to submit to the command of Allah; then if they return, make the peace with them, and do justice with them because Allah likes those who do justice.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اقْتَتَلُواْ فَاَصْلِحُواْ بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَاِنۢ بَغَتْ اِحْدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى الْاُخْرَىٰ فَقَـٰتِلُواْ الَّتِى تَبْغِى حَتَّىٰ تَفِىٓءَ اِلَىٰٓ اَمْرِ اللَّهِ ۚ فَاِن فَآءَتْ فَاَصْلِحُواْ بَيْنَهُمَا بِالْعَدْلِ وَاَقْسِطُوٓاْ ۖ اِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ

verses.english_text: Believers are brothers among themselves, so make things right between brothers, keep fearing Allah, so that perhaps you may receive Mercy.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ اِخْوَةٌۭ فَاَصْلِحُواْ بَيْنَ اَخَوَيْكُمْ ۚ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

verses.english_text: O believers, beware, no nation should mock at other nation, because they may be better than they; and group of women should not laugh at the other group, those women may be better than them and do not taunt one another and do not call one another with bad titles; even the name of evil is bad after faith; and know that those who do not repent, they are in fact the unjust people.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌۭ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰٓ اَن يَكُونُواْ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَآءٌۭ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ اَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُنَّ ۖ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوٓاْ اَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُواْ بِالْاَلْقَـٰبِ ۖ بِئْسَ الِاسْمُ الْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ الْاِيمَـٰنِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الظَّـٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: O people of faith avoid most of suspicions, because some suspicions are like sin, and beware, do not find faults in one another and do not backbite others; does anyone among you would like to eat the flesh of your dead brother, definitely you would consider it bad, so fear Allah, verily Allah is acceptor of repentance and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اجْتَنِبُواْ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الظَّنِّ اِنَّ بَعْضَ الظَّنِّ اِثْمٌۭ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُواْ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ اَيُحِبُّ اَحَدُكُمْ اَن يَاْكُلَ لَحْمَ اَخِيهِ مَيْتًۭا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: O people, We have created you from a man and a woman, then made families and tribes among you so that you might identify one another among you, verily most dear among you near Allah is, who is most pious; and Allah is Knowing and Aware.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍۢ وَاُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَـٰكُمْ شُعُوبًۭا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓاْ ۚ اِنَّ اَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ اللَّهِ اَتْقَىٰكُمْ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: These Arabs of desert say we believe, so you say to them: you have not believed but say you just accepted Islam, and faith has not entered into your hearts yet, and if you will obey Allah and His Prophet then He would not lessen your deeds, and He is very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قَالَتِ الْاَعْرَابُ ءَامَنَّا ۖ قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُواْ وَلَـٰكِن قُولُوٓاْ اَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ الْاِيمَـٰنُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۖ وَاِن تُطِيعُواْ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ اَعْمَـٰلِكُمْ شَيْـًٔا ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ

verses.english_text: People of Faith are only those who believe on Allah and His Prophet and then never doubted and struggled hard in His way with their wealth and lives; and in fact, these are the people who are truthful in their claim of faith.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُواْ وَجَـٰهَدُواْ بِاَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَاَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الصَّـٰدِقُونَ

verses.english_text: You tell them: are you teaching your religion to Allah, whereas He is Aware of everything in the skies and the earth, and He is Knower of everything of the universe.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَتُعَلِّمُونَ اللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: They show you as a favor that they have accepted faith, so you say to them: do not show the favor of your faith to me; this is the favor of Allah that He guided you to adopt faith - if you are truthful in claim of faith.
verses.arabic_text: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ اَنْ اَسْلَمُواْ ۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّواْ عَلَىَّ اِسْلَـٰمَكُم ۖ بَلِ اللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ اَنْ هَدَىٰكُمْ لِلْاِيمَـٰنِ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Indeed, Allah is aware of every unseen of the skies and the earth, and He is seeing all your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Qaaf, By the Glorious Quran.
verses.arabic_text: قٓ ۚ وَالْقُرْءَانِ الْمَجِيدِ

verses.english_text: But these infidels wonder that a man from among themselves has come as a Prophet; they say it is very strange.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓاْ اَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ الْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ

verses.english_text: What, when we will die and become dust, will we return again, it does not seem so.
verses.arabic_text: اَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ

verses.english_text: We know how earth diminishes their bodies, and we have a Secured Book.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ الْاَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ

verses.english_text: Fact is that, after the advent of the Truth, they denied it; now they are suffering from anxiety.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ كَذَّبُواْ بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ اَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ

verses.english_text: Didn't they see towards the sky above them; that - how We have made it and decorated it also, and there is no gap in it.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓاْ اِلَى السَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا وَ مَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍۢ

verses.english_text: And made earth the flooring and put mountains on it and grew beautiful things everywhere.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْاَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَاَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَاَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ

verses.english_text: This is the matter of admonition and insight for every servant of Allah who turns towards Him.
verses.arabic_text: تَبْصِرَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ

verses.english_text: And We sent down blessed water from the sky, then grew gardens, and grains in the fields.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَـٰرَكًۭا فَاَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَحَبَّ الْحَصِيدِ

verses.english_text: And grew long palm-trees, whose branches of fruits are arranged in layers together.
verses.arabic_text: وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَـٰتٍۢ لَّهَا طَلْعٌۭ نَّضِيدٌۭ

verses.english_text: This is all for the sustenance of Our servants, and We brought to life the dead lands from this water, like this We will bring you forth from the earth.
verses.arabic_text: رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَاَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ الْخُرُوجُ

verses.english_text: Before them the nation of Nuh, and the people of Rass and even Samood had denied.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَاَصْحَـٰبُ الرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ

verses.english_text: And also, the nation of Aad, Firaun and brothers of Lut.
verses.arabic_text: وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَاِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍۢ

verses.english_text: And also did companions of grove, and nation of Tab’e, they all denied prophets, so Our promise was fulfilled.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَصْحَـٰبُ الْاَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ

verses.english_text: So were We helpless from earlier creation, never, so fact is that they are doubting the future creation.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَعَيِينَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْاَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍۢ مِّنْ خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: We have created the man, We know what whisperings his conscience creates, and We are nearer to his jugular vein.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ ۖ وَنَحْنُ اَقْرَبُ اِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ

verses.english_text: When two writers write his deeds who are sitting on the right and left.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ يَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ

verses.english_text: He does not utter any word, but a watcher is present with him.
verses.arabic_text: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ اِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ

verses.english_text: And the unconsciousness of death will certainly come; this is the thing from which you were running away.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ

verses.english_text: And then the trumpet shall be blown, this is the day when punishment was promised.
verses.arabic_text: وَنُفِخَ فِى الصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْوَعِيدِ

verses.english_text: And every self shall come in such a way that there will be angels to drive them and bear witness.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌۭ وَشَهِيدٌۭ

verses.english_text: Verily you were neglectful from this, so We removed your veils, and now your sight has become sharp.
verses.arabic_text: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ

verses.english_text: And his companion angel will say: his deed is ready with me.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ

verses.english_text: Command shall come: both of you throw every ungrateful transgressor into Hell.
verses.arabic_text: اَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: Who was preventing (others) from good; transgressing and was creating doubts.
verses.arabic_text: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍۢ مُّرِيبٍ

verses.english_text: Who had created gods besides Allah; both of you, throw him into severe punishment.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ اللَّهِ اِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَاَلْقِيَاهُ فِى الْعَذَابِ الشَّدِيدِ

verses.english_text: Then his companion Satan will say: O Lord, I have not misguided him, he himself had gone far in great error.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُ رَبَّنَا مَآ اَطْغَيْتُهُ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: (Lord) will say: do not quarrel in My presence, I have warned you beforehand about the punishment.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُواْ لَدَىَّ وَ قَدْ قَدَّمْتُ اِلَيْكُم بِالْوَعِيدِ

verses.english_text: My words do not change, nor am I unjust to the servants.
verses.arabic_text: مَا يُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَ مَآ اَنَا۠ بِظَلَّـٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

verses.english_text: The day We will say to Hell: are you filled up? It will say: can I have more?
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلَاْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ

verses.english_text: And Paradise will be brought nearer to the pious people.
verses.arabic_text: وَاُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ

verses.english_text: This is the place which is promised with everyone who turns to Allah and who guards his self.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ اَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ

verses.english_text: Whoever fears the Beneficent (Allah) in secret; and comes to His Presence with the heart that turns to Him.
verses.arabic_text: مَّنْ خَشِىَ الرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ

verses.english_text: All of you enter Paradise with peace, this is the day of forever.
verses.arabic_text: ادْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُلُودِ

verses.english_text: Everything of their desire is present there, and We have more also.
verses.arabic_text: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ

verses.english_text: And how many nations did We destroy before them who were more powerful than they; so they went about and about all the towns; but where is the escape from death.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ اَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُواْ فِى الْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ

verses.english_text: There is admonition in this event for the man who has heart or who listens attentively.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ اَوْ اَلْقَى السَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌۭ

verses.english_text: And We created skies and the earth and what is in between them within six days, and exhaustion even did not touch Us.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍۢ وَ مَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ

verses.english_text: Hence, be patient on their talk, and glorify your Lord before sunrise and before sunset.
verses.arabic_text: فَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ

verses.english_text: And glorify Him during part of the night and also glorify Him after prostrations.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَاَدْبَـٰرَ السُّجُودِ

verses.english_text: And listen on the day attentively when the Divine Caller (Israfil) shall call out from the near place.
verses.arabic_text: وَاسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ الْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ

verses.english_text: The day; when they all shall hear the sound of the sky, and that is the day of coming forth from the graves.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ الصَّيْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُرُوجِ

verses.english_text: Verily, We give life and death and everyone has to return to Us.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ وَنُمِيتُ وَاِلَيْنَا الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: And that day the earth will be ruptured from their side, and they will come out hastening, saying the Resurrection is easy for us.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ الْاَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: We know well what these people are saying, and you are not going to force them, continue admonishing people through the Quran, who fear Our punishment.
verses.arabic_text: نَّحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَ مَآ اَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍۢ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِالْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ

verses.english_text: By the winds that scatter the clouds.
verses.arabic_text: وَالذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا

verses.english_text: Then carries the weight of the clouds.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا

verses.english_text: Then it blows gently.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا

verses.english_text: Then it is the distributor of an order.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ اَمْرًا

verses.english_text: Whatever has been promised to you is true.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ

verses.english_text: The reward and the punishment are verily going to happen.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ الدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ

verses.english_text: And by the sky which has different paths.
verses.arabic_text: وَالسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ الْحُبُكِ

verses.english_text: That you people are involved in different affairs.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ

verses.english_text: Who have already gone astray, only they can be misguided from the truth.
verses.arabic_text: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ اُفِكَ

verses.english_text: Verily speculators will be killed.
verses.arabic_text: قُتِلَ الْخَرَّٰصُونَ

verses.english_text: Who are lying in their own negligence.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ

verses.english_text: They ask: after all, when the Day of Judgement will come.
verses.arabic_text: يَسْـَٔلُونَ اَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الدِّينِ

verses.english_text: So this is the day when they shall be heated in the fire of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ

verses.english_text: Now taste your punishment, this is the punishment for which you hastened.
verses.arabic_text: ذُوقُواْ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily pious people will be amidst gardens and fountains.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ

verses.english_text: Whatever their Lord is going to give, they will receive it, these are the people who earlier did good.
verses.arabic_text: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: They sleep very less during the night.
verses.arabic_text: كَانُواْ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ الَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ

verses.english_text: And used to seek forgiveness in His Presence at dawn.
verses.arabic_text: وَبِالْاَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And in their wealth there was a portion for those who ask, and for deprived who do not ask.
verses.arabic_text: وَفِىٓ اَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ

verses.english_text: And many signs are found in the earth for those who accept.
verses.arabic_text: وَفِى الْاَرْضِ اٰيٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And within yourself also, are not you seeing.
verses.arabic_text: وَفِىٓ اَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ اَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And your sustenance is in the sky, and whatever is promised to you everything is present.
verses.arabic_text: وَفِى السَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَ مَا تُوعَدُونَ

verses.english_text: By the Master of the skies and the earth, Quran is most verily the Truth, just as you speak among yourselves.
verses.arabic_text: فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضِ اِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ اَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ

verses.english_text: Has the mention of honourable guests of Ibrahim reached you.
verses.arabic_text: هَلْ اَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ

verses.english_text: When they entered with him and said salutation, he replied with a salutation and said: you seem to be from an unknown nation.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَـٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then he went home, prepared and brought a fat (roasted) calf.
verses.arabic_text: فَرَاغَ اِلَىٰٓ اَهْلِهِ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then offered it to them and asked: don't you eat?
verses.arabic_text: فَقَرَّبَهُٓ اِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ اَلَا تَاْكُلُونَ

verses.english_text: Then he felt fear in his soul, so they said: do not fear, and then gave him the good news of a wise son.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Hearing this, his wife came shouting and struck her face (and said) I am an old and barren.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَقْبَلَتِ امْرَاَتُهُ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: They said: so will it be, this is the command of your Lord, He is Wise, and Knower of everything.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ اِنَّهُ هُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ

verses.english_text: Ibrahim said: O angels, what is your mission.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ اَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: we have been sent towards a guilty nation.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ اِنَّآ اُرْسِلْنَآ اِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: That we rain upon them the stones of clay.
verses.arabic_text: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Who have been marked as transgressors by the Lord.
verses.arabic_text: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ

verses.english_text: Then We took out all the believers from that settlement.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: We found there nobody except one house of the Muslims.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And We left therein a sign of painful punishment for those who fear.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ الْعَذَابَ الْاَلِيمَ

verses.english_text: And in the story of Moosa Our signs are there when We sent him towards Firaun with the explicit argument.
verses.arabic_text: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ اِذْ اَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ اِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: So on the strength of his army he turned his face away that he is magician or insane.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ اَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then We caught him and his army and threw them into the sea; and he was reprehensible.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى الْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And nation of Aad is also a sign, when We sent towards them the barren wind.
verses.arabic_text: وَفِى عَادٍ اِذْ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيحَ الْعَقِيمَ

verses.english_text: That wherever it passes it reduced everything to ruin like rotten bone.
verses.arabic_text: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ اَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ اِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيمِ

verses.english_text: And in the nation of Samood also there is a sign, when it was said to them: enjoy for few days.
verses.arabic_text: وَفِى ثَمُودَ اِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: They disobeyed the command of Allah, so lightning overtook them, while they just saw.
verses.arabic_text: فَعَتَوْاْ عَنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then they were not able to stand, nor could they seek help.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا اسْتَطَـٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَ مَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And before them was nation of Nooh that they were all transgressor and evil.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْمًۭا فَـٰسِقِينَ

verses.english_text: And We made skies with Our prowess, and We expanded it.
verses.arabic_text: وَالسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِاَيْي۟دٍۢ وَ اِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ

verses.english_text: And We made earth as floor, and how well We have spread it out.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْاَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ الْمَـٰهِدُونَ

verses.english_text: And We created a pair from everything that perhaps you might get admonition.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: Therefore, run towards Allah now that I am plain warner.
verses.arabic_text: فَفِرُّوٓاْ اِلَى اللَّهِ ۖ اِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And beware, do not make anyone god besides Him that I am a clear warner to you.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَجْعَلُواْ مَعَ اللَّهِ اِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ اِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: Like this, no prophet came to this nation before but these people said: he is magician or insane.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ اَتَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ اِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ اَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

verses.english_text: Have they made their will to one another for this, no, rather they are all rebellious.
verses.arabic_text: اَتَوَاصَوْاْ بِهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ

verses.english_text: Therefore, turn your face from them, then there is no blame on you.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ اَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ

verses.english_text: And continue to remind them that reminder is useful for the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَذَكِّرْ فَاِنَّ الذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: And I have created jinn and men just for My worshipping.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْاِنسَ اِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ

verses.english_text: I do not want any sustenance from them, nor do I want that they should feed Me.
verses.arabic_text: مَآ اُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَ مَآ اُرِيدُ اَن يُطْعِمُونِ

verses.english_text: Verily the one who gives sustenance is Allah only; the Lord of Power, the Strong.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ

verses.english_text: Then for those unjust is also the same rewards as were for their companions, so they should not hasten.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ اَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

verses.english_text: Then woe and punishment for infidels on that day, for the day that is being promised with them.
verses.arabic_text: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ الَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

verses.english_text: By the mountain (Toor).
verses.arabic_text: وَالطُّورِ

verses.english_text: And by the book that is written.
verses.arabic_text: وَكِتٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ

verses.english_text: Which is in the outstretched pages.
verses.arabic_text: فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ

verses.english_text: And by the frequently visited House.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُورِ

verses.english_text: And by the elevated ceiling (sky).
verses.arabic_text: وَالسَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوعِ

verses.english_text: And by the raging sea.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ

verses.english_text: Verily, the punishment of Your Lord shall happen.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ

verses.english_text: ​And no one can avert it.
verses.arabic_text: مَّا لَهُ مِن دَافِعٍۢ

verses.english_text: The day when skies shall revolve completely.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ السَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا

verses.english_text: And mountains shall come in movement.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَسِيرُ الْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا

verses.english_text: Then there will be punishment and destruction for the deniers.
verses.arabic_text: فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: Those who are playing in the wasteful discourse.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ

verses.english_text: The day when they will forcefully pushed into Hell.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ اِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا

verses.english_text: This is the fire of Hell which you were denying.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

verses.english_text: Is it magic, or do you not see.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَآ اَمْ اَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Now enter into it, whether be patient or don't be patient, it is the same (to you); this is the punishment of those deeds, which you have done.
verses.arabic_text: اصْلَوْهَا فَاصْبِرُوٓاْ اَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ اِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Indeed, pious people shall be amidst gardens and bliss.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: They will be happy with what Allah will bestow upon them, and Allah will keep them safe from the punishment of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: فَـٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ

verses.english_text: Now eat and drink here with ease on the basis of your deeds which you have done.
verses.arabic_text: كُلُواْ وَاشْرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: They will be reclining on the thrones set up in lines, and We will pair them with big-eyed Hoories.
verses.arabic_text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Those who believed and their children also obeyed them in faith, then We will cause them to unite with their descendants also, and We will not lessen anybody's deeds even for a particle, and everyone is responsible for his deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَاتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِاِيمَـٰنٍ اَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَ مَآ اَلَتْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ امْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And whatever fruit or meat they would desire, We will help them in much better way.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمْدَدْنَـٰهُم بِفَـٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

verses.english_text: They will pass on the cups (of pure wine) (one to another); but there shall not be any nonsense nor any sin.
verses.arabic_text: يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَاْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَاْثِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And young boys will wander around them, who will be like carefully hidden pearls, beautiful and elegant.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَاَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ

verses.english_text: And then they will turn towards one another and engage in question and answer.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Shall say: we were very fearful of Allah in our houses.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ اِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ اَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ

verses.english_text: So Allah has done favour to us, and saved us from the poisonous air of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ السَّمُومِ

verses.english_text: Earlier also we had been supplicating to Him; certainly, He does favours and is Benevolent.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ اِنَّهُ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: Therefore, continue admonishing people, by the grace of Allah you are neither a magician nor a madman.
verses.arabic_text: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ اَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ

verses.english_text: Do these people say he is a poet, for this we are waiting for the accidents of time to come.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ الْمَنُونِ

verses.english_text: So you say: Verily you wait, along with you I am also among the awaiters.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَاِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ الْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ

verses.english_text: Do their intellect say these things; or they are really rebellious.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ تَاْمُرُهُمْ اَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ ۚ اَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ

verses.english_text: Or they say the prophet has fabricated the Quran; and the fact is that they are not going to believe.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Then let them bring the similar writing, if they are truthful in their talk.
verses.arabic_text: فَلْيَاْتُواْ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِٓ اِن كَانُواْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Have they come into existence on their own without anything, or are they themselves creators.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ خُلِقُواْ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ اَمْ هُمُ الْخَـٰلِقُونَ

verses.english_text: Or they have created the skies and the earth; fact is that they will not believe.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ خَلَقُواْ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ

verses.english_text: Or treasures of the Lord are with them, or they are the masters?
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ اَمْ هُمُ الْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Or they have any such ladder by which they listen from the sky, so those who listen should bring any clear proof.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَاْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

verses.english_text: Or daughters are for Allah and sons are for you.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ لَهُ الْبَنَـٰتُ وَلَكُمُ الْبَنُونَ

verses.english_text: Or do you ask for any reward of prophethood from them that they are burdened with its load.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ اَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Or they have knowledge of the Unseen that they are writing about.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ عِندَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

verses.english_text: Or do they wish to do any deceit, so remember, infidels shall get entangled in their own deceit.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ الْمَكِيدُونَ

verses.english_text: Or for them there is another god besides Allah, whereas Allah is clean and pure from their polytheism.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ لَهُمْ اِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: And even if they will see the pieces of sky falling, they will say: these are the layers of the clouds.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن يَرَوْاْ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ

verses.english_text: So leave them on their condition, till they encounter the day when they shall become unconscious.
verses.arabic_text: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُواْ يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ

verses.english_text: The day when no trick will work, nor will there be any helper for them.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who did unjust, for them there is also other punishment than this; but most of them are unaware about this.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Now wait in patience for the command of your Lord, you are before Our sight; and while standing always glorify your Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَاِنَّكَ بِاَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

verses.english_text: And continue to glorify the Lord during the part of night and at the setting of the stars.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَاِدْبَـٰرَ النُّجُومِ

verses.english_text: By the star when it broke.
verses.arabic_text: وَالنَّجْمِ اِذَا هَوَىٰ

verses.english_text: Your companion neither got misguided nor deviated.
verses.arabic_text: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَ مَا غَوَىٰ

verses.english_text: And he does not even speak out of his own desire.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: His words are nothing but revelation, which is constantly revealed.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا وَحْىٌۭ يُوحَىٰ

verses.english_text: He has been taught by the Mighty Power.
verses.arabic_text: عَلَّمَهُ شَدِيدُ الْقُوَىٰ

verses.english_text: Who has beauty and elegance, who stands straight.
verses.arabic_text: ذُو مِرَّةٍۢ فَاسْتَوَىٰ

verses.english_text: When he was on the highest of the horizon.
verses.arabic_text: وَهُوَ بِالْاُفُقِ الْاَعْلَىٰ

verses.english_text: Then he drew near and came forward.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ

verses.english_text: So much so that the distance was of two bows, or even closer.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ اَوْ اَدْنَىٰ

verses.english_text: Then Allah revealed to his servant, whatever secret He meant to reveal.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَوْحَىٰٓ اِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ مَآ اَوْحَىٰ

verses.english_text: Heart has not rejected what he saw.
verses.arabic_text: مَا كَذَبَ الْفُؤَادُ مَا رَاَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Are you quarreling regarding the matter of what he is seeing?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ

verses.english_text: And he has seen it once more.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً اُخْرَىٰ

verses.english_text: Near the Lote-Tree (beyond which no one can pass).
verses.arabic_text: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ الْمُنتَهَىٰ

verses.english_text: Near which there is also have Paradise of Mawa'.
verses.arabic_text: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ الْمَاْوَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: When it was spreading over the lote-tree, whatever was spreading.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ يَغْشَى السِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ

verses.english_text: At that time neither his eye strayed, nor did it cross the limit.
verses.arabic_text: مَا زَاغَ الْبَصَرُ وَ مَا طَغَىٰ

verses.english_text: He saw the greatest signs of his Lord.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ رَاَىٰ مِنْ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِ الْكُبْرَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Have you people seen Laat and Uzza?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَرَءَيْتُمُ اللَّـٰتَ وَالْعُزَّىٰ

verses.english_text: Have you seen Manaat, which is their third?
verses.arabic_text: وَمَنَوٰةَ الثَّالِثَةَ الْاُخْرَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: What! Are males for you; and females for Him?
verses.arabic_text: اَلَكُمُ الذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ الْاُنثَىٰ

verses.english_text: This is a very unjust division.
verses.arabic_text: تِلْكَ اِذًۭا قِسْمَةٌۭ ضِيزَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: These are the names which you and your fathers have named, and Allah has not revealed any argument for them, in fact these people just follow their speculation and desires of their heart, Verily guidance has come to them from their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ هِىَ اِلَّآ اَسْمَآءٌۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ اَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ اَنزَلَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ اِن يَتَّبِعُونَ اِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَ مَا تَهْوَى الْاَنفُسُ ۖ وَ لَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ الْهُدَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Can man get everything he desires?
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ لِلْاِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ

verses.english_text: The world and The Hereafter, everything is only for Allah.
verses.arabic_text: فَلِلَّهِ الْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَالْاُولَىٰ

verses.english_text: And how many angels are there in the skies whose intercession cannot benefit anyone; except that Allah allows to whom He pleases and chooses.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍۢ فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا اِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ اَن يَاْذَنَ اللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Verily those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels after female names.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ الْاُنثَىٰ

verses.english_text: Although, they do not have any knowledge in this regard, they only follow the conjecture; and conjecture can give no benefit with regards to the truth.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا لَهُم بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ اِن يَتَّبِعُونَ اِلَّا الظَّنَّ ۖ وَاِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْـًۭٔا

verses.english_text: Therefore, who turns his face from Our mention and does not desire anything except this world, you also turn aside from him.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ اِلَّا الْحَيَوٰةَ الدُّنْيَا

verses.english_text: This is the limit of their knowledge, and certainly your Lord knows who has gone astray from His path and who is on the path of guidance.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ ۚ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ

verses.english_text: And to Allah belongs the authority of the skies and the earth, that He may punish those who do evil deeds; and reward those who do good deeds with what is the best.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ الَّذِينَ اَسَـٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجْزِىَ الَّذِينَ اَحْسَنُواْ بِالْحُسْنَى

verses.english_text: And those who desist from the major sins and indecencies (and) falls only into the small sins; Verily your Lord is very vast forgiver, He was aware of your condition when He created you from the dust, and when you were in the wombs of your mothers nearing birth, therefore do not attribute purity to your souls; He is well aware of the pious people.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ الْاِثْمِ وَالْفَوَٰحِشَ اِلَّا اللَّمَمَ ۚ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ اِذْ اَنشَاَكُم مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ وَاِذْ اَنتُمْ اَجِنَّةٌۭ فِى بُطُونِ اُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ اَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اتَّقَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Have you seen him also who has turn his face?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَرَءَيْتَ الَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ

verses.english_text: And withheld after giving little in the way of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًۭا وَاَكْدَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Does he have the knowledge of the unseen through which he is seeing.
verses.arabic_text: اَعِندَهُ عِلْمُ الْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Or he is not even aware from what was written in the scripture of Musa.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّاْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ

verses.english_text: Or in the scriptures of Ibrahim, who fulfilled his engagements truthfully.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِبْرَٰهِيمَ الَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ

verses.english_text: And no man is going to carry the burden of others.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ اُخْرَىٰ

verses.english_text: And man shall have that much for which he has strived.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَن لَّيْسَ لِلْاِنسَـٰنِ اِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ

verses.english_text: And that (the fruit of) his striving shall shortly be presented to him.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّ سَعْيَهُ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ

verses.english_text: Thereafter he shall be recompensed to the fullest.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ الْجَزَآءَ الْاَوْفَىٰ

verses.english_text: And Verily, the final destination is the Presence of the Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّ اِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ الْمُنتَهَىٰ

verses.english_text: And that He causes (us) to laugh and makes us cry.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّهُ هُوَ اَضْحَكَ وَاَبْكَىٰ

verses.english_text: And that He causes death and gives life.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّهُ هُوَ اَمَاتَ وَاَحْيَا

verses.english_text: And only He created pair of the male and the female.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّهُ خَلَقَ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْاُنثَىٰ

verses.english_text: From that sperm which is put in the womb.
verses.arabic_text: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ اِذَا تُمْنَىٰ

verses.english_text: And He is responsible for the second life as well.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّ عَلَيْهِ النَّشْاَةَ الْاُخْرَىٰ

verses.english_text: And He made wealthy and gave capital.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّهُ هُوَ اَغْنَىٰ وَاَقْنَىٰ

verses.english_text: And He is the Lord of the Sirius.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّهُ هُوَ رَبُّ الشِّعْرَىٰ

verses.english_text: And that is He who earlier destroyed the nation of Aad.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّهُٓ اَهْلَكَ عَادًا الْاُولَىٰ

verses.english_text: And also to the nation of Samood, then (He) spared nobody.
verses.arabic_text: وَثَمُودَاْ فَمَآ اَبْقَىٰ

verses.english_text: And nation of Nooh and people earlier than them were all very unjust and transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ هُمْ اَظْلَمَ وَاَطْغَىٰ

verses.english_text: And He destroyed the overturn town of the nation of Lut.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ اَهْوَىٰ

verses.english_text: Then it covered them; that which covered.
verses.arabic_text: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ

verses.english_text: Now on which of the favor of your Lord are you doubting.
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ

verses.english_text: Indeed, this prophet is also one of the warner like earlier warners.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌۭ مِّنَ النُّذُرِ الْاُولَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Look! the Day of Judgement is near.
verses.arabic_text: اَزِفَتِ الْـَٔازِفَةُ

verses.english_text: Except Allah, no one can avert it.
verses.arabic_text: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ

verses.english_text: Are you wondering at this?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ

verses.english_text: And then you laugh, and do not cry?
verses.arabic_text: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ

verses.english_text: You are totally negligent.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ

verses.english_text: So, prostrate for Allah and worship Him.
