verses.arabic_text: فَاسْجُدُواْ لِلَّهِ وَاعْبُدُواْ ۩

verses.english_text: The Day of Judgement has come near, and moon is split into two.
verses.arabic_text: اقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ

verses.english_text: And if they see any sign, they turn their face and say: it is continuous magic.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن يَرَوْاْ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ

verses.english_text: And they denied it and followed their desires; and every affair has its appointed term.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَاتَّبَعُوٓاْ اَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ اَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ

verses.english_text: Verily much communication has come to them which contain the warnings.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ الْاَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ

verses.english_text: Far-reaching wisdom, but warnings do not benefit them.
verses.arabic_text: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ النُّذُرُ

verses.english_text: Therefore, turn your face from them, the day when a caller (Israfeel) shall call them towards an unpleasant task.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ الدَّاعِ اِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ

verses.english_text: Looking downward they shall as come out from their graves as if locusts have spread.
verses.arabic_text: خُشَّعًا اَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْاَجْدَاثِ كَاَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ

verses.english_text: They shall all be running towards the caller with their heads raised, and infidels will be saying: today is a very hard day.
verses.arabic_text: مُّهْطِعِينَ اِلَى الدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ الْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ

verses.english_text: Before them nation of Nooh also denied, so they denied Our servant, saying he is mad and even he was scolded.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبْدَنَا وَ قَالُواْ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَازْدُجِرَ

verses.english_text: So, he prayed to his Lord, I have been defeated, help me.
verses.arabic_text: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُٓ اَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَانتَصِرْ

verses.english_text: So, We opened the doors of the sky with the torrential rain.
verses.arabic_text: فَفَتَحْنَآ اَبْوَٰبَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ

verses.english_text: And We made water gushed from rivers in land also, then both the waters gathered for the special purpose.
verses.arabic_text: وَفَجَّرْنَا الْاَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَالْتَقَى الْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ اَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ

verses.english_text: And We carried him on an Ark made of planks and nails.
verses.arabic_text: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ اَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ

verses.english_text: Sailing before Our eyes, this was a recompense for Our servant who was denied.
verses.arabic_text: تَجْرِى بِاَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ

verses.english_text: And We have left it as Our sign, is there anyone who get admonition.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then how our punishment and warning was proven.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

verses.english_text: And We made Quran easy for admonition, is there anyone to get admonition?
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

verses.english_text: And nation of Aad also denied, then how was Our punishment and warning?
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

verses.english_text: Then We sent sharp storm on them on a bitter ill-fortune day.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ

verses.english_text: Which uprooted people from their places as if they were dry stems of the palm-tree.
verses.arabic_text: تَنزِعُ النَّاسَ كَاَنَّهُمْ اَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then see! How my punishment and warning was proven.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

verses.english_text: And We made Quran easy for admonition, is there anyone to get admonition.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

verses.english_text: And (Nation of) Samood also denied the prophets.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِالنُّذُرِ

verses.english_text: And said: shall we follow a person from among ourselves, in that case we shall be in misguidance and will be in madness.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَالُوٓاْ اَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُٓ اِنَّآ اِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ

verses.english_text: What! Among us has the message revealed on him only, in fact he is a liar and seeker of glory.
verses.arabic_text: اَءُلْقِىَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ اَشِرٌۭ

verses.english_text: So they will come to know tomorrow who is the liar and proud.
verses.arabic_text: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ الْكَذَّابُ الْاَشِرُ

verses.english_text: We are going to send a she-camel as a trial for them, therefore you wait and have patience. ​
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا مُرْسِلُواْ النَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ وَاصْطَبِرْ

verses.english_text: And inform them that the water will be divided between them, and each one's right to drink shall be established by turn.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ اَنَّ الْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ

verses.english_text: So, they called their companion and they caught the she-camel and killed her.
verses.arabic_text: فَنَادَوْاْ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ

verses.english_text: Then everyone saw how Our punishment and warning was proven.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

verses.english_text: We sent upon them a mighty blast, so they all became like the dry stubble used in the cattle enclosure.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ

verses.english_text: And We made Quran easy for admonition, is there anyone to get admonition.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

verses.english_text: And nation of Lut also denied the prophets.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِالنُّذُرِ

verses.english_text: So We rained upon them the stones, except for the family of Lut, that We saved them in the morning itself.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا اِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ

verses.english_text: This was one of Our favors, and like this We reward Our thankful servants.
verses.arabic_text: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ

verses.english_text: And Lut warned them of Our violent seizure, but they doubted the warner.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْاْ بِالنُّذُرِ

verses.english_text: And when they demanded illegitimately about the guests, then We made their eyes blind, that now taste the punishment and warning.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِ فَطَمَسْنَآ اَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

verses.english_text: And the punishment which cannot be averted overtook them in the morning.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ

verses.english_text: Now taste Our punishment and warning.
verses.arabic_text: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

verses.english_text: And We made Quran easy for admonition, is there anyone to get admonition.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

verses.english_text: And messengers came to the Firaun's people also.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ النُّذُرُ

verses.english_text: They rejected all Our signs, so We also seized them in the manner of a Mighty Powerful One.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَاَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ اَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

verses.english_text: Are your infidels better than they or any Note of Pardon has been written for them in the books.
verses.arabic_text: اَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ اَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى الزُّبُرِ

verses.english_text: Or their saying that they have a big party which helps one another.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ

verses.english_text: Shortly this party will face defeat, and they all will turn their backs and run away.
verses.arabic_text: سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ

verses.english_text: Rather their promise is of the Hereafter, and the Hereafter is a very hard and bitter reality.
verses.arabic_text: بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ اَدْهَىٰ وَاَمَرُّ

verses.english_text: Verily, guilty (people) are suffering from misguidance and insanity.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ

verses.english_text: On the Day of Judgement when they shall be dragged upon their faces into fire; Taste Hell now.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى النَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ

verses.english_text: Verily We have created everything according to a fixed measure.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ

verses.english_text: And Our command is but one, like batting an eyelid.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَمْرُنَآ اِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِالْبَصَرِ

verses.english_text: And We have already destroyed your companions, so is there anyone to get the admonition.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَهْلَكْنَآ اَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

verses.english_text: And whatever these people have done everything is secured in the Book of Deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى الزُّبُرِ

verses.english_text: And every small and big deed has been noted in it.
verses.arabic_text: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ

verses.english_text: Verily pious people shall be amidst the gardens and rivers.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ

verses.english_text: At a pure place; in the presence of the Mighty Powerful King.
verses.arabic_text: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ

verses.english_text: Most Gracious.
verses.arabic_text: الرَّحْمَٰنُ

verses.english_text: He taught the Quran.
verses.arabic_text: عَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ

verses.english_text: Created the man.
verses.arabic_text: خَلَقَ الْاِنسَانَ

verses.english_text: And taught him speech.
verses.arabic_text: عَلَّمَهُ الْبَيَانَ

verses.english_text: Sun and the moon are following the course appointed by Him.
verses.arabic_text: الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ

verses.english_text: And stars and trees are all prostrating.
verses.arabic_text: وَالنَّجْمُ وَالشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ

verses.english_text: He raised the sky, and established the Balance (of Justice).
verses.arabic_text: وَالسَّمَاءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ الْمِيزَانَ

verses.english_text: That you may not transgress in balance.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَّا تَطْغَوْا فِي الْمِيزَانِ

verses.english_text: And establish the weight with justice and do not weigh less while weighing.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَقِيمُوا الْوَزْنَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا الْمِيزَانَ

verses.english_text: And He has spread earth for the people.
verses.arabic_text: وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلۡاَنَامِ

verses.english_text: Therein are fruits and date-palms whose bunches are covered with skin.
verses.arabic_text: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَالنَّخۡلُ ذَاتُ الۡاَكۡمَامِ

verses.english_text: Seeds are with husk, and fragrant flowers are also there.
verses.arabic_text: وَالۡحَبُّ ذُو الۡعَصۡفِ وَالرَّيۡحَانُ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: He created the man from sounding clay like pottery.
verses.arabic_text: خَلَقَ الۡاِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ كَالۡفَخَّارِ

verses.english_text: And created the Jinn with flames of fire.
verses.arabic_text: وَخَلَقَ الۡجَانَّ مِن مَّارِجٖ مِّن نَّارٖ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: Lord of the two Easts and Lord the two Wests.
verses.arabic_text: رَبُّ الۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ وَرَبُّ الۡمَغۡرِبَيۡنِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: He has flowed two seas which meet together.
verses.arabic_text: مَرَجَ الۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ يَلۡتَقِيَانِ

verses.english_text: There is a barrier between them that they cannot exceed upon each other.
verses.arabic_text: بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخٞ لَّا يَبۡغِيَانِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: Pearls and corals come out of these seas.
verses.arabic_text: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا اللُّؤْلُؤُ وَالْمَرْجَانُ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: And His are the ships that stand like mountains in the sea.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَهُ الْجَوَارِ الْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى الْبَحْرِ كَالْاَعْلَـٰمِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: Whatever is on earth everything shall perish.
verses.arabic_text: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍۢ

verses.english_text: And only forever shall remain the Face of your Lord, full of Majesty, Bounty and Honor.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو الْجَلَـٰلِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: Whoever is in the sky and on earth beg of Him, and every day He has new glory.
verses.arabic_text: يَسْـَٔلُهُ مَن فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَاْنٍۭ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: O both groups, shortly We shall turn towards you.
verses.arabic_text: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ اَيُّهَ الثَّقَلَانِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: O groups of Jinn and Man if you have power then go beyond the boundaries of skies and the earth; but remember, you cannot pass through without strength and authority (which you do not have).
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنسِ اِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ اَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنْ اَقْطَارِ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ فَانفُذُواْ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ اِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: Flame of green fire, and black smoke shall be set loose upon you, then both of you cannot avert it anyhow.
verses.arabic_text: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: And when the sky will rend and become red like oil.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا انشَقَّتِ السَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَالدِّهَانِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: Then on that day no Jinn and Man will be questioned about his sin.
verses.arabic_text: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنبِهِٓ اِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: Guilty people shall be recognized by their marks, then they shall be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
verses.arabic_text: يُعْرَفُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِالنَّوَاصِى وَالْاَقْدَامِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: This is the Hell which the guilty had denied.
verses.arabic_text: هٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Now go round about between this and the boiling water.
verses.arabic_text: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: And for him who fears to stand in the Presence of his Lord, there are two gardens.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ جَنَّتَانِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: And branches of both the gardens will be laden with the fresh fruits.
verses.arabic_text: ذَوَاتَآ اَفْنَانٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: In both of them two fountains shall be flowing.
verses.arabic_text: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: In both of them every fruit will be in pairs.
verses.arabic_text: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍۢ زَوْجَانِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: They shall be reclining on the carpets whose lining shall be of satin and fruits of both the gardens shall be very near.
verses.arabic_text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَٰى فُرُشٍۢ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ اِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى الْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۭ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: In those Paradises there will be Hoories, limiting their glances; whom neither man nor jinn would have touched them before.
verses.arabic_text: فِيهِنَّ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ الطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ اِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: Those Hoories will be like Rubies and coral.
verses.arabic_text: كَاَنَّهُنَّ الْيَاقُوتُ وَالْمَرْجَانُ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: Can the recompense of favor be anything else but favor?
verses.arabic_text: هَلْ جَزَآءُ الْاِحْسَـٰنِ اِلَّا الْاِحْسَـٰنُ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: And there will be two more gardens other than these two.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: Both of them will be extraordinarily green and blooming.
verses.arabic_text: مُدْهَامَّتَانِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: These two gardens will also have two fountains which will be gushing with water.
verses.arabic_text: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: In both the gardens will be fruits, date-palms and pomegranates.
verses.arabic_text: فِيهِمَا فَـٰكِهَةٌۭ وَنَخْلٌۭ وَرُمَّانٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: In these Paradises there will be pure and beautiful women.
verses.arabic_text: فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَٰتٌ حِسَانٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: Hoories will be sitting in the tents.
verses.arabic_text: حُورٌۭ مَّقْصُورَٰتٌۭ فِى الْخِيَامِ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: Whom no man or jinn would have touched them before.
verses.arabic_text: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ اِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: They shall be reclining on green cushions and fine carpets.
verses.arabic_text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَٰى رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

verses.english_text: Blessed is the name of your Lord, full of Majesty, Bounty and Honor.
verses.arabic_text: تَبَـٰرَكَ اسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى الْجَلَـٰلِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ

verses.english_text: When the Day of Judgement will be established.
verses.arabic_text: اِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ

verses.english_text: There is no lie in its establishment.
verses.arabic_text: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ

verses.english_text: It will make everything topsy-turvy.
verses.arabic_text: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ

verses.english_text: When the earth will shake violently.
verses.arabic_text: اِذَا رُجَّتِ الْاَرْضُ رَجًّا

verses.english_text: And the mountains will completely crumble.
verses.arabic_text: وَبُسَّتِ الْجِبَالُ بَسًّا

verses.english_text: Then will scattered into particles.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءٗ مُّنۢبَثّٗا

verses.english_text: Then you will become three groups.
verses.arabic_text: وَكُنتُمْ اَزْوَاجٗا ثَلَٰثَةٗ

verses.english_text: Then people of right hand, and what to say about right-handers.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَصْحَٰبُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ مَا اَصْحَٰبُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ

verses.english_text: And people of the left hand, and what to ask about left-handers.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَصْحَٰبُ الْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَا اَصْحَٰبُ الْمَشْـَٔمَةِ

verses.english_text: And the foremost ones (in faith), shall be the foremost ones (in the Hereafter).
verses.arabic_text: وَالسَّٰبِقُونَ السَّٰبِقُونَ

verses.english_text: And they will be nearest in the presence of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اُوْلَٰٓئِكَ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ

verses.english_text: (They) shall be in the Paradises of full of Bliss.
verses.arabic_text: فِي جَنَّٰتِ النَّعِيمِ

verses.english_text: Many people will be from the earlier ones (who first embraced Islam).
verses.arabic_text: ثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: And some of them will be from the last period.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَلِيلٞ مِّنَ الْآخِرِينَ

verses.english_text: On the large thrones (of pearls and rubies).
verses.arabic_text: عَلَٰى سُرُرٖ مَّوْضُونَةٖ

verses.english_text: They will be reclining on them, in front of each other.
verses.arabic_text: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ

verses.english_text: Youths, who will always remain young, will go roundabout (to serve) them.
verses.arabic_text: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٞ مُّخَلَّدُونَ

verses.english_text: Shall be carrying goblets, jugs and cups of pure wine.
verses.arabic_text: بِاَكْوَابٖ وَاَبَارِيقَ وَكَاْسٖ مِّن مَّعِينٖ

verses.english_text: From which there will not be any headache nor there will be any loss of consciousness.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ

verses.english_text: And shall be carrying fruits of their choice.
verses.arabic_text: وَفَٰكِهَةٖ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: And meat of those birds which they will desire.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

verses.english_text: And there will be wide-eyed Hoories.
verses.arabic_text: وَحُورٌ عِينٌ

verses.english_text: Like well-guarded pearls.
verses.arabic_text: كَاَمْثَالِ اللُّؤْلُؤِ الْمَكْنُونِ

verses.english_text: In fact all this will be as recompense and reward for their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: There they will not hear any vain talk or sinful-speech.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَاْثِيمًا

verses.english_text: There only will be peace and greetings everywhere.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا قِيلًا سَلَامًا سَلَامًا

verses.english_text: And what to say about the companions of right hand; those companions of Right-Hand!
verses.arabic_text: وَاَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ مَا اَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ

verses.english_text: (There will be) bores without thorns;
verses.arabic_text: فِي سِدْرٍ مَّخْضُودٍ

verses.english_text: Loaded bananas, one over another.
verses.arabic_text: وَطَلْحٍ مَّنضُودٍ

verses.english_text: Spreaded shades.
verses.arabic_text: وَظِلٍّ مَّمْدُودٍ

verses.english_text: Water falling from the Falls.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَاءٍ مَّسْكُوبٍ

verses.english_text: They will be amidst the plentiful fruits.
verses.arabic_text: وَفَٰكِهَةٖ كَثِيرَةٖ

verses.english_text: Whose continuance will never end and there won't be any hindrance.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٖ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٖ

verses.english_text: And there will be high quality mattresses.
verses.arabic_text: وَفُرُشٖ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ

verses.english_text: Indeed, We have created these Hoories.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَنشَاْنَٰهُنَّ اِنشَآءٗ

verses.english_text: We have created them all new.
verses.arabic_text: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ اَبْكَارًا

verses.english_text: These virgins will be companions among themselves.
verses.arabic_text: عُرُبًا اَتْرَابًا

verses.english_text: These are all for right handers.
verses.arabic_text: لِّاَصْحَٰبِ الْيَمِينِ

verses.english_text: Whose one group will be of earlier people.
verses.arabic_text: ثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: And one group will be of later people.
verses.arabic_text: وَثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ الْآخِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And companions of the left-hand; what to ask about the left-handers.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَصْحَٰبُ الشِّمَالِ مَآ اَصْحَٰبُ الشِّمَالِ

verses.english_text: Hot air and boiling water.
verses.arabic_text: فِي سَمُومٖ وَحَمِيمٖ

verses.english_text: Shade of black smoke.
verses.arabic_text: وَظِلّٖ مِّن يَحْمُومٖ

verses.english_text: Which will not be cool and nor feel good.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا بَارِدٖ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ

verses.english_text: These are the people who were living a very (lavish) luxurious life.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ

verses.english_text: They were persistent on the great sins.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَانُواْ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى الْحِنثِ الْعَظِيمِ

verses.english_text: They said: when we die and become dust and bones, shall then we be raised up again.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَانُواْ يَقُولُونَ اَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَٰبٗا وَعِظَٰمًا اَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

verses.english_text: Will our fathers be raised again?
verses.arabic_text: اَوَ ءَابَآؤُنَا الْاَوَّلُونَ

verses.english_text: Say: earlier ones and later ones, all.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّ الْاَوَّلِينَ وَالْءَاخِرِينَ

verses.english_text: They will all be collected on an appointed day at a promised place.
verses.arabic_text: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ اِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٖ مَّعْلُومٖ

verses.english_text: After that, O you who have gone astray and deniers.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمْ اَيُّهَا الضَّآلُّونَ الْمُكَذِّبُونَ

verses.english_text: They shall eat the Thor tree.
verses.arabic_text: لَآكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٖ مِّن زَقُّومٖ

verses.english_text: Then you shall fill your bellies with it.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَالِؤُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ

verses.english_text: Then shall drink boiling water on top of it.
verses.arabic_text: فَشَٰرِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْحَمِيمِ

verses.english_text: Then shall drink like thirsty camels drink.
verses.arabic_text: فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرْبَ الْهِيمِ

verses.english_text: This shall be their hospitality on the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ الدِّينِ

verses.english_text: We have created you, then why don't you affirm the re-creation.
verses.arabic_text: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ

verses.english_text: Have you seen that sperm which you put in the womb.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ

verses.english_text: Do you create that, or We are the Creator?
verses.arabic_text: ءَاَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُٓ اَمْ نَحْنُ الْخَٰلِقُونَ

verses.english_text: We have ordained death among you, and We are not unable to do this.
verses.arabic_text: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ الْمَوْتَ وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

verses.english_text: That We may create other people like you; and transform you in such a form which even you do not know.
verses.arabic_text: عَلَىٰٓ اَن نُّبَدِّلَ اَمْثَٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِي مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: You know the first form of creation, so why don't you ponder over it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ النَّشْاَةَ الْاُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: You have seen that seed also which you sow in the ground.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ

verses.english_text: Do you make it grow or We make it grow?
verses.arabic_text: ءَاَنتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُٓ اَمْ نَحْنُ الزَّٰرِعُونَ

verses.english_text: Had We pleased, We would have turned it into bits and you would have kept thinking.
verses.arabic_text: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ حُطَٰمٗا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ

verses.english_text: That we remain in great loss.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Rather we remained deprived.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ

verses.english_text: Did you see the water which you drink?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَرَءَيْتُمُ الْمَآءَ الَّذِي تَشْرَبُونَ

verses.english_text: Did you rain it from the clouds, or is it We who sent down the rain?
verses.arabic_text: ءَاَنتُمْ اَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ الْمُزْنِ اَمْ نَحْنُ الْمُنزِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Had We pleased, We would have made it saline, then why don't you give thanks to Us?
verses.arabic_text: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَٰهُ اُجَاجٗا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Did you see the fire which you kindle from wood?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَرَءَيْتُمُ النَّارَ الَّتِي تُورُونَ

verses.english_text: Did you grow that tree, or We are its Creator.
verses.arabic_text: ءَاَنتُمْ اَنشَاْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ اَمْ نَحْنُ الْمُنشِـُٔونَ

verses.english_text: We made it a source of a reminder; and a profitable object for the travelers.
verses.arabic_text: نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَٰهَا تَذْكِرَةٗ وَمَتَٰعٗا لِّلْمُقْوِينَ

verses.english_text: Now you glorify the name of your Greatest Lord.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ

verses.english_text: And I swear by the phases of the stars.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَآ اُقْسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ النُّجُومِ

verses.english_text: And it is a great oath; if you know.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّهُ لَقَسَمٞ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ

verses.english_text: This is the most honorable Quran.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ لَقُرْءَانٞ كَرِيمٞ

verses.english_text: This has been kept in the hidden book.
verses.arabic_text: فِي كِتَٰبٖ مَّكْنُونٖ

verses.english_text: No one can touch it except those who are purified.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا يَمَسُّهُٓ اِلَّا الْمُطَهَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: This is revealed by the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.arabic_text: تَنزِيلٞ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: So do you people deny this talk (Quran).
verses.arabic_text: اَفَبِهَٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ اَنتُم مُّدْهِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And you have made it your profession to deny it.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ اَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ

verses.english_text: Then why does it not happen, when your soul reaches your throat.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَوْلَآ اِذَا بَلَغَتِ الْحُلْقُومَ

verses.english_text: And then you shall just keep looking on.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٖ تَنظُرُونَ

verses.english_text: We are nearer to the dying person than you, but you cannot see.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَحْنُ اَقْرَبُ اِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Then if you are not under pressure from anyone and are totally free.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَوْلَآ اِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ

verses.english_text: Then why do you not return that soul, if you are truthful.
verses.arabic_text: تَرْجِعُونَهَآ اِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Then if the dying person is from the nearest one to Allah.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّآ اِن كَانَ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ

verses.english_text: Then for him is comfort, fragrant flowers, and gardens of bliss.
verses.arabic_text: فَرَوْحٞ وَرَيْحَانٞ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍ

verses.english_text: And if those are the right-hand people.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمَّآ اِن كَانَ مِنْ اَصْحَٰبِ الْيَمِينِ

verses.english_text: Then salutations are for you, from the companions of right-handers.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَلَٰمٞ لَّكَ مِنْ اَصْحَٰبِ الْيَمِينِ

verses.english_text: And if he is of those who deny and have gone astray.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمَّآ اِن كَانَ مِنَ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ الضَّآلِّينَ

verses.english_text: Then (for him) is hospitality of boiling water.
verses.arabic_text: فَنُزُلٞ مِّنْ حَمِيمٖ

verses.english_text: And the punishment of being thrown into Hell.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ

verses.english_text: This is that talk which is the Truth and certainty.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ الْيَقِينِ

verses.english_text: Then continue to glorify the name of your Greatest Lord.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ

verses.english_text: Everything which is in the sky and on the earth is busy in glorifying the Lord, and that Lord is Honorable and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: All the authority of the sky and the earth is with Him, and it is He who gives life and death, and He has Power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ

verses.english_text: He is The First, He is The Last, He is Outward, He is Inward, and He is Knower of everything.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الْاَوَّلُ وَالْـَٔاخِرُ وَالظَّـٰهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: It is He who has created the skies and the earth in six days, then established His power on the Throne, He knows all things which enters the earth and what comes out of it, and whatever comes down from the sky and raises towards it, He is with you - wherever you may be, and He sees all your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِى خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَ مَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ وَ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ اَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: Kingdom of the skies and the earth is for Him, and all the affairs return to Allah only.
verses.arabic_text: لَّهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ وَاِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْاُمُورُ

verses.english_text: He enters night into the day and the day into the night, and he has the knowledge of secrets of the chests too.
verses.arabic_text: يُولِجُ الَّيْلَ فِى النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِى الَّيْلِ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

verses.english_text: Believe in Allah and His prophet and spend from the wealth (in His way) in which Allah has made you His deputy, among you those who believe and spend in the way of Allah, there is great reward for them.
verses.arabic_text: ءَامِنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَاَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَالَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمْ وَاَنفَقُواْ لَهُمْ اَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And what has happened to you; that you do not believe in Allah, even while the prophet is inviting you to believe in your Lord, and Allah has already taken a covenant from you about this; if you would trust.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ ۙ وَالرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمْ وَ قَدْ اَخَذَ مِيثَـٰقَكُمْ اِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: That is He who sends the explicit signs on His servant, to bring you out of darkness towards the light, and verily Allah is kind on your condition and is Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِٓ اٰيٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَـٰتِ اِلَى النُّورِ ۚ وَاِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And what has happened to you that you do not spend in the cause of Allah? Whereas all the heritage of skies and the earth is His, and among you he cannot be equal to (the persons) who spent and fought before the victory, to those who spent and fought after the victory; those are higher in rank who fought before, however Allah has promised good to everyone, and Allah is well cognizant of what you do. ​
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا لَكُمْ اَلَّا تُنفِقُواْ فِى سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوِى مِنكُم مَّنْ اَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ الْفَتْحِ وَقَـٰتَلَ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ اَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةًۭ مِّنَ الَّذِينَ اَنفَقُواْ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَقَـٰتَلُواْ ۚ وَكُلًّۭا وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: Who is there who will give goodly loan (qarz-e-hasna) to Allah, and He will increase it two-fold, and besides that he will have respectful reward too.
verses.arabic_text: مَّن ذَا الَّذِى يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا فَيُضَـٰعِفَهُ لَهُ وَلَهُٓ اَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: On that day you will see to the believing men and the believing women - their light of faith is walking ahead of them and on their right side, and it is being said to them that today good news to you is that of gardens beneath which rivers are flowing, and you shall abide forever therein, and this is the grand success.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَرَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ اَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِاَيْمَـٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ الْيَوْمَ جَنَّـٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ

verses.english_text: On that day hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to the believers: look at us so we may borrow a light from your light, so they will be told: return to your rear and request for light from your demons; and thereafter separation will be brought between them by a wall - inside of which will be the Mercy, and outside of which will be the punishment.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ الْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَالْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ انظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ ارْجِعُواْ وَرَآءَكُمْ فَالْتَمِسُواْ نُورًا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍۢ لَّهُ بَابٌۢ بَاطِنُهُ فِيهِ الرَّحْمَةُ وَظَـٰهِرُهُ مِن قِبَلِهِ الْعَذَابُ

verses.english_text: Hypocrites will call out to the believers and say: were not we with you, they will say: indeed, but you afflicted yourselves in calamity and awaited adversity for us, and you doubted prophethood; and your desires kept you in deception, till the command of Allah came; and you were deceived by the deceptive Satan.
verses.arabic_text: يُنَادُونَهُمْ اَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ ۖ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمْ اَنفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَارْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ الْاَمَانِىُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ اَمْرُ اللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ

verses.english_text: So today no ransom will be accepted either from you or from the infidels, abode of all of you is Hell, He has the authority over all of you, and worst is your consequence.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنكُمْ فِدْيَةٌۭ وَلَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ۚ مَاْوَىٰكُمُ النَّارُ ۖ هِىَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: Has the time not come for the believers that their hearts are softened from the mention of Allah and about the Truth revealed from Him; and they should not be like those People of the Book who were given the book and their hearts were hardened after the passage of a period of time, and their majority became wicked.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اَلَمْ يَاْنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَ مَا نَزَلَ مِنَ الْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُواْ كَالَّذِينَ اُوتُواْ الْكِتٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْاَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ

verses.english_text: Remember, that it is Allah who gives life to the dead earth, and We have described all (Our) signs in detail, so that you may use your wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: اعْلَمُوٓاْ اَنَّ اللَّهَ يُحْىِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ الْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, men who do charity and women who do charity and those who give goodly loan to Allah with sincerity, their recompense will be doubled and (besides it) for them is honorable great reward.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَالْمُصَّدِّقَـٰتِ وَاَقْرَضُواْ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا يُضَـٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ اَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And the people who believed in Allah and His prophet, their rank near Allah is that of a truthful and a martyr and for them is their reward and the light; and those who adopted infidelity and denied Our signs, they are in fact companions of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِٓ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الصِّدِّيقُونَ ۖ وَالشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ اَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ ۖ وَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ اَصْحَـٰبُ الْجَحِيمِ

verses.english_text: Remember, life of the world is play, entertainment, adornment and mutual boasting, and competition about abundance of wealth and children; an example is of rain that its power of growth make the farmers happy, and later their farms withers and you see it grow yellow, and then it becomes dry and crumbles; and in the Hereafter there is severe Punishment and Forgiveness and Pleasure of Allah is also there, and life of this world is nothing but means of deception.
verses.arabic_text: اعْلَمُوٓاْ اَنَّمَا الْحَيَوٰةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌۭ وَلَهْوٌۭ وَزِينَةٌۭ وَتَفَاخُرٌۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌۭ فِى الْاَمْوَٰلِ وَالْاَوْلَـٰدِ ۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ اَعْجَبَ الْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّۭا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَـٰمًۭا ۖ وَفِى الْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ وَمَغْفِرَةٌۭ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٌۭ ۚ وَ مَا الْحَيَوٰةُ الدُّنْيَآ اِلَّا مَتَـٰعُ الْغُرُورِ

verses.english_text: Hasten towards the forgiveness of your Lord and His Paradise - width of which is equal to the earth and the skies, that has been provided for the people who believe on Allah and His prophet, this is in fact the Grace of Allah which He bestows upon whom He pleases; and Allah is the Master of abounding Grace.
verses.arabic_text: سَابِقُوٓاْ اِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضِ اُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ

verses.english_text: If any calamity befalls on earth or befalls on yourself; so this has already been written in the Divine Book before the creation of yourself, and this is a very easy thing for Allah.
verses.arabic_text: مَآ اَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍۢ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَا فِىٓ اَنفُسِكُمْ اِلَّا فِى كِتٰبٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِ اَن نَّبْرَاَهَآ ۚ اِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: This fate is there so that you do not grieve if anything goes out of your hands, and if you get something do not be proud of it; that Allah does not like prideful and arrogant people.
verses.arabic_text: لِّكَيْلَا تَاْسَوْاْ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍۢ فَخُورٍ

verses.english_text: Those who are stingy themselves and enjoin others also to do stinginess and whoever will turn away from Allah should know that Allah is Self-Sufficient and worthy of all Praise.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَاْمُرُونَ النَّاسَ بِالْبُخْلِ ۗ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِىُّ الْحَمِيدُ

verses.english_text: Verily, We have sent Our prophets with the clear signs and sent down with them the Book and the Balance that the people may stand forth in justice; and We have also sent down the iron in which there is material of mighty war and other benefits too; so that Allah may test who help Him and His prophet without seeing, and verily Allah is very Powerful and Honorable.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَاَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ وَالْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ النَّاسُ بِالْقِسْطِ ۖ وَاَنزَلْنَا الْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَاْسٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُ وَرُسُلَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌۭ

verses.english_text: And We sent Nooh and Ibrahim and kept book and the prophethood among their descendants; so some of them were on guidance and many of them were transgressors and wicked ones.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًۭا وَاِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتٰبَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مُّهْتَدٍۢ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ

verses.english_text: Then on their footsteps We sent other prophets, and after them sent Isa son of Maryam and bestowed upon him Injeel, and We ordained in the hearts of his followers love and compassion; and Monasticism, which they had invented for themselves to seek the pleasure of Allah, We did not prescribed for them, and even they themselves didn't followed it (as they should have done), so among them We rewarded those who really believed; but many of them were transgressors and wicked ones.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ الْاِنجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ رَاْفَةًۭ وَرَحْمَةًۭ وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ابْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَـٰهَا عَلَيْهِمْ اِلَّا ابْتِغَآءَ رِضْوَٰنِ اللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا ۖ فَـَٔاتَيْنَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنْهُمْ اَجْرَهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ

verses.english_text: O believers! fear Allah and believe in His prophet in reality, so that Allah bestow upon you double His Mercy on you, and establish a light for you with which you can walk (on the straight path), and forgive you, for Allah is Most-Forgiving and Most Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ وَءَامِنُواْ بِرَسُولِهِ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِن رَّحْمَتِهِ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُورًا تَمْشُونَ بِهِ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: That People of Book should know that they do not have any authority over the Grace of Allah, and all the Grace is in Allah's Hand only and He bestows upon whomever He pleases, and He is the Owner of the mighty Grace.
verses.arabic_text: لِّئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ اَهْلُ الْكِتٰبِ اَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ مِّن فَضْلِ اللَّهِ ۙ وَاَنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ

verses.english_text: Verily, Allah heard the talk of that lady who was talking to you regarding her husband and was pleading with Allah, and Allah was hearing the talk of both of you; Allah is all Hearing and all Seeing.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ سَمِعَ اللّٰهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِي اِلَى اللّٰهِ وَاللّٰهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَا ۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ

verses.english_text: Those people who do Zihaar with their wives, their wives cannot be their mothers, mothers are only those who gave birth to them, and they say very evil and false talk, and Allah is all Pardoning and all Forgiving.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ اُمَّهَٰتِهِمْ ۖ اِنْ اُمَّهَٰتُهُمْ اِلَّا الَّٰـٓـِٔى وَلَدْنَهُمْ ۚ وَاِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرًا مِّنَ الْقَوْلِ وَزُورًا ۚ وَ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌۭ

verses.english_text: Among you, those who pronounce Zihaar to their wives and wish to go back on their words they uttered, so they should free a slave before touching the wife, this is an admonition for you from Allah, and Allah is very cognizant with your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُواْ فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِ اَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِ ۚ وَاللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then if it is not possible for him to free a slave, he should keep the fast for two months consecutively before touching each other, if this is also not possible then he should feed sixty destitute; this is because you should keep faith on Allah and His prophet correctly, these are the limits set by Allah, and for the infidels there is very painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِ اَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَاِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُواْ بِاللّٰهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللّٰهِ ۗ وَلِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Verily, those who keep enmity with Allah and His prophet will be as humiliated as people before them were humiliated, and We have revealed the Clear Signs, and for the infidels is humiliating punishment.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُولَهُ كُبِتُواْ كَمَا كُبِتَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَ قَدْ اَنزَلْنَآ اٰيٰتٍۢ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ ۚ وَلِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: On the Day when Allah will bring everyone to life (again) and shall inform them about their deeds, which He has recorded and people themselves have forgotten, and Allah is Witness over everything.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللّٰهُ جَمِيعًۭا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓاْ ۚ اَحْصَىٰهُ اللّٰهُ وَنَسُوهُ ۚ وَاللّٰهُ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ

verses.english_text: Don't you see that Allah is aware of everything of the skies and the earth, there is not a secret talk between three persons but that He is their fourth, and where there are five secret talk holders He is their sixth; whether less or more if there is a secret talk He is surely with them - wherever they may be; thereafter on the Day of Judgement He will inform them what they had done; verily He is Knower of all things.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ ۖ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجْوَىٰ ثَلَـٰثَةٍ اِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلَا خَمْسَةٍ اِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلَا اَدْنَىٰ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ اَكْثَرَ اِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ اَيْنَ مَا كَانُواْ ۖ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُواْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Didn't you see those people who were forbidden from secret talk yet they talk like this and indulge in secret talk with iniquity, injustice and in disobedience to the prophet; when they come to you they address you in such a way which Allah has not taught them, and they say in their hearts if we are wrong why don't Allah send punishment on us; although for Hell is enough for them, in which they will burn, and that is the worst end.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِينَ نُهُواْ عَنِ النَّجْوَىٰ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا نُهُواْ عَنْهُ وَيَتَنَـٰجَوْنَ بِالْاِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَٰنِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ الرَّسُولِ ۖ وَاِذَا جَآءُوكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِمَا لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ اللّٰهُ وَيَقُولُونَ فِىٓ اَنفُسِهِمْ لَوْلَا يُعَذِّبُنَا اللّٰهُ بِمَا نَقُولُ ۚ حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۚ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: O you who believe! Whenever you talk in secret, beware, do not talk with iniquity, aggression and in disobedience to the prophet, but instead talk righteousness and with piousness, keep fearing Allah, after all your return is towards Him.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اِذَا تَنَـٰجَيْتُمْ فَلَا تَتَنَـٰجَوْاْ بِالْاِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَٰنِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ الرَّسُولِ وَتَنَـٰجَوْاْ بِالْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَاتَّقُواْ اللّٰهَ الَّذِىٓ اِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

verses.english_text: These secret talks are from Satan to trouble the believers, although he cannot harm them until Allah gives permission, and believers' trust is only on Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا النَّجْوَىٰ مِنَ الشَّيْطَـٰنِ لِيَحْزُنَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَيْسَ بِضَآرِّهِمْ شَيْـًٔا اِلَّا بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ ۚ وَعَلَى اللّٰهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: O you who believe! When you are asked to make room in the assemblies give place to other so that Allah expand your place in the Paradise; and when you are asked to rise up, get up, that Allah pleases to raise the ranks of those who believe and who have been granted knowledge; and Allah is well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُواْ فِى الْمَجَـٰلِسِ فَافْسَحُواْ يَفْسَحِ اللّٰهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَاِذَا قِيلَ انشُزُواْ فَانشُزُواْ يَرْفَعِ اللّٰهُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمْ وَ الَّذِينَ اُوتُواْ الْعِلْمَ دَرَجَـٰتٍۢ ۚ وَاللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: O you who believe! whenever you talk confidentially to the prophet give something in charity beforehand, it is better and purity for you; if charity is not possible then Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اِذَا نَـٰجَيْتُمُ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُواْ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ نَجْوَىٰكُمْ صَدَقَةًۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ وَاَطْهَرُ ۚ فَاِن لَّمْ تَجِدُواْ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Have you become fearful that you have to give charity before your confidential talk with the prophet, now that you have not done this then Allah has accepted your repentance; now establish prayer and give poor-rate and obey Allah and His prophet; Allah is well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: ءَاَشْفَقْتُمْ اَن تُقَدِّمُواْ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ نَجْوَىٰكُمْ صَدَقَـٰتٍۢ ۚ فَاِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُواْ وَتَابَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاَقِيمُواْ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ الزَّكَوٰةَ وَاَطِيعُواْ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ۚ وَاللّٰهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Didn't you see those people who befriended the nation on whom Allah has sent punishment, they are neither from you nor from them, and they swear falsely and they are themselves aware of their own falsehood.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْاْ قَوْمًۭا غَضِبَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا هُم مِّنكُمْ وَلَا مِنْهُمْ وَيَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى الْكَذِبِ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Allah has prepared severe punishment for them that they were doing very evil deeds.
verses.arabic_text: اَعَدَّ اللّٰهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًا ۖ اِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: They have made their oaths their shields and are creating hurdles in the path of Allah, so for them is humiliating punishment.
verses.arabic_text: اتَّخَذُوٓاْ اَيْمَـٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةًۭ فَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: Their wealth and their children are of no avail against Allah, they are all Hellish people and they shall abide in it forever.
verses.arabic_text: لَّن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ اَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ اَوْلَـٰدُهُم مِّنَ اللّٰهِ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ اَصْحَـٰبُ النَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

verses.english_text: On the Day Allah will raise them again, then they will swear with Him also as they swear with you; they will think that they have something to say, whereas they are totally liars.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللّٰهُ جَمِيعًۭا فَيَحْلِفُونَ لَهُ كَمَا يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ وَيَحْسَبُونَ اَنَّهُمْ عَلَٰى شَىْءٍ ۚ اَلَآ اِنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْكَـٰذِبُونَ

verses.english_text: Satan has overpowered them and he has made them oblivious from the remembrance of Allah; be aware, this is group of Satan, and at last group of Satan is loser.
verses.arabic_text: اسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِمُ الشَّيْطَـٰنُ فَاَنسَىٰهُمْ ذِكْرَ اللّٰهِ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ الشَّيْطَـٰنِ ۚ اَلَآ اِنَّ حِزْبَ الشَّيْطَـٰنِ هُمُ الْخَـٰسِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, those who are hostile to Allah and His prophet, they are among the most humiliating people.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُولَهُٓ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى الْاَذَلِّينَ

verses.english_text: Allah has written that I and My prophet are going to prevail, Verily, Allah is Owner of Strength and Honorable.
verses.arabic_text: كَتَبَ اللّٰهُ لَاَغْلِبَنَّ اَنَا۠ وَرُسُلِىٓ ۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌۭ

verses.english_text: You will never see that the nation who believe on Allah and the Day of Judgement is befriending to the people who are inimical to Allah and His prophet even if they are their fathers, children, brothers or of their clan and tribe; Allah has written faith in the hearts of the believers, and has endorsed them with exclusive Spirit from Himself, and He will admit them into those Paradises beneath which rivers will be flowing, and they shall abide in them forever, Allah will be pleased with them, and they will be pleased with Allah, they are the Party of Allah and be aware that deliverance is only for Allah's Party.
verses.arabic_text: لَا تَجِدُ قَوْمًا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللّٰهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ يُوَادُّونَ مَنْ حَادَّ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَ لَوْ كَانُوا آبَاءَهُمْ اَوْ اَبْنَاءَهُمْ اَوْ اِخْوَانَهُمْ اَوْ عَشِيرَتَهُمْ ۚ اُولَٰئِكَ كَتَبَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الْاِيمَانَ وَاَيَّدَهُم بِرُوحٍ مِّنْهُ ۖ وَيُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَارُ خٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ رَضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ ۚ اُولَٰئِكَ حِزْبُ اللّٰهِ ۚ اَلَا اِنَّ حِزْبَ اللّٰهِ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: Whatever is in the skies and on the earth, everything is busy glorifying Allah, and He is Honorable and Owner of Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: سَبَّحَ لِلّٰهِ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِي الْاَرْضِ ۖ وَ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: It is He who got out unbelievers among the People of the Book from their homes at the first gathering and you were not even imagining that they can be exiled, and they were also of the opinion that their forts will saved them from Allah, but Allah behaved in such a way that they could not had envisage about it, and cast terror in their hearts that they started to destroy their houses from their own hands and from the hands of the believers; so that people with the vision may take the lesson.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِي اَخْرَجَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ لِاَوَّلِ الْحَشْرِ ۚ مَا ظَنَنتُمْ اَن يَخْرُجُوا وَظَنُّوا اَنَّهُم مَّانِعَتُهُمْ حُصُونُهُم مِّنَ اللّٰهِ فَاَتَاهُمُ اللّٰهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ يَحْتَسِبُوا وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ

verses.english_text: If Allah would not have written exile in their fate, then He would have sent punishment on them in the world, and in the Hereafter punishment of Hell is certain.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا اَن كَتَبَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْجَلَآءَ لَعَذَّبَهُمْ فِى الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِى الْءَاخِرَةِ عَذَابُ النَّارِ

verses.english_text: This is because they disputed with Allah and His prophet, and those who dispute with Allah, then Allah is severe in punishment.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ شَآقُّوا اللّٰهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ۖ وَ مَن يُشَآقِّ اللّٰهَ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ

verses.english_text: O Muslims! Whether you cut the palm-tree branches or left them on their roots, this was all with the permission of Allah, that Allah may disgrace the transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ اَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰۤ اُصُولِهَا فَبِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ الْفَـٰسِقِينَ

verses.english_text: And whatever war booty Allah has made available from them to the Prophet, for that you made no expedition either through your horses or camels, but Allah gave domination to His prophet and Allah has power over everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا اَفَاءَ اللّٰهُ عَلَٰى رَسُولِهِ مِنْهُمْ فَمَآ اَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلٍۢ وَلَا رِكَابٍ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُسَلِّطُ رُسُلَهُ عَلَٰى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَاللّٰهُ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ

verses.english_text: Whatever Allah has made available from the people of the towns, all belong to Allah, to His prophet, relatives of the prophet, orphans, destitute and to poor-travelers; that all the wealth may not circulate and may not remain among the wealthy people only; and take whatever prophet give you, and refrain from whatever he prohibits you, and fear Allah; for Allah is strict in punishment.
verses.arabic_text: مَّآ اَفَآءَ اللّٰهُ عَلَٰى رَسُولِهِ مِنْ اَهْلِ الْقُرَىٰ فَلِلّٰهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِى الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَـٰمَىٰ وَالْمَسَـٰكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ كَىْ لَا يَكُونَ دُولَةًۢ بَيْنَ الْاَغْنِيَآءِ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ ۖ وَ مَا نَهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانتَهُواْ ۚ وَاتَّقُواْ اللّٰهَ ۖ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ

verses.english_text: This wealth belongs to the poor migrants also who have been expelled from their homes and property and they only desire the Grace and Pleasure of Allah and help Allah and His prophet, these are the people who are true to their claim in believing.
verses.arabic_text: لِلْفُقَرَآءِ الْمُهٰجِرِينَ الَّذِينَ اُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِمْ وَاَمْوَٰلِهِمْ يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًۭا وَيَنصُرُونَ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُولَهُٓ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الصَّـٰدِقُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who earlier had their homes (in Madina) and adopted faith before them and show affection to those who came to them after migration; and had no desire in their hearts for whatever was given to them and prefers others over themselves no matter how needful they themselves may be, and those who are saved from the greed of their Selves, they shall achieve the desires of their hearts.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُوا الدَّارَ وَالْاِيمَـٰنَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ يُحِبُّونَ مَنْ هَاجَرَ اِلَيْهِمْ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ فِى صُدُورِهِمْ حَاجَةًۭ مِّمَّآ اُوتُواْ وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَىٰٓ اَنفُسِهِمْ وَ لَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌۭ ۚ وَ مَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who came after them say: O Lord forgive us and also our brethren who accepted faith before us and do not let the malice take place in our hearts for the believers, O Lord, You are very Kind and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ جَآءُواْ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِاِخْوَٰنِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْاِيمَـٰنِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِى قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ۚ رَبَّنَآ اِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Did not you see the condition of the hypocrites that they say to their unbelieving brothers among the people of the book that if you are expelled, we will also go with you and will not obey anyone concerning you, and if you are attacked, we will help you; and Allah is witness that they are totally liars.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِينَ نَافَقُواْ يَقُولُونَ لِاِخْوَٰنِهِمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ لَئِنْ اُخْرِجْتُمْ لَنَخْرُجَنَّ مَعَكُمْ وَلَا نُطِيعُ فِيكُمْ اَحَدًا اَبَدًۭا وَاِن قُوتِلْتُمْ لَنَنصُرَنَّكُمْ ۚ وَاللّٰهُ يَشْهَدُ اِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ

verses.english_text: If they are expelled, they will not go with them; if they are attacked, they will never help them, and even if they help - they will turn their backs and run away, then no one will be there to help them.
verses.arabic_text: لَئِنْ اُخْرِجُواْ لَا يَخْرُجُونَ مَعَهُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن قُوتِلُواْ لَا يَنصُرُونَهُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن نَّصَرُوهُمْ لَيُوَلُّنَّ الْاَدْبَـٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يُنصَرُونَ

verses.english_text: O Muslims! You arouse greater fear in their hearts than Allah, this is because this nation is devoid of understanding.
verses.arabic_text: لَاَنتُمْ اَشَدُّ رَهْبَةًۭ فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنَ اللّٰهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌۭ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ

verses.english_text: They will never fight collectively with you except when they are in secured towns or from behind the walls, strong is their fighting spirit among them, you think they are united, never, there is severe discord in their hearts; and this is because this nation has no wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يُقَـٰتِلُونَكُمْ جَمِيعًا اِلَّا فِى قُرًى مُّحَصَّنَةٍ اَوْ مِن وَرَآءِ جُدُرٍۢ ۚ بَاْسُهُم بَيْنَهُمْ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ تَحْسَبُهُمْ جَمِيعًۭا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ شَتَّىٰ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌۭ لَّا يَعْقِلُونَ

verses.english_text: Like recently what has happened to the earlier people, they tasted the result of their conduct, and there is also painful punishment for them.
verses.arabic_text: كَمَثَلِ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ قَرِيبًۭا ذَاقُواْ وَبَالَ اَمْرِهِمْ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Their example is like Satan that he says to man: "adopt infidelity" and when he becomes infidel Satan says: I am free from you, I fear the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.arabic_text: كَمَثَلِ الشَّيْطَـٰنِ اِذْ قَالَ لِلْاِنسَـٰنِ اكْفُرْ ۖ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ اِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّنكَ اِنِّىٓ اَخَافُ اللّٰهَ رَبَّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: So consequence of both of them is that both shall abide in the Hell forever; and this is really the punishment of the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَانَ عَـٰقِبَتَهُمَآ اَنَّهُمَا فِى النَّارِ خَـٰلِدَيْنِ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَٰٓؤُاْ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: O you who believe! Fear Allah, and every person should see what he has sent for tomorrow (the Hereafter) and keep fearing Allah, He is indeed well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اتَّقُواْ اللّٰهَ ۖ وَلْتَنظُرْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍۢ ۖ وَاتَّقُواْ اللّٰهَ ۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: And beware! do not be like those who have forgotten Allah; so Allah Himself have also forgotten their Selves, and indeed they are all transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَكُونُواْ كَالَّذِينَ نَسُواْ اللّٰهَ فَاَنسَىٰهُمْ اَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْفَـٰسِقُونَ

verses.english_text: Companions of Paradise and Companions of Hell cannot be alike, Companions of Paradise are those who will achieve success.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يَسْتَوِىٓ اَصْحَـٰبُ النَّارِ وَاَصْحَـٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ ۚ اَصْحَـٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمُ الْفَآئِزُونَ

verses.english_text: Had We revealed this Quran on a mountain then you would have seen it tremble and become pieces with the Fear of Allah, and We describe these examples for man that perhaps they may ponder about it.
verses.arabic_text: لَوْ اَنزَلْنَا هٰذَا الْقُرْءَانَ عَلَٰى جَبَلٍۢ لَّرَاَيْتَهُ خَـٰشِعًۭا مُّتَصَدِّعًۭا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ اللّٰهِ ۚ وَتِلْكَ الْاَمْثَـٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah, there is no god but He, He is the knower of the Unseen and the seen; He is the Most Gracious, the All-compassionate.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ اللّٰهُ الَّذِى لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَـٰلِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهٰدَةِ ۖ هُوَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ

verses.english_text: That is Allah, there is no god but He. He is the King, Having Holy Attributes, Flawless, Giver of the Refuge, Guardian, Exalted in Honor, Greatest, Owner of Pride; He is above all the talk which polytheists do.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ اللّٰهُ الَّذِى لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَـٰمُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah who creates, invents, and makes faces; to Him belong the Most Beautiful Names, every particle of the earth and the skies is busy glorifying him, and He is Honorable and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ اللّٰهُ الْخَـٰلِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ ۖ لَهُ الْاَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ ۖ وَ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: O you who believe, beware! Never befriend with My enemy and your enemy, you will offer them friendship whereas they have denied the Truth that has come to you; and they are expelling the prophet and you, just because you believe in Allah - your Lord; if in reality you have left your homes to strive in Our way and to seek Our Pleasure, then how you are making secret friendship with them, whereas I know fully well all that you conceal and that you reveal; and whoever will act in this way verily he has deviated from the straight path.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَّخِذُواْ عَدُوِّى وَعَدُوَّكُمْ اَوْلِيَآءَ تُلْقُونَ اِلَيْهِم بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَ قَدْ كَفَرُواْ بِمَا جَآءَكُم مِّنَ الْحَقِّ يُخْرِجُونَ الرَّسُولَ وَاِيَّاكُمْ ۙ اَن تُؤْمِنُواْ بِاللَّهِ رَبِّكُمْ اِن كُنتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَـٰدًۭا فِى سَبِيلِى وَابْتِغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِى ۚ تُسِرُّونَ اِلَيْهِم بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَاَنَا۠ اَعْلَمُ بِمَآ اَخْفَيْتُمْ وَ مَآ اَعْلَنتُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْهُ مِنكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ السَّبِيلِ

verses.english_text: And if they find you, they will prove to be your enemies, they will work against you with their hands and their tongues, and they will desire you become infidels.
verses.arabic_text: اِن يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُواْ لَكُمْ اَعْدَآءًۭ وَيَبْسُطُوٓاْ اِلَيْكُمْ اَيْدِيَهُمْ وَاَلْسِنَتَهُم بِالسُّوٓءِ وَوَدُّواْ لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily your relatives and your children will be of no use to you on the Day of Judgement, that day Allah will decide between you, and He is well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: لَن تَنفَعَكُمْ اَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلَآ اَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ ۚ يَوْمَ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: The best example for your is in Ibrahim and his companions when they said to their nation that we are free from you and your gods, we have rejected you, and enmity and hatred between us and you is clear unless you believe in One Allah - who has no partner; except for the word of Ibrahim which he said to his father that Verily I will seek forgiveness for you though I do not have any authority from Allah (in this regard); O Allah, I have trusted you, and have turned towards You, and towards you is the return.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمْ اُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌۭ فِىٓ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَ الَّذِينَ مَعَهُٓ اِذْ قَالُواْ لِقَوْمِهِمْ اِنَّا بُرَءَٰٓؤُاْ مِنكُمْ وَمِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ كَفَرْنَا بِكُمْ وَبَدَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ الْعَدَٰوَةُ وَالْبَغْضَآءُ اَبَدًا حَتَّىٰ تُؤْمِنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَحْدَهُٓ اِلَّا قَوْلَ اِبْرَٰهِيمَ لِاَبِيهِ لَاَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَ مَآ اَمْلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۖ رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَاِلَيْكَ اَنَبْنَا وَاِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: O Lord, do not make us a temptation to the infidels, and forgive us, O Lord, You are all-Honorable and all-Wise.
verses.arabic_text: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَآ ۖ اِنَّكَ اَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: Verily for you is a best example in these people - for him who is hopeful of Allah and the Hereafter, but if anyone deviate then Allah is Self-Sufficient from him and worthy of all-Praise.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِيهِمْ اُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌۭ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُواْ اللَّهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْـَٔاخِرَ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِىُّ الْحَمِيدُ

verses.english_text: It is near that Allah may establish friendship between you and those with whom you have enmity that He is Owner of Power, and All-Forgiving and All-Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ عَسَى اللَّهُ اَن يَجْعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ الَّذِينَ عَادَيْتُم مِّنْهُم مَّوَدَّةًۭ ۚ وَاللَّهُ قَدِيرٌۭ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And He did not forbid you from doing kindness and justice with those who have not fought with you in religious matters and have not expelled you from your homes, that Allah likes those who do justice.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا يَنْهَىٰكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُقَـٰتِلُوكُمْ فِى الدِّينِ وَلَمْ يُخْرِجُوكُم مِّن دِيَـٰرِكُمْ اَن تَبَرُّوهُمْ وَتُقْسِطُوٓاْ اِلَيْهِمْ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ

verses.english_text: He only prohibits you from being friend with those who fought with you in religion's cause and who expelled you from your habitats and help the enemies in your expulsion; whoever will befriend with them is indeed unjust.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا يَنْهَىٰكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ قَـٰتَلُوكُمْ فِى الدِّينِ وَاَخْرَجُوكُم مِّن دِيَـٰرِكُمْ وَظَـٰهَرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ اِخْرَاجِكُمْ اَن تَوَلَّوْهُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُمْ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الظَّـٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: O you who believe, when the migrant believing women come to you, first test them that Allah is well aware of their faith, if you ascertain that they are believers then beware do not send them back to the infidels, that they are not lawful for them, nor these (women) are lawful for them (for infidels); but pay them (to infidels) whatever they have spent on dowers; there is no blame on you if you marry them after paying their dowers; and do not hold unto the infidel women, ask back for what you have spent on them (for their dower), and infidels may also ask for what they have spent; this is the command of Allah by which Allah has judged between you, and He is All-Knowing and All-Wise.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اِذَا جَآءَكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَـٰتُ مُهَـٰجِرَٰتٍۢ فَامْتَحِنُوهُنَّ ۖ اللَّهُ اَعْلَمُ بِاِيمَـٰنِهِنَّ ۖ فَاِنْ عَلِمْتُمُوهُنَّ مُؤْمِنَـٰتٍۢ فَلَا تَرْجِعُوهُنَّ اِلَى الْكُفَّارِ ۖ لَا هُنَّ حِلٌّۭ لَّهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحِلُّونَ لَهُنَّ ۖ وَءَاتُوهُم مَّآ اَنفَقُواْ ۚ وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ اَن تَنكِحُوهُنَّ اِذَآ ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ اُجُورَهُنَّ ۚ وَلَا تُمْسِكُواْ بِعِصَمِ الْكَوَافِرِ وَسْـَٔلُواْ مَآ اَنفَقْتُمْ وَلْيَسْـَٔلُواْ مَآ اَنفَقُواْ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ حُكْمُ اللَّهِ ۖ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And if any of your wives have deserted you for the infidels, so punish them; whose wife has gone, pay him the dower (what he had paid to the woman) from the war-booty; and anyhow fear Allah, in Whom you believe.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن فَاتَكُمْ شَىْءٌۭ مِّنْ اَزْوَٰجِكُمْ اِلَى الْكُفَّارِ فَعَاقَبْتُمْ فَـَٔاتُواْ الَّذِينَ ذَهَبَتْ اَزْوَٰجُهُم مِّثْلَ مَآ اَنفَقُواْ ۚ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ الَّذِىٓ اَنتُم بِهِ مُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: O Prophet, if believing women come to you and wish to give you oath of allegiance that they will not make any partner with Allah, and will not steal, and they will not commit fornication, and will not kill their children; and they will not forge a slander from their hands and their feet, and will not oppose you in any good, then accept their allegiance and ask forgiveness for them from Allah, that Allah is Most Forgiving and Most Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ اِذَا جَآءَكَ الْمُؤْمِنَـٰتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَىٰٓ اَن لَّا يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَسْرِقْنَ وَلَا يَزْنِينَ وَلَا يَقْتُلْنَ اَوْلَـٰدَهُنَّ وَلَا يَاْتِينَ بِبُهْتَـٰنٍۢ يَفْتَرِينَهُ بَيْنَ اَيْدِيهِنَّ وَاَرْجُلِهِنَّ وَلَا يَعْصِينَكَ فِى مَعْرُوفٍۢ ۙ فَبَايِعْهُنَّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُنَّ اللَّهَ ۖ اِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: O you who believe, never befriend with the nation on whom Allah has sent His wrath; that they are in despair from the Hereafter just as the infidels are in despair about those buried in graves.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَوَلَّوْاْ قَوْمًا غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ قَدْ يَئِسُواْ مِنَ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ كَمَا يَئِسَ الْكُفَّارُ مِنْ اَصْحَـٰبِ الْقُبُورِ

verses.english_text: Every particle which is on the earth and in the skies is busy glorifying Allah, and He is Honorable and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: O you who believe, why do you say that which you do not do.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ

verses.english_text: It is a matter of strong displeasure near Allah, that you say that you do not follow.
verses.arabic_text: كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ اللَّهِ اَن تَقُولُواْ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, Allah likes those who fight in battle in His way by forming rows like a wall filled with lead.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذِينَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِهِ صَفًّۭا كَاَنَّهُم بُنْيَـٰنٌۭ مَّرْصُوصٌۭ

verses.english_text: And remember the time when Moosa said to his nation: O my people why you are vexing me, although you are aware that I am a messenger of Allah to you, so when those people turned crooked then Allah let their hearts go crooked; that Allah do not guide transgressing nation.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ يَـٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِى وَقَد تَّعْلَمُونَ اَنِّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ اِلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا زَاغُوٓاْ اَزَاغَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الْفَـٰسِقِينَ

verses.english_text: And remember the time when Isa son of Maryam said: O Bani Israel I am a messenger of Allah to you; and I am confirming the earlier book Taurait, and giving glad-tidings of a Prophet after me, whose name is Ahmed; but even then when he came with the miracles, the people said: "this is open magic".
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ اِنِّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ اِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ التَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَاْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى اسْمُهُٓ اَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُواْ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: Who can be the bigger unjust who blames Allah, whereas he is being invited towards Islam, and Allah never guides the unjust nation.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدْعَىٰٓ اِلَى الْاِسْلَـٰمِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Intention of these people is to extinguish the Light of Allah (by blowing) with their mouth and Allah shall complete His Light, even if the infidels may not like it.
verses.arabic_text: يُرِيدُونَ لِيُطْفِـُٔواْ نُورَ اللَّهِ بِاَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَاللَّهُ مُتِمُّ نُورِهِ وَ لَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَـٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: That is Allah who has sent His Prophet with guidance and religion of truth, that He makes it dominate over all the religions, no matter how much the polytheists dislike it.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِىٓ اَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ وَ لَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ

verses.english_text: O you who believe, shall I guide you towards such a trade which will save you from the painful punishment?
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ هَلْ اَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ تِجَـٰرَةٍۢ تُنجِيكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ اَلِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Believe in Allah and His Prophet, and struggle hard in the way of Allah with your life and wealth, that this is the best for you; if you know.
verses.arabic_text: تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتُجَـٰهِدُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِاَمْوَٰلِكُمْ وَاَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ اِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: He will also forgive your sins and will enter you in that Paradises beneath which the rivers will be flowing, and there will be pure houses in this forever-remaining Paradise, and this the greater success.
