verses.arabic_text: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَيُدْخِلْكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ وَمَسَـٰكِنَ طَيِّبَةًۭ فِى جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ

verses.english_text: And one more thing which you like - help from Allah and close victory; and you may give glad tidings to the believers.
verses.arabic_text: وَاُخْرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَا ۖ نَصْرٌۭ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَفَتْحٌۭ قَرِيبٌۭ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.english_text: O you who believe, become helpers of Allah, like Isa ibn Maryam said to his disciples: who is my helper in the way of Allah? So his disciples said: we are the helpers of Allah; but then one group of Bani Israel believed, and one group disbelieved, so We helped the believers against their enemy, so eventually they dominated.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ كُونُوٓاْ اَنصَارَ اللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ اَنصَارِىٓ اِلَى اللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ اَنصَارُ اللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ اِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَاَيَّدْنَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَاَصْبَحُواْ ظَـٰهِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Every particle of the earth and the sky is glorifying Allah, who is the King, having Pure Attributes, Honorable and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ

verses.english_text: That is Allah who sent a prophet to the people of Makkah which was from among them to recite the verses in front of them, to purify themselves and may educate them in book and wisdom, although they were afflicted with the open misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِى بَعَثَ فِى الْاُمِّيِّـۧنَ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُواْ عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتِهِ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَاِن كَانُواْ مِن قَبْلُ لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: And from among them towards those people also, who have not joined them yet, and He is Honorable and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَءَاخَرِينَ مِنْهُمْ لَمَّا يَلْحَقُواْ بِهِمْ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: It is the Grace of Allah, He bestows upon whomever He pleases, and He is the Owner of the Mighty Grace.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ

verses.english_text: The example of the people who were given a load of Taurait and they could not bear it; its load are similar to a donkey who is carrying a load of books; this worst example is of those people who denied the Divine Verses, and Allah does not guide the unjust nation.
verses.arabic_text: مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ حُمِّلُواْ التَّوْرَىٰةَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحْمِلُوهَا كَمَثَلِ الْحِمَارِ يَحْمِلُ اَسْفَارًۢا ۚ بِئْسَ مَثَلُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ اللَّهِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet) Say: O you Jews! if you consider that only you are friends of Allah among all the people, so if you are true in your claim, then desire for death.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ هَادُوٓاْ اِن زَعَمْتُمْ اَنَّكُمْ اَوْلِيَآءُ لِلَّهِ مِن دُونِ النَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُاْ الْمَوْتَ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: And they will never desire for death because of the deeds their hands have already done, and Allah is well aware of the conditions of the unjust.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا يَتَمَنَّوْنَهُٓ اَبَدًۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ اَيْدِيهِمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِالظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Say: the death from which you are escaping is going to meet you itself, thereafter you will be returned to His Presence, Who is aware of all, the unseen and the seen and He will tell you what you had been doing in the world.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّ الْمَوْتَ الَّذِى تَفِرُّونَ مِنْهُ فَاِنَّهُ مُلَـٰقِيكُمْ ۖ ثُمَّ تُرَدُّونَ اِلَىٰ عَـٰلِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَـٰدَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: O believers, when on Friday you are called for the prayer, hasten towards the remembrance of Allah and close your business, that this is best for you; if you know.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اِذَا نُودِىَ لِلصَّلَوٰةِ مِن يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ فَاسْعَوْاْ اِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَذَرُواْ الْبَيْعَ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ اِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: When the prayer gets over, scatter in the land and search for the bounty of Allah (sustenance) and remember Allah in abundance, perhaps like this you may get deliverance.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا قُضِيَتِ الصَّلَوٰةُ فَانتَشِرُواْ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَابْتَغُواْ مِن فَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَاذْكُرُواْ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: And O prophet, when these people see the trade and games then they run towards and leave you standing alone; Say: whatever is with Allah is much better than this game and trade, and He is the best provider of the sustenance.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا رَاَوْاْ تِجَـٰرَةً اَوْ لَهْوًا انفَضُّوٓاْ اِلَيْهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَآئِمًۭا ۚ قُلْ مَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنَ اللَّهْوِ وَمِنَ التِّجَـٰرَةِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الرَّٰزِقِينَ

verses.english_text: O prophet, these hypocrites come to you and say: we bear witness that you are the prophet of Allah, Yes, Allah Knows that you are His prophet and Allah bears witness that these hypocrites are liars in their claim.
verses.arabic_text: اِذَا جَآءَكَ الْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ قَالُواْ نَشْهَدُ اِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ اِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُ وَاللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ اِنَّ الْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ

verses.english_text: They have made their oaths their shields and they are obstructing people from the way of Allah, and these are their worst deeds which they are doing.
verses.arabic_text: اتَّخَذُوٓاْ اَيْمَـٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةًۭ فَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ اِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: This is because they believed first and then they became infidels, so their hearts have been sealed, now they are not understanding anything.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ ءَامَنُواْ ثُمَّ كَفَرُواْ فَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ

verses.english_text: And when you will look at them, their bodies will seem very good to you, and when they speak, you will listen to their words, but in reality they are like dry woods leaning against the wall, and they think every scream is against them, in fact they are enemies, beware of them, may Allah destroy them; where are they going astray.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَاِذَا رَاَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ اَجْسَامُهُمْ ۖ وَاِن يَقُولُواْ تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْ ۖ كَاَنَّهُمْ خُشُبٌۭ مُّسَنَّدَةٌۭ ۖ يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ هُمُ الْعَدُوُّ فَاحْذَرْهُمْ ۚ قَـٰتَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ ۖ اَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ

verses.english_text: And when it is said to them: come, Prophet of Allah will pray for your forgiveness, they turn aside their heads; and you will see them turning their faces in arrogance.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْاْ يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ لَوَّوْاْ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَرَاَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ

verses.english_text: It is the same for them whether you pray for their forgiveness or not, Allah is not going to forgive them that Allah does not give guidance to the evil doing nation.
verses.arabic_text: سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ اَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمْ اَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ لَن يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الْفَـٰسِقِينَ

verses.english_text: These are the people who say: do not spend anything on the companions of the Prophet of Allah so they may get scattered, although all the treasures of skies and the earth belong to Allah only, and these hypocrites do not understand this.
verses.arabic_text: هُمُ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنفِقُواْ عَلَىٰ مَنْ عِندَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ حَتَّىٰ يَنفَضُّواْ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ خَزَآئِنُ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ الْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ

verses.english_text: These people say that if we come back to Madina, then we, the honorable people will drive out these mean people; although all the Honor belongs to Allah, His Prophet and to the believers and these hypocrites even do not know this.
verses.arabic_text: يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعْنَآ اِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الْاَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الْاَذَلَّ ۚ وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ الْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: O you who believe! beware, your wealth and your children may not make you oblivious from the remembrance of Allah, and Verily whoever will do this will be counted among the losers.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُلْهِكُمْ اَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ اَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخَـٰسِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And spend in Our way from the sustenance what We have bestowed upon you, before death come to any of you and he may say, "O Lord! Why don't you give us the respite for some days so that we give charity and be counted among the good servants".
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنفِقُواْ مِن مَّا رَزَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن قَبْلِ اَن يَاْتِىَ اَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوْلَآ اَخَّرْتَنِىٓ اِلَىٰٓ اَجَلٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ فَاَصَّدَّقَ وَاَكُن مِّنَ الصَّـٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: And when the appointed time (of death) comes, Allah does not grant respite to any soul, and He is well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا اِذَا جَآءَ اَجَلُهَا ۚ وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Every particle on the earth and in the skies is glorifying Allah, to Him belongs the Kingdom and to Him belongs the Praise and He has the power over all things.
verses.arabic_text: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ ۖ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ

verses.english_text: He has created you all, then some of you are believers and some of you are disbelievers, and He is well watching your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنكُمْ كَافِرٌۭ وَمِنكُم مُّؤْمِنٌۭ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

verses.english_text: Only He has created the skies and the earth with the Truth, and has given you face and made your faces very beautiful, and then everyone has to return to Him.
verses.arabic_text: خَلَقَ السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَاَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ ۖ وَاِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: He is aware of everything of the earth and the skies; and He knows all those things which you express or which you conceal and He is also aware of the secrets of your breasts.
verses.arabic_text: يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى السَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَ مَا تُعْلِنُونَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

verses.english_text: Did not the news of those who adopted infidelity earlier come to you that they tasted the disaster of their deeds; aur for them is the painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ يَاْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُاْ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُواْ وَبَالَ اَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: That was because prophets came to them with clear signs so they said clearly, 'will a human being give us guidance', and by saying this they rejected and turned the face, Allah is also needless from them; and He is Praiseworthy and free of all wants.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُ كَانَت تَّاْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَقَالُوٓاْ اَبَشَرٌۭ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُواْ وَتَوَلَّواْ ۚ وَّاسْتَغْنَى اللَّهُ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ

verses.english_text: These infidels think that they will not be raised again, say: by my Lord, you shall be brought to life again, then (you) shall be told of all that you did, and this is very easy for Allah.
verses.arabic_text: زَعَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ اَن لَّن يُبْعَثُواْ ۚ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: Therefore, believe on Allah and His Prophet and that Light which We have sent down that Allah is well aware of your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: فَـَٔامِنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَالنُّورِ الَّذِىٓ اَنزَلْنَا ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: He will gather you all on the Day of Judgement and that will be the day of loss and gain, and the one who believes in Allah and will perform good deeds; Allah will remove his evil deeds and will admit him in those gardens beneath which rivers will be flowing, and they will abide in it forever, and this is the biggest achievement.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ الْجَمْعِ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ التَّغَابُنِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًۭا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ اَبَدًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ

verses.english_text: And those who adopted infidelity and rejected Our signs, they are the people of Hell, and shall abide therein forever; and this is their worst recompense.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ اَصْحَـٰبُ النَّارِ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: No calamity comes, but with the command of Allah and he who is a believer, Allah guides his heart; and Allah knows all things.
verses.arabic_text: مَآ اَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And you people obey Allah and obey His Prophet and if you will deviate then the duty of the prophet is nothing but to reach you the message clearly.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَطِيعُواْ اللَّهَ وَاَطِيعُواْ الرَّسُولَ ۚ فَاِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَاِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا الْبَلَـٰغُ الْمُبِينُ

verses.english_text: That is Allah and besides Him there is no god, and all the believers should have trust in Him only.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: O you who believe! among your wives and children some of them are your enemies, therefore be careful of them, and if you forgive them and overlook them, and pardon them, then Allah is also All-Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اِنَّ مِنْ اَزْوَٰجِكُمْ وَاَوْلَـٰدِكُمْ عَدُوًّۭا لَّكُمْ فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ ۚ وَاِن تَعْفُواْ وَتَصْفَحُواْ وَتَغْفِرُواْ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Your wealth and your children are source of trial for you, and Great Reward is only with Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَآ اَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَاَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌۭ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُٓ اَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Therefore, fear Allah as much as you can and listen to Him and obey and spend in the way of Allah that there is good in it for you; and those who are saved from stinginess of their own souls are those who will prosper and get deliverance.
verses.arabic_text: فَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَاسْمَعُواْ وَاَطِيعُواْ وَاَنفِقُواْ خَيْرًا لِّاَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

verses.english_text: If you will give Goodly loan to Allah, He will make it double (to your credit) and will also forgive you; and He is very Appreciative and very Forbearing.
verses.arabic_text: اِن تُقْرِضُواْ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا يُضَـٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ

verses.english_text: He is the Knower of the seen and unseen and is Honorable and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: عَـٰلِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَـٰدَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: O Prophet! When you people divorce women, divorce them according to their prescribed periods, then count their prescribed period and keep fearing Allah for He is your Lord, and do not turn them out of homes, nor they should leave themselves, unless they commit some open lewdness, these are limits of Allah and whoever will transgress limits of Allah, will be unjust to his own soul; you are not aware that perhaps Allah thereafter may bring about some new situation.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ اِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَآءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَاَحْصُواْ الْعِدَّةَ ۖ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ ۖ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنۢ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ اِلَّآ اَن يَاْتِينَ بِفَـٰحِشَةٍۢ مُّبَيِّنَةٍۢ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُ ۚ لَا تَدْرِى لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ اَمْرًا

verses.english_text: When they complete their prescribed periods, either hold them back with goodness, or bid them farewell with goodness, and for divorce make two just witnesses from among yourselves, and bear witness only for the sake of Allah; this admonition is for those who believe in Allah and on the Last Day, and for those who fears Allah, He makes the way for his deliverance.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا بَلَغْنَ اَجَلَهُنَّ فَاَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ اَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍۢ وَاَشْهِدُواْ ذَوَىْ عَدْلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ وَاَقِيمُواْ الشَّهَـٰدَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْـَٔاخِرِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًۭا

verses.english_text: And (He) provide the sustenance from such places you cannot imagine, and if anyone trust in Allah, Allah is sufficient for him, verily, Allah reaches His command, and He has specified a quantity for everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُٓ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ بَـٰلِغُ اَمْرِهِ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدْرًا

verses.english_text: And among your women who have passed the age of menstrual course and if you have any doubt then their prescribed period is three months, and likewise for the women who do not menstruate; and prescribed period for pregnant is till the delivery of child, and who fear Allah, Allah makes easy their affairs.
verses.arabic_text: وَالَّـٰٓـِٔى يَئِسْنَ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمْ اِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَـٰثَةُ اَشْهُرٍۢ وَالَّـٰٓـِٔى لَمْ يَحِضْنَ ۚ وَاُو۟لَـٰتُ الْاَحْمَالِ اَجَلُهُنَّ اَن يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مِنْ اَمْرِهِ يُسْرًا

verses.english_text: This is the command of Allah which He has sent down towards you, and who fear Allah, Allah removes his evils, and increases his reward.
verses.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ اَمْرُ اللَّهِ اَنزَلَهُٓ اِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُٓ اَجْرًا

verses.english_text: And provide residence to the divorcee (during the prescribed period) as per your capacity and do not torment them so as to make them suffer; and if they are pregnant provide them the expenses until the delivery of child; and if they suckle your children then give them wages and decide it with mutual understanding that is just and reasonable, and if there is discord among you then give chance to other woman for suckling.
verses.arabic_text: اَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُواْ عَلَيْهِنَّ ۚ وَاِن كُنَّ اُو۟لَـٰتِ حَمْلٍۢ فَاَنفِقُواْ عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ فَاِنْ اَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ اُجُورَهُنَّ ۖ وَاْتَمِرُواْ بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفٍۢ ۖ وَاِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُٓ اُخْرَىٰ

verses.english_text: Let the rich man spend according to his capacity, and the man whose sustenance is strait, let him spend according to what Allah has given him; Allah does not trouble any Self beyond what he can bear; Allah will shortly grant vastness after straitness.
verses.arabic_text: لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍۢ مِّن سَعَتِهِ ۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ اللَّهُ ۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا اِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَا ۚ سَيَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍۢ يُسْرًا

verses.english_text: And how many settlements are there who disobeyed the Command of Allah and His Prophet, so We took severe account of them and afflicted them in the worst punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَاَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِ فَحَاسَبْنَـٰهَا حِسَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَعَذَّبْنَـٰهَا عَذَابًۭا نُّكْرًا

verses.english_text: Then did they taste the evil result of their conduct, and the final recompense is loss only.
verses.arabic_text: فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ اَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ اَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا

verses.english_text: Allah has prepared the severest type of punishment for them; therefore, O you who believe and O you men of understanding, fear Allah that He has sent down His remembrance towards you.
verses.arabic_text: اَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا ۖ فَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ يَـٰٓاُو۟لِى الْاَلْبَـٰبِ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ۚ قَدْ اَنزَلَ اللَّهُ اِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًا

verses.english_text: That Prophet who recites the explicit verses of Allah to bring out the believers and good doers from the darkness towards the light; and who will have faith on Allah and will do good deeds, Allah will enter him into the gardens beneath which rivers will be flowing, they shall abide in it forever, and Allah has bestowed upon them this, the excellent sustenance.
verses.arabic_text: رَّسُولًۭا يَتْلُواْ عَلَيْكُمْ اٰيٰتِ اللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ لِّيُخْرِجَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ الصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ مِنَ الظُّلُمَـٰتِ اِلَى النُّورِ ۚ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًۭا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ اَبَدًۭا ۖ قَدْ اَحْسَنَ اللَّهُ لَهُ رِزْقًا

verses.english_text: That is Allah who created the seven skies, and likewise created earths within the earth in same numbers, His commands descend between them that you must know He has power over all things, and that His Knowledge has encircled everything.
verses.arabic_text: اللَّهُ الَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍۢ وَمِنَ الْاَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ الْاَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوٓاْ اَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ وَاَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ اَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۢا

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Why are you withholding yourself from what Allah has made lawful for you, are you desirous of pleasing your wives; Allah is All-Forgiving and Most Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ اَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِى مَرْضَاتَ اَزْوَٰجِكَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: Allah has obliged that you end your oaths by giving expiation, and Allah is your Master, and He is the Knower of all things and has Wisdom.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ اَيْمَـٰنِكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ

verses.english_text: When Prophet disclosed a matter to one of his wives in confidence and she divulged it to the other (wife) and Allah made this known to the Prophet, so Prophet told some matters to her and withheld some; then when he told her, she asked: who told you this, so prophet said: Allah is all Knower and all Aware.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذْ اَسَرَّ النَّبِىُّ اِلَىٰ بَعْضِ اَزْوَٰجِهِ حَدِيثًۭا فَلَمَّا نَبَّاَتْ بِهِ وَاَظْهَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُ وَاَعْرَضَ عَنۢ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّاَهَا بِهِ قَالَتْ مَنْ اَنۢبَاَكَ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَ نَبَّاَنِىَ الْعَلِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ

verses.english_text: Now both of you seek repentance, crookedness has developed in your hearts, otherwise if you will back up each other against him, then remember, Allah is his Guardian and Gabriel, and righteous believers and angels all are his helpers.
verses.arabic_text: اِن تَتُوبَآ اِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖ وَاِن تَظَـٰهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَاِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَـٰلِحُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَالْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ

verses.english_text: Even if he divorces you (all), Allah will provide him better wives in your place, submissive, believers, obedient, repentant, worshipper, fasting ones, virgin and non-virgin, all.
verses.arabic_text: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُٓ اِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ اَن يُبْدِلَهُٓ اَزْوَٰجًا خَيْرًا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَـٰتٍۢ مُّؤْمِنَـٰتٍۢ قَـٰنِتَـٰتٍۢ تَـٰٓئِبَـٰتٍ عَـٰبِدَٰتٍۢ سَـٰٓئِحَـٰتٍۢ ثَيِّبَـٰتٍۢ وَاَبْكَارًا

verses.english_text: O you who believe, save yourselves and your families from this fire whose fuel will be human and stones, over which those angels will be appointed who are stern and harsh in temperament, and who do not oppose the command of Allah; and they obey the command that is given to them.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قُوٓاْ اَنفُسَكُمْ وَاَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌۭ شِدَادٌۭ لَّا يَعْصُونَ اللَّهَ مَآ اَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And O you who adopted infidelity, today do not present any excuse, today you will be punished for your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَعْتَذِرُواْ الْيَوْمَ ۖ اِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: O you who believe, repent sincerely, shortly your Lord will remove your evil and will admit you in such Paradises beneath which rivers will be flowing; that Day Allah will not allow His prophet and the believers to be disgraced, their light shall be walking ahead of them and on their right side; and they will say: O Allah, complete our light for us and forgive us that verily You have Power over all things.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ تُوبُوٓاْ اِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةًۭ نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ اَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَـٰرُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِى اللَّهُ النَّبِىَّ وَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُ ۖ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَىٰ بَيْنَ اَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِاَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ اَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَآ ۖ اِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: O Prophet, struggle hard against infidels and hypocrites and be stern with them, and their abode is Hell and that is the worst consequence.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ جَـٰهِدِ الْكُفَّارَ وَالْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَاغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَمَاْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: Those who adopted infidelity, Allah has described the example of wife of Nooh and wife of Lut for they both were under the marriage of our righteous servants, but they betrayed them (their husbands); therefore, their marriage (with the prophets) did not benefit them in the Presence of Allah, and they were told: you also enter the Hell along with other Hellish people.
verses.arabic_text: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ امْرَاَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَامْرَاَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ادْخُلَا النَّارَ مَعَ الدَّٰخِلِينَ

verses.english_text: And Allah has narrated the example of Firaun's wife for the believers, that she prayed: O Lord, build for me a house in the Paradise and deliver me from the doings of Firaun and deliver me from this entire unjust nation.
verses.arabic_text: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ امْرَاَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ اِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And the instance of Maryam, daughter of Imran who guarded her chastity, so We blew Our Spirit in her, and she testified the words of her Lord, and confirmed the books, and she was among Our obedient servants.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَٰنَ الَّتِىٓ اَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَـٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْقَـٰنِتِينَ

verses.english_text: Blessed is He in whose hands is the entire Kingdom; and He has power over all things.
verses.arabic_text: تَبَـٰرَكَ الَّذِى بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ

verses.english_text: He has created death and life so that He may try you that who is better among you with regards to the deed, and He is also Honorable and Forgiving.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِى خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ اَيُّكُمْ اَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفُورُ

verses.english_text: He has created seven skies one over another, and you will not see any difference in creation of the Beneficent, then look up again do you see any crack?
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِن تَفَـٰوُتٍۢ ۖ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍۢ

verses.english_text: Thereafter, look again and again, your sight will return to you tiredly, but you will not see any flaw.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ اِلَيْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًۭا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: And We have beautified the world's sky with the lamps, and made them the source for stoning the satans, and have also prepared punishment of Hell separately for them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَآءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَـٰطِينِ ۖ وَاَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيرِ

verses.english_text: And those who deny their Lord there is punishment of Hell for them and that is the worst result.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ

verses.english_text: When they will be cast therein (they) will listen to its cries, and it will be blazing forth.
verses.arabic_text: اِذَآ اُلْقُواْ فِيهَا سَمِعُواْ لَهَا شَهِيقًۭا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ

verses.english_text: Rather, it will be nearing that with intensity of flaring it may burst up; whenever any group will be cast into it, its wardens will ask them: had no warner come to you?
verses.arabic_text: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ اُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌۭ سَاَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ اَلَمْ يَاْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: So they will say, he did come to us, but we denied him and said: Allah never sent down anything; you people are yourselves in great misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ اِنْ اَنتُمْ اِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ

verses.english_text: And then they will say: if we would have heard and understood, today we would not have been among the Hellish people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ اَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ اَصْحَـٰبِ السَّعِيرِ

verses.english_text: So they have confessed to their sins, now people of Hell are far away from the Mercy of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: فَاعْتَرَفُواْ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًۭا لِّاَصْحَـٰبِ السَّعِيرِ

verses.english_text: Verily, as for those who fear their Lord without seeing Him, there is forgiveness and great reward for them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَاَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ

verses.english_text: Whether you talk slowly or talk loudly, Allah is even aware of the secrets of your breasts.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَسِرُّواْ قَوْلَكُمْ اَوِ اجْهَرُواْ بِهِٓ ۖ اِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

verses.english_text: And did the Creator not know? While He is also Subtle and also All-Aware.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ

verses.english_text: It is He who made the earth soft for you, that you walk on its sides and search for the sustenance of Allah; then rising from the graves have to return towards Him.
verses.arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَامْشُواْ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُواْ مِن رِّزْقِهِ ۖ وَاِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ

verses.english_text: Have you become complacent from the One who Rule the sky, that He will cause the earth to swallow you up, and it keep you rotating.
verses.arabic_text: ءَاَمِنتُم مَّن فِى السَّمَآءِ اَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْاَرْضَ فَاِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ

verses.english_text: Or do you feel secure from it that He will not send shower of stones on you; then you will very shortly know how is My warning.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ اَمِنتُم مَّن فِى السَّمَآءِ اَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ

verses.english_text: And people before them have also denied, then see how terrifying their result was.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

verses.english_text: Did not they observe the birds over themselves, who spread and wind up their wings, no one can uphold them in the atmosphere except Allah; and He is the Guardian over all things.
verses.arabic_text: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ اِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٍۢ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ اِلَّا الرَّحْمَـٰنُ ۚ اِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ

verses.english_text: Is this who is made up like your army can help you against Allah? Indeed, infidels are in delusion.
verses.arabic_text: اَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ اِنِ الْكَـٰفِرُونَ اِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ

verses.english_text: Or can he give you sustenance if Allah withhold His provisions, fact is that they are drowned in utter disobedience and hate.
verses.arabic_text: اَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ اِنْ اَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُ ۚ بَل لَّجُّواْ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ

verses.english_text: Does the person who walks on his face is more guided; or the person who walks upright on the straight path?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِٓ اَهْدَىٰٓ اَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Say: "It is Allah Who has created you and He has given you ears, eyes and heart, but you are very less grateful".
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِىٓ اَنشَاَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَـٰرَ وَالْاَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Say: "That He is the one who has spread you in the earth, and you will be gathered and taken towards Him".
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِى ذَرَاَكُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَاِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

verses.english_text: And these people say if you are truthful then when will this promise be perfected?
verses.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: Say: "Knowledge is with Allah and I am only a clear warner."
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَاِنَّمَآ اَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then, when they will see the punishment of the Day of Judgement approaching the infidels' faces will be defaced, and it will be said to them: this is the punishment what you wanted.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَاَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا الَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِ تَدَّعُونَ

verses.english_text: Say: Do you think Allah will destroy me and my companions or have Mercy on us; then who is there to protect these infidels from the painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِنْ اَهْلَكَنِىَ اللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ اَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ اَلِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Say: That is Beneficent Allah in whom we have believed and in Whom we trust, so shortly you will know who is in manifest misguidance.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Say: what you think if all your water is absorbed underground then who will bring flowing water in rivers for you.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِنْ اَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَاْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ

verses.english_text: Noon and Pen, and swear by what they inscribe.
verses.arabic_text: نٓ ۚ وَالْقَلَمِ وَ مَا يَسْطُرُونَ

verses.english_text: You, by the Grace of your Lord are not mad.
verses.arabic_text: مَآ اَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍۢ

verses.english_text: And for you is a never-ending reward.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّ لَكَ لَاَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍۢ

verses.english_text: And you are of the highest degree of morality.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Soon you will also see, and they will also see.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: That who is madman.
verses.arabic_text: بِاَييِّكُمُ الْمَفْتُونُ

verses.english_text: Your Lord knows best that who has deviated from His Path and who has been guided.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ

verses.english_text: Therefore, do not obey those who deny.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: They desire that you become soft, so they also become soft.
verses.arabic_text: وَدُّواْ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And beware you (do not obey) any worthless persistent swearer; mean,
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍۢ مَّهِينٍ

verses.english_text: Who always find faults, and high-level backbiters;
verses.arabic_text: هَمَّازٍۢ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: Very stingy, transgressor and sinner;
verses.arabic_text: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ اَثِيمٍ

verses.english_text: Ill-tempered and thereafter do not obey a person of a bad lineage.
verses.arabic_text: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ

verses.english_text: Only because they have wealth and children.
verses.arabic_text: اَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ

verses.english_text: When Divine Verses are recited before them, then he says: these are stories of the earlier people.
verses.arabic_text: اِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ اٰيٰتُنَا قَالَ اَسَـٰطِيرُ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: Shortly, We will brand over his nose.
verses.arabic_text: سَنَسِمُهُ عَلَى الْخُرْطُومِ

verses.english_text: We tried them in the same way as We had tried the people of the garden; when they swore that they would pluck the fruits in the morning.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ اَصْحَـٰبَ الْجَنَّةِ اِذْ اَقْسَمُواْ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ

verses.english_text: And they will not say 'Allah willing'.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ

verses.english_text: So, during the night an affliction from the Lord encompassed them when they were asleep.
verses.arabic_text: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And the whole garden burnt and became like black night.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَصْبَحَتْ كَالصَّرِيمِ

verses.english_text: Then in the morning one called out to another.
verses.arabic_text: فَتَنَادَوْاْ مُصْبِحِينَ

verses.english_text: That if fruits are to be plucked then let's go towards our field.
verses.arabic_text: اَنِ اغْدُواْ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ اِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Then they all went in a way that they were conversing secretly among themselves.
verses.arabic_text: فَانطَلَقُواْ وَهُمْ يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ

verses.english_text: That, beware, no poor man should enter the garden today.
verses.arabic_text: اَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌۭ

verses.english_text: And after arranging the prevention they reached the garden in the morning.
verses.arabic_text: وَغَدَوْاْ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍۢ قَـٰدِرِينَ

verses.english_text: Now, when they saw the garden, they said we have strayed.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَاَوْهَا قَالُوٓاْ اِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ

verses.english_text: Rather we have become deprived of everything.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ

verses.english_text: So the moderate among them said: Did not I tell you why you do not glorify Allah?
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ اَوْسَطُهُمْ اَلَمْ اَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: Our Lord is Pure and Self-Sufficient and we truly were unjust.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Then they started reproaching each other.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَلَـٰوَمُونَ

verses.english_text: They said: Alas! We were totally rebellious.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ اِنَّا كُنَّا طَـٰغِينَ

verses.english_text: Perhaps, our Lord may give us better than this; we are allured towards Him.
verses.arabic_text: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ اَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ اِنَّآ اِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ

verses.english_text: Punishment comes down like this and the punishment of the Hereafter is greater than this, if they knew.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ الْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ الْـَٔاخِرَةِ اَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُواْ يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily for the pious people there is Paradise full of favors with their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ النَّعِيمِ

verses.english_text: Should We make the obedient like the sinners.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَنَجْعَلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَالْمُجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: What has happened to you; how you are judging.
verses.arabic_text: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ

verses.english_text: Or do you have any of your books from which you read.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ لَكُمْ كِتٰبٌۭ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ

verses.english_text: That everything will be made available to you of your liking over there.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: Or have you taken oaths from Us till the Day of Judgement that you will get everything for which you will decide.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ لَكُمْ اَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ اِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ اِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ

verses.english_text: Ask them who is responsible for all these talks.
verses.arabic_text: سَلْهُمْ اَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ

verses.english_text: Or do they have partners; let them bring their partners if they are truthful.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَاْتُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ اِن كَانُواْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.english_text: The day shin shall be uncovered and they will be invited for prostration, and they will not even be able to prostrate.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍۢ وَيُدْعَوْنَ اِلَى السُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

verses.english_text: Their eyes shall be cast down with shame, humiliation would have covered them, and at that time also they were being invited for the prostration when they were healthy and sound.
verses.arabic_text: خَـٰشِعَةً اَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ وَ قَدْ كَانُواْ يُدْعَوْنَ اِلَى السُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ

verses.english_text: So now leave Me and the deniers of this talk alone, soon We will arrest them in such a way that they won't be able to perceive.
verses.arabic_text: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And We are giving them respite because Our strategy is strong.
verses.arabic_text: وَاُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ اِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ

verses.english_text: Are you asking them wages that they are under the burden with this ransom.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ اَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Or they have some unseen which they are writing.
verses.arabic_text: اَمْ عِندَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

verses.english_text: Now wait with patience for the command of your Lord, and do not be like Man of Whale when he had called out in a very angry tone.
verses.arabic_text: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ الْحُوتِ اِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌۭ

verses.english_text: That if the favor of Allah would not have supported him, then he would have been left in bad condition in a desolate barren land.
verses.arabic_text: لَّوْلَآ اَن تَدَٰرَكَهُ نِعْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِ لَنُبِذَ بِالْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous ones.
verses.arabic_text: فَاجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُ فَجَعَلَهُ مِنَ الصَّـٰلِحِينَ

verses.english_text: And these infidels when they listen to Quran it seems soon they will slide you with their eyes (with hatred) and then they say that he is a madman.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِن يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِاَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ الذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ اِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ

verses.english_text: Although this Quran is an admonition for the worlds, and that's it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Verily, the Day of Judgement is inevitable.
verses.arabic_text: الْحَآقَّةُ

verses.english_text: And what is the inevitable.
verses.arabic_text: مَا الْحَآقَّةُ

verses.english_text: And what do you know about the sure inevitable reality? which is going to happen.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَدْرَىٰكَ مَا الْحَآقَّةُ

verses.english_text: Nations of Samood and Aad had denied the Knocker (Day of Judgement).
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِالْقَارِعَةِ

verses.english_text: So as for Samood, they were destroyed by the sound of a colossal roar.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَاُهْلِكُواْ بِالطَّاغِيَةِ

verses.english_text: And Aad were destroyed through a very fierce gale.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَاُهْلِكُواْ بِرِيحٍۢ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍۢ

verses.english_text: Which Allah made to prevail over them for seven nights and eight days successively, that you are observing the nation is lying dead, as if they are hollow trunks of palm trees.
verses.arabic_text: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ اَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى الْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَاَنَّهُمْ اَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ

verses.english_text: So do you see any of their parts which has remained.
verses.arabic_text: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍۢ

verses.english_text: And Firaun, and those before him; people of the overturned settlements, they all committed mistakes.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُ وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِالْخَاطِئَةِ

verses.english_text: That they disobeyed the messengers of Lord, so the Lord caught them with the strong grip.
verses.arabic_text: فَعَصَوْاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَاَخَذَهُمْ اَخْذَةًۭ رَّابِيَةً

verses.english_text: We lifted you upon the ship at the time when water was rising above the head.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا الْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى الْجَارِيَةِ

verses.english_text: So that (We) make it an admonition for you, and ear that preserves may listen.
verses.arabic_text: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَتَعِيَهَآ اُذُنٌۭ وَٰعِيَةٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then when the trumpet will be blown for the first time.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا نُفِخَ فِى الصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ

verses.english_text: And the earth and mountains shall be uprooted, collided, and shall be turned into fragments.
verses.arabic_text: وَحُمِلَتِ الْاَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ

verses.english_text: So, then the Day of Judgement will occur.
verses.arabic_text: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ

verses.english_text: And the skies will crack up and become very soft.
verses.arabic_text: وَانشَقَّتِ السَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاهِيَةٌۭ

verses.english_text: And angels will be on its sides, and on that day Divine Throne will be carried by eight angels.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ اَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌۭ

verses.english_text: That day you would be brought to a conspicuous place; and nothing of your talk will be hidden.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌۭ

verses.english_text: Then he who will be given book of deeds in his right hand will say to all: just read my book of deeds.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّا مَنْ اُوتِىَ كِتٰبَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ اقْرَءُواْ كِتٰبِيَهْ

verses.english_text: I knew before that reckoning of mine will be given to me one day.
verses.arabic_text: اِنِّى ظَنَنتُ اَنِّى مُلَـٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ

verses.english_text: Then he will be in his favorite life.
verses.arabic_text: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ

verses.english_text: In the highest gardens.
verses.arabic_text: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ

verses.english_text: Therein fruits will be nearby (within reach).
verses.arabic_text: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌۭ

verses.english_text: Now eat and drink with ease that during the days bygone you have arranged for these blessings.
verses.arabic_text: كُلُواْ وَاشْرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ اَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى الْاَيَّامِ الْخَالِيَةِ

verses.english_text: But he who will be given the book of deeds in left hand, will say: I wish this book of deeds was not given to me.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمَّا مَنْ اُوتِىَ كِتٰبَهُ بِشِمَالِهِ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ اُوتَ كِتٰبِيَهْ

verses.english_text: And I would not have known my reckoning.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمْ اَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ

verses.english_text: I wish this death would have been my end.
verses.arabic_text: يَـٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ الْقَاضِيَةَ

verses.english_text: My wealth is also of no use to me.
verses.arabic_text: مَآ اَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ

verses.english_text: And my authority has also been ruined.
verses.arabic_text: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَـٰنِيَهْ

verses.english_text: Now seize him and arrest him.
verses.arabic_text: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ

verses.english_text: Then throw him into Hell.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ

verses.english_text: Then fasten him in a chain of seventy yards.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍۢ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًۭا فَاسْلُكُوهُ

verses.english_text: He did not believe in the Great Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ

verses.english_text: And had not encouraged people to feed the destitute.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ

verses.english_text: He does not have a friend here today.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ الْيَوْمَ هَـٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: And there is no food except puss.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا طَعَامٌ اِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Which none can eat except the sinners.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا يَاْكُلُهُٓ اِلَّا الْخَـٰطِـُٔونَ

verses.english_text: I swear also by whom you are seeing.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَآ اُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: And I swear also by whom you are not seeing.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

verses.english_text: That this is the statement of a respected angel.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: And this is not the word of any poet, yea you believe very less.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And this is not a word of any soothsayer on which you ponder very little.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.english_text: This is sent down by the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.arabic_text: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: And if this messenger would forge any word from Us.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ الْاَقَاوِيلِ

verses.english_text: So We would have seized his hand.
verses.arabic_text: لَاَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِالْيَمِينِ

verses.english_text: And then would have decapacitated him.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ الْوَتِينَ

verses.english_text: Then no one among you would have stopped Me.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ اَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ

verses.english_text: And this Quran is an admonition for the pious people.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّهُ لَتَذْكِرَةٌۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

verses.english_text: And We know there are deniers also among you.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ اَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: And this is cause of regret for the disbelievers.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّهُ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى الْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.english_text: And this is entirely definite fact.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنَّهُ لَحَقُّ الْيَقِينِ

verses.english_text: Hence, glorify the name of your Great Lord.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ

verses.english_text: A questioner asked for the chastisement which was to befall.
verses.arabic_text: سَاَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍۢ وَاقِعٍۢ

verses.english_text: Which no one could have ward off for the disbelievers.
verses.arabic_text: لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَافِعٌۭ

verses.english_text: This is from Allah. Lord of the Heights.
verses.arabic_text: مِّنَ اللَّهِ ذِى الْمَعَارِجِ

verses.english_text: Towards which angels and the Spirit ascend in a day whose measure is equal to fifty thousand years.
verses.arabic_text: تَعْرُجُ الْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ اِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ اَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ

verses.english_text: Hence, you use your best patience.
verses.arabic_text: فَاصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا

verses.english_text: They think it to be far away.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيدًۭا

verses.english_text: And We are seeing it near only.
verses.arabic_text: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًۭا

verses.english_text: When the sky will become like molten copper.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ السَّمَآءُ كَالْمُهْلِ

verses.english_text: And mountains like fine wool.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ

verses.english_text: And no friend will ask about the condition of friend.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: They will be shown to one another, so the sinner will desire his children is taken in exchange of torment of today.
verses.arabic_text: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ

verses.english_text: And to wife and brother.
verses.arabic_text: وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِ وَاَخِيهِ

verses.english_text: And to the clan in which he had resided.
verses.arabic_text: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ الَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ

verses.english_text: And to all creatures of the earth and he be given deliverance.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَن فِى الْاَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ

verses.english_text: Never ever, it is the fire of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّآ ۖ اِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ

verses.english_text: Peeler of the skin.
verses.arabic_text: نَزَّاعَةًۭ لِّلشَّوَىٰ

verses.english_text: Calling to all of them, who were going turning away their faces.
verses.arabic_text: تَدْعُواْ مَنْ اَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

verses.english_text: Who had kept close the wealth after amassing it.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَمَعَ فَاَوْعَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Verily man is very greedy.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اِنَّ الْاِنسَـٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا

verses.english_text: When trouble touches him, he becomes the complainant.
verses.arabic_text: اِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ جَزُوعًۭا

verses.english_text: And when gets the wealth becomes stingy.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا مَسَّهُ الْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا

verses.english_text: Except those who pray.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا الْمُصَلِّينَ

verses.english_text: Who are regular in their prayers.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And in the wealth of those a portion is fixed.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ فِىٓ اَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ

verses.english_text: (For) those who ask, and (for) those who do not ask.
verses.arabic_text: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ

verses.english_text: And those who verify the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ

verses.english_text: And those who fear the chastisement of their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

verses.english_text: Indeed, the chastisement of the Lord is not something to be considered safe from.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَاْمُونٍۢ

verses.english_text: And those who guard their private parts.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ

verses.english_text: Except their wives and slave girls, that they are not to be blamed for this.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ اَزْوَٰجِهِمْ اَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَاِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ

verses.english_text: Then if he who wishes apart from this, he is transgressor.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who respect for their trust and covenants.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ لِاَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ

verses.english_text: And those stand firm on their testimonies.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَـٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ

verses.english_text: And those who uphold their prayers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ

verses.english_text: These are the people who will abide respectfully in Paradise.
verses.arabic_text: اُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍۢ مُّكْرَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Then what has happened to these infidels who are rushing towards you.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَالِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ

verses.english_text: From right and left, in the groups.
verses.arabic_text: عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ

verses.english_text: Does everyone among them desire that they be entered into Paradise of bliss.
verses.arabic_text: اَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ اَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ

verses.english_text: No way, they know from what thing We have created them.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّآ ۖ اِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: I swear by the Lord of all the Easts and the Wests that We are Powerful.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَآ اُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ الْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَالْمَغَـٰرِبِ اِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ

verses.english_text: On the matter that We substitute them with better people and we are not incapable.
verses.arabic_text: عَلَىٰٓ اَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

verses.english_text: Therefore, leave them alone, let them be immersed in their falsehood, and let them play until they meet the Day which has been promised.
verses.arabic_text: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلْعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُواْ يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

verses.english_text: The day when they will hastily come out of the graves, as if they are rushing towards any flag.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْاَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَاَنَّهُمْ اِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ

verses.english_text: Their eyes will be downcast, and disgrace will have covered them; this will be the Day which has been promised to them.
verses.arabic_text: خَـٰشِعَةً اَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الَّذِى كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, We sent Nooh towards his nation so that he may warn his nation before the coming of the painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا اِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِٓ اَنْ اَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ اَن يَاْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۭ

verses.english_text: He said: "O nation, I am a clear warner to you."
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ اِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

verses.english_text: That they worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.
verses.arabic_text: اَنِ اعْبُدُواْ اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَاَطِيعُونِ

verses.english_text: He will forgive your sins and will keep you alive until an appointed term; when the time will come in cannot be averted, if you know anything.
verses.arabic_text: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ اِلَىٰٓ اَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ اِنَّ اَجَلَ اللَّهِ اِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: He said: O Lord, I called my nation during the day and at night also.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًا

verses.english_text: Even then the effect of my invitation was nothing except that they escaped.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ اِلَّا فِرَارًا

verses.english_text: And whenever I invited them that you forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears and covered themselves with their garments, and were obstinate in their talk, and were very haughty.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓاْ اَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْاْ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَاَصَرُّواْ وَاسْتَكْبَرُواْ اسْتِكْبَارًا

verses.english_text: Then I invited them openly.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا

verses.english_text: Then I announced, and I invited them secretly also.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِنِّىٓ اَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَاَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ اِسْرَارًا

verses.english_text: And said: seek forgiveness from your Lord, He is most forgiver.
verses.arabic_text: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمْ اِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّارًا

verses.english_text: He will rain upon you continuously.
verses.arabic_text: يُرْسِلِ السَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا

verses.english_text: And will help you with the wealth and children and will bestow upon you gardens and the rivers.
verses.arabic_text: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِاَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ اَنْهَـٰرًا

verses.english_text: What is wrong with you, why do you not consider the Greatness of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا

verses.english_text: Whereas He has created you in a different way.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ اَطْوَارًا

verses.english_text: Haven't you seen that Allah has made seven skies layer over layer.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَوْاْ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا

verses.english_text: And has made the moon a light among them and the sun a bright lamp.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًۭا

verses.english_text: And Allah has created you from the earth.
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ اَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ نَبَاتًۭا

verses.english_text: Then He will take you into it, then will bring out in new shape.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ اِخْرَاجًۭا

verses.english_text: And Allah has made the earth for you a carpet.
verses.arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ بِسَاطًۭا

verses.english_text: That you may walk on it in the spacious roads.
verses.arabic_text: لِّتَسْلُكُواْ مِنْهَا سُبُلًۭا فِجَاجًۭا

verses.english_text: And Nooh said: O Lord, they have disobeyed me and followed him who can give nothing except loss in wealth and children.
verses.arabic_text: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ اِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَاتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُٓ اِلَّا خَسَارًا

verses.english_text: And they have devised great plotting.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا

verses.english_text: And said to the people do not leave your gods and do not neglect Wadd, Suwa, Yaghoos, Yaooq and Nasr.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالُواْ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا

verses.english_text: They misguided many, so now You do not increase anything for wrong-doers but destruction.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَدْ اَضَلُّواْ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ اِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًۭا

verses.english_text: They were all drowned for their wrongdoings, then were entered into Hell, and they did not find any helper instead of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ اُغْرِقُواْ فَاُدْخِلُواْ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ اَنصَارًا

verses.english_text: And Nooh said, O Lord, do not leave any disbeliever who abides on this earth.
verses.arabic_text: وَقَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْاَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَـٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا

verses.english_text: If You will leave them, they will misguide your servants, and they will not have any children except disbelievers and transgressors.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّكَ اِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓاْ اِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا

verses.english_text: O Lord, forgive me and my parents and those who enter my house with belief and all the believing men and women; and do not increase into anything for wrongdoers but in destruction.
verses.arabic_text: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ اِلَّا تَبَارًۢا

verses.english_text: O Prophet! Say: this has been revealed to me, that a party of Jinns listened to the Quran. They said that we have heard a very strange Quran.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اُوحِىَ اِلَىَّ اَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ اِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا

verses.english_text: Which admonishes for the good, we have believed in it and will not make anyone partner with our Lord.
verses.arabic_text: يَهْدِىٓ اِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ اَحَدًۭا

verses.english_text: Glory of our Lord is very high; he has neither taken anyone as his wife nor his son.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّهُ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And foolish people among us are talking uselessly.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًۭا

verses.english_text: And we only thought that men and jinns will not speak lies against Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ اَن لَّن تَقُولَ الْاِنسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا

verses.english_text: And that some men were seeking refuge from some jinns, so they increased them in arresting.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌۭ مِّنَ الْاِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍۢ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًۭا

verses.english_text: And that like you they were also of the view that Allah will not bring anyone to life again.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ اَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ اَحَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And when we saw the sky and found it filled with the stringent guards and flaming fire.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَشُهُبًۭا

verses.english_text: And earlier we used to listen to the talk in some places; but now if anyone wishes to listen, he will find fire prepared for him.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ الْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَابًۭا رَّصَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And we do not know whether evil is meant for the dwellers of earth by this; or any goodness is intended.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ اَشَرٌّ اُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى الْاَرْضِ اَمْ اَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And there are some of good character among us and some are otherwise, and we are different parties.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّا مِنَّا الصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And we are of the view that on the earth we cannot humble Allah, and neither can we humble Him in escaping from His grip.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ اَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ اللَّهَ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُ هَرَبًۭا

verses.english_text: And when we listened to the guidance we believed, and now whoever will believe on his Lord will not have the fear of loss, cruelty, and oppression.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًۭا وَلَا رَهَقًۭا

verses.english_text: And some are obedient among us and some are disobedient, and whoever will be obedient has found the path of guidance.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَـٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ اَسْلَمَ فَاُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْاْ رَشَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And the disobedient will be the fuel of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمَّا الْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًۭا

verses.english_text: And if they would all have been on the path of guidance; We would have satiated them with the abundant water.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَلَّوِ اسْتَقَـٰمُواْ عَلَى الطَّرِيقَةِ لَاَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًۭا

verses.english_text: So that We could test them, and whoever will turn aside from the reminder of Allah will have to walk on the path of stringent punishment.
verses.arabic_text: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًۭا صَعَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And the mosques are for Allah, therefore do not worship anyone other than Him.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّ الْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُواْ مَعَ اللَّهِ اَحَدًۭا

verses.english_text: And that when the servant of Allah stands for worshipping it was nearly that people would crowd around him and fall.
verses.arabic_text: وَاَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًۭا

verses.english_text: O Prophet say, that I worship only my Lord, and do not make anyone partners with Him.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنَّمَآ اَدْعُواْ رَبِّى وَلَآ اُشْرِكُ بِهِٓ اَحَدًۭا

verses.english_text: Say, I neither have power for any evil nor good for you.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنِّى لَآ اَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا رَشَدًۭا

verses.english_text: Say, even for me also there is no one to save me against Allah, and nor I find any refuge.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ اللَّهِ اَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ اَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا

verses.english_text: But that I convey the commandments and message of my Lord, and there is Hell for whoever is disobedient of Allah and His Prophet, and he will abide in it forever.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا بَلَـٰغًۭا مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَاِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ اَبَدًا

verses.english_text: When they see the punishment, which was promised to them; then they will realize that whose helpers are weak and whose number is less.
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ اِذَا رَاَوْاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ اَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَاَقَلُّ عَدَدًۭا

verses.english_text: Say, I do not know whether that promise is near, or Allah will appoint another term also.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اِنْ اَدْرِىٓ اَقَرِيبٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ اَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّىٓ اَمَدًا

verses.english_text: He is the Knower of the unseen, and He does not reveal His unseen to anyone.
verses.arabic_text: عَـٰلِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِٓ اَحَدًا

verses.english_text: Except to the Prophet whom he chooses; He appoints the guarding angels from front and from behind him.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ فَاِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَدًۭا

verses.english_text: So that He sees that they have delivered the messages of their Lord, and whoever has whatever, He dominates over it; and He has reckoning of all the numbers.
verses.arabic_text: لِّيَعْلَمَ اَن قَدْ اَبْلَغُواْ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَاَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَاَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا

verses.english_text: O you who wrapped up in garment.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْمُزَّمِّلُ

verses.english_text: Rise up during the night but little less.
verses.arabic_text: قُمِ الَّيْلَ اِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Half the night or even less than that.
verses.arabic_text: نِّصْفَهُٓ اَوِ انقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا

verses.english_text: Or add to it and read the Quran slowly (and) regularly.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا

verses.english_text: We are shortly going to reveal a serious commandment on you.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًۭا ثَقِيلًا

verses.english_text: Verily rising up during the night is the best way for trampling on the Self, and it is the best time for mentioning (Allah).
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ الَّيْلِ هِىَ اَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَاَقْوَمُ قِيلًا

verses.english_text: Verily for you during the day there is lots of busyness.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ لَكَ فِى النَّهَارِ سَبْحًۭا طَوِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And mention the name of your Lord; and devote yourself to Him only.
verses.arabic_text: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ اِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: He is Lord of the East and West, and there is no god but He, therefore make him only as your guardian.
verses.arabic_text: رَّبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ لَآ اِلَـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Have patience with whatever these people are saying and separate them nicely from you.
verses.arabic_text: وَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And leave me to deal with those wealthy who reject and give them some respite.
verses.arabic_text: وَذَرْنِى وَالْمُكَذِّبِينَ اُو۟لِى النَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا

verses.english_text: We have got fetters and flaming fire for them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ اَنكَالًۭا وَجَحِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: And food which sticks in the throat, and painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: وَطَعَامًۭا ذَا غُصَّةٍۢ وَعَذَابًا اَلِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: When the earth and the mountains will tremble and the mountains will become a heap of sand.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الْاَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ الْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًۭا مَّهِيلًا

verses.english_text: Verily, We have sent a Prophet towards you as a witness, like Prophet was sent towards Firaun.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَآ اِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ اَرْسَلْنَآ اِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا

verses.english_text: So Firaun disobeyed the prophet, so We took in him in Our clutches.
verses.arabic_text: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ الرَّسُولَ فَاَخَذْنَـٰهُ اَخْذًۭا وَبِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Then if you also will disbelieve how will save yourself on the Day which will make children the aged ones.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ اِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًۭا يَجْعَلُ الْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا

verses.english_text: That day the sky will rend and this promise after all is going to be fulfilled.
verses.arabic_text: السَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَفْعُولًا

verses.english_text: These in fact are the talk of lesson and admonition and whoever wishes may adopt the path of his Lord.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا

verses.english_text: Your Lord knows that you stand nearly for two-third of night (sometime) half of it or (sometime) one-third of the night, along with you there is another group, and Allah keep the correct measure of the day and the night, and He knows that you people will not be able to do this correctly, so he showed beneficence on you, now read Quran as much as you can, He knows that shortly among you some will be sick; and some will go on travel to seek Allah's sustenance, and some will fight in the way of Allah, so recite as much as possible; establish prayer, give poor-rate, and give goodly loan (Qarz-e-Hasna) to Allah; and then whatever good you will send in advance for yourself you will find it present in the Presence of Allah, better and greater by the way of reward; and seek forgiveness from Allah, that He is most forgiving and merciful.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ اَنَّكَ تَقُومُ اَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ الَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُ وَثُلُثَهُ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ الَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ اَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَاقْرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ الْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ اَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى الْاَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ اللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ فَاقْرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَاَقِيمُواْ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ الزَّكَوٰةَ وَاَقْرِضُواْ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَ مَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِاَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَاَعْظَمَ اَجْرًا ۚ وَاسْتَغْفِرُواْ اللَّهَ ۖ اِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ

verses.english_text: O who covers with mantle.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ

verses.english_text: Arise and warn people.
verses.arabic_text: قُمْ فَاَنذِرْ

verses.english_text: And announce the greatness of your Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ

verses.english_text: And keep pure your dress.
verses.arabic_text: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ

verses.english_text: And abstain from the evil.
verses.arabic_text: وَالرُّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ

verses.english_text: And don't do such a favour that you become seeker of more.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ

verses.english_text: For the sake of your Lord, be patient.
verses.arabic_text: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَاصْبِرْ

verses.english_text: Then when the trumpet will be blown.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا نُقِرَ فِى النَّاقُورِ

verses.english_text: So that Day will be very difficult day.
verses.arabic_text: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ

verses.english_text: It will never be easy for the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: عَلَى الْكَـٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then leave me and that person whom I have created alone.
verses.arabic_text: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًۭا

verses.english_text: And has given him great wealth.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالًۭا مَّمْدُودًۭا

verses.english_text: And have given him sons which are before the eyes.
verses.arabic_text: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًۭا

verses.english_text: And have given expansion in everything.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُ تَمْهِيدًۭا

verses.english_text: And still, he wishes that I increase.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ اَنْ اَزِيدَ

verses.english_text: No way, he was stark enemy of My signs.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّآ ۖ اِنَّهُ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًۭا

verses.english_text: We will shortly encompass him in strict punishment.
verses.arabic_text: سَاُرْهِقُهُ صَعُودًا

verses.english_text: He thought and guessed.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ

verses.english_text: So he may be killed that how he has guessed.
verses.arabic_text: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ

verses.english_text: Then he was destroyed in it that how he has guessed.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ

verses.english_text: Then he pondered.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ

verses.english_text: Then he frowned and scowled.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ

verses.english_text: Then he turned his face and went away in haughtiness.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَدْبَرَ وَاسْتَكْبَرَ

verses.english_text: And in the end said it is magic which is going on since ancient time.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَالَ اِنْ هَـٰذَآ اِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ يُؤْثَرُ

verses.english_text: This is the word of an human being.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ هَـٰذَآ اِلَّا قَوْلُ الْبَشَرِ

verses.english_text: Shortly We will enter him into Hell.
verses.arabic_text: سَاُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ

verses.english_text: And what you know that what is Hell.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ

verses.english_text: It will leave none, nor will it spare anyone.
verses.arabic_text: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ

verses.english_text: Shall burn the body black.
verses.arabic_text: لَوَّاحَةٌۭ لِّلْبَشَرِ

verses.english_text: Over it nineteen angels are guarding.
verses.arabic_text: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ

verses.english_text: And We have made only angels to guard Hell and their numbers is a source of trial for infidels that people of book may be certain and faith of the believers may increase, and people of book and believers may not doubt in any way; and whoever has a disease in his heart and infidels say what is the purpose of this example, like this Allah leaves in misguidance to whoever He pleases, and guides to whoever He please; and nobody knows His armies except Him, this is only a source of admonition for the people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا جَعَلْنَآ اَصْحَـٰبَ النَّارِ اِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَ مَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ اِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ الَّذِينَ اُوتُواْ الْكِتٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ اِيمَـٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ الَّذِينَ اُوتُواْ الْكِتٰبَ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ الَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَالْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ اَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَ مَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ اِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَ مَا هِىَ اِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ

verses.english_text: Beware, We swear by moon.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا وَالْقَمَرِ

verses.english_text: And swear by the night which passes.
verses.arabic_text: وَالَّيْلِ اِذْ اَدْبَرَ

verses.english_text: And swear by the bright morning.
verses.arabic_text: وَالصُّبْحِ اِذَآ اَسْفَرَ
