verses.english_text: This Hell is a thing among the gravest things.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهَا لَاِحْدَى الْكُبَرِ

verses.english_text: Source of warning to the people.
verses.arabic_text: نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ

verses.english_text: For those who wish to move forward or backward.
verses.arabic_text: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ اَن يَتَقَدَّمَ اَوْ يَتَاَخَّرَ

verses.english_text: Every Self is surrounded in his deeds.
verses.arabic_text: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ

verses.english_text: Except for companions of Right-Hand.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّآ اَصْحَـٰبَ الْيَمِينِ

verses.english_text: They will be questioning among themselves in the Paradises.
verses.arabic_text: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

verses.english_text: About the sinners.
verses.arabic_text: عَنِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: After all what made you reach Hell.
verses.arabic_text: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ

verses.english_text: They will say we did not establish prayers.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ الْمُصَلِّينَ

verses.english_text: And never did we feed the destitute.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ الْمِسْكِينَ

verses.english_text: And we used to participate in the bad deeds of the people.
verses.arabic_text: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ الْخَآئِضِينَ

verses.english_text: And were used to deny the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ

verses.english_text: Till death overtook us.
verses.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ اَتَىٰنَا الْيَقِينُ

verses.english_text: So, the intercession of the intercessors will not be of any benefit to them.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ الشَّـٰفِعِينَ

verses.english_text: After all, what has happened to them, they have turned their faces away from the admonition.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ التَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ

verses.english_text: As if they are raging donkeys.
verses.arabic_text: كَاَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌۭ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌۭ

verses.english_text: who are running away from lions.
verses.arabic_text: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ

verses.english_text: In fact, among them every man is desirous that he be given the open books.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ اَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ

verses.english_text: (This) can never be done, fact is that they do not have the fear of the Hereafter.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ الْـَٔاخِرَةَ

verses.english_text: Yes, truly, it is open admonition.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّآ اِنَّهُ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ

verses.english_text: Now whoever wishes may remember Him.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُ

verses.english_text: And they will not remember Him, but only if Allah pleases; and He is capable of warning and Master of the forgiveness.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يَذْكُرُونَ اِلَّآ اَن يَشَآءَ اللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ اَهْلُ التَّقْوَىٰ وَاَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ

verses.english_text: I swear by the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: لَآ اُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ

verses.english_text: And I swear by the self that condemns itself on the evil.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَآ اُقْسِمُ بِالنَّفْسِ اللَّوَّامَةِ

verses.english_text: What does the man think that we will not be able to gather his bones.
verses.arabic_text: اَيَحْسَبُ الْاِنسَـٰنُ اَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُ

verses.english_text: Verily we are capable of it that we can make even upto his very fingertips.
verses.arabic_text: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ اَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُ

verses.english_text: Whereas man wants to continue doing bad deed in front of himself.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ يُرِيدُ الْاِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ اَمَامَهُ

verses.english_text: And he asks when the Day of Judgement will come.
verses.arabic_text: يَسْـَٔلُ اَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَـٰمَةِ

verses.english_text: When the eyes will dazzle.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا بَرِقَ الْبَصَرُ

verses.english_text: And moon will eclipse.
verses.arabic_text: وَخَسَفَ الْقَمَرُ

verses.english_text: And these sun and moon will be brought together.
verses.arabic_text: وَجُمِعَ الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ

verses.english_text: That day man will say now where is the way to escape.
verses.arabic_text: يَقُولُ الْاِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ اَيْنَ الْمَفَرُّ

verses.english_text: By no means, now there is no place.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ

verses.english_text: Now center of everyone is towards your Lord.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمُسْتَقَرُّ

verses.english_text: That day man will be told what deeds he has done before and after.
verses.arabic_text: يُنَبَّؤُاْ الْاِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَاَخَّرَ

verses.english_text: Rather man himself is aware of the circumstances of his Self.
verses.arabic_text: بَلِ الْاِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌۭ

verses.english_text: He may present any number of excuses.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَوْ اَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُ

verses.english_text: Look, while reciting the Quran do not move your tongue hastily.
verses.arabic_text: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِٓ

verses.english_text: It is Our responsibility to collect it and get it recited.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْءَانَهُ

verses.english_text: When We made you read then you should recite and repeat it.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا قَرَاْنَـٰهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُ

verses.english_text: Thereafter its explanation is also Our responsibility.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ

verses.english_text: No, but you people love the world.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ

verses.english_text: And have neglected the Hereafter.
verses.arabic_text: وَتَذَرُونَ الْـَٔاخِرَةَ

verses.english_text: That day some faces will be bright.
verses.arabic_text: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاضِرَةٌ

verses.english_text: They will be keeping an eye on the blessings of their Lord.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌۭ

verses.english_text: And some faces will be depressed.
verses.arabic_text: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌۭ

verses.english_text: They will think that the affliction may befall them anytime.
verses.arabic_text: تَظُنُّ اَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌۭ

verses.english_text: Be aware, when the life will come to the throat.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّآ اِذَا بَلَغَتِ التَّرَاقِىَ

verses.english_text: And it will be said, now who is the magician.
verses.arabic_text: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍۢ

verses.english_text: And people dying will think now there is separation from all.
verses.arabic_text: وَظَنَّ اَنَّهُ الْفِرَاقُ

verses.english_text: And the shin will wrap around the shin.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْتَفَّتِ السَّاقُ بِالسَّاقِ

verses.english_text: Today everyone will be taken towards the Lord.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمَسَاقُ

verses.english_text: He neither affirmed the words of Allah nor did he prayed.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ

verses.english_text: But rejected and turned the face.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

verses.english_text: Then went toward his family with arrogance.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ اِلَىٰٓ اَهْلِهِ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Alas; on your condition, alas!
verses.arabic_text: اَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَاَوْلَىٰ

verses.english_text: Alas, hundred times alas!
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَاَوْلَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Does the human perceive that he will be left free like this?
verses.arabic_text: اَيَحْسَبُ الْاِنسَـٰنُ اَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى

verses.english_text: Was not he a drop of semen which is put in the womb.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ

verses.english_text: He was a clot of blood then We created him and made perfect.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

verses.english_text: Then made a pair of the man and woman from it.
verses.arabic_text: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْاُنثَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Is that Allah not capable of this to bring to life again the dead ones?
verses.arabic_text: اَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ اَن يُحْـِۧىَ الْمَوْتَىٰ

verses.english_text: Verily, was there also a time on man when he was not anything worth mentioning?
verses.arabic_text: هَلْ اَتَىٰ عَلَى الْاِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا

verses.english_text: Verily, we have created man from the mixed sperm so that We test him, then we give him hearing and seeing power.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْاِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ اَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: Verily, We have guided him to a (straight) path, (now) whether he be grateful or ungrateful.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ السَّبِيلَ اِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَاِمَّا كَفُورًا

verses.english_text: Verily, for the infidels We have arranged chains, shackles and flaming fire.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَاْ وَاَغْلَـٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا

verses.english_text: Verily, Our righteous servants will drink from the vessel the mixture of which will be camphor.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْاَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَاْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا

verses.english_text: This is a fountain from which righteous servants of Allah will drink and will divert its flow wherever they desire.
verses.arabic_text: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا

verses.english_text: These (righteous) servants fulfil their vows, and fear from the day whose severity is spread everywhere.
verses.arabic_text: يُوفُونَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيرًا

verses.english_text: They feed the poor, orphan and captive in His love.
verses.arabic_text: وَيُطْعِمُونَ الطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَاَسِيرًا

verses.english_text: We feed only to please Allah otherwise (we) do not seek any reward or thanks from you.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا

verses.english_text: We fear our Lord about the Day when faces will be defaced and astonished.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًا

verses.english_text: So, Allah saved them from the hardness of the day and gave them freshness and happiness.
verses.arabic_text: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ اللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًا

verses.english_text: In reward to their patience [He] will bestow upon them Paradise and silk of Paradise.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُواْ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًا

verses.english_text: Where they will be reclining with cushions on the thrones, will not see the heat of the sun or the cold.
verses.arabic_text: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْاَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا

verses.english_text: The shade will be closest to their heads, and fruits will be accessible to them.
verses.arabic_text: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And silver vessels and goblets of glass will circle around them.
verses.arabic_text: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَاَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠

verses.english_text: These goblets will also be made of silver, which these people will make according to their scale.
verses.arabic_text: قَوَارِيرَاْ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا

verses.english_text: And they shall be satiated there with a cup the mixture which shall be of ginger.
verses.arabic_text: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَاْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا

verses.english_text: That is a fountain of Paradise which is called Salsabeel.
verses.arabic_text: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And around them will be youth whose age will never alter that when you will see they will seem like scattered pearls.
verses.arabic_text: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ اِذَا رَاَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًا

verses.english_text: And when you will see again you will see blessings and vast kingdom.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا رَاَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَاَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا

verses.english_text: They will be clothed with green crape cloth and silk gowns they will wear silver bracelets and their Lord will satiate them with the purest drink.
verses.arabic_text: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَاِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓاْ اَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا

verses.english_text: All this is your reward and your efforts are acceptable.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا

verses.english_text: We revealed the Qur'an to you gradually.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: Therefore, due to the command of Allah, be patient, and do not come under the impression of any sinner or infidel.
verses.arabic_text: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا اَوْ كَفُورًا

verses.english_text: And glorify the Name of your Lord morning and evening.
verses.arabic_text: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَاَصِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And prostrate to Him in the part of a night and glorify Him till late in the night.
verses.arabic_text: وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَاسْجُدْ لَهُ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا

verses.english_text: These people like only the blessings of the world, and they have neglected a hardest day.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: We have created them and made their body parts strong, whenever We please, We will change them and bring other people like them.
verses.arabic_text: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ اَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَاِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ اَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا

verses.english_text: This is the thing of admonition, whoever wishes, may adopt the path of his Lord.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًۭا

verses.english_text: And you only wish with which Lord pleases, Verily, Allah is Knower of everything and Wise.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا تَشَآءُونَ اِلَّآ اَن يَشَآءَ اللَّهُ ۚ اِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا

verses.english_text: To whoever he please enters into His mercy, and He has prepared the painful punishment for the tyrants.
verses.arabic_text: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ وَالظَّـٰلِمِينَ اَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا اَلِيمًۢا

verses.english_text: I swear by those (winds) which have been sent with continuity.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًۭا

verses.english_text: Then they are moving at a high speed.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًۭا

verses.english_text: And swear by those (winds) which disperse the things (clouds).
verses.arabic_text: وَالنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا

verses.english_text: Then will separate among them.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًۭا

verses.english_text: Then by the angels who bring revelations.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا

verses.english_text: So that there is no excuse; or fear is created.
verses.arabic_text: عُذْرًا اَوْ نُذْرًا

verses.english_text: The thing, which is promised to you, that is after all going to happen.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ

verses.english_text: When the brightness of stars will end.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا النُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ

verses.english_text: And when skies are rend asunder.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا السَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ

verses.english_text: When mountains will start flying.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا الْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ

verses.english_text: When all the prophets shall be gathered together at a time.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا الرُّسُلُ اُقِّتَتْ

verses.english_text: For which day these things are delayed.
verses.arabic_text: لِاَىِّ يَوْمٍ اُجِّلَتْ

verses.english_text: For the day of decision.
verses.arabic_text: لِيَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ

verses.english_text: And what you know what the day of decision is.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ

verses.english_text: That day there is Hell for the deniers.
verses.arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: Did We not destroy the earlier people.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: Then we will make other people to follow them too.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ الْـَٔاخِرِينَ

verses.english_text: We treat the guilty ones like this.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ

verses.english_text: And today there is ruin and ruin for the rejectors.
verses.arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: Have not We created you through the contemptible water.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍۢ مَّهِينٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then kept it in a safe place.
verses.arabic_text: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍ

verses.english_text: Until an appointed time.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then We have appointed term, and We are the best to appoint term.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ الْقَـٰدِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Today is the destruction for the deniers.
verses.arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: Have We not made the earth a container which collects.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْاَرْضَ كِفَاتًا

verses.english_text: In which (We) will collect alive and the dead.
verses.arabic_text: اَحْيَآءًۭ وَاَمْوَٰتًۭا

verses.english_text: And made high mountains in it, and satiate you with the sweet water.
verses.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَـٰمِخَـٰتٍۢ وَاَسْقَيْنَـٰكُم مَّآءًۭ فُرَاتًۭا

verses.english_text: Today is the ruin and ruin for the deniers.
verses.arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: Go towards it which you were denying.
verses.arabic_text: انطَلِقُوٓاْ اِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ

verses.english_text: Go towards the shadow of smoke, which has three corners.
verses.arabic_text: انطَلِقُوٓاْ اِلَىٰ ظِلٍّۢ ذِى ثَلَـٰثِ شُعَبٍۢ

verses.english_text: Neither cold, nor any support to save from the flames of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا ظَلِيلٍۢ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ اللَّهَبِ

verses.english_text: It throws sparks like palace.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍۢ كَالْقَصْرِ

verses.english_text: As if a yellow color camel.
verses.arabic_text: كَاَنَّهُ جِمَـٰلَتٌۭ صُفْرٌۭ

verses.english_text: Today is destruction and Hell for the deniers.
verses.arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: Today they will not even be able to talk.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ

verses.english_text: And nor they will not have the permission to present any excuse.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Today is Hell for the deniers.
verses.arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: This is the day of decision to which We have gathered you and all of the earlier people.
verses.arabic_text: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَالْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: Now if you have any plot, do use it on Us.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌۭ فَكِيدُونِ

verses.english_text: Today is Hell for the deniers.
verses.arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: Verily, the righteous will be between the thick shadow and fountains.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ

verses.english_text: And the fruits will be according to their desire.
verses.arabic_text: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

verses.english_text: Now with rest; eat and drink, because of the deeds which you have performed.
verses.arabic_text: كُلُواْ وَاشْرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Like this We reward the good-doers.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الْمُحْسِنِينَ

verses.english_text: Today is Hell for the deniers.
verses.arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: You people eat a few days and rest, you are guilty.
verses.arabic_text: كُلُواْ وَتَمَتَّعُواْ قَلِيلًا اِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ

verses.english_text: Today is affliction for the deniers.
verses.arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: And when they are asked to bow down; they don't.
verses.arabic_text: وَاِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ارْكَعُواْ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ

verses.english_text: Today is Hell for the deniers.
verses.arabic_text: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: After all, on what these people will believe after this.
verses.arabic_text: فَبِاَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: In which matter are these people questioning among themselves?
verses.arabic_text: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

verses.english_text: About the great news.
verses.arabic_text: عَنِ النَّبَاِ الْعَظِيمِ

verses.english_text: In which they differ among them.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِي هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ

verses.english_text: Nothing, shortly they will come to know.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: And will know well.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Have not We made the floor of earth.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْاَرْضَ مِهٰدًا

verses.english_text: And have not made the mountains like nails (thereon).
verses.arabic_text: وَ الْجِبَالَ اَوْتَادًا

verses.english_text: And only We have made your pair.
verses.arabic_text: وَ خَلَقْنٰكُمْ اَزْوَاجًا

verses.english_text: And make your sleep restful.
verses.arabic_text: وَ جَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا

verses.english_text: And made the night a curtain.
verses.arabic_text: وَ جَعَلْنَا الَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا

verses.english_text: And made the daytime for sustenance.
verses.arabic_text: وَ جَعَلْنَا النَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا

verses.english_text: And made seven strong skies upon your heads.
verses.arabic_text: وَ بَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا

verses.english_text: And have made a flaring lamp
verses.arabic_text: وَ جَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا

verses.english_text: And caused rained water incessantly from the clouds.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَنزَلْنَا مِنَ الْمُعْصِرٰتِ مَآءً ثَجَّاجًا

verses.english_text: So that through it cause to grow the seeds and grass.
verses.arabic_text: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِ حَبًّا وَّ نَبَاتًا

verses.english_text: And make thick gardens.
verses.arabic_text: وَ جَنّٰتٍ اَلْفَافًا

verses.english_text: Verily the day of decision is definite.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَاتًا

verses.english_text: The day trumpet will be blown, and you will come all in groups.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَتَاْتُونَ اَفْوَاجًا

verses.english_text: And ways of the sky will be made open, and gates shall come into existence.
verses.arabic_text: وَّ فُتِحَتِ السَمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ اَبْوابًا

verses.english_text: And mountains will be moved from their place, and they will become like sand.
verses.arabic_text: وَ سُيِّرَتِ الْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا

verses.english_text: Verily, Hell is waiting for them.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا

verses.english_text: That is the final abode for rebellious.
verses.arabic_text: لِّلطَّاغِينَ مَاٰبًا

verses.english_text: They will abide in it for ages.
verses.arabic_text: لّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ اَحْقَابًا

verses.english_text: They shall not be able to taste the cold nor of any drink.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَّ لَا شَرَابًا

verses.english_text: Except boiling water and puss.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَّ غَسَّاقًا

verses.english_text: This is complete recompense for their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا

verses.english_text: These people were not hopeful that they will be accounted for.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا

verses.english_text: They regularly denied Our verses.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَذَّبُوا بِاٰيَاتِنَا كِذَّابًا

verses.english_text: And We have collected everything in Our book.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ اَحْصَيْنٰهُ كِتٰبًا

verses.english_text: Now taste your deeds, and We cannot increase anything but punishment.
verses.arabic_text: فَذُوقُوا فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ اِلَّا عَذَابًا

verses.english_text: Verily for the righteous people it is point of achievement.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا

verses.english_text: Gardens are there and grapes.
verses.arabic_text: حَدَآئِقَ وَ اَعْنَابًا

verses.english_text: Young virgins girls and all of the same age.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَوَاعِبَ اَتْرَابًا

verses.english_text: Glasses filled up to the brims.
verses.arabic_text: وَ كَاْسًا دِهَاقًا

verses.english_text: There they will not hear any vain talk nor sin.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَّ لَا كِذّٰبًا

verses.english_text: This is the reckoning bestowed upon you from your Lord, and reward for your deeds.
verses.arabic_text: جَزَآءٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا

verses.english_text: He is the Merciful Lord of the skies and the earth and in between them and no one has the strength to talk before Him.
verses.arabic_text: رَّبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمـٰنِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا

verses.english_text: The day Spirit and the angels will stand in queue, and no one even will be able to talk; except whom the Merciful give permission, and talk rightfully.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الرُّوحُ وَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗا لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ اِلَّا مَنْ اَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمـٰنُ وَ قَالَ صَوَابًا

verses.english_text: This is the Day of Truth so anyone who wishes, may make a place towards his Lord.
verses.arabic_text: ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَقُّ فَمَن شَآءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلَٰى رَبِّهُ مَـَٔابًا

verses.english_text: We have warned you from a near punishment, the day man will see his deeds, and infidel will say, O! I wish I would have become dust.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَنذَرْنٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدٰهُ وَ يَقُولُ الْكٰفِرُ يٰلَيْتَنِي كُنتُ تُرٰبا

verses.english_text: I swear by (the angels) who will drown and pull the soul (of the infidels) with difficulty.
verses.arabic_text: وَالنّٰزِعٰتِ غَرْقًا

verses.english_text: And I swear by (the angels) who will pull (the soul) of the believers with ease.
verses.arabic_text: وَّ النّٰشِطٰتِ نَشْطًا

verses.english_text: And I swear by those who float (between the skies).
verses.arabic_text: وَّ السّٰبِحٰتِ سَبْحًا

verses.english_text: Then there are those who go ahead at high speed.
verses.arabic_text: فَالسّٰبِقٰتِ سَبْقًا

verses.english_text: Then those who regulate the affairs.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْمُدَبِّرٰتِ اَمْرًا

verses.english_text: The day on which earth will be made to shake by a jerk.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الرَّاجِفَةُ

verses.english_text: Then there will be a second jerk.
verses.arabic_text: تَتْبَعُهَا الرَّادِفَةُ

verses.english_text: That day hearts will tremble.
verses.arabic_text: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَّاجِفَةٌ

verses.english_text: Eyes will be cast down with fear.
verses.arabic_text: اَبْصَـارُهَا خَـاشِعَةٌۭ

verses.english_text: These infidels say, will we be sent into this world again?
verses.arabic_text: يَقُولُونَ اَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى الْحَافِرَةِ

verses.english_text: Even though we have become hollow bones?
verses.arabic_text: ءَاِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـامًا نَّخِرَةً

verses.english_text: This return will be of a great loss.
verses.arabic_text: قَالُواْ تِلْكَ اِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةً

verses.english_text: This Day of Judgement will be just a scream.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةً

verses.english_text: Thereafter everyone will be seen in the field of the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا هُم بِالسَّاهِرَةِ

verses.english_text: Has the news of Musa reached you.
verses.arabic_text: هَلْ اَتٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسٰى

verses.english_text: When his Lord called upon him in the holy valley of Toa
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ نَادٰهُ رَبُّه بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى

verses.english_text: Go to Firaun, he has become rebellious.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْهَبْ اِلَٰى فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّهُ طَغٰى

verses.english_text: Say to him, is it possible that you refine your character.
verses.arabic_text: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ اِلَىٰٓ اَن تَزَكّٰى

verses.english_text: And I will guide you towards your Lord, and create fear in your heart.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَهْدِيَكَ اِلَٰى رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشٰى

verses.english_text: Then he showed him the great sign.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَرٰهُ الْاٰيَةَ الْكُبْرٰى

verses.english_text: So he denied and disobeyed.
verses.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبَ وَ عَصٰى

verses.english_text: Then turned his face hastily.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَدْبَرَ يَسْعٰى

verses.english_text: Then gathered everyone and called out.
verses.arabic_text: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادٰى

verses.english_text: And said, I am your lord, most high.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَالَ اَنَا رَبُّكُمُ الْاَعْلَٰى

verses.english_text: So Allah caught him in the punishment of both this world and the Hereafter.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَخَذَهُ اللّٰهُ نَكَالَ الْاٰخِرَةِ وَ الْاُولَٰى

verses.english_text: In this event there is a lesson for those who fear Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ فِى ذٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِِّمَن يَّخْشٰى

verses.english_text: Is your creation more difficult than making the sky that He has created the sky.
verses.arabic_text: ءَاَنتُمْ اَشَدُّ خَلْقًا امِ السَّمَآءُ بَنٰهَا

verses.english_text: He raised the roof and then leveled it.
verses.arabic_text: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوّٰهَا

verses.english_text: (He) made night of it dark and made brightness in the day.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَ اَخْرَجَ ضُحٰهَا

verses.english_text: Thereafter spread the flooring of the earth.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَلْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ دَحٰهَا

verses.english_text: Brought out water and pastures from it.
verses.arabic_text: اَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعٰهَا

verses.english_text: And firmed the mountains.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَلْجِبَالَ اَرْسٰهَا

verses.english_text: All this is provision for you and your animals.
verses.arabic_text: مَتاعًا لَّكُمْ وَ لِانْعامِكُمْ

verses.english_text: Then when the big trouble will come.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا جَآءَتِ اَلطَّآمَّةُ اَلْكُبْرٰى

verses.english_text: The day man will remember that what he did.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْاِنسَانُ مَا سَعٰى

verses.english_text: And Hell will be made manifest for those who sees.
verses.arabic_text: وَ بُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَّرٰى

verses.english_text: Then the one who rebelled.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّا مَن طَغٰى

verses.english_text: And adopted the worldly life.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اٰثَرَ الْحَيٰوةَ الدُّنْيَا

verses.english_text: Hell will be his abode.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنَّ الْجَحِيمَ هِىَ الْمَاْوٰى

verses.english_text: And he who developed the fear to present himself before his Lord and restrains his Self from the desires.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى اَلنَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوٰى

verses.english_text: So, Paradise is his abode and center.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ هِىَ الْمَاْوٰى

verses.english_text: O Prophet, people ask you about the Day of Judgement that when will it come.
verses.arabic_text: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ اَيَّانَ مُرْسٰهَا

verses.english_text: On what stage are you about its remembrance.
verses.arabic_text: فِيمَ اَنتَ مِن ذِكْرٰهَا

verses.english_text: With your Lord is the finality of its knowledge.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَٰى رَبِّكَ مُنتَهٰهَا

verses.english_text: You are only the warner from it for those who have fear of it.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّمَآ اَنْتَ مُنذِرُ مَنْ يَخْشٰهَا

verses.english_text: As if when the people will see it, they will feel that they have stayed one evening or one morning in the world.
verses.arabic_text: كَاَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا اِلَّا عَشِيَّةً اَوْ ضُحٰهَا

verses.english_text: He frowned and turn (his) back.
verses.arabic_text: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ

verses.english_text: That a blind came to him.
verses.arabic_text: اَن جَآءَهُ اَلْاَعْمٰى

verses.english_text: And what do you know, maybe he would become a pure soul.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Or if he gets the admonition, then the admonition would be useful for him.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ الذِّكْرٰى

verses.english_text: As for him, who considers himself free from need (of you).
verses.arabic_text: اَمَّا مَنِ اسْتَغْنٰى

verses.english_text: You are thinking about him.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَنتَ لَهُ تَصَدَّى

verses.english_text: Although there is no responsibility on you, if he does not purify himself.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا عَلَيْكَ اَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ

verses.english_text: But who has come running to you?
verses.arabic_text: وَاَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ

verses.english_text: And also has fear of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هُوَ يَخْشٰى

verses.english_text: You try to ignore him.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهّٰى

verses.english_text: Look, this Quran is an admonition.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّآ اِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ

verses.english_text: Whoever wishes may accept it.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُ

verses.english_text: It is among the respectable scriptures.
verses.arabic_text: فِى صُحُفٍۢ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ

verses.english_text: Which is high and pure.
verses.arabic_text: مَّرْفُوعَةٍۢ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۢ

verses.english_text: Is in the hands of such writers.
verses.arabic_text: بِاَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍ

verses.english_text: Who are respectable and are of virtuous character.
verses.arabic_text: كِرَامٍۢ بَرَرَةٍ

verses.english_text: Man perished on this that how ungrateful he has become.
verses.arabic_text: قُتِلَ الْاِنسَانُ مَآ اَكْفَرَهُ

verses.english_text: After all, from what has been created.
verses.arabic_text: مِنْ اَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَه

verses.english_text: He has been created by sperm then his measure was decided.
verses.arabic_text: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَه فَقَدَّرَه

verses.english_text: Then for him the way has been made easy.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ السَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُ

verses.english_text: Then he was annihilated by giving death.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَمَاتَهُ فَاَقْبَرَه

verses.english_text: Then whenever (He) pleases, was raised to life again.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِذَا شَآءَ اَنشَرَه

verses.english_text: No way, verily he did not complete the commandment of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ اَمَرَه

verses.english_text: Let the man look at his food.
verses.arabic_text: فَلْيَنظُرِ الْاِنسَانُ اِلَٰى طَعَامِهِٓ

verses.english_text: Verily, We rained the water.
verses.arabic_text: اَنَّا صَبَبْنَا الْمَآءَ صَبًّا

verses.english_text: Then We cracked the earth.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا اَلْاَرْضَ شَقًّا

verses.english_text: Then We caused to grow the seed therein.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا

verses.english_text: And grapes and vegetables.
verses.arabic_text: وَّ عِنَبًا وَّ قَضْبًا

verses.english_text: And olive and dates.
verses.arabic_text: وَّ زَيْتُونًا وَّ نَخْلًا

verses.english_text: And thick gardens.
verses.arabic_text: وَّحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًا

verses.english_text: And fruits and fodder.
verses.arabic_text: وَّ فَاكِهَةً وَّ اَبًّا

verses.english_text: All this is wealth of life for you and your animals.
verses.arabic_text: مَّتاعًا لَّكُمْ وَ لِاَنْعَامِكُمْ

verses.english_text: Then when the ear-splitting Day of Judgement will come.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا جَآءَتِ اَلصَّآخَّةُ

verses.english_text: The day man will flee from his brother.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ الْمَرْءُ مِنْ اَخِيهِ

verses.english_text: And from mother and father too.
verses.arabic_text: وَاُمِّهِ وَاَبِيهِ

verses.english_text: And from wife and children too.
verses.arabic_text: وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَبَنِيهِ

verses.english_text: That day every man will have different thinking which will be enough for him.
verses.arabic_text: لِكُلِّ امْرِىً مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَانٌ يُغْنِيهِ

verses.english_text: That day some faces will be bright.
verses.arabic_text: وُجُوهٌ يَّوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ

verses.english_text: Smiling and fresh.
verses.arabic_text: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ

verses.english_text: Some faces will be covered with dust.
verses.arabic_text: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ

verses.english_text: They will be covered with humiliation.
verses.arabic_text: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ

verses.english_text: These people in fact will be infidel and sinful.
verses.arabic_text: اَولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْكَفَرَةُ الْفَجَرَةُ

verses.english_text: When the sun will be folded up.
verses.arabic_text: اِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ

verses.english_text: When stars will fall.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا النُّجُومُ انكَدَرَتْ

verses.english_text: When the mountains will come into motion.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا الْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ

verses.english_text: When the pregnant she-camels will be left unattended.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا الْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ

verses.english_text: When animals will be gathered.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا الْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ

verses.english_text: When oceans will be flared up.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا الْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ

verses.english_text: When souls will be united with the bodies.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا النُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ

verses.english_text: And when they will be questioned about burying the girls alive.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا الْمَوْءُدَةُ سُئِلَتْ

verses.english_text: That - for what sin they were killed.
verses.arabic_text: بِاَيِّ ذَنبٍ قُتِلَتْ

verses.english_text: When the books of deeds will be distributed.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا الصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ

verses.english_text: And when the peel of the sky will be removed.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا السَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ

verses.english_text: When Hell fire will be flared up.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا الْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ

verses.english_text: When Paradise will be made nearer.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا الْجَنَّةُ اُزْلِفَتْ

verses.english_text: Then every Self will know what he has sent earlier.
verses.arabic_text: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا اَحْضَرَتْ

verses.english_text: So I swear by the stars which are returned.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا اُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ

verses.english_text: Moving and hiding.
verses.arabic_text: الْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ

verses.english_text: And (I) swear by the night when it's about to end.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّيْلِ اِذَا عَسْعَسَ

verses.english_text: And (I) swear by the morning when it starts breathing.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الصُّبْحِ اِذَا تَنَفَّسَ

verses.english_text: Verily, this is the word of a respected messenger.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ

verses.english_text: He is owner of power and having high rank in the Presence of the Lord of the Throne.
verses.arabic_text: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ

verses.english_text: He is obeyed there, and then is trusty.
verses.arabic_text: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ اَمِينٍ

verses.english_text: And your companion prophet is not a madman.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ

verses.english_text: And he has seen the angel on the high horizon.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَقَدْ رَآهُ بِالْاُفُقِ الْمُبِينِ

verses.english_text: And He is not stingy about the unseen.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا هُوَ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ

verses.english_text: And this Quran is not the word of any accursed Satan.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ

verses.english_text: So where are you going?
verses.arabic_text: فَاَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ

verses.english_text: This is only a thing of admonition for the world.
verses.arabic_text: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Whoever wants to go on a straight path among you.
verses.arabic_text: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ اَن يَّسْتَقِيمَ

verses.english_text: You cannot aspire anything, but only if the Lord of the worlds Allah pleases.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا تَشَآءُوْنَ اِلَّا اَن يَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: When the sky will rend asunder.
verses.arabic_text: اِذَا السَّمَآءُ انفَطَرَتْ

verses.english_text: And when the stars will be scattered.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا الْكَوَاكِبُ انْتَثَرَتْ

verses.english_text: And when the oceans will mix with each other.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا الْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ

verses.english_text: And when graves will be laid open.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا الْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ

verses.english_text: Then every Self will know what it has sent before and what was left behind.
verses.arabic_text: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَ اَخَّرَتْ

verses.english_text: O man, what has deceived you about the Gracious Lord?
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْاِنسَـانُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الْكَرِيمِ

verses.english_text: He created you, perfected you and then balanced you.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوّٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ

verses.english_text: He constituted your (body) parts as he pleases.
verses.arabic_text: فِىٓ اَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ

verses.english_text: But you people deny the reward (Day of Judgement).
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِالدِّينِ

verses.english_text: And verily there are guards over your heads.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحٰفِظِينَ

verses.english_text: Who are honorable recorders.
verses.arabic_text: كِرَامًا كَاتِبِيْنَ

verses.english_text: They know your deeds well.
verses.arabic_text: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, righteous people will be in bliss.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْاَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ

verses.english_text: And wicked people will be in Hell.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنَّ الْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ

verses.english_text: They will be thrown into it (Hell) on the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ الدِّينِ

verses.english_text: And they cannot escape it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ

verses.english_text: And what do you know what the day of recompense is?
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَدْرٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ

verses.english_text: Then what do you know how the day of recompense is?
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ مَآ اَدْرٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ

verses.english_text: That day, no one will have any authority over anyone, all control will be in the hands of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْئًا ۖ وَ الْاَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ

verses.english_text: Woe to the stinters. (Who give deficient measure and weight).
verses.arabic_text: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ

verses.english_text: When they take, they take full measurement.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ اِذَا اكْتَالُواْ عَلَى النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ

verses.english_text: And when they give to others, they give deficient measure or weight.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا كَالُوهُمْ اَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ

verses.english_text: Do they not think that one day they will be raised again.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَا يَظُنُّ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ

verses.english_text: On the very difficult day.
verses.arabic_text: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

verses.english_text: The day they will be presented in the Presence of the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.arabic_text: يَّوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعٰلَمِينَ

verses.english_text: Remember, book of deeds of the wicked will be in Sijjin.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّآ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ

verses.english_text: And what you know what is Sijjin.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَدْرٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٍ

verses.english_text: It is a written book.
verses.arabic_text: كِتٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ

verses.english_text: Today is destruction for the deniers.
verses.arabic_text: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

verses.english_text: Those who deny the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ

verses.english_text: Only those who deny it are transgressing sinners.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِٓ اِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ اَثِيمٍ

verses.english_text: When verses are recited in front of them, they say these are the tales of the old ones.
verses.arabic_text: اِذَا تُتْلَٰى عَلَيْهِ اٰيٰاتُنَا قَالَ اَسَاطِيرُ الْاَوَّلِينَ

verses.english_text: No, no, but their hearts are rusted with their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَٰى قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ

verses.english_text: Remember, on the Day of Judgement they will be debarred from the mercy of the Lord.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّآ اِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ

verses.english_text: Then thereafter they will be thrown into Hell.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا الْجَحِيمِ

verses.english_text: Then it will be said to them, this is it what you had been denying.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هٰذَا الَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ

verses.english_text: Remember, book of deeds of the righteous ones will be in Illiyeen.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّآ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الْاَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ

verses.english_text: And what do you know what is Illiyeen.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَآ اَدْرٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ

verses.english_text: It is a written book.
verses.arabic_text: كِتٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ

verses.english_text: Whose witnesses are angels and those who are drawn near to Allah.
verses.arabic_text: يَّشْهَدُهُ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, righteous ones will be in the bliss.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْاَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ

verses.english_text: Shall be sitting and watching from the thrones.
verses.arabic_text: عَلَى الْاَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

verses.english_text: You will see the freshness of bliss on their faces.
verses.arabic_text: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ النَّعِيمِ

verses.english_text: They will be made to satiated with a pure drink that is sealed.
verses.arabic_text: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ

verses.english_text: Whose seal will be of musk, and those who are fond of these things should aspire among themselves.
verses.arabic_text: خِتٰمُهُ مِسْكٌ وَ فِى ذٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ الْمُتَنافِسُونَ

verses.english_text: This drink will be mixed with the water of Tasneem.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِزَاجُهُ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ

verses.english_text: This is a fountain from which drink the servants who are near to the Presence of Allah.
verses.arabic_text: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا الْمُقَرَّبُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, these guilty ones used to make fun of the believers.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ اَجْرَمُوا كَانُوا مِنَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُواْ يَضْحَكُونَ

verses.english_text: And when they passed by them, they used to gesture at them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا مَرُّوا بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُوْنَ

verses.english_text: And when they used to return to their people they would return mockingly.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا انْقَلَبُوٓا اِلَٰى اَهْلِهِمُ انْقَلَبُوا فَكِهِينَ

verses.english_text: When they see the believers, they used to say they are all really misguided.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا رَاَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا اِنَّ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ

verses.english_text: Although We did not send them as their guardians.
verses.arabic_text: وَمَآ اُرْسِلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ حٰفِظِينَ

verses.english_text: So today believers will also make fun of the infidels.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْيَوْمَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوا مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ

verses.english_text: They will be sitting on the thrones watching.
verses.arabic_text: عَلَى الْاَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

verses.english_text: Now infidels are getting full reward of their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ الْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ

verses.english_text: When the sky will burst.
verses.arabic_text: اِذَا السَّمَآءُ انشَقَّتْ

verses.english_text: And will follow the commandment of Allah, this is necessary also.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَ حُقَّتْ

verses.english_text: When the earth will be leveled and spread.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا الْاَرْضُ مُدَّتْ

verses.english_text: Will throw up its treasures and become empty.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَ تَخَلَّتْ

verses.english_text: And will follow the commandment of Allah, this is necessary also.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَ حُقَّتْ

verses.english_text: O man, you are striving to go towards your Lord; so one day you will face Him.
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْاِنسَانُ اِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ اِلَٰى رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلٰقِيهِ

verses.english_text: Then whoever will be given the book of deeds in the right hand.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّا مَنْ اُوتِيَ كِتٰبَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ

verses.english_text: His reckoning will be easy.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا

verses.english_text: And shall return to his people joyfully.
verses.arabic_text: وَّ يَنقَلِبُ اِلٰٓى اَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا

verses.english_text: And to whom his book of deeds will be given behind his back.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَمَّا مَنْ اُوتِيَ كِتٰبَهُ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِ

verses.english_text: He will shortly pray for death.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا ثُبُورًا

verses.english_text: And will enter the fire of Hell.
verses.arabic_text: وَّ يَصْلَٰى سَعِيرًا

verses.english_text: Earlier he was very happy among his family.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ كَانَ فِىٓ اَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا

verses.english_text: And he had imagined that he would not be returned to Allah.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ ظَنَّ اَن لَّن يَحُورَ

verses.english_text: Yes, his Lord is all-seeing.
verses.arabic_text: بَلٰٓى اِنَّ رَبَّهُ كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيرًا

verses.english_text: I swear by the redness of the horizon at sunset.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا اُقْسِمُ بِالشَّفَقِ

verses.english_text: And I swear by night and whatever it covers.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّيْلِ وَ مَا وَسَقَ

verses.english_text: And (I) swear by the moon when it is full.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الْقَمَرِ اِذَا اتَّسَقَ

verses.english_text: That you will befall one affliction after another affliction.
verses.arabic_text: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ

verses.english_text: Then what has happened to them (why) they do not believe.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.english_text: And when the Quran is recited in front of them they do not prostrate.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِذَا قُرِىءَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْاٰنُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ

verses.english_text: {Prostrate, Non-Obligatory} But the infidels deny it also.
verses.arabic_text: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُكَذِّبُونَ

verses.english_text: And Allah knows best what they are concealing in their hearts.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ

verses.english_text: Now give them the news of painful punishment.
verses.arabic_text: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيمٍ

verses.english_text: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for them is a reward and recompense that will never end.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوا وَ عَمِلُوا الصَٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمْ اَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ

verses.english_text: I swear by the sky of mansions.
verses.arabic_text: وَ السَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْبُرُوجِ

verses.english_text: And I swear of the day which has been promised.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اليَوْمِ الْمَوْعُودِ

verses.english_text: And (I) swear by the witness and of him whose testimony will be given.
verses.arabic_text: وَ شَاهِدٍ وَ مَشْهُودٍ

verses.english_text: Companions of Ukhdood were killed.
verses.arabic_text: قُتِلَ اَصْحٰبُ الْاُخْدُودِ

verses.english_text: People of the ditches full of fire.
verses.arabic_text: النَّارِ ذَاتِ الْوَقُودِ

verses.english_text: They sat by filling it with fire.
verses.arabic_text: اِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ

verses.english_text: And the behavior they were doing with believers, they are themselves a witness of it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هُمْ عَلَٰى مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ

verses.english_text: They avenged them only because they believed in Allah, the Mighty and the Praiseworthy.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا نَقَمُوا مِنْهُمْ اِلَّآ اَن يُؤْمِنُوا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ

verses.english_text: That is Allah in whose possession is the kingdom of skies and the earth and he is also the witness and guardian of all things.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ  وَ اللّٰهُ عَلَٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ

verses.english_text: Verily, those who persecute believing men and women and do not repent; there is punishment of Hell for them, and also the punishment of burning.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَ لَهُمْ عَذَابُ الْحَرِيقِ

verses.english_text: Verily, those who believed and did the good deeds for them are those Paradises beneath which rivers will flow, and this is great success.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنّٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ  ذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْكَبِيرُ

verses.english_text: Verily, your Lord's grip is very strong.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ

verses.english_text: He is the creator, and He will resurrect again.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ هُوَ يُبْدِىءُ وَيُعِيدُ

verses.english_text: He is very forgiving and loving.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الْوَدُودُ

verses.english_text: He is the Lord of the Throne, the Glorious.
verses.arabic_text: ذُو الْعَرْشِ الْمَجِيدُ

verses.english_text: He is doer of what He pleases.
verses.arabic_text: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ

verses.english_text: Does the news of armies reach you.
verses.arabic_text: هَلْ اَتٰكَ حَدِيثُ الْجُنُودِ

verses.english_text: News of Firaun and people of Samood.
verses.arabic_text: فِرْعَوْنَ وَ ثَمُودَ

verses.english_text: But infidels are just denying.
verses.arabic_text: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِى تَكْذِيبٍ

verses.english_text: And Allah has encompassed them from behind.
verses.arabic_text: وَّ اللّٰهُ مِنْ وَّرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌ

verses.english_text: Verily, this is the great and superior Quran.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْاٰنٌ مَّجِيدٌ

verses.english_text: Which is saved on Lauh-e-Mahfooz.
verses.arabic_text: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍ

verses.english_text: I swear by the sky and visitor of the night.
verses.arabic_text: وَ السَّمَآءِ وَ الطَّارِقِ

verses.english_text: And - What do you know - what is the visitor of night?
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَدْرٰكَ مَا الطَّارِقُ

verses.english_text: This is the brightest star.
verses.arabic_text: النَّجْمُ الثَّاقِبُ

verses.english_text: There is no soul on which the watcher is not appointed.
verses.arabic_text: اِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ

verses.english_text: Then man should see from what thing he has been created from.
verses.arabic_text: فَلْيَنظُرِ الْاِنسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ

verses.english_text: He has been created from the bouncing water.
verses.arabic_text: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ

verses.english_text: Which comes out from between the bones of the back and chest.
verses.arabic_text: يَخْرُجُ مِن بَيْنِ الصُّلْبِ وَ التَّرَآئِبِ

verses.english_text: Verily, that Allah is also capable to raise the man again.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ عَلَٰى رَجْعِهِ لَقَادِرٌ

verses.english_text: When the secrets will be tested.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَآئِرُ

verses.english_text: Then no one will have strength nor helper.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا لَهُ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَ لَا نَاصِرٍ

verses.english_text: Swear by the swiveling sky.
verses.arabic_text: وَ السَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِ

verses.english_text: And by the splitting earth.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الْاَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ

verses.english_text: Verily it is a decisive word.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ

verses.english_text: And not a joke.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا هُوَ بِالْهَزْلِ

verses.english_text: These people are doing their planning.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا

verses.english_text: And We are doing Our planning.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَكِيدُ كَيْدًا

verses.english_text: So, leave infidels and give them some respite.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَهِّلِ الْكٰفِرِينَ اَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا

verses.english_text: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High.
verses.arabic_text: سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْاَعْلَى

verses.english_text: Who created and then gave order and perfection.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوّٰى

verses.english_text: Who appointed fate and then guided.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدٰى

verses.english_text: Who brought out the pasture.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِيٓ اَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعٰى

verses.english_text: Then make it dried up, a litter of black color.
verses.arabic_text: فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَاءً اَحْوٰى

verses.english_text: We will shortly teach you in such a way that you shall not forget.
verses.arabic_text: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسٰى

verses.english_text: But only if Allah pleases; that He knows everything that is manifest and what is hidden.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ اللّٰهُ اِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ وَ مَا يَخْفٰى

verses.english_text: And We will give you an opportunity for the easy way.
verses.arabic_text: وَ نُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرٰى

verses.english_text: Therefore, make them understand, if it is of any benefit.
verses.arabic_text: فَذَكِّرْ اِن نَّفَعَتِ الذِّكْرٰى

verses.english_text: Shortly, those who have fear of Allah would understand.
verses.arabic_text: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَّخْشٰى

verses.english_text: And, a wretched one would shun it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ يَتَجَنَّبُهَا الْاَشْقَى

verses.english_text: Who is going to burn in a very big fire.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِي يَصْلَى النَّارَ الْكُبْرٰى

verses.english_text: Then in it there is neither life nor death.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَ لَا يَحْيٰى

verses.english_text: Verily he shall be successful who purifies himself.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ اَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكّٰى

verses.english_text: Whoever glorified the name of his Lord and prayed.
verses.arabic_text: وَ ذَكَرَ اسْمَ رَبِّهِ فَصَلّٰى

verses.english_text: But you people give precedence to the worldly life.
verses.arabic_text: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ الْحَيَٰوةَ الدُّنْيَا

verses.english_text: Whereas the Hereafter is better and everlasting.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الْاٰخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَ اَبْقٰى

verses.english_text: This is present in all earlier scriptures also.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِي الصُّحُفِ الْاُولَٰى

verses.english_text: Also, the scriptures of Ibrahim and scriptures of Musa.
verses.arabic_text: صُحُفِ اِبْرٰهِيمَ وَ مُوسٰى

verses.english_text: Do you know about the Day of Judgement's matter that will cover (you) up.
verses.arabic_text: هَلْ اَتٰكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ

verses.english_text: That day many faces will be dishonored and disgraced.
verses.arabic_text: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَاشِعَةٌ

verses.english_text: Who are laborious and tired.
verses.arabic_text: عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ

verses.english_text: Shall enter the burning fire.
verses.arabic_text: تَصْلَٰى نَارًا حَامِيَةً

verses.english_text: They will be made to satiated with the fountain of boiling water.
verses.arabic_text: تُسْقٰى مِنْ عَيْنٍ انِيَةٍ

verses.english_text: There will be no food for them except thorny bushes.
verses.arabic_text: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ اِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ

verses.english_text: Which will neither fatten nor will be of any use in hunger.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَ لَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ

verses.english_text: And some faces will be fresh.
verses.arabic_text: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ

verses.english_text: Happy with their hard work and discipline.
verses.arabic_text: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ

verses.english_text: In the highest Paradise.
verses.arabic_text: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ

verses.english_text: There won't be any vain sound.
verses.arabic_text: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَاغِيَةً

verses.english_text: There fountains will be flowing.
verses.arabic_text: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ

verses.english_text: There will be high thrones.
verses.arabic_text: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ

verses.english_text: And there will be bowls placed on sides.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ

verses.english_text: Cushions will be lined up.
verses.arabic_text: وَ نَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ

verses.english_text: There will be silken carpets spread out.
verses.arabic_text: وَ زَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ

verses.english_text: Do they not look at the camels how they are created?
verses.arabic_text: اَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ اِلَى الْاِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ

verses.english_text: And to the sky, how it has been elevated [hanged in space].
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِلَى السَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ

verses.english_text: And to the mountains, how they have been established.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِلَى الْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ

verses.english_text: And to the earth, how it has been spread out.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ

verses.english_text: Therefore, continue admonishing, you are only an admonisher.
verses.arabic_text: فَذَكِّرْ اِنَّمَآ اَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ

verses.english_text: You are not imposed upon them, and you are not responsible for them.
verses.arabic_text: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ

verses.english_text: But whoever turns his face and becomes infidel.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا مَنْ تَوَلّٰى وَ كَفَرَ

verses.english_text: So, Allah will cause him to suffer a great punishment.
verses.arabic_text: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ اللّٰهُ الْعَذَابَ الْاَكْبَرَ

verses.english_text: Then towards Us is the return of everyone.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اِلَيْنَآ اِيَابَهُمْ

verses.english_text: And upon Us is their reckoning.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ اِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُمْ

verses.english_text: I swear by the daybreak.
verses.arabic_text: وَالْفَجْرِ

verses.english_text: And of ten nights.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ

verses.english_text: And of the even and the odd.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الشَّفْعِ وَ الْوَتْرِ

verses.english_text: And of night when it starts going.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّيْلِ اِذَا يَسْرِ

verses.english_text: Verily there is an oath in these things for the people of understanding.
verses.arabic_text: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ

verses.english_text: Did not you see what your Lord did with the nation of Aad.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ

verses.english_text: (The people of) Iram, possessors of lofty pillars.
verses.arabic_text: اِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ

verses.english_text: Of the example which was not found in other cities.
verses.arabic_text: الَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى الْبِلَادِ

verses.english_text: And with the (people of) Samood, who were used to make houses by hewing stones in valley.
verses.arabic_text: وَ ثَمُودَ الَّذِينَ جَابُوا الصَّخْرَ بِالْوَادِ

verses.english_text: And with Firaun, who had pegs.
verses.arabic_text: وَ فِرْعَوْنَ ذِى الْاَوْتَادِ

verses.english_text: Those who spread transgression in the cities.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ طَغَوْا فِى الْبِلَادِ

verses.english_text: And did mischief therein.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَكْثَرُوا فِيهَا الْفَسَادَ

verses.english_text: Then Allah rained whips of punishment upon them.
verses.arabic_text: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ

verses.english_text: Verily, your Lord is watching the wrongdoers.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِالْمِرْصَادِ

verses.english_text: But as for man when the Lord tested him in this way by giving him honor and blessing, so he said, my Lord has honored me.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّا الْاِنسَانُ اِذَا مَا ابْتَلٰهُ رَبُّهُ فَاَكْرَمَهُ وَ نَعَّمَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ اَكْرَمَنِ

verses.english_text: And when straiten the sustenance for trial, he said my Lord has insulted me.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَمَّآ اِذَا مَا ابْتَلٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ اَهَانَنِ

verses.english_text: Not at all, but you don't respect orphans.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ الْيَتِيمَ

verses.english_text: And (you) do not encourage people to feed the destitute.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَٰى طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ

verses.english_text: And by collecting the wealth of inheritance, you eat away all, permitted and forbidden.
verses.arabic_text: وَ تَاَكُلُونَ التُّرَاثَ اَكْلًا لَّمًّا

verses.english_text: And you love the worldly wealth very much.
verses.arabic_text: وَ تُحِبُّونَ الْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا

verses.english_text: Remember, when the earth will be made to crumble into particles.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّآ اِذَا دُكَّتِ الْاَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا

verses.english_text: And the commandment of your Lord; and angels will come in queues.
verses.arabic_text: وَّ جَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَ الْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا

verses.english_text: And on that day Hell will be brought to the fore, then the man will come to his senses; but what is the use of waking up on that day.
verses.arabic_text: وَ جَاىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِجَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْاِنسَانُ وَ اَنّٰى لَهُ الذِّكْرٰى

verses.english_text: Man will say, I wish I would have sent earlier something for this life.
verses.arabic_text: يَقُولُ يٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى

verses.english_text: So, on that day, Allah will give such a punishment that no one would have given.
verses.arabic_text: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُٓ اَحَدٌ

verses.english_text: And no one would have been arrested like this before.
verses.arabic_text: وَّ لَا يُوثِقُ وَ ثَاقَهُٓ اَحَدٌ

verses.english_text: O contented soul!
verses.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ

verses.english_text: Return towards your Lord, in the way that you are well-pleased with Him and He is well-pleased with you.
verses.arabic_text: ارْجِعِىٓ اِلَٰى رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً

verses.english_text: Then be among My servants.
verses.arabic_text: فَادْخُلِى فِى عِبٰدِى

verses.english_text: And enter my Paradise.
verses.arabic_text: وَ ادْخُلِى جَنَّتِى

verses.english_text: I swear by this city.
verses.arabic_text: لَا اُقْسِمُ بِهٰذَا الْبَلَدِ

verses.english_text: And you live in this city.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَنتَ حِلٌّ بِهٰذَا الْبَلَدِ

verses.english_text: And I swear by your father Adam and his children.
verses.arabic_text: وَ وَالِدٍ وَّ مَا وَلَدَ

verses.english_text: We have created man to live in hardship.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنسَانَ فِى كَبَدٍ

verses.english_text: Does he think that no one will be able to overcome him.
verses.arabic_text: اَيَحْسَبُ اَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ اَحَدٌ

verses.english_text: That he says that he has spent immensely.
verses.arabic_text: يَقُولُ اَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُّبَدًا

verses.english_text: Does he think that no one has seen him?
verses.arabic_text: اَيَحْسَبُ اَن لَّمْ يَرَهُٓ اَحَدٌ

verses.english_text: Have not We given him two eyes.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُ عَيْنَيْنِ

verses.english_text: And also, a tongue and two lips.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لِسَانًا وَّ شَفَتَيْنِ

verses.english_text: And we have guided him both ways.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هَدَيْنٰهُ النَّجْدَيْنِ

verses.english_text: Then why did he not pass over the gorge.
verses.arabic_text: فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ

verses.english_text: And what do you know what this gorge is?
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَدْرٰكَ مَا الْعَقَبَةُ

verses.english_text: (It is) freeing of a neck (slave).
verses.arabic_text: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ

verses.english_text: Or feeding on a day of hunger.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ اِطْعٰمٌ فِى يَوْمٍ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍ

verses.english_text: To any nearest orphan kin.
verses.arabic_text: يَّتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ

verses.english_text: Or to a poor destitute.
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ

verses.english_text: Then he became among those who believed, and they advised patience and mercy to one another.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوا وَ تَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ وَ تَوَاصَوْا بِالْمَرْحَمَةِ

verses.english_text: These are the lucky people.
verses.arabic_text: اُولٰئِكَ اَصْحٰبُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ

verses.english_text: And those who denied our signs are the unfortunate people.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِاٰيَاتِنَا هُمْ اَصْحٰبُ الْمَشْـَٔمَةِ

verses.english_text: They will be thrown into the fire, and it will be closed from all sides.
verses.arabic_text: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌ

verses.english_text: I swear by the light of the Sun.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الشَّمْسِ وَ ضُحٰهَا

verses.english_text: And I swear by the moon which follows it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الْقَمَرِ اِذَا تَلٰهَا

verses.english_text: And I swear by the day when it gives brightness.
verses.arabic_text: وَ النَّهَارِ اِذَا جَلّٰهَا

verses.english_text: And I swear by the night when it covers up.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّيْلِ اِذَا يَغْشٰهَا

verses.english_text: And I swear by the sky, and of Him who made it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ السَّمَآءِ وَ مَا بَنٰهَا

verses.english_text: And I swear by the earth, and of Him who spread it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا طَحٰهَا

verses.english_text: And I swear by the Soul, and of Him who perfected it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ نَفْسٍ وَّ مَا سَوّٰهَا

verses.english_text: Then guided about evil and righteousness.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَ تَقْوٰهَا

verses.english_text: Verily, he is successful, who purified himself.
verses.arabic_text: قَدْ اَفْلَحَ مَن زَكّٰهَا

verses.english_text: And he became hopeless [of one] who polluted it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسّٰهَا

verses.english_text: Samood denied the prophet because of their rebelliousness.
verses.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوٰهَا

verses.english_text: When the most unfortunate of them stood up.
verses.arabic_text: اِذِ انْبَعَثَ اَشْقٰهَا

verses.english_text: So, the messenger of Allah said to take care of Allah's she-camel and let her drink.
verses.arabic_text: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللّٰهِ نَاقَةَ اللّٰهِ وَ سُقْيٰهَا

verses.english_text: So they denied him, and hamstrung her; so Allah sent down the punishment due to their sin and levelled them completely (to the ground).
verses.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسَوّٰهَا

verses.english_text: And he does not have any fear of its consequences.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا يَخَافُ عُقْبٰهَا

verses.english_text: I swear by the night when it covers the day.
verses.arabic_text: وَالَّيْلِ اِذَا يَغْشٰى

verses.english_text: And I swear by the day when it brightens up.
verses.arabic_text: وَ النَّهَارِ اِذَا تَجَلَٰى

verses.english_text: And I swear by Him, who has created man and woman.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَ الانْثٰى

verses.english_text: Verily your endeavors are of different kinds.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتّٰى

verses.english_text: Then who gave wealth and adopted piety.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّا مَنْ اَعْطَىٰ وَ اتَّقٰى

verses.english_text: And confirmed the goodness.
verses.arabic_text: وَ صَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنٰى

verses.english_text: So We will make things easy for him.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرٰى

verses.english_text: Who did miserliness and carelessness.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَمَّا مَن بَخِلَ وَاسْتَغْنَىٰ

verses.english_text: And denied goodness.
verses.arabic_text: وَكَذَّبَ بِالْحُسْنٰى

verses.english_text: For him We will make the way difficult.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ

verses.english_text: And his wealth will not avail him when he will be perished.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ اِذَا تَرَدّٰى

verses.english_text: Verily, responsibility of guidance is upon Us.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدٰى

verses.english_text: And the power of the world and the Hereafter is in Our Hands.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنَّ لَنَا لَلْآخِرَةَ وَ الْاُولَى

verses.english_text: So We have warned you from the flaring fire.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَٰى

verses.english_text: Wherein no one will go except the wretched ones.
verses.arabic_text: لَا يَصْلٰهَآ اِلَّا الْاَشْقَى

verses.english_text: Who denied and turned away.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَ تَوَلّٰى

verses.english_text: And shortly pious people will be kept away from it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ سَيُجَنَّبُهَا الْاَتْقَى

verses.english_text: Who arranges his purity by giving away his wealth.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِي يُؤْتِي مَالَهُ يَتَزَكّٰى

verses.english_text: Whereas he does not have any favor which should be recompensed.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا لِاَحَدٍ عِندَهُ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزٰى

verses.english_text: Except that he is a seeker of will of the Great Lord.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا ابْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ الْاَعْلَٰى

verses.english_text: And shortly he will be satisfied.
verses.arabic_text: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ

verses.english_text: I swear by the early hours of the day.
verses.arabic_text: وَالضُّحَىٰ

verses.english_text: And (I) swear by the night when it covers the things.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الَّيْلِ اِذَا سَجَىٰ

verses.english_text: Your Lord has not abandoned you, nor is he offended by you.
verses.arabic_text: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَ مَا قَلَىٰ

verses.english_text: And the Hereafter is much better for you than this world.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَلْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ الْاُولَىٰ

verses.english_text: And soon your Lord will give you so much that you shall be well pleased.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰ

verses.english_text: Did not He give you shelter finding you orphan.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَآوَىٰ

verses.english_text: And did not He reach you to the destination finding you lost.
verses.arabic_text: وَ وَجَدَكَ ضَالًّا فَهَدَىٰ

verses.english_text: And did not He make you needless finding you in straitness.
verses.arabic_text: وَ وَجَدَكَ عَائِلًا فَاَغْنَىٰ

verses.english_text: Therefore, now you do not oppress the orphan.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّا الْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ

verses.english_text: And as for him who asks, do not chide (him).
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَمَّا السَّائِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ

verses.english_text: And as for the favor of your Lord, do announce (it).
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ

verses.english_text: Have We not expanded for you, your breast?
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ

verses.english_text: And have we not taken off your burden?
verses.arabic_text: وَ وَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ

verses.english_text: Which had broken your back.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِىْٓ اَنْقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ

verses.english_text: And have exalted your remembrance?
verses.arabic_text: وَ رَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ

verses.english_text: Yes! With difficulty is also the ease.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

verses.english_text: Verily with the difficulty, there is more relief.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

verses.english_text: So, when you become free (from your obligations), do nominate.
verses.arabic_text: فَاِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانصَبْ

verses.english_text: And turn to your Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِلَٰى رَبِّكَ فَارْغَبْ

verses.english_text: I swear by the fig and the olive.
verses.arabic_text: وَ التِّينِ وَ الزَّيْتُونِ

verses.english_text: And by Mount Sinai.
verses.arabic_text: وَ طُورِ سِينِينَ

verses.english_text: And by this peaceful city.
verses.arabic_text: وَ هٰذَا الْبَلَدِ الْاَمِينِ

verses.english_text: We have created the man in the best creation.
verses.arabic_text: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنسَانَ فِىٓ اَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ

verses.english_text: Then We returned him to the lowest position.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنٰهُ اَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ

verses.english_text: Except those who believed, and they performed the good deeds, so they shall have a never-ending reward.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُمْ اَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ

verses.english_text: Then who can believe you about the Day of Judgment?
verses.arabic_text: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِالدِّينِ

verses.english_text: Is Allah not the greatest of the Rulers and the one who judges.
verses.arabic_text: اَلَيْسَ اللّٰهُ بِاَحْكَمِ الْحٰكِمِينَ

verses.english_text: Read in the name of your Lord Who created (you).
verses.arabic_text: اقْرَاَ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِى خَلَقَ

verses.english_text: He created man from a blood clot.
verses.arabic_text: خَلَقَ الْاِِنسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ

verses.english_text: Read and your Lord is most Merciful.
verses.arabic_text: اقْرَاْ وَ رَبُّكَ الْاَكْرَمُ

verses.english_text: Who taught (to write) through the pen.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِىْ عَلَّمَ بِالْقَلَمِ

verses.english_text: And taught all that to the man what he had not known.
verses.arabic_text: عَلَّمَ الْاِِنسَانَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ

verses.english_text: Indeed, man does rebelliousness.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّآ اِنَّ الْاِِنسَانَ لَيَطْغٰٓى

verses.english_text: That he imagines himself to be needless.
verses.arabic_text: اَن رَّاٰهُ اسْتَغْنٰى

verses.english_text: Verily to your Lord is the return.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ اِلَٰى رَبِّكَ الرُّجْعٰى

verses.english_text: Have you seen the one who prohibits?
verses.arabic_text: اَرَءَيْتَ الَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ

verses.english_text: A servant when he prays?
verses.arabic_text: عَبْدًا اِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Did you see if he is on guidance?
verses.arabic_text: اَرَءَيْتَ اِن كَانَ عَلَى الْهُدَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Or orders for piousness (then why to stop him).
verses.arabic_text: اَوْ اَمَرَ بِالتَّقْوَىٰٓ

verses.english_text: Did you see that infidel denied and turned his face.
verses.arabic_text: اَرَءَيْتَ اِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ

verses.english_text: So, don't you know that Allah does see?
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَرَىٰ

verses.english_text: Remember! if he did not desist from prohibiting, We would drag (him) from hairs of his forehead.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِالنَّاصِيَةِ

verses.english_text: Hairs of forehead of liar and wrongdoer.
verses.arabic_text: نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَـٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ

verses.english_text: Then let him call his companions.
verses.arabic_text: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ

verses.english_text: We too then would call the executioner-angels.
verses.arabic_text: سَنَدْعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَ

verses.english_text: Remember, never obey him; and draw near to Allah by making obeisance.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَاسْجُدْ وَاقْتَرِب ۩

verses.english_text: Verily, We revealed it on the Grand Night.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّآ اَنزَلْنٰهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ

verses.english_text: And what do you know what a great thing this Grand Night is?
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَدْرٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ

verses.english_text: The Grand Night is better than a thousand months.
verses.arabic_text: لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ اَلْفِ شَهْرٍ

verses.english_text: The angels and the Holy Spirit descend in it by the permission of their Lord with all the affairs.
verses.arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ وَ الرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ اَمْرٍ

verses.english_text: Peace is this night until the rise of dawn.
verses.arabic_text: سَلٰمٌ هِىَ حَتّٰى مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ

verses.english_text: Those of the People of the Book who are infidels and other polytheists were not going to separate from their disbelief until they would have received a manifest argument.
verses.arabic_text: لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ وَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنْفَكِّينَ حَتّٰى تَاْتِيَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ

verses.english_text: Messenger of Allah who recites pure scriptures.
verses.arabic_text: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ يَتْلُوا صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً

verses.english_text: Wherein all the precious and strong commands are written.
verses.arabic_text: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ

verses.english_text: And these People of Book were not divided until the manifest argument had not come to them.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَا تَفَرَّقَ الَّذِينَ اُوتُوا الْكِتٰبَ اِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ

verses.english_text: And they were enjoined only for that they should worship Allah, and worship Him sincerely, and establish prayer and give the poor-rate, and this is the true and right religion.
