verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اُمِرُوٓا اِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَ يُقِيمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَ يُؤْتُوا الزَّكٰوةَ  وَ ذٰلِكَ دِينُ الْقَيِّمَةِ

verses.english_text: Verily those from among the People of Book who adopted infidelity and other polytheists shall be in Hell, abiding forever therein; and they are the worst of creatures.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ وَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ الْبَرِيَّةِ

verses.english_text: And those who believed and they did good deeds, are the best of the creatures.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ الْبَرِيَّةِ

verses.english_text: Their reward with their Lord is those gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever; Allah is well pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him; and this is all for him who has fear of the Lord in his heart.
verses.arabic_text: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنّٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ اَبَدًا رَّضِىَ اللّٰهُ عَنْهُمْ وَ رَضُوا عَنْهُ ذٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُ

verses.english_text: When the earth will tremble violently in an earthquake.
verses.arabic_text: اِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ الْاَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا

verses.english_text: And it will bring forth all its treasures.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَخْرَجَتِ الْاَرْضُ اَثْقَالَهَا

verses.english_text: And the man will say: What has befallen it?
verses.arabic_text: وَ قَالَ الْاِنسَانُ مَا لَهَا

verses.english_text: On that day it shall tell its news.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ اَخْبَارَهَا

verses.english_text: That your Lord has given it the direction.
verses.arabic_text: بِاَنَّ رَبَّكَ اَوْحٰى لَهَا

verses.english_text: On that day all the men shall come out of their graves in groups so that they may see their deeds.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ اَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْاْ اَعْمَالَهُمْ

verses.english_text: Then whoever has done an atom's worth of good shall see it.
verses.arabic_text: فَمَن يَّعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَّرَهُ

verses.english_text: And he who has done an atom's worth of evil shall see it.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَّرَهُ

verses.english_text: I swear by galloping horses.
verses.arabic_text: وَ الْعٰدِيٰتِ ضَبْحًا

verses.english_text: Who produce sparks by hitting their hooves.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْمُورِيٰتِ قَدْحًا

verses.english_text: launching raids in the morning.
verses.arabic_text: فَالْمُغِيرٰتِ صُبْحًا

verses.english_text: Then those who raise the dust of battle.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَثَرْنَ بِهِ نَقْعًا

verses.english_text: Then those who rush into the crowd of the enemy.
verses.arabic_text: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِ جَمْعًا

verses.english_text: Verily man is most ungrateful to his Lord.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْاِنسَانَ لِرَبِّهِ  لَكَنُودٌ

verses.english_text: And he himself is a witness of that.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنَّهُ عَلَٰى ذٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ

verses.english_text: And he is very tenacious in love of wealth.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اِنَّهُ لِحُبِّ الْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ

verses.english_text: Does he not know when the dead will be extracted from their graves.
verses.arabic_text: اَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ اِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى الْقُبُورِ

verses.english_text: And secrets of the breasts will be made obvious
verses.arabic_text: وَ حُصِّلَ مَا فِى الصُّدُورِ

verses.english_text: So their Lord that day shall be fully aware of their conditions.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌ

verses.english_text: The quivering!
verses.arabic_text: الْقَارِعَةُ

verses.english_text: And such a terrible quivering!
verses.arabic_text: مَا الْقَارِعَةُ

verses.english_text: And what will you comprehend how terrible the quivering is?
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَدْرٰكَ مَا الْقَارِعَةُ

verses.english_text: The day on which people shall become like scattered moths.
verses.arabic_text: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ النَّاسُ كَالْفَرَاشِ الْمَبْثُوثِ

verses.english_text: And the mountains shall be flying like beaten cotton.
verses.arabic_text: وَ تَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ الْمَنفُوشِ

verses.english_text: Then that day as for the one whose measure of good deeds will be heavy.
verses.arabic_text: فَاَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ

verses.english_text: He will be in a pleasing luxury.
verses.arabic_text: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ

verses.english_text: And as for him whose measure of deeds will be light.
verses.arabic_text: وَ اَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ

verses.english_text: Then his center will be ‘Haviya’.
verses.arabic_text: فَاُمُّهُ هَاوِيَةٌ

verses.english_text: And what will you know what a distress ‘Haviya’ is?
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَدْرٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ

verses.english_text: This is a raging fire.
verses.arabic_text: نَارٌ  حَامِيَةٌ

verses.english_text: Mutual competition and abundance of wealth and children have made you negligent.
verses.arabic_text: اَلْهٰكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ

verses.english_text: Even until you meet your graves.
verses.arabic_text: حَتّٰى زُرْتُمُ الْمَقَابِرَ

verses.english_text: Shortly you shall know.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: Then you will very well know
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.english_text: See! If you knew for sure.
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ الْيَقِينِ

verses.english_text: That you would surely see Hell;
verses.arabic_text: لَتَرَوُنَّ الْجَحِيمَ

verses.english_text: Then you will see it with your eyes and see it with certainty.
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ الْيَقِينِ

verses.english_text: Then on that day you shall be questioned about the bounties (of Allah).
verses.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيمِ

verses.english_text: I swear by the time (‘Asr’)
verses.arabic_text: وَالْعَصْرِ

verses.english_text: Verily, man is at a loss.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ الْاِنسَانَ لَفِي خُسْرٍ

verses.english_text: Except those who believed, and did good deeds; and they enjoin and admonish each other for truth and patience.
verses.arabic_text: اِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَ تَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَ تَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ

verses.english_text: Destruction to every taunter and backbiter.
verses.arabic_text: وَيْلٌ لِكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍ لُمَزَةٍ

verses.english_text: Who amassed the wealth and kept its accounting.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِي جَمَعَ مَالًا وَّعَدَّدَهُ

verses.english_text: He thought this wealth will make him immortal.
verses.arabic_text: يَحْسَبُ اَنَّ مَالَهُٓ اَخْلَدَهُ

verses.english_text: No way, he will verily be thrown in "Hutamah".
verses.arabic_text: كَلَّا لَيُنْبَذَنَّ فِي الْحُطَمَةِ

verses.english_text: And what do you know what "Hutamah" is?
verses.arabic_text: وَ مَآ اَدْرٰكَ مَا الْحُطَمَةُ

verses.english_text: It is the fire kindled by Allah.
verses.arabic_text: نَارُ اللّٰهِ الْمُوقَدَةُ

verses.english_text: Which rises above the hearts.
verses.arabic_text: الَّتِي تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى الْاَفْئِدَةِ

verses.english_text: That fire will encircle them from above.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِمْ مُؤْصَدَةٌ

verses.english_text: With long columns.
verses.arabic_text: فِي عَمَدٍ مُمَدَّدَةٍ

verses.english_text: Did not you see what your Lord did to the companions of the Elephant?
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِاَصْحٰبِ الْفِيلِ

verses.english_text: Did not He foil their plan?
verses.arabic_text: اَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِي تَضْلِيلٍ

verses.english_text: And sent upon them flocks of flying ababeel, (birds).
verses.arabic_text: وَّ اَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا اَبَابِيلَ

verses.english_text: Which showered upon them the stones of baked clay.
verses.arabic_text: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

verses.english_text: Then it made them like chewed straw.
verses.arabic_text: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّاْكُولٍ

verses.english_text: For the love of Quraish
verses.arabic_text: لِاِيلٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ

verses.english_text: For their protection during their trading in the winter and the summer.
verses.arabic_text: اِلٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ الشِّتَآءِ وَ الصَّيْفِ

verses.english_text: So they should worship the Lord of this House.
verses.arabic_text: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا رَبَّ هٰذَا الْبَيْتِ

verses.english_text: Who fed them in hunger and secured them from fear?
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِىٓ اَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَّ اٰمَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍ

verses.english_text: Did you see the man who denies the Day of Judgement.
verses.arabic_text: اَرَءَيْتَ الَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِالدِّينِ

verses.english_text: He is the one to treat the orphan with harshness.
verses.arabic_text: فَذٰلِكَ الَّذِي يَدُعُّ الْيَتِيمَ

verses.english_text: And does not encourage anyone to feed the needy.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَا يَحُضُّ عَلَٰى طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ

verses.english_text: So destruction for those people who pray.
verses.arabic_text: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ

verses.english_text: Those who neglect their prayers.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ

verses.english_text: And do the deeds for show-off.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ

verses.english_text: And they refuse to lend even the small things (to their neighbors).
verses.arabic_text: وَ يَمْنَعُونَ الْمَاعُونَ

verses.english_text: Verily, We bestow upon you Kausar.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّا اَعْطَيْنٰكَ الْكَوْثَرَ

verses.english_text: Therefore, pray to your Lord and give sacrifice.
verses.arabic_text: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَ انْحَرْ

verses.english_text: Certainly, your enemy will remain childless.
verses.arabic_text: اِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الْاَبْتَرُ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet!) Say: O infidels!
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْكٰفِرُونَ

verses.english_text: I cannot worship those gods whom you worship.
verses.arabic_text: لَآ اَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

verses.english_text: And neither you are going to worship my Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَآ اَنتُمْ عٰبِدُونَ مَآ اَعْبُدُ

verses.english_text: And nor I am not going to worship your gods.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَآ اَنَا عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدْتُّمْ

verses.english_text: And nor do you worship my Lord.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَآ اَنتُمْ عٰبِدُونَ مَآ اَعْبُدُ

verses.english_text: For you, is your religion, and for me, is my religion.
verses.arabic_text: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَ لِىَ دِينِ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet!) When Allah's help comes, victory (of Makkah) will come.
verses.arabic_text: اِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ اللّٰهِ وَ الْفَتْحُ

verses.english_text: And you will see that people are entering the religion of Allah in groups.
verses.arabic_text: وَ رَاَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُوْنَ فِىْ دِينِ اللّٰهِ اَفْوَاجًا

verses.english_text: Then glorify your Lord with praise and seek His forgiveness, for He is most accepting of repentance.
verses.arabic_text: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَ اسْتَغْفِرْهُ اِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا

verses.english_text: May the hands of Abu Lahab break and may he perish.
verses.arabic_text: تَبَّتْ يَدَآ اَبِى لَهَبٍ وَّ تَبَّ

verses.english_text: His wealth was not of any use to him which he had earned.
verses.arabic_text: مَآ اَغْنٰى عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَ مَا كَسَبَ

verses.english_text: Shortly he will enter into the severe flaring fire.
verses.arabic_text: سَيَصْلَٰى نَارًا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍ

verses.english_text: And his wife who carry the firewood on her head.
verses.arabic_text: وَّ امْرَاَتُهُ حَمَّالَةَ الْحَطَبِ

verses.english_text: A twisted rope is tied around her neck.
verses.arabic_text: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌ مِّنْ مَّسَدٍ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet!) Say: He, Allah is One.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ اللّٰهُ اَحَدٌ

verses.english_text: Allah is Truth and Self-Sufficient.
verses.arabic_text: اللّٰهُ الصَّمَدُ

verses.english_text: He neither begets, nor is begotten.
verses.arabic_text: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَ لَمْ يُولَدْ

verses.english_text: And no one is equal to Him, nor anyone is comparable to Him.
verses.arabic_text: وَ لَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا اَحَدٌ

verses.english_text: '(O Prophet!) Say:' I seek refuge from the Master of the dawn.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ

verses.english_text: From the evil of all the creatures.
verses.arabic_text: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

verses.english_text: And from the evil of darkness of night when darkness spreads
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ اِذَا وَقَبَ

verses.english_text: And from the evil of those who breath on the amulets.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِن شَرِّ النَّفّٰثّٰتِ فِى الْعُقَدِ

verses.english_text: And from the evil of envy, when they envy.
verses.arabic_text: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ اِذَا حَسَدَ

verses.english_text: (O Prophet!) Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of people.
verses.arabic_text: قُلْ اَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ

verses.english_text: The Master of mankind.
verses.arabic_text: مَلِكِ النَّاسِ

verses.english_text: The God of mankind.
verses.arabic_text: اِلٰهِ النَّاسِ

verses.english_text: (I) Seek refuge from the evil whispering of Satan, who withdraws (on hearing the name of Allah).
verses.arabic_text: مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ

verses.english_text: Who creates whispering in the hearts of mankind.
verses.arabic_text: الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ

verses.english_text: From among the Jinns and the men.
verses.arabic_text: مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ
